TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE = {}
TM_EPISODE_LIST_CACHE = {}
TM_EPISODE_CONTENT_CACHE = {}
TM_WARDROBE_CATALOG_CACHE = {}

function tmIsMacroRawKey(name)
    return TM_MACRO_RAW_KEYS[tostring(name or "")] == true
end

function tmIsPackedStoreName(name)
    return TM_PACKED_STORE_NAMES[tostring(name or "")] == true
end

function tmPackedStoreCacheKey(triggerId, storeName)
    return tostring(triggerId or "") .. "\31" .. tostring(storeName or "")
end

function tmInvalidatePackedStoreCache(triggerId, storeName)
    if type(TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE) ~= "table" then
        TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE = {}
        return
    end
    local store = tostring(storeName or "")
    if store ~= "" then
        TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE[tmPackedStoreCacheKey(triggerId, store)] = nil
        return
    end
    local triggerText = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if triggerText == "" then
        TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE = {}
        return
    end
    local prefix = triggerText .. "\31"
    for key in pairs(TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE) do
        if tostring(key):sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE[key] = nil
        end
    end
end

function tmRuntimeCacheStamp(triggerId)
    return table.concat({
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_id", "")),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_source", "")),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_seed", "")),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_created_at", "")),
    }, "\31")
end

function tmRawGetVar(triggerId, name)
    local val = getChatVar(triggerId, name)
    if val == nil or val == "" or val == "null" then return nil end
    return val
end

function tmRawSetVar(triggerId, name, value)
    local key = tostring(name or "")
    local text = tostring(value)
    local current = getChatVar(triggerId, key)
    if current ~= nil and tostring(current) == text then return false end
    if (current == nil or current == "null") and text == "" then return false end
    setChatVar(triggerId, key, text)
    if tmIsPackedStoreName(key) then tmInvalidatePackedStoreCache(triggerId, key) end
    return true
end

function tmPackEscape(value)
    local s = tostring(value or "")
    s = s:gsub("%%", "%%25")
    s = s:gsub("\r", "%%0D")
    s = s:gsub("\n", "%%0A")
    s = s:gsub("|", "%%7C")
    s = s:gsub("~", "%%7E")
    s = s:gsub("=", "%%3D")
    return s
end

function tmPackUnescape(value)
    local s = tostring(value or "")
    s = s:gsub("%%0D", "\r")
    s = s:gsub("%%0A", "\n")
    s = s:gsub("%%7C", "|")
    s = s:gsub("%%7E", "~")
    s = s:gsub("%%3D", "=")
    s = s:gsub("%%25", "%%")
    return s
end

function tmReadPackedStore(triggerId, storeName)
    local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, storeName)
    local key = tmPackedStoreCacheKey(triggerId, storeName)
    local cached = TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE[key]
    if cached and cached.raw == raw then return cached.store end
    local store = {}
    if raw == nil then
        TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE[key] = {raw = raw, store = store}
        return store
    end
    for record in tostring(raw):gmatch("[^|]+") do
        local encodedId, rest = record:match("^([^~]*)~?(.*)$")
        local id = tmPackUnescape(encodedId or "")
        if id ~= "" then
            local fields = {}
            for token in tostring(rest or ""):gmatch("[^~]+") do
                local k, v = token:match("^([^=]*)=(.*)$")
                if k then fields[tmPackUnescape(k)] = tmPackUnescape(v or "") end
            end
            store[id] = fields
        end
    end
    TM_PACKED_STORE_CACHE[key] = {raw = raw, store = store}
    return store
end

function tmWritePackedStore(triggerId, storeName, store)
    local ids = {}
    for id, fields in pairs(store or {}) do
        if id ~= "" and type(fields) == "table" then table.insert(ids, id) end
    end
    table.sort(ids)
    local records = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
        local fields = store[id] or {}
        local keys = {}
        for key, value in pairs(fields) do
            if key ~= "" and value ~= nil then table.insert(keys, key) end
        end
        table.sort(keys)
        local parts = {tmPackEscape(id)}
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            table.insert(parts, tmPackEscape(key) .. "=" .. tmPackEscape(fields[key]))
        end
        table.insert(records, table.concat(parts, "~"))
    end
    local changed = tmRawSetVar(triggerId, storeName, table.concat(records, "|"))
    if changed then tmInvalidatePackedStoreCache(triggerId, storeName) end
    return changed
end

TM_PERSISTENT_DRAWER_OPEN_FIELDS = {
    tm_side_panel = "",
    ui_charsheet_open = "false",
    tm_drawer_keep_active = "",
    tm_active_drawer = "",
    tm_drawer_open_anim = "",
}

function tmDecodePackedStoreValue(value)
    local raw = tostring(value or "")
    local store = {}
    if raw == "" then return store end
    for record in raw:gmatch("[^|]+") do
        local encodedId, rest = record:match("^([^~]*)~?(.*)$")
        local id = tmPackUnescape(encodedId or "")
        if id ~= "" then
            local fields = {}
            for token in tostring(rest or ""):gmatch("[^~]+") do
                local k, v = token:match("^([^=]*)=(.*)$")
                if k then fields[tmPackUnescape(k)] = tmPackUnescape(v or "") end
            end
            store[id] = fields
        end
    end
    return store
end

function tmEncodePackedStoreValue(store)
    local ids = {}
    for id, fields in pairs(store or {}) do
        if id ~= "" and type(fields) == "table" then table.insert(ids, id) end
    end
    table.sort(ids)
    local records = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
        local fields = store[id] or {}
        local keys = {}
        for key, value in pairs(fields) do
            if key ~= "" and value ~= nil then table.insert(keys, key) end
        end
        table.sort(keys)
        local parts = {tmPackEscape(id)}
        for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
            table.insert(parts, tmPackEscape(key) .. "=" .. tmPackEscape(fields[key]))
        end
        table.insert(records, table.concat(parts, "~"))
    end
    return table.concat(records, "|")
end

function tmSanitizeUiPackedValue(value)
    local raw = tostring(value or "")
    if raw == "" then return raw end
    local store = tmDecodePackedStoreValue(raw)
    local ui = store.ui or {}
    store.ui = ui
    for field, defaultValue in pairs(TM_PERSISTENT_DRAWER_OPEN_FIELDS) do
        ui[field] = defaultValue
    end
    return tmEncodePackedStoreValue(store)
end

function tmSanitizeSavePackedValue(storeName, value)
    local name = tostring(storeName or "")
    if name == "tm_ui" then return tmSanitizeUiPackedValue(value) end
    if name ~= "tm_flow" then return tostring(value or "") end
    local raw = tostring(value or "")
    if raw == "" then return raw end
    local store = tmDecodePackedStoreValue(raw)
    local flow = store.flow or {}
    store.flow = flow
    flow.action_locked = nil
    flow.action_started_at = nil
    return tmEncodePackedStoreValue(store)
end

function tmSanitizeSaveSnapshotValue(key, value)
    return tmSanitizeSavePackedValue(key, value)
end

function tmGetPackedField(triggerId, storeName, recordId, fieldName)
    local store = tmReadPackedStore(triggerId, storeName)
    local record = store[tostring(recordId or "")]
    if not record then return nil end
    local val = record[tostring(fieldName or "")]
    if val == nil then return nil end
    return tostring(val)
end

function tmSetPackedField(triggerId, storeName, recordId, fieldName, value)
    local store = tmReadPackedStore(triggerId, storeName)
    local id = tostring(recordId or "")
    if id == "" then return false, false end
    store[id] = store[id] or {}
    local field = tostring(fieldName or "")
    local text = tostring(value or "")
    if store[id][field] ~= nil and tostring(store[id][field]) == text then
        return true, false
    end
    store[id][field] = text
    local changed = tmWritePackedStore(triggerId, storeName, store)
    return true, changed == true
end

function tmSplitCsvPreserve(raw, expectedCount)
    local out = {}
    for item in (tostring(raw or "") .. ","):gmatch("(.-),") do
        table.insert(out, item)
    end
    while #out < expectedCount do table.insert(out, "") end
    return out
end

function tmCompressedPlayerParts(name)
    local key = tostring(name or "")
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(TM_COMPRESSED_OWNER_IDS) do
        local prefix = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_"
        if key:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            return ownerId, key:sub(#prefix + 1)
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

function tmCompressedPlayerStatsFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
    local values, found = {}, false
    for _, stat in ipairs(TM_COMPRESSED_STAT_KEYS) do
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. stat)
        if raw ~= nil then found = true end
        table.insert(values, raw or "10")
    end
    if not found then return nil end
    local packed = table.concat(values, ",")
    tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "stats", packed)
    return packed
end

function tmCompressedPlayerVitalDefaults(ownerId)
    local defaults = TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_DEFAULTS[ownerId] or TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_DEFAULTS.yuseola
    local values = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_KEYS) do
        table.insert(values, defaults[key] or "")
    end
    return values
end

function tmCompressedPlayerVitalFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
    local values, found = tmCompressedPlayerVitalDefaults(ownerId), false
    for idx, key in ipairs(TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_KEYS) do
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. key)
        if raw ~= nil then
            values[idx] = raw
            found = true
        end
    end
    if not found then return nil end
    local packed = table.concat(values, ",")
    tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "vital", packed)
    return packed
end

function tmCompressedPlayerDerived(triggerId, ownerId, fieldName)
    if fieldName == "name_ko" and type(CHAR_NAMES_KO) == "table" then
        return CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId]
    end
    if fieldName == "class_name" and type(tmClassName) == "function" then
        local classId = tmGetCompressedPlayerVar(triggerId, ownerId, "class")
        if classId ~= nil and classId ~= "" then return tmClassNameForLang(triggerId, classId) end
    end
    return nil
end

function tmGetCompressedPlayerVar(triggerId, ownerId, fieldName)
    if not TM_COMPRESSED_OWNER_SET[ownerId] then return nil end
    local field = tostring(fieldName or "")
    if field == "stats" then
        return tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "stats")
            or tmCompressedPlayerStatsFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
    end
    local statIdx = TM_COMPRESSED_STAT_INDEX[field]
    if statIdx then
        local stats = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "stats")
            or tmCompressedPlayerStatsFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
        if stats ~= nil then
            local values = tmSplitCsvPreserve(stats, #TM_COMPRESSED_STAT_KEYS)
            if values[statIdx] ~= nil and values[statIdx] ~= "" then return values[statIdx] end
        end
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. field)
        if raw ~= nil then
            tmSetCompressedPlayerVar(triggerId, ownerId, field, raw)
            return raw
        end
        return nil
    end
    if field == "vital" then
        return tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "vital")
            or tmCompressedPlayerVitalFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
    end
    local vitalIdx = TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_INDEX[field]
    if vitalIdx then
        local vital = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "vital")
            or tmCompressedPlayerVitalFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
        if vital ~= nil then
            local values = tmSplitCsvPreserve(vital, #TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_KEYS)
            if values[vitalIdx] ~= nil and values[vitalIdx] ~= "" then return values[vitalIdx] end
        end
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. field)
        if raw ~= nil then
            tmSetCompressedPlayerVar(triggerId, ownerId, field, raw)
            return raw
        end
        return nil
    end
    local derived = tmCompressedPlayerDerived(triggerId, ownerId, field)
    if derived ~= nil then return derived end
    local val = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, field)
    if val ~= nil then return val end
    local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. field)
    if raw ~= nil then
        tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, field, raw)
        return raw
    end
    return nil
end

function tmSetCompressedPlayerVar(triggerId, ownerId, fieldName, value)
    if not TM_COMPRESSED_OWNER_SET[ownerId] then return false end
    local field = tostring(fieldName or "")
    if field == "name_ko" or field == "class_name" then return true end
    if field == "stats" then
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "stats", value)
    end
    local statIdx = TM_COMPRESSED_STAT_INDEX[field]
    if statIdx then
        local stats = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "stats")
            or tmCompressedPlayerStatsFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
            or "10,10,10,10,10,10"
        local values = tmSplitCsvPreserve(stats, #TM_COMPRESSED_STAT_KEYS)
        values[statIdx] = tostring(value or "")
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "stats", table.concat(values, ","))
    end
    if field == "vital" then
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "vital", value)
    end
    local vitalIdx = TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_INDEX[field]
    if vitalIdx then
        local vital = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "vital")
            or tmCompressedPlayerVitalFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
        local values = vital and tmSplitCsvPreserve(vital, #TM_COMPRESSED_VITAL_KEYS)
            or tmCompressedPlayerVitalDefaults(ownerId)
        values[vitalIdx] = tostring(value or "")
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, "vital", table.concat(values, ","))
    end
    return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_players", ownerId, field, value)
end

function tmCompressedEpisodeChoiceParts(name)
    local idx = tostring(name or ""):match("^tm_episode_choice_(%d+)$")
    if idx then return "tm_episode_choice_" .. idx end
    return nil
end

function tmCompressedXpParts(name)
    local key = tostring(name or "")
    if key:match("^xp_awarded_[%w_%-]+$") or key:match("^roll_xp_total_[%w_%-]+$") then
        return key
    end
    return nil
end

function tmCompressedObjectParts(name)
    local key = tostring(name or "")
    local slot = key:match("^tm_obj_(%d%d)$")
    if slot then return "slot" .. slot, "record" end
    if key == "tm_obj_next_slot" then return "meta", "next_slot" end
    if key == "tm_obj_last" then return "meta", "last" end
    if key == "last_runtime_object_error" then return "meta", "last_error" end
    local currentKind = key:match("^current_([%w]+)$")
    if currentKind == "enemy" or currentKind == "npc" or currentKind == "gimmick" then
        return "meta", "current_" .. currentKind
    end
    local currentSlotKind = key:match("^current_([%w]+)_slot$")
    if currentSlotKind == "enemy" or currentSlotKind == "npc" or currentSlotKind == "gimmick" then
        return "meta", "current_" .. currentSlotKind .. "_slot"
    end
    return nil, nil
end

function tmCompressedEnemyParts(name)
    local key = tostring(name or "")
    if key:sub(1, 6) ~= "enemy_" then return nil, nil end
    for _, field in ipairs({"gold_awarded", "xp_awarded", "hp_max", "defeated", "special", "name", "hp", "dc", "atk"}) do
        local tail = "_" .. field
        if key:sub(-#tail) == tail then
            local enemyId = key:sub(7, #key - #tail)
            if enemyId ~= "" then return enemyId, field end
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

function tmGetCompressedVar(triggerId, name)
    local ownerId, playerField = tmCompressedPlayerParts(name)
    if ownerId then return tmGetCompressedPlayerVar(triggerId, ownerId, playerField) end

    local enemyId, enemyField = tmCompressedEnemyParts(name)
    if enemyId then
        local recordId = "enemy:" .. enemyId
        local val = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_objs", recordId, enemyField)
        if val ~= nil then return val end
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, name)
        if raw ~= nil then
            tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_objs", recordId, enemyField, raw)
            return raw
        end
        return nil
    end

    local objectRecordId, objectField = tmCompressedObjectParts(name)
    if objectRecordId then
        local val = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_objs", objectRecordId, objectField)
        if val ~= nil then return val end
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, name)
        if raw ~= nil then
            tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_objs", objectRecordId, objectField, raw)
            return raw
        end
        return nil
    end

    local choiceKey = tmCompressedEpisodeChoiceParts(name)
    if choiceKey then
        local val = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_runtime", "runtime", choiceKey)
        if val ~= nil then return val end
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, name)
        if raw ~= nil then
            tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_runtime", "runtime", choiceKey, raw)
            return raw
        end
        return nil
    end

    local xpKey = tmCompressedXpParts(name)
    if xpKey then
        local val = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_runtime", "runtime", xpKey)
        if val ~= nil then return val end
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, name)
        if raw ~= nil then
            tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_runtime", "runtime", xpKey, raw)
            return raw
        end
        return nil
    end

    local map = TM_PACKED_KEY_MAP[name]
    if map then
        local val = tmGetPackedField(triggerId, map[1], map[2], map[3])
        if val ~= nil then return val end
        local raw = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, name)
        if raw ~= nil then
            tmSetPackedField(triggerId, map[1], map[2], map[3], raw)
            return raw
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function tmSetCompressedVar(triggerId, name, value)
    local ownerId, playerField = tmCompressedPlayerParts(name)
    if ownerId then return tmSetCompressedPlayerVar(triggerId, ownerId, playerField, value) end

    local enemyId, enemyField = tmCompressedEnemyParts(name)
    if enemyId then
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_objs", "enemy:" .. enemyId, enemyField, value)
    end

    local objectRecordId, objectField = tmCompressedObjectParts(name)
    if objectRecordId then
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_objs", objectRecordId, objectField, value)
    end

    local choiceKey = tmCompressedEpisodeChoiceParts(name)
    if choiceKey then
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_runtime", "runtime", choiceKey, value)
    end

    local xpKey = tmCompressedXpParts(name)
    if xpKey then
        return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, "tm_runtime", "runtime", xpKey, value)
    end

    local map = TM_PACKED_KEY_MAP[name]
    if map then return tmSetPackedField(triggerId, map[1], map[2], map[3], value) end
    return false
end

function getVar(triggerId, name, default)
    if default == nil then default = "" end
    local key = tostring(name or "")
    local val = nil
    if tmIsMacroRawKey(key) then val = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, key) end
    if val == nil then val = tmGetCompressedVar(triggerId, key) end
    if val == nil and not tmIsMacroRawKey(key) then val = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, key) end
    if val == nil or val == "" or val == "null" then
        return default
    end
    return val
end

function getNumVar(triggerId, name, default)
    if default == nil then default = 0 end
    local val = getVar(triggerId, name, "")
    if val == nil or val == "" or val == "null" then
        return default
    end
    local n = tonumber(val)
    if n == nil then
        return default
    end
    return n
end

function setVar(triggerId, name, value)
    local key = tostring(name or "")
    if tmIsMacroRawKey(key) then
        local changed = tmRawSetVar(triggerId, key, value)
        -- Write-through for dual keys (macro-raw AND packed) so packed stores can
        -- never hold a stale copy that later poisons save seeds. (v1.11.12 FIX-B)
        local map = TM_PACKED_KEY_MAP[key]
        if map then tmSetPackedField(triggerId, map[1], map[2], map[3], value) end
        if changed and type(tmRecordTemporaryChange) == "function" then
            tmRecordTemporaryChange(triggerId, key, value)
        end
        return
    end
    local compressed, compressedChanged = tmSetCompressedVar(triggerId, key, value)
    if compressed then
        if compressedChanged and type(tmRecordTemporaryChange) == "function" then
            tmRecordTemporaryChange(triggerId, key, value)
        end
        return
    end
    local changed = tmRawSetVar(triggerId, key, value)
    if changed and type(tmRecordTemporaryChange) == "function" then
        tmRecordTemporaryChange(triggerId, key, value)
    end
end

TM_SAVE_SEED_STORE_KEY = "tm_save_seed_store"
TM_SAVE_SEED_GC_COUNTER_KEY = "tm_save_seed_gc_counter"
TM_SAVE_TEMP_DELTA_KEY = "tm_save_temporary_delta"
TM_SAVE_LATEST_SEED_KEY = "tm_save_latest_seed"
TM_SAVE_REQUEST_SEED_KEY = "tm_save_request_seed_for_output"
TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_CODE_KEY = "tm_save_export_code"
TM_SAVE_EXPORT_DISPLAY_TEXT_KEY = "tm_save_export_display_text"
TM_SAVE_SEED_GC_INTERVAL = 40
TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = false
TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_IN_PROGRESS = false
TM_PANEL_REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS = false
TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_PREFIX = "tm1_"
TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_MAGIC = "TMSS1"
TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_"

TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEYS = {
    "tm_schema", "tm_core", "tm_flow", "tm_ui", "tm_story", "tm_log",
    "tm_players", "tm_registry", "tm_objs", "tm_runtime",
    "lang", "wizard_step", "opening_route", "session_prep_open", "session_started",
    "game_mode", "nai_guide_text", "image_guide_text", "asset_display",
}

TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEY_SET = {}
for _, tmSaveKey in ipairs(TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEYS) do
    TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEY_SET[tmSaveKey] = true
end

TM_SAVE_TEMP_EXCLUDED_KEYS = {
    action_locked = true,
    action_started_at = true,
    character_generation_pending = true,
    tm_active_drawer = true,
    tm_control_panel_html = true,
    tm_drawer_keep_active = true,
    tm_drawer_open_anim = true,
    tm_side_panel = true,
    tm_guide_refresh_loading = true,
    tm_save_code_pending = true,
    tm_session_load_pending = true,
    tm_custom_class_generating = true,
    ui_charsheet_open = true,
}

function tmStateGet(triggerId, key, default)
    if type(getState) ~= "function" then return default end
    local ok, value = pcall(getState, triggerId, key)
    if not ok or value == nil then return default end
    return value
end

function tmStateSet(triggerId, key, value)
    if type(setState) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok = pcall(setState, triggerId, key, value)
    return ok == true
end

function tmSaveSeedStore(triggerId)
    local store = tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_SEED_STORE_KEY, nil)
    if type(store) ~= "table" then store = {data = {}} end
    if type(store.data) ~= "table" then store.data = {} end
    return store
end

function tmMakeSaveSeed(triggerId)
    local chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"
    local store = tmSaveSeedStore(triggerId)
    for _ = 1, 20 do
        local seed = "t"
        for _ = 1, 18 do
            local idx = math.random(1, #chars)
            seed = seed .. chars:sub(idx, idx)
        end
        if not store.data[seed] then return seed end
    end
    return "t" .. tostring(tmNow()) .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
end

function tmStripSaveSeedTags(text)
    local out = tostring(text or "")
    out = out:gsub("<!%-%-%[TMSEED%|[^%]]+%]%-%->", "")
    out = out:gsub("<!%-%-%[SEED%|[^%]]+%]%-%->", "")
    return out
end

function tmExtractLatestSaveSeed(text)
    local seed = nil
    for found in tostring(text or ""):gmatch("<!%-%-%[TMSEED%|([^%]]+)%]%-%->") do
        seed = found
    end
    if seed ~= nil then return seed end
    for found in tostring(text or ""):gmatch("<!%-%-%[SEED%|([^%]]+)%]%-%->") do
        seed = found
    end
    return seed
end

function tmBase64UrlMap()
    if type(TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_MAP) == "table" then return TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_MAP end
    local map = {}
    for i = 1, #TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_ALPHABET do
        map[TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_ALPHABET:sub(i, i)] = i - 1
    end
    TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_MAP = map
    return map
end

function tmBase64UrlEncode(raw)
    local s = tostring(raw or "")
    if s == "" then return "" end
    local out = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #s do
        local b1 = s:byte(i) or 0
        local b2 = s:byte(i + 1)
        local b3 = s:byte(i + 2)
        local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
        local c1 = math.floor(n / 262144) % 64
        local c2 = math.floor(n / 4096) % 64
        local c3 = math.floor(n / 64) % 64
        local c4 = n % 64
        out[#out + 1] = TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_ALPHABET:sub(c1 + 1, c1 + 1)
        out[#out + 1] = TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_ALPHABET:sub(c2 + 1, c2 + 1)
        if b2 ~= nil then out[#out + 1] = TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_ALPHABET:sub(c3 + 1, c3 + 1) end
        if b3 ~= nil then out[#out + 1] = TM_SAVE_BASE64URL_ALPHABET:sub(c4 + 1, c4 + 1) end
        i = i + 3
    end
    return table.concat(out, "")
end

function tmBase64UrlDecode(encoded)
    local input = tostring(encoded or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if input == "" then return "" end
    if (#input % 4) == 1 then return nil end
    local map = tmBase64UrlMap()
    local out = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #input do
        local chunkLen = math.min(4, #input - i + 1)
        local c1 = map[input:sub(i, i)]
        local c2 = map[input:sub(i + 1, i + 1)]
        local c3 = chunkLen >= 3 and map[input:sub(i + 2, i + 2)] or 0
        local c4 = chunkLen >= 4 and map[input:sub(i + 3, i + 3)] or 0
        if c1 == nil or c2 == nil or (chunkLen >= 3 and c3 == nil) or (chunkLen >= 4 and c4 == nil) then
            return nil
        end
        local n = c1 * 262144 + c2 * 4096 + (c3 or 0) * 64 + (c4 or 0)
        out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256)
        if chunkLen >= 3 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 256) % 256) end
        if chunkLen >= 4 then out[#out + 1] = string.char(n % 256) end
        i = i + 4
    end
    return table.concat(out, "")
end

function tmCollectSaveState(triggerId, options)
    local collectOptions = options or {}
    if type(tmRefreshSavedRecentChatTail) == "function" then
        pcall(tmRefreshSavedRecentChatTail, triggerId, collectOptions.currentOutput or "")
    end
    local vars = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEYS) do
        local value = nil
        if type(getChatVar) == "function" then
            value = getChatVar(triggerId, key)
        end
        vars[key] = tmSanitizeSaveSnapshotValue(key, value)
    end
    return {
        schema = TM_PACK_SCHEMA,
        version = GAME_VERSION,
        created_at = tmNow(),
        vars = vars,
    }
end

function tmSerializePortableSaveState(stateTable)
    if type(stateTable) ~= "table" or type(stateTable.vars) ~= "table" then return "" end
    local parts = {TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_MAGIC}
    parts[#parts + 1] = "schema=" .. tmPackEscape(stateTable.schema or TM_PACK_SCHEMA)
    parts[#parts + 1] = "version=" .. tmPackEscape(stateTable.version or GAME_VERSION)
    parts[#parts + 1] = "created_at=" .. tmPackEscape(stateTable.created_at or tmNow())
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEYS) do
        if stateTable.vars[key] ~= nil then
            parts[#parts + 1] = tmPackEscape(key) .. "=" .. tmPackEscape(stateTable.vars[key])
        end
    end
    return table.concat(parts, "|")
end

function tmDeserializePortableSaveState(payload)
    local text = tostring(payload or "")
    if text == "" then return nil end
    local state = {schema = TM_PACK_SCHEMA, version = GAME_VERSION, created_at = 0, vars = {}}
    local first = true
    local sawMagic = false
    for token in (text .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        if first then
            first = false
            if token ~= TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_MAGIC then return nil end
            sawMagic = true
        else
            local key, value = token:match("^([^=]*)=(.*)$")
            if key ~= nil then
                key = tmPackUnescape(key)
                value = tmPackUnescape(value or "")
                if key == "schema" then
                    state.schema = value
                elseif key == "version" then
                    state.version = value
                elseif key == "created_at" then
                    state.created_at = tonumber(value) or 0
                elseif TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEY_SET[key] then
                    state.vars[key] = tmSanitizeSaveSnapshotValue(key, value)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not sawMagic then return nil end
    return state
end

function tmEncodePortableSaveState(stateTable)
    local serialized = tmSerializePortableSaveState(stateTable)
    if serialized == "" then return "" end
    return TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_PREFIX .. tmBase64UrlEncode(serialized)
end

function tmDecodePortableSaveCode(code)
    local text = tmTrimText(code)
    if text:sub(1, #TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_PREFIX) ~= TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_PREFIX then return nil end
    local payload = tmBase64UrlDecode(text:sub(#TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_PREFIX + 1))
    if payload == nil or payload == "" then return nil end
    return tmDeserializePortableSaveState(payload)
end

function tmRememberSaveSeedState(triggerId, seed, stateTable)
    local store = tmSaveSeedStore(triggerId)
    store.data[tostring(seed or "")] = stateTable
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_SEED_STORE_KEY, store)
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_LATEST_SEED_KEY, tostring(seed or ""))
end

function tmReferencedSaveSeeds(triggerId)
    local referenced = {}
    if type(getFullChat) ~= "function" then return referenced end
    local ok, chatHistory = pcall(getFullChat, triggerId)
    if not ok or type(chatHistory) ~= "table" then return referenced end
    for _, message in ipairs(chatHistory) do
        local text = type(message) == "table" and tostring(message.data or "") or ""
        for seed in text:gmatch("<!%-%-%[TMSEED%|([^%]]+)%]%-%->") do referenced[seed] = true end
        for seed in text:gmatch("<!%-%-%[SEED%|([^%]]+)%]%-%->") do referenced[seed] = true end
    end
    return referenced
end

function tmProtectReferencedSaveSeed(referenced, seed)
    local cleanSeed = tostring(seed or "")
    if cleanSeed ~= "" then referenced[cleanSeed] = true end
end

function tmPruneUnusedSaveSeeds(triggerId, protectedSeed)
    local store = tmSaveSeedStore(triggerId)
    local referenced = tmReferencedSaveSeeds(triggerId)
    tmProtectReferencedSaveSeed(referenced, protectedSeed)
    tmProtectReferencedSaveSeed(referenced, tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_LATEST_SEED_KEY, ""))
    local changed = false
    for seed in pairs(store.data) do
        if not referenced[seed] then
            store.data[seed] = nil
            changed = true
        end
    end
    if changed then tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_SEED_STORE_KEY, store) end
end

function tmGenerateSaveSeedTag(triggerId, currentOutput)
    local seed = tmMakeSaveSeed(triggerId)
    tmRememberSaveSeedState(triggerId, seed, tmCollectSaveState(triggerId, {currentOutput = currentOutput}))
    local gcCounter = tonumber(tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_SEED_GC_COUNTER_KEY, 0) or 0) or 0
    gcCounter = gcCounter + 1
    if gcCounter >= TM_SAVE_SEED_GC_INTERVAL then
        tmPruneUnusedSaveSeeds(triggerId, seed)
        gcCounter = 0
    end
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_SEED_GC_COUNTER_KEY, gcCounter)
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_TEMP_DELTA_KEY, nil)
    return "<!--[TMSEED|" .. seed .. "]-->"
end

function tmAppendSaveSeedTag(triggerId, output)
    local clean = tmStripSaveSeedTags(output)
    local tag = tmGenerateSaveSeedTag(triggerId, clean)
    if clean == "" then return tag end
    return clean .. "\n" .. tag
end

function tmNormalizeSaveSeedInput(raw)
    local text = tmTrimText(raw)
    if text == "" then return "" end
    local compactPortable = text:gsub("%s+", ""):match("(tm1_[%w_%-]+)")
    if compactPortable ~= nil and compactPortable ~= "" then return compactPortable end
    local fromExport = text:match("__tm_save_export_code%s*[:=]%s*([%w_%-]+)")
        or text:match("tm_save_export_code%s*[:=]%s*([%w_%-]+)")
        or text:match("__tm_session_save_code%s*[:=]%s*([%w_%-]+)")
        or text:match("tm_session_save_code%s*[:=]%s*([%w_%-]+)")
    if fromExport ~= nil and tostring(fromExport or "") ~= "" then return tmTrimText(fromExport) end
    local fromTag = tmExtractLatestSaveSeed(text)
    if fromTag ~= nil and tostring(fromTag or "") ~= "" then return tmTrimText(fromTag) end
    local fromVar = text:match("__tm_save_latest_seed%s*[:=]%s*([%w_%-]+)")
        or text:match("tm_save_latest_seed%s*[:=]%s*([%w_%-]+)")
    if fromVar ~= nil and tostring(fromVar or "") ~= "" then return tmTrimText(fromVar) end
    local token = text:match("^%s*([%w_%-]+)%s*$")
    if token ~= nil and token ~= "" then return token end
    return ""
end

function tmCreateVisibleSaveCode(triggerId)
    local portableCode = tmEncodePortableSaveState(tmCollectSaveState(triggerId))
    if portableCode ~= "" then
        tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_CODE_KEY, portableCode)
        return portableCode
    end
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_PORTABLE_CODE_KEY, "")
    return ""
end

function tmCreateVisibleSaveSeed(triggerId)
    return tmCreateVisibleSaveCode(triggerId)
end

function tmSyncMacroRawFromPacked(triggerId)
    -- Fill-only: packed values only fill missing/empty raw keys (old-seed backfill).
    -- An existing raw value always wins, so poisoned seeds (raw/packed mismatch)
    -- can no longer flip live state back to a stale packed value. (v1.11.12 FIX-A)
    for key in pairs(TM_MACRO_RAW_KEYS) do
        if key ~= "tm_control_panel_html" and tmRawGetVar(triggerId, key) == nil then
            local val = tmGetCompressedVar(triggerId, key)
            if val ~= nil then tmRawSetVar(triggerId, key, val) end
        end
    end
end

function tmClearPersistentDrawerOpenState(triggerId)
    for field, defaultValue in pairs(TM_PERSISTENT_DRAWER_OPEN_FIELDS) do
        setVar(triggerId, field, defaultValue)
    end
end

function tmApplySaveState(triggerId, stateTable, options)
    if type(stateTable) ~= "table" or type(stateTable.vars) ~= "table" then return false end
    local applyOptions = options or {}
    local previous = TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS
    TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = true
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEYS) do
        if stateTable.vars[key] ~= nil then
            tmRawSetVar(triggerId, key, tmSanitizeSaveSnapshotValue(key, stateTable.vars[key]))
        end
    end
    pcall(tmRefreshNaiGuideText, triggerId)
    tmSyncMacroRawFromPacked(triggerId)
    if applyOptions.keepDrawerState ~= true then
        tmClearPersistentDrawerOpenState(triggerId)
    end
    if applyOptions.skipControlPanelBuild ~= true and type(tmGenerateControlPanel) == "function" then
        pcall(tmGenerateControlPanel, triggerId)
    end
    TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = previous
    return true
end

function tmNormalizeLoadedSessionDisplay(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "true")
    tmClearPersistentDrawerOpenState(triggerId)
end

function tmApplyTemporaryDelta(triggerId, seed)
    local delta = tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_TEMP_DELTA_KEY, nil)
    if type(delta) ~= "table" or type(delta.data) ~= "table" then return end
    if tostring(delta.baseSeed or "") ~= tostring(seed or "") then return end
    local previous = TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS
    TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = true
    for key, value in pairs(delta.data) do
        setVar(triggerId, key, value)
    end
    TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = previous
end

function tmParseAndApplySaveSeed(triggerId, seed, options)
    local cleanSeed = tostring(seed or "")
    if cleanSeed == "" then return false end
    local portableState = tmDecodePortableSaveCode(cleanSeed)
    if type(portableState) == "table" then
        if not tmApplySaveState(triggerId, portableState, options) then return false end
        local restoredSeed = tmMakeSaveSeed(triggerId)
        tmRememberSaveSeedState(triggerId, restoredSeed, portableState)
        return true
    end
    local store = tmSaveSeedStore(triggerId)
    local stateTable = store.data[cleanSeed]
    if type(stateTable) ~= "table" then return false end
    if not tmApplySaveState(triggerId, stateTable, options) then return false end
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_LATEST_SEED_KEY, cleanSeed)
    tmApplyTemporaryDelta(triggerId, cleanSeed)
    return true
end

function tmHasLoadedSaveSnapshot(triggerId)
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEYS) do
        if tmRawGetVar(triggerId, key) ~= nil then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory(triggerId, options)
    local loadOptions = options or {}
    if type(getFullChat) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok, chatHistory = pcall(getFullChat, triggerId)
    if not ok or type(chatHistory) ~= "table" then return false end
    for i = #chatHistory, 1, -1 do
        local message = chatHistory[i]
        if type(message) == "table" and message.role == "char" then
            local seed = tmExtractLatestSaveSeed(message.data or "")
            if seed ~= nil
                and loadOptions.skipUnchangedSeed == true
                and tostring(tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_LATEST_SEED_KEY, "") or "") == tostring(seed)
                and tmHasLoadedSaveSnapshot(triggerId) then
                return true
            end
            if seed ~= nil and tmParseAndApplySaveSeed(triggerId, seed, options) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmCaptureRequestSaveSeed(triggerId, data)
    local seed = nil
    if type(data) == "table" then
        for _, message in ipairs(data) do
            if type(message) == "table" and type(message.content) == "string" then
                local found = tmExtractLatestSaveSeed(message.content)
                if found ~= nil then seed = found end
            end
        end
    elseif type(data) == "string" then
        seed = tmExtractLatestSaveSeed(data)
    end
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_REQUEST_SEED_KEY, tostring(seed or ""))
    return seed
end

-- Mode-cluster keys set together on daily/session switches (prepareNormalSceneState /
-- prepareReturnToSessionFlowState). Preserved across the editOutput request-seed
-- restore only; explicit load paths (save code / portable) still fully restore.
TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_PRESERVE_KEYS = {"game_mode", "game_phase", "tm_ui_panel", "daily_return_target"}

function tmRestoreRequestSaveSeedForOutput(triggerId)
    local seed = tostring(tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_REQUEST_SEED_KEY, "") or "")
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_REQUEST_SEED_KEY, "")
    if seed == "" then return false end
    -- v1.11.12 FIX-C: the request seed predates any mode switch made after that
    -- turn (e.g. regenerate after entering daily mode), so keep the current mode
    -- cluster instead of letting the older seed revert it.
    local preserved = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_PRESERVE_KEYS) do
        preserved[key] = getVar(triggerId, key, "")
    end
    local applied = tmParseAndApplySaveSeed(triggerId, seed)
    if applied then
        local previous = TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS
        TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = true
        for _, key in ipairs(TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_PRESERVE_KEYS) do
            if preserved[key] ~= "" then setVar(triggerId, key, preserved[key]) end
        end
        TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = previous
    end
    return applied
end

function tmShouldSaveSeedKey(key)
    local name = tostring(key or "")
    if name == "" or TM_SAVE_TEMP_EXCLUDED_KEYS[name] then return false end
    if TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEY_SET[name] or TM_MACRO_RAW_KEYS[name] then return true end
    if tmCompressedPlayerParts(name) then return true end
    if tmCompressedEnemyParts(name) then return true end
    if tmCompressedObjectParts(name) then return true end
    if tmCompressedEpisodeChoiceParts(name) then return true end
    if tmCompressedXpParts(name) then return true end
    local map = TM_PACKED_KEY_MAP[name]
    if map and TM_SAVE_SNAPSHOT_KEY_SET[map[1]] then return true end
    return false
end

function tmRecordTemporaryChange(triggerId, key, value)
    if TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS or TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_IN_PROGRESS or TM_PANEL_REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS then return end
    if not tmShouldSaveSeedKey(key) then return end
    local baseSeed = tostring(tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_LATEST_SEED_KEY, "") or "")
    if baseSeed == "" then return end
    local delta = tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_TEMP_DELTA_KEY, nil)
    if type(delta) ~= "table" or tostring(delta.baseSeed or "") ~= baseSeed then
        delta = {baseSeed = baseSeed, data = {}}
    end
    if type(delta.data) ~= "table" then delta.data = {} end
    delta.data[tostring(key or "")] = tostring(value or "")
    tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_TEMP_DELTA_KEY, delta)
end

function tmNow()
    return os.time()
end

function tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, locked)
    if locked then
        setVar(triggerId, "action_locked", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "action_started_at", tmNow())
        if type(tmEnsureLoadingTip) == "function" then tmEnsureLoadingTip(triggerId) end
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "action_locked", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "action_started_at", "0")
        if type(tmClearLoadingTip) == "function" then tmClearLoadingTip(triggerId) end
    end
end

function tmActionTimedOut(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "action_locked", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    local startedAt = getNumVar(triggerId, "action_started_at", 0)
    local limit = TM_ACTION_LOCK_SECONDS or 90
    return startedAt > 0 and (tmNow() - startedAt) >= limit
end

function tmNotice(triggerId, message)
    local text = tostring(message or "")
    if type(tmClosePersistentDrawerState) == "function" then tmClosePersistentDrawerState(triggerId) end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_notice", text)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_notice_type", "normal")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_kind", "normal")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_title", tmUiText(triggerId, "notice_title"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_body", text)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_fn", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_fn", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_label", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_label", "")
    print("[TRPG NOTICE] " .. text)
    return true
end

function tmError(triggerId, message)
    local text = tostring(message or "")
    if type(tmClosePersistentDrawerState) == "function" then tmClosePersistentDrawerState(triggerId) end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_notice", text)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_notice_type", "error")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_kind", "error")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_title", tmUiText(triggerId, "error_title"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_body", text)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_fn", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_fn", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_label", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_label", "")
    print("[TRPG ERROR NOTICE] " .. text)
    return true
end

function tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_kind", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_title", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_body", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_fn", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_fn", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_label", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_label", "")
end

function tmOpenConfirmPopup(triggerId, title, body, yesLabel, yesFn, noLabel, noFn)
    if type(tmClosePersistentDrawerState) == "function" then tmClosePersistentDrawerState(triggerId) end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_kind", "confirm")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_title", title or tmUiText(triggerId, "notice_title"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_body", body or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_label", yesLabel or tmUiText(triggerId, "yes"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_fn", yesFn or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_label", noLabel or tmUiText(triggerId, "no"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_fn", noFn or "closeInAppPopup")
end

-- === SECTION 2: Utility ===

function clamp(val, lo, hi)
    if val < lo then return lo end
    if val > hi then return hi end
    return val
end

function tmLastHangulSyllableCodepoint(str)
    local s = tostring(str or "")
    local i = #s
    while i >= 1 do
        local b = s:byte(i)
        if b >= 0x80 then
            local start = i
            while start > 1 do
                local prev = s:byte(start)
                if not prev or prev < 0x80 or prev >= 0xC0 then break end
                start = start - 1
            end
            local b1, b2, b3 = s:byte(start, start + 2)
            if b1 and b2 and b3 and b1 >= 0xE0 and b1 < 0xF0
                and b2 >= 0x80 and b2 < 0xC0
                and b3 >= 0x80 and b3 < 0xC0 then
                local cp = (b1 - 0xE0) * 4096 + (b2 - 0x80) * 64 + (b3 - 0x80)
                if cp >= 0xAC00 and cp <= 0xD7A3 then return cp end
            end
            i = start - 1
        else
            i = i - 1
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function hasBatchim(str)
    local cp = tmLastHangulSyllableCodepoint(str)
    if not cp then return false end
    if cp < 0xAC00 or cp > 0xD7A3 then return false end
    return ((cp - 0xAC00) % 28) ~= 0
end

function tmJosa(triggerId, name, withBatchim, withoutBatchim, fallbackPair)
    local text = tostring(name or "")
    if triggerId and tmLang(triggerId) ~= "ko" then return text end
    local cp = tmLastHangulSyllableCodepoint(text)
    if not cp then
        if fallbackPair and fallbackPair ~= "" then return text .. " " .. fallbackPair end
        return text .. tostring(withoutBatchim or "")
    end
    if ((cp - 0xAC00) % 28) ~= 0 then return text .. tostring(withBatchim or "") end
    return text .. tostring(withoutBatchim or "")
end

function tmJosaIga(triggerId, name)
    local text = tostring(name or "")
    if triggerId and tmLang(triggerId) ~= "ko" then return text end
    return text .. " 이(가)"
end

function tmJosaEunNeun(triggerId, name)
    local text = tostring(name or "")
    if triggerId and tmLang(triggerId) ~= "ko" then return text end
    return text .. " 은(는)"
end

function tmJosaEulReul(triggerId, name)
    local text = tostring(name or "")
    if triggerId and tmLang(triggerId) ~= "ko" then return text end
    return text .. " 을(를)"
end

function pp(triggerIdOrName, nameOrWith, withOrWithout, maybeWithout)
    local triggerId, name, withBatchim, withoutBatchim
    if maybeWithout ~= nil then
        triggerId = triggerIdOrName
        name = nameOrWith
        withBatchim = withOrWithout
        withoutBatchim = maybeWithout
    else
        triggerId = nil
        name = triggerIdOrName
        withBatchim = nameOrWith
        withoutBatchim = withOrWithout
    end
    return tmJosa(triggerId, name, withBatchim, withoutBatchim)
end

function parseSheet(content)
    local data = {}
    if not content then return data end
    for line in content:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        -- skip section dividers (=== ... ===), comments (#), lorebook decorators
        -- (@@depth / @@match_full_word), and "- bullet" body lines. Bullet lines
        -- like "<<ENEMY:set:id>>" contain a colon and would otherwise become keys.
        if not line:match("^===") and not line:match("^#")
           and not line:match("^@@") and not line:match("^%s*%-") then
            local key, value = line:match("^([^:]+):(.*)$")
            if key and value then
                key = key:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                value = value:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                -- require non-empty value so section headers (DESCRIPTION:,
                -- COMBAT_NOTES:, SPAWN_DIRECTIVE:) do not pollute the sheet table
                if key ~= "" and value ~= "" then data[key] = value end
            end
        end
    end
    return data
end

-- atkToInt: convert an ATK dice expression ("1d4+1 fire", "2d8+4", "1d6") into a
-- flat integer using the average roll: floor(N*(F+1)/2)+B. Any malformed or
-- missing value falls back to 4 so combat math never breaks.
function atkToInt(atk)
    if type(atk) ~= "string" then return 4 end
    local n, f, b = atk:match("^(%d+)[dD](%d+)([%+%-]?%d*)")
    if not n or not f then return 4 end
    local nn = tonumber(n)
    local ff = tonumber(f)
    if not nn or not ff or nn == 0 or ff == 0 then return 4 end
    local bonus = 0
    if b and b ~= "" and b ~= "+" and b ~= "-" then
        bonus = tonumber(b) or 0
    end
    return math.floor((nn * (ff + 1)) / 2) + bonus
end

function parseList(str, sep)
    if not str or str == "" then return {} end
    if not sep then sep = "," end
    local result = {}
    for item in str:gmatch("[^" .. sep .. "]+") do
        local trimmed = item:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(result, trimmed) end
    end
    return result
end

function csvListContains(str, needle)
    if not needle or needle == "" then return false end
    for _, item in ipairs(parseList(str, ",")) do
        if item == needle then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function addCsvItem(str, item)
    if not item or item == "" then return str or "none" end
    local normalized = (str == nil or str == "" or str == "none") and "" or str
    if csvListContains(normalized, item) then
        return normalized ~= "" and normalized or "none"
    end
    if normalized == "" then return item end
    return normalized .. "," .. item
end

function removeCsvItem(str, item)
    if not item or item == "" then return str or "none" end
    local result = {}
    for _, cur in ipairs(parseList(str, ",")) do
        if cur ~= item and cur ~= "none" then table.insert(result, cur) end
    end
    if #result == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(result, ",")
end

function csvItemCount(str)
    local n = 0
    for _, item in ipairs(parseList(str, ",")) do
        if item ~= "" and item ~= "none" then n = n + 1 end
    end
    return n
end
