function tmStackItemId(raw)
    return tostring(raw or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "")
end

function tmStackEntryFields(entry)
    local id, count = tostring(entry or ""):match("^([^:]+):(%d+)$")
    if not id then
        id = tostring(entry or "")
        count = "1"
    end
    id = tmStackItemId(id)
    return id, math.max(0, tonumber(count) or 0)
end

function tmStackListGet(list, itemId)
    local target = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    if target == "" then return 0 end
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(list, ",")) do
        local id, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
        if id == target then return count end
    end
    return 0
end

function tmStackListSet(list, itemId, count)
    local target = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    local n = math.max(0, tonumber(count) or 0)
    if target == "" then return list or "none" end
    local result = {}
    local written = false
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(list, ",")) do
        local id, cur = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
        if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" then
            if id == target then
                if n > 0 then table.insert(result, id .. ":" .. tostring(n)) end
                written = true
            elseif cur > 0 then
                table.insert(result, id .. ":" .. tostring(cur))
            end
        end
    end
    if not written and n > 0 then table.insert(result, target .. ":" .. tostring(n)) end
    if #result == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(result, ",")
end

function tmStackListAdd(list, itemId, count)
    local target = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    local add = math.max(1, tonumber(count) or 1)
    return tmStackListSet(list, target, tmStackListGet(list, target) + add)
end

function tmStackListRemoveOne(list, itemId)
    local target = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    return tmStackListSet(list, target, tmStackListGet(list, target) - 1)
end

function tmStackListCountSlots(list)
    local n = 0
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(list, ",")) do
        local id, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
        if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and count > 0 then n = n + 1 end
    end
    return n
end

function tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    return "p_" .. ownerId .. "_items"
end

function tmOwnerEquipmentItemSlots(triggerId, ownerId)
    local equipmentSlots = csvItemCount(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", ""))
    local itemSlots = tmStackListCountSlots(getVar(triggerId, tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId), "none"))
    return equipmentSlots + itemSlots
end

TM_CLASS_STARTER_STACK_ITEMS = {
    paladin  = {{id = "health_potion", count = 2}},
    monk     = {{id = "health_potion", count = 1}},
    mage     = {{id = "mana_potion", count = 2}},
    summoner = {{id = "mana_potion", count = 1}},
    priest   = {{id = "condition_cleanse", count = 2}},
    warrior  = {{id = "condition_cleanse", count = 1}},
    rogue    = {{id = "condition_cleanse", count = 1}},
    dancer   = {{id = "condition_cleanse", count = 1}},
}

function tmClassStarterStackItems(classId)
    local id = tostring(classId or "")
    return TM_CLASS_STARTER_STACK_ITEMS[id] or TM_CLASS_STARTER_STACK_ITEMS.rogue
end

function tmEnsureOwnerItems(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return end
    local initVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_items_initialized"
    if getVar(triggerId, initVar, "false") == "true" then return end
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local items = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    for _, entry in ipairs(tmClassStarterStackItems(classId)) do
        local itemId = tmStackItemId(entry.id)
        local count = math.floor(tonumber(entry.count) or 0)
        if itemId ~= "" and count > 0 and TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[itemId] then
            items = tmStackListAdd(items, itemId, count)
        end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, itemVar, items)
    setVar(triggerId, initVar, "true")
end

function tmEnsurePartyItems(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do tmEnsureOwnerItems(triggerId, id) end
end

function tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, itemId)
    local id = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    if TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then return TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id].label end
    if id:match("^it%d+$") then return tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, id) end
    return id
end

-- tmStackItemTooltipText: returns ALREADY-ESCAPED player-facing tooltip HTML.
function tmStackItemTooltipText(triggerId, itemId, ownerId)
    local id = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    local def = TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id]
    if def then
        return tmTooltipProseHtml(def.desc, "이 아이템의 상세 효과는 아직 정리되지 않았습니다.")
    end
    if id:match("^it%d+$") then return tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId) end
    return tmTooltipProseHtml("", "이 아이템의 상세 효과는 아직 정리되지 않았습니다.")
end

function tmConditionSourceText(source)
    local s = tostring(source or ""):gsub("[,:%^;|]", " ")
    s = s:gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
    return s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function tmConditionDef(conditionId)
    return TM_CONDITION_DEFS[tostring(conditionId or "")] or nil
end

function tmConditionEntryFields(entry)
    local id, ticks, source = tostring(entry or ""):match("^([^:]+):(%d+):(.*)$")
    if not id then
        id, ticks = tostring(entry or ""):match("^([^:]+):(%d+)$")
        source = ""
    end
    id = tostring(id or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "")
    return id, math.max(0, tonumber(ticks) or 0), tmConditionSourceText(source)
end

function tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId)
    local result = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_conditions", "none"), ",")) do
        local id, ticks, source = tmConditionEntryFields(entry)
        if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and ticks > 0 and tmConditionDef(id) then
            table.insert(result, {id = id, ticks = ticks, source = source})
        end
    end
    return result
end

function tmSaveOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId, list)
    local out = {}
    for _, cond in ipairs(list or {}) do
        if cond.id and cond.id ~= "" and (tonumber(cond.ticks) or 0) > 0 and tmConditionDef(cond.id) then
            table.insert(out, cond.id .. ":" .. tostring(math.max(1, tonumber(cond.ticks) or 1)) .. ":" .. tmConditionSourceText(cond.source))
        end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_conditions", #out > 0 and table.concat(out, ",") or "none")
end

function tmOwnerHasCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId)
    for _, cond in ipairs(tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId)) do
        if cond.id == conditionId then return true, cond end
    end
    return false, nil
end

function tmConditionRuntimeProtection(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId)
    if type(tmCollectRuntimeEffects) ~= "function" then return nil, 0 end
    local bestResist = 0
    for _, eff in ipairs(tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, ownerId, "item+skill")) do
        local category = tostring(eff.effect or "")
        local trigger = tostring(eff.trigger or "")
        local cond = tostring(eff.condition or "")
        local appliesToCondition = (cond == "" or cond == conditionId)
        local passiveLike = (trigger == "passive" or trigger == "scene" or trigger == "on_damage_taken")
        if appliesToCondition and passiveLike then
            if category == "condition_immunity" then
                return "immunity", 0
            elseif category == "condition_resist" then
                bestResist = math.max(bestResist, tmEffectGradeFlatValue(eff.grade))
            end
        end
    end
    if bestResist > 0 then return "resist", bestResist end
    return nil, 0
end

function tmApplyCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, source)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "condition_bad_owner"); return false end
    local def = tmConditionDef(conditionId)
    if not def then tmLootFail(triggerId, "condition_bad_id"); return false end
    local duration = def.duration or 1
    local protection, reduction = tmConditionRuntimeProtection(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId)
    if protection == "immunity" then
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "condition_block:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. conditionId)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "CONDITION_BLOCK: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tostring(conditionId) .. " / immunity")
        return false
    elseif protection == "resist" then
        duration = math.max(0, duration - (tonumber(reduction) or 0))
        if duration <= 0 then
            setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "condition_resist:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. conditionId)
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "CONDITION_RESIST: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tostring(conditionId))
            return false
        end
    end
    local list = tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId)
    local applied = false
    for _, cond in ipairs(list) do
        if cond.id == conditionId then
            cond.ticks = math.max(cond.ticks, duration)
            cond.source = tmConditionSourceText(source)
            applied = true
        end
    end
    if not applied then
        table.insert(list, {id = conditionId, ticks = duration, source = tmConditionSourceText(source)})
    end
    tmSaveOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId, list)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "condition_apply:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. conditionId)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "CONDITION_APPLY: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. def.label)
    return true
end

function tmClearCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, reason)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "condition_clear_bad_owner"); return false end
    local list = tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId)
    local out = {}
    local changed = false
    for _, cond in ipairs(list) do
        local def = tmConditionDef(cond.id)
        local remove = false
        if conditionId == "all" then
            remove = true
        elseif conditionId == "removable" then
            remove = def and def.removable
        elseif cond.id == conditionId then
            remove = true
        end
        if remove then
            changed = true
        else
            table.insert(out, cond)
        end
    end
    if changed then
        tmSaveOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId, out)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "condition_clear:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. tostring(conditionId))
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "CONDITION_CLEAR: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tostring(conditionId) .. " / " .. tostring(reason or ""))
    end
    return changed
end

function tmFirstRemovableCondition(triggerId, ownerId, preferred)
    if preferred and preferred ~= "" then
        local has, cond = tmOwnerHasCondition(triggerId, ownerId, preferred)
        local def = tmConditionDef(preferred)
        if has and def and def.removable then return cond.id end
        return ""
    end
    for _, wanted in ipairs(TM_CONDITION_PRIORITY) do
        local has, cond = tmOwnerHasCondition(triggerId, ownerId, wanted)
        local def = tmConditionDef(wanted)
        if has and def and def.removable then return cond.id end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmConditionPenalty(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    local total = 0
    local details = {}
    for _, cond in ipairs(tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId)) do
        local def = tmConditionDef(cond.id)
        if def and (def.penalty or 0) ~= 0 then
            local applies = true
            if def.stat and def.stat ~= "" then
                applies = false
                for stat in tostring(def.stat):gmatch("[^,]+") do
                    if stat == statKey then applies = true end
                end
            end
            if applies then
                total = total + (def.penalty or 0)
                table.insert(details, def.label .. " " .. tostring(def.penalty))
            end
        end
    end
    return total, table.concat(details, ", ")
end

function tmTickConditions(triggerId, reason)
    local changed = false
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local out = {}
        local ownerChanged = false
        for _, cond in ipairs(tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId)) do
            local def = tmConditionDef(cond.id)
            if def and (def.tickDamage or 0) > 0 then
                damageHeroine(triggerId, ownerId, def.tickDamage)
                tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "CONDITION_TICK: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. def.label .. " / HP -" .. tostring(def.tickDamage))
            end
            if def and (def.tickMp or 0) > 0 then
                adjustHeroineMp(triggerId, ownerId, -def.tickMp)
                tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "CONDITION_TICK: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. def.label .. " / MP -" .. tostring(def.tickMp))
            end
            cond.ticks = (tonumber(cond.ticks) or 1) - 1
            if cond.ticks > 0 then table.insert(out, cond) end
            ownerChanged = true
        end
        if ownerChanged then
            changed = true
            tmSaveOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId, out)
        end
    end
    if changed then setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "condition_tick:" .. tostring(reason or "")) end
    return changed
end

function tmConditionTooltipText(conditionId, ticks, source)
    local def = tmConditionDef(conditionId)
    if not def then return conditionId end
    local parts = {
        "effect=" .. def.desc,
        "remaining=" .. tostring(ticks),
        "source=" .. (source ~= "" and source or "-"),
        "cleanse=" .. (def.removable and "yes" or "no"),
    }
    if (def.tickDamage or 0) > 0 then table.insert(parts, "tick_hp=-" .. tostring(def.tickDamage)) end
    if (def.tickMp or 0) > 0 then table.insert(parts, "tick_mp=-" .. tostring(def.tickMp)) end
    return table.concat(parts, " / ")
end

function tmOwnerConditionHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    local chips = {}
    for _, cond in ipairs(tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, ownerId)) do
        local def = tmConditionDef(cond.id)
        if def then
            local tip = tmConditionTooltipText(cond.id, cond.ticks, cond.source)
            table.insert(chips, '<span class="tm-condition-chip"><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(def.label) .. ' ' .. tostring(cond.ticks) .. '</span><span class="tm-guide-help tm-loadout-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="condition detail">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tip) .. '</span></span></span>')
        end
    end
    if #chips == 0 then return "" end
    return '<span class="tm-condition-list">' .. table.concat(chips, "") .. '</span>'
end

function tmItemUseTarget(triggerId, ownerId, target)
    local raw = tostring(target or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if raw == "" or raw == "self" then return ownerId end
    local kind, id = raw:match("^([%w_]+):(.*)$")
    if kind == "ally" and CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] then return id end
    return ownerId
end

function tmApplyItemUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemId, target, conditionId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_bad_owner"); return "" end
    local item = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    if item:match("^it%d+$") then
        return tmApplyRuntimeItemUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, item, target)
    end
    local def = TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[item]
    if not def then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_unknown"); return "" end
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local items = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    if tmStackListGet(items, item) <= 0 then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_empty"); return "" end
    local targetOwner = tmItemUseTarget(triggerId, ownerId, target)
    if item == "condition_cleanse" then
        local clearId = tmFirstRemovableCondition(triggerId, targetOwner, conditionId)
        if clearId == "" then
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_no_condition")
            return ""
        end
        tmClearCondition(triggerId, targetOwner, clearId, "item:" .. item)
        setVar(triggerId, itemVar, tmStackListRemoveOne(items, item))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "item_use:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. item .. ":" .. targetOwner .. ":" .. clearId)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "ITEM_USE: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, item) .. " -> " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, targetOwner) .. " / " .. clearId)
        return ""
    elseif def.restore == "hp" then
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. targetOwner .. "_status", "active") == "ko" then
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_ko")
            return ""
        end
        local amount = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(def.amount) or 10))
        healHeroine(triggerId, targetOwner, amount)
        setVar(triggerId, itemVar, tmStackListRemoveOne(items, item))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "item_use:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. item .. ":" .. targetOwner .. ":hp" .. tostring(amount))
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "ITEM_USE: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, item) .. " -> " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, targetOwner) .. " / HP +" .. tostring(amount))
        return ""
    elseif def.restore == "mp" then
        local amount = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(def.amount) or 10))
        adjustHeroineMp(triggerId, targetOwner, amount)
        setVar(triggerId, itemVar, tmStackListRemoveOne(items, item))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "item_use:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. item .. ":" .. targetOwner .. ":mp" .. tostring(amount))
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "ITEM_USE: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, item) .. " -> " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, targetOwner) .. " / MP +" .. tostring(amount))
        return ""
    end
    tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_unknown_effect")
    return ""
end

function tmCleanItemRef(ref)
    local itemRef = tostring(ref or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if itemRef:match("^it%d+$") then return itemRef end
    return ""
end

function tmPositiveAssignQty(value)
    local qty = math.floor(tonumber(value) or 1)
    if qty < 1 or qty > TM_OWNER_IDENTICAL_ITEM_CAP then return 0 end
    return qty
end

function tmRuntimeItemEffectForUse(triggerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then return nil end
    local eff = tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", ref)
    if not eff then return nil end
    eff.sourceRef = ref
    eff.parentRef = eff.parentRef or ref
    if not tmResolveEffectTrigger(eff, "on_use") then return nil end
    return eff
end

function tmNormalizeRuntimeItemKind(kind)
    local token = tostring(kind or ""):lower()
    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    token = token:gsub("[%s%-]+", "_")
    if token == "equipment" or token == "equip" or token == "gear" or token == "weapon" or token == "armor" then
        return "equipment"
    end
    if token == "consumable" or token == "consume" or token == "usable" or token == "use" or token == "item" then
        return "consumable"
    end
    if token == "key" or token == "key_item" then
        return "key"
    end
    return "equipment"
end

function tmRuntimeItemKind(triggerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then return "" end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", ref)
    if not record then return "" end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    return tmNormalizeRuntimeItemKind(fields[5] or "equipment")
end

function tmTextHasAnyToken(text, tokens)
    local haystack = tostring(text or ""):lower()
    for _, token in ipairs(tokens or {}) do
        if haystack:find(tostring(token), 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmInferRuntimeItemKindFromLabel(label)
    local text = tostring(label or ""):lower()
    local keyTokens = {
        "key", "clue", "map", "seal", "token", "trophy", "quest item",
        "열쇠", "단서", "지도", "인장", "증표", "트로피", "목표물",
        "鍵", "手がかり", "地図", "印章", "証"
    }
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, keyTokens) then return "key" end

    local consumableTokens = {
        "potion", "elixir", "scroll", "food", "ration", "powder", "oil", "bomb", "medicine",
        "포션", "물약", "비약", "두루마리", "식량", "가루", "기름", "폭탄", "약초", "약",
        "ポーション", "薬", "巻物", "食料", "粉", "油", "爆弾"
    }
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, consumableTokens) then return "consumable" end

    local equipmentTokens = {
        "sword", "blade", "dagger", "axe", "spear", "bow", "staff", "wand", "shield", "armor", "armour",
        "helmet", "helm", "boots", "gloves", "cloak", "robe", "ring", "amulet", "weapon", "equipment",
        "검", "칼", "단검", "대검", "롱소드", "도끼", "창", "활", "지팡이", "완드", "방패", "갑옷", "투구", "장화", "장갑", "망토", "로브", "반지", "목걸이", "무기", "장비",
        "剣", "刀", "短剣", "斧", "槍", "弓", "杖", "盾", "鎧", "兜", "靴", "手袋", "外套", "指輪", "首飾り", "武器", "装備"
    }
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, equipmentTokens) then return "equipment" end
    return "consumable"
end

function tmResolveAuxRewardItemKind(rawKind, name, evidence, meta)
    local metaKind = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 3))
    if metaKind == "equipment" or metaKind == "consumable" or metaKind == "key" then return metaKind end
    local kind = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(rawKind or "")
    if kind == "equipment" or kind == "gear" or kind == "weapon" or kind == "armor" or kind == "shield" or kind == "accessory" then return "equipment" end
    if kind == "consumable" or kind == "consume" or kind == "usable" or kind == "use" then return "consumable" end
    if kind == "key" or kind == "key_item" or kind == "clue" or kind == "quest" then return "key" end
    return tmInferRuntimeItemKindFromLabel(tostring(name or "") .. " " .. tostring(evidence or ""))
end

function tmItemRefAssignable(triggerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then return false end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", ref)
    if not record then return false end
    if tmRuntimeItemKind(triggerId, ref) == "consumable" then return true end
    return tmRuntimeItemEffectForUse(triggerId, ref) ~= nil
end

function tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then return "" end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", ref)
    if not record then return "" end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    local note = tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", ref)
    return table.concat({
        fields[2] or "",
        fields[3] or "",
        fields[4] or "",
        fields[5] or "",
        fields[6] or "",
        fields[8] or "",
        fields[9] or "",
        note or "",
    }, "\31")
end

function tmOwnerItemIdentityCount(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef)
    local identity = tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, itemRef)
    if identity == "" then return 0 end
    local total = 0
    local items = getVar(triggerId, tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId), "none")
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(items, ",")) do
        local id, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
        if id:match("^it%d+$") and tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, id) == identity then
            total = total + math.max(0, tonumber(count) or 0)
        end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(parseList(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", ""), ",")) do
        if tmCleanItemRef(id) ~= "" and tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, id) == identity then
            total = total + 1
        end
    end
    return total
end

function tmPartyItemRefsByIdentity(triggerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    local identity = tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, ref)
    local refs = {}
    if ref == "" or identity == "" then return refs end
    local seen = {}
    if csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref) then
        table.insert(refs, ref)
        seen[ref] = true
    end
    for _, cur in ipairs(parseList(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ",")) do
        local curRef = tmCleanItemRef(cur)
        if curRef ~= "" and not seen[curRef] and tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, curRef) == identity then
            table.insert(refs, curRef)
            seen[curRef] = true
        end
    end
    return refs
end

function tmOwnerItemRefsByIdentity(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    local identity = tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, ref)
    local refs = {}
    if ref == "" or identity == "" then return refs end
    local items = getVar(triggerId, tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId), "none")
    local seen = {}
    if tmStackListGet(items, ref) > 0 then
        table.insert(refs, ref)
        seen[ref] = true
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(items, ",")) do
        local curRef, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
        if curRef ~= "" and count > 0 and not seen[curRef] and curRef:match("^it%d+$") and tmRuntimeItemIdentityKey(triggerId, curRef) == identity then
            table.insert(refs, curRef)
            seen[curRef] = true
        end
    end
    return refs
end

function tmApplyItemAssignMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef, qtyValue)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_bad_owner"); return "" end
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_bad_ref"); return "" end
    local qty = tmPositiveAssignQty(qtyValue)
    if qty <= 0 then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_bad_qty"); return "" end
    if not csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref) then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_missing_item")
        return ""
    end
    if not tmItemRefAssignable(triggerId, ref) then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_not_usable")
        return ""
    end
    local refs = tmPartyItemRefsByIdentity(triggerId, ref)
    if #refs < qty then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_short_qty")
        return ""
    end
    if tmOwnerEquipmentItemSlots(triggerId, ownerId) + qty > TM_EQUIPMENT_ITEM_SLOT_CAP then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_item_full")
        return ""
    end
    if tmOwnerItemIdentityCount(triggerId, ownerId, ref) + qty > TM_OWNER_IDENTICAL_ITEM_CAP then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_assign_identity_full")
        return ""
    end

    local partyItems = getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none")
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local ownerItems = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    local assigned = {}
    for i = 1, qty do
        local curRef = refs[i]
        partyItems = removeCsvItem(partyItems, curRef)
        ownerItems = tmStackListAdd(ownerItems, curRef, 1)
        table.insert(assigned, curRef)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "party_items", partyItems)
    setVar(triggerId, itemVar, ownerItems)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "item_assign:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. ref .. ":" .. tostring(qty))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 분배: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. table.concat(assigned, ","))
    return ""
end

function tmApplyItemReleaseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef, qtyValue)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_release_bad_owner"); return "" end
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_release_bad_ref"); return "" end
    local qty = tmPositiveAssignQty(qtyValue)
    if qty <= 0 then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_release_bad_qty"); return "" end
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local ownerItems = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    if tmStackListGet(ownerItems, ref) <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_release_missing_item")
        return ""
    end
    local refs = tmOwnerItemRefsByIdentity(triggerId, ownerId, ref)
    if #refs < qty then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_release_short_qty")
        return ""
    end
    local partyItems = getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none")
    for i = 1, qty do
        if csvListContains(partyItems, refs[i]) then
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_release_duplicate_bag")
            return ""
        end
    end
    local released = {}
    for i = 1, qty do
        local curRef = refs[i]
        ownerItems = tmStackListSet(ownerItems, curRef, tmStackListGet(ownerItems, curRef) - 1)
        partyItems = addCsvItem(partyItems, curRef)
        table.insert(released, curRef)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, itemVar, ownerItems)
    setVar(triggerId, "party_items", partyItems)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "item_release:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. ref .. ":" .. tostring(qty))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 반환: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. table.concat(released, ","))
    return ""
end

function tmApplyRuntimeItemUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef, target)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_bad_ref"); return "" end
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local items = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    if tmStackListGet(items, ref) <= 0 then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_empty"); return "" end
    local effect = tmRuntimeItemEffectForUse(triggerId, ref)
    if not effect then tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_use_unknown_effect"); return "" end

    local targetText = tostring(target or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if targetText == "" then
        if effect.target == "enemy" then
            targetText = "enemy:current"
        elseif effect.target == "scene" then
            targetText = "scene"
        else
            targetText = "self"
        end
    end
    local kind, targetId = tmSkillUseTarget(triggerId, ownerId, targetText)
    local cat, amount = tmApplyRuntimeEffect(effect, {
        triggerId = triggerId,
        actorId = ownerId,
        targetId = targetId,
        targetKind = kind,
        event = "on_use",
    })
    setVar(triggerId, itemVar, tmStackListRemoveOne(items, ref))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "item_use:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. ref .. ":" .. tostring(cat))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "ITEM_USE: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref) .. " / " .. tostring(cat) .. (((tonumber(amount) or 0) > 0) and (" " .. tostring(amount)) or ""))
    return ""
end

function countKeywords(input, keywords)
    if not input or input == "" then return 0 end
    local lower = input:lower()
    local score = 0
    for _, kw in ipairs(keywords) do
        if input:find(kw, 1, true) or lower:find(kw:lower(), 1, true) then
            score = score + 1
        end
    end
    return score
end

-- === SECTION 3: i18n ===

function tmLang(triggerId)
    local lang = getVar(triggerId, "lang", "ko")
    if lang == "en" or lang == "ja" then return lang end
    return "ko"
end

function tmTrimVisibleText(text)
    return tostring(text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function tmTextHasHangul(text)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    local i, n = 1, #s
    while i <= n do
        local b1 = s:byte(i)
        local codepoint, step = b1, 1
        if b1 >= 194 and b1 <= 223 and i + 1 <= n then
            local b2 = s:byte(i + 1) or 0
            codepoint = (b1 % 32) * 64 + (b2 % 64)
            step = 2
        elseif b1 >= 224 and b1 <= 239 and i + 2 <= n then
            local b2 = s:byte(i + 1) or 0
            local b3 = s:byte(i + 2) or 0
            codepoint = (b1 % 16) * 4096 + (b2 % 64) * 64 + (b3 % 64)
            step = 3
        elseif b1 >= 240 and b1 <= 244 and i + 3 <= n then
            local b2 = s:byte(i + 1) or 0
            local b3 = s:byte(i + 2) or 0
            local b4 = s:byte(i + 3) or 0
            codepoint = (b1 % 8) * 262144 + (b2 % 64) * 4096 + (b3 % 64) * 64 + (b4 % 64)
            step = 4
        end
        if (codepoint >= 44032 and codepoint <= 55203)
            or (codepoint >= 4352 and codepoint <= 4607)
            or (codepoint >= 12592 and codepoint <= 12687) then
            return true
        end
        i = i + step
    end
    return false
end

function tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, text)
    local value = tmTrimVisibleText(text)
    if value == "" then return false end
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then return tmTextHasHangul(value) end
    return true
end

function tmLooksLikeFormulaLoadoutText(text, kind)
    local value = tmTrimVisibleText(text)
    if value == "" then return false end
    if value:match("^Lv%d+%s+") then
        if value:find("기반", 1, true) then return true end
        if kind == "skill" then return value:find("스킬", 1, true) ~= nil end
        return value:find("장비", 1, true) ~= nil
    end
    local lower = value:lower()
    if lower:match("^level%s+%d+%s+") and lower:find("based", 1, true) then return true end
    return false
end

function tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, text, kind)
    if not tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, text) then return false end
    return not tmLooksLikeFormulaLoadoutText(text, kind)
end

function T(triggerId, ko, en, ja)
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" then return en
    elseif lang == "ja" then return ja or en
    else return ko end
end

function tmUiText(triggerId, key)
    local entry = TM_UI_TEXT[tostring(key or "")]
    if not entry then return tostring(key or "") end
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" then return entry.en or entry.ko or tostring(key or "") end
    if lang == "ja" then return entry.ja or entry.en or entry.ko or tostring(key or "") end
    return entry.ko or entry.en or tostring(key or "")
end

function tmEnsureLoadingTip(triggerId)
    local count = #TM_LOADING_TIPS
    if count <= 0 then return 0 end
    local existing = tonumber(getVar(triggerId, "tm_loading_tip_idx", ""))
    if existing and existing >= 1 and existing <= count then return math.floor(existing) end
    local idx = math.random(1, count)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_loading_tip_idx", tostring(idx))
    return idx
end

function tmClearLoadingTip(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_loading_tip_idx", "")
end

function tmLoadingTipText(triggerId)
    local idx = tmEnsureLoadingTip(triggerId)
    local entry = TM_LOADING_TIPS[idx]
    if not entry then return "" end
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    return entry[lang] or entry.en or entry.ko or ""
end

function tmLoadingRemainingSeconds(triggerId)
    local limit = TM_ACTION_LOCK_SECONDS or 90
    local startedAt = getNumVar(triggerId, "action_started_at", 0)
    local remaining = limit
    if startedAt > 0 then remaining = limit - (tmNow() - startedAt) end
    return math.max(0, math.ceil(tonumber(remaining) or 0))
end

function tmLoadingUnlockText(triggerId, seconds)
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" then return "Unlock available now" end
    if lang == "ja" then return "ロック解除可能" end
    return "잠금 해제 가능"
end

function tmLoadingUnlockHtml(triggerId, seconds)
    return tmLoadingUnlockText(triggerId, seconds)
end

function tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" then return "English" end
    if lang == "ja" then return "Japanese" end
    return "Korean"
end

function tmGuideLeadVoiceStyle(triggerId)
    local lang = getVar(triggerId, "lang", "ko")
    if lang == "en" then
        return "Voice: direct English GM table speech/narration addressed to the players as final table text. Use one consistent table register. Prefer sensory detail, consequence, and established-fiction endings."
    elseif lang == "ja" then
        return "Voice: direct Japanese GM table speech/narration addressed to the players as final table text. Use one consistent table register. Prefer sensory detail, consequence, and established-fiction endings."
    end
    return "Voice: direct Korean GM table narration addressed to the players as final table text. Write sentences the GM can paste or say aloud. Use one consistent casual table register; do not mix '-습니다/-합니다/-해요' with casual narration. Prefer sensory/result endings such as '-보여', '-들려', '-드러나', '-멎어', '-흔들려', '-가까워져'. For generated names/titles, do not attach bare particles that may be wrong; use safe particles like '이(가)', '은(는)', '을(를)' or rephrase."
end

function tmAwaitHostResult(result)
    local resultType = type(result)
    if resultType ~= "table" and resultType ~= "userdata" then return end
    local ok, awaitFn = pcall(function() return result.await end)
    if ok and type(awaitFn) == "function" then
        pcall(function() result:await() end)
    end
end

function tmReloadLastCharChat(triggerId)
    if type(getFullChat) ~= "function" or type(reloadChat) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok, chatHistory = pcall(getFullChat, triggerId)
    if not ok or type(chatHistory) ~= "table" then return false end
    for i = #chatHistory, 1, -1 do
        local message = chatHistory[i]
        if type(message) == "table" and message.role == "char" then
            local reloadOk, reloadResult = pcall(reloadChat, triggerId, i - 1)
            if reloadOk then tmAwaitHostResult(reloadResult) end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmAppendToLastCharChat(triggerId, suffix)
    if type(getFullChat) ~= "function" or type(setChat) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok, chatHistory = pcall(getFullChat, triggerId)
    if not ok or type(chatHistory) ~= "table" then return false end
    for i = #chatHistory, 1, -1 do
        local message = chatHistory[i]
        if type(message) == "table" and message.role == "char" then
            local text = tostring(message.data or "")
            local add = tostring(suffix or "")
            if add ~= "" and not text:find(add, 1, true) then
                setChat(triggerId, i - 1, text .. "\n" .. add)
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmReloadDisplayNow(triggerId)
    if type(reloadDisplay) ~= "function" then return end
    local ok, result = pcall(reloadDisplay, triggerId)
    if ok then tmAwaitHostResult(result) end
end

function tmReloadControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, options)
    options = options or {}
    if options.reload == false then return false end
    local preferLastChar = options.fullReload ~= true and options.reloadLastChar ~= false
    if preferLastChar then
        local chatOk, didReloadChat = pcall(tmReloadLastCharChat, triggerId)
        if chatOk and didReloadChat == true then
            return true
        end
    end
    if options.await == true then
        tmReloadDisplayNow(triggerId)
        return true
    end
    if type(reloadDisplay) == "function" then
        pcall(reloadDisplay, triggerId)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function tmBuildControlPanelSafe(triggerId)
    if type(tmGenerateControlPanel) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok, resultOrErr, changed = pcall(tmGenerateControlPanel, triggerId)
    if not ok then
        local err = tostring(resultOrErr)
        print("[TRPG] control panel build error: " .. err)
        local escape = type(tmEscapeHtml) == "function" and tmEscapeHtml or function(value) return tostring(value or "") end
        local escapedTitle = escape(T(triggerId, "시트 패널 오류", "Sheet Panel Error", "シートパネルエラー"))
        local escapedErr = escape(err)
        local errorChanged = false
        if type(tmSetControlPanelHtml) == "function" then
            errorChanged = tmSetControlPanelHtml(triggerId, '<div class="tm-overlay-root trs-compat"><div class="tm-modal-backdrop trs-compat"><div class="tm-modal tm-sheet-modal"><div class="tm-sheet-title">' .. escapedTitle .. '</div><div class="tm-sheet-note">' .. escapedErr .. '</div></div></div></div>') == true
        end
        return false, errorChanged
    end
    return true, changed == true
end

function tmFindSingleCharacterSheetRegion(html)
    local raw = tostring(html or "")
    local startA, startB = raw:find(TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_START, 1, true)
    if not startA then return nil end
    if raw:find(TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_START, startB + 1, true) then return nil end
    local endA = raw:find(TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_END, startB + 1, true)
    if not endA then return nil end
    if raw:find(TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_END, endA + #TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_END, true) then return nil end
    return startB, endA
end

function tmFindSinglePopupRegion(html)
    local raw = tostring(html or "")
    local startA, startB = raw:find(TM_POPUP_REGION_START, 1, true)
    if not startA then return nil end
    if raw:find(TM_POPUP_REGION_START, startB + 1, true) then return nil end
    local endA = raw:find(TM_POPUP_REGION_END, startB + 1, true)
    if not endA then return nil end
    if raw:find(TM_POPUP_REGION_END, endA + #TM_POPUP_REGION_END, true) then return nil end
    return startB, endA
end

function tmCanFastRefreshCharacterSheet(triggerId, reason)
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    if _actionLocked == true or getVar(triggerId, "action_locked", "false") == "true" then return false end
    if tostring(reason or "") ~= "close"
        and getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false") ~= "true" then
        return false
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "") ~= "" then return false end
    for _, flag in ipairs({
        "tm_popup_open",
        "ui_scenario_select_open",
        "ui_scenario_sheet_open",
        "ui_player_info_open",
        "ui_wardrobe_open",
        "ui_session_log_open",
        "character_generation_pending",
        "tm_first_session_loading_hold",
        "tm_save_code_pending",
        "tm_session_load_pending",
        "tm_custom_scenario_pending",
        "tm_custom_class_pending",
        "tm_custom_class_generating",
        "tm_input_roll_pending",
    }) do
        if getVar(triggerId, flag, "false") == "true" then return false end
    end
    return true
end

function tmRefreshPopupRegion(triggerId, reason)
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    if _actionLocked == true or getVar(triggerId, "action_locked", "false") == "true" then return false end
    local html = tmGetControlPanelHtml(triggerId)
    if html == "" then return false end
    local startB, endA = tmFindSinglePopupRegion(html)
    if not startB or not endA then return false end
    local ok, popupHtml = pcall(tmRenderInAppPopup, triggerId)
    if not ok then
        print("[TRPG] popup fast refresh error: " .. tostring(popupHtml))
        return false
    end
    local nextHtml = html:sub(1, startB) .. tostring(popupHtml or "") .. html:sub(endA)
    local changed = tmSetControlPanelHtml(triggerId, nextHtml)
    return true, changed == true
end

function tmRefreshCharacterSheetRegion(triggerId, reason)
    if not tmCanFastRefreshCharacterSheet(triggerId, reason) then return false end
    local html = tmGetControlPanelHtml(triggerId)
    if html == "" then return false end
    local startB, endA = tmFindSingleCharacterSheetRegion(html)
    if not startB or not endA then return false end
    local ok, sheetHtml = pcall(tmRenderCharacterSheetRegion, triggerId)
    if not ok then
        print("[TRPG] character sheet fast refresh error: " .. tostring(sheetHtml))
        return false
    end
    local nextHtml = html:sub(1, startB) .. tostring(sheetHtml or "") .. html:sub(endA)
    local changed = tmSetControlPanelHtml(triggerId, nextHtml)
    return true, changed == true
end

function tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, options)
    options = options or {}
    if type(tmApplyPendingPersistentDrawerKeep) == "function" then
        tmApplyPendingPersistentDrawerKeep(triggerId)
    end
    local attemptedFast = false
    local fastOk = true
    local panelChanged = false
    if options.fastPopup then
        attemptedFast = true
        local popupOk, popupChanged = tmRefreshPopupRegion(triggerId, options.fastPopup)
        if popupOk == true then
            panelChanged = panelChanged or popupChanged == true
        else
            fastOk = false
        end
    end
    if fastOk == true and options.fastSheet then
        attemptedFast = true
        local sheetOk, sheetChanged = tmRefreshCharacterSheetRegion(triggerId, options.fastSheet)
        if sheetOk == true then
            panelChanged = panelChanged or sheetChanged == true
        else
            fastOk = false
        end
    end
    local ok = attemptedFast == true and fastOk == true
    if attemptedFast ~= true or fastOk ~= true then
        ok, panelChanged = tmBuildControlPanelSafe(triggerId)
    end
    local markerChanged = false
    if type(tmEnsureControlPanelMarker) == "function" then
        local markerOk, markerResult = pcall(tmEnsureControlPanelMarker, triggerId)
        markerChanged = markerOk and markerResult == true
    end
    if options.reload == false then return false end
    local forceReload = options.forceReload == true
        or options.fullReload == true
        or options.await == true
        or options.reloadLastChar == true
    if ok == true and forceReload ~= true and panelChanged ~= true and markerChanged ~= true then
        return false
    end
    return tmReloadControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, options)
end

-- === SECTION 4: Action Lock ===

_actionLocked = false
TM_GUARDED_DEPTH = 0
TM_STATE_CHANGE_PENDING = false
TM_PENDING_FAST_SHEET_REFRESH = {}
TM_PENDING_FAST_POPUP_REFRESH = {}

function tmQueueFastSheetRefresh(triggerId, reason)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if key == "" then return end
    TM_PENDING_FAST_SHEET_REFRESH[key] = tostring(reason or "sheet")
end

function tmTakeFastSheetRefresh(triggerId)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if key == "" then return nil end
    local reason = TM_PENDING_FAST_SHEET_REFRESH[key]
    TM_PENDING_FAST_SHEET_REFRESH[key] = nil
    return reason
end

function tmQueueFastPopupRefresh(triggerId, reason)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if key == "" then return end
    TM_PENDING_FAST_POPUP_REFRESH[key] = tostring(reason or "popup")
end

function tmTakeFastPopupRefresh(triggerId)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if key == "" then return nil end
    local reason = TM_PENDING_FAST_POPUP_REFRESH[key]
    TM_PENDING_FAST_POPUP_REFRESH[key] = nil
    return reason
end

function guarded(fn, options)
    local guardOptions = options or {}
    return async(function(triggerId)
        pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId, {skipUnchangedSeed = guardOptions.skipUnchangedSeed ~= false})
        if _actionLocked then
            print("[TRPG] guarded: _actionLocked, skipping")
            return
        end
        _actionLocked = true
        tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, true)
        if guardOptions.firstSessionLoading then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "true")
        end
        if guardOptions.saveCodeLoading then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_save_code_pending", "true")
        end
        if guardOptions.sessionLoadLoading then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_session_load_pending", "true")
        end
        local needsPreRefresh = guardOptions.preRefresh == true
            or guardOptions.firstSessionLoading == true
            or guardOptions.saveCodeLoading == true
            or guardOptions.sessionLoadLoading == true
        if needsPreRefresh then
            tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {reloadLastChar = guardOptions.preRefreshReloadLastChar ~= false})
        end
        TM_GUARDED_DEPTH = TM_GUARDED_DEPTH + 1
        local ok, err = pcall(fn, triggerId)
        TM_GUARDED_DEPTH = math.max(0, TM_GUARDED_DEPTH - 1)
        local reloadLastChar = false
        if getVar(triggerId, "tm_post_action_locked_display", "false") == "true" then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_post_action_locked_display", "false")
            reloadLastChar = true
        end
        if not ok then
            print("[TRPG ERROR] " .. tostring(err))
            pcall(tmError, triggerId, "처리 중 오류: " .. tostring(err))
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false")
        end
        if guardOptions.saveCodeLoading then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_save_code_pending", "false")
        end
        if guardOptions.sessionLoadLoading then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_session_load_pending", "false")
        end
        if getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false") == "true" then
            TM_STATE_CHANGE_PENDING = false
            local holdRefreshOptions = {await = true}
            if reloadLastChar then holdRefreshOptions.reloadLastChar = true end
            tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, holdRefreshOptions)
            if getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false") == "true" then
                return
            end
        end
        _actionLocked = false
        tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, false)
        TM_STATE_CHANGE_PENDING = false
        local refreshOptions = {}
        if reloadLastChar then refreshOptions.reloadLastChar = true end
        local fastPopupReason = tmTakeFastPopupRefresh(triggerId)
        if fastPopupReason then refreshOptions.fastPopup = fastPopupReason end
        local fastSheetReason = tmTakeFastSheetRefresh(triggerId)
        if fastSheetReason then refreshOptions.fastSheet = fastSheetReason end
        tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, refreshOptions)
    end)
end

function tmLocalSheetButtonGuard(fn)
    return async(function(triggerId)
        if _actionLocked then
            print("[TRPG] local sheet button: _actionLocked, skipping")
            return
        end
        _actionLocked = true
        if type(tmApplyPendingPersistentDrawerKeep) == "function" then
            pcall(tmApplyPendingPersistentDrawerKeep, triggerId)
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId)
        _actionLocked = false
        if not ok then
            print("[TRPG ERROR] " .. tostring(result))
            pcall(tmError, triggerId, "처리 중 오류: " .. tostring(result))
            tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {fastPopup = "local_sheet_error"})
            return
        end
        if result == "refresh" then
            tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {fastPopup = "local_sheet", fastSheet = "local_sheet"})
        end
    end)
end

function tmSheetBagFastLocalButton(fn)
    return async(function(triggerId)
        if _actionLocked then
            print("[TRPG] sheet bag local button: _actionLocked, skipping")
            return
        end
        _actionLocked = true
        if type(tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen) == "function" then
            pcall(tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen, triggerId, "character-sheet")
        end
        if type(tmApplyPendingPersistentDrawerKeep) == "function" then
            pcall(tmApplyPendingPersistentDrawerKeep, triggerId)
        end
        local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId)
        _actionLocked = false
        if not ok then
            print("[TRPG ERROR] " .. tostring(result))
            pcall(tmError, triggerId, "처리 중 오류: " .. tostring(result))
            tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {fastPopup = "sheet_bag_error"})
            return
        end
        if getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "false") == "true" then
            tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {fastPopup = "sheet_bag_popup"})
        end
    end)
end

function prepareReturnToSessionFlowState(triggerId)

    setVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "true")

    setVar(triggerId, "ui_session_log_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    if sessionStarted then
        setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "playing")

        setVar(triggerId, "last_scene_state_reason", "return_to_running_session")

        setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId) and "session_prep" or getVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "session_prep"))

    end
    setVar(triggerId, "active_scene_heroines", table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","))
end

function tmSessionOrdinalLabelFromCount(count)
    local n = math.max(1, tonumber(count) or 1)
    if n <= 1 then return "첫 세션" end
    return tostring(n) .. "번째 세션"
end

function tmCurrentSessionLabel(triggerId)
    return tmSessionOrdinalLabelFromCount(getNumVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", 1))
end

function tmReturnSessionLabel(triggerId)
    local n = math.max(1, getNumVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", 1))
    if n <= 1 then return "세션" end
    return tmSessionOrdinalLabelFromCount(n)
end

    local nextCount = math.max(0, getNumVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", 0)) + 1
    setVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", tostring(nextCount))
    return nextCount
end

TM_CONTROL_MARKER = "▥TM_CONTROL_PANEL▥"
TM_CONTROL_MARKER_LEGACY = "<<TM_CONTROL_PANEL>>"
TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER = "▥TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY▥"
TM_LOADING_MARKER = "⌛♦⌛"
TM_CONTROL_PANEL_HTML_CACHE = {}
TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_START = "<!--TM_REGION_CHARSHEET_START-->"
TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_END = "<!--TM_REGION_CHARSHEET_END-->"
TM_POPUP_REGION_START = "<!--TM_REGION_POPUP_START-->"
TM_POPUP_REGION_END = "<!--TM_REGION_POPUP_END-->"

function tmSetControlPanelHtml(triggerId, html)
    local value = tostring(html or "")
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    local previous = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "tm_control_panel_html")
        or TM_CONTROL_PANEL_HTML_CACHE[key]
        or ""
    TM_CONTROL_PANEL_HTML_CACHE[key] = value
    local changed = tmRawSetVar(triggerId, "tm_control_panel_html", value)
    if changed == true then
        local rev = tonumber(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_rev") or "", 10) or 0
        if rev < 0 then rev = 0 end
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_rev", tostring(rev + 1))
    end
    return changed == true or tostring(previous or "") ~= value
end

function tmGetControlPanelHtml(triggerId)
    return tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "tm_control_panel_html")
        or TM_CONTROL_PANEL_HTML_CACHE[tostring(triggerId or "")]
        or ""
end

function tmStripLoadingMarker(text)
    local clean = tostring(text or "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?" .. TM_LOADING_MARKER .. "%s*\n?", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("[ \t]+\n", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n\n\n+", "\n\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n+$", "")
    return clean
end

function tmShouldAppendIllustrationWait(triggerId, text)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    if raw == "" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "asset_display", "show") == "hide" then return false end
    return raw:find('<img="', 1, true) ~= nil
end

function tmAppendIllustrationWaitMarker(triggerId, text)
    local clean = tmStripLoadingMarker(text)
    if tmShouldAppendIllustrationWait(triggerId, clean) then
        return clean .. "\n" .. TM_LOADING_MARKER
    end
    return clean
end

function tmClearIllustrationWaitMarkerFromLastChar(triggerId, options)
    local opts = options or {}
    if not opts.force and getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false") == "true" then return false end
    if type(getFullChat) ~= "function" or type(setChat) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok, chatHistory = pcall(getFullChat, triggerId)
    if not ok or type(chatHistory) ~= "table" then return false end
    for i = #chatHistory, 1, -1 do
        local message = chatHistory[i]
        if type(message) == "table" and message.role == "char" then
            local text = tostring(message.data or "")
            if not text:find(TM_LOADING_MARKER, 1, true) then return false end
            local clean = tmStripLoadingMarker(text)
            if clean ~= text then
                setChat(triggerId, i - 1, clean)
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
    end
    return false
end

TM_CLASS_ORDER = {"warrior", "paladin", "mage", "rogue", "priest", "dancer", "monk", "summoner", "maid", "ranger", "warlock", "bard"}
TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF = {
    id = "rogue",
    name = "로그",
    main = "DEX/WIS",
    order = {"dex", "wis", "con", "int", "cha", "str"},
    hp = 22,
    mp = 4,
    role = "정찰, 보조",
    outfit = "rogue_cosplay",
}

function tmNormalizeClassId(raw)
    local id = tostring(raw or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if id:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$") then return id end
    return ""
end

function tmClassBool(value)
    local text = tostring(value or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return text == "true" or text == "yes" or text == "1"
end

function tmClassStatOrderFromText(raw, fallback)
    local allowed = {str = true, dex = true, con = true, int = true, wis = true, cha = true}
    local out, seen = {}, {}
    for token in tostring(raw or ""):lower():gmatch("[a-z]+") do
        if allowed[token] and not seen[token] then
            seen[token] = true
            table.insert(out, token)
        end
    end
    for _, token in ipairs(fallback or {}) do
        if allowed[token] and not seen[token] then
            seen[token] = true
            table.insert(out, token)
        end
    end
    if #out == 0 then return {"dex", "wis", "con", "int", "cha", "str"} end
    return out
end

function tmApplyClassDefaultExtension(sheet, extensions)
    if type(sheet) ~= "table" or type(extensions) ~= "table" then return sheet end
    local defaults = extensions.tm_class_defaults
    if type(defaults) ~= "table" then return sheet end
    if defaults.equipment then sheet.DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT = tostring(defaults.equipment) end
    if defaults.skill then sheet.DEFAULT_SKILL = tostring(defaults.skill) end
    if defaults.equipment_name then sheet.DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT_NAME = tostring(defaults.equipment_name) end
    if defaults.skill_name then sheet.DEFAULT_SKILL_NAME = tostring(defaults.skill_name) end
    if defaults.equipment_desc then sheet.DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT_DESC = tostring(defaults.equipment_desc) end
    if defaults.skill_desc then sheet.DEFAULT_SKILL_DESC = tostring(defaults.skill_desc) end
    return sheet
end

function tmBuildClassDefFromSheet(classId, sheet)
    local id = tmNormalizeClassId(classId)
    if id == "" then return nil end
    local base = TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF
    local def = {
        id = id,
        name = (sheet and sheet.DISPLAY_NAME and sheet.DISPLAY_NAME ~= "" and sheet.DISPLAY_NAME) or (id == base.id and base.name or id),
        name_en = sheet and sheet.DISPLAY_NAME_EN or nil,
        name_ja = sheet and sheet.DISPLAY_NAME_JA or nil,
        main = (sheet and sheet.MAIN_STATS and sheet.MAIN_STATS ~= "" and sheet.MAIN_STATS) or base.main,
        role = (sheet and sheet.ROLE and sheet.ROLE ~= "" and sheet.ROLE) or base.role,
        order = tmClassStatOrderFromText(sheet and (sheet.STAT_ORDER or sheet.STAT_BIAS) or "", base.order),
        hp = tonumber(sheet and sheet.HP_BASE) or tonumber(base.hp) or 22,
        mp = tonumber(sheet and sheet.MP_BASE) or tonumber(base.mp) or 4,
        concept_ko = sheet and sheet.CONCEPT_KO or nil,
        concept_en = sheet and sheet.CONCEPT_EN or nil,
        concept_ja = sheet and sheet.CONCEPT_JA or nil,
        concept_tokens = sheet and sheet.CONCEPT_TOKENS or nil,
        outfit = (sheet and sheet.GENASSETS_OUTFIT and sheet.GENASSETS_OUTFIT ~= "" and sheet.GENASSETS_OUTFIT) or base.outfit,
        default_loadout = sheet and {
            equipment = sheet.DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT or "",
            skill = sheet.DEFAULT_SKILL or "",
            equipment_name = sheet.DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT_NAME or "",
            skill_name = sheet.DEFAULT_SKILL_NAME or "",
            equipment_desc = sheet.DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT_DESC or "",
            skill_desc = sheet.DEFAULT_SKILL_DESC or "",
        } or nil,
        manual_only = tmClassBool(sheet and (sheet.RANDOM_EXCLUDE or sheet.MANUAL_ONLY)),
        trait = sheet,
    }
    return def
end

function tmGetClassTraitLoreBooks(triggerId)
    if type(getLoreBooks) ~= "function" then return false, nil end
    local previous = ""
    if type(getVar) == "function" then
        previous = getVar(triggerId, "tm_lua_class_defaults", "")
    end
    if type(setVar) == "function" then
        pcall(setVar, triggerId, "tm_lua_class_defaults", "true")
    end
    local ok, books = pcall(getLoreBooks, triggerId, "TRAIT")
    if type(setVar) == "function" then
        pcall(setVar, triggerId, "tm_lua_class_defaults", previous)
    end
    return ok, books
end

function tmLoadClassRegistry(triggerId)
    local list, byId, seen = {}, {}, {}
    local orderIndex = {}
    for index, classId in ipairs(TM_CLASS_ORDER) do orderIndex[classId] = index end
    local function addDef(def)
        if not def or def.id == "" then return end
        if not seen[def.id] then
            seen[def.id] = true
            table.insert(list, def.id)
        end
        byId[def.id] = def
    end
    if type(getLoreBooks) == "function" then
        local ok, books = tmGetClassTraitLoreBooks(triggerId)
        if ok and type(books) == "table" then
            for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.content) == "string" then
                    local sheet = parseSheet(entry.content)
                    tmApplyClassDefaultExtension(sheet, entry.extensions)
                    local id = tmNormalizeClassId(sheet.CLASS or "")
                    if id ~= "" then addDef(tmBuildClassDefFromSheet(id, sheet)) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #list == 0 then addDef(tmBuildClassDefFromSheet(TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id, nil)) end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        local ai = orderIndex[a] or 9999
        local bi = orderIndex[b] or 9999
        if ai == bi then return a < b end
        return ai < bi
    end)
    return {list = list, byId = byId}
end

function tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local id = tmNormalizeClassId(classId)
    local registry = tmLoadClassRegistry(triggerId)
    return registry.byId[id] or registry.byId[TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id] or tmBuildClassDefFromSheet(TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id, nil)
end

function tmClassExists(triggerId, classId)
    local id = tmNormalizeClassId(classId)
    if id == "" then return false end
    return tmLoadClassRegistry(triggerId).byId[id] ~= nil
end

function tmClassIds(triggerId, includeManualOnly)
    local registry = tmLoadClassRegistry(triggerId)
    local out = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(registry.list) do
        local def = registry.byId[id]
        if def and (includeManualOnly or not def.manual_only) then table.insert(out, id) end
    end
    return out
end

function tmClassValidListText(triggerId, includeManualOnly)
    return table.concat(tmClassIds(triggerId, includeManualOnly), ", ")
end

function tmClassRoleListText(triggerId, includeManualOnly)
    local registry = tmLoadClassRegistry(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(tmClassIds(triggerId, includeManualOnly)) do
        local def = registry.byId[id]
        local role = def and def.role or ""
        if role == "" then role = def and def.main or "" end
        table.insert(rows, id .. " " .. role)
    end
    return table.concat(rows, "; ")
end

function tmClassNameRuntime(triggerId, classId)
    return (tmClassDef(triggerId, classId).name or tmClassName(classId))
end

function tmClassOutfitToken(triggerId, classId)
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local outfit = cls and cls.outfit or TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.outfit
    if outfit == nil or outfit == "" then outfit = TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.outfit end
    return outfit
end

<li><b>C/B/A/S</b>는 별도의 구조 효과 등급입니다. 능력치 보너스나 스킬 기본 효과량과 섞이지 않습니다.</li>

<li>캐릭터가 가진 장비/아이템과 스킬 옆의 <b>-</b>는 각각 공용 가방으로 반환하거나 스킬 잊기 확인 팝업을 엽니다. 스킬 사용은 캐릭터 시트의 스킬 슬롯과 MP, 대상 조건을 기준으로 검증됩니다.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>골드는 <b>에피소드(퀘스트) 클리어 보상</b>과 <b>몬스터 처치</b>로 들어옵니다. 처치 보상은 적의 등급이 높을수록 많아집니다.</li>
<li>이 보상들은 <b>시스템이 자동으로 지급</b>합니다. 따로 받을 처리를 할 필요가 없습니다.</li>
</ul>
<h5>쓰는 법</h5>

<li><b>여관 숙박</b>: 하룻밤 쉬며 체력을 회복합니다. 비용은 약 <b>20골드</b>입니다(쓰러진 동료는 여관이 아니라 교회에서 살립니다).</li>

<ul>
<li><b>상점·여관·교회는 버튼이 아닙니다.</b> "상점에 간다", "여관에서 하룻밤 묵는다", "교회에서 OO를 부활시킨다"처럼 <b>대화로 직접 입력</b>하면 GM이 그 장면을 진행합니다.</li>

function tmManualEntry(triggerId, page)
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" and TM_MANUAL_PAGES_EN[page] then return TM_MANUAL_PAGES_EN[page] end
    if lang == "ja" and TM_MANUAL_PAGES_JA[page] then return TM_MANUAL_PAGES_JA[page] end
    return TM_MANUAL_PAGES[page]
end

function tmManualNavHtml(triggerId, page, total)
    local dots = {}
    for i = 1, total do
        local cls = "tm-manual-dot"
        if i == page then cls = cls .. " tm-manual-dot-current" end
        table.insert(dots, '<span class="' .. cls .. '">' .. tmButton(tostring(i), "tmManualPage" .. tostring(i)) .. '</span>')
    end
    return '<div class="tm-manual-nav">'
        .. '<span class="tm-manual-arrow tm-manual-prev">' .. tmButton("‹", "tmManualPrev") .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-manual-dots">' .. table.concat(dots, "") .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-manual-arrow tm-manual-next">' .. tmButton("›", "tmManualNext") .. '</span>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmManualBodyHtml(triggerId)
    local pages = {}
    local total = #TM_MANUAL_PAGES
    for i = 1, total do
        local entry = tmManualEntry(triggerId, i) or TM_MANUAL_PAGES[i]
        if entry then
            table.insert(pages, tmPhonePage(entry.title or "", '<div class="tm-manual-page">' .. tostring(entry.body or "") .. '</div>', "tm-manual-slide-page"))
        end
    end
    local page = clamp(getNumVar(triggerId, "tm_manual_page", 1), 1, math.max(#pages, 1))
    return tmPhoneSlider("manual-" .. tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId), pages, page)
end

TM_STAT_LABELS = {str = "STR", dex = "DEX", con = "CON", int = "INT", wis = "WIS", cha = "CHA"}
TM_STAT_LABELS_KO = {str = "근력", dex = "민첩", con = "체력", int = "지능", wis = "지혜", cha = "매력"}
TM_PLAYER_STAT_KEYS = {"str", "dex", "con", "int", "wis", "cha"}
TM_PLAYER_STAT_INDEX = {str = 1, dex = 2, con = 3, int = 4, wis = 5, cha = 6}

function tmPackPlayerStatsFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
    local values = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_PLAYER_STAT_KEYS) do
        table.insert(values, tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. key, 10)))
    end
    return table.concat(values, ",")
end

function tmUnpackNumberCsv(raw, expectedCount, fallback)
    local out = {}
    for item in tostring(raw or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        table.insert(out, tonumber(item) or fallback or 0)
    end
    for i = #out + 1, expectedCount do
        out[i] = fallback or 0
    end
    return out
end

function tmEnsurePlayerStatsPacked(triggerId, ownerId)
    local varName = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_stats"
    local raw = getVar(triggerId, varName, "")
    if raw == "" or raw == "none" then
        raw = tmPackPlayerStatsFromLegacy(triggerId, ownerId)
        setVar(triggerId, varName, raw)
    end
    return raw
end

function tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey, default)
    local key = normalizeStatKey(statKey)
    local idx = TM_PLAYER_STAT_INDEX[key]
    if not idx then return default or 10 end
    local values = tmUnpackNumberCsv(tmEnsurePlayerStatsPacked(triggerId, ownerId), #TM_PLAYER_STAT_KEYS, default or 10)
    return values[idx] or default or 10
end

function tmSetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey, value)
    local key = normalizeStatKey(statKey)
    local idx = TM_PLAYER_STAT_INDEX[key]
    if not idx then return false end
    local values = tmUnpackNumberCsv(tmEnsurePlayerStatsPacked(triggerId, ownerId), #TM_PLAYER_STAT_KEYS, 10)
    values[idx] = tonumber(value) or values[idx] or 10
    local packed = {}
    for i = 1, #TM_PLAYER_STAT_KEYS do
        table.insert(packed, tostring(values[i] or 10))
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_stats", table.concat(packed, ","))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. key, values[idx])
    return true
end

function tmEscapeHtml(value)
    local s = tostring(value or "")
    s = s:gsub("&", "&amp;")
    s = s:gsub("<", "&lt;")
    s = s:gsub(">", "&gt;")
    s = s:gsub('"', "&quot;")
    return s
end

function tmBriefLineBreaks(value)
    local s = tmEscapeHtml(value)
    s = s:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("\r", "\n"):gsub("\n+", "<br>")
    s = s:gsub("%. +", ".<br>")
    s = s:gsub("。 +", "。<br>")
    s = s:gsub("! +", "!<br>")
    s = s:gsub("%? +", "?<br>")
    return s
end

function tmRenderGuideText(value)
    local text = tostring(value or "")
    local before, example = text:match("^(.-)%s*%(?예:%s*(.+)%)%s*$")
    if not before then
        before, example = text:match("^(.-)%s*예:%s*(.+)$")
    end
    if before and example then
        example = example:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        return tmBriefLineBreaks(before) .. '<br><span class="tm-guide-example">(예: ' .. tmEscapeHtml(example) .. ')</span>'
    end
    return tmBriefLineBreaks(text)
end

function tmPhoneRadio(group, index, checked)
    local id = "tm-phone-" .. tostring(group) .. "-" .. tostring(index)
    local state = checked and " checked" or ""
    return '<input type="radio" class="tm-phone-radio tm-phone-radio-' .. tostring(index) .. '" name="tm-phone-' .. tostring(group) .. '" id="' .. id .. '"' .. state .. '>'
end

function tmPhoneDot(group, index, label)
    local id = "tm-phone-" .. tostring(group) .. "-" .. tostring(index)
    return '<label class="tm-phone-dot tm-phone-dot-' .. tostring(index) .. '" for="' .. id .. '" aria-label="' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '"></label>'
end

function tmPhoneArrow(group, kind, fromIndex, toIndex, label)
    local id = "tm-phone-" .. tostring(group) .. "-" .. tostring(toIndex)
    return '<label class="tm-phone-arrow tm-phone-' .. kind .. ' tm-phone-' .. kind .. '-' .. tostring(fromIndex) .. '" for="' .. id .. '" aria-label="' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '">' .. (kind == "prev" and "‹" or "›") .. '</label>'
end

function tmPhonePage(title, body, extraClass)
    local cls = extraClass and (" " .. tostring(extraClass)) or ""
    return '<section class="tm-phone-page' .. cls .. '"><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(title) .. '</h4><div class="tm-phone-page-body">' .. tostring(body or "") .. '</div></section>'
end

function tmPhonePageHtmlTitle(titleHtml, body, extraClass)
    local cls = extraClass and (" " .. tostring(extraClass)) or ""
    return '<section class="tm-phone-page' .. cls .. '"><h4>' .. tostring(titleHtml or "") .. '</h4><div class="tm-phone-page-body">' .. tostring(body or "") .. '</div></section>'
end

function tmPhoneSlider(group, pages, checkedIndex)
    local count = #pages
    local radios, arrows, dots = {}, {}, {}
    local checked = clamp(tonumber(checkedIndex) or 1, 1, math.max(count, 1))
    for i = 1, count do
        table.insert(radios, tmPhoneRadio(group, i, i == checked))
        local prev = (i == 1) and count or (i - 1)
        local next = (i == count) and 1 or (i + 1)
        table.insert(arrows, tmPhoneArrow(group, "prev", i, prev, "이전"))
        table.insert(arrows, tmPhoneArrow(group, "next", i, next, "다음"))
        table.insert(dots, tmPhoneDot(group, i, "페이지 " .. tostring(i)))
    end
    return '<div class="tm-phone-frame tm-phone-pages-' .. tostring(count) .. '">'
        .. table.concat(radios, "")
        .. '<div class="tm-phone-screen"><div class="tm-phone-track">' .. table.concat(pages, "") .. '</div></div>'
        .. table.concat(arrows, "")
        .. '<div class="tm-phone-dots">' .. table.concat(dots, "") .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId)

    if pcName ~= "" and pcName ~= "미정" and pcName ~= "pending" then
        return pcName .. "(" .. realName .. ")"
    end
    return realName
end

    end

end

function tmAppendRollMeta(triggerId, meta)

    if text == "" then return end
    local cur = getVar(triggerId, "last_roll_meta", "")
    if cur == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "last_roll_meta", text)
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "last_roll_meta", cur .. "\n" .. text)
    end
end

    for _ in tostring(meta or ""):gmatch("▥ROLL actor=") do count = count + 1 end
    return count
end

function tmVisibleSpeakerLabel(triggerId, ownerId)
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) end
    return tostring(ownerId or "")
end

function tmReplaceInternalSpeakerLabels(triggerId, output)
    local text = tostring(output or "")
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local label = '<span class="tm-speaker-label">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmVisibleSpeakerLabel(triggerId, id)) .. '</span>'
        text = text:gsub("%[" .. id .. "%]%s*:%s*", label .. "\n")
        text = text:gsub("\n" .. id .. "%s*:%s*", "\n" .. label .. "\n")
        text = text:gsub("^" .. id .. "%s*:%s*", label .. "\n")
    end
    return text
end

function tmSigned(value)
    local n = tonumber(value) or 0
    if n >= 0 then return "+" .. tostring(n) end
    return tostring(n)
end

function tmCleanLogText(text)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    s = s:gsub("[\r\n]+", " ")
    s = s:gsub("▥.-▥", "")
    s = s:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    s = s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return s
end

function tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, text)
    local entry = tmCleanLogText(text)
    if entry == "" then return end
    local count = getNumVar(triggerId, "session_log_count", 0) + 1
    setVar(triggerId, "session_log_count", count)
    local rows = {}
    local recent = getVar(triggerId, "session_log_recent", "")
    for line in tostring(recent or ""):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        if line ~= "" then table.insert(rows, line) end
    end
    table.insert(rows, string.format("%02d. %s", count, entry))
    while #rows > TM_SESSION_LOG_MAX do table.remove(rows, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, "session_log_recent", table.concat(rows, "\n"))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_session_log_entry", entry)
end

function tmSetSessionLogSummary(triggerId, text)
    local summary = tmCleanLogText(text)
    if summary ~= "" then setVar(triggerId, "session_log_summary", summary) end
end

function tmSessionLogLines(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    local recent = getVar(triggerId, "session_log_recent", "")
    for line in tostring(recent or ""):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        if line ~= "" then table.insert(rows, line) end
    end
    return rows
end
