function tmTextCharCount(text)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    local count = 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        local b = s:byte(i)
        if b < 0x80 or b >= 0xC0 then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count
end

function tmCleanUtf8Text(text)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    if s == "" then return "" end
    local out = {}
    local i = 1
    local len = #s
    local function cont(pos)
        local b = s:byte(pos)
        return b and b >= 0x80 and b <= 0xBF
    end
    local function keep(n)
        table.insert(out, s:sub(i, i + n - 1))
        i = i + n
    end
    while i <= len do
        local b1 = s:byte(i)
        if b1 < 0x80 then
            keep(1)
        elseif b1 >= 0xC2 and b1 <= 0xDF and cont(i + 1) then
            keep(2)
        elseif b1 == 0xE0 and s:byte(i + 1) and s:byte(i + 1) >= 0xA0 and s:byte(i + 1) <= 0xBF and cont(i + 2) then
            keep(3)
        elseif b1 >= 0xE1 and b1 <= 0xEC and cont(i + 1) and cont(i + 2) then
            keep(3)
        elseif b1 == 0xED and s:byte(i + 1) and s:byte(i + 1) >= 0x80 and s:byte(i + 1) <= 0x9F and cont(i + 2) then
            keep(3)
        elseif b1 == 0xEF and s:byte(i + 1) == 0xBF and s:byte(i + 2) == 0xBD then
            i = i + 3
        elseif b1 >= 0xEE and b1 <= 0xEF and cont(i + 1) and cont(i + 2) then
            keep(3)
        elseif b1 == 0xF0 and s:byte(i + 1) and s:byte(i + 1) >= 0x90 and s:byte(i + 1) <= 0xBF and cont(i + 2) and cont(i + 3) then
            keep(4)
        elseif b1 >= 0xF1 and b1 <= 0xF3 and cont(i + 1) and cont(i + 2) and cont(i + 3) then
            keep(4)
        elseif b1 == 0xF4 and s:byte(i + 1) and s:byte(i + 1) >= 0x80 and s:byte(i + 1) <= 0x8F and cont(i + 2) and cont(i + 3) then
            keep(4)
        else
            i = i + 1
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

function tmRollActionCapText(text)
    local clean = tmCleanUtf8Text(text):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if type(tmTruncateUtf8) == "function" then
        return tmTruncateUtf8(clean, TM_ROLL_ACTION_TEXT_MAX)
    end
    return clean
end

function tmRollReasonText(reason)
    local text = tmCleanUtf8Text(reason)
    text = text:gsub('"', "'")
    text = text:gsub("▥", " ")
    text = text:gsub("[\r\n]+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return text
end

function tmRollActionCompareText(text)
    local s = tostring(text or ""):lower()
    s = s:gsub("[,%.%!%?;:%(%)%[%]%{%}\"'`~]", " ")
    for _, punct in ipairs({"，", "。", "！", "？", "…", "·", "“", "”", "‘", "’", "《", "》", "〈", "〉", "「", "」", "『", "』", "、"}) do
        s = s:gsub(punct, " ")
    end
    return s:gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function tmRollActionWordCount(text)
    local count = 0
    for token in tmRollActionCompareText(text):gmatch("%S+") do
        if token ~= "" then count = count + 1 end
    end
    return count
end

function tmRollReasonLooksGeneric(reason, intent)
    local r = tmRollActionCompareText(reason)
    local i = tmRollActionCompareText(intent)
    if r == "" or i == "" then return false end
    if r == i then return false end
    local rChars = tmTextCharCount(r)
    local iChars = tmTextCharCount(i)
    if iChars <= rChars + 4 then return false end
    local rWords = tmRollActionWordCount(r)
    if rWords <= 3 then return true end
    if rWords <= 4 and countKeywords(r, TM_ROLL_ACTION_GENERIC_WORDS) > 0 then return true end
    return false
end

function tmRollIntentText(triggerId, actor)
    local owner = tostring(actor or "")
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[owner] then return "" end
    local text = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_intent", "")
    text = tostring(text or "")
    text = text:gsub('"', "'")
    text = text:gsub("▥", " ")
    text = text:gsub("[\r\n]+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return text
end

function tmRollActionHasFreshIntent(triggerId, actor)
    if TM_ROLL_ACTION_INTENT_DETAIL_ALLOWED ~= true then return false end
    local owner = tostring(actor or "")
    if owner == "" then return false end
    local applied = "," .. getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_applied_ids", "") .. ","
    return applied:find("," .. owner .. ",", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function tmRollActionMergeText(reason, intent)
    local r = tmRollReasonText(reason)
    local i = tostring(intent or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if r == "" then return tmRollActionCapText(i) end
    if i == "" then return tmRollActionCapText(r) end
    local rc = tmRollActionCompareText(r)
    local ic = tmRollActionCompareText(i)
    if rc == ic or ic:find(rc, 1, true) then
        return tmRollActionCapText(i)
    end
    return tmRollActionCapText(r .. " - " .. i)
end

function tmRollActionText(triggerId, actor, reason)
    local text = tmRollReasonText(reason)
    if text ~= "" then
        if tmRollActionHasFreshIntent(triggerId, actor) then
            local intent = tmRollIntentText(triggerId, actor)
            if intent ~= "" and tmRollReasonLooksGeneric(text, intent) then
                return tmRollActionMergeText(text, intent)
            end
        end
        return tmRollActionCapText(text)
    end
    text = tmRollIntentText(triggerId, actor)
    if text ~= "" then return tmRollActionCapText(text) end
    text = tmCleanLogText(getVar(triggerId, "last_session_log_entry", ""))
    if text ~= "" then return tmRollActionCapText(text) end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_action_missing", tostring(actor or "") .. ":" .. tostring(reason or ""))
    print("[TRPGMaster] missing roll action text for " .. tostring(actor or "unknown"))
    return ""
end

function tmFastFnButtonAllowedForRender(fn)
    local fnName = tostring(fn or "")
    if fnName == "" then return false end
    local exact = {
        closeCharSheet = true,
        closeSidePanel = true,
        closeInAppPopup = true,
        closeSessionLogPanel = true,
        closePlayerInfoPanel = true,
        closeWardrobePanel = true,
        closeScenarioSheetPanel = true,
        startNormalScene = true,
        tmReturnToSessionFlow = true,
        tmManualPrev = true,
        tmManualNext = true,
        tmRefreshGuideLead = true,
        tmApplyGuideLead = true,
        tmToggleGuideLeadCollapsed = true,
        tmCloseScenarioPicker = true,
        tmScenarioPickerPrev = true,
        tmScenarioPickerNext = true,
        tmStartFreeScenarioInput = true,
        tmCancelFreeScenarioInput = true,
        tmGenerateRandomScenario = true,
        tmAskEndScenario = true,
        tmConfirmEndScenario = true,
        tmCancelEndScenario = true,
        tmAskSessionSaveSeed = true,
        tmShowSessionSaveSeed = true,
        tmOpenSessionSeedLoadPopup = true,
        tmStartCustomClassInput = true,
        tmAskCreateCharacters = true,
        tmConfirmCreateCharacters = true,
        tmStartFirstSessionFromPrep = true,
        tmAskRerollAllSheets = true,
        tmConfirmRerollActiveSheet = true,
        tmConfirmRerollAllSheets = true,
        tmCancelSheetEdit = true,
        tmPartyBagCancelTarget = true,
        tmPartyBagConfirmSell = true,
        tmSheetBagConfirmLearn = true,
        tmSheetBagConfirmForget = true,
        tmSheetBagConfirmSell = true,
        tmForceUnlock = true,
    }
    if exact[fnName] then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmManualPage%d+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmSelectEpisodeChoice%d+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmAskRerollSheet_[%w_]+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmOpenClassSelect_[%w_]+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmSetClassSlot_%d%d$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmLevelUp_[%w_]+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmSpendAp_[%w_]+_[%a]+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmPartyBagTarget_[%w_]+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^tmBag[%w_%-]+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^setLang_[%w_]+$") then return true end
    if fnName:match("^setDiceXpMultiplier%d+$") then return true end
    return false
end

function tmButton(label, fn)
    local fnName = tostring(fn or "")
    if type(tmDrawerButtonFnForRender) == "function" then
        fnName = tmDrawerButtonFnForRender(fnName)
    end
    if tmFastFnButtonAllowedForRender(fnName) then
        return '<button class="button-default" risu-btn="' .. tmEscapeHtml("fn-" .. fnName) .. '">' .. tostring(label or "") .. '</button>'
    end
    return "{{button::" .. tostring(label or "") .. "::" .. fnName .. "}}"
end

function tmFnButton(label, fn)
    local fnName = tostring(fn or "")
    if type(tmDrawerButtonFnForRender) == "function" then
        fnName = tmDrawerButtonFnForRender(fnName)
    end
    return '<button class="button-default" risu-btn="' .. tmEscapeHtml("fn-" .. fnName) .. '">' .. tostring(label or "") .. '</button>'
end

function tmPopupSafeButton(label, fn)
    local fnName = tostring(fn or "")
    if fnName == "closeInAppPopup" then
        return tmFnButton(label, fnName)
    end
    return tmButton(label, fnName)
end

function tmSideSlideSafeButton(label, fn)
    local fnName = tostring(fn or "")
    if fnName == "closeSidePanel" or fnName == "closeCharSheet" then
        return tmFnButton(label, fnName)
    end
    return tmButton(label, fnName)
end

function tmTriggerLabelButtonHtml(label, fn, targetId, className)
    local fnName = tostring(fn or "")
    if type(tmDrawerButtonFnForRender) == "function" then
        fnName = tmDrawerButtonFnForRender(fnName)
    end
    local cls = "tm-trigger-label-button"
    if tostring(className or "") ~= "" then cls = cls .. " " .. tostring(className or "") end
    return '<button type="button" class="' .. tmEscapeHtml(cls) .. '" risu-trigger="' .. tmEscapeHtml(fnName) .. '"><label for="' .. tmEscapeHtml(targetId) .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '</label></button>'
end

-- D212/P309: risu-btn variant of tmTriggerLabelButtonHtml. Emits an onButtonClick
-- payload (a plain data string) instead of a risu-trigger, so a click routes to the
-- top-level onButtonClick dispatcher (no global ReloadGUIPointer remount) instead of
-- the manual/risu-trigger var-route that forces a global remount ("튕김"). Keeps the
-- nested <label for> so the click still flips the hidden checkbox for the 0ms :checked
-- visual preview, and does NOT stopPropagation (we WANT the native label toggle).
-- Unlike tmTriggerLabelButtonHtml this does NOT run tmDrawerButtonFnForRender on the
-- payload (payload is a stable slot reference, not a Lua fn name).
function tmSheetBagRisuBtnLabelHtml(label, payload, targetId, className)
    local cls = "tm-trigger-label-button"
    if tostring(className or "") ~= "" then cls = cls .. " " .. tostring(className or "") end
    return '<button type="button" class="' .. tmEscapeHtml(cls) .. '" risu-btn="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tostring(payload or "")) .. '"><label for="' .. tmEscapeHtml(targetId) .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '</label></button>'
end

function tmSheetBagToggleLabelButtonHtml(label, targetId, className)
    local cls = "tm-trigger-label-button"
    if tostring(className or "") ~= "" then cls = cls .. " " .. tostring(className or "") end
    return '<button type="button" class="' .. tmEscapeHtml(cls) .. '"><label for="' .. tmEscapeHtml(targetId) .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '</label></button>'
end

function tmClassName(classId)
    local id = tmNormalizeClassId(classId)
    if id == TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id then return TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.name end
    if id ~= "" then return id end
    return TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.name
end

function tmClassNameForLang(triggerId, classId)
    local id = tostring(classId or "")
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, id)
    local names = TM_CLASS_NAME_I18N[id]
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" and cls.name_en and cls.name_en ~= "" then return cls.name_en end
    if lang == "ja" and cls.name_ja and cls.name_ja ~= "" then return cls.name_ja end
    if lang == "en" and names and names.en then return names.en end
    if lang == "ja" and names and names.ja then return names.ja end
    return cls.name
end

function tmBuildCosplayContext(triggerId, opening)
    local lines = {"[Cosplay event state]"}
    local firstRevealPending = opening and getVar(triggerId, "cosplay_event_done", "false") ~= "true"
    local repeatSessionPrep = opening and getVar(triggerId, "cosplay_event_done", "false") == "true"
    if firstRevealPending then
        table.insert(lines, "- First-session cosplay reveal is pending. Include it in the opening scene before the in-scenario danger begins.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Costume funding, fitting, repair, and detail-work facts should come from CHR profile context, not static SYSTEM facts. The user GM did not order this.")
    elseif repeatSessionPrep then
        table.insert(lines, "- First-session cosplay reveal already happened. This opening is a later session or new scenario prep beat.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Present costume changing as an established Persona Table routine: quick refitting, class outfit updates, prop checks, and familiar teasing before the scenario begins.")
        table.insert(lines, "- The user GM already knows they do serious class cosplay; the scene should not repeat the first-time surprise or the full hallway reveal.")
    elseif getVar(triggerId, "cosplay_event_done", "false") == "true" then
        table.insert(lines, "- First-session cosplay reveal already happened. The players are wearing high-quality class cosplay while seated at the table.")
    else
        table.insert(lines, "- No cosplay reveal has happened yet.")
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- Treat cosplay as real Seongsil University clubroom costumes, not magical transformation, not separate fantasy portraits, and not a system UI event.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Costume quality is serious and near professional: tailored fabric, fitted accessories, safe but convincing prop weapons, polished stage-level finish.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Do not describe cheap improvised props such as mops, foam board, cardboard armor, bedsheets, blankets, graduation gowns, taped toy swords, or rough paper props.")
    if firstRevealPending then
        table.insert(lines, "- The reveal is romcom because the user did not expect this level of preparation, not because the costumes are sloppy.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Romcom sequence: after PC sheets are done, the players tell the user to wait outside; the confused user hears hurried voices; when invited back in, the four are already in class-inspired cosplay.")
    elseif repeatSessionPrep then
        table.insert(lines, "- Later-session costume beat: the players already know the routine; keep it shorter than the first reveal and let the humor come from small adjustments, class changes, and familiar embarrassment.")
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- Use CHR profile context to decide which members are excited, embarrassed, shy, proud, practical, or hesitant.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Let them justify it in dialogue as Persona Table being a roleplay research club: if they are doing this, they should do it properly.")
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_class", "rogue")
        local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
        local outfitToken = tmClassOutfitToken(triggerId, classId)
        local portraitTag = id .. "_neutral_" .. outfitToken
        table.insert(lines, string.format(
            "- %s/%s: class=%s(%s), concept=%s, outfit_state=%s, image_tag_outfit=%s, portrait_tag=<img=\"%s\">",
            CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or id,
            id,
            classId,
            cls.name,
            getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_concept_title", ""),
            getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_current_outfit_state", "default"),
            outfitToken,
            portraitTag
        ))
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmNaiCleanText(value)
    local text = tostring(value or "")
    text = text:gsub("▥", " ")
    text = text:gsub("[\r\n]+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return text
end

function tmFetchLoreSheetByComment(triggerId, comment, matcher)
    if type(getLoreBooks) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok, books = pcall(getLoreBooks, triggerId, comment)
    if not ok or type(books) ~= "table" then return nil end
    for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.content) == "string" then
            local sheet = parseSheet(entry.content)
            if matcher(entry, sheet) then return sheet end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function tmFetchChrSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    local id = tostring(ownerId or "")
    if id == "" then return nil end
    return tmFetchLoreSheetByComment(triggerId, "CHR", function(entry, sheet)
        return entry.name == id or sheet.ID == ("char_" .. id)
    end)
end

function tmFetchClassTraitSheet(triggerId, classId)
    local id = tostring(classId or ""):lower()
    if id == "" then return nil end
    return tmFetchLoreSheetByComment(triggerId, "TRAIT", function(entry, sheet)
        return entry.name == ("class_" .. id) or tostring(sheet.CLASS or ""):lower() == id
    end)
end

function tmClassIdForNaiGuide(triggerId, ownerId)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "")
    if tmClassExists(triggerId, classId) then return classId end
    local starter = TM_STARTER_CONCEPTS[ownerId] or TM_STARTER_CONCEPTS.yuseola
    return (starter and starter.class) or "rogue"
end

TM_XNAI_SLOT_LABELS = {"girlA", "girlB", "girlC", "girlD"}

function tmXnaiOwnerListFromCsv(raw)
    local out = {}
    local seen = {}
    for token in tostring(raw or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local ownerId = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] and not seen[ownerId] then
            seen[ownerId] = true
            table.insert(out, ownerId)
        end
    end
    return out
end

function tmXnaiPrimaryOwnerList(triggerId)
    local addressee = getVar(triggerId, "last_addressee", "")
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[addressee] then
        return {addressee}, "single_addressee"
    end

    local active = tmXnaiOwnerListFromCsv(getVar(triggerId, "active_scene_heroines", ""))
    if addressee == "all" then
        if #active > 0 then return active, "explicit_all" end
        return CHAR_IDS, "explicit_all"
    end
    if #active == 1 then
        return active, "single_active_scene"
    end

    local activeOwner = getVar(triggerId, "active_owner_id", "")
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[activeOwner] then
        return {activeOwner}, "active_owner_default"
    end
    if #active > 0 then
        return {active[1]}, "first_active_default"
    end
    return {"yuseola"}, "fallback_default"
end

function tmBuildNaiGuideText(triggerId)
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal")
    local owners, subjectMode = tmXnaiPrimaryOwnerList(triggerId)
    local multiSubject = #owners > 1
    local lines = {
        "[ACTIVE XNAI VISUAL SOURCES]",
        "- runtime_mode=" .. mode,
        "- subject_mode=" .. subjectMode,
        "- Source rule: CHR owns character identity/default outfit; TRAIT owns class cosplay outfit. Use only the current class for each owner.",
        multiSubject
            and "- Subject rule: explicit multi-subject prompt. Use every listed slot and attach identity/outfit/action state to the correct girl."
            or "- Subject rule: single-subject prompt. Use only girlA's visual identity/outfit tags; omit other heroines' hair, eyes, body, outfit, class, and identity tags unless the user/story explicitly asks for a group image.",
        "- Slot rule: for 2+ character prompts, use these stable slot labels and separate character blocks with `|`.",
        "- Multi prompt pattern: girlA = identity + outfit + pose/action | girlB = identity + outfit + pose/action | interaction = girlA ... girlB ... | scene = location + camera + lighting.",
        "- NSFW slot rule: when the scene/state is adult or erotic, attach clothing rung, arousal tier, contact/restraint/exposure, and expression to the exact slot; compact means dense, not vague.",
    }
    for index, ownerId in ipairs(owners) do
        local chr = tmFetchChrSheet(triggerId, ownerId) or {}
        local classId = tmClassIdForNaiGuide(triggerId, ownerId)
        local trait = tmFetchClassTraitSheet(triggerId, classId) or {}
        local slot = TM_XNAI_SLOT_LABELS[index] or ("girl" .. tostring(index))
        local className = tmNaiCleanText(trait.DISPLAY_NAME or tmClassName(classId))
        local outfitState = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_current_outfit_state", "default")
        local charTags = tmNaiCleanText(chr.NAI_TAGS or chr.IMAGE_GUIDE or chr.APPEARANCE or "")
        local dailyTags = tmNaiCleanText(chr.NAI_DAILY or chr.DEFAULT_OUTFIT or "")
        local charNotes = tmNaiCleanText(chr.NAI_NOTES or chr.COLOR_PALETTE or "")
        local cosplayTags = tmNaiCleanText(trait.NAI_COSPLAY_TAGS or "")
        local cosplayNotes = tmNaiCleanText(trait.NAI_COSPLAY_NOTES or "")
        table.insert(lines, string.format(
            "- %s = %s / %s: class=%s(%s), outfit_state=%s",
            slot,
            ownerId,
            CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId,
            classId,
            className,
            outfitState
        ))
        if charTags ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  CHR_NAI_TAGS: " .. charTags) end
        if dailyTags ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  CHR_NAI_DAILY: " .. dailyTags) end
        if charNotes ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  CHR_NAI_NOTES: " .. charNotes) end
        if cosplayTags ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  TRAIT_NAI_COSPLAY_TAGS: " .. cosplayTags) end
        if cosplayNotes ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  TRAIT_NAI_COSPLAY_NOTES: " .. cosplayNotes) end
        if cosplayTags == "" then table.insert(lines, "  TRAIT_NAI_COSPLAY_TAGS: missing for class=" .. classId) end
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

TM_BASE_RISU_IMAGE_EMOTIONS = "neutral"
TM_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS = "bard_cosplay, bikini, boyfriend_shirt, bunny, dancer_cosplay, default, korean_uniform_summer, mage_cosplay, maid, monk_cosplay, naked, paladin_cosplay, priest_cosplay, ranger_cosplay, rogue_cosplay, summoner_cosplay, underwear, warlock_cosplay, warrior_cosplay"
TM_BUILTIN_RISU_IMAGE_EMOTIONS = TM_BASE_RISU_IMAGE_EMOTIONS
TM_BUILTIN_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS = TM_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS

function tmAddUniqueImageGuideToken(out, seen, value)
    local token = tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if token == "" or seen[token] then return end
    seen[token] = true
    table.insert(out, token)
end

function tmRisuImageGuideOutfits(triggerId)
    local out, seen = {}, {}
    for token in TM_BUILTIN_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS:gmatch("[^,]+") do
        tmAddUniqueImageGuideToken(out, seen, token)
    end
    for _, classId in ipairs(tmClassIds(triggerId, true)) do
        local def = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
        tmAddUniqueImageGuideToken(out, seen, def and def.outfit or "")
    end
    table.sort(out)
    if seen.default then
        local sorted = {"default"}
        for _, token in ipairs(out) do
            if token ~= "default" then table.insert(sorted, token) end
        end
        return sorted
    end
    return out
end

function tmBuiltinRisuOutfitTokenSet()
    local set = {}
    for token in tostring(TM_BUILTIN_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local clean = tmTrimText(token):lower()
        if clean ~= "" then set[clean] = true end
    end
    return set
end

function tmBuiltinRisuOutfitListText()
    local seen, out = {}, {}
    for token in tostring(TM_BUILTIN_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local clean = tmTrimText(token):lower()
        if clean ~= "" and not seen[clean] then
            seen[clean] = true
            table.insert(out, clean)
        end
    end
    table.sort(out)
    if seen.default then
        local sorted = {"default"}
        for _, token in ipairs(out) do
            if token ~= "default" then table.insert(sorted, token) end
        end
        return table.concat(sorted, ", ")
    end
    return table.concat(out, ", ")
end

function tmCustomClassSafeOutfitToken(raw)
    local token = tmTrimText(raw):lower():gsub("[^a-z0-9_]", "")
    if token == "maid_cosplay" then token = "maid" end
    if token == "" then return "warrior_cosplay", false end
    local allowed = tmBuiltinRisuOutfitTokenSet()
    if allowed[token] then return token, true end
    return "warrior_cosplay", false
end

function tmExtractCustomClassTraitSheet(text)
    local raw = tmStripControlMarkers(tostring(text or ""))
    raw = raw:gsub("```[%w_%-]*\n", "")
    raw = raw:gsub("```", "")
    local startAt = raw:find("=== TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT ===", 1, true)
    if startAt then raw = raw:sub(startAt) end
    return tmTrimText(raw)
end

function tmCustomClassSetField(content, key, value)
    local found, lines = false, {}
    local pattern = "^%s*" .. tostring(key or "") .. "%s*:"
    for line in (tostring(content or "") .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\r\n]*)\r?\n") do
        if line:match(pattern) then
            if not found then
                table.insert(lines, tostring(key or "") .. ": " .. tostring(value or ""))
                found = true
            end
        else
            table.insert(lines, line)
        end
    end
    if not found then table.insert(lines, tostring(key or "") .. ": " .. tostring(value or "")) end
    return tmTrimText(table.concat(lines, "\n"))
end

function tmCustomClassPrimaryStat(sheet)
    local order = tmClassStatOrderFromText(sheet and sheet.STAT_ORDER or "", TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.order)
    return order[1] or "dex"
end

function tmSanitizeCustomClassTraitSheet(triggerId, content)
    content = tmTrimText(content)
    if content == "" then return nil, "", "", "" end
    if not content:find("=== TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT ===", 1, true) then
        content = "=== TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT ===\n" .. content
    end
    local sheet = parseSheet(content)
    local classId = tmNormalizeClassId(sheet.CLASS or "")
    if classId == "" then return nil, "", "", T(triggerId, "CLASS는 소문자 ASCII id여야 합니다.", "CLASS must be a lowercase ASCII id.", "CLASS は小文字 ASCII id である必要があります。") end
    local outfit, outfitOk = tmCustomClassSafeOutfitToken(sheet.GENASSETS_OUTFIT or "")
    local warning = ""
    if not outfitOk then
        warning = T(triggerId, "등록되지 않은 GENASSETS_OUTFIT을 warrior_cosplay로 보정했습니다.", "Unregistered GENASSETS_OUTFIT was normalized to warrior_cosplay.", "未登録の GENASSETS_OUTFIT を warrior_cosplay に補正しました。")
    end
    content = tmCustomClassSetField(content, "CLASS", classId)
    content = tmCustomClassSetField(content, "GENASSETS_OUTFIT", outfit)
    content = tmCustomClassSetField(content, "MANUAL_ONLY", "true")
    content = tmCustomClassSetField(content, "RANDOM_EXCLUDE", "true")
    sheet = parseSheet(content)
    local primary = tmCustomClassPrimaryStat(sheet)
    if tmTrimText(sheet.DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT or "") == "" then
        content = tmCustomClassSetField(content, "DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT", "eq_l1_" .. primary .. "_support")
    end
    if tmTrimText(sheet.DEFAULT_SKILL or "") == "" then
        content = tmCustomClassSetField(content, "DEFAULT_SKILL", "sk_l1_" .. primary .. "_support")
    end
    return content, classId, outfit, warning
end

function tmCustomClassTraitSheetValid(content)
    local text = tostring(content or "")
    if text == "" or not text:find("=== TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT ===", 1, true) then return false end
    local sheet = parseSheet(text)
    if tmNormalizeClassId(sheet.CLASS or "") == "" then return false end
    if tmTrimText(sheet.DISPLAY_NAME or "") == "" then return false end
    if tmTrimText(sheet.ROLE or "") == "" then return false end
    if tmTrimText(sheet.MAIN_STATS or "") == "" then return false end
    if tmTrimText(sheet.CONCEPT_KO or sheet.CONCEPT_EN or sheet.CONCEPT_JA or "") == "" then return false end
    local outfit, outfitOk = tmCustomClassSafeOutfitToken(sheet.GENASSETS_OUTFIT or "")
    return outfit ~= "" and outfitOk
end

        "MAIN_STATS should be compact, such as DEX/WIS or INT/CHA.",
        "HP_BASE should be 18-30. MP_BASE should be 1-14.",
        "GENASSETS_OUTFIT MUST be exactly one registered asset token from this list: " .. outfitTokens .. ". Unregistered outfit tokens are invalid. If unsure, use warrior_cosplay.",
        "Use MANUAL_ONLY: true and RANDOM_EXCLUDE: true so the class is selected manually after the user saves the lorebook entry.",

        "",
        "Required format:",
        "=== TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT ===",
        "CLASS: lowercase_ascii_id",
        "DISPLAY_NAME: visible class name in " .. languageName,
        "DISPLAY_NAME_EN: English class name",
        "DISPLAY_NAME_JA: Japanese class name",
        "ROLE: short role tags",
        "GENASSETS_OUTFIT: one token from the registered list",
        "NAI_COSPLAY_TAGS: concise outfit visual tags matching the selected outfit token",
        "NAI_COSPLAY_NOTES: short cosplay prop/material notes",
        "STAT_ORDER: dex, wis, con, int, cha, str",
        "MAIN_STATS: DEX/WIS",
        "HP_BASE: 22",
        "MP_BASE: 4",
        "CONCEPT_KO: Korean class concept sentence",
        "CONCEPT_EN: English class concept sentence",
        "CONCEPT_JA: Japanese class concept sentence",
        "CONCEPT_TOKENS: comma-separated concept keywords",
        "WEAKNESS: short weakness or complication",
        "DEFAULT_EQUIPMENT: eq_l1_dex_support",

function tmBuildCustomClassResultMessage(triggerId, content, classId, outfit, warning)
    local sheet = parseSheet(content)
    local keys = {}
    local seen = {}
    local function addKey(value)
        local key = tmTrimText(value)
        if key ~= "" and not seen[key] then
            seen[key] = true
            keys[#keys + 1] = key
        end
    end
    local asciiId = tostring(classId or "")
    local titleId = asciiId
    if titleId ~= "" then titleId = titleId:sub(1, 1):upper() .. titleId:sub(2) end
    addKey(sheet.DISPLAY_NAME or "")
    addKey(asciiId)
    addKey(titleId)
    local keyText = table.concat(keys, ", ")
    return T(triggerId, "이름", "Name", "名前") .. ": TRAIT"
        .. "\n" .. T(triggerId, "활성화 키", "Activation Keys", "有効化キー") .. ": " .. keyText
        .. "\nInsertion Order: 80"
        .. "\n\n" .. T(triggerId,
            "=== TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT === 줄은 제외하고, 아래 CLASS:부터 로어북 content에 복사하세요.",
            "Leave out the === TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT === marker line and copy from CLASS: downward into the lorebook content field.",
            "=== TRPGMASTER_CLASS_TRAIT === の行は除き、下の CLASS: からロアブック content にコピーしてください。")
        .. "\n\n" .. tostring(content or "")
end

function tmGenerateCustomClassTraitFromSeed(triggerId, seed)
    seed = tmTrimText(seed)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_seed", seed)
    if seed == "" then
        return false, T(triggerId, "직업 컨셉을 한두 줄로 입력해 주세요.", "Enter the class concept in one or two lines.", "クラスコンセプトを一、二行で入力してください。")
    end
    local fn = tmSelectPanelLLM(triggerId)
    if not fn then
        return false, T(triggerId, "RisuAI LLM API를 사용할 수 없습니다.", "RisuAI LLM API is unavailable.", "RisuAI LLM APIを使用できません。")
    end
    local messages = {
        {role = "system", content = "Generate one valid TRPGMaster TRAIT class sheet only."},
        {role = "user", content = tmBuildCustomClassTraitPrompt(triggerId, seed)}
    }
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId, messages)
    if not ok then return false, tostring(result) end
    local text, err = tmReadLLMText(result)
    if err then return false, err end
    local raw = tmExtractCustomClassTraitSheet(text or "")
    local content, classId, outfit, warning = tmSanitizeCustomClassTraitSheet(triggerId, raw)
    if not content or not tmCustomClassTraitSheetValid(content) then
        return false, T(triggerId, "LLM 응답에서 유효한 TRAIT 직업 시트를 읽지 못했습니다.", "Could not read a valid TRAIT class sheet from the LLM response.", "LLM応答から有効な TRAIT クラスシートを読めませんでした。")
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_input_error", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_last_id", classId)
    return true, tmBuildCustomClassResultMessage(triggerId, content, classId, outfit, warning)
end

function tmBuildRisuImageGuideText(triggerId)
    local outfitNames = tmRisuImageGuideOutfits(triggerId)
    local lines = {
        "[Risu image tag guide - base asset contract and runtime CHR/TRAIT sources]",
        "Base syntax: <img=\"name_neutral_outfit\">. Do not include .webp in the tag.",
        "Base guaranteed emotion: neutral only.",
        "Base guaranteed neutral outfits plus TRAIT GENASSETS_OUTFIT values: " .. table.concat(outfitNames, ", "),
        "Default outfit tags use plain default, e.g. <img=\"owner_neutral_default\">.",
        "Class portrait tags use TRAIT GENASSETS_OUTFIT exactly, e.g. <img=\"owner_neutral_warrior_cosplay\">. Maid uses <img=\"owner_neutral_maid\">.",
        "Non-neutral emotions and NSFW pose tags are Extra-module assets. When TRPGMaster Extra is active, image tags MUST use only exact name, emotion, pose, and outfit tokens listed in TRPGMASTER_EXTRA_IMAGE_GUIDE.",
        "Use the runtime character rows below as the authoritative character/image source.",
    }
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local chr = tmFetchChrSheet(triggerId, ownerId) or {}
        local classId = tmClassIdForNaiGuide(triggerId, ownerId)
        local trait = tmFetchClassTraitSheet(triggerId, classId) or {}
        local display = tmNaiCleanText(chr.NAME_KO or CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId)
        local defaultVisual = tmNaiCleanText(chr.NAI_DAILY or chr.DEFAULT_OUTFIT or "")
        local classVisual = tmNaiCleanText(trait.NAI_COSPLAY_TAGS or trait.GENASSETS_OUTFIT or "")
        table.insert(lines, string.format(
            "- %s (%s): current_class=%s, current_outfit_state=%s",
            ownerId,
            display,
            classId,
            getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_current_outfit_state", "default")
        ))
        if defaultVisual ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  default_visual: " .. defaultVisual) end
        if classVisual ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  class_cosplay_visual: " .. classVisual) end
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmRefreshNaiGuideText(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "nai_guide_text", tmBuildNaiGuideText(triggerId))
    setVar(triggerId, "image_guide_text", tmBuildRisuImageGuideText(triggerId))
end

function tmApplyFirstSessionCosplayState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "cosplay_event_done", "true")
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_class", TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id)
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_cosplay_unlocked", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_current_outfit_state", tmClassOutfitToken(triggerId, classId))
    end
    pcall(tmRefreshNaiGuideText, triggerId)
end

function tmPrimaryStat(classId)
    return TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.order[1] or "dex"
end

function tmPrimaryStatFor(triggerId, classId)
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    return (cls.order and cls.order[1]) or "dex"
end

function tmClassDefaultLoadout(classId)
    local stat = tmPrimaryStat(classId)
    return "eq_l1_" .. stat .. "_support", "sk_l1_" .. stat .. "_support"
end

function tmClassDefaultLoadoutFor(triggerId, classId)
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local traitDefaults = cls.default_loadout or {}
    if traitDefaults.equipment and traitDefaults.equipment ~= ""
        and traitDefaults.skill and traitDefaults.skill ~= "" then
        return traitDefaults.equipment, traitDefaults.skill
    end
    local stat = tmPrimaryStatFor(triggerId, cls.id or classId)
    return "eq_l1_" .. stat .. "_support", "sk_l1_" .. stat .. "_support"
end

function tmClassDefaultLoadoutField(classId, field)
    return ""
end

function tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, field)
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local traitDefaults = cls.default_loadout or {}
    local value = traitDefaults[field]
    if value and value ~= "" then return value end
    return ""
end

function tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRef(classId, kind, ref, field)
    local equipmentId, skillId = tmClassDefaultLoadout(classId)
    local id = tostring(ref or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if kind == "skill" and id == skillId then return tmClassDefaultLoadoutField(classId, field) end
    if kind ~= "skill" and id == equipmentId then return tmClassDefaultLoadoutField(classId, field) end
    return ""
end

function tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, classId, kind, ref, field)
    local equipmentId, skillId = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFor(triggerId, classId)
    local id = tostring(ref or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if kind == "skill" and id == skillId then return tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, field) end
    if kind ~= "skill" and id == equipmentId then return tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, field) end
    return ""
end

function tmKnownDefaultLoadoutTextForRef(kind, ref, field)
    return ""
end

function tmKnownDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, kind, ref, field)
    local id = tostring(ref or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if id == "" then return "" end
    for _, classId in ipairs(tmClassIds(triggerId, true)) do
        local equipmentId, skillId = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFor(triggerId, classId)
        if kind == "skill" and id == skillId then return tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, field) end
        if kind ~= "skill" and id == equipmentId then return tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, field) end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmLoadoutFallbackTextForRef(classId, kind, ref, field)
    return tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRef(classId, kind, ref, field)
end

function tmLoadoutFallbackTextForRefFor(triggerId, classId, kind, ref, field)
    local scoped = tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, classId, kind, ref, field)
    if scoped ~= "" then return scoped end
    return tmKnownDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, kind, ref, field)
end

function tmMaxHp(classId, con)
    local bonus = math.max(0, getAbilityMod(con or 10))
    return (tonumber(TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.hp) or 22) + bonus
end

function tmMaxHpFor(triggerId, classId, con)
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local bonus = math.max(0, getAbilityMod(con or 10))
    return (tonumber(cls.hp) or 22) + bonus
end

function tmMaxMp(classId, wis, intv)
    local base = tonumber(TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.mp) or 4
    if base < 1 then base = 1 end
    local bonus = math.max(0, getAbilityMod(math.max(wis or 10, intv or 10)))
    return base + bonus
end

function tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, wis, intv)
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local base = tonumber(cls.mp) or 0
    if base < 1 then base = 1 end
    local bonus = math.max(0, getAbilityMod(math.max(wis or 10, intv or 10)))
    return base + bonus
end

function tmRollAbility()
    local dice = {math.random(6), math.random(6), math.random(6), math.random(6)}
    table.sort(dice, function(a, b) return a > b end)
    return dice[1] + dice[2] + dice[3]
end

function tmNormalizeAlignmentId(alignmentId)
    local key = tostring(alignmentId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):lower()
    key = key:gsub("-", "_")
    key = key:gsub("%s+", "_")
    if TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA[key] then return key end
    local alias = TM_ALIGNMENT_ALIASES[key] or TM_ALIGNMENT_ALIASES[tostring(alignmentId or "")]
    if alias and TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA[alias] then return alias end
    return ""
end

function tmAlignmentFallback(ownerId, classId)
    local byOwner = TM_ALIGNMENT_FALLBACKS[ownerId] or {}
    return byOwner[classId] or byOwner.default or "true_neutral"
end

function tmEnsureAlignment(triggerId, ownerId)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local alignmentVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_alignment"
    local alignmentNameVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_alignment_name"
    local alignment = tmNormalizeAlignmentId(getVar(triggerId, alignmentVar, ""))
    if alignment == "" then alignment = tmAlignmentFallback(ownerId, classId) end
    if getVar(triggerId, alignmentVar, "") ~= alignment then
        setVar(triggerId, alignmentVar, alignment)
    end
    local alignmentName = TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA[alignment].name
    if getVar(triggerId, alignmentNameVar, "") ~= alignmentName then
        setVar(triggerId, alignmentNameVar, alignmentName)
    end
    return alignment
end

function tmAlignmentName(alignmentId)
    local key = tmNormalizeAlignmentId(alignmentId)
    return (TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA[key] and TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA[key].name) or TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA.true_neutral.name
end

function tmAlignmentCue(alignmentId)
    local key = tmNormalizeAlignmentId(alignmentId)
    return (TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA[key] and TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA[key].cue) or TM_ALIGNMENT_DATA.true_neutral.cue
end

function tmSheetFlavorNote(classId)
    return tmClassName(classId) .. " 역할. " .. (TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.role or "") .. "을 맡는다."
end

function tmSheetFlavorNoteFor(triggerId, classId)
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    return (cls.name or tostring(classId or "")) .. " 역할. " .. (cls.role or "") .. "을 맡는다."
end

function tmClassConceptFallback(triggerId, classId)
    local id = tmClassExists(triggerId, classId) and classId or "rogue"
    local def = tmClassDef(triggerId, id)
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" and def.concept_en and def.concept_en ~= "" then return def.concept_en end
    if lang == "ja" and def.concept_ja and def.concept_ja ~= "" then return def.concept_ja end
    if def.concept_ko and def.concept_ko ~= "" then return def.concept_ko end
    local entry = TM_CLASS_CONCEPT_I18N[id] or TM_CLASS_CONCEPT_I18N.rogue
    return entry[lang] or entry.ko or tmClassName(id)
end

function tmIsClassConceptFallbackText(text)
    local value = tmTrimVisibleText(text)
    if value == "" then return false end
    for _, id in ipairs(TM_CLASS_ORDER) do
        local entry = TM_CLASS_CONCEPT_I18N[id]
        if entry then
            if value == entry.ko or value == entry.en or value == entry.ja then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmConceptRoleCompareText(text)
    local value = tmTrimVisibleText(text):lower()
    value = value:gsub("역할", "")
    value = value:gsub("[,%s%.%-%|/·ㆍ・﹞◆]+", "")
    return value
end

function tmConceptLooksLikeClassRole(triggerId, classId, text)
    local id = tmClassExists(triggerId, classId) and classId or TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, id)
    local role = cls and cls.role or ""
    local valueKey = tmConceptRoleCompareText(text)
    local roleKey = tmConceptRoleCompareText(role)
    return valueKey ~= "" and roleKey ~= "" and valueKey == roleKey
end

function tmConceptConflictsWithClass(classId, text)
    local id = tmNormalizeClassId(classId)
    if id == "" then id = TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id end
    local value = tmTrimVisibleText(text):lower()
    if value == "" then return true end
    for otherId, tokens in pairs(TM_CLASS_CONCEPT_STRONG_TOKENS) do
        if otherId ~= id then
            for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do
                local needle = tostring(token or ""):lower()
                if needle ~= "" and value:find(needle, 1, true) then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmNormalizeConceptTitle(triggerId, ownerId, classId, title)
    local id = tmClassExists(triggerId, classId) and classId or TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id
    local value = tmTrimVisibleText(title)
    if tmConceptLooksLikeClassRole(triggerId, id, value) then
        return tmClassConceptFallback(triggerId, id), "class_fallback"
    end
    if tmIsClassConceptFallbackText(value) then
        return tmClassConceptFallback(triggerId, id), "class_fallback"
    end
    if not tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, value) then
        return tmClassConceptFallback(triggerId, id), "class_fallback"
    end
    if tmConceptConflictsWithClass(id, value) then
        return tmClassConceptFallback(triggerId, id), "class_fallback"
    end
    return value, "llm"
end

function tmOwnerConceptTitle(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
    local title = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_title", "")
    if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_source", "") == "class_fallback" then
        return tmClassConceptFallback(triggerId, classId)
    end
    local normalized = tmNormalizeConceptTitle(triggerId, ownerId, classId, title)
    return normalized
end

function tmSetSheetConcept(triggerId, ownerId, classId, title, note)
    local cls = tmClassExists(triggerId, classId) and classId or "rogue"
    local normalizedTitle, source = tmNormalizeConceptTitle(triggerId, ownerId, cls, title or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", cls)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class_name", tmClassNameRuntime(triggerId, cls))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_title", normalizedTitle)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_source", source or "llm")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_note", note or tmSheetFlavorNoteFor(triggerId, cls))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", "1"))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", "0"))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap_spent", getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap_spent", "0"))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_status", getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_status", "active"))
    pcall(tmRefreshNaiGuideText, triggerId)
end

function tmEnsureSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    local concept = TM_STARTER_CONCEPTS[ownerId] or TM_STARTER_CONCEPTS.yuseola
    if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "") == "" then
        tmSetSheetConcept(triggerId, ownerId, concept.class, concept.title, concept.note)
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_name_ko", "") == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_name_ko", CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId)
    end
    tmEnsureAlignment(triggerId, ownerId)
    local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, ownerId)
    if pcName ~= "" and tmLooksLikeModernPcName(ownerId, pcName) then
        local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_pc_name", tmNormalizeGeneratedPcName(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId))
    end
    tmEnsureSheetMpPool(triggerId, ownerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false") == "true"
        or getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false") == "true" then
        tmEnsureOwnerItems(triggerId, ownerId)
    end
end

function tmEnsureSheetMpPool(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return end
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local wis = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "wis", 10)
    local intv = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "int", 10)
    local mpMax = tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, wis, intv)
    local oldMpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", mpMax)
    if oldMpMax >= 1 and oldMpMax >= mpMax then return end
    local curMp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", oldMpMax)
    local gain = math.max(0, mpMax - math.max(0, oldMpMax))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", mpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", clamp(curMp + gain, 0, mpMax))
end

function tmEnsurePartySheets(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do tmEnsureSheet(triggerId, id) end
end

function tmHasCharacterSheets(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false") == "true" then return true end
    if getVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false") ~= "true" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

function tmAllSheetsGenerated(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false") ~= "true" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

function tmCanRerollClasses(triggerId)
    return tmCanEditSheets(triggerId)
end

function tmCanEditSheets(triggerId)
    return getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true"
end

function tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_mode", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_owner", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "class_reroll_confirm", "false")
end

function tmSheetEditOwner(triggerId)
    local ownerId = getVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_owner", "")
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
        ownerId = getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", "")
    end
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
        ownerId = tmGetActiveOwner(triggerId)
    end
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then ownerId = "yuseola" end
    setVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_owner", ownerId)
    return ownerId
end

TM_SHEET_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS = {
    "pc_name", "class", "class_name", "concept_title", "concept_note", "concept_source",
    "alignment", "alignment_name", "class_choice_reason",
    "equipment", "skills", "equipment_name", "skill_name", "equipment_desc", "skill_desc",
    "skill_loadout",
    "stats", "str", "dex", "con", "int", "wis", "cha", "sheet_rolled",
    "sheet_llm_created", "hp_max", "hp", "mp_max", "mp",
    "level", "ap", "ap_spent", "status", "conditions", "items", "items_initialized"
}

function tmSnapshotSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    local snap = {}
    for _, field in ipairs(TM_SHEET_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS) do
        snap[field] = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. field, "")
    end
    return snap
end

function tmRestoreSheet(triggerId, ownerId, snap)
    if type(snap) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, field in ipairs(TM_SHEET_SNAPSHOT_FIELDS) do
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. field, snap[field] or "")
    end
end

function tmSnapshotSheets(triggerId)
    local snaps = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        snaps[id] = tmSnapshotSheet(triggerId, id)
    end
    return snaps
end

function tmRestoreSheets(triggerId, snaps)
    if type(snaps) ~= "table" then return end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        tmRestoreSheet(triggerId, id, snaps[id])
    end
end

function tmApplyClassDefaultLoadout(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return end
    local equipmentId, skillId = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFor(triggerId, classId)
    local equipmentName = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, "equipment_name")
    local skillName = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, "skill_name")
    local equipmentDesc = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, "equipment_desc")
    local skillDesc = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFieldFor(triggerId, classId, "skill_desc")
    if equipmentName == "" then equipmentName = tmFormulaLabel(triggerId, equipmentId, "equipment") or "" end
    if skillName == "" then skillName = tmFormulaLabel(triggerId, skillId, "skill") or "" end
    if equipmentDesc == "" then equipmentDesc = tmFormulaDescription(triggerId, equipmentId, "equipment") end
    if skillDesc == "" then skillDesc = tmFormulaDescription(triggerId, skillId, "skill") end
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", equipmentId)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", skillId)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_loadout", skillId)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment_name", equipmentName)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_name", skillName)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment_desc", equipmentDesc)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_desc", skillDesc)
end

function tmApplyClassOnlyChange(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    if not tmClassExists(triggerId, classId) then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", classId)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_current_outfit_state", tmClassOutfitToken(triggerId, classId))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class_name", tmClassNameRuntime(triggerId, classId))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_title", tmClassConceptFallback(triggerId, classId))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_source", "class_fallback")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_concept_note", tmSheetFlavorNoteFor(triggerId, classId))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class_choice_reason", "user_selected_class")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_llm_created", "true")
    tmApplyClassDefaultLoadout(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_items", "none")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_items_initialized", "false")
    tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStatsPreserveCurrent(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmEnsureOwnerItems(triggerId, ownerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "stats_locked", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:class_changed:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. classId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_post_action_locked_display", "true")
    pcall(tmRefreshNaiGuideText, triggerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetStatSummary(triggerId, ownerId)
    return "STR " .. tostring(tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "str", 10))
        .. " / DEX " .. tostring(tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "dex", 10))
        .. " / CON " .. tostring(tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "con", 10))
        .. " / INT " .. tostring(tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "int", 10))
        .. " / WIS " .. tostring(tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "wis", 10))
        .. " / CHA " .. tostring(tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "cha", 10))
end

function tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStats(triggerId, ownerId)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local con = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "con", 10)
    local wis = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "wis", 10)
    local intv = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "int", 10)
    local hpMax = tmMaxHpFor(triggerId, classId, con)
    local mpMax = tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, wis, intv)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp_max", hpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp", hpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", mpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", mpMax)
end

function tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStatsPreserveCurrent(triggerId, ownerId)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local con = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "con", 10)
    local wis = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "wis", 10)
    local intv = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, "int", 10)
    local oldHpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp_max", tmMaxHpFor(triggerId, classId, con))
    local oldMpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, wis, intv))
    local curHp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp", oldHpMax)
    local curMp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", oldMpMax)
    local hpMax = tmMaxHpFor(triggerId, classId, con)
    local mpMax = tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, wis, intv)
    local hpDelta = math.max(0, hpMax - oldHpMax)
    local mpDelta = math.max(0, mpMax - oldMpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp_max", hpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", mpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp", clamp(curHp + hpDelta, 0, hpMax))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", clamp(curMp + mpDelta, 0, mpMax))
end

function tmFantasyPcNameFallback(ownerId, classId)
    local stem = TM_PC_NAME_FALLBACK_OWNER_STEMS[ownerId] or "별빛"
    local cls = tmNormalizeClassId(classId)
    local title = TM_PC_NAME_FALLBACK_CLASS_TITLES[cls] or "모험가"
    return stem .. title
end

function tmLooksLikeModernPcName(ownerId, pcName)
    local name = tostring(pcName or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if name == "" or name == "미정" or name == "pending" then return true end
    if TM_MODERN_PC_NAME_BLOCKLIST[name] or TM_MODERN_PC_NAME_BLOCKLIST[name:lower()] then return true end
    if name == (CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or "") then return true end
    if not name:match("[A-Za-z]") and not name:match("[-'·]") and #name <= 6 then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function tmNormalizeGeneratedPcName(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId)
    local name = tostring(pcName or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if tmLooksLikeModernPcName(ownerId, name) then
        local fallback = tmFantasyPcNameFallback(ownerId, classId)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_pc_name_normalized", ownerId .. ":" .. name .. "->" .. fallback)
        return fallback
    end
    return name
end

function tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return "" end
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local name = tmTrimVisibleText(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_pc_name", ""))
    if name == "" or name == "미정" or name == "pending" then return "" end
    local visible = name
    if tmLooksLikeModernPcName(ownerId, visible) then
        visible = tmNormalizeGeneratedPcName(triggerId, ownerId, visible, classId)
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" and not tmTextHasHangul(visible) then
        visible = tmFantasyPcNameFallback(ownerId, classId)
    end
    if visible ~= name then
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_pc_name", visible)
    end
    return visible
end

function tmSanitizeLoadoutDisplayName(value)
    local text = tostring(value or "")
    text = tmStripControlMarkers(text)
    text = text:gsub("▥.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("{{.-}}", "")
    text = text:gsub("[|%^<>]", " ")
    text = text:gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("%s+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if text == "" or text == "none" or text == "미정" then return "" end
    if #text > 72 then return "" end
    return text
end

function tmSanitizeLoadoutDescription(value)
    local text = tostring(value or "")
    text = tmStripControlMarkers(text)
    text = text:gsub("▥.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("{{.-}}", "")
    text = text:gsub("[|%^<>]", " ")
    text = text:gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("%s+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if text == "" or text == "none" or text == "미정" then return "" end
    if #text > 180 then text = text:sub(1, 180) end
    return text
end

function tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId, equipmentName, skillName, equipmentDesc, skillDesc)
    ownerId = tostring(ownerId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    pcName = tostring(pcName or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    classId = tostring(classId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    concept = tostring(concept or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    equipmentId = tostring(equipmentId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    skillId = tostring(skillId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    alignmentId = tostring(alignmentId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    equipmentName = tmSanitizeLoadoutDisplayName(equipmentName)
    skillName = tmSanitizeLoadoutDisplayName(skillName)
    equipmentDesc = tmSanitizeLoadoutDescription(equipmentDesc)
    skillDesc = tmSanitizeLoadoutDescription(skillDesc)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    local classDef = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local cls = (classDef and classDef.id and not classDef.manual_only) and classDef.id or TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id
    local defaultEquipmentId, defaultSkillId = tmClassDefaultLoadoutFor(triggerId, cls)
    if equipmentId == "" or equipmentId == "none" then equipmentId = defaultEquipmentId end
    if skillId == "" or skillId == "none" then skillId = defaultSkillId end
    if not tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, equipmentName, "equipment") then
        local fallback = tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, cls, "equipment", equipmentId, "equipment_name")
        if fallback ~= "" then equipmentName = fallback end
    end
    if not tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, skillName, "skill") then
        local fallback = tmLoadoutFallbackTextForRefFor(triggerId, cls, "skill", skillId, "skill_name")
        skillName = fallback ~= "" and fallback or ""
    end
    if not tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, equipmentDesc, "equipment") then
        local fallback = tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, cls, "equipment", equipmentId, "equipment_desc")
        if fallback ~= "" then equipmentDesc = fallback end
    end
    if not tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, skillDesc, "skill") then
        local fallback = tmLoadoutFallbackTextForRefFor(triggerId, cls, "skill", skillId, "skill_desc")
        if fallback ~= "" then skillDesc = fallback end
    end
    local alignment = tmNormalizeAlignmentId(alignmentId)
    if alignment == "" then alignment = tmAlignmentFallback(ownerId, cls) end
    pcName = tmNormalizeGeneratedPcName(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, cls)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_pc_name", pcName or "")
    tmSetSheetConcept(triggerId, ownerId, cls, concept or tmClassNameRuntime(triggerId, cls), tmSheetFlavorNoteFor(triggerId, cls))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_alignment", alignment)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_alignment_name", tmAlignmentName(alignment))
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class_choice_reason", "llm_generated_from_stats_and_personality")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", equipmentId or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", skillId or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment_name", equipmentName or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_name", skillName or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment_desc", equipmentDesc or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_desc", skillDesc or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_llm_created", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_items", "none")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_items_initialized", "false")
    tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStats(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmEnsureOwnerItems(triggerId, ownerId)
    if tmAllSheetsGenerated(triggerId) then
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "stats_locked", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "ready_to_start")
        setVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "sheets_confirmed")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:llm_generated")
    end
    return true
end

function tmBuildCharacterGenerationUserPrompt(triggerId)
    local languageName = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local validClasses = tmClassValidListText(triggerId, false)
    local classRoles = tmClassRoleListText(triggerId, false)
    local lines = {
        "[TRPGMaster character sheet generation request]",
        "The ability scores below were rolled by the system for this sheet generation. Create generic level-1 fantasy PCs that fit the four real players' personalities and stats.",
        "Playable race is fixed as human for everyone. Choose exactly one class from this registry: " .. validClasses .. ".",
        "Do not change ability scores. Create only class, PC name, one-line concept, level-1 equipment ID/display name/description, level-1 skill ID/display name/description, and alignment ID.",
        "Visible sheet fields use " .. languageName .. ": pc_name, concept, equipment_name, equipment_desc, skill_name, skill_desc.",
        "Internal IDs stay ASCII exactly as specified: owner, class_id, equipment_id, skill_id, alignment_id.",
        tmPcNameLanguageLine(triggerId),
        "PC names must not be the real players' names, nicknames, abbreviations, romanizations, direct Hangul readings, or modern Korean given-name variants.",
        "PC names should be original fantasy TRPG role names, usually 2-5 syllables, with genre flavor matching class and personality. Do not copy names from this prompt.",
        "alignment_id must be one of lawful_good, neutral_good, chaotic_good, lawful_neutral, true_neutral, chaotic_neutral, lawful_evil, neutral_evil, chaotic_evil.",
        "Choose alignment so the real player's personality and class concept can work together. Use evil alignments only when they create playable table comedy rather than sabotage.",
        "PC sheets are not current-scenario-only sheets. Do not put a specific location, quest object, book title, clue, monster, or episode goal into class, concept, equipment, or skill.",
        "Match concept to class_id using this compact registry: " .. classRoles .. ".",
        "Use short formula IDs for equipment and skills, such as eq_l1_str_guard or sk_l1_dex_trick.",
        "equipment_name and skill_name are display-only fantasy names. Mechanics come from IDs, not from names.",
        "equipment_desc and skill_desc are short user-facing tooltip prose. Do not include internal IDs, stat tokens, role tokens, raw numbers, or refs in descriptions.",
        "Keep equipment and skill names short and generic for level-1 fantasy play; do not bake in an episode-specific objective or monster name.",
        "Output a short visible sentence for each PC first, then attach the exact marker at the end of each line.",
        "Marker format: ▥PC_SHEET:owner|pc_name|class_id|concept|equipment_id|equipment_name|equipment_desc|skill_id|skill_name|skill_desc|alignment_id▥",
        "owner is one of sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola.",
        ""
    }
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        table.insert(lines, "- " .. (CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or id) .. " (" .. id .. "): " .. tmSheetStatSummary(triggerId, id))
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
