function tmHelperLLMSource(triggerId)
    local source = tostring(getVar(triggerId, "helper_llm_source", "aux") or "")
    if source == "main" or source == "aux" then return source end
    return "aux"
end

function tmSelectHelperLLM(triggerId)
    local source = tmHelperLLMSource(triggerId)
    if source == "main" and type(LLM) == "function" then return LLM, "main" end
    if source == "aux" and type(axLLM) == "function" then return axLLM, "aux" end
    if type(axLLM) == "function" then return axLLM, "aux_fallback" end
    if type(LLM) == "function" then return LLM, "main_fallback" end
    return nil, "none"
end

function tmSheetGenerationLLMFn(triggerId)
    local fn = tmSelectHelperLLM(triggerId)
    return fn
end

function tmUtf8SafeTailStart(text, requestedStart)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    local start = math.floor(tonumber(requestedStart) or 1)
    if start < 1 then start = 1 end
    if start > #s then return #s + 1 end
    while start > 1 do
        local b = s:byte(start)
        if not b or b < 0x80 or b >= 0xC0 then break end
        start = start - 1
    end
    return start
end

function tmTailText(text, maxLen)
    local s = tmCleanUtf8Text(text)
    local limit = math.floor(tonumber(maxLen) or 800)
    if limit <= 0 then return "" end
    if #s <= limit then return s end
    local start = tmUtf8SafeTailStart(s, #s - limit + 1)
    return "..." .. s:sub(start)
end

function tmRecentChatContextText(text)
    return tmCleanUtf8Text(text)
end

function tmContextTextFromHtml(fragment)
    local s = tostring(fragment or "")
    s = s:gsub("<[^>]->", " ")
    s = s:gsub("&quot;", '"')
    s = s:gsub("&#39;", "'")
    s = s:gsub("&lt;", "<")
    s = s:gsub("&gt;", ">")
    s = s:gsub("&amp;", "&")
    s = s:gsub("[+-]?%d+", "")
    s = s:gsub("%s+", " ")
    s = s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return s
end

function tmRollCardContextSummary(block)
    local raw = tostring(block or "")
    local actor = tmContextTextFromHtml(raw:match('<span class="tm%-roll%-actor">(.-)</span>') or "")
    local stat = tmContextTextFromHtml(raw:match('<span class="tm%-roll%-check">(.-)</span>') or "")
    local tier = tmContextTextFromHtml(raw:match('<span class="tm%-roll%-tier">(.-)</span>') or raw:match('data%-tier="([^"]*)"') or "")
    local reason = tmContextTextFromHtml(raw:match('<div class="tm%-roll%-action">.-<span>(.-)</span></div>') or "")
    if stat ~= "" and not stat:find("판정", 1, true) then stat = stat .. " 판정" end
    if reason ~= "" and type(tmTruncateUtf8) == "function" then reason = tmTruncateUtf8(reason, 56) end

    local parts = {}
    if actor ~= "" then table.insert(parts, actor) end
    if stat ~= "" then table.insert(parts, stat) end
    if tier ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "- " .. tier) end
    if reason ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "/ " .. reason) end
    if #parts == 0 then return "[주사위 판정]" end
    return "[주사위: " .. table.concat(parts, " ") .. "]"
end

function tmFindRollCardEnd(html, startPos)
    local s = tostring(html or "")
    local depth = 0
    local pos = tonumber(startPos) or 1
    while true do
        local nextOpen = s:find("<div", pos, true)
        local nextClose = s:find("</div>", pos, true)
        if not nextClose then return nil end
        if nextOpen and nextOpen < nextClose then
            depth = depth + 1
            pos = nextOpen + 4
        else
            depth = depth - 1
            pos = nextClose + 6
            if depth <= 0 then return pos - 1 end
        end
    end
end

function tmSummarizeRollCardsForContext(text)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    local marker = '<div class="tm-roll-result'
    if not s:find(marker, 1, true) then return s end
    local out = {}
    local pos = 1
    while true do
        local startPos = s:find(marker, pos, true)
        if not startPos then
            table.insert(out, s:sub(pos))
            break
        end
        table.insert(out, s:sub(pos, startPos - 1))
        local endPos = tmFindRollCardEnd(s, startPos)
        if not endPos then
            table.insert(out, tmRollCardContextSummary(s:sub(startPos)))
            break
        end
        table.insert(out, tmRollCardContextSummary(s:sub(startPos, endPos)))
        pos = endPos + 1
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

function tmSanitizeChatSnippet(text)
    local clean = tostring(text or "")
    clean = tmStripControlMarkers(clean)
    clean = tmSummarizeRollCardsForContext(clean)
    clean = clean:gsub("<[^>]->", " ")
    clean = clean:gsub("{{[^}]-}}", " ")
    clean = clean:gsub("%s+", " ")
    clean = clean:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return clean
end

function tmRecentChatRecordLine(role, text)
    local clean = tmSanitizeChatSnippet(text)
    if clean == "" then return "" end
    local roleLabel = tostring(role or "")
    if roleLabel ~= "user" then roleLabel = "char" end
    return roleLabel .. ": " .. tmRecentChatContextText(clean)
end

function tmCaptureRecentSessionDialogue(triggerId, currentOutput, maxMessages)
    local limit = tonumber(maxMessages) or 3
    if limit < 1 then limit = 1 end
    local currentLine = tmRecentChatRecordLine("char", currentOutput or "")
    local historyLimit = currentLine ~= "" and math.max(0, limit - 1) or limit
    local records = {}
    if historyLimit > 0 and type(getFullChat) == "function" then
        local ok, chatHistory = pcall(getFullChat, triggerId)
        if ok and type(chatHistory) == "table" then
            local added = 0
            for i = #chatHistory, 1, -1 do
                local msg = chatHistory[i] or {}
                local role = tostring(msg.role or "")
                if role == "char" or role == "user" then
                    local line = tmRecentChatRecordLine(role, msg.data or msg.content or "")
                    if line ~= "" then
                        table.insert(records, 1, line)
                        added = added + 1
                    end
                end
                if added >= historyLimit then break end
            end
        end
    end
    if currentLine ~= "" then table.insert(records, currentLine) end
    return table.concat(records, "\n")
end

function tmRefreshSavedRecentChatTail(triggerId, currentOutput)
    local captured = tmCaptureRecentSessionDialogue(triggerId, currentOutput, 3)
    if captured ~= "" then
        local previous = TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS
        TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = true
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_saved_recent_chat_tail", captured)
        TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = previous
    end
    return captured
end

function tmRecentTailCompareText(text)
    local clean = tmTrimText(tostring(text or ""))
    clean = clean:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\r", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("%s+", " ")
    return clean
end

function tmSavedRecentTailCoveredByContext(saved, context)
    local contextText = tmRecentTailCompareText(context)
    if contextText == "" then return false end
    local total = 0
    local covered = 0
    for line in tostring(saved or ""):gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local probe = tmRecentTailCompareText(line)
        if probe ~= "" then
            total = total + 1
            if contextText:find(probe, 1, true) then covered = covered + 1 end
        end
    end
    return total > 0 and covered == total
end

function tmSavedRecentChatTailContext(triggerId, recentContext)
    local saved = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "tm_saved_recent_chat_tail", ""))
    if saved == "" then return "" end
    if recentContext ~= nil and tmSavedRecentTailCoveredByContext(saved, recentContext) then return "" end
    local lines = {"[Saved visible conversation tail from session save]"}
    for line in saved:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local clean = tmTrimText(line)
        if clean ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "- " .. clean) end
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- Use this as immediate continuity after loading; current runtime state remains authoritative.")
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmBuildRecentChatContext(triggerId, maxMessages)
    local lines = {"[Recent visible conversation tail]"}
    local limit = tonumber(maxMessages) or 4
    if limit < 1 then limit = 1 end
    if type(getFullChat) ~= "function" then
        table.insert(lines, "- unavailable in this runtime; rely on stored scene variables and player profiles.")
        local savedContext = tmSavedRecentChatTailContext(triggerId)
        if savedContext ~= "" then table.insert(lines, savedContext) end
        return table.concat(lines, "\n")
    end
    local ok, chatHistory = pcall(getFullChat, triggerId)
    if not ok or type(chatHistory) ~= "table" then
        table.insert(lines, "- unavailable in this runtime; rely on stored scene variables and player profiles.")
        local savedContext = tmSavedRecentChatTailContext(triggerId)
        if savedContext ~= "" then table.insert(lines, savedContext) end
        return table.concat(lines, "\n")
    end
    local added = 0
    for i = #chatHistory, 1, -1 do
        local msg = chatHistory[i] or {}
        local role = tostring(msg.role or "")
        if role == "char" or role == "user" then
            local text = tmSanitizeChatSnippet(msg.data or msg.content or "")
            if text ~= "" then
                table.insert(lines, 2, string.format("- %s: %s", role, tmRecentChatContextText(text)))
                added = added + 1
            end
        end
        if added >= limit then break end
    end
    if added == 0 then
        table.insert(lines, "- no visible user/character messages found yet.")
    end
    local recentContext = table.concat(lines, "\n")
    if added == 0 then
        local savedContext = tmSavedRecentChatTailContext(triggerId, recentContext)
        if savedContext ~= "" then table.insert(lines, savedContext) end
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function buildPlayerProfileContext(triggerId)
    local lines = {
        "[Real player profiles and table experience - CHR lorebook source]",
        "- The heroines are real Seongsil University club members at a TRPG table, not already-competent fantasy adventurers.",
        "- Character-specific personality, voice, table behavior, rule-help behavior, and cosplay attitude come from CHR lorebook fields.",
        "- Use CHR ROLE, MOTIVATION, CLUB_BEHAVIOR, CONCEPT_PLAY, SPEECH_STYLE, RULE_HELP, and other parsed CHR fields as the source of truth.",
        "- Let rule knowledge, hesitation, jokes, and player confidence follow the CHR text instead of static SYSTEM character summaries.",
        "- Do not let beginners self-select ability scores, DCs, or expert tactics unless the user already taught that procedure in the visible chat.",
        "- Keep speech and props tied to each player's stored PC class/equipment. Do not invent familiars, summons, shields, staves, or special props unless the sheet/class/concept supports them.",
        "- Table dialogue uses casual Korean between club members. They may call the user '마스터', but avoid formal honorifics like '~습니다', '~해요', '~해주실', '입장하십쇼', or '대기해 줘'.",
        "- Avoid flattening the four real players into one generic novice type. Use the parsed CHR notes for nuance.",
    }
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local chr = tmFetchChrSheet(triggerId, id) or {}
        local display = tmNaiCleanText(chr.NAME_KO or CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or id)
        local role = tmNaiCleanText(chr.ROLE or "")
        local motivation = tmNaiCleanText(chr.MOTIVATION or "")
        local clubBehavior = tmNaiCleanText(chr.CLUB_BEHAVIOR or "")
        local conceptPlay = tmNaiCleanText(chr.CONCEPT_PLAY or "")
        local speechStyle = tmNaiCleanText(chr.SPEECH_STYLE or "")
        local ruleHelp = tmNaiCleanText(chr.RULE_HELP or "")
        table.insert(lines, string.format(
            "- %s/%s: role=%s; motivation=%s; club_behavior=%s; concept_play=%s",
            display,
            id,
            role,
            motivation,
            clubBehavior,
            conceptPlay
        ))
        if speechStyle ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  speech_style: " .. speechStyle) end
        if ruleHelp ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "  rule_help: " .. ruleHelp) end
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmDailyRelationHookField(affection)
    local val = tonumber(affection) or 100
    if val <= 75 then return "RELATION_HOOK_0_75", "0-75" end
    if val <= 175 then return "RELATION_HOOK_76_175", "76-175" end
    if val <= 300 then return "RELATION_HOOK_176_300", "176-300" end
    if val <= 400 then return "RELATION_HOOK_301_400", "301-400" end
    return "RELATION_HOOK_401_500", "401-500"
end

function tmFetchRelationCueSheet(triggerId)
    return tmFetchLoreSheetByComment(triggerId, "RELATION_DATA", function(entry, sheet)
        return entry.name == "tm_relation_cues" or sheet.ID == "tm_relation_cues"
    end) or {}
end

function tmRelationCueKey(ownerId, field)
    local owner = tostring(ownerId or ""):upper()
    local suffix = tostring(field or ""):gsub("^RELATION_HOOK_", "")
    if owner == "" or suffix == "" then return "" end
    return "RELATION_HOOK_" .. owner .. "_" .. suffix
end

function tmCurrentRelationHook(triggerId, ownerId)
    local affection = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_affection", 100)
    local field = tmDailyRelationHookField(affection)
    local relationData = tmFetchRelationCueSheet(triggerId)
    return tmNaiCleanText(relationData[tmRelationCueKey(ownerId, field)] or "")
end

function tmRelationshipPromptLine(triggerId, ownerId, mode)
    local display = CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId
    local relationText = tmRelationStateText(triggerId, ownerId)
    if mode == "daily" then
        local hook = tmCurrentRelationHook(triggerId, ownerId)
        local line = string.format("- %s (%s): %s. Treat this as the current social distance toward the user.", display, ownerId, relationText)
        if hook ~= "" then
            line = line .. " Current attitude toward the user: " .. hook
        end
        return line
    end
    return string.format("- %s (%s): %s. Apply this only to table-talk tone and reaction intensity toward the user GM; active TRPG play should not unlock daily private-story beats by itself.", display, ownerId, relationText)
end

function tmBuildRelationshipContext(triggerId, activeList, mode)
    local header = mode == "daily"
        and "[Relationship context - current state only]"
        or "[Table relationship context - current state only]"
    local lines = {
        header,
        "- Stored relationship values have already been translated by Lua into readable current-state cues.",
        "- Relationship numbers, trust numbers, meter values, and implementation band keys are hidden implementation state; visible prose should use only the cues below.",
    }
    local seen = {}
    local added = 0
    local source = tostring(activeList or table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","))
    for rawId in source:gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local id = rawId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if id ~= "" and CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] and not seen[id] then
            seen[id] = true
            table.insert(lines, tmRelationshipPromptLine(triggerId, id, mode))
            added = added + 1
        end
    end
    if added == 0 then return "" end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmReadLLMText(result)
    if type(result) == "table" then
        if result.success == false then
            return nil, tostring(result.result or "LLM 호출 실패")
        end
        local text = result.result or result.content or result.text
        if text == nil then
            return nil, "LLM 응답에 result 텍스트가 없습니다."
        end
        return tostring(text), nil
    end
    if type(result) == "string" then
        return result, nil
    end
    return nil, "알 수 없는 LLM 응답 형식입니다."
end

function tmPcNameLanguageLine(triggerId)
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        return "PC names are visible text and use original Korean Hangul fantasy names. Avoid modern real-name patterns and do not copy a fixed example list."
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        return "PC names are visible text and use Japanese fantasy names or Japanese transliterations."
    end
    return "PC names are visible text and use English fantasy names."
end

function tmGeneratePartySheetsWithLLM(triggerId)
    local languageName = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local validClasses = tmClassValidListText(triggerId, false)
    local classRoles = tmClassRoleListText(triggerId, false)
    local systemPrompt = table.concat({
        "You generate compact first-session TRPG player-character sheets for Persona Table.",
        "Return exactly four ▥PC_SHEET:...▥ markers and no extra system commentary.",
        "Use the system-rolled stats supplied in the prompt. Do not start the scenario.",
        "Write visible PC-sheet fields in " .. languageName .. ": pc_name, concept, equipment_name, equipment_desc, skill_name, skill_desc.",
        "Keep parser fields as ASCII IDs: owner, class_id, equipment_id, skill_id, alignment_id.",
        tmPcNameLanguageLine(triggerId),
        "Use original fantasy TRPG character names for pc_name. Do not use real player names, shortened Korean nicknames, romanizations, direct readings, or modern Korean given-name variants.",
        "Good pc_name shape: short fantasy role names that are distinct across the four PCs; do not copy a fixed example list.",
        "Choose one alignment_id for each PC: lawful_good, neutral_good, chaotic_good, lawful_neutral, true_neutral, chaotic_neutral, lawful_evil, neutral_evil, chaotic_evil.",
        "The alignment should work together with the real player's personality and class concept. Avoid evil alignments unless they create playable table comedy rather than sabotage.",
        "PC sheets are scenario-generic. Do not bake current episode locations, quest objects, clues, monsters, or plot goals into PC concepts, equipment, or skills.",
        "Match concept to class_id using this compact registry: " .. classRoles .. ".",
        "Use short formula IDs for equipment and skills: eq_l1_{stat}_{role}, sk_l1_{stat}_{role}.",
        "Also create short fantasy display names for equipment_name and skill_name. These names are display-only; mechanics come only from the formula IDs.",
        "Also create equipment_desc and skill_desc as short user-facing tooltip prose. Do not include formula IDs, refs, stat tokens, role tokens, or raw numbers in descriptions.",
        "Valid owners: sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola.",
        "Valid class_id: " .. validClasses .. ".",
        "Return marker format: ▥PC_SHEET:owner|pc_name|class_id|concept|equipment_id|equipment_name|equipment_desc|skill_id|skill_name|skill_desc|alignment_id▥"
    }, "\n")
    local messages = {
        {role = "system", content = systemPrompt},
        {role = "user", content = tmBuildCharacterGenerationUserPrompt(triggerId)}
    }
    local fn = tmSheetGenerationLLMFn(triggerId)
    if not fn then
        return false, "RisuAI LLM API를 사용할 수 없습니다."
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId, messages)
    if not ok then
        return false, tostring(result)
    end
    local text, err = tmReadLLMText(result)
    if err then
        return false, err
    end
    if text == nil or text == "" then
        return false, "LLM 응답이 비어 있습니다."
    end
    local _, applied = stripAndApplyCharacterSheetMarkers(triggerId, text)
    if not applied then
        return false, "LLM 응답에서 PC_SHEET 마커를 찾지 못했습니다."
    end
    if not tmAllSheetsGenerated(triggerId) then
        return false, "4인 캐릭터 시트가 모두 생성되지 않았습니다."
    end
    return true, ""
end

        "Use the system-rolled stats supplied in the prompt. Do not start the scenario.",
        "Write visible PC-sheet fields in " .. languageName .. ": pc_name, concept, equipment_name, equipment_desc, skill_name, skill_desc.",

        tmPcNameLanguageLine(triggerId),
        "Use an original fantasy TRPG character name for pc_name. Do not use real player names, shortened Korean nicknames, romanizations, direct readings, or modern Korean given-name variants.",
        "Choose one alignment_id: lawful_good, neutral_good, chaotic_good, lawful_neutral, true_neutral, chaotic_neutral, lawful_evil, neutral_evil, chaotic_evil.",
        "The sheet is scenario-generic. Do not bake current episode locations, quest objects, clues, monsters, or plot goals into PC concepts, equipment, or skills.",
        "Match concept to class_id using this compact registry: " .. classRoles .. ".",
        "Use short formula IDs for equipment and skills: eq_l1_{stat}_{role}, sk_l1_{stat}_{role}.",
        "Also create short fantasy display names for equipment_name and skill_name. These names are display-only; mechanics come only from the formula IDs.",
        "Also create equipment_desc and skill_desc as short user-facing tooltip prose. Do not include formula IDs, refs, stat tokens, role tokens, or raw numbers in descriptions.",

        "Valid class_id: " .. validClasses .. ".",
        "Return marker format: ▥PC_SHEET:owner|pc_name|class_id|concept|equipment_id|equipment_name|equipment_desc|skill_id|skill_name|skill_desc|alignment_id▥"
    }, "\n")
    local messages = {
        {role = "system", content = systemPrompt},
        {role = "user", content = tmBuildOneSheetGenerationUserPrompt(triggerId, ownerId)}
    }
    local fn = tmSheetGenerationLLMFn(triggerId)
    if not fn then
        return false, "RisuAI LLM API를 사용할 수 없습니다."
    end
    local snapshots = tmSnapshotSheets(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false")
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId, messages)
    if not ok then
        tmRestoreSheets(triggerId, snapshots)
        return false, tostring(result)
    end
    local text, err = tmReadLLMText(result)
    if err then
        tmRestoreSheets(triggerId, snapshots)
        return false, err
    end
    if text == nil or text == "" then
        tmRestoreSheets(triggerId, snapshots)
        return false, "LLM 응답이 비어 있습니다."
    end
    local _, applied = stripAndApplyCharacterSheetMarkers(triggerId, text)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if id ~= ownerId then tmRestoreSheet(triggerId, id, snapshots[id]) end
    end
    if not applied or getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false") ~= "true" then
        tmRestoreSheet(triggerId, ownerId, snapshots[ownerId])
        return false, "LLM 응답에서 대상 PC_SHEET 마커를 찾지 못했습니다."
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "stats_locked", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "ready_to_start")
    setVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "sheets_confirmed")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:reroll_one:" .. ownerId)
    return true, ""
end

        "\"나는 아직도 반대야.\" 민희가 작게 중얼거렸다. \"근데... 퀄리티 낮으면 더 창피하잖아. 그래서 한 거야.\"",
        "",
        "설아는 시선을 살짝 피한 채 내 앞의 GM석 의자를 조용히 빼 주었다. 손끝으로 자기 의상 장식을 한번 더 눌러 확인하는 모습이 어쩐지 부끄럽고도 진지했다.",
        "",
        "\"마스터 앉으면... 이제 시작이야.\"",
        "",
        "나는 아직도 상황을 다 받아들이지 못한 채 GM석에 앉았다. 네 사람의 의상, 시트, 주사위, 그리고 기대에 찬 시선이 한꺼번에 내 쪽으로 모였다.",
        "",
        "첫 의뢰는 『" .. title .. "』이었다. " .. summary .. " " .. opening,
        "",
        "\"그러니까... 지금 보이는 걸 확인한다고 말하면 되는 거야? 아니면 먼저 뭘 하겠다고 정해야 해?\"",
        "",
        "정한나가 주사위를 손끝으로 굴리며 흥미로운 단서부터 건드려 봐도 되냐는 얼굴을 했다. 민희도 괜히 툴툴대는 표정으로 고개를 들었다. \"그리고 굴리라면 뭘 굴리는데. 힘? 민첩? 그런 거 마스터가 정해 주는 거 맞지?\"",
        "",
        "설아가 작게 고개를 끄덕였다. \"음... 먼저 뭐 할지 말하면 돼. 판정은 마스터가 정해줄 거야. 아마.\"",
        "",
        "네 사람의 시선이 자연스럽게 GM석으로 모였다. 아직 첫 d20은 굴러가지 않았다. 누가 어떤 행동을 선언할지, 그리고 어떤 판정으로 받아 줄지 정해지는 순간을 기다리고 있었다."
    }, "\n")
end

function tmBuildOpeningScenePrompt(triggerId)
    local episodeId = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", ""))
    local content = ""
    if type(tmFetchEpisodeContent) == "function" then content = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId) end
    local sheet = parseSheet(content)
    local languageName = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local title = tmScenarioTitle(triggerId, episodeId)
    local summary = tmEpisodeSummaryFromContent(content)
    if summary == "" then summary = tmFallbackEpisodeEntry().summary end
    local opening = tmEpisodeOpeningFromContent(content)
    if opening == "" then opening = "Introduce the first visible clue of the selected episode." end
    local scenes = tmEpisodeSection(content, "SCENES")
    if scenes == "" then scenes = "Use the selected episode's first scene and wait for player declarations." end
    local cosplayDone = getVar(triggerId, "cosplay_event_done", "false") == "true"
    local openingTask = cosplayDone
        and "Write the first visible scene for TRPGMaster's next TRPG session or newly selected scenario."
        or "Write the first visible scene for TRPGMaster's first session."
    local situationLine = cosplayDone
        and "Situation: Persona Table's four members already have finalized fantasy PC sheets and an established class-cosplay table routine; the user is the GM/master at the table."
        or "Situation: Persona Table's four members have finished preparing their first level-1 fantasy PC sheets, and the user is the GM/master at the table."
    local tableSkillPremise = cosplayDone
        and "Opening table skill premise: this is a later session or new scenario after the first cosplay reveal. Use the CHR-derived player profile context for table skill, confidence, voice, and rule-help behavior."
        or "Opening table skill premise: this is the members' first actual session together. Use the CHR-derived player profile context below for each member's table skill, confidence, voice, and rule-help behavior."
    local cosplayBeatLead = cosplayDone
        and "- Before the in-scenario opening hook, write a compact later-session outfit preparation beat, not a first-time cosplay reveal."
        or "- Before the in-scenario opening hook, write the cosplay reveal as a light romcom scene, not as an explanatory status summary."
    local cosplayBeatSequence = cosplayDone
        and "- Sequence: after the scenario is selected, the players briefly adjust or refit their current class cosplay, check props and sheets, trade familiar teasing, then settle around the GM seat."
        or "- Sequence: after PC sheets are finalized, the players tell the user GM to wait outside; the user is confused; hurried fitting and repair voices are heard behind the door; when the user is called back in, all four are wearing high-quality class cosplay based on their finalized PC sheets."
    local cosplayBeatExpectation = cosplayDone
        and "- The user already knows Persona Table uses serious cosplay. Show familiarity, small embarrassment, and practical outfit checks rather than first-time shock."
        or "- The user did not expect them to cosplay and should visibly feel flustered before sitting in the GM seat."
    local cosplayPortraitLine = cosplayDone
        and "- Portraits: show each heroine exactly once using the exact portrait_tag from [Cosplay event state], placed near her short outfit-prep beat."
        or "- Portraits: show each heroine exactly once using the exact portrait_tag from [Cosplay event state], placed right before or right after her introduction beat in the cosplay reveal."
    local cosplayOutfitLine = cosplayDone
        and "- Image tag syntax: <img=\"name_emotion_outfit\"> with no .webp extension. Use only the exact portrait_tag shown for that owner in [Cosplay event state]. Do not infer {class}_cosplay; some classes use non-{class}_cosplay outfit tokens such as maid."
        or "- Image tag syntax: <img=\"name_emotion_outfit\"> with no .webp extension. Use only the exact portrait_tag shown for that owner in [Cosplay event state]. Do not infer {class}_cosplay; some classes use non-{class}_cosplay outfit tokens such as maid."
    local cosplayStateLine = cosplayDone
        and "- Use current class/concept details. The exact portrait_tag in [Cosplay event state] is authoritative for image tags."
        or "- The context may still show outfit_state=default before Lua applies the reveal state, but this scene IS the reveal: use the exact portrait_tag values, never _default and never an inferred mage or {class}_cosplay fallback."
    local lines = {
        openingTask,
        "Language: " .. languageName .. ".",
        "Tone: light web-novel TRPG club scene, not a system notice. Avoid formal Korean narrator endings like '-습니다' or '-합니다'.",
        situationLine,
        "Real setting: Seongsil University TRPG clubroom. Do not rename the real university into a magic university.",
        "Scenario setting: inside the TRPG session, if the scenario uses a university/campus location, make that fictional location fantasy-flavored, such as a magic academy, old arcane hall, or enchanted lecture building.",
        "Selected episode id: " .. episodeId,
        "Selected episode title: " .. title,
        "Selected episode level: " .. tmTrimText(sheet.RECOMMENDED_LEVEL or "1"),
        "Selected episode summary: " .. summary,
        "Selected episode opening hook: " .. opening,
        "Selected episode scene notes: " .. scenes,
        "Use the selected episode above for the in-scenario opening. Do not default to the old arcane hall basement unless the selected episode is ep_001_basement_goblins.",
        tableSkillPremise,
        "Requirements:",
        cosplayBeatLead,
        cosplayBeatSequence,
        cosplayBeatExpectation,
        "- Use the CHR-derived profile context to decide who sounds excited, embarrassed, shy, proud, or practical.",
        "- Let the players justify it through dialogue: this is a roleplay research club, so if they are doing roleplay they should do it properly.",
        "- Treat costume funding, fitting, repair, and costume-detail work as character/profile facts supplied by CHR context, not SYSTEM facts.",
        "- The cosplay is real Seongsil University clubroom preparation, not a magical transformation or separate fantasy portrait. It should feel like committed stage-level costumes made for table immersion.",
        "- Visible output is player-facing narrative prose only: table narration, character dialogue, scene facts, declarations, and natural roll handoff.",
        "- Private GM guide/check notes stay as adjudication context and are expressed only through the visible scene.",
        "- Do not describe cheap improvised props or sloppy costumes: no mops, foam board, cardboard armor, bedsheets, blankets, graduation gowns, taped toy swords, or rough paper props.",
        "- Tie each player's outfit detail to their stored class/concept, but keep details compact so the scene can still move into the fantasy scenario.",
        cosplayPortraitLine,
        cosplayOutfitLine,
        cosplayStateLine,
        "- For non-neutral portraits, each image tag's emotion MUST be one exact token listed in TRPGMASTER_EXTRA_IMAGE_GUIDE.",
        "- Exactly four image tags total, one per heroine. Do not tag the user GM, do not repeat a tag, and do not place two tags adjacent without narration between them.",
        "- Table dialogue uses casual Korean. They may call the user '마스터', but avoid formal honorifics like '~습니다', '~해요', '~해주실', '입장하십쇼', or '대기해 줘'.",
        "- Show all four CHR-sourced real players reacting in character at the table.",
        "- Blend table talk and the in-game opening scene.",
        "- Make the players' early intentions visible through hesitant dialogue, posture, sheets, or dice, but do not make them look like veteran players.",
        "- Also emit exactly four hidden INTENT markers, one for each owner: ▥INTENT:sinsoyul|short current action or none▥, ▥INTENT:junghanna|short current action or none▥, ▥INTENT:kimminhee|short current action or none▥, ▥INTENT:yuseola|short current action or none▥.",
        "- INTENT marker separator is a pipe character after the owner id: owner|intention.",
        "- Each INTENT marker must describe that player's actual current declared or clearly implied action in the opening scene. Use none when no current declared or implied action exists. Waiting is valid only if the player actually waits or holds position.",
        "- INTENT is not mood, personality, advice, future plan, or a guessed next action. It is the current table action state.",
        "- Keep each INTENT value short " .. languageName .. " status-panel text, without DCs, stat abbreviations, target numbers, HTML, or image tags.",
        "- The players should ask or imply 'what can I declare?' and 'what do I roll?' rather than confidently choosing stats/DCs themselves.",
        "- If a CHR profile gives rule-help behavior, keep that help in that character's voice and do not turn it into a smooth lecture.",
        "- The guide panel should not be a generic tutorial or a bare DC list. It should guide the user GM on how to lead this scenario beat: mood, visible clues, what to reveal after player declarations, likely adjudications, and consequence.",
        "- The user is the GM. The GM does not act for the players; the GM judges the players' intended actions.",
        "- End with the four members waiting for the GM's ruling, difficulty, or roll call.",
        "- Do not directly tell the user what to do. Do not ask the user a question. Do not write a GM instruction in the narrative.",
        "- Avoid endings like '무엇을 하시겠습니까?', '진행을 부탁드립니다', '마스터, 어떻게 하시겠습니까?', or '어떤 행동을 요구하시겠습니까?'.",
        "- The separate session status panel will carry examples of GM judgment; visible narrative should only describe the scene and player intentions.",
        "- Prefer natural light-novel narration with varied sentence endings. Avoid a stiff chain of '-다' sentences.",
        "- Do not output system notices, debug text, HTML, buttons, or hidden control UI. The Risu image tags and the four required INTENT markers are the only allowed tag-like output.",
        "- Do not output PC_SHEET, ROLL, EPISODE, ENEMY, REWARD, GUIDE, GUIDE_LEAD, BRIEF, or SCENE markers.",
        "",
        tmBuildRecentChatContext(triggerId),
        "",
        buildPlayerProfileContext(triggerId),
        "",
        tmBuildCosplayContext(triggerId, true),
        "",
        buildPartySheetContext(triggerId)
    }
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmOpeningSceneToneLooksWrong(text)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    if s == "" then return true end
    if countKeywords(s, {"무엇을 하시겠습니까", "진행을 부탁드립니다", "마스터, 어떻게 하시겠습니까", "어떤 행동을 요구"}) > 0 then
        return true
    end
    if countKeywords(s, {"습니다", "합니다", "있습니다", "입니다"}) >= 4 then
        return true
    end
    if countKeywords(s, {"해요", "해주실", "입장하십쇼", "대기해 줘", "거예요"}) >= 2 then
        return true
    end
    if countKeywords(s, {"INT", "STR", "DEX", "CON", "WIS", "CHA", "DC"}) >= 5 then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function tmGenerateOpeningSceneText(triggerId)
    local messages = {
        {role = "system", content = "Write the visible first-session narrative for TRPGMaster. Include only the required hidden INTENT markers besides visible prose/image tags. No system messages."},
        {role = "user", content = tmBuildOpeningScenePrompt(triggerId)}
    }
    local fn = tmSelectHelperLLM(triggerId)
    if fn then
        local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId, messages)
        if ok then
            local text, err = tmReadLLMText(result)
            if not err and text and text ~= "" then
                local rawText = tmStripControlMarkers(text)
                local visibleText = tmStripIntentMarkersFromText(rawText)
                text = visibleText
                text = text:gsub("▥.-▥", "")
                text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
                text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                rawText = rawText:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
                if text ~= "" and not tmOpeningSceneToneLooksWrong(text) then return rawText end
            end
        else
            print("[TRPG] opening scene LLM failed: " .. tostring(result))
        end
    end
    return tmFallbackOpeningScene(triggerId)
end

function tmAddNarrativeChat(triggerId, text)
    if type(addChat) ~= "function" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "RisuAI addChat API를 사용할 수 없어 첫 장면을 채팅에 추가하지 못했습니다.", "The RisuAI addChat API is unavailable, so the first scene could not be added to chat.", "RisuAI addChat APIを使用できないため、最初の場面をチャットに追加できませんでした。"))
        return false
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(addChat, triggerId, "char", tostring(text or ""))
    if not ok then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "첫 장면을 채팅에 추가하지 못했습니다: ", "Could not add the first scene to chat: ", "最初の場面をチャットに追加できませんでした: ") .. tostring(result))
        return false
    end
    if result and type(result.await) == "function" then
        local awaitOk, awaitErr = pcall(function() result:await() end)
        if not awaitOk then
            tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "첫 장면 표시 대기 중 오류: ", "Error while waiting for the first scene to display: ", "最初の場面表示待機中にエラー: ") .. tostring(awaitErr))
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end

function tmApplyStarterConcepts(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local c = TM_STARTER_CONCEPTS[id]
        tmSetSheetConcept(triggerId, id, c.class, c.title, c.note)
        local alignment = tmAlignmentFallback(id, c.class)
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_alignment", alignment)
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_alignment_name", tmAlignmentName(alignment))
        tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStats(triggerId, id)
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "stats_locked", "false") == "true" and tmAllSheetsGenerated(triggerId) then
        setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_started", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:class_changed")
        return
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_started", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:starter_concepts")
end

function tmRollSheetStatsForced(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmEnsureSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local values = {}
    for _, stat in ipairs(cls.order) do values[stat] = tmRollAbility() end
    for key, _ in pairs(TM_STAT_LABELS) do
        if values[key] == nil then values[key] = tmRollAbility() end
        tmSetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, key, values[key])
    end
    local hpMax = tmMaxHpFor(triggerId, classId, values.con)
    local mpMax = tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, values.wis, values.int)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp_max", hpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp", hpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", mpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", mpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_rolled", "true")
end

function tmRollSheetStats(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmEnsureSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "stats_locked", "false") == "true"
        and getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_rolled", "false") == "true" then
        return
    end
    tmRollSheetStatsForced(triggerId, ownerId)
end

function tmRerollPartySheetStatsForced(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do tmRollSheetStatsForced(triggerId, id) end
end

function tmRollPartySheets(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do tmRollSheetStats(triggerId, id) end
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_started", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:roll_party")
end

function tmConfirmPartySheets(triggerId)
    tmEnsurePartySheets(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_sheet_rolled", "false") ~= "true" then
            tmRollSheetStats(triggerId, id)
        end
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false") ~= "true" then
            setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_sheet_llm_created", "true")
            local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_class", "rogue")
            setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_pc_name", tmNormalizeGeneratedPcName(triggerId, id, getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_pc_name", ""), classId))
            tmEnsureAlignment(triggerId, id)
        end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_started", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "stats_locked", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "ready_to_start")
    setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "sheets_confirmed")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:confirmed")
end

function tmGetActiveOwner(triggerId)
    local ownerId = getVar(triggerId, "active_owner_id", "yuseola")
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then ownerId = "yuseola" end
    return ownerId
end

function tmStripControlMarkers(msg)
    local clean = tostring(msg or "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    clean = tmStripLoadingMarker(clean)
    clean = tmStripRequestContextSummaries(clean)
    if type(tmStripAuxMarkers) == "function" then clean = tmStripAuxMarkers(clean) end
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?" .. TM_CONTROL_MARKER, "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?" .. TM_CONTROL_MARKER_LEGACY, "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?" .. TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER, "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?▥AFF_TIER.-▥", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?<META AFF_TIER[^>]*/>", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("[ \t]+\n", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n+$", "")
    return clean
end

function tmStripRequestContextSummaries(text)
    local clean = tostring(text or "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[ROLL_CALL:%s*.-%]%s*", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[COMBAT_CALL:%s*.-%]%s*", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[ROLL_RESULT:%s*.-%]%s*", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[ROLL_PENDING:%s*.-%]%s*", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[COMBAT_RESULT:%s*.-%]%s*", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[LOADING:%s*.-%]%s*", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[COUNTDOWN%]%s*", "")
    return clean
end

function tmRequestHtmlText(value)
    local s = tostring(value or "")
    s = s:gsub("<br%s*/?>", "\n")
    s = s:gsub("<[^>]+>", " ")
    s = s:gsub("&nbsp;", " ")
    s = s:gsub("&quot;", '"')
    s = s:gsub("&#39;", "'")
    s = s:gsub("&lt;", "<")
    s = s:gsub("&gt;", ">")
    s = s:gsub("&amp;", "&")
    s = s:gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " ")
    s = s:gsub("%s+", " ")
    return s:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function tmRequestTagHasClass(openTag, className)
    local classes = tostring(openTag or ""):match('class%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"')
        or tostring(openTag or ""):match("class%s*=%s*'([^']*)'")
    if not classes then return false end
    return (" " .. classes .. " "):find(" " .. tostring(className or "") .. " ", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function tmRequestFindMatchingTagEnd(text, tagName, openEnd)
    local tag = tostring(tagName or "")
    if tag == "" then return nil end
    local pos = (openEnd or 0) + 1
    local depth = 1
    local openPat = "<" .. tag
    local closePat = "</" .. tag .. ">"
    while true do
        local nextOpen = text:find(openPat, pos, true)
        local nextClose = text:find(closePat, pos, true)
        if not nextClose then return nil end
        if nextOpen and nextOpen < nextClose then
            local nextOpenEnd = text:find(">", nextOpen, true)
            if not nextOpenEnd then return nil end
            local openTag = text:sub(nextOpen, nextOpenEnd)
            if not openTag:match("/%s*>$") then depth = depth + 1 end
            pos = nextOpenEnd + 1
        else
            depth = depth - 1
            local closeEnd = nextClose + #closePat - 1
            if depth <= 0 then return closeEnd end
            pos = closeEnd + 1
        end
    end
end

function tmRequestFindElementByClass(text, className, startPos)
    local pos = startPos or 1
    while true do
        local s, e, tagName = text:find("<([%w]+)[^>]*>", pos)
        if not s then return nil end
        local openTag = text:sub(s, e)
        if tmRequestTagHasClass(openTag, className) then
            local finish = tmRequestFindMatchingTagEnd(text, tagName, e) or e
            return s, finish, text:sub(s, finish)
        end
        pos = e + 1
    end
end

function tmRequestElementTextByClass(text, className, startPos)
    local _, _, block = tmRequestFindElementByClass(tostring(text or ""), className, startPos)
    return tmRequestHtmlText(block or "")
end

function tmRequestAllElementTextsByClass(text, className)
    local values = {}
    local pos = 1
    while true do
        local s, e, block = tmRequestFindElementByClass(tostring(text or ""), className, pos)
        if not s then break end
        local plain = tmRequestHtmlText(block)
        if plain ~= "" then table.insert(values, plain) end
        pos = e + 1
    end
    return values
end

function tmRequestTipValue(block, label)
    local needle = ">" .. tostring(label or "") .. "</span>"
    local pos = tostring(block or ""):find(needle, 1, true)
    if not pos then return "" end
    return tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-tip-v", pos + #needle)
end

function tmRequestAppendPart(parts, value)
    local s = tmRequestHtmlText(value)
    if s ~= "" then table.insert(parts, s) end
end

function tmRequestRenderedRollSummary(block)
    local actor = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-roll-actor")
    local check = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-roll-check")
    local action = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-roll-action")
    action = action:gsub("^행동%s*", ""):gsub("^Action%s*", ""):gsub("^行動%s*", "")
    local tier = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-roll-tier")
    local dataTier = tostring(block or ""):match('data%-tier%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') or ""
    local pending = dataTier == "pending" or tier:find("대기", 1, true) ~= nil
        or tier:lower():find("pending", 1, true) ~= nil
    local label = pending and "ROLL_PENDING" or "ROLL_RESULT"
    local plainParts = {}
    tmRequestAppendPart(plainParts, actor)
    tmRequestAppendPart(plainParts, check)
    if action ~= "" then table.insert(plainParts, "행동: " .. action) end
    tmRequestAppendPart(plainParts, tier)
    local parts = {}
    tmRequestAppendPart(parts, actor)
    tmRequestAppendPart(parts, check)
    if action ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "행동: " .. action) end
    if not pending then
        local d20 = tostring(block or ""):match('aria%-label%s*=%s*"[^"]-(%d+)[^"]-"')
            or tostring(block or ""):match("tm_dice_d20_(%d%d)")
        local success = tmRequestTipValue(block, "성공 기준")
        if success == "" then success = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-roll-dc") end
        local partial = tmRequestTipValue(block, "부분 성공 기준")
        local dc = tmRequestTipValue(block, "원래 난이도")
        if dc == "" then dc = tmRequestTipValue(block, "기준") end
        if dc == "" then dc = tmRequestTipValue(block, "최종 기준") end
        local successFormula = tmRequestTipValue(block, "성공 기준식")
        local partialFormula = tmRequestTipValue(block, "부분 성공 기준식")
        local comparison = tmRequestTipValue(block, "비교")
        local total = tmRequestTipValue(block, "합계")
        local margin = tmRequestTipValue(block, "차이")
        if d20 and d20 ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "d20=" .. tostring(tonumber(d20) or d20)) end
        if successFormula ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "성공기준식=" .. successFormula)
        elseif success ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "성공기준=" .. success) end
        if partialFormula ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "부분성공기준식=" .. partialFormula)
        elseif partial ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "부분성공기준=" .. partial) end
        if dc ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "원래난이도=" .. dc) end
        if comparison ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "비교=" .. comparison) end
        if successFormula == "" and partialFormula == "" and comparison == "" then
            if total ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "합계=" .. total) end
            if margin ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "차이=" .. margin) end
        end
        tmRequestAppendPart(parts, "결과=" .. tier)
    else
        tmRequestAppendPart(parts, "상태=" .. tier)
    end
    if #plainParts == 0 then
        return pending and "최근 판정 요청: 이전 주사위 카드가 있었다." or "최근 판정 결과: 이전 주사위 카드가 있었다."
    end
    return (pending and "최근 판정 요청: " or "최근 판정 결과: ") .. table.concat(plainParts, " / ")
end

function tmRequestRenderedCombatSummary(block)
    local sentence = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-combat-sentence")
    local hp = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-combat-hp-label")
    local chips = tmRequestAllElementTextsByClass(block, "tm-combat-chip")
    local outcome = tostring(block or ""):match('data%-outcome%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') or ""
    local parts = {}
    tmRequestAppendPart(parts, sentence)
    if #chips > 0 then table.insert(parts, table.concat(chips, ", ")) end
    if hp ~= "" then table.insert(parts, hp) end
    if outcome ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "outcome=" .. outcome) end
    if #parts == 0 then return "최근 전투 결과: 이전 전투 카드가 있었다." end
    return "최근 전투 결과: " .. table.concat(parts, " / ")
end

function tmRequestRenderedLoadingSummary(block)
    local title = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-loading-modal")
    local body = tmRequestElementTextByClass(block, "tm-loading-body")
    if body ~= "" then title = body end
    if title == "" then return "[LOADING: sanitized rendered loading UI]" end
    return "[LOADING: " .. title .. "]"
end

function tmRequestReplaceRenderedDivBlocks(text, className, summarizer)
    local source = tostring(text or "")
    local out, pos = {}, 1
    while true do
        local s, openEnd = nil, nil
        local scan = pos
        while true do
            local ds, de = source:find("<div[^>]*>", scan)
            if not ds then break end
            local openTag = source:sub(ds, de)
            if tmRequestTagHasClass(openTag, className) then
                s, openEnd = ds, de
                break
            end
            scan = de + 1
        end
        if not s then
            table.insert(out, source:sub(pos))
            break
        end
        table.insert(out, source:sub(pos, s - 1))
        local finish = tmRequestFindMatchingTagEnd(source, "div", openEnd)
        if not finish then
            local close = source:find("</div>", openEnd + 1, true)
            finish = close and (close + 5) or openEnd
        end
        local block = source:sub(s, finish)
        local ok, summary = pcall(summarizer, block)
        if not ok or not summary or summary == "" then summary = "[" .. className .. ": sanitized rendered UI]" end
        table.insert(out, summary)
        pos = finish + 1
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

function tmRequestReplaceRenderedElements(text, className, replacement)
    local source = tostring(text or "")
    local out, pos = {}, 1
    while true do
        local s, e = tmRequestFindElementByClass(source, className, pos)
        if not s then
            table.insert(out, source:sub(pos))
            break
        end
        table.insert(out, source:sub(pos, s - 1))
        table.insert(out, replacement)
        pos = e + 1
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

function tmSanitizePlainCountdownForRequest(text)
    local clean = tostring(text or "")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[COUNTDOWN%]초 후 잠금 해제 가능", "[LOADING: 잠금 해제 대기]")
    clean = clean:gsub("%[COUNTDOWN%]秒後にロック解除可能", "[LOADING: ロック解除待ち]")
    clean = clean:gsub("Unlock available in %[COUNTDOWN%]s", "[LOADING: unlock pending]")
    clean = clean:gsub("%d%d%d%d%d+초 후 잠금 해제 가능", "[LOADING: 잠금 해제 대기]")
    clean = clean:gsub("%d%d%d%d%d+秒後にロック解除可能", "[LOADING: ロック解除待ち]")
    clean = clean:gsub("Unlock available in %d%d%d%d%d+s", "[LOADING: unlock pending]")
    return clean
end

function tmSanitizeRenderedUiForRequest(text)
    local clean = tmStripControlMarkers(tmStripSaveSeedTags(text or ""))
    clean = tmRequestReplaceRenderedDivBlocks(clean, "tm-roll-result", tmRequestRenderedRollSummary)
    clean = tmRequestReplaceRenderedDivBlocks(clean, "tm-combat-result", tmRequestRenderedCombatSummary)
    clean = tmRequestReplaceRenderedDivBlocks(clean, "tm-loading-backdrop", tmRequestRenderedLoadingSummary)
    clean = tmRequestReplaceRenderedElements(clean, "tm-countdown", "[COUNTDOWN]")
    clean = tmSanitizePlainCountdownForRequest(clean)
    clean = clean:gsub("[ \t]+\n", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n\n\n+", "\n\n")
    return clean:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function tmSanitizePlayerIntentText(raw)
    local clean, isClear, valid = tmNormalizePlayerIntentText(raw)
    if not valid or isClear then return "" end
    return clean
end

function tmNormalizePlayerIntentText(raw)
    local text = tostring(raw or "")
    text = text:gsub("\r\n", "\n"):gsub("\n", " ")
    text = text:gsub("[ \t]+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local compact = text:gsub("%s+", ""):lower()
    if compact == "" or compact == "none" or compact == "-none"
        or compact == "noaction" or compact == "nocurrentaction"
        or compact == "없음" or compact == "행동없음"
        or compact == "명시된행동없음" or compact == "현재명시된행동없음" then
        return "", true, true
    end
    if countKeywords(text, {"▥", "<<", ">>", "{{", "}}", "<div", "</div", "<img"}) > 0 then
        return "", false, false
    end
    return tmTailText(text, 160), false, true
end

function tmIntentIdList(set)
    local ids = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if set and set[id] then table.insert(ids, id) end
    end
    return table.concat(ids, ",")
end

function tmCsvSet(raw)
    local set = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(parseList(raw, ",")) do
        set[item] = true
    end
    return set
end

function tmCopyIntentSet(source)
    local copied = {}
    if type(source) ~= "table" then return copied end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if source[id] then copied[id] = true end
    end
    return copied
end

function tmStripIntentMarkersFromText(text)
    local output = tostring(text or "")
    output = output:gsub("▥INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|(.-)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥INTENT:([%w_%-]+):(.-)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+)|(.-)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+):(.-)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|(.-)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+):(.-)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|([^>]+)>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<INTENT:([%w_%-]+):([^>]+)>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+)|([^>]+)>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+):([^>]+)>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|([^>]+)>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+):([^>]+)>>", "")
    return output
end

function tmApplyPlayerIntent(triggerId, ownerId, intent, source)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    local clean, isClear, valid = tmNormalizePlayerIntentText(intent)
    if not valid then return false, false end
    local key = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_intent"
    local prev = getVar(triggerId, key, "")
    if isClear then
        if prev ~= "" then
            setVar(triggerId, key, "")
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "의도 해제: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId))
        end
        return true, true
    end
    setVar(triggerId, key, clean)
    if prev ~= clean then
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "의도: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " - " .. clean)
    end
    return true, false
end

function tmRecordIntentDiagnostics(triggerId, source, applied, present, cleared)
    local appliedIds = {}
    local presentIds = {}
    local clearedIds = {}
    local missingIds = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if applied and applied[id] then table.insert(appliedIds, id) end
        if present and present[id] then table.insert(presentIds, id) end
        if cleared and cleared[id] then table.insert(clearedIds, id) end
        local current = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", "")
        if current == "" or current == "none" then table.insert(missingIds, id) end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_source", source or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_applied_ids", table.concat(appliedIds, ","))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_present_ids", table.concat(presentIds, ","))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_cleared_ids", table.concat(clearedIds, ","))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_missing_ids", table.concat(missingIds, ","))
    if #missingIds > 0 then
        print("[TRPGMaster] missing player intents after " .. tostring(source or "unknown") .. ": " .. table.concat(missingIds, ","))
    end
    return #missingIds == 0
end

function tmApplyIntentMarkers(triggerId, output, source)
    local applied = {}
    local present = {}
    local cleared = {}
    local cleaned = tostring(output or "")
    local function apply(ownerId, intent)
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then present[ownerId] = true end
        local ok, didClear = tmApplyPlayerIntent(triggerId, ownerId, intent, source)
        if ok then
            applied[ownerId] = true
            if didClear then cleared[ownerId] = true end
        end
        return ""
    end
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("▥INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|(.-)▥", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("▥INTENT:([%w_%-]+):(.-)▥", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<<INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|([^>]+)>>", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<<INTENT:([%w_%-]+):([^>]+)>>", apply)
    tmRecordIntentDiagnostics(triggerId, source or "intent_markers", applied, present, cleared)
    return cleaned, applied
end

function tmApplyAuxIntentMarkers(triggerId, output, source, prefilled)
    local applied = tmCopyIntentSet(prefilled and prefilled.applied)
    local cleared = tmCopyIntentSet(prefilled and prefilled.cleared)
    local skipped = tmCopyIntentSet(prefilled and prefilled.skipped)
    local alreadyFilled = prefilled and prefilled.applied or {}
    local alreadyHandled = prefilled and prefilled.handled or {}
    local mainPresent = tmCsvSet(getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_present_ids", ""))
    local cleaned = tostring(output or "")
    local function apply(ownerId, intent)
        if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return "" end
        if alreadyFilled[ownerId] or alreadyHandled[ownerId] then
            skipped[ownerId] = true
            return ""
        end
        if mainPresent[ownerId] then
            skipped[ownerId] = true
            return ""
        end
        local ok, didClear = tmApplyPlayerIntent(triggerId, ownerId, intent, source or "intent_aux")
        if ok then
            applied[ownerId] = true
            if didClear then cleared[ownerId] = true end
        end
        return ""
    end
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("▥INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+)|(.-)▥", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("▥INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+):(.-)▥", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<<INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+)|([^>]+)>>", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<<INTENT_AUX:([%w_%-]+):([^>]+)>>", apply)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_aux_last_source", source or "intent_aux")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_aux_last_applied_ids", tmIntentIdList(applied))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_aux_last_cleared_ids", tmIntentIdList(cleared))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_aux_last_skipped_ids", tmIntentIdList(skipped))
    return cleaned, applied
end

function tmApplyPanelIntentSnapshot(triggerId, output, source)
    local applied = {}
    local present = {}
    local cleared = {}
    local cleaned = tostring(output or "")
    local function apply(ownerId, intent)
        if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return "" end
        present[ownerId] = true
        local ok, didClear = tmApplyPlayerIntent(triggerId, ownerId, intent, source or "panel_intent")
        if ok then
            applied[ownerId] = true
            if didClear then cleared[ownerId] = true end
        end
        return ""
    end
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("▥PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|(.-)▥", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("▥PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+):(.-)▥", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<<PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+)|([^>]+)>>", apply)
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<<PANEL_INTENT:([%w_%-]+):([^>]+)>>", apply)

    local missing = {}
    local actions = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if not present[id] then
            table.insert(missing, id)
        else
            local value = tmIntentPromptText(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", ""))
            if value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then actions[id] = true end
        end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_last_source", source or "panel_intent")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_last_present_ids", tmIntentIdList(present))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_last_applied_ids", tmIntentIdList(applied))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_last_cleared_ids", tmIntentIdList(cleared))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_last_missing_ids", table.concat(missing, ","))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_action_owners", tmIntentIdList(actions))
    return cleaned, {
        allPresent = #missing == 0,
        present = present,
        applied = applied,
        cleared = cleared,
        missing = missing,
        actions = actions,
    }
end

function tmPcStatusLabel(status)
    local labels = {
        active = "정상",
        ko = "전투불능",
        stunned = "기절",
    }
    return labels[tostring(status or "")] or tostring(status or "정상")
end

function tmCharacterSheetPortraitAsset(triggerId, ownerId)
    local owner = CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] and ownerId or "yuseola"
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_class", TM_CLASS_DEFAULT_DEF.id)
    return owner .. "_neutral_" .. tmClassOutfitToken(triggerId, classId) .. ".webp"
end

function tmUiAssetClassId(assetName)
    return tostring(assetName or "")
        :gsub("%.[A-Za-z0-9]+$", "")
        :gsub("[^%w_-]", "-")
end

function tmUiAssetHtml(assetName, extraClass, label)
    local classId = tmUiAssetClassId(assetName)
    local classes = "tm-ui-asset tm-ui-asset-" .. classId
    if extraClass and extraClass ~= "" then classes = classes .. " " .. extraClass end
    return '<span class="' .. classes .. '" role="img" aria-label="' .. tmEscapeHtml(label or classId) .. '"></span>'
end

-- candidate-5 hex radar. Static grid rings/spokes + fixed-position labels are
-- hardcoded; the data polygon and vertex dots are computed from the 6 live stats.
-- Geometry: viewBox 0..320, center (160,160), r = clamp(score,0,20)/20*120,
-- vertex = (160 + r*cos, 160 + r*sin), axes clockwise from top:
-- STR(-90) DEX(-30) CON(30) INT(90) WIS(150) CHA(210). 0.8660254 = cos(30).
TM_S5_RADAR_AXES = {
    {key = "str", cos = 0,          sin = -1,  left = "50%", top = "6%"},
    {key = "dex", cos = 0.8660254,  sin = -0.5, left = "90%", top = "28%"},
    {key = "con", cos = 0.8660254,  sin = 0.5,  left = "90%", top = "72%"},
    {key = "int", cos = 0,          sin = 1,   left = "50%", top = "94%"},
    {key = "wis", cos = -0.8660254, sin = 0.5,  left = "10%", top = "72%"},
    {key = "cha", cos = -0.8660254, sin = -0.5, left = "10%", top = "28%"},
}

function tmS5Round2(n)
    return math.floor(n * 100 + 0.5) / 100
end

function tmS5ApOptimisticGroup(triggerId, ownerId)
    return "tm-s5-ap-opt-" .. tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId) .. "-" .. tmDrawerSafeDomKeyPart(ownerId)
end

function tmS5ApOptimisticInputId(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    return tmS5ApOptimisticGroup(triggerId, ownerId) .. "-" .. tmDrawerSafeDomKeyPart(statKey)
end

function tmS5ApOptimisticRadios(triggerId, ownerId, ap)
    if tonumber(ap or 0) <= 0 then return "" end
    local group = tmS5ApOptimisticGroup(triggerId, ownerId)
    local inputs = {}
    for _, statKey in ipairs(TM_PLAYER_STAT_KEYS) do
        inputs[#inputs + 1] = '<input type="radio" class="tm-s5-ap-opt-state tm-s5-ap-opt-'
            .. tmEscapeHtml(statKey) .. '" name="' .. tmEscapeHtml(group) .. '" id="'
            .. tmEscapeHtml(tmS5ApOptimisticInputId(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)) .. '">'
    end
    return table.concat(inputs, "")
end

function tmS5ApOptimisticGrowButton(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    local inputId = tmS5ApOptimisticInputId(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    local label = '<label class="tm-s5-grow-label" for="' .. tmEscapeHtml(inputId) .. '" aria-label="'
        .. tmEscapeHtml((TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[statKey] or statKey) .. ' +1') .. '">+</label>'
    return tmFnButton(label, "tmSpendAp_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. statKey)
end

function tmRenderStatRadar(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
    local points = {}
    local dots = {}
    local tiles = {}
    local vlabels = {}
    local ap = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", 0)
    local apOptimistic = ap > 0 and (ap - 1) or 0
    local optimisticRadios = tmS5ApOptimisticRadios(triggerId, ownerId, ap)
    for _, axis in ipairs(TM_S5_RADAR_AXES) do
        local effectiveValue, value, statBonus = tmEffectivePlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, axis.key, 10)
        local score = effectiveValue
        if score < 0 then score = 0 end
        if score > 20 then score = 20 end
        local r = score / 20 * 120
        local x = tmS5Round2(160 + r * axis.cos)
        local y = tmS5Round2(160 + r * axis.sin)
        points[#points + 1] = tostring(x) .. "," .. tostring(y)
        dots[#dots + 1] = '<circle cx="' .. tostring(x) .. '" cy="' .. tostring(y) .. '" r="3.2"/>'
        vlabels[#vlabels + 1] = '<span class="tm-s5-vlabel" style="left:' .. axis.left .. ';top:' .. axis.top .. '">'
            .. '<span class="tm-s5-vabbr">' .. (TM_STAT_LABELS[axis.key] or axis.key) .. '</span>'
            .. '</span>'
        local statClass = ' tm-s5-stat-' .. axis.key
        tiles[#tiles + 1] = '<div class="tm-s5-stat' .. statClass .. '">'
            .. '<span class="tm-s5-abbr">' .. (TM_STAT_LABELS[axis.key] or axis.key) .. '</span>'
            .. '<span class="tm-s5-num tm-s5-num-current">' .. tostring(value)
            .. ' <span class="tm-s5-bonus">(' .. tmSigned(statBonus) .. ')</span></span>'
            .. '<span class="tm-s5-num tm-s5-num-optimistic">' .. tostring(value + 1)
            .. ' <span class="tm-s5-bonus">(' .. tmSigned(statBonus) .. ')</span></span>'
            .. (ap > 0 and ('<span class="tm-s5-grow">' .. tmS5ApOptimisticGrowButton(triggerId, ownerId, axis.key) .. '</span>') or '')
            .. '<span class="tm-s5-ko">' .. (TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[axis.key] or axis.key) .. '</span>'
            .. '</div>'
    end
    local pointsStr = table.concat(points, " ")
    return '<section class="tm-s5-graph">'
        .. optimisticRadios
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-graph-head"><h2 class="tm-s5-graph-h2">능력치 '
        .. '<span class="tm-guide-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="보너스 설명">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip">괄호 안 +N은 장비/버프/상태에서 얻는 능력치 보너스예요. 기본 능력치와 합쳐 유효 능력치를 만들고, d20 판정의 능력 보정은 유효 능력치에서 계산됩니다.</span></span>'
        .. '</h2>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-ap"><span class="tm-s5-ap-current">남은 포인트 ' .. tostring(ap) .. '</span><span class="tm-s5-ap-optimistic">남은 포인트 ' .. tostring(apOptimistic) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-hint">기본 능력치 (보너스)</span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-radar">'

        .. '<polygon points="160,130 185.98,145 185.98,175 160,190 134.02,175 134.02,145"/>'
