function tmRenderCharacterSheet(triggerId, ownerId, opts)
    local deferBagSlots = type(opts) == "table" and opts.deferBagSlots == true
    local includePartyBag = not (type(opts) == "table" and opts.includePartyBag == false)
    tmEnsureSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local name = CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId
    local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, ownerId)
    local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1)
    local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp", tmMaxHpFor(triggerId, classId, 10))
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp_max", tmMaxHpFor(triggerId, classId, 10))
    local mp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, 10, 10))
    local mpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", tmMaxMpFor(triggerId, classId, 10, 10))
    local status = tmPcStatusLabel(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_status", "active"))
    local title = tmOwnerConceptTitle(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
    local equipment = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", "")
    local skills = tmOwnerSkillLoadout(triggerId, ownerId)
    local alignment = tmEnsureAlignment(triggerId, ownerId)
    local alignmentName = tmAlignmentName(alignment)
    local alignmentCue = tmAlignmentCue(alignment)
    -- merge role: cls.role is comma-separated; mockup renders it as " · " joined
    local roleText = tmEscapeHtml(cls.role):gsub(",%s*", " · ")
    -- vital bar widths
    local hpPct = (hpMax > 0) and math.floor(hp / hpMax * 100 + 0.5) or 0
    if hpPct < 0 then hpPct = 0 elseif hpPct > 100 then hpPct = 100 end
    local mpPct = (mpMax > 0) and math.floor(mp / mpMax * 100 + 0.5) or 0
    if mpPct < 0 then mpPct = 0 elseif mpPct > 100 then mpPct = 100 end
    -- D046 EXP bar: shared helper feeds bar and level-up gate (never desync).
    local exp = tmExpProgress(triggerId, ownerId)
    local expPct = (exp.next > 0) and math.floor(exp.cur / exp.next * 100 + 0.5) or 0
    if expPct < 0 then expPct = 0 elseif expPct > 100 then expPct = 100 end
    local levelReady = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level_ready", "false") == "true"
        or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0) >= tmXpForNextLevel(level)
    local levelUpAction = levelReady
        and '<span class="tm-s5-levelup">' .. tmFnButton(T(triggerId, "레벨업", "Level Up", "レベルアップ"), "tmLevelUp_" .. ownerId) .. '</span>'
        or ''
    if not deferBagSlots then tmSheetBagResetActionSlots(triggerId) end
    local equipDisplay = tmOwnerEquipmentItemsHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    local skillDisplay = tmOwnerLoadoutHtml(triggerId, ownerId, skills, "skill")
    local sheetBagDisplay = includePartyBag and tmCharacterSheetPartyBagHtml(triggerId, ownerId) or ""
    if not deferBagSlots then tmSheetBagPersistSlotActions(triggerId) end
    local equipSlotLabel = "장비 및 아이템 " .. tostring(tmOwnerEquipmentItemSlots(triggerId, ownerId)) .. "/" .. tostring(TM_EQUIPMENT_ITEM_SLOT_CAP)
    local skillSlotLabel = "스킬 " .. tostring(csvItemCount(skills)) .. "/" .. tostring(TM_SKILL_LOADOUT_CAP)
    local conditionDisplay = tmOwnerConditionHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    local html = '<div class="tm-sheet-body">'
        -- identity band: portrait + id block
        .. '<header class="tm-s5-header tm-s5-hero">'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-portrait">'
        .. tmUiAssetHtml(tmCharacterSheetPortraitAsset(triggerId, ownerId), "tm-s5-portrait-asset", name)
        .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-id-block">'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-eyebrow">Player · ' .. tmEscapeHtml(name) .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-pcname">' .. tmEscapeHtml(pcName ~= "" and pcName or "이름 미정") .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-meta">'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-pill"><span class="tm-s5-pill-k">Lv</span>' .. tostring(level) .. '</span>' .. levelUpAction
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-sep">◆</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-pill">' .. tmEscapeHtml(cls.name) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-sep">◆</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-pill">' .. tmEscapeHtml(alignmentName) .. '</span>'
        .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-role"><span class="tm-s5-role-k">역할</span>' .. roleText .. '</div>'
        .. '<p class="tm-s5-concept">' .. tmEscapeHtml(title) .. '</p>'
        .. '<p class="tm-s5-trait"><span class="tm-s5-trait-k">성향</span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(alignmentCue) .. '</p>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-status-line"><span class="tm-s5-status-label">상태:</span><span class="tm-s5-chip">' .. tmEscapeHtml(status) .. '</span>' .. conditionDisplay .. '</div>'
        .. '</div></header>'
        -- vitals: HP/MP/EXP numeric bars (AP moved to radar header; status/conditions
        -- moved to the name header per D046/T003; EXP occupies the former status slot)
        .. '<section class="tm-s5-vitals">'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-vital"><span class="tm-s5-vlabel-txt">HP</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-value">' .. tostring(hp) .. '<span class="tm-s5-max"> / ' .. tostring(hpMax) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-bar hp"><i style="width:' .. tostring(hpPct) .. '%"></i></span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-vital"><span class="tm-s5-vlabel-txt">MP</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-value">' .. tostring(mp) .. '<span class="tm-s5-max"> / ' .. tostring(mpMax) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-bar mp"><i style="width:' .. tostring(mpPct) .. '%"></i></span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-vital"><span class="tm-s5-vlabel-txt">EXP</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-value tm-s5-exp-value">' .. tostring(exp.cur) .. '<span class="tm-s5-max"> / ' .. tostring(exp.next) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-s5-bar exp"><i style="width:' .. tostring(expPct) .. '%"></i></span></div>'
        .. '</section>'
        -- radar centerpiece
        .. tmRenderStatRadar(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
        -- loadout cards
        .. '<section class="tm-s5-loadout">'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-card"><span class="tm-s5-card-k">' .. equipSlotLabel .. '</span><span class="tm-s5-card-v">' .. equipDisplay .. '</span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-s5-card"><span class="tm-s5-card-k">' .. skillSlotLabel .. '</span><span class="tm-s5-card-v">' .. skillDisplay .. '</span></div>'
        .. sheetBagDisplay
        .. '</section>'
        .. '</div>'
    return html
end

function tmRenderSheetEditPanel(triggerId, activeTab)
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_mode", "")
    if mode == "" then return "" end
    local ownerId = tmSheetEditOwner(triggerId)
    local ownerName = CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId
    if mode == "class_select" then
        local classIds = tmClassIds(triggerId, true)
        tmSetClassSelectionSlots(triggerId, classIds)
        local rows = '<div class="tm-confirm-row">'
        for index, classId in ipairs(classIds) do
            if index <= TM_CLASS_SELECTION_SLOT_CAP then
                rows = rows .. '<span>' .. tmFnButton(tmClassNameForLang(triggerId, classId), tmClassSelectionSlotFn(index)) .. '</span>'
            end
        end
        rows = rows .. '<span>' .. tmFnButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "cancel"), "tmCancelSheetEdit") .. '</span></div>'
        -- v1.11.14: render as an overlay box over the active sheet page (H052
        -- inline-confirm technique: position fixed resolves against the always-
        -- transformed .tm-phone-track, radio-aware left picks the active page
        -- center). Out-of-flow, so the sheet/bag layout below stays unchanged.
        return '<div class="tm-sheet-class-overlay"><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(ownerName) .. ' · ' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "change_class")) .. '</b><span>'
            .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId,
                "선택한 플레이어의 직업만 바꿉니다. PC 이름, 컨셉, 성향, 능력치는 유지하고 직업 기준 장비/스킬/기본 소지품만 기계적으로 맞춥니다.",
                "Change only this player's class. PC name, concept, alignment, and ability scores stay unchanged; class-based equipment, skill, and starter items are adjusted mechanically.",
                "選択したプレイヤーのクラスだけを変更します。PC名、コンセプト、属性、能力値は維持し、クラス基準の装備・スキル・初期所持品だけを機械的に合わせます。"))
            .. '</span>' .. rows .. '</div>'
    end
    return ""
end

function tmRenderCharacterSheetPanel(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false") ~= "true" then return "" end
    return ""
end

function tmCharacterSheetOwnerIndex(ownerId)
    for index, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if id == ownerId then return index end
    end
    return 1
end

function tmRenderCharacterSheetOwnerActions(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not tmCanEditSheets(triggerId) then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-sheet-actions">'
        .. '<span>' .. tmFnButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "change_class"), "tmOpenClassSelect_" .. ownerId) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "reroll_sheet"), "tmAskRerollSheet_" .. ownerId) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "reroll_all"), "tmAskRerollAllSheets") .. '</span>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmCharacterSheetSlotOverflowWarningHtml(triggerId)
    if TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_OVERFLOW ~= true then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-sheet-bag-empty tm-sheet-bag-overflow">'
        .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId,
            "가방 버튼이 너무 많아 일부 작업을 만들지 못했습니다. 가방을 정리한 뒤 다시 열어 주세요.",
            "Too many bag buttons were generated. Clean up the bag and reopen the sheet.",
            "バッグボタンが多すぎるため、一部の操作を作成できませんでした。バッグを整理してから開き直してください。"))
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmCharacterSheetPhoneShell(triggerId, activeTab)
    local activeIndex = tmCharacterSheetOwnerIndex(activeTab)
    local radios, pages, arrows, dots = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local editOwner = ""
    if getVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_mode", "") ~= "" then
        editOwner = tmSheetEditOwner(triggerId)
    end

    tmSheetBagResetActionSlots(triggerId)
    for index, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        table.insert(radios, tmPhoneRadio("character-sheet", index, index == activeIndex))
        local prev = (index == 1) and #CHAR_IDS or (index - 1)
        local next = (index == #CHAR_IDS) and 1 or (index + 1)
        table.insert(arrows, tmPhoneArrow("character-sheet", "prev", index, prev, "이전"))
        table.insert(arrows, tmPhoneArrow("character-sheet", "next", index, next, "다음"))
        table.insert(dots, tmPhoneDot("character-sheet", index, CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId))

        local pageBody = tmRenderCharacterSheet(triggerId, ownerId, {deferBagSlots = true, includePartyBag = false})
        if editOwner == ownerId then
            pageBody = pageBody .. tmRenderSheetEditPanel(triggerId, ownerId)
        end
        pageBody = pageBody .. tmRenderCharacterSheetOwnerActions(triggerId, ownerId)
        table.insert(pages, tmPhonePage(CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId, pageBody, "tm-character-sheet-page tm-character-sheet-page-" .. ownerId))
    end

    local phoneHtml = '<div class="tm-phone-frame tm-phone-pages-4 tm-character-sheet-phone">'
        .. '<div class="tm-phone-screen"><div class="tm-phone-track">' .. table.concat(pages, "") .. '</div></div>'
        .. table.concat(arrows, "")
        .. '<div class="tm-phone-dots">' .. table.concat(dots, "") .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
    local bagHtml = '<div class="tm-character-sheet-fixed-bag">' .. tmCharacterSheetPartyBagHtml(triggerId, activeTab, {ownerLinked = true}) .. '</div>'
    local overflowHtml = tmCharacterSheetSlotOverflowWarningHtml(triggerId)
    tmSheetBagPersistSlotActions(triggerId)

    return '<div class="tm-character-sheet-shell">'
        .. table.concat(radios, "")
        .. phoneHtml
        .. bagHtml
        .. overflowHtml
        .. '<div class="tm-sheet-confirm"><span>' .. tmFnButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "ok"), "closeCharSheet") .. '</span></div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmCharacterSheetBodyHtml(triggerId)
    local activeTab = getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", tmGetActiveOwner(triggerId))
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[activeTab] then activeTab = "yuseola" end
    local html = ""
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false") == "true" then
        html = html .. '<div class="tm-sheet-empty tm-sheet-loading"><span class="tm-inline-spinner"></span><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "sheet_creating")) .. '</b><span>'
            .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "완료되면 이 패널에 바로 반영됩니다.", "When complete, this panel updates immediately.", "完了すると、このパネルにすぐ反映されます。"))
            .. '</span></div>'
    elseif not tmHasCharacterSheets(triggerId) then
        html = html .. '<div class="tm-sheet-empty"><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "아직 작성된 시트가 없습니다.", "No sheets have been created yet.", "まだ作成されたシートがありません。")) .. '</b><span>'
            .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId,
                "첫 세션을 시작하려면 네 사람이 사용할 PC 시트가 먼저 필요합니다.",
                "The first session needs PC sheets for all four players.",
                "最初のセッションには四人分のPCシートが必要です。"))
            .. '</span><div class="tm-confirm-row"><span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "create_sheet"), "tmAskCreateCharacters") .. '</span></div></div>'
    else
        html = html .. tmCharacterSheetPhoneShell(triggerId, activeTab)
    end
    return html
end

function tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false") == "true" then return true end
    return getVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "false") == "true"
        and getVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "false") == "true"
end

function tmSessionButtonLabel(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true" then return "진행" end
    if tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId) then return "시작" end
    return "준비"
end

TM_DEFAULT_EPISODE_ID = "ep_001_basement_goblins"
TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE = 3
TM_EPISODE_PICKER_CSS_PAGE_CAP = 12
TM_EPISODE_PICKER_SLOTS = TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE * TM_EPISODE_PICKER_CSS_PAGE_CAP
TM_RUNTIME_FREE_EPISODE_ID = "runtime_free_scenario"
TM_RUNTIME_RANDOM_EPISODE_ID = "runtime_random_scenario"

function tmEpisodeBandForBaseLevel(level)
    local base = math.floor(tonumber(level) or 1)
    base = clamp(base, 1, 7)
    return tostring(base) .. "-" .. tostring(base + 1)
end

function tmRecommendedEpisodeBaseLevel(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false") ~= "true"
        and getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then
        return 1
    end
    local count, sum, maxLevel = 0, 0, 0
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_level", 0)
        if level > 0 then
            count = count + 1
            sum = sum + level
            if level > maxLevel then maxLevel = level end
        end
    end
    if count == 0 then return 1 end
    local avg = math.floor(sum / count)
    local conservative = math.min(avg, math.max(1, maxLevel - 1))
    return clamp(conservative, 1, 7)
end

function tmRecommendedEpisodeBand(triggerId)
    return tmEpisodeBandForBaseLevel(tmRecommendedEpisodeBaseLevel(triggerId))
end

function tmRuntimeEpisodeRewardDefaults(triggerId)
    local base = tmRecommendedEpisodeBaseLevel(triggerId)
    local xpByBase = { [1] = 40, [2] = 50, [3] = 60, [4] = 75, [5] = 90, [6] = 110, [7] = 130 }
    local goldByBase = { [1] = 120, [2] = 140, [3] = 160, [4] = 190, [5] = 220, [6] = 260, [7] = 300 }
    return xpByBase[base] or 40, goldByBase[base] or 120
end

function tmRuntimeScenarioComment(value)
    local text = tostring(value or "")
    text = text:gsub("▥", " ")
    text = text:gsub("[\r\n]+", " / ")
    text = tmTrimText(text)
    if text == "" then return "none" end
    return tmTruncateUtf8(text, 260)
end

function tmTrimText(value)
    return tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(scenarioId)
    local id = tmTrimText(scenarioId)
    if id == "" then return "" end
    if id == "fantasy_first_session" then return TM_DEFAULT_EPISODE_ID end
    return id
end

function tmIsLegacyDefaultScenarioId(scenarioId)
    local id = tmTrimText(scenarioId)
    return id == "" or id == "fantasy_first_session" or id == TM_DEFAULT_EPISODE_ID
end

function tmScenarioSelectedForStart(triggerId)
    local selected = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", ""))
    if selected == "" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_explicit_selection", "false") == "true" then return true end
    return not tmIsLegacyDefaultScenarioId(selected)
end

function tmEnsureScenarioSelectedForStart(triggerId)
    if tmScenarioSelectedForStart(triggerId) then return true, "" end
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "start_blocked:missing_scenario")
    return false, "scenario_not_selected"
end

function tmResolveSelectedEpisodeForStart(triggerId)
    local selected = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", ""))
    if selected == "" or selected == "fantasy_first_session" then return "" end
    return tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(selected)
end

function tmEpisodeSection(content, key)
    local target = tostring(key or "")
    if target == "" then return "" end
    local lines = {}
    local collecting = false
    local text = tostring(content or ""):gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local trimmed = tmTrimText(line)
        if collecting then
            if trimmed:match("^===") or trimmed:match("^@@") or trimmed:match("^[A-Z0-9_]+:%s*$") then
                break
            end
            if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(lines, trimmed) end
        else
            local sameLine = trimmed:match("^" .. target .. ":%s*(.+)$")
            if sameLine then return tmTrimText(sameLine) end
            if trimmed == target .. ":" then collecting = true end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, key, fallback)
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    local baseKey = tostring(key or "")
    if baseKey == "" then return "" end
    local localizedKey = ""
    if lang == "ko" then
        localizedKey = baseKey .. "_KO"
    elseif lang == "ja" then
        localizedKey = baseKey .. "_JA"
    end
    if localizedKey ~= "" then
        local display = tmEpisodeSection(content, "DISPLAY_" .. localizedKey)
        if display ~= "" then return display end
        local localized = tmEpisodeSection(content, localizedKey)
        if localized ~= "" then return localized end
    end
    local base = tmEpisodeSection(content, baseKey)
    if base ~= "" then return base end
    return fallback or ""
end

function tmFirstEpisodeLine(value)
    local text = tostring(value or ""):gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local trimmed = tmTrimText(line)
        if trimmed ~= "" then return trimmed end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmEpisodeSummaryFromContent(content)
    return tmFirstEpisodeLine(tmEpisodeSection(content, "SUMMARY"))
end

function tmEpisodeOpeningFromContent(content)
    return tmFirstEpisodeLine(tmEpisodeSection(content, "OPENING"))
end

function tmEpisodeDisplaySummaryFromContent(triggerId, content)
    return tmFirstEpisodeLine(tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "SUMMARY", "한국어 시나리오 요약이 아직 준비되지 않았습니다."))
end

function tmEpisodeDisplayOpeningFromContent(triggerId, content)
    return tmFirstEpisodeLine(tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "OPENING", "선택된 에피소드의 첫 장면을 짧게 제시한다."))
end

function tmEpisodePromptSection(label, value, maxChars)
    local text = tostring(value or ""):gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    text = tmTrimText(text)
    if text == "" then return "" end
    if maxChars and tonumber(maxChars) and #text > tonumber(maxChars) then
        text = tmTruncateUtf8(text, tonumber(maxChars))
    end
    return tostring(label or "SECTION") .. ":\n" .. text
end

function tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, key)
    -- Runtime prompts use canonical parser-safe episode source. UI localization is
    -- selected only at display boundaries so prompt excerpts never carry duplicate
    -- language copies of the same scenario field.
    return tmEpisodeSection(content, key)
end

function tmEpisodeRuntimePromptExcerpt(triggerId, content, mode)
    local text = tostring(content or "")
    if text == "" then return "" end
    local panelMode = tostring(mode or "") == "panel"
    local sheet = parseSheet(text)
    local lines = {}
    local function add(label, value, maxChars)
        local section = tmEpisodePromptSection(label, value, maxChars)
        if section ~= "" then table.insert(lines, section) end
    end
    add("ID", sheet.ID or "", 80)
    add("TITLE", sheet.TITLE or "", 160)
    add("RECOMMENDED_LEVEL", sheet.RECOMMENDED_LEVEL or "", 60)
    add("LENGTH", sheet.LENGTH or "", 60)
    add("TONE", sheet.TONE or "", 160)
    add("GENRE_TAGS", sheet.GENRE_TAGS or "", 180)
    add("SETTING_TAGS", sheet.SETTING_TAGS or "", 180)
    add("COMMENTS", tmEpisodeSection(text, "COMMENTS"), panelMode and 280 or nil)
    add("SUMMARY", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "SUMMARY"), panelMode and 360 or nil)
    add("OPENING", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "OPENING"), panelMode and 420 or nil)
    add("SCENES", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "SCENES"), panelMode and 900 or nil)
    add("CHECK_NOTES", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "CHECK_NOTES"), panelMode and 420 or nil)
    add("ROLL_HINTS", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "ROLL_HINTS"), panelMode and 520 or nil)
    add("ENEMY_FILTER", tmEpisodeSection(text, "ENEMY_FILTER"), panelMode and 240 or nil)
    add("THREATS", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "THREATS"), panelMode and 520 or nil)
    add("GIMMICKS", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "GIMMICKS"), panelMode and 420 or nil)
    add("REWARDS", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "REWARDS"), panelMode and 520 or nil)
    add("NEXT_HINT", tmEpisodeRuntimeDisplaySection(triggerId, text, "NEXT_HINT"), panelMode and 280 or nil)
    add("LLM_DIRECTIVE", tmEpisodeSection(text, "LLM_DIRECTIVE"), panelMode and 700 or nil)
    return table.concat(lines, "\n\n")
end

function tmEpisodeGuideCue(label, value, maxChars)
    local text = tmFirstEpisodeLine(value)
    if text == "" then return "" end
    return label .. ": " .. tmTruncateUtf8(text, maxChars or 150)
end

function tmGuideTextHasPlayerReference(text)
    return countKeywords(text, {
        "김민희", "정한나", "신소율", "유설아",
        "민희", "한나", "소율", "설아",
        "kimminhee", "junghanna", "sinsoyul", "yuseola",
        "PLAYER_SPOTLIGHT", "Focus:"
    }) > 0
end

function tmSanitizeGuideText(raw)
    local text = tmStripControlMarkers(tostring(raw or ""))
    text = text:gsub("▥.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("{{.-}}", "")
    text = text:gsub("<.->", "")
    text = text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    local lines = {}
    for line in (text .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local trimmed = tmTrimText(line)
        if trimmed ~= "" and not tmGuideTextHasPlayerReference(trimmed) then
            table.insert(lines, tmTruncateUtf8(trimmed, 180))
            if #lines >= 4 then break end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmEpisodeGuideFromContent(triggerIdOrContent, maybeContent)
    local triggerId = nil
    local content = triggerIdOrContent
    if maybeContent ~= nil then
        triggerId = triggerIdOrContent
        content = maybeContent
    end
    -- "현재 상황/현재 장면"이 OPENING(장면)을 이미 보여주므로, GM 가이드는 장면을 다시
    -- 서술하지 않는다(중복 제거). OPENING이 비어 현재 상황이 SUMMARY로 떨어지는 경우엔
    -- 목표(SUMMARY)도 현재 상황과 같아지므로 목표 줄도 넣지 않는다.
    local guide = {}
    local opening = triggerId and tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "OPENING", "") or tmEpisodeSection(content, "OPENING")
    local hasOpening = tmTrimText(opening) ~= ""
    if hasOpening then
        local summaryText = triggerId and tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "SUMMARY", "") or tmEpisodeSection(content, "SUMMARY")
        local summary = tmEpisodeGuideCue("목표", summaryText, 150)
        if summary ~= "" then table.insert(guide, summary) end
    end
    table.insert(guide, "진행: 눈에 보이는 단서와 첫 장애물을 짧게 설명하고, 플레이어들이 무엇을 먼저 확인할지 듣는다.")
    local clean = tmSanitizeGuideText(table.concat(guide, "\n"))
    if clean == "" then return "진행: 선택된 에피소드의 첫 장면을 짧게 제시하고, 플레이어들이 무엇을 확인할지 듣는다." end
    return clean
end

function tmInternalGuideLine(line)
    local text = tmTrimText(line)
    if text == "" then return false end
    if text:find("[Master's Guide]", 1, true) or text:find("[Master’s Guide]", 1, true)
        or text:find("[GM Guide]", 1, true) or text:find("[GM 가이드]", 1, true)
        or text:find("[GM 가이드:", 1, true) or text:find("[GM Guide:", 1, true)
        or text:find("[Master's Guide:", 1, true) or text:find("[Master’s Guide:", 1, true) then
        return true
    end
    return text:find("분위기:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("조사 포인트:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("마력 오염:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("함정/장애물:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("판정 유도:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("진행 가이드:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("장면 가이드:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("내부 가이드:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("판정 가이드:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("환경 요소:", 1, true) == 1
        or text:find("상인의 상태:", 1, true) == 1
end

function tmStripInternalGuideBlocks(text)
    local src = tostring(text or "")
    if src == "" then return "" end
    local out = {}
    local skipping = false
    for line in (src .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local trimmed = tmTrimText(line)
        local markerLine = line:find("▥", 1, true) or line:find("<<", 1, true)
        if skipping then
            if markerLine then
                skipping = false
                table.insert(out, line)
            elseif trimmed == "" then
                skipping = false
            end
        elseif tmInternalGuideLine(line) then
            skipping = true
        else
            table.insert(out, line)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

function tmFallbackEpisodeEntry()
    return {
        id = TM_DEFAULT_EPISODE_ID,
        title = "시나리오 데이터 없음",
        summary = "선택된 TM_EPISODE 데이터를 찾지 못했다. 시나리오를 다시 선택하거나 런타임 시나리오를 생성해야 한다.",
        level = "",
        length = "",
        tone = "",
    }
end

function tmEpisodeFieldLower(sheet, key)
    return tmTrimText(sheet[key] or ""):lower()
end

function tmEpisodeSectionPresent(content, key)
    return tmEpisodeSection(content, key) ~= ""
end

function tmEpisodePickerEligible(sheet, content)
    local visible = tmEpisodeFieldLower(sheet, "PICKER_VISIBLE")
    if visible == "false" or visible == "no" or visible == "0" then return false end
    local kind = tmEpisodeFieldLower(sheet, "EPISODE_KIND")
    if kind ~= "" and kind ~= "trpg_adventure" then return false end
    return tmEpisodeSectionPresent(content, "SUMMARY")
        and tmEpisodeSectionPresent(content, "OPENING")
        and tmEpisodeSectionPresent(content, "SCENES")
        and tmEpisodeSectionPresent(content, "ROLL_HINTS")
        and tmEpisodeSectionPresent(content, "GIMMICKS")
        and tmEpisodeSectionPresent(content, "REWARDS")
end

function tmFetchEpisodeList(triggerId)
    local cacheKey = tostring(triggerId or "") .. "\31" .. tmLang(triggerId) .. "\31" .. tmRuntimeCacheStamp(triggerId)
    local cached = TM_EPISODE_LIST_CACHE[cacheKey]
    if cached then return cached end
    local episodes = {}
    if type(getLoreBooks) == "function" then
        local ok, books = pcall(getLoreBooks, triggerId, "EPISODE")
        if ok and type(books) == "table" then
            for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
                if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.content) == "string"
                    and entry.content:find("=== TM_EPISODE ===", 1, true) then
                    local sheet = parseSheet(entry.content)
                    local id = tmTrimText(sheet.ID or entry.name or "")
                    if id ~= "" and id ~= "episode_seed_bank_20" and tmEpisodePickerEligible(sheet, entry.content) then
                        table.insert(episodes, {
                            id = id,
                            title = tmTrimText(sheet.TITLE or id),
                            summary = tmEpisodeDisplaySummaryFromContent(triggerId, entry.content),
                            level = tmTrimText(sheet.RECOMMENDED_LEVEL or ""),
                            length = tmTrimText(sheet.LENGTH or ""),
                            tone = tmTrimText(sheet.TONE or ""),
                            unlock = tmTrimText(sheet.UNLOCK or ""),
                            kind = tmTrimText(sheet.EPISODE_KIND or ""),
                            content = entry.content,
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #episodes == 0 then table.insert(episodes, tmFallbackEpisodeEntry()) end
    table.sort(episodes, function(a, b) return tostring(a.id or "") < tostring(b.id or "") end)
    TM_EPISODE_LIST_CACHE = {[cacheKey] = episodes}
    return episodes
end

function tmEpisodePickerPageCount(episodes)
    local count = 0
    if type(episodes) == "table" then count = #episodes end
    local pages = math.ceil(count / TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE)
    if pages < 1 then pages = 1 end
    return pages
end

function tmEpisodePickerPage(triggerId, episodes)
    local pages = tmEpisodePickerPageCount(episodes)
    local page = math.floor(getNumVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_picker_page", 1))
    if page < 1 then page = 1 end
    if page > pages then page = pages end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_picker_page", tostring(page))
    return page, pages
end

function tmStoreEpisodeChoiceSlots(triggerId, episodes, page, storeAll)
    local startIndex = storeAll and 0 or (((page or 1) - 1) * TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE)
    for i = 1, TM_EPISODE_PICKER_SLOTS do
        local entry = episodes[startIndex + i]
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_episode_choice_" .. tostring(i), entry and entry.id or "")
    end
end

function tmEpisodePickerMeta(entry)
    local parts = {}
    if entry.level and entry.level ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "LV " .. entry.level) end
    if entry.length and entry.length ~= "" then table.insert(parts, entry.length) end
    return table.concat(parts, " · ")
end

function tmScenarioTitle(triggerIdOrScenarioId, maybeScenarioId)
    local triggerId = nil
    local scenarioId = triggerIdOrScenarioId
    if maybeScenarioId ~= nil then
        triggerId = triggerIdOrScenarioId
        scenarioId = maybeScenarioId
    end
    local titles = {
        fantasy_first_session = "푸른 등불의 색인",
        clubroom_daily = "동아리 대화",
        [TM_DEFAULT_EPISODE_ID] = "푸른 등불의 색인",
    }
    if scenarioId == nil or scenarioId == "" then return "미선택" end
    if triggerId ~= nil then
        local episodeId = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(scenarioId)
        if type(tmEpisodeTitle) == "function" then
            local episodeTitle = tmEpisodeTitle(triggerId, episodeId)
            if episodeTitle ~= "" and episodeTitle ~= episodeId then return episodeTitle end
        end
    end
    return titles[scenarioId] or scenarioId or "미선택"
end

function tmScenarioTooltipText(triggerId, scenarioId)
    if tmTrimText(scenarioId) == "" then return "" end
    local episodeId = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(scenarioId)
    local content = ""
    if type(tmFetchEpisodeContent) == "function" then
        content = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId)
    end
    local summary = tmEpisodeDisplaySummaryFromContent(triggerId, content)
    local opening = tmEpisodeDisplayOpeningFromContent(triggerId, content)
    local parts = {}
    if summary ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "목표: " .. summary) end
    if opening ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "도입: " .. opening) end
    return table.concat(parts, "\n")
end

function tmGameClock(triggerId)
    local day = getVar(triggerId, "game_day", "첫 모임")
    local time = getVar(triggerId, "game_time", "오후")
    return day .. " · " .. time
end

function tmSheetStatusLabel(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false") == "true" then
        return T(triggerId, "작성 중", "Creating", "作成中")
    end
    if tmHasCharacterSheets(triggerId) then
        return T(triggerId, "작성 완료", "Ready", "作成済み")
    end
    return T(triggerId, "미작성", "Not Created", "未作成")
end

-- D046 geometric level curve. tmExpForLevelStep is the per-level XP step
-- (L1=50, L2=100, L3=200, ...); tmExpCumulativeStart is the total XP needed to
-- have REACHED a level (start-of-level absolute, L1=0, L2=50, L3=150, ...).
-- One shared pair feeds BOTH the EXP bar (tmExpProgress) and the level-up gate
-- (tmXpForNextLevel) so they can never desync.
function tmExpForLevelStep(level)
    local lv = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(level) or 1))
    -- math.floor keeps the result an integer subtype so tostring renders "50",
    -- not "50.0" (2^n is a float in Lua 5.3+).
    return math.floor(50 * (2 ^ (lv - 1)))
end

function tmExpCumulativeStart(level)
    local lv = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(level) or 1))
    local total = 0
    for l = 1, lv - 1 do
        total = total + tmExpForLevelStep(l)
    end
    return total
end

-- tmExpProgress: into-level form for the EXP bar.
-- xp is cumulative party_xp (never decremented); base is the start-of-level
-- absolute, step is this level's span. cur is clamped into [0, step].
function tmExpProgress(triggerId, ownerId)
    local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1)
    local xp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0)
    local base = tmExpCumulativeStart(level)
    local step = tmExpForLevelStep(level)
    local cur = xp - base
    if cur < 0 then cur = 0 elseif cur > step then cur = step end
    return { level = level, cur = cur, next = step }
end

-- Level-up GATE (single source of truth). Returns the cumulative-absolute
-- party_xp threshold to advance OUT of `level` = start-of-(level+1).
-- L1->2 at >=50, L2->3 at >=150, L3->4 at >=350, ...
function tmXpForNextLevel(level)
    return tmExpCumulativeStart((math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(level) or 1))) + 1)
end

function tmRefreshLevelReady(triggerId)
    local xp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_level", 1)
        local ready = xp >= tmXpForNextLevel(level)
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_level_ready", ready and "true" or "false")
    end
end

function tmLevelUpOwner(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    tmEnsureSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1)
    local xp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0)
    local need = tmXpForNextLevel(level)
    if xp < need then
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "아직 레벨업에 필요한 XP가 부족합니다.", "Not enough XP to level up yet.", "まだレベルアップに必要なXPが足りません。"))
        return false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", level + 1)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", 0) + 1)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level_ready", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_last_levelup", "Lv " .. tostring(level + 1))
    tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStatsPreserveCurrent(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " 레벨업: Lv " .. tostring(level + 1) .. ", AP +1")
    tmRefreshLevelReady(triggerId)
    return true
end

function tmAutoLevelUpReadyParty(triggerId)
    local applied = 0
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local guard = 0
        while CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId]
            and getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0) >= tmXpForNextLevel(getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1))
            and guard < 20 do
            guard = guard + 1
            if tmLevelUpOwner(triggerId, ownerId) then
                applied = applied + 1
            else
                break
            end
        end
    end
    tmRefreshLevelReady(triggerId)
    return applied
end

function tmSpendApOnStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey, reason)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    statKey = normalizeStatKey(statKey or "dex")
    local ap = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", 0)
    if ap <= 0 then
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "사용할 AP가 없습니다.", "No AP is available.", "使用できるAPがありません。"))
        return false
    end
    local cur = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. statKey, 10)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. statKey, cur + 1)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", ap - 1)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap_spent", getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap_spent", 0) + 1)
    tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStatsPreserveCurrent(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " 성장: " .. (TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[statKey] or statKey) .. " +1" .. (reason and reason ~= "" and " (" .. reason .. ")" or ""))
    return true
end

function tmRecommendedGrowthStat(triggerId, ownerId)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    return cls.order and cls.order[1] or "dex"
end

function tmSessionBriefValue(triggerId, key, fallback)
    local value = getVar(triggerId, key, "")
    if value == "" or value == "none" then return fallback end
    return value
end
