function tmIntentPromptText(text)
    local clean = tmTrimText(tostring(text or ""))
    clean = clean:gsub("[\r\n|<>]", " ")
    clean = clean:gsub("▥", " ")
    clean = clean:gsub("%s+", " ")
    return tmTruncateUtf8(clean, 120)
end

function tmCsvOrNone(raw)
    local text = tmTrimText(tostring(raw or ""))
    if text == "" then return "none" end
    return text
end

function tmCurrentMainIntentBlock(triggerId)
    local present = tmCsvSet(getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_present_ids", ""))
    local rows = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local value = "missing"
        if present[id] then
            value = tmIntentPromptText(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", ""))
            if value == "" or value == "none" then value = "none" end
        end
        table.insert(rows, "- " .. tmGuidePcLabel(triggerId, id) .. ": " .. value)
    end
    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

function tmCurrentMainIntentActionOwners(triggerId)
    local present = tmCsvSet(getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_present_ids", ""))
    local owners = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if present[id] then
            local value = tmIntentPromptText(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", ""))
            if value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then table.insert(owners, id) end
        end
    end
    if #owners == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(owners, ",")
end

function tmStoredIntentMemoryBlock(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local value = tmIntentPromptText(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", ""))
        local state = (value ~= "" and value ~= "none") and "stored" or "empty"
        table.insert(rows, "- " .. tmGuidePcLabel(triggerId, id) .. ": " .. state)
    end
    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

function tmStoredIntentOwners(triggerId)
    local owners = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local value = tmIntentPromptText(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", ""))
        if value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then table.insert(owners, id) end
    end
    if #owners == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(owners, ",")
end

function tmIntentSourceDiagnostics(triggerId)
    return table.concat({
        "current_main_owners=" .. tmCsvOrNone(getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_present_ids", "")),
        "current_main_action_owners=" .. tmCurrentMainIntentActionOwners(triggerId),
        "cleared_by_main=" .. tmCsvOrNone(getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_cleared_ids", "")),
        "stored_intent_owners=" .. tmStoredIntentOwners(triggerId),
    }, "\n")
end

function tmSetMainEnemyMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, state, enemyId, enemyName, source)
    local cleanState = tostring(state or "missing")
    if cleanState ~= "set" and cleanState ~= "none" and cleanState ~= "missing" then
        cleanState = "missing"
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_state", cleanState)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_id", tostring(enemyId or ""))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_name", tostring(enemyName or ""))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_source", tostring(source or "main_output"))
end

function tmCaptureMainEnemyMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    local raw = tostring(output or "")
    local state = "missing"
    local enemyId = ""
    local enemyName = ""
    local rawName = raw:match("▥ENEMY_NAME:(.-)▥") or raw:match("<<ENEMY_NAME:([^>]+)>>")
    if rawName then
        enemyName = tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, 24)
    end
    local setId = raw:match("▥ENEMY:set:([%w_%-]+)▥") or raw:match("<<ENEMY:set:([%w_%-]+)>>")
    if setId and setId ~= "" then
        state = "set"
        enemyId = setId
    elseif raw:find("▥ENEMY:none▥", 1, true) or raw:find("<<ENEMY:none>>", 1, true) then
        state = "none"
    end
    tmSetMainEnemyMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, state, enemyId, enemyName, "main_output")
    return state, enemyId, enemyName
end

function tmCurrentMainEnemyMarkerBlock(triggerId)
    local state = getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_state", "missing")
    if state == "" then state = "missing" end
    local current = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    return table.concat({
        "marker_state=" .. state,
        "marker_id=" .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_id", "") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_id", "") or "none"),
        "marker_name=" .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_name", "") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_name", "") or "none"),
        "current_enemy=" .. (current ~= "" and current or "none"),
    }, "\n")
end

function tmEnemyAuditDiagnostics(triggerId)
    return table.concat({
        "main_marker_state=" .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_state", "missing") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_state", "missing") or "missing"),
        "audit_state=" .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_state", "") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_state", "") or "none"),
        "audit_applied=" .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_applied", "") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_applied", "") or "none"),
        "audit_mismatch=" .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_mismatch", "") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_mismatch", "") or "none"),
    }, "\n")
end

function tmEnemyAuditCleanOutput(output)
    local cleaned = tostring(output or "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("▥ENEMY_AUDIT:.-▥", "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("<<ENEMY_AUDIT:[^>]+>>", "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("%[%[ENEMY_AUDIT:.-%]%]", "")
    cleaned = cleaned:gsub("%{%{ENEMY_AUDIT:.-%}%}", "")
    return cleaned
end

function tmEnemyAuditFirstPayload(output)
    local raw = tmExtractPanelMarkers(output, "ENEMY_AUDIT")
    for line in tostring(raw or ""):gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        local clean = tmTrimText(line)
        if clean ~= "" then return clean end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmEnemyAuditSplit(raw)
    local parts = {}
    for part in (tostring(raw or "") .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        table.insert(parts, tmPanelCueCleanField(part, 120))
    end
    while #parts < 3 do table.insert(parts, "") end
    return parts
end

function tmNormalizeEnemyAuditId(triggerId, rawId)
    local id = tmPanelCueCleanField(rawId, 48)
    local lowered = id:lower()
    if lowered == "" or lowered == "none" or lowered == "empty" or lowered == "-" then return "" end
    if lowered == "current" or lowered == "enemy:current" then
        return getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    end
    if id:match("^[%w_%-]+$") then return id end
    return ""
end

function tmParseEnemyAuditPayload(triggerId, payload)
    local parts = tmEnemyAuditSplit(payload)
    local state = tostring(parts[1] or ""):lower()
    local idOrReason = parts[2] or ""
    local name = tmLootSanitizeText(parts[3] or "", 24)
    if state == "present" then
        local enemyId = tmNormalizeEnemyAuditId(triggerId, idOrReason)
        if enemyId == "" then
            return {state = "unknown", id = "", name = "", reason = "present_without_valid_id"}
        end
        return {state = "present", id = enemyId, name = name, reason = ""}
    elseif state == "none" then
        return {state = "none", id = "", name = "", reason = ""}
    elseif state == "unknown" then
        return {state = "unknown", id = "", name = "", reason = idOrReason ~= "" and idOrReason or "unknown"}
    end
    return {state = "unknown", id = "", name = "", reason = "bad_status:" .. tostring(parts[1] or "")}
end

function tmAuxThreatAuditFromRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_THREAT" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source)
            if parsed.reason == "ok" then
                local status = parsed.status
                if status == "present" then
                    local enemyId = tmNormalizeEnemyAuditId(triggerId, parsed.fields[3] or "")
                    if enemyId == "" then
                        return {state = "unknown", id = "", name = "", reason = "aux_threat_present_without_valid_id"}
                    end
                    return {
                        state = "present",
                        id = enemyId,
                        name = tmLootSanitizeText(parsed.fields[4] or "", 24),
                        reason = "",
                    }
                elseif status == "none" then
                    return {state = "none", id = "", name = "", reason = ""}
                elseif status == "unknown" then
                    local reason = tmPanelCueCleanField(parsed.fields[5] or "", 120)
                    return {state = "unknown", id = "", name = "", reason = reason ~= "" and reason or "aux_threat_unknown"}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return {state = "missing", id = "", name = "", reason = "missing"}
end

function tmEnemyAuditAuxThreatMismatch(audit, auxAudit)
    if not audit or not auxAudit then return "" end
    if auxAudit.state == "" or auxAudit.state == "missing" then return "" end
    if audit.state == "" or audit.state == "missing" then return "" end
    if audit.state ~= auxAudit.state then
        return "enemy_audit_" .. tostring(audit.state) .. "_aux_threat_" .. tostring(auxAudit.state)
    end
    if audit.state == "present" and audit.id ~= "" and auxAudit.id ~= "" and audit.id ~= auxAudit.id then
        return "enemy_audit_aux_threat_different"
    end
    return ""
end

function tmJoinEnemyAuditMismatches(first, second)
    local a = tostring(first or "")
    local b = tostring(second or "")
    if a == "" then return b end
    if b == "" then return a end
    return a .. ";" .. b
end

function tmEnemyAuditMismatch(mainState, mainId, audit)
    local auditState = audit and audit.state or "missing"
    if auditState == "missing" then return "aux_missing" end
    if mainState == "set" then
        if auditState == "none" then return "main_set_aux_none" end
        if auditState == "present" and audit.id ~= "" and mainId ~= "" and audit.id ~= mainId then
            return "main_set_aux_different"
        end
    elseif mainState == "none" then
        if auditState == "present" then return "main_none_aux_present" end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmStoreEnemyAuditDiagnostic(triggerId, audit, source, applied, mismatch)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_state", audit and audit.state or "missing")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_id", audit and audit.id or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_name", audit and audit.name or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_reason", audit and audit.reason or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_source", tostring(source or "panel"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_applied", tostring(applied or "false"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_audit_last_mismatch", tostring(mismatch or ""))
end

function tmApplyEnemyAuditPresent(triggerId, audit, source, applied, mismatch, markSource, eventPrefix, logSuffix)
    local before = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    tmMarkTerminalEnemyAutoclearProcessed(triggerId, markSource or "enemy_audit_marker")
    loadEnemy(triggerId, audit.id)
    if audit.name ~= "" and not tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(audit.name) then
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. audit.id .. "_name", audit.name)
    end
    pcall(tmStoreRuntimeEnemyObject, triggerId, audit.id)
    if audit.name ~= "" and not tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(audit.name) then
        tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "enemy", 3, audit.name)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", audit.id)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", tostring(eventPrefix or "enemy_audit") .. ":" .. audit.id)
    tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "threat")
    if before ~= audit.id then
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "위협 등장: " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, audit.id) .. " / " .. tostring(logSuffix or "audit"))
    end
    tmStoreEnemyAuditDiagnostic(triggerId, audit, source, applied or "present", mismatch)
end

function tmApplyEnemyAuditNone(triggerId, audit, source, applied, mismatch, logSuffix)
    local hadEnemy = type(tmRuntimeEnemyStateExists) == "function" and tmRuntimeEnemyStateExists(triggerId)
        or getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "") ~= ""
    tmClearRuntimeEnemies(triggerId)
    if hadEnemy then tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "현재 위협 없음 / " .. tostring(logSuffix or "audit")) end
    tmStoreEnemyAuditDiagnostic(triggerId, audit, source, applied or "none", mismatch)
end

function tmApplyEnemyAuditMarkers(triggerId, output, source, auxRows)
    local payload = tmEnemyAuditFirstPayload(output)
    local cleaned = tmEnemyAuditCleanOutput(output)
    local auxAudit = tmAuxThreatAuditFromRows(triggerId, auxRows, source)
    if payload == "" then
        local mainState = getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_state", "missing")
        local mainId = getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_id", "")
        if auxAudit.state == "present" and mainState == "missing" then
            tmApplyEnemyAuditPresent(triggerId, auxAudit, tostring(source or "panel") .. "_aux_threat", "present_aux_threat", "", "aux_threat_marker", "aux_threat", "aux threat")
        elseif auxAudit.state == "none" and mainState == "missing" then
            tmApplyEnemyAuditNone(triggerId, auxAudit, tostring(source or "panel") .. "_aux_threat", "none_aux_threat", "", "aux threat")
        elseif auxAudit.state ~= "missing" then
            tmStoreEnemyAuditDiagnostic(triggerId, auxAudit, tostring(source or "panel") .. "_aux_threat", "observe_aux_threat", tmEnemyAuditMismatch(mainState, mainId, auxAudit))
        else
            local missing = {state = "missing", id = "", name = "", reason = "missing"}
            tmStoreEnemyAuditDiagnostic(triggerId, missing, source, "missing", mainState == "missing" and "main_missing_aux_missing" or "")
        end
        return cleaned
    end
    local audit = tmParseEnemyAuditPayload(triggerId, payload)
    local mainState = getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_state", "missing")
    if mainState == "" then mainState = "missing" end
    local mainId = getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_id", "")
    local auxMismatch = tmEnemyAuditAuxThreatMismatch(audit, auxAudit)
    if mainState ~= "missing" then
        tmStoreEnemyAuditDiagnostic(triggerId, audit, source, "ignored_main_" .. mainState, tmJoinEnemyAuditMismatches(tmEnemyAuditMismatch(mainState, mainId, audit), auxMismatch))
        return cleaned
    end
    if audit.state == "present" then
        tmApplyEnemyAuditPresent(triggerId, audit, source, "present", auxMismatch, "enemy_audit_marker", "enemy_audit", "audit")
    elseif audit.state == "none" then
        tmApplyEnemyAuditNone(triggerId, audit, source, "none", auxMismatch, "audit")
    else
        tmStoreEnemyAuditDiagnostic(triggerId, audit, source, "preserved_unknown", auxMismatch)
    end
    return cleaned
end

function tmPanelGroundingGateActive(triggerId)
    if tmCurrentMainIntentActionOwners(triggerId) ~= "none" then return false end
    if tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId) == "" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    if type(tmCurrentThreatInfo) == "function" and tmCurrentThreatInfo(triggerId) then return false end
    return true
end

function tmPanelActionGroundingBlock(triggerId)
    local rows = {
        "[Panel action grounding]",
        "current_main_action_owners=" .. tmCurrentMainIntentActionOwners(triggerId),
        "stored_memory_owners=" .. tmStoredIntentOwners(triggerId),
    }
    if tmPanelGroundingGateActive(triggerId) then
        table.insert(rows, "scene_state=closure_or_choice")
        table.insert(rows, "card_policy=Return ROLL_PANEL:none, COMBAT_PANEL:none, and DEFENSE_PANEL:none until the latest visible response or Current Main block supplies a new uncertain action.")
    else
        table.insert(rows, "scene_state=active_or_grounded")
        table.insert(rows, "card_policy=Create cards from the latest visible response or Current Main block.")
    end
    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

function tmClearStoredIntentsForPanelGrounding(triggerId)
    local cleared = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local key = "p_" .. id .. "_intent"
        local value = tmIntentPromptText(getVar(triggerId, key, ""))
        if value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then
            setVar(triggerId, key, "")
            table.insert(cleared, id)
        end
    end
    if #cleared > 0 then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_missing_ids", table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_aux_last_cleared_ids", table.concat(cleared, ","))
    end
end

function tmGroundPanelCardCues(triggerId, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    if not tmPanelGroundingGateActive(triggerId) then return rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue end
    if #tmPanelCueRows(rollCue) == 0 and #tmPanelCueRows(combatCue) == 0 and #tmPanelCueRows(defenseCue) == 0 then
        return rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue
    end
    return "none", "none", "none"
end

function tmPanelIntentActionOwnerSet(triggerId)
    return tmCsvSet(getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_action_owners", ""))
end

function tmPanelIntentSnapshotPresent(triggerId)
    return tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_last_present_ids", "")) ~= ""
end

function tmPanelRollCueOwner(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 7)
    if #parts == 0 then return "" end
    local entry = tmFindTurnDiceEntry(triggerId, parts[1], parts[2])
    return entry and entry.owner or tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[2])
end

function tmPanelCombatCueOwner(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 10)
    if #parts == 0 then return "" end
    local entry = tmFindTurnDiceEntry(triggerId, parts[1], parts[2])
    return entry and entry.owner or tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[2])
end

function tmPanelDefenseCueOwner(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 12)
    if #parts == 0 then return "" end
    local entry = tmFindTurnDiceEntry(triggerId, parts[1], parts[2])
    return entry and entry.owner or tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[2])
end

function tmFilterPanelRowsBySnapshot(triggerId, rows, ownerFn, skipped)
    local allowed = tmPanelIntentActionOwnerSet(triggerId)
    local filtered = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        local owner = ownerFn(triggerId, row)
        if owner ~= "" and allowed[owner] then
            table.insert(filtered, row)
        elseif owner ~= "" then
            skipped[owner] = true
        end
    end
    return filtered
end

function tmFilterPanelCuesByPanelIntent(triggerId, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    if not tmPanelIntentSnapshotPresent(triggerId) then return "none", "none", "none" end
    local skipped = {}
    local rollRows = tmFilterPanelRowsBySnapshot(triggerId, tmPanelCueRows(rollCue), tmPanelRollCueOwner, skipped)
    local combatRows = tmFilterPanelRowsBySnapshot(triggerId, tmPanelCueRows(combatCue), tmPanelCombatCueOwner, skipped)
    local defenseRows = tmFilterPanelRowsBySnapshot(triggerId, tmPanelCueRows(defenseCue), tmPanelDefenseCueOwner, skipped)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_card_skipped_ids", tmIntentIdList(skipped))
    local rollOut = #rollRows > 0 and table.concat(rollRows, "\n") or "none"
    local combatOut = #combatRows > 0 and table.concat(combatRows, "\n") or "none"
    local defenseOut = #defenseRows > 0 and table.concat(defenseRows, "\n") or "none"
    return rollOut, combatOut, defenseOut
end

function tmCurrentEpisodeContent(triggerId)
    local episodeId = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    if episodeId == "" then episodeId = getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", "") end
    episodeId = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(episodeId)
    if episodeId == "" then return "", "" end
    if type(tmFetchEpisodeContent) ~= "function" then return episodeId, "" end
    return episodeId, tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId)
end

function tmRollResultSummary(triggerId)
    local meta = getVar(triggerId, "last_roll_meta", "")
    if meta == "" then return "" end
    local rows = {}
    for item in tostring(meta or ""):gmatch("▥ROLL actor=[^\n]+") do
        local actor = item:match('actor_label="([^"]+)"') or ""
        local tier = item:match('tier_label="([^"]+)"') or ""
        local reason = item:match('reason="([^"]+)"') or ""
        if actor ~= "" or tier ~= "" then
            local row = actor
            if tier ~= "" then row = row .. " " .. tier end
            if reason ~= "" then row = row .. " - " .. tmTruncateUtf8(reason, 44) end
            table.insert(rows, row)
        end
        if #rows >= 4 then break end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then return "" end
    return "최근 결과: " .. table.concat(rows, " / ")
end

function tmResolvedTurnResultText(triggerId)
    local inputSummary = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", ""))
    if inputSummary ~= "" then return inputSummary end
    local rollSummary = tmTrimText(tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    if rollSummary ~= "" then return rollSummary end
    return ""
end

function tmCurrentActionTextBlock(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local value = tmIntentPromptText(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", ""))
        if value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then
            table.insert(rows, "- " .. tmGuidePcLabel(triggerId, id) .. ": " .. value)
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then return "- none" end
    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

function tmAuthoritativeCurrentTurnResultBlock(triggerId)
    local result = tmResolvedTurnResultText(triggerId)
    local lines = {
        "[Authoritative current turn result]",
        "resolved_result=" .. (result ~= "" and result or "none"),
        "current_actions:",
        tmCurrentActionTextBlock(triggerId),
    }
    if result ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "state_priority=This resolved_result is the current post-adjudication state; latest Main prose is scene context, not a newer pending request.")
        table.insert(lines, "output_contract=BRIEF and GUIDE_LEAD describe what happens after the resolved success, partial success, failure, or cost.")
    else
        table.insert(lines, "state_priority=No current resolved result is recorded; use latest Main prose and current actions normally.")
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmEnsureSessionPanelFresh(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then return end
end

function tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId)
    local episode = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", ""))
    if episode == "" then episode = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", "")) end
    if episode == "" then return "" end
    return tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(episode)
end

function tmClearScenarioWrapupState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_episode", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_last_user", "")
end

function tmSetScenarioWrapupSuggested(triggerId, source)
    local episode = tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId)
    if episode == "" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_episode", episode)
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") ~= "true" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false")
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "wrapup_suggested:" .. episode .. ":" .. tostring(source or "marker"))
    tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "wrapup")
    return true
end

function tmRecordScenarioWrapupDeclaration(triggerId, input)
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    local text = tmTrimText(input)
    if text == "" then return false end
    local strong = countKeywords(text, {
        "마무리하자", "마무리해", "마무리한다", "마무리할게", "끝내자", "끝내",
        "끝낼게", "종료하자", "종료해", "종료한다", "클리어하자", "클리어 처리",
        "클리어해", "wrap up", "wrap it up", "finish this", "clear this"
    })
    local scoped = countKeywords(text, {
        "시나리오", "에피소드", "세션", "모험", "퀘스트",
        "scenario", "episode", "session", "adventure", "quest"
    }) > 0 and countKeywords(text, {
        "마무리", "종료", "클리어", "완료", "끝내", "끝낼", "끝맺",
        "finish", "end", "clear", "complete", "wrap"
    }) > 0
    local suggested = getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "false") == "true"
    if strong == 0 and not scoped then return false end
    if not suggested and not scoped and strong == 0 then return false end
    local episode = tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId)
    if episode == "" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_episode", episode)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_last_user", tmTailText(tmSanitizeChatSnippet(text), 180))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "wrapup_confirmed:" .. episode)
    tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "wrapup")
    return true
end

function tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") == "true" then
        return "마무리 선언이 들어왔다. 이제 현재 장면을 정리하고 에피소드를 닫는 흐름이다."
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "false") == "true" then
        return "목표와 보상이 충분히 드러나 장면을 마무리해도 자연스러운 흐름이다."
    end
    return ""
end

TM_PACE_SCHEMA = "v1"

function tmPaceEpisode(triggerId)
    local episode = tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId)
    if episode == "" then episode = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", "")) end
    return episode
end

function tmPaceSplit(raw)
    local parts = {}
    for seg in (tostring(raw or "") .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        table.insert(parts, seg)
    end
    return parts
end

function tmPaceDefaultState(triggerId, episode)
    return {
        ep = tmTrimText(episode or "") ~= "" and tmTrimText(episode) or tmPaceEpisode(triggerId),
        t = 0, e = 0, g = 0, r = 0, w = 0,
        c = "", s = "", p = 0,
    }
end

function tmPaceEncode(state)
    state = state or {}
    return table.concat({
        TM_PACE_SCHEMA,
        tostring(state.ep or ""):gsub("[|]", "_"),
        tostring(math.max(0, tonumber(state.t) or 0)),
        tostring(math.max(0, tonumber(state.e) or 0)),
        tostring(math.max(0, tonumber(state.g) or 0)),
        tostring(math.max(0, tonumber(state.r) or 0)),
        tostring(math.max(0, tonumber(state.w) or 0)),
        tostring(state.c or ""):gsub("[|]", "_"),
        tostring(state.s or ""):gsub("[|]", "_"),
        tostring(math.max(0, tonumber(state.p) or 0)),
    }, "|")
end

function tmPaceDecode(triggerId)
    local episode = tmPaceEpisode(triggerId)
    local raw = getVar(triggerId, "tm_pace_state", "")
    if raw == "" then return tmPaceDefaultState(triggerId, episode), true end
    local parts = tmPaceSplit(raw)
    if parts[1] ~= TM_PACE_SCHEMA or parts[2] == "" or parts[2] ~= episode then
        return tmPaceDefaultState(triggerId, episode), true
    end
    return {
        ep = parts[2],
        t = tonumber(parts[3]) or 0,
        e = tonumber(parts[4]) or 0,
        g = tonumber(parts[5]) or 0,
        r = tonumber(parts[6]) or 0,
        w = tonumber(parts[7]) or 0,
        c = parts[8] or "",
        s = parts[9] or "",
        p = tonumber(parts[10]) or 0,
    }, false
end

function tmPaceSave(triggerId, state)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_pace_state", tmPaceEncode(state))
end

function tmPaceResetState(triggerId, reason, episode)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_pace_state", "")
end

function tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, kind)
    local state = tmPaceDecode(triggerId)
    local turn = math.max(tonumber(state.t) or 0, 1)
    if kind == "threat" then
        state.e = turn
    elseif kind == "gimmick" then
        state.g = turn
    elseif kind == "reward" then
        state.r = turn
    elseif kind == "wrapup" then
        state.w = turn
    end
    state.c, state.s, state.p = "", "", 0
    tmPaceSave(triggerId, state)
end

function tmPaceChanceForDistance(distance)
    local d = tonumber(distance) or 0
    if d >= 8 then return "strong", 70 end
    if d >= 5 then return "normal", 45 end
    if d >= 3 then return "soft", 25 end
    return "", 0
end

function tmPaceSelectCue(triggerId, state)
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then return nil end
    local progress = getVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "none")
    if progress == "cleared" or progress == "failed" then return nil end
    local turn = tonumber(state.t) or 0
    if turn < 3 then return nil end

    local candidates = {}
    local function add(kind, distance, bias)
        local strength, chance = tmPaceChanceForDistance(distance)
        if chance > 0 then
            table.insert(candidates, {
                kind = kind,
                strength = strength,
                chance = math.min(70, chance),
                score = chance + (tonumber(bias) or 0),
            })
        end
    end

    add("threat", turn - (tonumber(state.e) or 0), 0)
    add("gimmick", turn - (tonumber(state.g) or 0), 3)
    if turn >= 6 then add("reward", turn - (tonumber(state.r) or 0), -4) end
    if turn >= 12 and getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "false") ~= "true" then
        local strength, chance = tmPaceChanceForDistance(turn - math.max(tonumber(state.w) or 0, tonumber(state.r) or 0))
        if chance > 0 then
            table.insert(candidates, {
                kind = "wrapup",
                strength = strength,
                chance = math.min(70, chance),
                score = chance - 8,
            })
        end
    end
    if #candidates == 0 then return nil end

    table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
        if a.score == b.score then return a.kind < b.kind end
        return a.score > b.score
    end)
    local cue = candidates[1]
    if math.random(100) > cue.chance then return nil end
    return cue
end

function tmPaceTouchForPrompt(triggerId)
    local state = tmPaceDecode(triggerId)
    state.t = math.max(tonumber(state.t) or 0, 0) + 1
    state.c, state.s, state.p = "", "", 0
    local cue = tmPaceSelectCue(triggerId, state)
    if cue then
        state.c, state.s, state.p = cue.kind, cue.strength, cue.chance
    end
    tmPaceSave(triggerId, state)
    return cue
end

function tmPaceCurrentCue(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "false") == "true"
        and getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") ~= "true" then
        return {kind = "wrapup", strength = "strong", chance = 70, active = true}
    end
    local state = tmPaceDecode(triggerId)
    if state.c == "" then return nil end
    return {kind = state.c, strength = state.s, chance = tonumber(state.p) or 0, active = false}
end

function tmPaceCueSentence(cue, target)
    if not cue or not cue.kind or cue.kind == "" then return "" end
    if cue.kind == "threat" then
        return target == "panel"
            and "Recommended lead may point the GM toward a natural threat, hostile sign, environmental pressure, or suspicious movement."
            or "Let the next beat naturally surface a threat, hostile sign, environmental pressure, or suspicious movement when the scene supports it."
    elseif cue.kind == "gimmick" then
        return target == "panel"
            and "Recommended lead may point the GM toward a trap, obstacle, clue mechanism, object interaction, or visible complication."
            or "Let the next beat naturally surface a trap, obstacle, clue mechanism, object interaction, or visible complication when the scene supports it."
    elseif cue.kind == "reward" then
        return target == "panel"
            and "Recommended lead may point the GM toward a payoff, useful clue, item, skillbook, gold, shortcut, or earned reward."
            or "Let the next beat naturally surface a payoff, useful clue, item, skillbook, gold, shortcut, or earned reward when the scene supports it."
    elseif cue.kind == "wrapup" then
        return target == "panel"
            and "Recommended lead should clearly suggest a natural closing beat; the user GM decides when to end the scenario."
            or "If the objective, reward, or consequence feels sufficiently developed, write a visible natural closing beat for the table."
    end
    return ""
end

function tmPacePromptBlock(triggerId, target, touch)
    local cue = touch and tmPaceTouchForPrompt(triggerId) or tmPaceCurrentCue(triggerId)
    if not cue then return "" end
    local sentence = tmPaceCueSentence(cue, target)
    if sentence == "" then return "" end
    local lines = {
        "[Pacing cue]",
        "- cue=" .. tostring(cue.kind) .. ", strength=" .. tostring(cue.strength or "soft"),
        "- " .. sentence,
    }
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- D063/P066: number-free "현재 상태" cue for the session panel.
-- KO has priority (church revive). Otherwise a living PC at/below 30% HP
-- surfaces an inn-rest hint. Returns "" when nothing needs attention.
-- Never contains gold or HP figures.
function tmSessionStateCue(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active") == "ko" then
            return tmJosaIga(triggerId, tmActorLabel(triggerId, id)) .. " 쓰러졌다. 교회에 가면 다시 일으킬 수 있을 것이다."
        end
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active") ~= "ko" then
            local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 0)
            local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 0)
            if hpMax > 0 and hp > 0 and (hp / hpMax) <= 0.30 then
                return "체력이 많이 떨어졌다. 여관에서 쉬어 가는 것도 방법이다."
            end
        end
    end
    local wrapupCue = tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId)
    if wrapupCue ~= "" then return wrapupCue end
    return ""
end

function tmPanelStateEventText(triggerId, event)
    local text = tostring(event or "")
    if text == "" then return "" end
    local enemyId = text:match("^enemy_defeated:([%w_%-]+)")
    if enemyId then
        local name = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_name", enemyId)
        return "Lua state marks the current threat as defeated or resolved: " .. tostring(name)
    end
    if text == "enemy:none" then
        return "Lua state has cleared the current threat."
    end
    enemyId = text:match("^enemy:([%w_%-]+)")
    if enemyId then
        local name = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_name", enemyId)
        return "Lua state records an active threat: " .. tostring(name)
    end
    local owner = text:match("^revive:([%w_]+)")
    if owner then
        return tmActorLabel(triggerId, owner) .. " has been revived through a confirmed service result."
    end
    owner = text:match("^hp:([%w_]+):")
    if owner then
        return tmActorLabel(triggerId, owner) .. " has a stored HP change from the resolved result."
    end
    owner = text:match("^mp:([%w_]+):")
    if owner then
        return tmActorLabel(triggerId, owner) .. " has a stored MP change from the resolved result."
    end
    if text:match("^shop_buy:") then
        return "Lua state records a confirmed shop purchase."
    end
    if text:match("^shop_sell:") then
        return "Lua state records a confirmed shop sale."
    end
    if text:match("^skillbook") or text:match("^loot_skill") then
        return "Lua state records a skill or skillbook reward."
    end
    if text:match("^loot_item") or text:match("^reward_item") then
        return "Lua state records an item reward."
    end
    if text:match("^clear:") then
        return "Lua state records scenario progress as cleared."
    end
    if text:match("^fail:") then
        return "Lua state records scenario progress as failed."
    end
    if text:match("^wrapup_") then
        return "Lua state records a scenario wrap-up cue."
    end
    return "Lua state has a recent resolved event for continuity."
end

function tmPanelStateSanityBlock(triggerId)
    local lines = {}
    local cue = tmTrimText(tmSessionStateCue(triggerId))
    if cue ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "- table cue: " .. cue)
    end
    local threatInfo = nil
    if type(tmCurrentThreatInfo) == "function" then
        threatInfo = tmCurrentThreatInfo(triggerId)
    end
    if threatInfo then
        local state = tostring(threatInfo.state or "active")
        local name = tostring(threatInfo.name or threatInfo.id or "current threat")
        if state == "defeated" or (tonumber(threatInfo.hp) or 1) <= 0 then
            table.insert(lines, "- current threat state: " .. name .. " is resolved or defeated.")
        else
            table.insert(lines, "- current threat state: " .. name .. " is active.")
        end
    else
        table.insert(lines, "- current threat state: none recorded in Lua state.")
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local status = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active")
        if status == "ko" then
            table.insert(lines, "- player status: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, id) .. " is KO and can be revived through a church/healer service when confirmed.")
        else
            local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 0)
            local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 0)
            if hpMax > 0 and hp > 0 and (hp / hpMax) <= 0.30 then
                table.insert(lines, "- player status: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, id) .. " is in low-health danger and rest or healing is relevant.")
            end
        end
    end
    local rollSummary = ""
    if type(tmRollResultSummary) == "function" then
        rollSummary = tmTrimText(tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    end
    if rollSummary ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "- latest resolved roll/combat: " .. tmTailText(rollSummary, 220))
    end
    local eventText = tmPanelStateEventText(triggerId, getVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", ""))
    if eventText ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "- last resolved event: " .. eventText)
    end
    if #lines == 0 then
        return "- Lua state has no special resolved cue."
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmVitalPercent(current, maximum)
    local maxValue = tonumber(maximum) or 0
    if maxValue <= 0 then return 0 end
    return clamp(math.floor(((tonumber(current) or 0) / maxValue) * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100)
end

function tmCompactActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId)
    local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, ownerId)
    if pcName ~= "" and pcName ~= "미정" and pcName ~= "pending" then return pcName end
    return CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or tostring(ownerId or "")
end

function tmEpisodeNodeLabel(triggerId)
    local node = getVar(triggerId, "episode_node", "")
    if node == "" or node == "none" then return "" end
    if node == "opening_request" then return T(triggerId, "도입", "Opening", "導入") end
    return tostring(node):gsub("_", " ")
end

function tmScenarioSummaryText(triggerId)
    local episode = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    if episode == "" then
        episode = getVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", ""))
    end
    episode = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(episode)
    if episode == "" then return "시나리오 미선택" end
    local title = tmScenarioTitle(triggerId, episode)
    local nodeLabel = tmEpisodeNodeLabel(triggerId)
    if nodeLabel ~= "" then return title .. " / " .. nodeLabel end
    return title
end

function tmPartyStatusSummary(triggerId)
    local koParts = {}
    local lowHpParts = {}
    local conditionParts = {}
    local lowMpParts = {}
    local levelParts = {}
    local apParts = {}
    local hpPercentTotal = 0
    local hpPercentCount = 0
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local label = tmCompactActorLabel(triggerId, id)
        local status = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active")
        local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 0)
        local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 0)
        if status == "ko" or (hpMax > 0 and hp <= 0) then
            table.insert(koParts, label .. " KO")
        else
            if hpMax > 0 then
                hpPercentTotal = hpPercentTotal + tmVitalPercent(hp, hpMax)
                hpPercentCount = hpPercentCount + 1
            end
            if hpMax > 0 and hp > 0 and (hp / hpMax) <= 0.30 then
                table.insert(lowHpParts, label .. " " .. T(triggerId, "HP 낮음", "low HP", "HP低下"))
            end
            local mpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_mp_max", 0)
            local mp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_mp", 0)
            if mpMax > 0 and mp <= math.max(1, math.floor(mpMax * 0.25)) then
                table.insert(lowMpParts, label .. " " .. T(triggerId, "MP 부족", "low MP", "MP不足"))
            end
        end
        for _, cond in ipairs(tmOwnerConditionList(triggerId, id)) do
            local def = tmConditionDef(cond.id)
            if def and def.label then
                table.insert(conditionParts, label .. " " .. def.label .. "(" .. tostring(cond.ticks) .. ")")
            end
        end
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_level_ready", "false") == "true" then
            table.insert(levelParts, label .. " " .. T(triggerId, "레벨업 가능", "level-up ready", "レベルアップ可"))
        end
        local ap = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_ap", 0)
        if ap > 0 then
            table.insert(apParts, label .. " AP " .. tostring(ap))
        end
    end
    local parts = {}
    local ordered = {koParts, lowHpParts, conditionParts, lowMpParts, levelParts, apParts}
    for _, group in ipairs(ordered) do
        for _, part in ipairs(group) do table.insert(parts, part) end
    end
    if tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId) ~= "" then
        table.insert(parts, T(triggerId, "마무리 가능", "wrap-up ready", "締め可能"))
    end
    if #parts == 0 then
        local avgHp = hpPercentCount > 0 and math.floor((hpPercentTotal / hpPercentCount) + 0.5) or 100
        return T(triggerId, "파티 양호 · 평균 HP ", "Party stable · avg HP ", "パーティ良好・平均HP ") .. tostring(avgHp) .. "%"
    end
    local visible = {}
    local limit = math.min(#parts, 4)
    for i = 1, limit do table.insert(visible, parts[i]) end
    if #parts > limit then
        table.insert(visible, T(triggerId, "외", "plus", "ほか") .. " " .. tostring(#parts - limit))
    end
    return table.concat(visible, " · ")
end

function tmSessionSummaryItemHtml(label, value, className, valueIsHtml)
    return '<div class="tm-session-summary-item ' .. className .. '"><b class="tm-session-summary-label">'
        .. tmEscapeHtml(label)
        .. '</b><span class="tm-session-summary-value">'
        .. (valueIsHtml and tostring(value or "") or tmEscapeHtml(value))
        .. '</span></div>'
end

function tmSessionSummaryRowHtml(triggerId)
    local threatHtml = tmCurrentThreatInlineHtml(triggerId)
    if threatHtml == "" then
        threatHtml = tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "기록된 위협 없음", "No recorded threat", "記録された脅威なし"))
    end
    return '<div class="tm-session-summary-row">'
        .. tmSessionSummaryItemHtml(T(triggerId, "시나리오", "Scenario", "シナリオ"), tmScenarioSummaryText(triggerId), "tm-session-summary-scenario")
        .. tmSessionSummaryItemHtml(T(triggerId, "위협", "Threat", "脅威"), threatHtml, "tm-session-summary-threat", true)
        .. tmSessionSummaryItemHtml(T(triggerId, "상태", "Status", "状態"), tmPartyStatusSummary(triggerId), "tm-session-summary-status")
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmCurrentThreatInfo(triggerId)
    if type(tmMaybeAutoclearEnemyForTerminalEpisode) == "function"
        and tmMaybeAutoclearEnemyForTerminalEpisode(triggerId, "threat_info") then
        return nil
    end
    local enemyId = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    if enemyId == "" and type(tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy) == "function" then
        enemyId = tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
    end
    if enemyId == "" then return nil end
    if type(tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated) == "function" and tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, enemyId) then
        enemyId = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
        if enemyId == "" and type(tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy) == "function" then
            enemyId = tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
        end
        if enemyId == "" then return nil end
    end
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp_max", 0)
    if hpMax <= 0 then return nil end
    local hp = clamp(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", 0), 0, hpMax)
    local defeated = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true"
    if defeated or hp <= 0 then
        if type(tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated) == "function" then
            tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, enemyId)
        end
        enemyId = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
        if enemyId == "" and type(tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy) == "function" then
            enemyId = tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
        end
        if enemyId == "" then return nil end
        hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp_max", 0)
        if hpMax <= 0 then return nil end
        hp = clamp(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", 0), 0, hpMax)
        defeated = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true"
        if defeated or hp <= 0 then return nil end
    end
    local state = defeated and T(triggerId, "처치됨", "defeated", "撃破") or T(triggerId, "활동 중", "active", "活動中")
    local special = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_special", "")
    local detail = {
        "HP " .. tostring(hp) .. "/" .. tostring(hpMax),
        "DC " .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_dc", 0)),
        "ATK " .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_atk", 0)),
        T(triggerId, "상태", "State", "状態") .. " " .. state,
    }
    if special ~= "" then
        table.insert(detail, T(triggerId, "특수", "Special", "特殊") .. " " .. special)
    end
    return {
        id = enemyId,
        name = tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId),
        hp = hp,
        hpMax = hpMax,
        state = state,
        detail = table.concat(detail, "\n"),
    }
end

function tmCurrentThreatInlineHtml(triggerId)
    local threat = tmCurrentThreatInfo(triggerId)
    if not threat then return "" end
    return '<span class="tm-threat-line"><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(threat.name) .. '</b> '
        .. '<span class="tm-guide-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="threat detail">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip">'
        .. tmEscapeHtml(threat.detail)
        .. '</span></span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-threat-hp">HP ' .. tostring(threat.hp) .. '/' .. tostring(threat.hpMax) .. '</span>'
end

function tmPanelCueCleanField(value, limit)
    local text = tmTrimText(tmCleanUtf8Text(value))
    if text == "" then return "" end
    text = text:gsub("[\r\n|<>]", " ")
    text = text:gsub("▥", " ")
    text = text:gsub("%s+", " ")
    text = tmCleanUtf8Text(text)
    if limit and limit > 0 then text = tmTruncateUtf8(text, limit) end
    return text
end

function tmPanelCueSplit(raw, expected)
    local text = tmTrimText(raw)
    local lowered = text:lower()
    local first = tmTrimText((lowered:match("^([^|]*)") or lowered))
    if text == "" or lowered == "none" or lowered == "empty" or text == "-"
        or first == "none" or first == "empty" or first == "-" then
        return {}
    end
    local parts = {}
    for part in (text .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        table.insert(parts, tmPanelCueCleanField(part, 120))
    end
    while #parts < expected do table.insert(parts, "") end
    return parts
end

function tmPanelCueRows(raw)
    local text = tostring(raw or "")
    local rows = {}
    for line in text:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        local clean = tmTrimText(line)
        if clean ~= "" then
            table.insert(rows, clean)
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 and tmTrimText(text) ~= "" then
        table.insert(rows, tmTrimText(text))
    end
    return rows
end

function tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, raw)
    local owner = tmPanelCueCleanField(raw, 32)
    if type(tmResolveRollActorId) == "function" then owner = tmResolveRollActorId(triggerId, owner) end
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[owner] then return owner end
    return ""
end

function tmPanelCueStat(raw)
    if type(tmValidRollStatKey) == "function" then
        return tmValidRollStatKey(raw) or ""
    end
    return ""
end

function tmPanelCueMode(raw)
    local mode = tmPanelCueCleanField(raw, 24):lower()
    if mode == "" then return "attack" end
    local allowed = {
        quick = true, strike = true, attack = true, spell = true, heavy = true, guard = true,
        evade = true, dodge = true, escape = true, social = true, talk = true,
        distract = true, maneuver = true, observe = true,
    }
    if allowed[mode] then return mode end
    return "attack"
end

TM_COMBAT_NON_DAMAGE_MODES = {
    guard = true, evade = true, dodge = true, escape = true, social = true, talk = true,
    distract = true, maneuver = true, observe = true,

function tmTextHasAnyPlain(text, terms)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    local lower = raw:lower()
    for _, term in ipairs(terms or {}) do
        local t = tostring(term or "")
        if t ~= "" and (raw:find(t, 1, true) or lower:find(t:lower(), 1, true)) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmClassifyPanelCombatAction(mode, stat, reason)
    local modeKey = tostring(mode or ""):lower()
    local statKey = tostring(stat or ""):lower()
    local text = tostring(reason or "")
    local offensive = tmTextHasAnyPlain(text, TM_COMBAT_OFFENSIVE_TERMS)
    if TM_COMBAT_NON_DAMAGE_MODES[modeKey] and not offensive then
        return {kind = "non_damage", damage = false, reason = "mode:" .. modeKey}
    end
    if tmTextHasAnyPlain(text, TM_COMBAT_NON_DAMAGE_TERMS) and not offensive then
        return {kind = "non_damage", damage = false, reason = "term"}
    end
    if statKey == "cha" and not offensive then
        return {kind = "non_damage", damage = false, reason = "stat:cha"}
    end
    return {kind = "damage", damage = true, reason = offensive and "offensive" or "default"}
end

function tmCombatPanelShouldDamage(mode, stat, reason)
    return tmClassifyPanelCombatAction(mode, stat, reason).damage == true
end

function tmPanelStoreEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId, rawName)
    local enemyId = tmTrimText(targetId)
    if enemyId == "" then return false end
    local name = tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, 48)
    if name == "" or tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(name) then return false end
    if not tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, name) then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_name", name)
    tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "enemy", 3, name)
    return true
end

function tmPanelTargetDisplayNameCandidate(triggerId, rawTarget)
    local target = tmLootSanitizeText(rawTarget, 48)
    if target == "" or target == "enemy:current" or target == "current" then return "" end
    local kind, id = target:match("^([%w_]+):(.*)$")
    if kind == "enemy" then target = tmLootSanitizeText(id, 48) end
    if target == "" or target == "current" then return "" end
    if tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(target) then return "" end
    if target:match("^[%w_%-]+$") then return "" end
    if not tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, target) then return "" end
    return target
end

function tmEnsurePanelCombatEnemy(triggerId, target, displayName)
    local targetId = type(tmCombatTargetId) == "function" and tmCombatTargetId(triggerId, target) or ""
    if targetId ~= "" then return targetId end
    local rawTarget = tmTrimText(tostring(target or ""))
    local displayCandidate = tmPanelTargetDisplayNameCandidate(triggerId, displayName)
    if rawTarget == "enemy:current" or rawTarget == "current" then
        return ""
    end
    if rawTarget ~= "" and rawTarget ~= "enemy:current"
        and tmPanelTargetDisplayNameCandidate(triggerId, rawTarget) == ""
        and displayCandidate == "" then
        return ""
    end
    local band = type(tmRecommendedEpisodeBand) == "function" and tmRecommendedEpisodeBand(triggerId) or 1
    targetId = "en_l" .. tostring(clamp(tonumber(band) or 1, 1, 5)) .. "_standard_lesser_folk"
    loadEnemy(triggerId, targetId)
    pcall(tmStoreRuntimeEnemyObject, triggerId, targetId)
    tmPanelStoreEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId, displayCandidate ~= "" and displayCandidate or tmPanelTargetDisplayNameCandidate(triggerId, rawTarget))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy:" .. targetId)
    return targetId
end

function tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return "invalid_actor" end
    local status = tostring(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_status", "active") or ""):lower()
    local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp", 1)
    if status == "dead" then return "dead" end
    if status == "ko" then return "ko" end
    if status == "downed" then return "downed" end
    if status == "unconscious" then return "unconscious" end
    if status == "incapacitated" then return "incapacitated" end
    if hp <= 0 then return "hp_zero" end
    return ""
end

function tmCanOwnerRoll(triggerId, ownerId)
    return tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, ownerId) == ""
end

function tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, ownerId, reason, source)
    local why = tostring(reason or "")
    if why == "" then why = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, ownerId) end
    if why == "" then why = "blocked" end
    local detail = table.concat({
        "why=actor_ineligible_" .. why,
        "actor=" .. tostring(ownerId or ""),
        "source=" .. tostring(source or ""),
    }, "|")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_roll_blocked_reason", detail)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_roll_marker_error", detail)
    print("[TRPGMaster] blocked normal roll: " .. detail)
    return detail
end

function tmReadTurnDiceBlockedOwners(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for record in tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_blocked_owners", "")):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local ownerId, reason = record:match("^([^|]+)|([^|]+)$")
        if ownerId and CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            table.insert(rows, {owner = ownerId, reason = reason or "blocked"})
        end
    end
    return rows
end

function tmBlockedRollOwnersPrompt(triggerId)
    local rows = tmReadTurnDiceBlockedOwners(triggerId)
    if #rows == 0 then return "" end
    local out = {"[Blocked roll owners]"}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        table.insert(out, string.format("- owner=%s label=%s reason=%s",
            row.owner, tmGuidePcLabel(triggerId, row.owner), row.reason))
    end
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

function tmPrepareTurnDicePool(triggerId)
    local seq = getNumVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool_seq", 0) + 1
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool_seq", seq)
    local records = {}
    local blocked = {}
    for idx, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            local blockedReason = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, ownerId)
            if blockedReason == "" then
                local diceId = "dice_" .. tostring(idx)
                local raw = math.random(1, 20)
                table.insert(records, table.concat({diceId, ownerId, tostring(raw)}, "|"))
            else
                table.insert(blocked, table.concat({ownerId, blockedReason}, "|"))
            end
        end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool", table.concat(records, ";"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_blocked_owners", table.concat(blocked, ";"))
    return records
end

function tmReadTurnDicePool(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    local raw = getVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool", "")
    for record in tostring(raw or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local diceId, ownerId, d20 = record:match("^([^|]+)|([^|]+)|([^|]+)$")
        if diceId and CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            table.insert(rows, {
                id = diceId,
                owner = ownerId,
                d20 = clamp(math.floor(tonumber(d20) or 1), 1, 20),
            })
        end
    end
    return rows
end

function tmFindTurnDiceEntry(triggerId, diceId, ownerId)
    local wantedDice = tmPanelCueCleanField(diceId, 32)
    local wantedOwner = tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, ownerId)
    local fallback = nil
    for _, entry in ipairs(tmReadTurnDicePool(triggerId)) do
        if wantedDice ~= "" and entry.id == wantedDice then return entry end
        if wantedOwner ~= "" and entry.owner == wantedOwner and fallback == nil then fallback = entry end
    end
    return fallback
end

function tmTurnDicePoolPrompt(triggerId)
    local rows = tmReadTurnDicePool(triggerId)
    local out = {}
    if #rows == 0 then
        table.insert(out, "- none")
    else
        for _, entry in ipairs(rows) do
            table.insert(out, string.format("- id=%s owner=%s label=%s d20=%d",
                entry.id, entry.owner, tmGuidePcLabel(triggerId, entry.owner), entry.d20))
        end
    end
    local blocked = tmBlockedRollOwnersPrompt(triggerId)
    if blocked ~= "" then table.insert(out, blocked) end
    return table.concat(out, "\n")
end

function tmPanelNaturalActionPhrase(action)

    if text == "" then return "" end
    local compact = text:gsub("%s+", "")

        or lower:find("roll_panel", 1, true) or lower:find("combat_panel", 1, true) then
        return ""
    end
    if text:find(" ", 1, true) then return "" end
    local fixed = {
        ["조사"] = "주변 단서를 조사한다",
        ["관찰"] = "주변 상황을 관찰한다",
        ["확인"] = "수상한 지점을 확인한다",
        ["판별"] = "단서의 진위를 판별한다",
        ["해독"] = "문자의 의미를 해독해본다",
        ["추적"] = "흔적을 따라 추적한다",
        ["진입"] = "위험을 살피며 진입한다",
        ["이동"] = "위험 지대를 지나 이동한다",
        ["회피"] = "위험을 피해 이동한다",
        ["공격"] = "적을 향해 공격한다",
        ["기습"] = "빈틈을 노려 기습한다",
        ["방어"] = "공격을 막아 방어한다",
        ["설득"] = "상대를 설득해본다",
        ["함정탐색"] = "함정을 탐색한다",
        ["룬문자해독"] = "룬 문자를 해독해본다",
        ["기습공격"] = "기습 공격을 시도한다",
        ["압판피하며진입"] = "압박판을 피해 방 안으로 진입한다",
        ["진짜색인판별"] = "진짜 색인의 표식을 판별한다",
        ["흔적조사"] = "바닥의 흔적을 조사한다",
        ["괴물의흔적추적"] = "괴물의 흔적을 추적한다",
        ["앞서서경계태세유지"] = "앞서서 경계 태세를 유지한다",
        ["기괴한마의흔적감지"] = "기괴한 마력의 흔적을 감지한다",
        ["부자연스러운움직임포착"] = "부자연스러운 움직임을 포착한다",
        ["주변의부자연스러운움직임포착"] = "주변의 부자연스러운 움직임을 포착한다",
    }
    return fixed[compact] or text
end

function tmPanelFallbackAction(triggerId, ownerId, rawAction)
    local action = tmPanelCueCleanField(rawAction, 80)
    if action ~= "" then return tmPanelNaturalActionPhrase(action) end
    action = tmRollIntentText(triggerId, ownerId)
    if action ~= "" then return tmPanelNaturalActionPhrase(action) end
    action = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "last_user_input", ""), 80)
    if action ~= "" then return tmPanelNaturalActionPhrase(action) end
    action = tmPanelCueCleanField(tmRollHintText(triggerId), 80)
    if action ~= "" then return tmPanelNaturalActionPhrase(action) end
    return T(triggerId, "장면 행동 판정", "Scene action check", "場面行動判定")
end

function tmPanelCueKey(rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    return tmPanelCueCleanField(combatCue, 600) .. "||" .. tmPanelCueCleanField(defenseCue, 600) .. "||" .. tmPanelCueCleanField(rollCue, 600)
end

function tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw)
    local text = tostring(raw or "")
    local hash = 0
    for i = 1, #text do
        hash = (hash * 131 + text:byte(i)) % 2147483647
    end
    return tostring(hash)
end

function tmPanelDicePoolFingerprint(triggerId)
    local seq = tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool_seq", "0"))
    local pool = tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool", ""))
    return seq .. ":" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(pool)
end

function tmPanelLatestVisibleFingerprint(triggerId)
    if type(tmBuildRecentChatContext) == "function" then
        local recent = tmBuildRecentChatContext(triggerId, 4)
        if tostring(recent or "") ~= "" then return tmPanelStableFingerprint(recent) end
    end
    local saved = tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_saved_recent_chat_tail", ""))
    if saved ~= "" then return tmPanelStableFingerprint(saved) end
    return tmPanelStableFingerprint(tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId))
end

function tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)
    local rawSnap = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_REFRESH_BASELINE_KEY) or "")
    local varSnap = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_REFRESH_VAR_BASELINE_KEY) or "")
    if rawSnap == "" and varSnap == "" then return "baseline:none" end
    return "baseline:" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(rawSnap .. "\n" .. varSnap)
end

function tmPanelCardIdempotencyKey(triggerId, cardType, raw, diceId, ownerId, targetId)
    local parts = {
        tostring(cardType or ""),
        tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
        tmPanelDicePoolFingerprint(triggerId),
        tmPanelLatestVisibleFingerprint(triggerId),
        tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId),
        tostring(diceId or ""),
        tostring(ownerId or ""),
        tostring(targetId or "none"),
    }
    return tmPanelCueCleanField(table.concat(parts, "#"), 240)
end

function tmPanelCardDiagnosticLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or "aux_panel"),
        tmPackEscape(row.card or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.dice_id or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.owner or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.stat or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.mode or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.action_kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.damage_eligible or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.non_damage_reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.dice_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.visible_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_id or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.card_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    if type(row) ~= "table" then return false end
    row.dice_fp = row.dice_fp or tmPanelDicePoolFingerprint(triggerId)
    row.visible_fp = row.visible_fp or tmPanelLatestVisibleFingerprint(triggerId)
    row.baseline_id = row.baseline_id or tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)
    local line = tmPanelCardDiagnosticLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_CARD_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_PANEL_CARD_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_CARD_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_CARD_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_card_last_key", tostring(row.card_key or ""))
    return true
end

function tmRejectPanelBlockedOwner(triggerId, cardType, ownerId, diceId, targetId, stat, mode, cardKey, source, actionKind, damageEligible)
    local reason = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, ownerId)
    if reason == "" then return false end
    local diagReason = "actor_ineligible_" .. reason
    tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, ownerId, reason, source or ("panel_" .. tostring(cardType or "card")))
    tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        card = tostring(cardType or ""),
        status = "rejected",
        dice_id = tmPanelCueCleanField(diceId, 32),
        owner = tostring(ownerId or ""),
        target = targetId ~= "" and tostring(targetId or "none") or "none",
        stat = tostring(stat or ""),
        mode = tostring(mode or ""),
        action_kind = tostring(actionKind or ""),
        damage_eligible = tostring(damageEligible or "false"),
        non_damage_reason = tostring(cardType or ""),
        card_key = tostring(cardKey or ""),
        reason = diagReason,
    })
    local hpmpTarget = targetId ~= "" and targetId or "none"
    if cardType == "combat" or cardType == "defense" then
        local snapshot = tmPanelHpMpOutcomeSnapshot(triggerId, ownerId, hpmpTarget)
        tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            status = "rejected",
            actor = ownerId,
            target = hpmpTarget,
            card_key = tostring(cardKey or ""),
            action_kind = tostring(actionKind or cardType or ""),
            damage_eligible = tostring(damageEligible or ""),
            before = snapshot,
            after = snapshot,
            reason = diagReason,
        })
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId,
        "행동 가능한 캐릭터만 판정할 수 있습니다.",
        "Only active characters can make normal checks.",
        "行動可能なキャラクターだけが通常判定できます。"))
    return true
end

function tmPanelHpMpSnapshotNumber(triggerId, key)
    local name = tostring(key or "")
    if name == "" then return "none" end
    if type(getNumVar) == "function" then return tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, name, 0)) end
    local raw = tostring(getVar(triggerId, name, ""))
    if raw == "" then return "0" end
    return tostring(tonumber(raw) or raw)
end

function tmPanelHpMpOutcomeSnapshot(triggerId, actorId, targetId)
    local actor = tmPanelCueCleanField(actorId, 40)
    local target = tmPanelCueCleanField(targetId, 60)
    local snap = {
        actor_hp = "none",
        actor_mp = "none",
        enemy_hp = "none",
        enemy_defeated = "none",
    }
    if actor ~= "" and type(CHAR_NAMES_KO) == "table" and CHAR_NAMES_KO[actor] ~= nil then
        snap.actor_hp = tmPanelHpMpSnapshotNumber(triggerId, "p_" .. actor .. "_hp")
        snap.actor_mp = tmPanelHpMpSnapshotNumber(triggerId, "p_" .. actor .. "_mp")
    end
    if target ~= "" and target ~= "none" then
        snap.enemy_hp = tmPanelHpMpSnapshotNumber(triggerId, "enemy_" .. target .. "_hp")
        snap.enemy_defeated = tostring(getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. target .. "_defeated", "false"))
    end
    return snap
end

function tmPanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnosticLine(row)
    local before = type(row.before) == "table" and row.before or {}
    local after = type(row.after) == "table" and row.after or before
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or "panel_combat"),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.actor or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.card_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.action_kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.damage_eligible or ""),
        tmPackEscape(before.actor_hp or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(after.actor_hp or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(before.actor_mp or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(after.actor_mp or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(before.enemy_hp or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(after.enemy_hp or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(before.enemy_defeated or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(after.enemy_defeated or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnosticOnly(triggerId, row)
    if type(row) ~= "table" then return false end
    local line = tmPanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnosticLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return true
end

function tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local stored = tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnosticOnly(triggerId, row)
    if not stored then return false end
    tmRememberHpMpDiagnosticMeta(triggerId, "panel")
    local _, compareRow, _, resolverRow = tmRefreshHpMpComparisonDiagnostic(triggerId, "panel")
    return true, compareRow, resolverRow
end

function tmHpMpMainMarkerKey(kind, ownerId, delta, reason)
    local raw = table.concat({
        tostring(kind or ""),
        tostring(ownerId or ""),
        tostring(delta or ""),
        tmPanelStableFingerprint(reason or ""),
    }, "#")
    return tmPanelCueCleanField(raw, 160)
end

function tmHpMpMainDiagnosticLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or "main_marker"),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.owner or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.delta or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.before or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.after or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.marker_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmHpMpDiagUnescape(value)
    if type(tmPackUnescape) == "function" then return tmPackUnescape(value) end
    return tostring(value or "")
end

function tmHpMpDiagSplitLine(line)
    local text = tostring(line or "")
    local fields = {}
    if text == "" then return fields end
    for field in (text .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        table.insert(fields, tmHpMpDiagUnescape(field))
    end
    return fields
end

function tmParseHpMpMainDiagnosticLine(line)
    local fields = tmHpMpDiagSplitLine(line)
    if #fields == 0 then return {present = false} end
    return {
        present = true,
        source = fields[1] or "",
        kind = tostring(fields[2] or ""):lower(),
        status = fields[3] or "",
        owner = fields[4] or "",
        marker_delta = fields[5] or "",
        before = fields[6] or "",
        after = fields[7] or "",
        marker_key = fields[8] or "",
        reason = fields[9] or "",
    }
end

function tmParseHpMpPanelDiagnosticLine(line)
    local fields = tmHpMpDiagSplitLine(line)
    if #fields == 0 then return {present = false} end
    return {
        present = true,
        source = fields[1] or "",
        status = fields[2] or "",
        actor = fields[3] or "",
        target = fields[4] or "none",
        card_key = fields[5] or "",
        action_kind = fields[6] or "",
        damage_eligible = fields[7] or "",
        actor_hp_before = fields[8] or "",
        actor_hp_after = fields[9] or "",
        actor_mp_before = fields[10] or "",
        actor_mp_after = fields[11] or "",
        enemy_hp_before = fields[12] or "",
        enemy_hp_after = fields[13] or "",
        enemy_defeated_before = fields[14] or "",
        enemy_defeated_after = fields[15] or "",
        reason = fields[16] or "",
    }
end

function tmHpMpCompareNumericDelta(beforeValue, afterValue)
    local before = tonumber(beforeValue)
    local after = tonumber(afterValue)
    if before == nil or after == nil then return "none" end
    return tostring(after - before)
end

function tmHpMpCompareDefeatedChange(beforeValue, afterValue)
    local before = tostring(beforeValue or "")
    local after = tostring(afterValue or "")
    if before == "" or after == "" or before == "none" or after == "none" then return "none" end
    if before == after then return "none" end
    return before .. ">" .. after
end

function tmHpMpCompareContextFingerprint(triggerId)
    if type(tmPanelLatestVisibleFingerprint) == "function" then
        local ok, value = pcall(tmPanelLatestVisibleFingerprint, triggerId)
        if ok and tostring(value or "") ~= "" then return tostring(value) end
    end
    return "ctx:unknown"
end

function tmHpMpCompareNextSeq(triggerId)
    local seq = tonumber(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_COMPARE_SEQ_KEY) or "0") or 0
    seq = seq + 1
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_COMPARE_SEQ_KEY, tostring(seq))
    return tostring(seq)
end

function tmRememberHpMpDiagnosticMeta(triggerId, sourceKind)
    local seq = tmHpMpCompareNextSeq(triggerId)
    local context = tmHpMpCompareContextFingerprint(triggerId)
    if tostring(sourceKind or "") == "panel" then
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_SEQ_KEY, seq)
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_CONTEXT_KEY, context)
    else
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_SEQ_KEY, seq)
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_CONTEXT_KEY, context)
    end
    return seq, context
end

        tmPackEscape(row.context_match or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_owner or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_delta or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_actor or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_target or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_actor_hp_delta or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_actor_mp_delta or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_enemy_hp_delta or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_defeated_change or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_marker_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.panel_card_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

    }, "|")
