function tmStoreHpMpResolveDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    if type(row) ~= "table" then return false end
    local line = tmHpMpResolveDiagnosticLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_RESOLVE_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_HPMP_RESOLVE_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_RESOLVE_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_RESOLVE_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return true
end

function tmHpMpResolverPanelDeltaForKind(compare)
    local kind = tostring(compare and compare.main_kind or ""):lower()
    if kind == "hp" then return tostring(compare.panel_actor_hp_delta or "") end
    if kind == "mp" then return tostring(compare.panel_actor_mp_delta or "") end
    return "none"
end

function tmHpMpNormalizeDeltaText(value)
    local n = tonumber(value)
    if n == nil then return "none" end
    return tostring(n)
end

function tmHpMpPendingMatchesComparison(pending, compare)
    if type(pending) ~= "table" or not pending.present then return false end
    if type(compare) ~= "table" or not compare.present then return false end
    if tostring(pending.status or "") ~= "deferred" then return false end
    if tostring(pending.kind or "") ~= tostring(compare.main_kind or "") then return false end
    if tostring(pending.owner or "") ~= tostring(compare.main_owner or "") then return false end
    local pendingKey = tostring(pending.marker_key or "")
    local compareKey = tostring(compare.main_marker_key or "")
    if compareKey ~= "" and pendingKey ~= "" and pendingKey ~= compareKey then return false end
    return true
end

function tmHpMpResolverEffectiveStatus(compare, pending)
    local status = tostring(compare and compare.status or "")
    local reason = tostring(compare and compare.reason or "")
    if type(compare) ~= "table" or not compare.present then return "none", "compare_missing" end
    if tostring(compare.main_status or "") ~= "deferred" then return status, reason end
    if not tmHpMpPendingMatchesComparison(pending, compare) then return status, reason end
    if status ~= "same_delta" and status ~= "conflict_delta" and status ~= "uncomparable" then return status, reason end
    local mainDelta = tmHpMpNormalizeDeltaText(pending.marker_delta)
    local panelDelta = tmHpMpNormalizeDeltaText(tmHpMpResolverPanelDeltaForKind(compare))
    if mainDelta == "none" or panelDelta == "none" then return "uncomparable", "missing_numeric_delta" end
    if mainDelta == panelDelta then return "same_delta", tostring(compare.main_kind or "") .. "_delta_match" end
    return "conflict_delta", tostring(compare.main_kind or "") .. "_delta_conflict"
end

function tmResolveHpMpSourcePriority(triggerId, compareRow)
    return false, nil
end

function tmRefreshHpMpComparisonDiagnostic(triggerId, triggerSource)
    local main = tmParseHpMpMainDiagnosticLine(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_LATEST_KEY))
    local panel = tmParseHpMpPanelDiagnosticLine(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_LATEST_KEY))
    if not main.present and not panel.present then return false, nil, false, nil end

    local mainSeq = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_SEQ_KEY) or "")
    local panelSeq = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_SEQ_KEY) or "")
    local mainContext = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_CONTEXT_KEY) or "")
    local panelContext = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_PANEL_DIAG_CONTEXT_KEY) or "")
    local mainActualDelta = main.present and tmHpMpCompareNumericDelta(main.before, main.after) or "none"
    if main.present and tostring(main.status or "") == "deferred" then
        mainActualDelta = tmHpMpNormalizeDeltaText(main.marker_delta)
    end
    local panelActorHpDelta = panel.present and tmHpMpCompareNumericDelta(panel.actor_hp_before, panel.actor_hp_after) or "none"
    local panelActorMpDelta = panel.present and tmHpMpCompareNumericDelta(panel.actor_mp_before, panel.actor_mp_after) or "none"
    local panelEnemyHpDelta = panel.present and tmHpMpCompareNumericDelta(panel.enemy_hp_before, panel.enemy_hp_after) or "none"
    local panelDefeatedChange = panel.present and tmHpMpCompareDefeatedChange(panel.enemy_defeated_before, panel.enemy_defeated_after) or "none"
    local contextMatch = "unknown"
    if main.present and panel.present and mainContext ~= "" and panelContext ~= "" then
        contextMatch = mainContext == panelContext and "true" or "false"
    end

    local status = "uncomparable"
    local reason = "uncomparable"
    if main.present and not panel.present then
        status = "main_only"
        reason = "panel_missing"
    elseif panel.present and not main.present then
        status = "panel_only"
        reason = "main_missing"
    else
        local mainSeqNum = tonumber(mainSeq) or 0
        local panelSeqNum = tonumber(panelSeq) or 0
        if panelSeqNum < mainSeqNum then
            status = "main_only"
            reason = "panel_older"
        elseif mainContext ~= "" and panelContext ~= "" and mainContext ~= panelContext then
            status = "different_context"
            reason = "context_mismatch"
        elseif tostring(main.owner or "") ~= tostring(panel.actor or "") then
            status = "different_actor"
            reason = "actor_mismatch"
        else
            local comparableDelta = "none"
            if main.kind == "hp" then
                comparableDelta = panelActorHpDelta
            elseif main.kind == "mp" then
                comparableDelta = panelActorMpDelta
            end
            if mainActualDelta == "none" or comparableDelta == "none" then
                status = "uncomparable"
                reason = "missing_numeric_delta"
            elseif mainActualDelta == comparableDelta then
                status = "same_delta"
                reason = main.kind .. "_delta_match"
            else
                status = "conflict_delta"
                reason = main.kind .. "_delta_conflict"
            end
        end
    end

    local row = {
        status = status,
        trigger_source = triggerSource or "",
        main_seq = mainSeq,
        panel_seq = panelSeq,
        context_match = contextMatch,
        main_kind = main.kind or "",
        main_status = main.status or "",
        main_owner = main.owner or "",
        main_delta = mainActualDelta,
        panel_status = panel.status or "",
        panel_actor = panel.actor or "",
        panel_target = panel.target or "none",
        panel_actor_hp_delta = panelActorHpDelta,
        panel_actor_mp_delta = panelActorMpDelta,
        panel_enemy_hp_delta = panelEnemyHpDelta,
        panel_defeated_change = panelDefeatedChange,
        main_marker_key = main.marker_key or "",
        panel_card_key = panel.card_key or "",
        reason = reason,
    }
    local stored = tmStoreHpMpComparisonDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local resolverStored, resolverRow = tmResolveHpMpSourcePriority(triggerId, row)
    return stored, row, resolverStored, resolverRow
end

function tmStoreHpMpMainDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    if type(row) ~= "table" then return false end
    local line = tmHpMpMainDiagnosticLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    tmRememberHpMpDiagnosticMeta(triggerId, "main")
    tmRefreshHpMpComparisonDiagnostic(triggerId, "main")
    return true
end

function tmStoreHpMpMainStripDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    if type(row) ~= "table" then return false end
    local line = tmHpMpMainDiagnosticLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return true
end

function tmHpMpMainAuthLegacyRollbackEnabled(triggerId)
    local raw = tmPanelCueCleanField(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_AUTH_LEGACY_ROLLBACK_KEY) or "", 16):lower()
    return raw == "true" or raw == "1" or raw == "yes" or raw == "on"
end

function tmHpMpMainAuthorityMode(triggerId)
    if tmHpMpMainAuthLegacyRollbackEnabled(triggerId) then
        return TM_HPMP_MAIN_AUTH_DEFAULT_MODE
    end
    local mode = tmPanelCueCleanField(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_AUTH_MODE_KEY) or "", 40):lower()
    if mode == "legacy_apply" then
        return TM_HPMP_MAIN_AUTH_DEFAULT_MODE
    end
    if mode == "strip_only" then return "strip_only" end
    return TM_HPMP_MAIN_AUTH_DEFAULT_MODE
end

function tmShouldStripMainHpMpMarker(triggerId)
    return tmHpMpMainAuthorityMode(triggerId) == "strip_only"
end

function tmShouldDeferMainHpMpMarker(triggerId)
    return false
end

function tmStoreHpMpMainPendingCandidate(triggerId, row)
    if type(row) ~= "table" then return false end
    local pendingRow = {
        source = "main_marker_pending",
        kind = row.kind or "",
        status = row.status or "deferred",
        owner = row.owner or "",
        delta = row.delta or "",
        before = row.before or "",
        after = row.after or "",
        marker_key = row.marker_key or "",
        reason = row.reason or "",
    }
    local line = tmHpMpMainDiagnosticLine(pendingRow)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_PENDING_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_HPMP_MAIN_PENDING_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_PENDING_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_HPMP_MAIN_PENDING_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return true
end

function tmStripMainHpMpCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, kind, ownerId, delta, reason)
    local statKind = tostring(kind or ""):lower()
    if statKind ~= "hp" and statKind ~= "mp" then statKind = "hp" end
    local owner = tmPanelCueCleanField(ownerId, 40)
    local amount = tonumber(delta) or 0
    local reasonText = tmPanelCueCleanField(reason, 160)
    local validOwner = CHAR_NAMES_KO[owner] ~= nil
    local before = validOwner and getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_" .. statKind, 0) or nil
    local valueText = before ~= nil and tostring(before) or "none"
    tmStoreHpMpMainStripDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        kind = statKind,
        status = validOwner and "stripped" or "rejected",
        owner = owner,
        delta = tostring(amount),
        before = valueText,
        after = valueText,
        marker_key = tmHpMpMainMarkerKey(statKind, owner, amount, reasonText),
        reason = reasonText,
    })
    return ""
end

function tmExerciseMainHpMpCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, kind, ownerId, delta, reason)
    local statKind = tostring(kind or ""):lower()
    if statKind ~= "hp" and statKind ~= "mp" then statKind = "hp" end
    local owner = tmPanelCueCleanField(ownerId, 40)
    local amount = tonumber(delta) or 0
    local reasonText = tmPanelCueCleanField(reason, 160)
    local validOwner = CHAR_NAMES_KO[owner] ~= nil
    local before = validOwner and getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_" .. statKind, 0) or nil
    local markerKey = tmHpMpMainMarkerKey(statKind, owner, amount, reasonText)
    if validOwner and tmShouldStripMainHpMpMarker(triggerId) then
        local valueText = before ~= nil and tostring(before) or "none"
        tmStoreHpMpMainDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            kind = statKind,
            status = "stripped",
            owner = owner,
            delta = tostring(amount),
            before = valueText,
            after = valueText,
            marker_key = markerKey,
            reason = reasonText,
        })
        return ""
    end
    if validOwner and tmShouldDeferMainHpMpMarker(triggerId) then
        local valueText = before ~= nil and tostring(before) or "none"
        tmStoreHpMpMainPendingCandidate(triggerId, {
            kind = statKind,
            status = "deferred",
            owner = owner,
            delta = tostring(amount),
            before = valueText,
            after = valueText,
            marker_key = markerKey,
            reason = reasonText,
        })
        tmStoreHpMpMainDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            kind = statKind,
            status = "deferred",
            owner = owner,
            delta = tostring(amount),
            before = valueText,
            after = valueText,
            marker_key = markerKey,
            reason = reasonText,
        })
        return ""
    end
    local valueText = before ~= nil and tostring(before) or "none"
    tmStoreHpMpMainDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        kind = statKind,
        status = validOwner and "stripped" or "rejected",
        owner = owner,
        delta = tostring(amount),
        before = valueText,
        after = valueText,
        marker_key = markerKey,
        reason = reasonText,
    })
    return ""
end

function tmHandleMainHpMpCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, kind, ownerId, delta, reason)
    return tmStripMainHpMpCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, kind, ownerId, delta, reason)
end

function tmPanelCardDuplicateSuppressionEnabled(triggerId)
    if TM_PANEL_CARD_DUP_SUPPRESS_ENABLED == false then return false end
    local disabled = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_card_dup_suppression_disabled") or "")
    return disabled ~= "true"
end

function tmPanelCardDuplicateGuardSeen(triggerId, guardKey)
    if not tmPanelCardDuplicateSuppressionEnabled(triggerId) then return false end
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_CARD_DUP_GUARD_KEYS_VAR) or "")
    if current == "none" then current = "" end
    return csvListContains(current, key)
end

function tmRememberPanelCardDuplicateGuardKey(triggerId, guardKey)
    if not tmPanelCardDuplicateSuppressionEnabled(triggerId) then return false end
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_CARD_DUP_GUARD_KEYS_VAR) or "")
    if current == "none" then current = "" end
    local items = parseList(current, ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == key then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, key)
    while #items > TM_PANEL_CARD_DUP_GUARD_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_CARD_DUP_GUARD_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmPanelCueRollCard(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 5)
    if #parts == 0 then return "", false end
    local owner = tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[1])
    local stat = tmPanelCueStat(parts[2])
    local dc = tonumber(type(tmRollDcNumber) == "function" and tmRollDcNumber(parts[3]) or parts[3])
    local reason = parts[4]
    if owner == "" or stat == "" or not dc or reason == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "판정 후보 없음", "No roll cue.", "判定候補なし。"))
        return "", false
    end
    if tmRejectPanelBlockedOwner(triggerId, "roll", owner, "", "none", stat, "", "", "legacy_panel_roll", "non_damage", "false") then
        return "", false
    end
    local meta = tmApplyRollMarker(triggerId, owner, stat, clamp(dc, 5, 25), reason)
    local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    if meta == "" or card == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "판정 카드를 만들지 못했습니다.", "Could not create the roll card.", "判定カードを作成できませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    return card, true
end

function tmPanelCueCombatCard(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 7)
    if #parts == 0 then return "", false end
    local actor = tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[1])
    local target = parts[2] ~= "" and parts[2] or "enemy:current"
    local rawTarget = target
    local stat = tmPanelCueStat(parts[3])
    local mode = tmPanelCueMode(parts[4])
    local reason = parts[5]
    if actor ~= "" and tmRejectPanelBlockedOwner(triggerId, "combat", actor, "", "none", stat, mode, "", "legacy_panel_combat", "combat", "unknown") then
        return "", false
    end
    local targetId = tmEnsurePanelCombatEnemy(triggerId, target, parts[10])
    target = targetId ~= "" and ("enemy:" .. targetId) or target
    tmPanelStoreEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId, parts[6] ~= "" and parts[6] or tmPanelTargetDisplayNameCandidate(triggerId, rawTarget))
    reason = tmPanelFallbackAction(triggerId, actor, reason)
    if actor == "" or targetId == "" or stat == "" or reason == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "전투 후보를 해석하지 못했습니다.", "Could not read the combat cue.", "戦闘候補を読み取れませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, "")
    local card = tmApplyCombatMarker(triggerId, actor, target, stat, mode, reason)
    if card == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "전투 카드를 만들지 못했습니다.", "Could not create the combat card.", "戦闘カードを作成できませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    return card, true
end

function tmPanelSelectionRollCard(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 7)
    if #parts == 0 then return "", false end
    local requestedOwner = tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[2])
    local entry = tmFindTurnDiceEntry(triggerId, parts[1], parts[2])
    local owner = entry and entry.owner or requestedOwner
    local stat = tmPanelCueStat(parts[3])
    local dc = tonumber(type(tmRollDcNumber) == "function" and tmRollDcNumber(parts[4]) or parts[4])
    local bonus = tonumber(parts[5]) or 0
    local penalty = tonumber(parts[6]) or 0
    local reason = tmPanelFallbackAction(triggerId, owner, parts[7])
    local cardKey = tmPanelCardIdempotencyKey(triggerId, "roll", raw, entry and entry.id or parts[1], owner, "none")
    local blockedOwner = requestedOwner ~= "" and requestedOwner or owner
    if blockedOwner ~= "" and tmRejectPanelBlockedOwner(triggerId, "roll", blockedOwner, entry and entry.id or parts[1], "none", stat, "", cardKey, "panel_roll", "non_damage", "false") then
        return "", false
    end
    if not entry or owner == "" or stat == "" or not dc or reason == "" then
        tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            card = "roll",
            status = "rejected",
            dice_id = entry and entry.id or tmPanelCueCleanField(parts[1], 32),
            owner = owner,
            target = "none",
            stat = stat,
            mode = "",
            action_kind = "non_damage",
            damage_eligible = "false",
            non_damage_reason = "roll_panel",
            card_key = cardKey,
            reason = "invalid_roll_selection",
        })
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "판정 후보 없음", "No roll cue.", "判定候補なし。"))
        return "", false
    end
    if tmPanelCardDuplicateGuardSeen(triggerId, cardKey) then
        tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            card = "roll",
            status = "duplicate",
            dice_id = entry.id,
            owner = owner,
            target = "none",
            stat = stat,
            mode = "",
            action_kind = "non_damage",
            damage_eligible = "false",
            non_damage_reason = "roll_panel",
            card_key = cardKey,
            reason = "duplicate_key",
        })
        return "", false
    end
    tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        card = "roll",
        status = "accepted",
        dice_id = entry.id,
        owner = owner,
        target = "none",
        stat = stat,
        mode = "",
        action_kind = "non_damage",
        damage_eligible = "false",
        non_damage_reason = "roll_panel",
        card_key = cardKey,
        reason = tmPanelCueCleanField(reason, 80),
    })
    local meta = tmApplyRollMarkerWithRaw(triggerId, owner, stat, clamp(dc, 5, 25), reason, entry.d20, bonus, penalty)
    local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    if meta == "" or card == "" then
        tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            card = "roll",
            status = "rejected",
            dice_id = entry.id,
            owner = owner,
            target = "none",
            stat = stat,
            mode = "",
            action_kind = "non_damage",
            damage_eligible = "false",
            non_damage_reason = "roll_panel",
            card_key = cardKey,
            reason = "roll_card_failed",
        })
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "판정 카드를 만들지 못했습니다.", "Could not create the roll card.", "判定カードを作成できませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    tmRememberPanelCardDuplicateGuardKey(triggerId, cardKey)
    return card, true
end

function tmPanelSelectionCombatCard(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 10)
    if #parts == 0 then return "", false end
    local requestedActor = tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[2])
    local entry = tmFindTurnDiceEntry(triggerId, parts[1], parts[2])
    local actor = entry and entry.owner or requestedActor
    local target = parts[3] ~= "" and parts[3] or "enemy:current"
    local rawTarget = target
    local stat = tmPanelCueStat(parts[4])
    local mode = tmPanelCueMode(parts[5])
    local preliminaryCardKey = tmPanelCardIdempotencyKey(triggerId, "combat", raw, entry and entry.id or parts[1], actor, "none")
    local blockedActor = requestedActor ~= "" and requestedActor or actor
    if blockedActor ~= "" and tmRejectPanelBlockedOwner(triggerId, "combat", blockedActor, entry and entry.id or parts[1], "none", stat, mode, preliminaryCardKey, "panel_combat", "combat", "unknown") then
        return "", false
    end
    local targetId = tmEnsurePanelCombatEnemy(triggerId, target, parts[10])
    target = targetId ~= "" and ("enemy:" .. targetId) or target
    tmPanelStoreEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId, parts[10] ~= "" and parts[10] or tmPanelTargetDisplayNameCandidate(triggerId, rawTarget))
    local dc = tonumber(type(tmRollDcNumber) == "function" and tmRollDcNumber(parts[6]) or parts[6])
    local bonus = tonumber(parts[7]) or 0
    local penalty = tonumber(parts[8]) or 0
    local reason = tmPanelFallbackAction(triggerId, actor, parts[9])
    local actionInfo = tmClassifyPanelCombatAction(mode, stat, reason)
    local cardKey = tmPanelCardIdempotencyKey(triggerId, "combat", raw, entry and entry.id or parts[1], actor, targetId ~= "" and targetId or "none")
    if targetId ~= "" and (not dc or dc <= 0) then
        dc = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_dc", 13)
    end
    if not entry or actor == "" or targetId == "" or stat == "" or not dc or reason == "" then
        local hpmpSnapshot = tmPanelHpMpOutcomeSnapshot(triggerId, actor, targetId ~= "" and targetId or "none")
        tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            card = "combat",
            status = "rejected",
            dice_id = entry and entry.id or tmPanelCueCleanField(parts[1], 32),
            owner = actor,
            target = targetId ~= "" and targetId or "none",
            stat = stat,
            mode = mode,
            action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
            damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
            non_damage_reason = actionInfo.damage and "" or (actionInfo.reason or ""),
            card_key = cardKey,
            reason = "invalid_combat_selection",
        })
        tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            status = "rejected",
            actor = actor,
            target = targetId ~= "" and targetId or "none",
            card_key = cardKey,
            action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
            damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
            before = hpmpSnapshot,
            after = hpmpSnapshot,
            reason = "invalid_combat_selection",
        })
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "전투 후보를 해석하지 못했습니다.", "Could not read the combat cue.", "戦闘候補を読み取れませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    if tmPanelCardDuplicateGuardSeen(triggerId, cardKey) then
        local hpmpSnapshot = tmPanelHpMpOutcomeSnapshot(triggerId, actor, targetId)
        tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            card = "combat",
            status = "duplicate",
            dice_id = entry.id,
            owner = actor,
            target = targetId,
            stat = stat,
            mode = mode,
            action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
            damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
            non_damage_reason = actionInfo.damage and "" or (actionInfo.reason or ""),
            card_key = cardKey,
            reason = "duplicate_key",
        })
        tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            status = "duplicate",
            actor = actor,
            target = targetId,
            card_key = cardKey,
            action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
            damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
            before = hpmpSnapshot,
            after = hpmpSnapshot,
            reason = "duplicate_key",
        })
        return "", false
    end
    tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        card = "combat",
        status = "accepted",
        dice_id = entry.id,
        owner = actor,
        target = targetId,
        stat = stat,
        mode = mode,
        action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
        damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
        non_damage_reason = actionInfo.damage and "" or (actionInfo.reason or ""),
        card_key = cardKey,
        reason = tmPanelCueCleanField(reason, 80),
    })
    tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, "")
    local hpmpBefore = tmPanelHpMpOutcomeSnapshot(triggerId, actor, targetId)
    local card = tmApplyCombatMarkerWithRaw(triggerId, actor, target, stat, mode, reason, entry.d20, clamp(dc, 5, 25), bonus, penalty)
    local hpmpAfter = tmPanelHpMpOutcomeSnapshot(triggerId, actor, targetId)
    if card == "" then
        tmStorePanelCardDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            card = "combat",
            status = "rejected",
            dice_id = entry.id,
            owner = actor,
            target = targetId,
            stat = stat,
            mode = mode,
            action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
            damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
            non_damage_reason = actionInfo.damage and "" or (actionInfo.reason or ""),
            card_key = cardKey,
            reason = "combat_card_failed",
        })
        tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            status = "rejected",
            actor = actor,
            target = targetId,
            card_key = cardKey,
            action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
            damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
            before = hpmpBefore,
            after = hpmpAfter,
            reason = "combat_card_failed",
        })
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "전투 카드를 만들지 못했습니다.", "Could not create the combat card.", "戦闘カードを作成できませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    tmStorePanelHpMpOutcomeDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        status = "applied",
        actor = actor,
        target = targetId,
        card_key = cardKey,
        action_kind = actionInfo.kind or "",
        damage_eligible = actionInfo.damage and "true" or "false",
        before = hpmpBefore,
        after = hpmpAfter,
        reason = tmPanelCueCleanField(reason, 80),
    })
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    tmRememberPanelCardDuplicateGuardKey(triggerId, cardKey)
    return card, true
end

function tmPanelCueDefenseCard(triggerId, raw)
    local parts = tmPanelCueSplit(raw, 9)
    if #parts == 0 then return "", false end
    local defender = tmPanelCueOwner(triggerId, parts[1])
    local target = parts[2] ~= "" and parts[2] or "enemy:current"
    local rawTarget = target
    local stat = tmPanelCueStat(parts[3])
    local mode = parts[4]
    if defender ~= "" and tmRejectPanelBlockedOwner(triggerId, "defense", defender, "", "none", stat, mode, "", "legacy_panel_defense", "defense", "incoming") then
        return "", false
    end
    local targetId = tmEnsurePanelCombatEnemy(triggerId, target, parts[9])
    target = targetId ~= "" and ("enemy:" .. targetId) or target
    tmPanelStoreEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId, parts[9] ~= "" and parts[9] or tmPanelTargetDisplayNameCandidate(triggerId, rawTarget))
    local dc = tonumber(type(tmRollDcNumber) == "function" and tmRollDcNumber(parts[5]) or parts[5])
    local incoming = tonumber(parts[6]) or 0
    local damageKind = parts[7]
    local reason = tmPanelFallbackAction(triggerId, defender, parts[8])
    if defender == "" or targetId == "" or stat == "" or reason == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "방어 후보를 해석하지 못했습니다.", "Could not read the defense cue.", "防御候補を読み取れませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, "")
    local entry = tmFindTurnDiceEntry(triggerId, "", defender)
    local card = ""
    if entry then
        card = tmApplyDefenseMarkerWithRaw(triggerId, defender, target, stat, mode, reason, entry.d20, dc, 0, 0, incoming, damageKind, "legacy_defense:" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw))
    else
        card = tmApplyDefenseMarker(triggerId, defender, target, stat, mode, reason, dc, incoming, damageKind)
    end
    if card == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId, "방어 카드를 만들지 못했습니다.", "Could not create the defense card.", "防御カードを作成できませんでした。"))
        return "", false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    return card, true
end

        actor = defender,
        target = targetId,
        card_key = cardKey,
        action_kind = "defense",
        damage_eligible = "incoming",
        before = hpmpBefore,
        after = hpmpAfter,
        reason = tmPanelCueCleanField(reason, 80),
    })
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", tmRollResultSummary(triggerId))
    tmRememberPanelCardDuplicateGuardKey(triggerId, cardKey)
    return card, true
end

function tmStorePanelSelections(triggerId, rollPanel, combatPanel, defensePanel)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", "")
    local rollRows = tmPanelCueRows(rollPanel)
    local combatRows = tmPanelCueRows(combatPanel)
    local defenseRows = tmPanelCueRows(defensePanel)
    if #rollRows == 0 and #combatRows == 0 and #defenseRows == 0 then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_src", tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", "")
        return
    end
    local cueKey = tmPanelCueKey(rollPanel, combatPanel, defensePanel) .. "||" .. getVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool", "")
    if cueKey ~= "" and cueKey == getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", "")
        and getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", "") ~= "" then
        return
    end
    local cards = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(combatRows) do
        local card, used = tmPanelSelectionCombatCard(triggerId, row)
        if used and card ~= "" then
            table.insert(cards, card)
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(defenseRows) do
        local card, used = tmPanelSelectionDefenseCard(triggerId, row)
        if used and card ~= "" then
            table.insert(cards, card)
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(rollRows) do
        local card, used = tmPanelSelectionRollCard(triggerId, row)
        if used and card ~= "" then
            table.insert(cards, card)
        end
    end
    if #cards > 0 then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", table.concat(cards, ""))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_src", tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", cueKey)
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_src", tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", cueKey)
    end
end

function tmStorePanelCues(triggerId, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", "")
    local rollRows = tmPanelCueRows(rollCue)
    local combatRows = tmPanelCueRows(combatCue)
    local defenseRows = tmPanelCueRows(defenseCue)
    if #rollRows == 0 and #combatRows == 0 and #defenseRows == 0 then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_src", tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", "")
        return
    end
    local cueKey = tmPanelCueKey(rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    if cueKey ~= "" and cueKey == getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", "")
        and getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", "") ~= "" then
        return
    end
    local cards = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(combatRows) do
        local card, used = tmPanelCueCombatCard(triggerId, row)
        if used and card ~= "" then
            table.insert(cards, card)
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(defenseRows) do
        local card, used = tmPanelCueDefenseCard(triggerId, row)
        if used and card ~= "" then
            table.insert(cards, card)
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(rollRows) do
        local card, used = tmPanelCueRollCard(triggerId, row)
        if used and card ~= "" then
            table.insert(cards, card)
        end
    end
    if #cards > 0 then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", table.concat(cards, ""))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_src", tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", cueKey)
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_src", tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_cue_key", cueKey)
    end
end

function tmPanelEngineCardHtml(triggerId)
    local blocks = {}
    local html = getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_engine_card_html", "")
    if html ~= "" then table.insert(blocks, html) end
    local warning = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", ""))
    if warning ~= "" then
        table.insert(blocks, '<div class="tm-guide-warning">' .. tmBriefLineBreaks(tmEscapeHtml(warning)) .. '</div>')
    end
    if #blocks == 0 then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-panel-engine-card">' .. table.concat(blocks, "") .. '</div>'
end

function tmRenderSessionBrief(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then return "" end
    tmEnsureSessionPanelFresh(triggerId)
    local summary = tmSanitizePanelBrief(getVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", ""))
    local rows = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local intent = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", "")
        if intent == "none" then intent = "" end
        table.insert(rows, '<div class="tm-intent-row"><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmActorLabel(triggerId, id)) .. '</b><span>' .. tmBriefLineBreaks(intent) .. '</span></div>')
    end
    local lead = tmSanitizeGuideLead(getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", ""))
    local leadWarning = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", ""))
    local leadWarningHtml = ""
    if leadWarning ~= "" then
        leadWarningHtml = '<div class="tm-guide-warning">' .. tmBriefLineBreaks(leadWarning) .. '</div>'
    end
    local leadLoading = getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_refresh_loading", "false") == "true"
    local leadLoadingHtml = ""
    if leadLoading then
        leadLoadingHtml = '<div class="tm-guide-warning tm-guide-refresh-loading">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "추천 리드를 새로고침하는 중입니다.", "Refreshing suggested lead.", "おすすめリードを更新中です。")) .. '</div>'
    end
    local leadHtml = '<div class="tm-session-guide-block tm-guide-lead"><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "guide_lead")) .. '</h4><p>'
        .. tmBriefLineBreaks(lead)
        .. '</p>' .. leadLoadingHtml .. leadWarningHtml .. '<div class="tm-guide-apply"><span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "refresh"), "tmRefreshGuideLead") .. '</span><span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "apply_guide_lead"), "tmApplyGuideLead") .. '</span></div></div>'
    local leadCollapsed = getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_collapsed", "false") == "true"
    if leadLoading then leadCollapsed = false end
    local leadStateClass = leadCollapsed and " tm-guide-lead-collapsed" or " tm-guide-lead-expanded"
    local leadHead = '<div class="tm-guide-lead-head"><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "guide_lead")) .. '</h4><span class="tm-guide-collapse-toggle">' .. tmButton(leadCollapsed and "expand" or "collapse", "tmToggleGuideLeadCollapsed") .. '</span></div>'
    local leadBody = ""
    if not leadCollapsed then
        leadBody = '<div class="tm-guide-lead-body"><p>' .. tmBriefLineBreaks(lead)
            .. '</p>' .. leadLoadingHtml .. leadWarningHtml .. '<div class="tm-guide-apply"><span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "refresh"), "tmRefreshGuideLead") .. '</span><span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "apply_guide_lead"), "tmApplyGuideLead") .. '</span></div></div>'
    end
    leadHtml = '<div class="tm-session-guide-block tm-guide-lead' .. leadStateClass .. '">' .. leadHead .. leadBody .. '</div>'
    local stateCue = tmSessionStateCue(triggerId)
    local cueHtml = ""
    if stateCue ~= "" then
        cueHtml = '<div class="tm-session-guide-block tm-session-state-cue"><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "current_state")) .. '</h4><p>'
            .. tmBriefLineBreaks(tmEscapeHtml(stateCue)) .. '</p></div>'
    end
    return '<div class="tm-session-brief tm-session-tabs">'
        .. '<input type="radio" class="tm-session-tab-radio tm-session-tab-guide-radio" name="tm-session-tabs" id="tm-session-tab-guide" checked>'
        .. '<input type="radio" class="tm-session-tab-radio tm-session-tab-intents-radio" name="tm-session-tabs" id="tm-session-tab-intents">'
        .. tmSessionSummaryRowHtml(triggerId)
        .. '<div class="tm-session-tabbar"><label class="tm-session-tab-label tm-session-tab-guide-label" for="tm-session-tab-guide">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "gm_guide")) .. '</label><label class="tm-session-tab-label tm-session-tab-intents-label" for="tm-session-tab-intents">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "player_intent")) .. '</label></div>'
        .. '<section class="tm-session-tab-panel tm-session-guide-panel"><div class="tm-session-guide-block"><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "current_state")) .. '</h4><p>' .. tmBriefLineBreaks(summary) .. '</p></div>' .. cueHtml .. leadHtml .. '</section>'
        .. '<section class="tm-session-tab-panel tm-session-intents-panel"><div class="tm-intent-list">' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</div></section>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmServiceGuideContext(triggerId)
    local ko = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local status = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active")
        local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 1)
        local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 0)
        if status == "ko" or (hpMax > 0 and hp <= 0) then
            table.insert(ko, id .. "=" .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, id))
        end
    end
    return table.concat({
        "[Service scene guidance]",
        "party_gold=" .. tostring(type(tmGetPartyGold) == "function" and tmGetPartyGold(triggerId) or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)),
        "ko_members=" .. (#ko > 0 and table.concat(ko, ", ") or "none"),
        "party_bag_items=" .. tmPartyItemsWithRefs(triggerId),
        "party_skillbooks=" .. tmPartySkillbooksWithRefs(triggerId),
        "- In a church, temple, shrine, priest, healer, or resurrection service scene with ko_members, surface revival for the listed KO members as the first paid service option.",
        "- In an inn, lodging, camp service, bathhouse rest, or paid rest scene, surface overnight rest or recovery with a clear party cost.",
        "- In a shop, merchant, market, or service counter scene, surface concrete goods with prices and current party-bag sale refs when relevant.",
        "- GUIDE_LEAD may offer service options before confirmation. Completed recovery, rest, buy, or sale belongs in GUIDE_LEAD when Lua runtime already reflects it or this same aux response returns a confirmed service or skill-use row.",
        "- Keep exact hidden markers outside visible text; Lua validates confirmed service candidates.",
        "- These service cues are table-facing options. The user GM keeps the final transaction choice."
    }, "\n")
end

function tmBuildMainNpcCompatibilityMarkerRules(triggerId)
    local lines = {}
    table.insert(lines, "[NPC compatibility marker boundary]")
    table.insert(lines, tmNpcResolveAuthorityPromptText(triggerId))
    table.insert(lines, tmMainNpcCompatibilityMarkerText(triggerId))
    table.insert(lines, "- Lua/Aux panel gates can fill missing current NPC creation, visible name, note, resolved/inactive state, or current-pointer clear when Main NPC evidence is absent and the exact-current guards pass.")
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, cues)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    local lower = raw:lower()
    for _, cue in ipairs(cues or {}) do
        local needle = tostring(cue or "")
        if needle ~= "" and (raw:find(needle, 1, true) or lower:find(needle:lower(), 1, true)) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmPanelHasKoMember(triggerId)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local status = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active")
        local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 1)
        local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 0)
        if status == "ko" or (hpMax > 0 and hp <= 0) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmPanelHasRewardRuntimeState(triggerId)
    local payloadKeys = {
        "party_items",
        "party_item_registry",
        "party_skillbook_registry",
        "tm_reward_aux_grant_keys",
    }
    for _, key in ipairs(payloadKeys) do
        local value = tostring(getVar(triggerId, key, "") or "")
        if value ~= "" and value ~= "none" and value ~= "[]" and value ~= "{}" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return tmPanelFlagTextHas(getVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", ""), {
        "reward", "loot", "skillbook", "gold", "item",
        "보상", "전리품", "획득", "스킬북", "골드", "아이템"
    })
end

function tmSessionPanelEpisodeMarkersEnabled(triggerId)
    return getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true"
        and getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal") == "trpg"
end

function tmBuildPanelContextFlags(triggerId, latestContext, retryMode, manualSnapshot)
    local text = table.concat({
        tostring(latestContext or ""),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "last_session_log_entry", "")),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", "")),
        tostring(tmPlaceCurrentContextPromptLine(triggerId)),
    }, "\n")
    local dicePool = getVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_pool", "")
    local blockedPool = getVar(triggerId, "tm_turn_dice_blocked_owners", "")
    local hasRollState = dicePool ~= "" or blockedPool ~= ""
    local hasResolvedResult = tmResolvedTurnResultText(triggerId) ~= ""
    local hasThreat = tmCurrentThreatInfo(triggerId) ~= nil or getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "") ~= ""
    local needsRoll = hasRollState and tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
        "판정", "굴림", "주사위", "체크", "시도", "조사", "수색", "설득", "위협",
        "roll", "check", "test", "attempt"
    })
    local needsCombat = hasThreat or tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
        "전투", "적", "몬스터", "공격", "피해", "데미지", "방어", "회피", "쓰러", "격퇴",
        "combat", "enemy", "monster", "attack", "damage", "defense", "defeat"
    })
    local needsService = tmPanelHasKoMember(triggerId) or tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
        "성당", "교회", "신전", "사제", "치유", "부활", "헌금", "상점", "상인", "구매", "판매", "여관", "휴식", "수리",
        "church", "temple", "shrine", "priest", "healer", "heal", "revive", "resurrection", "donation",
        "shop", "merchant", "market", "buy", "sell", "inn", "rest", "repair", "service"
    })
    local hasRewardRuntime = tmPanelHasRewardRuntimeState(triggerId)
    local needsInventory = hasRewardRuntime or tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
        "아이템", "장비", "가방", "스킬북", "전리품", "획득", "보상", "습득", "판매", "구매", "사용", "장착", "해제",
        "item", "equipment", "bag", "skillbook", "loot", "reward", "learn", "sell", "buy", "use", "equip", "unequip", "assign", "release"
    })
    local episodeMarkersEnabled = tmSessionPanelEpisodeMarkersEnabled(triggerId)
    local wrapupCue = episodeMarkersEnabled and tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId) or ""
    local needsEpisode = episodeMarkersEnabled and (wrapupCue ~= "" or tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
        "시나리오", "목표", "클리어", "완료", "성공", "실패", "보상", "출발", "탈출", "귀환",
        "scenario", "episode", "objective", "clear", "complete", "success", "fail", "reward", "next", "travel", "wrapup"
    }))
    local needsWorld = getVar(triggerId, "current_npc", "") ~= "" or getVar(triggerId, "current_gimmick", "") ~= ""
        or tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
            "NPC", "인물", "상인", "사제", "문", "장치", "함정", "장소", "마을", "던전", "성당", "상점",
            "npc", "merchant", "priest", "door", "device", "trap", "place", "village", "dungeon", "church", "shop"
        })
    local needsActorState = tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
        "상태", "중독", "저주", "기절", "묶", "속박", "젖", "끈적", "부상", "회복",
        "condition", "poison", "curse", "ko", "restrain", "bound", "wet", "sticky", "injury", "recover"
    })
    local needsSkillUse = tmPanelFlagTextHas(text, {
        "스킬", "기술", "회복", "치유", "부활", "응급", "보살핌", "힐", "MP", "마나",
        "skill", "cast", "heal", "healing", "recover", "recovery", "restore", "revive", "mend", "cure", "first aid", "mp",
        "スキル", "回復", "治癒", "蘇生"
    })
    local debugFlag = getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_debug_prompt", "false") == "true"
        or getVar(triggerId, "tm_debug_panel_prompt", "false") == "true"
    local needsDebug = debugFlag or retryMode == "fresh_angle"
    local needsCard = manualSnapshot == true or retryMode == "card_result_required" or needsRoll or needsCombat or hasResolvedResult
    return {
        needs_roll_context = needsRoll,
        needs_combat_context = needsCombat,
        needs_service_context = needsService,
        needs_inventory_context = needsInventory,
        needs_reward_context = hasRewardRuntime or needsInventory or needsEpisode,
        needs_skill_use_context = needsSkillUse,
        needs_episode_context = needsEpisode,
        needs_world_context = needsWorld,
        needs_actor_context = needsActorState,
        needs_debug_diagnostics = needsDebug,
        needs_card_context = needsCard,
    }
end

        "party_gold=" .. tostring(type(tmGetPartyGold) == "function" and tmGetPartyGold(triggerId) or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)),
        "party_bag_items=" .. tmPartyItemsWithRefs(triggerId),
        "party_skillbooks=" .. tmPartySkillbooksWithRefs(triggerId),

end

        "wrapup_episode=" .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_episode", "") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_episode", "") or "none"),
