function tmPanelOutputContractBlock(triggerId, manualSnapshot, flags, rollMarkerShape, combatMarkerShape, defenseMarkerShape)
    local lines = {
        "Return session panel control markers and no visible commentary:",
        "▥ENEMY_AUDIT:present|enemy_id|visible enemy name▥ or ▥ENEMY_AUDIT:none|none|none▥ or ▥ENEMY_AUDIT:unknown|reason|none▥",
        "▥AUX_THREAT:v1|present|enemy_id_or_current|visible enemy name|short evidence▥ or ▥AUX_THREAT:v1|none|none|none|short evidence▥ or ▥AUX_THREAT:v1|unknown|none|none|short evidence▥",
        "▥AUX_INTENT:v1|owner|present|current action|short evidence▥ or ▥AUX_INTENT:v1|owner|none|none|short evidence▥ or ▥AUX_INTENT:v1|owner|unknown|none|short evidence▥",
        "▥BRIEF:one or two current in-scenario situation sentences▥",
        "▥GUIDE_LEAD:1-2 short GM scene/result narration sentences▥",
        manualSnapshot and "▥PANEL_INTENT:owner|current action or none▥ for each owner: sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola" or "▥INTENT_AUX:owner|current action or none▥ for each owner: sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola",
    }
    if flags.needs_reward_context then
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_REWARD:v1|kind|status|name_or_ref|qty|rarity_or_grade|target_or_none|short evidence▥")
    end
    if flags.needs_service_context then
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_SERVICE:v1|status|kind|target_or_none|ref_or_label_or_none|price_or_none|short evidence▥")
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_SERVICE_Q:v1|confirmed|buy|none|item_label|unit_price|qty|short evidence▥ when a confirmed multi-buy exists")
    end
    if flags.needs_skill_use_context then
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_SKILL_USE:v1|status|owner_or_none|skill_ref_or_current|target_or_none|short evidence▥")
    end
    if flags.needs_world_context then
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_WORLD:v1|section|id_or_name|state|visible_name_or_none|short evidence▥")
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_NPC_META:v1|npc_id_or_none|status|short_note_or_none|short evidence▥")
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_NPC_PAYMENT:v1|status|npc_id_or_none|gold|result|short evidence▥")
    end
    if flags.needs_actor_context or flags.needs_debug_diagnostics then
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_ACTOR_STATE:v1|owner_or_none|op|condition_or_none|duration_or_none|short evidence▥")
    end
    if flags.needs_episode_context then
        table.insert(lines, "▥AUX_EPISODE:v1|kind|status|episode_id_or_none|detail_or_none|short evidence▥")
    end
    if flags.needs_card_context then
        table.insert(lines, rollMarkerShape)
        table.insert(lines, combatMarkerShape)
        table.insert(lines, defenseMarkerShape)
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- FB-5: build the aux-LLM prompt for the suggested GM lead.
function tmBuildPanelMarkerRules(triggerId, mode, manualSnapshot, flags)
    local outputLanguage = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local voiceStyle = tmGuideLeadVoiceStyle(triggerId)
    flags = flags or {}
    local lines = {}
    if mode == "main" then
        table.insert(lines, "[Session panel marker boundary]")
        table.insert(lines, "- The axLLM session panel handles roll/combat/defense cards, BRIEF, GUIDE_LEAD, AUX observation rows, and panel-side reward/service candidates from the latest visible response and Lua runtime state.")
        table.insert(lines, "- UI/Lua handles inventory assignment, release, equip/unequip, shop quantity, sell, skillbook, and service mutation details through validated writers.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Main writes visible scene prose and the compact runtime markers it still owns.")
        table.insert(lines, tmBuildMainNpcCompatibilityMarkerRules(triggerId))
        table.insert(lines, "- Main INTENT markers are authoritative when present. Use exactly four current-action INTENT markers during active TRPG turns; use none for a player with no current declared or implied action.")
        table.insert(lines, "- When the scene establishes that visible monster, hostile creature, active foe, and targetable threat are absent, emit hidden `▥ENEMY:none▥` to clear current enemy state.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Lua prepares raw d20 values before the Main LLM request, parses markers from both Main and axLLM, merges duplicate candidates, calculates state, and renders final UI.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Visible prose carries scene narration, player declarations, character reactions, ordinary state changes, and narration from supplied Lua result summaries. Hidden markers carry runtime state.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Visible roll handoffs use character-facing fiction and light dice cues; exact ability keys, DC labels, target numbers, thresholds, and ROLL_HINTS values stay in hidden markers or rendered roll/combat cards.")
        return table.concat(lines, "\n")
    else
        table.insert(lines, "[Session panel marker rules]")
        table.insert(lines, "- Generate panel text from the latest visible response and compact Lua state.")
        if manualSnapshot then
            table.insert(lines, "- Return PANEL_INTENT, ENEMY_AUDIT, BRIEF, and GUIDE_LEAD marker contents in this same response.")
            table.insert(lines, "- First derive exactly four PANEL_INTENT markers from [Latest visible Main response - full] and [Current Main INTENT markers parsed from latest response].")
            table.insert(lines, "- Treat PANEL_INTENT as the refreshed current action snapshot for this panel response.")
        else
            table.insert(lines, "- Return ENEMY_AUDIT, BRIEF, GUIDE_LEAD, and exactly four INTENT_AUX marker contents in this same response.")
        end
        local enabled = {"ENEMY_AUDIT", "AUX_THREAT", "AUX_INTENT", "BRIEF", "GUIDE_LEAD"}
        table.insert(enabled, manualSnapshot and "PANEL_INTENT" or "INTENT_AUX")
        if flags.needs_card_context then table.insert(enabled, "ROLL_PANEL/COMBAT_PANEL/DEFENSE_PANEL") end
        if flags.needs_reward_context then table.insert(enabled, "AUX_REWARD") end
        if flags.needs_service_context then table.insert(enabled, "AUX_SERVICE/AUX_SERVICE_Q") end
        if flags.needs_skill_use_context then table.insert(enabled, "AUX_SKILL_USE") end
        if flags.needs_world_context then table.insert(enabled, "AUX_WORLD/AUX_NPC_META/AUX_NPC_PAYMENT") end
        if flags.needs_actor_context or flags.needs_debug_diagnostics then table.insert(enabled, "AUX_ACTOR_STATE") end
        if flags.needs_episode_context then table.insert(enabled, "AUX_EPISODE") end
        table.insert(lines, "- Enabled output families: " .. table.concat(enabled, ", ") .. ".")
        if flags.needs_card_context then
            table.insert(lines, "- ROLL_PANEL, COMBAT_PANEL, and DEFENSE_PANEL may appear multiple times. Emit one card marker for each visible resolved roll, attack, or defense action.")
            table.insert(lines, "- Use [Stored turn dice pool] as the raw d20 source for roll/combat/defense panels.")
            table.insert(lines, "- Create card markers only for owners with dice rows in [Stored turn dice pool]. Owners listed in [Blocked roll owners] use none for normal roll/combat/defense cards.")
            table.insert(lines, "- Choose useful panel cards first, then write BRIEF and GUIDE_LEAD from the same known d20 outcome and scene judgment.")
        end
    end
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, "Rules for ENEMY_AUDIT:")
    table.insert(lines, "- ENEMY_AUDIT is the axLLM enemy-presence judgment for Lua's fallback resolver.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use exactly one of these forms: ▥ENEMY_AUDIT:present|enemy_id|visible enemy name▥, ▥ENEMY_AUDIT:none|none|none▥, or ▥ENEMY_AUDIT:unknown|reason|none▥.")
    table.insert(lines, "- ENEMY_AUDIT and AUX_THREAT should express the same threat judgment. Use the same status, enemy id, and visible name when evidence is clear.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Build the judgment from the latest visible response first, then current runtime objects and recent log as continuity evidence.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use present when the current visible scene contains or continues a monster, hostile creature, active foe, or targetable threat.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use none when the current visible scene clearly establishes that active visible threats are gone, defeated, absent, escaped, or no longer targetable.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use unknown when the latest visible response lacks enough threat evidence for a clear present/none judgment.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Main ENEMY markers remain authoritative. Lua applies ENEMY_AUDIT only when Main ENEMY marker presence is missing.")
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, "Rules for AUX observe markers:")
    table.insert(lines, "- AUX markers reflect the same latest visible response and runtime state used for cards and GUIDE_LEAD. AUX_INTENT present may fill only a missing Main INTENT owner; AUX_INTENT none may clear only a stale missing owner.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Core forms: ▥AUX_THREAT:v1|status|enemy_id_or_none|visible enemy name or none|short evidence▥ and ▥AUX_INTENT:v1|owner|status|current action or none|short evidence▥.")
    if flags.needs_reward_context then
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_REWARD form: ▥AUX_REWARD:v1|kind|status|name_or_ref|qty|rarity_or_grade|target_or_none|short evidence▥.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_REWARD status is present, none, or unknown. Use present for a reward acquired, found, looted, bought, gifted, or granted in the latest visible response.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_REWARD kind is equipment, consumable, key, skillbook, gold, none, or unknown. Use equipment for weapons, armor, shields, wearable gear, tools used as gear, and magical accessories.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use consumable for potions, scrolls, food, bombs, powders, oils, and one-use supplies. Use key for clues, keys, quest objects, maps, seals, trophies, and scenario-progress objects.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_ITEM_META form: ▥AUX_ITEM_META:v1|name_or_ref|kind|rarity|grade|slot|stat|role|effect|trigger|target|short evidence▥. Add it when the latest visible response gives concrete item mechanics.")
    end
    if flags.needs_service_context then
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_SERVICE candidate form: ▥AUX_SERVICE:v1|status|kind|target_or_none|ref_or_label_or_none|price_or_none|short evidence▥.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_SERVICE_Q candidate form: ▥AUX_SERVICE_Q:v1|confirmed|buy|none|item_label|unit_price|qty|short evidence▥.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_SERVICE_Q is buy-only. Return at most one row for a confirmed multi-buy; unit_price is per item and qty is the confirmed count.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_SERVICE status semantics: use confirmed when the latest visible Main response says the party paid, received a service, completed rest, bought an item, or sold an item.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use suggested when the latest scene offers a service, goods, prices, sale options, or asks for a decision while the transaction remains pending.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use none when the latest scene has no active service, rest, or trade.")
        table.insert(lines, "- For church/healer scenes with KO members, surface revive as the first service option. For inn scenes, surface rest and party cost. For shop scenes, surface concrete goods/prices and current party-bag sale refs.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Examples: ▥AUX_SERVICE:v1|confirmed|revive|sinsoyul|none|50|paid priest revived KO PC▥ / ▥AUX_SERVICE:v1|confirmed|rest|party|inn|20|paid inn rest completed▥ / ▥AUX_SERVICE:v1|confirmed|buy|none|체력 회복 포션|30|paid shop purchase completed▥ / ▥AUX_SERVICE:v1|confirmed|sell|none|it003|25|sold shared-bag item▥.")
    end
    if flags.needs_skill_use_context then
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_SKILL_USE form: ▥AUX_SKILL_USE:v1|status|owner_or_none|skill_ref_or_current|target_or_none|short evidence▥.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_SKILL_USE status is confirmed, none, or unknown. Use confirmed when the latest visible Main response says a PC actually used a loaded/current sheet skill now.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use none when the latest visible Main response contains no completed skill use. Use unknown when the skill user, skill, or target remains ambiguous.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use owner ids only: sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola. Use current when visible text says current or active skill without an exact ref.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Targets use self, ally:owner, enemy:current, enemy:id, npc:id, gimmick:id, or scene. For healing/recovery skill use, choose self or ally:owner.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Confirmed AUX_SKILL_USE is a mechanical event candidate for Lua validation. The existing skill engine validates ownership, loadout, MP, silence, and target.")
    end
    if flags.needs_world_context then
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_WORLD form: ▥AUX_WORLD:v1|section|id_or_name|state|visible_name_or_none|short evidence▥. section is npc, gimmick, place, none, or unknown. state is present, none, resolved, inactive, or unknown.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use AUX_WORLD state resolved for a cleared, completed, defeated, finished, or settled place, gimmick, or NPC context.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_NPC_META form: ▥AUX_NPC_META:v1|npc_id_or_none|status|short_note_or_none|short evidence▥.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_NPC_PAYMENT form: ▥AUX_NPC_PAYMENT:v1|status|npc_id_or_none|gold|result|short evidence▥.")
        table.insert(lines, "- For AUX_WORLD npc rows, use a valid formula npc id such as npc_l2_merchant_neutral when the latest response introduces a concrete NPC, and put the Korean visible name in visible_name.")
        table.insert(lines, "- For AUX_WORLD gimmick rows, use a valid formula gimmick id such as gm_l2_standard_hazard when the latest response introduces a concrete current gimmick.")
        table.insert(lines, "- For AUX_WORLD place rows, put the current TRPG-fiction scene place in id_or_name or visible_name.")
    end
    if flags.needs_actor_context or flags.needs_debug_diagnostics then
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_ACTOR_STATE form: ▥AUX_ACTOR_STATE:v1|owner_or_none|op|condition_or_none|duration_or_none|short evidence▥. op is apply, clear, tick, none, or unknown.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_ACTOR_STATE condition is an actual condition id such as poison, bleed, stunned, fear, slow, silence, weakened, or confused. KO stays in HP/runtime status and service guidance.")
    end
    if flags.needs_episode_context then
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_EPISODE form: ▥AUX_EPISODE:v1|kind|status|episode_id_or_none|detail_or_none|short evidence▥.")
        table.insert(lines, "- AUX_EPISODE kind is wrapup, start, node, episode_clear, episode_fail, flag, none, or unknown. status is suggested, confirmed, none, or unknown.")
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- AUX_THREAT and AUX_INTENT status is an English enum only: present, none, or unknown.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Return one AUX_THREAT row and one AUX_INTENT row for each owner: sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Korean proper nouns and natural text belong only in visible enemy name, current action, visible_name, id_or_name when it is a visible place/NPC/gimmick name, or evidence fields.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use none when the latest visible response explicitly supports absence; use unknown when evidence is insufficient.")
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, "Rules for BRIEF:")
    table.insert(lines, "- BRIEF is the TRPG in-world situation only: location, threat, clue, obstacle, or immediate fictional scene.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Summarize the latest in-scenario state after the most recent visible chat, rolls, discoveries, and consequences.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Keep BRIEF centered on the current fictional scene; leave UI state, clubroom logistics, table meta, tutorials, and old intentions outside it.")
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, "Rules for GUIDE_LEAD:")
    table.insert(lines, voiceStyle)
    table.insert(lines, "- GUIDE_LEAD is the exact visible text that will be moved into the user's chat input by the apply-recommended-lead button.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Put only plain visible table narration inside GUIDE_LEAD; keep all control markers and hidden bookkeeping outside the marker content.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Write 1-2 short " .. outputLanguage .. " sentences as the GM speaking/narrating directly to the players.")
    table.insert(lines, "- GUIDE_LEAD MUST be paste-ready GM speech/narration for visible scene facts, sensory pressure, and resolved roll outcomes.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Write the finished in-world GM line itself, as if the user already pressed the button and the text entered the chat box.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Phrase roll-related moments as visible fiction: what the characters notice, touch, hear, reveal, or trigger from the established result.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use exact PC/player labels from [PC/player labels], in the form PC name (real player name).")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use [Current Main INTENT markers parsed from latest response] and [Latest visible Main response - full] as the action sources for roll and combat cards.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use [Stored intent memory state] as memory status for cleanup decisions.")
    table.insert(lines, "- When [Authoritative current turn result] has resolved_result=none, describe the immediate visible/audible/felt scene response and fictional pressure around current attempts; when the current action is uncertain, include a light roll-call cue in natural table language while exact stat/DC details stay in the card or hidden state.")
    table.insert(lines, "- ROLL_PANEL, COMBAT_PANEL, and DEFENSE_PANEL markers returned in this same response are already roll results for GUIDE_LEAD.")
    table.insert(lines, "- After a roll result exists, GUIDE_LEAD MUST continue from that resolved result as the next fictional beat: success, partial success, failure cost, clue revealed, danger change, or consequence.")
    table.insert(lines, "- End on sensory detail, consequence, or tension. Use a clear roll-call cue only when [Authoritative current turn result] has resolved_result=none.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Keep a steady scenario pace: reveal a new visible clue, pressure, reaction, path, or complication when the scene would otherwise stall, while preserving meaningful player choices.")
    table.insert(lines, "- The user GM keeps authority over exact ability, DC, and final adjudication; GUIDE_LEAD may lightly cue that the declared action should be decided with a roll only while [Authoritative current turn result] has resolved_result=none.")
    table.insert(lines, "- When choosing stat_key and dc for card markers, prioritize the latest user GM wording over episode defaults and generic difficulty assumptions.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Write visible facts around the current action source only. Hidden mechanics and exact procedure remain with the user GM, while simple dice language may cue pending uncertain actions.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Hidden mechanics and hidden facts remain in panel/hidden state: DC, target numbers, ability abbreviations, hidden monsters, traps, failure branches, and success conditions.")
    table.insert(lines, "- GUIDE_LEAD contains fiction-first GM speech; ROLL, COMBAT, CONDITION_APPLY, HP, MP, EPISODE, FLAG, stat abbreviations, and target-number notation remain in markers or panel state.")
    table.insert(lines, "- GUIDE_LEAD is the finished GM line itself, not an instruction to another writer.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Keep visible GUIDE_LEAD focused on fiction: sensory detail, discoveries, consequences, pressure, and character-facing narration.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use sensory/result scene phrasing rather than task-brief phrasing.")
    if flags.needs_service_context then
        table.insert(lines, "- Use [Service scene guidance] for church, temple, shrine, priest, healer, shop, merchant, market, inn, repair, revive, or payment scenes.")
        table.insert(lines, "- GUIDE_LEAD may offer service options before confirmation. GUIDE_LEAD carries completed recovery, rest, buy, or sale when Lua runtime already reflects it or this same response returns a confirmed AUX_SERVICE/AUX_SERVICE_Q/AUX_SKILL_USE row.")
    end
    if tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId) ~= "" then
        if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") == "true" then
            table.insert(lines, "- If [Scenario wrap-up cue] is confirmed by the user GM, make the recommended lead visibly suggest a natural closing beat.")
        else
            table.insert(lines, "- If [Scenario wrap-up cue] is only suggested, treat it as optional pacing context and keep useful roll/combat cards or current player-facing pressure active when they fit the latest response.")
        end
        table.insert(lines, "- Keep the ending as a recommendation only: the user GM keeps the final ending decision.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Keep EPISODE_CLEAR, marker text, and system instructions outside BRIEF/GUIDE_LEAD.")
    end
    if tmPacePromptBlock(triggerId, "panel", false) ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "- If [Pacing cue] is present, reflect it as a natural scene-facing lead while preserving user choice.")
    end
    if manualSnapshot then
        table.insert(lines, "")
        table.insert(lines, "Rules for PANEL_INTENT:")
        table.insert(lines, "- Return exactly four PANEL_INTENT markers: one each for sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, and yuseola.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Each PANEL_INTENT value is the owner's current declared or clearly implied action from [Latest visible Main response - full] or [Current Main INTENT markers parsed from latest response].")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use the ASCII word none when the latest visible response has no current action for that owner.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Use [Stored intent memory state] only when the latest visible response clearly repeats or continues that same action.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Generate ROLL_PANEL, COMBAT_PANEL, and DEFENSE_PANEL only from the same PANEL_INTENT snapshot. Cards belong to owners whose PANEL_INTENT is a current action.")
    end
    if not manualSnapshot then
        table.insert(lines, "")
        table.insert(lines, "Rules for INTENT_AUX:")
        table.insert(lines, "- INTENT_AUX reports current action evidence from [Latest visible Main response - full].")
        table.insert(lines, "- Return exactly four markers: one each for sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, and yuseola.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Each INTENT_AUX value is the owner's current declared or clearly implied action from the latest visible response.")
        table.insert(lines, "- For owners whose current action is absent from the latest visible response, emit the ASCII word none.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Keep INTENT_AUX to action text only: table action, object, target, and verb.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Lua applies INTENT_AUX for owners with missing Main INTENT marker presence; explicit Main INTENT values stay authoritative.")
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmBuildGuideLeadPrompt(triggerId)
    local summary = tmSessionBriefValue(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", "")
    local episode = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    local episodeContent = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episode)
    local languageName = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local voiceStyle = tmGuideLeadVoiceStyle(triggerId)
    local rollSummary = tmRollResultSummary(triggerId)
    local wrapupCue = tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId)
    local lines = {
        "Write the next paste-ready GM speech/narration for the user's TRPG session.",
        "Output language: " .. languageName .. " (selected by the game's lang setting).",
        voiceStyle,
        "Length: 1-2 short spoken table sentences.",
        "Return a non-empty lead. A blank response is invalid.",
        "GUIDE_LEAD is the exact text the GM can paste or say aloud to the players.",
        "GUIDE_LEAD content is plain visible table narration only; control markers and hidden bookkeeping stay outside it.",
        "GUIDE_LEAD is visible GM speech/narration for scene facts, sensory pressure, and resolved roll outcomes.",
        "Write the finished in-world GM line itself, as if the user already pressed the button and the text entered the chat box.",
        "Phrase roll-related moments as visible fiction: what the characters notice, touch, hear, reveal, or trigger from the established result.",
        "Use exact PC/player labels from [PC/player labels], in the form PC name (real player name).",
        "Use [Current Main INTENT markers parsed from latest response] and [Current scene] as the action sources.",
        "Use [Service scene guidance] when the current visible scene is a church, temple, shrine, priest, healer, inn, lodging, shop, merchant, market, or service counter.",
        "GUIDE_LEAD may offer service options before confirmation. GUIDE_LEAD carries completed recovery, rest, buy, or sale when Lua runtime already reflects it or the current panel pass has a confirmed service or skill-use row.",
        "Use [Stored intent memory state] as memory status for cleanup decisions.",
        "Before a roll result exists, describe the immediate scene response and fictional pressure around current attempts; when the current action is uncertain, include a light roll-call cue in natural table language while exact stat/DC details stay in the card or hidden state.",
        "ROLL_PANEL, COMBAT_PANEL, and DEFENSE_PANEL markers returned in this same response are already roll results for GUIDE_LEAD.",
        "After a roll result exists, GUIDE_LEAD MUST continue from that resolved result as the next fictional beat: success, partial success, failure cost, clue revealed, danger change, or consequence.",
        "End on sensory detail, consequence, tension, or a clear roll-call cue for the pending attempt.",
        "Keep a steady scenario pace: reveal a new visible clue, pressure, reaction, path, or complication when the scene would otherwise stall, while preserving meaningful player choices.",
        "The user GM keeps authority over exact ability, DC, and final adjudication; GUIDE_LEAD may lightly cue that the declared action should be decided with a roll.",
        "Write visible facts around the current action source only. Hidden mechanics and exact procedure remain with the user GM, while simple dice language may cue pending uncertain actions.",
        "Hidden mechanics and hidden facts remain in panel/hidden state: DC, target numbers, ability abbreviations, hidden monsters, traps, failure branches, and success conditions.",
        "GUIDE_LEAD contains fiction-first GM speech; ROLL, COMBAT, CONDITION_APPLY, HP, MP, EPISODE, FLAG, stat abbreviations, and target-number notation remain in markers or panel state.",
        "GUIDE_LEAD is the finished GM line itself, not an instruction to another writer.",
        "Keep visible GUIDE_LEAD focused on fiction: sensory detail, discoveries, consequences, pressure, and character-facing narration.",
        "Use sensory/result scene phrasing rather than task-brief phrasing.",
        "Keep the text as words the GM can say aloud at the table.",
        "Return plain visible text only.",
        "",
        "[PC/player labels]", tmGuideLeadLabelContext(triggerId),
        "[Current scene]", summary,
        tmServiceGuideContext(triggerId),
        "[Current Main INTENT markers parsed from latest response]", tmCurrentMainIntentBlock(triggerId),
        "[Stored intent memory state]", tmStoredIntentMemoryBlock(triggerId),
        "[Intent source diagnostics]", tmIntentSourceDiagnostics(triggerId),
        "[Most recent roll result]", rollSummary,
        "[Session summary]", getVar(triggerId, "session_log_summary", ""),
        "[Scenario wrap-up cue]", wrapupCue ~= "" and wrapupCue or "- none",
        "",
        tmPacePromptBlock(triggerId, "panel", false),
    }
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmSanitizePanelBrief(raw)
    local text = tmStripControlMarkers(tmStripInternalGuideBlocks(tostring(raw or "")))
    text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("{{.-}}", "")
    text = text:gsub("<.->", "")
    text = text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    text = text:gsub("[ \t]+\n", "\n")
    text = text:gsub("\n\n\n+", "\n\n")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if text == "" then return "" end
    if countKeywords(text, {"▥", "<<", ">>", "{{", "}}", "<div", "</div", "<img"}) > 0 then return "" end
    if countKeywords(text, {
        "초보 플레이어", "행동 선언", "선언 방법", "마스터의 판정", "GM의 판정",
        "판정 안내", "판정을 기다", "룰 설명", "튜토리얼"
    }) > 0 then return "" end
    return text
end

function tmBuildSessionPanelPrompt(triggerId, retryMode, manualSnapshot)
    tmMaybeAutoclearEnemyForTerminalEpisode(triggerId, "panel_prompt")
    local episode = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    local episodeContent = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episode)
    local languageName = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local firstSessionOpening = getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_opening_text", "")
    local wrapupCue = tmScenarioWrapupCue(triggerId)
    local wrapupEpisode = getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_episode", "")
    local wrapupConfirmed = getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") == "true"
    local recentContext = tmBuildRecentChatContext(triggerId, 1)
    local flags = tmBuildPanelContextFlags(triggerId, recentContext, retryMode, manualSnapshot)
    local threatInfo = tmCurrentThreatInfo(triggerId)
    local threatOutcome = "- none"
    if threatInfo then
        threatOutcome = string.format("%s / HP %d/%d / state=%s",
            threatInfo.name, threatInfo.hp, threatInfo.hpMax, threatInfo.state)
    end
    local outcomeSummary = table.concat({
        "last_episode_event=" .. getVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", ""),
        "party_xp=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0)),
        "party_gold=" .. tostring(type(tmGetPartyGold) == "function" and tmGetPartyGold(triggerId) or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)),
        "party_status=" .. tmPartyStatusSummary(triggerId),
        "current_threat=" .. threatOutcome,
    }, "\n")
    local rollMarkerShape = "▥ROLL_PANEL:dice_id|owner|stat_key|dc|bonus|penalty|action or none▥"
    local combatMarkerShape = "▥COMBAT_PANEL:dice_id|actor|enemy:current|stat_key|mode|dc|bonus|penalty|action or none|enemy display name▥"
    local defenseMarkerShape = "▥DEFENSE_PANEL:dice_id|defender|enemy:current|stat_key|defense_mode|dc|bonus|penalty|incoming_damage|damage_kind|action or none|enemy display name▥"
    local cardContractLines
    if not flags.needs_card_context then
        cardContractLines = table.concat({
            "[Panel guide contract]",
            "Build BRIEF and GUIDE_LEAD from the latest visible Main response, compact Lua state, and enabled AUX observation rows.",
            "Card marker grammar is compacted for this pass because no current roll/combat/defense context is active.",
            "Use roll-call wording only when the latest visible response itself asks for an uncertain action or check.",
        }, "\n")
    elseif manualSnapshot then
        cardContractLines = table.concat({
            "[Manual refresh actual recomputation contract]",
            "This manual refresh is an actual table input. Recompute the panel result from the restored baseline state, not from any previous refresh result.",
            "Return exactly four PANEL_INTENT markers first, one per owner, using the current action snapshot for this refresh.",
            "Generate ROLL_PANEL, COMBAT_PANEL, and DEFENSE_PANEL only from that same PANEL_INTENT snapshot. Cards belong to owners whose PANEL_INTENT is a current action.",
            "Use only dice_id values from [Stored turn dice pool] for ROLL_PANEL, COMBAT_PANEL, and DEFENSE_PANEL.",
            "Create normal roll/combat/defense cards only for owners with dice rows. Blocked roll owners use none for normal card rows.",
            "ROLL_PANEL uses the selected stored d20 plus your chosen owner/stat_key/dc/bonus/penalty/action.",
            "COMBAT_PANEL uses the selected stored d20 plus your chosen actor/target/stat_key/mode/dc/bonus/penalty/action/enemy display name.",
            "DEFENSE_PANEL uses the selected stored d20 plus defender/enemy/stat_key/defense_mode/dc/bonus/penalty/incoming_damage/damage_kind/action/enemy display name.",

    else
        cardContractLines = table.concat({
            "[Panel card contract]",

            "COMBAT_PANEL uses the selected stored d20 plus your chosen actor/target/stat_key/mode/dc/bonus/penalty/action/enemy display name.",

            "Use complete action phrases instead of fragments such as 조사, 회피, 공격, 함정 탐색, 룬 문자 해독, 압 판 피하며 진입, or 진짜 색인 판별.",
            "Examples: ▥ROLL_PANEL:dice_1|sinsoyul|wis|11|0|0|함정을 탐색한다▥ / ▥ROLL_PANEL:dice_4|yuseola|int|11|0|0|룬 문자를 해독해본다▥",
            "Combat examples: ▥COMBAT_PANEL:dice_2|kimminhee|enemy:current|dex|strike|0|0|0|기습 공격을 시도한다|고블린 정찰병▥ / ▥COMBAT_PANEL:dice_3|junghanna|en_l1_standard_lesser_folk|int|spell|0|0|0|작은 화염탄을 날린다|고블린 정찰병▥",

            "bonus and penalty are integer situation modifiers; use 0 when neutral.",
            "Lua runtime outcomes are the current mechanical truth: enemy defeat, skill MP spending, HP damage or healing, XP, gold, level-up readiness, current threat, party status, and session progress.",

    end
    local lines = {
        "Refresh the TRPG session panel from the actual current chat and state.",
        "Output language: " .. languageName .. " (selected by the game's lang setting).",
        tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" and "Korean particle rule: for generated names/titles, do not attach bare particles that may be wrong; use safe particles like '이(가)', '은(는)', '을(를)' or rephrase." or "",

        tmGuideLeadLabelContext(triggerId),

        tmPanelActionGroundingBlock(triggerId),
        "",
        "[Runtime objects]",
        tmRuntimeObjectSummary(triggerId) ~= "" and tmRuntimeObjectSummary(triggerId) or "- none",
        "",
        "[Current TRPG place context]",
        tmPlaceCurrentContextPromptLine(triggerId),
        "",
        "[Lua state sanity]",
        flags.needs_debug_diagnostics and tmPanelStateSanityBlock(triggerId) or "- compacted for this pass",
        "",
        "[Lua runtime outcome summary]",
        outcomeSummary,
        "",
        (flags.needs_inventory_context or flags.needs_skill_use_context) and tmPanelInventoryContext(triggerId) or "[Inventory context]\n- compacted for this pass",
        "",
        flags.needs_service_context and tmServiceGuideContext(triggerId) or "",
        "",
        "[Intent source diagnostics]",
        flags.needs_debug_diagnostics and tmIntentSourceDiagnostics(triggerId) or "- compacted for this pass",
        "",
        "[Enemy audit diagnostics]",
        flags.needs_debug_diagnostics and tmEnemyAuditDiagnostics(triggerId) or "- compacted for this pass",
        "",
        "[Session summary]",
        flags.needs_debug_diagnostics and getVar(triggerId, "session_log_summary", "") or "- compacted for this pass",
        "",
        "[Scenario wrap-up cue]",
        wrapupCue ~= "" and wrapupCue or "- none",
        "wrapup_episode=" .. (wrapupEpisode ~= "" and wrapupEpisode or "- none"),
        "wrapup_user_confirmed=" .. tostring(wrapupConfirmed),
        "",
        tmPacePromptBlock(triggerId, "panel", false),
        "",
        "[Recent session log]",
        flags.needs_debug_diagnostics and getVar(triggerId, "session_log_recent", "") or "- compacted for this pass",
        "",
        "[Most recent roll result]",
        flags.needs_card_context and tmResolvedTurnResultText(triggerId) or "- compacted for this pass",
    }
    if retryMode == "fresh_angle" then
        table.insert(lines, "")
        table.insert(lines, "[Fresh angle request]")
        table.insert(lines, "Focus on the newest change after the latest player declarations.")
        table.insert(lines, "Advance the table handoff by one visible step.")
        table.insert(lines, "Use a new focal detail, location, reaction, pressure, or consequence.")
        table.insert(lines, "If the same clue still matters, show the next observable consequence of that clue.")
        table.insert(lines, "Write the guide lead as the GM's next table-facing narration.")
        table.insert(lines, "Keep the lead grounded in the current state and recent player intent.")
    elseif retryMode == "card_result_required" then
        table.insert(lines, "")
        table.insert(lines, "[Resolved card result]")
        table.insert(lines, "Return ▥ROLL_PANEL:none▥, ▥COMBAT_PANEL:none▥, and ▥DEFENSE_PANEL:none▥ in this response.")
        table.insert(lines, "Use this resolved card summary as completed fiction: " .. (getVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", "") ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", "") or tmRollResultSummary(triggerId)))
        table.insert(lines, "Use [Lua runtime outcome summary] for enemy HP, defeat, player HP/MP, XP, gold, and status after those cards.")
        table.insert(lines, "Write BRIEF and GUIDE_LEAD as the next scene beat after those completed results.")
    end
    local episodeExcerpt = flags.needs_episode_context and tmEpisodeRuntimePromptExcerpt(triggerId, episodeContent, "panel") or ""
    if episodeExcerpt ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "")
        table.insert(lines, "[Active episode runtime excerpt]")
        table.insert(lines, episodeExcerpt)
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
