function tmRewardMainAuthorityMode(triggerId)
    local raw = getVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_MAIN_AUTH_MODE_KEY, TM_REWARD_MAIN_AUTH_DEFAULT_MODE)
    local mode = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(raw)
    if TM_REWARD_MAIN_AUTH_MODES[mode] then return mode end
    return TM_REWARD_MAIN_AUTH_DEFAULT_MODE
end

function tmShouldCaptureMainRewardMarkerEvidence(triggerId)
    return tmRewardMainAuthorityMode(triggerId) == "active_compat"
end

function tmShouldApplyMainRewardMarker(triggerId)
    return tmRewardMainAuthorityMode(triggerId) == "active_compat"
end

function tmHandleMainRewardCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, kind, payload, applyFn)
    if not tmShouldApplyMainRewardMarker(triggerId) then return "" end
    if type(applyFn) ~= "function" then return "" end
    return applyFn(kind, payload) or ""
end

function tmStripMainRewardCompatibilityLeaks(text)
    local output = tostring(text or "")
    output = output:gsub("▥REWARD:item:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥REWARD:skillbook:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_NAME:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_EFFECT:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥SKILLBOOK_EFFECT:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<REWARD:item:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<REWARD:skillbook:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_NAME:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_EFFECT:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<SKILLBOOK_EFFECT:[^>]+>>", "")
    return output
end

function tmRewardCompareSplitLine(line, expected)
    local fields = {}
    for part in (tostring(line or "") .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        table.insert(fields, tmPackUnescape(part))
    end
    while #fields < expected do table.insert(fields, "") end
    return fields
end

function tmEpisodeSnapshotLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.status or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.id or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.markers or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.item_marker or "false"),
        tmPackEscape(row.skillbook_marker or "false"),
        tmPackEscape(row.fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmEpisodeSnapshotFromLine(line)
    local fields = tmRewardCompareSplitLine(line, 6)
    return {
        status = fields[1] ~= "" and fields[1] or "missing",
        id = fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] or "none",
        markers = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none",
        item_marker = fields[4] == "true" and "true" or "false",
        skillbook_marker = fields[5] == "true" and "true" or "false",
        fp = fields[6] or "",
    }
end

function tmMainEpisodeHasExplicitItemGrant(raw)
    local text = tostring(raw or "")
    return text:find("▥ITEM_NAME:", 1, true) ~= nil
        or text:find("▥REWARD:item:", 1, true) ~= nil
        or text:find("▥SHOP:buy:", 1, true) ~= nil
        or text:find("▥SHOP:buyq:", 1, true) ~= nil
        or text:find("<<REWARD:item:", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function tmMainEpisodeHasExplicitSkillbookGrant(raw)
    return tostring(raw or ""):find("▥REWARD:skillbook:", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function tmEpisodeMainAuthorityMode(triggerId)
    local mode = tmPanelCueCleanField(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_EPISODE_MAIN_AUTH_MODE_KEY) or "", 40):lower()
    if mode == "strip_only" then return "strip_only" end
    if mode == "active_compat" then return "strip_only" end
    return TM_EPISODE_MAIN_AUTH_DEFAULT_MODE
end

function tmShouldCaptureMainEpisodeMarkerEvidence(triggerId)
    return false
end

function tmShouldApplyMainEpisodeMarker(triggerId)
    return false
end

function tmEpisodeMainAuthorityPromptText(triggerId)
    return "- Episode Main authority mode is strip_only: Lua strips leaked Main episode markers as compatibility text. Accepted automatic panel AUX_EPISODE may fill Main-missing current-episode lifecycle gaps through existing writers."
end

function tmApplyMainEpisodeCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, kind, options)
    if not tmShouldApplyMainEpisodeMarker(triggerId) then return false end
    local opts = options or {}
    local markerKind = tostring(kind or ""):lower()

    if markerKind == "wrapup" then
        return tmSetScenarioWrapupSuggested(triggerId, opts.source or "marker")
    end
    if markerKind == "start" then
        return tmApplyEpisodeStartMarker(triggerId, opts.episodeId, opts.source or "episode_start_marker")
    end
    if markerKind == "node" then
        return tmApplyEpisodeNodeMarker(triggerId, opts.episodeId, opts.nodeId, opts.source or "episode_node_marker")
    end
    if markerKind == "clear" then
        return tmApplyEpisodeClearMarker(triggerId, opts.episodeId, {
            source = opts.source or "episode_clear_marker",
            skipItem = opts.skipItem == true,
            skipSkillbook = opts.skipSkillbook == true,
        })
    end
    if markerKind == "fail" then
        return tmApplyEpisodeFailMarker(triggerId, opts.episodeId, opts.source or "episode_fail_marker")
    end
    if markerKind == "flag" then
        return tmApplyEpisodeFlagMarker(triggerId, opts.op, opts.flagId, opts.source or "flag_marker")
    end
    return false
end

function tmStripMainEpisodeCompatibilityLeaks(output)
    local text = tostring(output or "")
    text = text:gsub("▥WRAPUP:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥WRAPUP▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<WRAPUP:[^>]*>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<WRAPUP>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥EPISODE_START:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<EPISODE_START:[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥EPISODE_NODE:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<EPISODE_NODE:[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥EPISODE_CLEAR:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<EPISODE_CLEAR:[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥EPISODE_FAIL:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<EPISODE_FAIL:[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥FLAG:add:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<FLAG:add:[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥FLAG:remove:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<FLAG:remove:[^>]+>>", "")
    return text
end

function tmCaptureMainEpisodeMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    local raw = tostring(output or "")
    if not tmShouldCaptureMainEpisodeMarkerEvidence(triggerId) then
        local snapshot = {
            status = "none",
            id = "none",
            markers = "strip_only",
            item_marker = tmMainEpisodeHasExplicitItemGrant(raw) and "true" or "false",
            skillbook_marker = tmMainEpisodeHasExplicitSkillbookGrant(raw) and "true" or "false",
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
        }
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_EPISODE_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmEpisodeSnapshotLine(snapshot))
        return snapshot
    end
    local status, episodeId = "none", "none"
    local markers, seen = {}, {}
    local function mark(name)
        local marker = tostring(name or "")
        if marker ~= "" and not seen[marker] then
            table.insert(markers, marker)
            seen[marker] = true
        end
    end
    local function setPrimary(nextStatus, nextEpisode, marker)
        if status == "none" then
            status = tostring(nextStatus or "unknown")
            local cleanEpisode = tmPanelCueCleanField(nextEpisode or "none", 80)
            episodeId = cleanEpisode ~= "" and cleanEpisode or "none"
        end
        mark(marker)
    end

    for id in raw:gmatch("▥EPISODE_CLEAR:([%w_%-]+)▥") do setPrimary("clear", id, "EPISODE_CLEAR") end
    for id in raw:gmatch("<<EPISODE_CLEAR:([%w_%-]+)>>") do setPrimary("clear", id, "EPISODE_CLEAR") end
    for id in raw:gmatch("▥EPISODE_FAIL:([%w_%-]+)▥") do setPrimary("fail", id, "EPISODE_FAIL") end
    for id in raw:gmatch("<<EPISODE_FAIL:([%w_%-]+)>>") do setPrimary("fail", id, "EPISODE_FAIL") end
    for id in raw:gmatch("▥EPISODE_START:([%w_%-]+)▥") do setPrimary("start", id, "EPISODE_START") end
    for id in raw:gmatch("<<EPISODE_START:([%w_%-]+)>>") do setPrimary("start", id, "EPISODE_START") end
    for id in raw:gmatch("▥EPISODE_NODE:([%w_%-]+):[%w_%-]+▥") do setPrimary("node", id, "EPISODE_NODE") end
    for id in raw:gmatch("<<EPISODE_NODE:([%w_%-]+):[%w_%-]+>>") do setPrimary("node", id, "EPISODE_NODE") end
    if raw:find("▥WRAPUP▥", 1, true) or raw:find("▥WRAPUP:", 1, true)
        or raw:find("<<WRAPUP>>", 1, true) or raw:find("<<WRAPUP:", 1, true) then
        setPrimary("wrapup", tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId), "WRAPUP")
    end
    if raw:find("▥FLAG:add:", 1, true) or raw:find("▥FLAG:remove:", 1, true)
        or raw:find("<<FLAG:add:", 1, true) or raw:find("<<FLAG:remove:", 1, true) then
        setPrimary("flag", tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId), "FLAG")
    end

    local snapshot = {
        status = status,
        id = episodeId,
        markers = #markers > 0 and table.concat(markers, ",") or "none",
        item_marker = tmMainEpisodeHasExplicitItemGrant(raw) and "true" or "false",
        skillbook_marker = tmMainEpisodeHasExplicitSkillbookGrant(raw) and "true" or "false",
        fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
    }
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_EPISODE_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmEpisodeSnapshotLine(snapshot))
    return snapshot
end

function tmEpisodeReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_EPISODE_SNAPSHOT_KEY) or "")
    if raw == "" then
        return {status = "missing", id = "none", markers = "none", item_marker = "false", skillbook_marker = "false", fp = ""}
    end
    return tmEpisodeSnapshotFromLine(raw)
end

function tmEpisodeAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, main, parsed, episodeId)
    local fields = parsed and parsed.fields or {}
    return "ep" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(table.concat({
        tostring(fields[2] or ""),
        tostring(parsed and parsed.status or ""),
        tostring(episodeId or ""),
        tostring(fields[5] or ""),
        tostring(main and main.fp or ""),
        tostring(tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)),
    }, "\n"))
end

function tmEpisodeAuxLifecycleKeySeen(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    return csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, TM_EPISODE_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEYS_VAR, ""), token)
end

function tmRememberEpisodeAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    local items = parseList(getVar(triggerId, TM_EPISODE_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEYS_VAR, ""), ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == token then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, token)
    while #items > TM_EPISODE_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_EPISODE_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmConditionSnapshotLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.status or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.owner or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.condition or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.duration or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.markers or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmConditionSnapshotFromLine(line)
    local fields = tmRewardCompareSplitLine(line, 6)
    return {
        status = fields[1] ~= "" and fields[1] or "missing",
        owner = fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] or "none",
        condition = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none",
        duration = fields[4] ~= "" and fields[4] or "none",
        markers = fields[5] ~= "" and fields[5] or "none",
        fp = fields[6] or "",
    }
end

function tmCaptureMainConditionMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    local raw = tostring(output or "")
    local rows, markers, seen = {}, {}, {}
    local function add(op, ownerId, conditionId, marker)
        local cleanOp = tmAuxNormalizeActorOp(op)
        local cleanOwner = tmPanelCueCleanField(ownerId or "none", 48)
        if cleanOwner == "" then cleanOwner = "none" end
        local cleanCondition = tmAuxNormalizeConditionId(conditionId or "none")
        local cleanMarker = tostring(marker or "CONDITION")
        table.insert(rows, {op = cleanOp, owner = cleanOwner, condition = cleanCondition, marker = cleanMarker})
        if not seen[cleanMarker] then
            table.insert(markers, cleanMarker)
            seen[cleanMarker] = true
        end
    end

    for payload in raw:gmatch("▥CONDITION_APPLY:(.-)▥") do
        local ownerId, conditionId = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|.*$")
        if ownerId then add("apply", ownerId, conditionId, "CONDITION_APPLY") end
    end
    for ownerId, conditionId in raw:gmatch("<<CONDITION_APPLY:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|[^>]*>>") do
        add("apply", ownerId, conditionId, "CONDITION_APPLY")
    end
    for payload in raw:gmatch("▥CONDITION_CLEAR:(.-)▥") do
        local ownerId, conditionId = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|.*$")
        if ownerId then add("clear", ownerId, conditionId, "CONDITION_CLEAR") end
    end
    for ownerId, conditionId in raw:gmatch("<<CONDITION_CLEAR:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|[^>]*>>") do
        add("clear", ownerId, conditionId, "CONDITION_CLEAR")
    end
    for _ in raw:gmatch("▥CONDITION_TICK:.-▥") do add("tick", "none", "all", "CONDITION_TICK") end
    for _ in raw:gmatch("<<CONDITION_TICK:[^>]*>>") do add("tick", "none", "all", "CONDITION_TICK") end

    local snapshot
    if #rows == 0 then
        snapshot = {status = "none", owner = "none", condition = "none", duration = "none", markers = "none", fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw)}
    else
        local primary = rows[1]
        snapshot = {
            status = primary.op,
            owner = primary.owner,
            condition = primary.condition,
            duration = "none",
            markers = table.concat(markers, ","),
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
        }
    end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_CONDITION_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmConditionSnapshotLine(snapshot))
    return snapshot
end

function tmConditionReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_CONDITION_SNAPSHOT_KEY) or "")
    if raw == "" then
        return {status = "missing", owner = "none", condition = "none", duration = "none", markers = "none", fp = ""}
    end
    return tmConditionSnapshotFromLine(raw)
end

function tmRewardCompareLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmRewardSnapshotLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.status or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.name or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.qty or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.markers or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmRewardSnapshotFromLine(line)
    local fields = tmRewardCompareSplitLine(line, 6)
    return {
        status = fields[1] ~= "" and fields[1] or "missing",
        kind = fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] or "none",
        name = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none",
        qty = fields[4] ~= "" and fields[4] or "none",
        markers = fields[5] ~= "" and fields[5] or "none",
        fp = fields[6] or "",
    }
end

function tmRewardPayloadHead(payload)
    local text = tostring(payload or "")
    local sep = text:find("|", 1, true)
    if sep then text = text:sub(1, sep - 1) end
    local clean = tmPanelCueCleanField(text, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX or 80)
    return clean ~= "" and clean or "none"
end

function tmRewardSkillNameFromPayload(payload)
    local text = tostring(payload or "")
    local sep = text:find("|", 1, true)
    if sep then text = text:sub(sep + 1) end
    return tmRewardPayloadHead(text)
end

function tmRewardSkillbookNameFromPayload(payload)
    local text = tostring(payload or "")
    local name = text:match("name%s*=%s*([^|]+)")
    if name and name ~= "" then return tmRewardPayloadHead(name) end
    return tmRewardPayloadHead(text)
end

function tmRewardEvidencePriority(kind)
    local k = tostring(kind or "")
    if k == "skillbook" then return 1 end
    if k == "item" or k == "equipment" then return 2 end
    if k == "skill" then return 3 end
    if k == "gold" then return 4 end
    if k == "xp" then return 5 end
    return 9
end

function tmRewardPrimaryEvidence(rows)
    local best = nil
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if not best or tmRewardEvidencePriority(row.kind) < tmRewardEvidencePriority(best.kind) then
            best = row
        end
    end
    return best
end

function tmCaptureMainRewardMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    local raw = tostring(output or "")
    if not tmShouldCaptureMainRewardMarkerEvidence(triggerId) then
        local snapshot = {
            status = "none",
            kind = "none",
            name = "none",
            qty = "none",
            markers = "strip_only",
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
        }
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_REWARD_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmRewardSnapshotLine(snapshot))
        return snapshot
    end
    local rows, markers, seen = {}, {}, {}
    local function add(kind, name, qty, marker)
        local cleanKind = tostring(kind or "unknown")
        local cleanName = tmPanelCueCleanField(name or "none", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX or 80)
        if cleanName == "" then cleanName = "none" end
        local cleanQty = tmPanelCueCleanField(qty or "none", 32)
        if cleanQty == "" then cleanQty = "none" end
        local cleanMarker = tostring(marker or "UNKNOWN")
        table.insert(rows, {kind = cleanKind, name = cleanName, qty = cleanQty, marker = cleanMarker})
        if not seen[cleanMarker] then
            table.insert(markers, cleanMarker)
            seen[cleanMarker] = true
        end
    end

    for amount in raw:gmatch("▥REWARD:xp:(%d+)▥") do add("xp", "xp", amount, "REWARD_XP") end
    for amount in raw:gmatch("<<REWARD:xp:(%d+)>>") do add("xp", "xp", amount, "REWARD_XP") end
    for payload in raw:gmatch("▥REWARD:item:(.-)▥") do add("item", tmRewardPayloadHead(payload), "1", "REWARD_ITEM") end
    for payload in raw:gmatch("<<REWARD:item:([^>]+)>>") do add("item", tmRewardPayloadHead(payload), "1", "REWARD_ITEM") end
    for payload in raw:gmatch("▥ITEM_NAME:(.-)▥") do add("item", tmRewardPayloadHead(payload), "1", "ITEM_NAME") end
    for payload in raw:gmatch("▥REWARD:skillbook:(.-)▥") do add("skillbook", tmRewardSkillbookNameFromPayload(payload), "1", "REWARD_SKILLBOOK") end
    for payload in raw:gmatch("▥SKILL_NAME:(.-)▥") do add("skill", tmRewardSkillNameFromPayload(payload), "1", "SKILL_NAME") end
    for label, price in raw:gmatch("▥SHOP:buy:(.-)|(%d+)▥") do add("item", tmRewardPayloadHead(label), price, "SHOP_BUY") end
    for label, unitPrice, qty in raw:gmatch("▥SHOP:buyq:(.-)|(%d+)|(%d+)▥") do add("item", tmRewardPayloadHead(label), tmServiceCleanQty(qty, "1"), "SHOP_BUY_Q") end
    for episodeId in raw:gmatch("▥EPISODE_CLEAR:([%w_%-]+)▥") do add("unknown", episodeId, "none", "EPISODE_CLEAR") end
    for episodeId in raw:gmatch("<<EPISODE_CLEAR:([%w_%-]+)>>") do add("unknown", episodeId, "none", "EPISODE_CLEAR") end

    local snapshot
    if #rows == 0 then
        snapshot = {status = "none", kind = "none", name = "none", qty = "none", markers = "none", fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw)}
    else
        local primary = tmRewardPrimaryEvidence(rows)
        snapshot = {
            status = "present",
            kind = primary.kind,
            name = primary.name,
            qty = primary.qty,
            markers = table.concat(markers, ","),
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
        }
    end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_REWARD_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmRewardSnapshotLine(snapshot))
    return snapshot
end

function tmRewardReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_REWARD_SNAPSHOT_KEY) or "")
    if raw == "" then
        return {status = "missing", kind = "none", name = "none", qty = "none", markers = "none", fp = ""}
    end
    return tmRewardSnapshotFromLine(raw)
end

function tmRewardMissingAuxParsed(source)
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_REWARD", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = ""}
end

function tmRewardAuxParsedRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local parsedRows = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_REWARD" then
            table.insert(parsedRows, tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux"))
        end
    end
    if #parsedRows == 0 then
        table.insert(parsedRows, tmRewardMissingAuxParsed(source))
    end
    return parsedRows
end

function tmRewardFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    return tmRewardAuxParsedRows(triggerId, rows, source)[1]
end

function tmAuxItemMetaParsedRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local parsedRows = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_ITEM_META" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
            if parsed.reason == "ok" then
                table.insert(parsedRows, parsed)
            end
        end
    end
    return parsedRows
end

function tmCanonicalRewardNameToken(name)
    local text = tmPanelCueCleanField(name or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX or 80):lower()
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    text = text:gsub("^[\"'`“”‘’]+", ""):gsub("[\"'`“”‘’]+$", "")
    text = text:gsub("^%[", ""):gsub("%]$", ""):gsub("^%(", ""):gsub("%)$", "")
    for _, wrapper in ipairs({"아이템", "보상", "카드", "전리품", "item", "reward", "card", "loot"}) do
        text = text:gsub(wrapper, "")
    end
    text = text:gsub("[%p%s]+", "")
    return text
end

function tmAuxItemMetaNameToken(meta)
    local fields = meta and meta.fields or {}
    return tmCanonicalRewardNameToken(fields[2] or "")
end

function tmFindAuxItemMetaForReward(proof, aux, metas)
    local name = proof and proof.name or ""
    local wanted = tmCanonicalRewardNameToken(name)
    if wanted == "" or wanted == "none" or wanted == "unknown" then return nil end
    local first = nil
    for _, meta in ipairs(metas or {}) do
        local token = tmAuxItemMetaNameToken(meta)
        if token ~= "" and token == wanted then return meta end
        if not first then first = meta end
    end
    if #(metas or {}) == 1 then return first end
    return nil
end

function tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, index)
    if not meta or not meta.fields then return "" end
    return tostring(meta.fields[index] or "")
end

function tmRewardKindsCompatible(mainKind, auxKind)
    local main = tostring(mainKind or "")
    local aux = tostring(auxKind or "")
    if main == aux then return true end
    if (main == "item" and aux == "equipment") or (main == "equipment" and aux == "item") then return true end
    if main == "item" and (aux == "consumable" or aux == "key") then return true end
    if aux == "item" and (main == "consumable" or main == "key") then return true end
    if main == "unknown" and aux ~= "" and aux ~= "none" and aux ~= "unknown" then return true end
    return false
end

function tmRewardNameToken(name)
    local text = tmPanelCueCleanField(name or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX or 80):lower()
    text = text:gsub("%s+", " ")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return text
end

function tmRewardHasComparableName(name)
    local token = tmRewardNameToken(name)
    return token ~= "" and token ~= "none" and token ~= "unknown" and token ~= "-"
end

function tmRewardCompareStatus(main, aux)
    local auxStatus = tostring(aux.status or "missing")
    local auxKind = aux.fields and tmAuxNormalizeEnum(aux.fields[2] or "") or "none"
    local auxName = aux.fields and tmPanelCueCleanField(aux.fields[4] or "none", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX or 80) or "none"
    if auxKind == "" then auxKind = "none" end
    if auxName == "" then auxName = "none" end

    if auxStatus == "malformed" then return "aux_malformed", aux.reason or "malformed", auxKind, auxName end
    if auxStatus == "missing" then return "aux_missing", "missing", auxKind, auxName end
    if auxStatus == "unknown" then return "aux_unknown", "unknown", auxKind, auxName end
    if main.status == "missing" then return "main_snapshot_missing", "missing_main_snapshot", auxKind, auxName end
    if main.status == "none" and auxStatus == "none" then return "both_none", "ok", auxKind, auxName end
    if main.status == "none" and auxStatus == "present" then return "main_missing_aux_present", "main_missing", auxKind, auxName end
    if main.status == "present" and auxStatus == "none" then return "main_present_aux_none", "aux_none", auxKind, auxName end
    if main.status == "present" and auxStatus == "present" then
        if not tmRewardKindsCompatible(main.kind, auxKind) then
            return "kind_mismatch", "kind", auxKind, auxName
        end
        if tmRewardHasComparableName(main.name) and tmRewardHasComparableName(auxName)
            and tmRewardNameToken(main.name) ~= tmRewardNameToken(auxName) then
            return "name_mismatch", "name", auxKind, auxName
        end
        if tostring(main.markers or ""):find(",", 1, true) then
            return "match", "ok_multi_main", auxKind, auxName
        end
        return "match", "ok", auxKind, auxName
    end
    return "aux_unknown", "unhandled", auxKind, auxName
end

function tmStoreRewardCompareDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmRewardCompareLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_COMPARE_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_REWARD_COMPARE_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_COMPARE_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_COMPARE_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return true
end

function tmRewardDuplicateProofLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.proof_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.evidence_source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.qty or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.context or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.compare_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmRewardDuplicateCanonicalKind(kind)
    local token = tostring(kind or ""):lower()
    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    token = token:gsub("[%s%-]+", "_")
    if token == "" or token == "-" then return "none" end
    if token == "equipment" then return "item" end
    return token
end

function tmRewardDuplicateCleanName(name)
    local clean = tmPanelCueCleanField(name or "none", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX or 80)
    clean = clean:gsub("%s+", " ")
    clean = clean:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return clean ~= "" and clean or "none"
end

function tmRewardDuplicateNameToken(name)
    return tmRewardDuplicateCleanName(name):lower()
end

function tmRewardDuplicateQty(kind, qty)
    local clean = tmPanelCueCleanField(qty or "", 32)
    clean = clean:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if clean ~= "" and clean ~= "-" and clean ~= "none" then return clean end
    local k = tmRewardDuplicateCanonicalKind(kind)
    if k == "item" or k == "consumable" or k == "key" or k == "skillbook" or k == "skill" then return "1" end
    return "none"
end

function tmRewardDuplicateContext(triggerId)
    local episode = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", ""), 48)
    local node = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "episode_node", ""), 48)
    local scenario = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", ""), 48)
    local session = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", ""), 24)
    return table.concat({
        "ep=" .. (episode ~= "" and episode or "none"),
        "node=" .. (node ~= "" and node or "none"),
        "scenario=" .. (scenario ~= "" and scenario or "none"),
        "session=" .. (session ~= "" and session or "none"),
    }, ";")
end

function tmRewardDuplicateProofKey(kind, name, qty, mainFp, baselineFp, context)
    local material = table.concat({
        tmRewardDuplicateCanonicalKind(kind),
        tmRewardDuplicateNameToken(name),
        tmRewardDuplicateQty(kind, qty),
        tostring(mainFp or ""),
        tostring(baselineFp or ""),
        tostring(context or ""),
    }, "\31")
    return "rw#" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(material)
end

function tmRewardDuplicateAuxQty(aux)
    if aux and aux.fields then
        return aux.fields[5] or ""
    end
    return ""
end

function tmRewardDuplicateCandidateRow(triggerId, source, evidenceSource, kind, name, qty, mainFp, baselineFp, compareStatus, reason)
    local cleanKind = tmRewardDuplicateCanonicalKind(kind)
    local cleanName = tmRewardDuplicateCleanName(name)
    local cleanQty = tmRewardDuplicateQty(cleanKind, qty)
    local context = tmRewardDuplicateContext(triggerId)
    if tostring(mainFp or "") == "" then
        return {
            source = source,
            status = "blocked",
            proof_key = "none",
            evidence_source = evidenceSource,
            kind = cleanKind,
            name = cleanName,
            qty = cleanQty,
            main_fp = "",
            baseline_fp = baselineFp,
            context = context,
            compare_status = compareStatus,
            reason = "missing_main_fp",
        }
    end
    return {
        source = source,
        status = "candidate",
        proof_key = tmRewardDuplicateProofKey(cleanKind, cleanName, cleanQty, mainFp, baselineFp, context),
        evidence_source = evidenceSource,
        kind = cleanKind,
        name = cleanName,
        qty = cleanQty,
        main_fp = mainFp,
        baseline_fp = baselineFp,
        context = context,
        compare_status = compareStatus,
        reason = reason,
    }
end

function tmBuildRewardDuplicateProofDiagnostic(triggerId, source, main, aux, auxKind, auxName, compareStatus, reason)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    local status = tostring(compareStatus or "")
    local baselineFp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)
    if main.status == "present" then
        return tmRewardDuplicateCandidateRow(triggerId, src, "main", main.kind, main.name, main.qty, main.fp, baselineFp, status, reason)
    end
    if main.status == "none" and tostring(aux.status or "missing") == "present" then
        return tmRewardDuplicateCandidateRow(triggerId, src, "aux", auxKind, auxName, tmRewardDuplicateAuxQty(aux), main.fp, baselineFp, status, reason)
    end
    if main.status == "none" and tostring(aux.status or "missing") == "none" then
        return {
            source = src,
            status = "no_reward",
            proof_key = "none",
            evidence_source = "none",
            kind = "none",
            name = "none",
            qty = "none",
            main_fp = main.fp,
            baseline_fp = baselineFp,
            context = tmRewardDuplicateContext(triggerId),
            compare_status = status,
            reason = reason,
        }
    end
    return {
        source = src,
        status = "blocked",
        proof_key = "none",
        evidence_source = "none",
        kind = tmRewardDuplicateCanonicalKind(auxKind),
        name = tmRewardDuplicateCleanName(auxName),
        qty = tmRewardDuplicateQty(auxKind, tmRewardDuplicateAuxQty(aux)),
        main_fp = main.fp,
        baseline_fp = baselineFp,
        context = tmRewardDuplicateContext(triggerId),
        compare_status = status,
        reason = reason,
    }
end

function tmStoreRewardDuplicateProofDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmRewardDuplicateProofLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_DUP_PROOF_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_REWARD_DUP_PROOF_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_DUP_PROOF_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_DUP_PROOF_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return true
end

function tmCompareRewardWithAuxRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return nil end
    local main = tmRewardReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmRewardFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local status, reason, auxKind, auxName = tmRewardCompareStatus(main, aux)
    local row = {
        source = src,
        status = status,
        main_status = main.status,
        main_kind = main.kind,
        aux_status = aux.status or "missing",
        aux_kind = auxKind,
        reason = reason,
        main_name = main.name,
        aux_name = auxName,
        main_fp = main.fp,
        baseline_fp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId),
    }
    tmStoreRewardCompareDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local proof = tmBuildRewardDuplicateProofDiagnostic(triggerId, src, main, aux, auxKind, auxName, status, reason)
    tmStoreRewardDuplicateProofDiagnostic(triggerId, proof)
    return row
end

function tmServiceSnapshotLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.status or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.ref_or_label or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.price or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.markers or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmServiceSnapshotFromLine(line)
    local fields = tmRewardCompareSplitLine(line, 7)
    return {
        status = fields[1] ~= "" and fields[1] or "missing",
        kind = fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] or "none",
        target = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none",
        ref_or_label = fields[4] ~= "" and fields[4] or "none",
        price = fields[5] ~= "" and fields[5] or "none",
        markers = fields[6] ~= "" and fields[6] or "none",
        fp = fields[7] or "",
    }
end

function tmServiceTxProofLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.proof_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.evidence_source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.ref_or_label or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.price or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.context or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.compare_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmServiceCleanKind(kind)
    local clean = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(kind or "")
    if TM_AUX_SERVICE_KINDS and TM_AUX_SERVICE_KINDS[clean] then return clean end
    return "unknown"
end

function tmServiceCleanText(value, fallback, maxLen)
    local clean = tmPanelCueCleanField(value or "", maxLen or 96)
    if clean == "" or clean == "-" then return fallback or "none" end
    return clean
end

function tmServiceCleanPrice(value, fallback)
    local clean = tmPanelCueCleanField(value or "", 32)
    if clean == "" or clean == "-" or clean == "none" then return fallback or "none" end
    local n = math.floor(tonumber(clean) or 0)
    if n <= 0 then return fallback or "none" end
    return tostring(n)
end

function tmServiceCleanQty(value, fallback)
    local clean = tmPanelCueCleanField(value or "", 16)
    if clean == "" or clean == "-" or clean == "none" then return fallback or "none" end
    local n = math.floor(tonumber(clean) or 0)
    if n <= 0 then return fallback or "none" end
    return tostring(clamp(n, 1, TM_SERVICE_QTY_MAX or 20))
end

function tmServiceQuantityMaterialRef(refOrLabel, qty)
    local cleanRef = tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel or "none", "none", 96)
    local cleanQty = tmServiceCleanQty(qty or "none", "1")
    if cleanQty == "none" or cleanQty == "1" then return cleanRef end
    return cleanRef .. "#qty=" .. cleanQty
end

function tmServiceQuantityTotalPrice(unitPrice, qty)
    local unit = tmServicePositivePrice(tmServiceCleanPrice(unitPrice, "none"), nil)
    local cleanQty = tonumber(tmServiceCleanQty(qty or "none", "none")) or 0
    if unit <= 0 or cleanQty <= 0 then return 0 end
    local total = unit * cleanQty
    if total > (TM_GOLD_MAX_SINGLE or 1000000) then return 0 end
    return total
end

function tmServicePrimaryEvidence(rows)
    return rows and rows[1] or nil
end

function tmCaptureMainServiceMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    local raw = tostring(output or "")
    local rows, markers, seen = {}, {}, {}
    local function add(kind, target, refOrLabel, price, marker)
        local cleanKind = tmServiceCleanKind(kind)
        local cleanTarget = tmServiceCleanText(target or "none", "none", 64)
        local cleanRef = tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel or "none", "none", 96)
        local cleanPrice = tmServiceCleanPrice(price or "none", "none")
        local cleanMarker = tostring(marker or "UNKNOWN")
        table.insert(rows, {kind = cleanKind, target = cleanTarget, ref_or_label = cleanRef, price = cleanPrice, marker = cleanMarker})
        if not seen[cleanMarker] then
            table.insert(markers, cleanMarker)
            seen[cleanMarker] = true
        end
    end

    for owner, cost in raw:gmatch("▥GOLD_REVIVE:([%w_]+)|?(%d*)▥") do
        add("revive", owner, "none", cost ~= "" and cost or "50", "GOLD_REVIVE")
    end
    if raw:find("▥REST▥", 1, true) then
        add("rest", "party", "inn", "20", "REST")
    end
    for label, price in raw:gmatch("▥SHOP:buy:(.-)|(%d+)▥") do
        add("buy", "none", tmRewardPayloadHead(label), price, "SHOP_BUY")
    end
    for label, unitPrice, qty in raw:gmatch("▥SHOP:buyq:(.-)|(%d+)|(%d+)▥") do
        local cleanQty = tmServiceCleanQty(qty, "none")
        local total = tmServiceQuantityTotalPrice(unitPrice, cleanQty)
        add("buy", "none", tmServiceQuantityMaterialRef(tmRewardPayloadHead(label), cleanQty), total > 0 and tostring(total) or "none", "SHOP_BUY_Q")
    end
    for itemRef, price in raw:gmatch("▥SHOP:sell:([^|▥]+)|(%d+)▥") do
        add("sell", "none", itemRef, price, "SHOP_SELL")
    end

    local snapshot
    if #rows == 0 then
        snapshot = {status = "none", kind = "none", target = "none", ref_or_label = "none", price = "none", markers = "none", fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw)}
    else
        local primary = tmServicePrimaryEvidence(rows)
        snapshot = {
            status = "present",
            kind = primary.kind,
            target = primary.target,
            ref_or_label = primary.ref_or_label,
            price = primary.price,
            markers = table.concat(markers, ","),
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
        }
    end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_SERVICE_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmServiceSnapshotLine(snapshot))
    return snapshot
end

function tmServiceReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_SERVICE_SNAPSHOT_KEY) or "")
    if raw == "" then
        return {status = "missing", kind = "none", target = "none", ref_or_label = "none", price = "none", markers = "none", fp = ""}
    end
    return tmServiceSnapshotFromLine(raw)
end

function tmServiceFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_SERVICE_Q" then
            return tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
        end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_SERVICE" then
            return tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
        end
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_SERVICE", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = ""}
end

function tmServiceAuxMaterial(aux)
    local fields = aux and aux.fields or {}
    if aux and aux.name == "AUX_SERVICE_Q" then
        local cleanQty = tmServiceCleanQty(fields[7] or "none", "none")
        local total = tmServiceQuantityTotalPrice(fields[6] or "none", cleanQty)
        return {
            status = aux and aux.status or "missing",
            kind = tmServiceCleanKind(fields[3] or "none"),
            target = tmServiceCleanText(fields[4] or "none", "none", 64),
            ref_or_label = tmServiceCleanText(fields[5] or "none", "none", 96),
            price = total > 0 and tostring(total) or "none",
            unit_price = tmServiceCleanPrice(fields[6] or "none", "none"),
            qty = cleanQty,
            reason = aux and aux.reason or "",
        }
    end
    return {
        status = aux and aux.status or "missing",
        kind = tmServiceCleanKind(fields[3] or "none"),
        target = tmServiceCleanText(fields[4] or "none", "none", 64),
        ref_or_label = tmServiceCleanText(fields[5] or "none", "none", 96),
        price = tmServiceCleanPrice(fields[6] or "none", "none"),
        reason = aux and aux.reason or "",
    }
end

function tmServiceMaterialMatches(left, right, key)
    local a = tmServiceCleanText(left and left[key] or "none", "none", key == "target" and 64 or 96)
    local b = tmServiceCleanText(right and right[key] or "none", "none", key == "target" and 64 or 96)
    return a == "none" or b == "none" or a == b
end

function tmServiceCompareStatus(main, aux)
    local auxStatus = tostring(aux.status or "missing")
    local auxMat = tmServiceAuxMaterial(aux)
    if auxStatus == "malformed" then return "aux_malformed", aux.reason or "malformed", auxMat end
    if auxStatus == "missing" then return "aux_missing", "missing", auxMat end
    if auxStatus == "unknown" then return "aux_unknown", "unknown", auxMat end
    if main.status == "missing" then return "main_snapshot_missing", "missing_main_snapshot", auxMat end
    if auxStatus == "suggested" then return "suggestion_only", "suggested", auxMat end
    if auxStatus == "insufficient_gold" then return "insufficient_gold", "insufficient_gold", auxMat end
    if main.status == "none" and auxStatus == "none" then return "both_none", "ok", auxMat end
    if main.status == "none" and auxStatus == "confirmed" then return "main_missing_aux_confirmed", "main_missing", auxMat end
    if main.status == "present" and auxStatus == "none" then return "main_present_aux_none", "aux_none", auxMat end
    if main.status == "present" and auxStatus == "confirmed" then
        if tmServiceCleanKind(main.kind) ~= auxMat.kind then return "kind_mismatch", "kind", auxMat end
        if not tmServiceMaterialMatches(main, auxMat, "target") then return "target_mismatch", "target", auxMat end
        if not tmServiceMaterialMatches(main, auxMat, "ref_or_label") then return "ref_mismatch", "ref_or_label", auxMat end
        if main.price ~= "none" and auxMat.price ~= "none" and tostring(main.price) ~= tostring(auxMat.price) then return "price_mismatch", "price", auxMat end
        return "match", tostring(main.markers or ""):find(",", 1, true) and "ok_multi_main" or "ok", auxMat
    end
    return "aux_unknown", "unhandled", auxMat
end

function tmServiceTxContext(triggerId)
    local scenario = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", ""), 48)
    local episode = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", ""), 48)
    local session = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", ""), 24)
    local gold = tmPanelCueCleanField(tostring(type(tmGetPartyGold) == "function" and tmGetPartyGold(triggerId) or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)), 24)
    return table.concat({
        "scenario=" .. (scenario ~= "" and scenario or "none"),
        "ep=" .. (episode ~= "" and episode or "none"),
        "session=" .. (session ~= "" and session or "none"),
        "gold=" .. (gold ~= "" and gold or "0"),
    }, ";")
end

function tmServiceTxProofKey(source, evidenceSource, kind, target, refOrLabel, price, mainFp, baselineFp, context)
    local material = table.concat({
        tostring(source or ""),
        tostring(evidenceSource or ""),
        tmServiceCleanKind(kind),
        tmServiceCleanText(target or "none", "none", 64),
        tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel or "none", "none", 96),
        tmServiceCleanPrice(price or "none", "none"),
        tostring(mainFp or ""),
        tostring(baselineFp or ""),
        tostring(context or ""),
    }, "\31")
    return "sv#" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(material)
end

function tmServiceTxCandidateRow(triggerId, source, evidenceSource, material, mainFp, baselineFp, compareStatus, reason)
    local context = tmServiceTxContext(triggerId)
    local cleanKind = tmServiceCleanKind(material.kind)
    local cleanTarget = tmServiceCleanText(material.target or "none", "none", 64)
    local cleanRef = tmServiceCleanText(material.ref_or_label or "none", "none", 96)
    local cleanPrice = tmServiceCleanPrice(material.price or "none", "none")
    local cleanQty = tmServiceCleanQty(material.qty or "none", "none")
    local keyRef = tmServiceQuantityMaterialRef(cleanRef, cleanQty)
    if tostring(mainFp or "") == "" then
        return {
            source = source,
            status = "blocked",
            proof_key = "none",
            evidence_source = evidenceSource,
            kind = cleanKind,
            target = cleanTarget,
            ref_or_label = cleanRef,
            price = cleanPrice,
            qty = cleanQty,
            main_fp = "",
            baseline_fp = baselineFp,
            context = context,
            compare_status = compareStatus,
            reason = "missing_main_fp",
        }
    end
    return {
        source = source,
        status = "candidate",
        proof_key = tmServiceTxProofKey(source, evidenceSource, cleanKind, cleanTarget, keyRef, cleanPrice, mainFp, baselineFp, context),
        evidence_source = evidenceSource,
        kind = cleanKind,
        target = cleanTarget,
        ref_or_label = cleanRef,
        price = cleanPrice,
        qty = cleanQty,
        main_fp = mainFp,
        baseline_fp = baselineFp,
        context = context,
        compare_status = compareStatus,
        reason = reason,
    }
end

function tmBuildServiceTxProofDiagnostic(triggerId, source, main, aux, auxMat, compareStatus, reason)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    local baselineFp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)
    local status = tostring(compareStatus or "")
    if main.status == "present" then
        return tmServiceTxCandidateRow(triggerId, src, "main", main, main.fp, baselineFp, status, reason)
    end
    if main.status == "none" and tostring(aux.status or "missing") == "confirmed" then
        return tmServiceTxCandidateRow(triggerId, src, "aux", auxMat, main.fp, baselineFp, status, reason)
    end
    if main.status == "none" and tostring(aux.status or "missing") == "none" then
        return {
            source = src,
            status = "no_service",
            proof_key = "none",
            evidence_source = "none",
            kind = "none",
            target = "none",
            ref_or_label = "none",
            price = "none",
            main_fp = main.fp,
            baseline_fp = baselineFp,
            context = tmServiceTxContext(triggerId),
            compare_status = status,
            reason = reason,
        }
    end
    return {
        source = src,
        status = "blocked",
        proof_key = "none",
        evidence_source = tostring(aux.status or "missing") == "suggested" and "suggestion" or "none",
        kind = auxMat.kind,
        target = auxMat.target,
        ref_or_label = auxMat.ref_or_label,
        price = auxMat.price,
        main_fp = main.fp,
        baseline_fp = baselineFp,
        context = tmServiceTxContext(triggerId),
        compare_status = status,
        reason = reason,
    }
end

function tmStoreServiceTxProofDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmServiceTxProofLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_TX_PROOF_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_SERVICE_TX_PROOF_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_TX_PROOF_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_TX_PROOF_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return true
end

function tmCompareServiceWithAuxRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return nil end
    local main = tmServiceReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmServiceFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local status, reason, auxMat = tmServiceCompareStatus(main, aux)
    local proof = tmBuildServiceTxProofDiagnostic(triggerId, src, main, aux, auxMat, status, reason)
    tmStoreServiceTxProofDiagnostic(triggerId, proof)
    return proof
end

function tmNpcCleanText(value, fallback, maxLen)

    if clean == "" or clean == "-" then return fallback or "none" end
    return clean
end

function tmNpcIdToken(value)

    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    token = token:gsub("%s+", "_")
    return token
end
