function tmCaptureMainGimmickMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    local raw = tostring(output or "")
    local markers, seen = {}, {}
    local gimmickId, gimmickName, gimmickEffect = "none", "none", "none"
    local hasSet, hasMetadata = false, false
    local function mark(name)
        local marker = tostring(name or "")
        if marker ~= "" and not seen[marker] then
            table.insert(markers, marker)
            seen[marker] = true
        end
    end

    for id in raw:gmatch("▥GIMMICK:set:([%w_%-]+)▥") do
        if not hasSet then gimmickId = tmNpcCleanText(id, "none", 64) end
        hasSet = true
        mark("GIMMICK_SET")
    end
    for id in raw:gmatch("<<GIMMICK:set:([%w_%-]+)>>") do
        if not hasSet then gimmickId = tmNpcCleanText(id, "none", 64) end
        hasSet = true
        mark("GIMMICK_SET")
    end
    for name in raw:gmatch("▥GIMMICK_NAME:(.-)▥") do
        gimmickName = tmNpcCleanText(name, "none", 96)
        hasMetadata = true
        mark("GIMMICK_NAME")
    end
    for name in raw:gmatch("<<GIMMICK_NAME:([^>]+)>>") do
        gimmickName = tmNpcCleanText(name, "none", 96)
        hasMetadata = true
        mark("GIMMICK_NAME")
    end
    for effect in raw:gmatch("▥GIMMICK_EFFECT:(.-)▥") do
        gimmickEffect = tmNpcCleanText(effect, "none", 120)
        hasMetadata = true
        mark("GIMMICK_EFFECT")
    end
    for effect in raw:gmatch("<<GIMMICK_EFFECT:([^>]+)>>") do
        gimmickEffect = tmNpcCleanText(effect, "none", 120)
        hasMetadata = true
        mark("GIMMICK_EFFECT")
    end

    local status = "none"
    if hasSet then
        status = "set"
    elseif hasMetadata then
        status = "metadata"
    end
    local snapshot = {
        status = status,
        id = gimmickId,
        name = gimmickName,
        effect = gimmickEffect,
        markers = #markers > 0 and table.concat(markers, ",") or "none",
        fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
    }
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_GIMMICK_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmGimmickSnapshotLine(snapshot))
    return snapshot
end

function tmGimmickReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_GIMMICK_SNAPSHOT_KEY) or "")
    if raw == "" then
        return {status = "missing", id = "none", name = "none", effect = "none", markers = "none", fp = ""}
    end
    return tmGimmickSnapshotFromLine(raw)
end

function tmGimmickIsMeaningfulStatus(status)
    local s = tostring(status or "")
    return s == "set" or s == "metadata"
end

function tmNpcResolveAuthorityPromptText(triggerId)
    return "- Legacy NPC_RESOLVE marker text is cleanup-only. Gold-settled current-NPC payments use accepted panel AUX_NPC_PAYMENT when Main NPC evidence is missing."
end

function tmMainNpcCompatibilityMarkerText(triggerId)
    return "- Main NPC markers are compatibility output: emit NPC:set, NPC_NAME, and NPC_TRAIT for explicit visible-scene NPC creation, display-name, or note/trait events. Gold-settled current-NPC payments use the accepted panel AUX_NPC_PAYMENT path when Main NPC evidence is missing."
end

function tmCaptureMainNpcMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    local raw = tostring(output or "")
    local markers, seen = {}, {}
    local npcId, npcName, npcTrait = "none", "none", "none"
    local hasSet, hasMetadata = false, false
    local function mark(name)
        local marker = tostring(name or "")
        if marker ~= "" and not seen[marker] then
            table.insert(markers, marker)
            seen[marker] = true
        end
    end

    for id in raw:gmatch("▥NPC:set:([%w_%-]+)▥") do
        if not hasSet then npcId = tmNpcCleanText(id, "none", 64) end
        hasSet = true
        mark("NPC_SET")
    end
    for id in raw:gmatch("<<NPC:set:([%w_%-]+)>>") do
        if not hasSet then npcId = tmNpcCleanText(id, "none", 64) end
        hasSet = true
        mark("NPC_SET")
    end
    for name in raw:gmatch("▥NPC_NAME:(.-)▥") do
        npcName = tmNpcCleanText(name, "none", 96)
        hasMetadata = true
        mark("NPC_NAME")
    end
    for trait in raw:gmatch("▥NPC_TRAIT:(.-)▥") do
        npcTrait = tmNpcCleanText(trait, "none", 120)
        hasMetadata = true
        mark("NPC_TRAIT")
    end
    local status = "none"
    if hasSet then
        status = "set"
    elseif hasMetadata then
        status = "metadata"
    end
    local snapshot = {
        status = status,
        id = npcId,
        name = npcName,
        trait = npcTrait,
        markers = #markers > 0 and table.concat(markers, ",") or "none",
        fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(raw),
    }
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_NPC_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmNpcSnapshotLine(snapshot))
    return snapshot
end

function tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_NPC_SNAPSHOT_KEY) or "")
    if raw == "" then
        return {status = "missing", id = "none", name = "none", trait = "none", markers = "none", fp = ""}
    end
    return tmNpcSnapshotFromLine(raw)
end

function tmNpcFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    local firstWorld = nil
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_WORLD" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
            local fields = parsed.fields or {}
            local section = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
            parsed.section = section
            if section == "npc" then return parsed end
            if not firstWorld then firstWorld = parsed end
        end
    end
    if firstWorld then
        firstWorld.nonNpc = true
        return firstWorld
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_WORLD", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = "", section = ""}
end

function tmNpcFirstAuxMetaParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_NPC_META" then
            return tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
        end
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_NPC_META", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = ""}
end

function tmNpcAuxMaterial(aux)
    local fields = aux.fields or {}
    local section = aux.section or tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
    local state = tostring(aux.status or "missing")
    return {
        status = state,
        section = section ~= "" and section or "none",
        id_or_name = tmNpcCleanText(fields[3] or "none", "none", 96),
        visible_name = tmNpcCleanText(fields[5] or "none", "none", 96),
        evidence = tmNpcCleanText(fields[6] or "none", "none", 120),
        reason = aux.reason or "",
        non_npc = aux.nonNpc == true,
    }
end

function tmNpcAuxMetaMaterial(aux)
    local fields = aux.fields or {}
    local state = tostring(aux.status or "missing")
    return {
        status = state,
        section = "npc",
        id_or_name = tmNpcCleanText(fields[2] or "none", "none", 96),
        visible_name = "none",
        note = tmNpcCleanText(fields[4] or "none", "none", 120),
        evidence = tmNpcCleanText(fields[5] or "none", "none", 120),
        reason = aux.reason or "",
    }
end

function tmNpcCompareStatus(main, aux, auxMat)
    local mainStatus = tostring(main.status or "missing")
    local auxStatus = tostring(aux.status or "missing")
    if auxStatus == "malformed" then return "aux_malformed", aux.reason or "malformed" end
    if auxStatus == "missing" then
        if mainStatus == "set" or mainStatus == "resolve" or mainStatus == "metadata" then return "main_only", "aux_missing" end
        return "both_none", "missing"
    end
    if auxMat.non_npc then
        if mainStatus == "set" or mainStatus == "resolve" or mainStatus == "metadata" then return "main_only", "aux_non_npc" end
        return "non_npc", auxMat.section
    end
    if auxMat.section ~= "npc" then
        if mainStatus == "set" or mainStatus == "resolve" or mainStatus == "metadata" then return "main_only", "aux_section_" .. tostring(auxMat.section or "none") end
        return "non_npc", auxMat.section
    end
    if auxStatus == "unknown" then return "aux_unknown", "unknown" end
    if auxStatus == "none" then
        if mainStatus == "set" or mainStatus == "resolve" or mainStatus == "metadata" then return "main_only", "aux_none" end
        return "both_none", "ok"
    end
    if auxStatus == "present" or auxStatus == "resolved" or auxStatus == "inactive" then
        if mainStatus == "none" or mainStatus == "missing" then return "aux_only", auxStatus end
        local mainToken = tmNpcIdToken(main.id)
        local auxToken = tmNpcIdToken(auxMat.id_or_name)
        if mainToken ~= "none" and auxToken ~= "none" and mainToken == auxToken then
            return "agreement", "exact_id"
        end
        return "both_present_no_exact_id", auxStatus
    end
    return "aux_unknown", "unhandled"
end

function tmNpcCompareLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_id or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_trait or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_markers or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_section or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_id_or_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_visible_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_evidence or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreNpcCompareDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmNpcCompareLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_COMPARE_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_NPC_AUX_COMPARE_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_COMPARE_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_COMPARE_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return row
end

function tmCompareNpcWithAuxWorldRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return nil end
    local main = tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmNpcFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local auxMat = tmNpcAuxMaterial(aux)
    local status, reason = tmNpcCompareStatus(main, aux, auxMat)
    return tmStoreNpcCompareDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = src,
        status = status,
        main_status = main.status,
        main_id = main.id,
        main_name = main.name,
        main_trait = main.trait,
        main_markers = main.markers,
        aux_status = auxMat.status,
        aux_section = auxMat.section,
        aux_id_or_name = auxMat.id_or_name,
        aux_visible_name = auxMat.visible_name,
        aux_evidence = auxMat.evidence,
        reason = reason,
        main_fp = main.fp,
        baseline_fp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId),
    })
end

function tmNpcLatestCompareStatus(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_COMPARE_DIAG_LATEST_KEY) or "")
    if raw == "" then return "missing" end
    local fields = tmRewardCompareSplitLine(raw, 2)
    return fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] or "missing"
end

function tmNpcIsMeaningfulStatus(status)
    local s = tostring(status or "")
    return s == "set" or s == "resolve" or s == "metadata"
end

function tmNpcMainStableToken(main)
    local status = tostring(main.status or "")
    if status ~= "set" and status ~= "resolve" then return "none" end
    local token = tmNpcIdToken(main.id)
    if token == "" or token == "none" or token == "-" then return "none" end
    return token
end

function tmNpcAuxCandidateToken(auxMat)
    if tostring(auxMat.section or "") ~= "npc" then return "none" end
    local status = tostring(auxMat.status or "")
    if status ~= "present" and status ~= "resolved" and status ~= "inactive" then return "none" end
    local token = tmNpcIdToken(auxMat.id_or_name)
    if token == "" or token == "none" or token == "-" then return "none" end
    return token
end

function tmNpcLooksStableAuxId(token)
    local t = tostring(token or ""):lower()
    if t == "" or t == "none" or t == "-" then return false end
    if t:match("^npc_l%d") then return true end
    if t:match("^npc[_%-]") then return true end
    return false
end

function tmNpcRuntimeExactMatch(triggerId, candidateToken)
    local token = tmNpcIdToken(candidateToken)
    local result = {status = "missing", slot = "none", id = "none", name = "none", count = 0}
    if token == "" or token == "none" or token == "-" then return result end
    result.status = "new"
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] == "npc" and fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] ~= "-" then
            local idToken = tmNpcIdToken(fields[2])
            if idToken == token then
                result.count = result.count + 1
                if result.slot == "none" then
                    result.slot = tmObjectSlotId(slot)
                    result.id = fields[2]
                    result.name = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none"
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if result.count == 1 then
        result.status = "known"
    elseif result.count > 1 then
        result.status = "duplicate"
    end
    return result
end

function tmNpcIdentityProofLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.candidate_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_id or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_id_or_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_visible_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_slot or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_id or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.comparison_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreNpcIdentityProofDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmNpcIdentityProofLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_IDENTITY_PROOF_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_NPC_IDENTITY_PROOF_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_IDENTITY_PROOF_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_IDENTITY_PROOF_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return row
end

function tmBuildNpcIdentityProof(triggerId, source, main, auxMat)
    local mainToken = tmNpcMainStableToken(main)
    local auxToken = tmNpcAuxCandidateToken(auxMat)
    local candidateToken = "none"
    local status, reason = "none", "no_stable_id"

    if mainToken ~= "none" and auxToken ~= "none" and mainToken == auxToken then
        candidateToken = mainToken
        status, reason = "main_aux_exact", "exact_id"
    elseif mainToken ~= "none" and auxToken ~= "none" and mainToken ~= auxToken then
        status, reason = "conflict", "main_aux_mismatch"
    elseif mainToken ~= "none" then
        candidateToken = mainToken
        status, reason = "main_id", tostring(main.status or "main")
    elseif auxToken ~= "none" then
        local runtimeProbe = tmNpcRuntimeExactMatch(triggerId, auxToken)
        if runtimeProbe.status == "known" or runtimeProbe.status == "duplicate" then
            candidateToken = auxToken
            status, reason = "runtime_exact", runtimeProbe.status
        elseif tmNpcLooksStableAuxId(auxToken) then
            candidateToken = auxToken
            status, reason = "aux_exact_id", "id_like"
        else
            status, reason = "visible_only", "weak_aux"
        end
    elseif tmNpcCleanText(auxMat.visible_name or "none", "none", 96) ~= "none" then
        status, reason = "visible_only", "weak_visible"
    end

    local runtime = tmNpcRuntimeExactMatch(triggerId, candidateToken)
    return {
        source = source or "aux",
        status = status,
        candidate_key = candidateToken ~= "none" and ("npc:" .. candidateToken) or "none",
        reason = reason,
        main_status = main.status or "missing",
        main_id = main.id or "none",
        main_name = main.name or "none",
        aux_status = auxMat.status or "missing",
        aux_id_or_name = auxMat.id_or_name or "none",
        aux_visible_name = auxMat.visible_name or "none",
        runtime_status = runtime.status,
        runtime_slot = runtime.slot,
        runtime_id = runtime.id,
        runtime_name = runtime.name,
        comparison_status = tmNpcLatestCompareStatus(triggerId),
        baseline_fp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId),
        main_fp = main.fp or "",
    }
end

function tmProveNpcIdentityWithAuxWorldRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return nil end
    local main = tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmNpcFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local auxMat = tmNpcAuxMaterial(aux)
    return tmStoreNpcIdentityProofDiagnostic(triggerId, tmBuildNpcIdentityProof(triggerId, src, main, auxMat))
end

function tmNpcAuxFillDiagLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.guard_key or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.candidate_key or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.result_ref or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.proof_status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_status or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmNpcAuxFillDiagLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return row
end

function tmNpcAuxFillCandidateId(proof)
    local key = tostring(proof and proof.candidate_key or "")
    local id = key:match("^npc:(.+)$")
    if not id or id == "" or id == "none" then return "none" end
    return id
end

function tmNpcAuxFillGuardKey(triggerId, source, proof)
    local id = tmNpcAuxFillCandidateId(proof)
    if id == "none" then return "none" end
    return table.concat({
        "npcfill",
        tostring(source or "panel"),
        id,
        tostring(proof and proof.main_fp or ""),
        tostring(proof and proof.baseline_fp or ""),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "none")),
    }, ":")
end

function tmNpcAuxFillKeySeen(triggerId, guardKey)
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    return csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_KEYS_VAR, ""), key)
end

function tmRememberNpcAuxFillKey(triggerId, guardKey)
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local items = parseList(getVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_KEYS_VAR, ""), ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == key then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, key)
    while #items > TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_FILL_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, source, status, proof, resultRef, reason, main, aux, runtime)
    local guardKey = tmNpcAuxFillGuardKey(triggerId, source, proof)
    return tmStoreNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = source or "aux_fill",
        status = status or "blocked",
        guard_key = guardKey,
        candidate_key = proof and proof.candidate_key or "none",
        result_ref = resultRef or "none",
        reason = reason or "",
        main_status = main and main.status or "missing",
        aux_status = aux and aux.status or "missing",
        proof_status = proof and proof.status or "missing",
        runtime_status = runtime and runtime.status or "missing",
    })
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxFillMissingRuntime(triggerId, source, main, aux, proof)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    if src ~= "panel" then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "manual_refresh_proof_only", proof, "none", "source_not_panel", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    local mainStatus = tostring(main and main.status or "missing")
    if tmNpcIsMeaningfulStatus(mainStatus) then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "main_present", proof, "none", "main_authoritative", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    if tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing") ~= "present" then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "aux_not_present", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    if not proof or proof.status ~= "aux_exact_id" then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "identity_not_stable", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    local npcId = tmNpcAuxFillCandidateId(proof)
    local formula = tmParseNpcFormulaId(npcId)
    if not formula then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "bad_id", proof, "none", "not_parseable_formula", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    local guardKey = tmNpcAuxFillGuardKey(triggerId, src, proof)
    if tmNpcAuxFillKeySeen(triggerId, guardKey) then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "duplicate_key", proof, "none", "guard_seen", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    local runtime = tmNpcRuntimeExactMatch(triggerId, npcId)
    if runtime.status == "known" then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "runtime_known", proof, runtime.slot, "already_known", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    elseif runtime.status == "duplicate" then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "runtime_duplicate", proof, runtime.slot, "duplicate_runtime_id", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    local slot = tmStoreRuntimeNpc(triggerId, npcId)
    if not slot then
        tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "writer_failed", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    tmRememberNpcAuxFillKey(triggerId, guardKey)
    tmNpcAuxFillDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied", proof, tostring(slot), "ok", main, aux, runtime)
    return true
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxFillMissingRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmNpcFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local auxMat = tmNpcAuxMaterial(aux)
    local proof = tmBuildNpcIdentityProof(triggerId, src, main, auxMat)
    return tmApplyNpcAuxFillMissingRuntime(triggerId, src, main, aux, proof)
end

function tmNpcAuxNameDiagLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.candidate_key or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.result_ref or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.proof_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_slot or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.old_name or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.new_name or "none"),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmNpcAuxNameDiagLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_NAME_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_NPC_AUX_NAME_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_NAME_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_AUX_NAME_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return row
end

function tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, source, status, proof, resultRef, reason, main, aux, runtime, oldName, newName)
    return tmStoreNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = source or "aux_name",
        status = status or "blocked",
        candidate_key = proof and proof.candidate_key or "none",
        result_ref = resultRef or "none",
        reason = reason or "",
        main_status = main and main.status or "missing",
        aux_status = aux and aux.status or "missing",
        proof_status = proof and proof.status or "missing",
        runtime_status = runtime and runtime.status or "missing",
        runtime_slot = runtime and runtime.slot or "none",
        old_name = oldName or "none",
        new_name = newName or "none",
    })
end

function tmNpcAuxVisibleNameCandidate(triggerId, auxMat)
    local name = tmNpcCleanText(auxMat and auxMat.visible_name or "none", "none", 48)
    local token = tmNpcIdToken(name)
    if name == "none" or token == "none" or token == "unknown" then return "none", "missing_visible_name" end
    if tmParseNpcFormulaId(token) then return "none", "internal_id_visible_name" end
    if not tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, name) then return "none", "unusable_visible_name" end
    return name, "ok"
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxNameRuntime(triggerId, source, main, aux, proof)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    if src ~= "panel" then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "manual_refresh_proof_only", proof, "none", "source_not_panel", main, aux, nil, nil, nil)
        return false
    end
    local mainStatus = tostring(main and main.status or "missing")
    if tmNpcIsMeaningfulStatus(mainStatus) then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "main_present", proof, "none", "main_authoritative", main, aux, nil, nil, nil)
        return false
    end
    local auxStatus = tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing")
    if tostring(aux and aux.section or "") ~= "npc" then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "not_npc_section", main, aux, nil, nil, nil)
        return false
    end
    if auxStatus ~= "present" then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "aux_not_present", main, aux, nil, nil, nil)
        return false
    end
    local newName, nameReason = tmNpcAuxVisibleNameCandidate(triggerId, aux)
    if newName == "none" then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", nameReason, main, aux, nil, nil, newName)
        return false
    end
    if not proof or tostring(proof.status or "") ~= "runtime_exact" or tostring(proof.reason or "") ~= "known" then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "identity_not_current_runtime", main, aux, nil, nil, newName)
        return false
    end
    local runtime = {
        status = proof.runtime_status or "missing",
        slot = proof.runtime_slot or "none",
        id = proof.runtime_id or "none",
        name = proof.runtime_name or "none",
    }
    if runtime.status ~= "known" then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "runtime_not_unique", main, aux, runtime, nil, newName)
        return false
    end
    local slotNum = tonumber(runtime.slot)
    local currentSlot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "npc")
    if not slotNum or not currentSlot or tonumber(currentSlot) ~= slotNum then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "not_current_npc", main, aux, runtime, nil, newName)
        return false
    end
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slotNum), ""))
    if fields[1] ~= "npc" or tmNpcIdToken(fields[2]) ~= tmNpcIdToken(runtime.id) then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "runtime_mismatch", main, aux, runtime, nil, newName)
        return false
    end
    local oldName = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none"
    if oldName == newName then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_named", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "already_named", main, aux, runtime, oldName, newName)
        return false
    end
    if tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, "npc", slotNum, 3, newName) ~= true then
        tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "writer_failed", main, aux, runtime, oldName, newName)
        return false
    end
    tmNpcAuxNameDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "ok", main, aux, runtime, oldName, newName)
    return true
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxNameRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmNpcFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local auxMat = tmNpcAuxMaterial(aux)
    local proof = tmBuildNpcIdentityProof(triggerId, src, main, auxMat)
    return tmApplyNpcAuxNameRuntime(triggerId, src, main, auxMat, proof)
end

function tmNpcAuxNoteCandidate(auxMat)
    local note = tmNpcCleanText(auxMat and auxMat.note or "none", "none", 120)
    local token = tmNpcIdToken(note)
    if note == "none" or token == "none" or token == "unknown" then return "none", "missing_note" end
    if note == token and tmParseNpcFormulaId(token) then return "none", "internal_id_note" end
    return note, "ok"
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxMetaRuntime(triggerId, source, main, aux, proof)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    if src ~= "panel" then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "manual_refresh_proof_only", proof, "none", "source_not_panel", main, aux, nil, nil, nil)
        return false
    end
    local mainStatus = tostring(main and main.status or "missing")
    if tmNpcIsMeaningfulStatus(mainStatus) then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "main_present", proof, "none", "main_authoritative", main, aux, nil, nil, nil)
        return false
    end
    local auxStatus = tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing")
    if auxStatus ~= "present" then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "aux_not_present", main, aux, nil, nil, nil)
        return false
    end
    local newNote, noteReason = tmNpcAuxNoteCandidate(aux)
    if newNote == "none" then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", noteReason, main, aux, nil, nil, newNote)
        return false
    end
    if not proof or tostring(proof.status or "") ~= "runtime_exact" or tostring(proof.reason or "") ~= "known" then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "identity_not_current_runtime", main, aux, nil, nil, newNote)
        return false
    end
    local runtime = {
        status = proof.runtime_status or "missing",
        slot = proof.runtime_slot or "none",
        id = proof.runtime_id or "none",
        name = proof.runtime_name or "none",
    }
    if runtime.status ~= "known" then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "runtime_not_unique", main, aux, runtime, nil, newNote)
        return false
    end
    local slotNum = tonumber(runtime.slot)
    local currentSlot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "npc")
    if not slotNum or not currentSlot or tonumber(currentSlot) ~= slotNum then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "not_current_npc", main, aux, runtime, nil, newNote)
        return false
    end
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slotNum), ""))
    if fields[1] ~= "npc" or tmNpcIdToken(fields[2]) ~= tmNpcIdToken(runtime.id) then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "runtime_mismatch", main, aux, runtime, nil, newNote)
        return false
    end
    local oldNote = fields[6] ~= "" and fields[6] or "none"
    if oldNote == newNote then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_noted", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "already_noted", main, aux, runtime, oldNote, newNote)
        return false
    end
    if tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, "npc", slotNum, 6, newNote) ~= true then
        tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "writer_failed", main, aux, runtime, oldNote, newNote)
        return false
    end
    tmNpcAuxMetaDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "ok", main, aux, runtime, oldNote, newNote)
    return true
end

    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)

    local auxMat = tmNpcAuxMetaMaterial(aux)
    local proof = tmBuildNpcIdentityProof(triggerId, src, main, auxMat)
    return tmApplyNpcAuxMetaRuntime(triggerId, src, main, auxMat, proof)
end
