function tmApplyNpcAuxLifecycleRuntime(triggerId, source, main, aux, proof)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    if src ~= "panel" then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "manual_refresh_proof_only", proof, "none", "source_not_panel", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    local mainStatus = tostring(main and main.status or "missing")
    if tmNpcIsMeaningfulStatus(mainStatus) then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "main_present", proof, "none", "main_authoritative", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    local auxStatus = tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing")
    local auxSection = tostring(aux and aux.section or "")
    if auxStatus == "none" then
        if auxSection ~= "npc" then
            tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "none_not_npc", main, aux, nil)
            return false
        end
        local currentSlot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "npc")
        if not currentSlot then
            tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_clear", proof, "none", "no_current_npc", main, aux, nil)
            return false
        end
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(currentSlot), ""))
        if fields[1] ~= "npc" or fields[2] == "" or fields[2] == "-" then
            tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, tmObjectSlotId(currentSlot), "runtime_mismatch", main, aux, nil)
            return false
        end
        local runtime = {
            status = "known",
            slot = tmObjectSlotId(currentSlot),
            id = fields[2],
            name = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none",
        }
        if tmClearCurrentRuntimeObjectRef(triggerId, "npc", currentSlot, fields[2]) ~= true then
            tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_clear", proof, runtime.slot, "no_current_npc", main, aux, runtime)
            return false
        end
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "npc_aux_none:" .. tostring(runtime.id or "none"))
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "NPC 현재 포커스 해제: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "npc", runtime.id))
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "cleared_current", proof, runtime.slot, "ok", main, aux, runtime)
        return true
    end
    if auxStatus ~= "resolved" and auxStatus ~= "inactive" then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "aux_lifecycle_status_unhandled", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    if not proof or tostring(proof.status or "") ~= "runtime_exact" or tostring(proof.reason or "") ~= "known" then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "identity_not_current_runtime", main, aux, nil)
        return false
    end
    local runtime = {
        status = proof.runtime_status or "missing",
        slot = proof.runtime_slot or "none",
        id = proof.runtime_id or "none",
        name = proof.runtime_name or "none",
    }
    if runtime.status ~= "known" then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "runtime_not_unique", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    local slotNum = tonumber(runtime.slot)
    local currentSlot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "npc")
    if not slotNum or not currentSlot or tonumber(currentSlot) ~= slotNum then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "not_current_npc", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slotNum), ""))
    if fields[1] ~= "npc" or tmNpcIdToken(fields[2]) ~= tmNpcIdToken(runtime.id) then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "runtime_mismatch", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    if auxStatus == "resolved" then
        if tostring(fields[4] or "") == "resolved" then
            tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_resolved", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "already_resolved", main, aux, runtime)
            return false
        end
        if tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, "npc", slotNum, 4, "resolved") ~= true then
            tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "writer_failed", main, aux, runtime)
            return false
        end
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "npc_aux_resolved:" .. tostring(runtime.id or "none"))
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "NPC 상태 해결: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "npc", runtime.id))
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "ok", main, aux, runtime)
        return true
    end
    if tostring(fields[4] or "") == "inactive" then
        tmClearCurrentRuntimeObjectRef(triggerId, "npc", slotNum, runtime.id)
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_inactive", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "already_inactive", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    if tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, "npc", slotNum, 4, "inactive") ~= true then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "writer_failed", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    if tmClearCurrentRuntimeObjectRef(triggerId, "npc", slotNum, runtime.id) ~= true then
        tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "current_clear_failed", main, aux, runtime)
        return false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "npc_aux_inactive:" .. tostring(runtime.id or "none"))
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "NPC 현재 비활성화: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "npc", runtime.id))
    tmNpcAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied_inactive", proof, runtime.slot or "none", "ok", main, aux, runtime)
    return true
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxLifecycleRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmNpcFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local auxMat = tmNpcAuxMaterial(aux)
    local proof = tmBuildNpcIdentityProof(triggerId, src, main, auxMat)
    return tmApplyNpcAuxLifecycleRuntime(triggerId, src, main, aux, proof)
end

function tmGimmickFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_WORLD" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
            local fields = parsed.fields or {}
            parsed.section = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
            if parsed.section == "gimmick" then return parsed end
        end
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_WORLD", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = "", section = ""}
end

function tmGimmickExactFormulaId(value)
    local id = tmPanelCueCleanField(value or "", 64):lower()
    id = id:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if id == "" or id == "-" or id == "none" or id == "unknown" then return "none" end
    local n, tier, gtype = id:match("^gm_l(%d%d?)_([a-z]+)_([a-z_]+)$")
    local band = tonumber(n)
    if not band or band < 1 or band > 5 then return "none" end
    if not TM_GIMMICK_TIERS[tier] or not TM_GIMMICK_TYPES[gtype] then return "none" end
    return id
end

function tmGimmickAuxMaterial(aux)
    local fields = aux and aux.fields or {}
    local section = aux and aux.section or tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
    return {
        status = tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing"),
        section = section ~= "" and section or "none",
        id = tmGimmickExactFormulaId(fields[3] or "none"),
        raw_id = tmNpcCleanText(fields[3] or "none", "none", 96),
        visible_name = tmNpcCleanText(fields[5] or "none", "none", 96),
        evidence = tmNpcCleanText(fields[6] or "none", "none", 120),
        reason = aux and aux.reason or "",
    }
end

function tmGimmickRuntimeExactMatch(triggerId, candidateId)
    local id = tmGimmickExactFormulaId(candidateId)
    local result = {status = "missing", slot = "none", id = "none", state = "none", count = 0}
    if id == "none" then return result end
    result.status = "new"
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] == "gimmick" and tostring(fields[2] or ""):lower() == id then
            result.count = result.count + 1
            if result.slot == "none" then
                result.slot = tmObjectSlotId(slot)
                result.id = fields[2]
                result.state = fields[4] ~= "" and fields[4] or "active"
            end
        end
    end
    if result.count == 1 then
        result.status = "known"
    elseif result.count > 1 then
        result.status = "duplicate"
    end
    return result
end

function tmGimmickCurrentRuntime(triggerId)
    local slot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "gimmick")
    if not slot then return {status = "missing", slot = "none", id = "none", state = "none", count = 0} end
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
    if fields[1] ~= "gimmick" then return {status = "missing", slot = "none", id = "none", state = "none", count = 0} end
    return {status = "known", slot = tmObjectSlotId(slot), id = fields[2] or "none", state = fields[4] or "active", count = 1}
end

function tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, source, action, main, mat, runtime)
    local parts = {
        "gimmick_lifecycle",
        tostring(source or "panel"),
        tostring(action or "none"),
        tostring(mat and mat.id or "none"),
        tostring(runtime and runtime.slot or "none"),
        tostring(runtime and runtime.id or "none"),
        tostring(main and main.fp or ""),
        tostring(tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "none")),
    }
    return "gl" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(table.concat(parts, "\n"))
end

function tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKeySeen(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    return csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, TM_GIMMICK_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEYS_VAR, ""), token)
end

function tmRememberGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    local items = parseList(getVar(triggerId, TM_GIMMICK_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEYS_VAR, ""), ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == token then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, token)
    while #items > TM_GIMMICK_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_GIMMICK_AUX_LIFECYCLE_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, source, status, mat, resultRef, reason)
    tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = source or "aux",
        name = "AUX_GIMMICK_LIFECYCLE",
        status = status or "blocked",
        subject = "gimmick",
        ref_or_condition = mat and (mat.id ~= "none" and mat.id or mat.raw_id) or "none",
        state_or_duration = mat and mat.status or "missing",
        visible_name = resultRef or "none",
        evidence = mat and mat.evidence or "",
        reason = reason or "",
    })
end

function tmGimmickAuxLifecycleExactCurrent(triggerId, mat)
    local id = tostring(mat and mat.id or "none")
    if id == "none" then return nil, "bad_gimmick_id" end
    local runtime = tmGimmickRuntimeExactMatch(triggerId, id)
    if runtime.status ~= "known" then return runtime, runtime.status == "duplicate" and "duplicate_runtime_id" or "runtime_missing" end
    local slotNum = tonumber(runtime.slot)
    local currentSlot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "gimmick")
    if not slotNum or not currentSlot or tonumber(currentSlot) ~= slotNum then return runtime, "not_current_gimmick" end
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slotNum), ""))
    if fields[1] ~= "gimmick" or tostring(fields[2] or ""):lower() ~= id then return runtime, "runtime_mismatch" end
    return runtime, "ok"
end

function tmApplyGimmickAuxLifecycleRuntime(triggerId, source, main, aux)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    local mat = tmGimmickAuxMaterial(aux or {})
    if mat.reason == "missing" then return false end
    if src ~= "panel" then
        tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "manual_refresh_proof_only", mat, "none", "source_not_panel")
        return false
    end
    if mat.reason ~= "ok" then
        tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, "none", mat.reason)
        return false
    end
    if tostring(main and main.status or "missing") == "missing" then
        tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", mat, "none", "main_snapshot_missing")
        return false
    end
    if tmGimmickIsMeaningfulStatus(main and main.status) then
        tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "main_present", mat, "none", "main_authoritative")
        return false
    end

    local auxStatus = tostring(mat.status or "missing")
    if auxStatus == "present" then
        if mat.id == "none" then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, "none", "bad_gimmick_id")
            return false
        end
        if not tmParseGimmickFormulaId(mat.id) then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, "none", "not_parseable_formula")
            return false
        end
        local runtime = tmGimmickRuntimeExactMatch(triggerId, mat.id)
        if runtime.status == "known" or runtime.status == "duplicate" then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "runtime_" .. runtime.status, mat, runtime.slot, "already_known")
            return false
        end
        local key = tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, src, "present", main, mat, runtime)
        if tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKeySeen(triggerId, key) then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "duplicate_key", mat, key, "guard_seen")
            return false
        end
        local slot = tmStoreRuntimeGimmick(triggerId, mat.id)
        if not slot then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, "none", "writer_failed")
            return false
        end
        tmRememberGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, key)
        tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "gimmick")
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "기믹 등장: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "gimmick", mat.id))
        tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied_present", mat, tostring(slot), "ok")
        return true
    end

    if auxStatus == "resolved" or auxStatus == "inactive" then
        local runtime, reason = tmGimmickAuxLifecycleExactCurrent(triggerId, mat)
        if reason ~= "ok" then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, runtime and runtime.slot or "none", reason)
            return false
        end
        if runtime.state == auxStatus then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_" .. auxStatus, mat, runtime.slot, "already_" .. auxStatus)
            return false
        end
        local key = tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, src, auxStatus, main, mat, runtime)
        if tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKeySeen(triggerId, key) then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "duplicate_key", mat, key, "guard_seen")
            return false
        end
        local slotNum = tonumber(runtime.slot)
        if tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, "gimmick", slotNum, 4, auxStatus) ~= true then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, runtime.slot, "writer_failed")
            return false
        end
        tmRememberGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, key)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "gimmick_aux_" .. auxStatus .. ":" .. tostring(runtime.id or "none"))
        if auxStatus == "resolved" then
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "기믹 해결: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "gimmick", runtime.id))
        else
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "기믹 비활성화: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "gimmick", runtime.id))
        end
        tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied_" .. auxStatus, mat, runtime.slot, "ok")
        return true
    end

    if auxStatus == "none" then
        local runtime = tmGimmickCurrentRuntime(triggerId)
        if runtime.status ~= "known" then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_none", mat, "none", "no_current_gimmick")
            return false
        end
        local key = tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, src, "none", main, mat, runtime)
        if tmGimmickAuxLifecycleKeySeen(triggerId, key) then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "duplicate_key", mat, key, "guard_seen")
            return false
        end
        local slotNum = tonumber(runtime.slot)
        if tmClearCurrentRuntimeObjectRef(triggerId, "gimmick", slotNum, runtime.id) ~= true then
            tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, runtime.slot, "current_clear_failed")
            return false
        end
        tmRememberGimmickAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, key)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "gimmick_aux_none:" .. tostring(runtime.id or "none"))
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "현재 기믹 없음: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "gimmick", runtime.id))
        tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied_none", mat, runtime.slot, "ok")
        return true
    end

    tmGimmickAuxLifecycleDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", mat, "none", "state_not_actionable")
    return false
end

function tmApplyGimmickAuxLifecycleRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmGimmickReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmGimmickFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    return tmApplyGimmickAuxLifecycleRuntime(triggerId, src, main, aux)
end

function tmPlaceContextCleanText(value, fallback, maxLen)
    local clean = tmNpcCleanText(value or "", fallback or "none", maxLen or 96)
    local token = clean:lower()
    if token == "" or token == "-" or token == "none" or token == "unknown" then return fallback or "none" end
    return clean
end

function tmPlaceFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_WORLD" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
            local fields = parsed.fields or {}
            parsed.section = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
            if parsed.section == "place" then return parsed end
        end
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_WORLD", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = "", section = ""}
end

function tmPlaceAuxMaterial(aux)
    local fields = aux and aux.fields or {}
    local section = aux and aux.section or tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
    local idOrName = tmPlaceContextCleanText(fields[3] or "none", "none", 96)
    local visibleName = tmPlaceContextCleanText(fields[5] or "none", "none", 96)
    if visibleName == "none" and idOrName ~= "none" then visibleName = idOrName end
    return {
        status = tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing"),
        section = section ~= "" and section or "none",
        id_or_name = idOrName,
        visible_name = visibleName,
        evidence = tmPlaceContextCleanText(fields[6] or "none", "none", 120),
        reason = aux and aux.reason or "",
    }
end

function tmPlaceContextLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.status or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.id_or_name or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.visible_name or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.source or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.episode or "none"),
    }, "|")
end

function tmPlaceContextFromLine(line)
    local fields = tmRewardCompareSplitLine(line, 5)
    local status = fields[1] ~= "" and fields[1] or "none"
    local idOrName = fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] or "none"
    local visibleName = fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] or "none"
    if visibleName == "none" and idOrName ~= "none" then visibleName = idOrName end
    return {
        status = status,
        id_or_name = idOrName,
        visible_name = visibleName,
        source = fields[4] ~= "" and fields[4] or "none",
        episode = fields[5] ~= "" and fields[5] or "none",
    }
end

function tmReadPlaceContext(triggerId)
    local raw = tostring(getVar(triggerId, TM_PLACE_CONTEXT_VAR, "") or "")
    if raw == "" or raw == "none" then
        return {status = "none", id_or_name = "none", visible_name = "none", source = "none", episode = "none"}
    end
    local ctx = tmPlaceContextFromLine(raw)
    if ctx.status ~= "present" then
        return {status = "none", id_or_name = "none", visible_name = "none", source = "none", episode = "none"}
    end
    return ctx
end

function tmPlaceCurrentContextPromptLine(triggerId)
    local ctx = tmReadPlaceContext(triggerId)
    if ctx.status ~= "present" then return "- none" end
    return "- state=present id_or_name=" .. tostring(ctx.id_or_name or "none")
        .. " visible_name=" .. tostring(ctx.visible_name or "none")
        .. " episode=" .. tostring(ctx.episode or "none")
        .. " source=" .. tostring(ctx.source or "none")
end

function tmPlaceAuxContextKey(triggerId, source, mat)
    if not mat then return "none" end
    local packed = table.concat({
        "place_context",
        tostring(source or "panel"),
        tostring(mat.status or "none"),
        tostring(mat.id_or_name or "none"),
        tostring(mat.visible_name or "none"),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "none")),
        tostring(tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)),
        tostring(tmPanelLatestVisibleFingerprint(triggerId)),
    }, "\31")
    return "pc#" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(packed)
end

function tmPlaceAuxContextKeySeen(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    return csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, TM_PLACE_AUX_CONTEXT_KEYS_VAR, ""), token)
end

function tmRememberPlaceAuxContextKey(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    local items = parseList(getVar(triggerId, TM_PLACE_AUX_CONTEXT_KEYS_VAR, ""), ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == token then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, token)
    while #items > TM_PLACE_AUX_CONTEXT_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_PLACE_AUX_CONTEXT_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, source, status, mat, resultRef, reason)
    tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = source or "aux",
        name = "AUX_PLACE_CONTEXT",
        status = status or "blocked",
        subject = "place",
        ref_or_condition = mat and mat.id_or_name or "none",
        state_or_duration = mat and mat.status or "missing",
        visible_name = mat and mat.visible_name or "none",
        evidence = mat and mat.evidence or "",
        reason = reason or resultRef or "",
    })
end

function tmApplyPlaceAuxContextRuntime(triggerId, source, aux)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    local mat = tmPlaceAuxMaterial(aux or {})
    if mat.reason == "missing" then return false end
    if src ~= "panel" then
        tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "manual_refresh_proof_only", mat, "none", "source_not_panel")
        return false
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then
        tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", mat, "none", "inactive_session")
        return false
    end
    if mat.reason ~= "ok" then
        tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, "none", mat.reason)
        return false
    end
    if mat.section ~= "place" then return false end

    local auxStatus = tostring(mat.status or "missing")
    if auxStatus == "present" then
        if mat.id_or_name == "none" and mat.visible_name == "none" then
            tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", mat, "none", "missing_place_label")
            return false
        end
        local key = tmPlaceAuxContextKey(triggerId, src, mat)
        if tmPlaceAuxContextKeySeen(triggerId, key) then
            tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "duplicate_key", mat, key, "guard_seen")
            return false
        end
        local current = tmReadPlaceContext(triggerId)
        if current.status == "present" and current.id_or_name == mat.id_or_name and current.visible_name == mat.visible_name then
            tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_current", mat, key, "same_context")
            return false
        end
        setVar(triggerId, TM_PLACE_CONTEXT_VAR, tmPlaceContextLine({
            status = "present",
            id_or_name = mat.id_or_name,
            visible_name = mat.visible_name,
            source = "aux_world_panel",
            episode = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "none"),
        }))
        tmRememberPlaceAuxContextKey(triggerId, key)
        tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied_present", mat, key, "ok")
        return true
    end

    if auxStatus == "none" then
        local current = tmReadPlaceContext(triggerId)
        if current.status ~= "present" then
            tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_none", mat, "none", "empty_context")
            return false
        end
        local key = tmPlaceAuxContextKey(triggerId, src, mat)
        if tmPlaceAuxContextKeySeen(triggerId, key) then
            tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "duplicate_key", mat, key, "guard_seen")
            return false
        end
        setVar(triggerId, TM_PLACE_CONTEXT_VAR, "")
        tmRememberPlaceAuxContextKey(triggerId, key)
        tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied_none", mat, key, "ok")
        return true
    end

    tmPlaceAuxContextDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", mat, "none", "state_not_actionable")
    return false
end

function tmApplyPlaceAuxContextRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local aux = tmPlaceFirstAuxWorldParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    return tmApplyPlaceAuxContextRuntime(triggerId, src, aux)
end

function tmNpcPaymentPositiveGold(value)
    local amount = math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0)
    if amount <= 0 then return 0 end
    return clamp(amount, 1, TM_GOLD_MAX_SINGLE or 1000000)
end

function tmNpcFirstAuxPaymentParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_NPC_PAYMENT" then
            return tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
        end
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_NPC_PAYMENT", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = ""}
end

function tmNpcPaymentMaterial(aux)
    local fields = aux and aux.fields or {}
    local result = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[5] or "")
    if not TM_AUX_NPC_PAYMENT_RESULTS[result] then result = "unknown" end
    return {
        status = tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing"),
        npc_id = tmNpcCleanText(fields[3] or "none", "none", 64),
        gold = tmNpcPaymentPositiveGold(fields[4] or "0"),
        result = result,
        evidence = tmNpcCleanText(fields[6] or "none", "none", 120),
    }
end

function tmNpcPaymentIdentityMaterial(payment)
    return {
        status = payment and payment.result == "resolved" and "resolved" or "unknown",
        section = "npc",
        id_or_name = payment and payment.npc_id or "none",
        visible_name = "none",
        evidence = payment and payment.evidence or "none",
    }
end

function tmNpcPaymentGuardKey(triggerId, source, material, proof, main)
    if not material or not proof then return "none" end
    if material.gold <= 0 or material.npc_id == "none" or material.result ~= "resolved" then return "none" end
    if tostring(proof.status or "") ~= "runtime_exact" or tostring(proof.reason or "") ~= "known" then return "none" end
    local packed = table.concat({
        "npcpay",
        tostring(source or "panel"),
        tostring(material.npc_id or "none"),
        tostring(proof.runtime_slot or "none"),
        tostring(proof.runtime_id or "none"),
        tostring(material.gold or 0),
        tostring(material.result or "none"),
        tostring(main and main.fp or ""),
        tostring(proof.baseline_fp or ""),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "none")),
        tostring(getVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", "0")),
    }, "\31")
    return "np#" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(packed)
end

function tmNpcPaymentGuardKeySeen(triggerId, guardKey)
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local current = tostring(getVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_PAYMENT_GUARD_KEYS_VAR, "") or "")
    if current == "none" then current = "" end
    return csvListContains(current, key)
end

function tmRememberNpcPaymentGuardKey(triggerId, guardKey)
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local current = tostring(getVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_PAYMENT_GUARD_KEYS_VAR, "") or "")
    if current == "none" then current = "" end
    local items = parseList(current, ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == key then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, key)
    while #items > TM_NPC_PAYMENT_GUARD_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_PAYMENT_GUARD_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmNpcPaymentDiagLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.guard_key or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.candidate_key or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.result_ref or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.aux_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.proof_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_status or "missing"),
        tmPackEscape(row.runtime_slot or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.npc_id or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.gold or "0"),
        tmPackEscape(row.result or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmNpcPaymentDiagLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_PAYMENT_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_NPC_PAYMENT_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_PAYMENT_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_NPC_PAYMENT_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
    return row
end

function tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, source, status, material, proof, main, aux, runtime, resultRef, reason, guardKey)
    return tmStoreNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = source or "aux_payment",
        status = status or "blocked",
        guard_key = guardKey or tmNpcPaymentGuardKey(triggerId, source, material, proof, main),
        candidate_key = proof and proof.candidate_key or "none",
        result_ref = resultRef or "none",
        reason = reason or "",
        main_status = main and main.status or "missing",
        aux_status = aux and aux.status or "missing",
        proof_status = proof and proof.status or "missing",
        runtime_status = runtime and runtime.status or "missing",
        runtime_slot = runtime and runtime.slot or "none",
        npc_id = material and material.npc_id or "none",
        gold = tostring(material and material.gold or 0),
        result = material and material.result or "none",
        baseline_fp = proof and proof.baseline_fp or tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId),
        main_fp = main and main.fp or "",
    })
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxPaymentRuntime(triggerId, source, main, aux, proof)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    local material = tmNpcPaymentMaterial(aux)
    if src ~= "panel" then
        local reason = src == "manual_refresh" and "manual_refresh_proof_only" or "source_not_panel"
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "proof_only", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", reason, "none")
        return false
    end
    local mainStatus = tostring(main and main.status or "missing")
    if tmNpcIsMeaningfulStatus(mainStatus) then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "main_present", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "main_authoritative", "none")
        return false
    end
    local auxStatus = tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing")
    if auxStatus == "missing" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "missing", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "missing", "none")
        return false
    end
    if auxStatus == "none" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "no_payment", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "none", "none")
        return false
    end
    if auxStatus == "insufficient_gold" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "insufficient_gold", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "aux_insufficient_gold", "none")
        return false
    end
    if auxStatus ~= "confirmed" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "aux_not_confirmed", "none")
        return false
    end
    if material.result ~= "resolved" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "result_not_resolved", "none")
        return false
    end
    if material.gold <= 0 then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "bad_gold", "none")
        return false
    end
    if not proof or tostring(proof.status or "") ~= "runtime_exact" or tostring(proof.reason or "") ~= "known" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, nil, "none", "identity_not_current_runtime", "none")
        return false
    end
    local runtime = {
        status = proof.runtime_status or "missing",
        slot = proof.runtime_slot or "none",
        id = proof.runtime_id or "none",
        name = proof.runtime_name or "none",
    }
    if runtime.status ~= "known" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, "none", "runtime_not_unique", "none")
        return false
    end
    local slotNum = tonumber(runtime.slot)
    local currentSlot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "npc")
    if not slotNum or not currentSlot or tonumber(currentSlot) ~= slotNum then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, runtime.slot or "none", "not_current_npc", "none")
        return false
    end
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slotNum), ""))
    if fields[1] ~= "npc" or tmNpcIdToken(fields[2]) ~= tmNpcIdToken(runtime.id) then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, runtime.slot or "none", "runtime_mismatch", "none")
        return false
    end
    if tostring(fields[4] or "") == "resolved" then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "already_resolved", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, runtime.slot or "none", "already_resolved", "none")
        return false
    end
    local guardKey = tmNpcPaymentGuardKey(triggerId, src, material, proof, main)
    if tmNpcPaymentGuardKeySeen(triggerId, guardKey) then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "duplicate", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, runtime.slot or "none", "duplicate_guard", guardKey)
        return false
    end
    local beforeGold = type(tmGetPartyGold) == "function" and tmGetPartyGold(triggerId) or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)
    if tmSpendGold(triggerId, material.gold, "npc_payment:" .. tostring(runtime.id or material.npc_id)) ~= true then
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "insufficient_gold", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, runtime.slot or "none", "spend_failed", guardKey)
        return false
    end
    if tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, "npc", slotNum, 4, "resolved") ~= true then
        setVar(triggerId, "party_gold", beforeGold)
        tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, runtime.slot or "none", "writer_failed", guardKey)
        return false
    end
    tmRememberNpcPaymentGuardKey(triggerId, guardKey)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "npc_aux_payment:" .. tostring(runtime.id or material.npc_id) .. ":" .. tostring(material.gold))
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "NPC 협상 성사: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "npc", runtime.id) .. " · " .. tostring(material.gold) .. "골드 소비")
    tmNpcPaymentDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied", material, proof, main, aux, runtime, runtime.slot or "none", "ok", guardKey)
    return true
end

function tmApplyNpcAuxPaymentRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmNpcReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmNpcFirstAuxPaymentParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local material = tmNpcPaymentMaterial(aux)
    local proof = tmBuildNpcIdentityProof(triggerId, src, main, tmNpcPaymentIdentityMaterial(material))
    return tmApplyNpcAuxPaymentRuntime(triggerId, src, main, aux, proof)
end

TM_SERVICE_PAYMENT_GUARD_STATUSES = {
    ready = true,
    applied = true,
    duplicate = true,
    insufficient_gold = true,
    missing_item = true,
    invalid_target = true,
    stale_baseline = true,
    blocked = true,
}

function tmServiceGuardStatus(status)
    local token = tostring(status or ""):lower()
    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    token = token:gsub("[%s%-]+", "_")
    if TM_SERVICE_PAYMENT_GUARD_STATUSES[token] then return token end
    return "blocked"
end

function tmServiceWriterMainFingerprint(triggerId)
    local main = tmServiceReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    return tostring(main.fp or "")
end

function tmServiceAppendRawDiagnostic(triggerId, storeKey, latestKey, maxRows, line)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, storeKey) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > maxRows do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, storeKey, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, latestKey, line)
    return true
end

function tmServicePaymentGuardLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or "main_writer"),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.ref_or_label or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.price or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.context or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.applied_key or "none"),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmServiceAppliedLedgerLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or "main_writer"),
        tmPackEscape(row.applied_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.ref_or_label or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.price or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.context or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmServiceAppliedLedgerKey(kind, target, refOrLabel, price, mainFp, baselineFp, context)
    local material = table.concat({
        tmServiceCleanKind(kind),
        tmServiceCleanText(target, "none", 64),
        tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel, "none", 96),
        tmServiceCleanPrice(price, "none"),
        tostring(mainFp or ""),
        tostring(baselineFp or ""),
        tostring(context or ""),
    }, "\31")
    return "sa#" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(material)
end

function tmServiceDuplicateContext(triggerId)
    local scenario = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", ""), 48)
    local episode = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", ""), 48)
    local session = tmPanelCueCleanField(getVar(triggerId, "trpg_session_count", ""), 24)
    return table.concat({
        "scenario=" .. (scenario ~= "" and scenario or "none"),
        "ep=" .. (episode ~= "" and episode or "none"),
        "session=" .. (session ~= "" and session or "none"),
    }, ";")
end

function tmServiceDuplicateGuardKey(kind, target, refOrLabel, price, mainFp, baselineFp, context)
    local material = table.concat({
        tmServiceCleanKind(kind),
        tmServiceCleanText(target, "none", 64),
        tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel, "none", 96),
        tmServiceCleanPrice(price, "none"),
        tostring(mainFp or ""),
        tostring(baselineFp or ""),
        tostring(context or ""),
    }, "\31")
    return "sd#" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(material)
end

function tmServiceDuplicateGuardLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or "main_writer"),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.guard_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.ref_or_label or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.price or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.main_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.baseline_fp or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.context or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreServiceDuplicateGuardDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    return tmServiceAppendRawDiagnostic(
        triggerId,
        TM_SERVICE_DUP_GUARD_DIAG_STORE_KEY,
        TM_SERVICE_DUP_GUARD_DIAG_LATEST_KEY,
        TM_SERVICE_DUP_GUARD_DIAG_MAX_ROWS,
        tmServiceDuplicateGuardLine(row)
    )
end

function tmServiceDuplicateGuardKeySeen(triggerId, guardKey)
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_DUP_GUARD_KEYS_VAR) or "")
    if current == "none" then current = "" end
    return csvListContains(current, key)
end

function tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuardKey(triggerId, guardKey)
    local key = tostring(guardKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_DUP_GUARD_KEYS_VAR) or "")
    if current == "none" then current = "" end
    local items = parseList(current, ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == key then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, key)
    while #items > TM_SERVICE_DUP_GUARD_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_DUP_GUARD_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmBuildServiceDuplicateGuardRow(triggerId, kind, target, refOrLabel, price, reason, source)
    local baselineFp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)
    local context = tmServiceDuplicateContext(triggerId)
    local mainFp = tmServiceWriterMainFingerprint(triggerId)
    local cleanKind = tmServiceCleanKind(kind)
    local cleanTarget = tmServiceCleanText(target, "none", 64)
    local cleanRef = tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel, "none", 96)
    local cleanPrice = tmServiceCleanPrice(price, "none")
    local guardKey = "none"
    if mainFp ~= "" then
        guardKey = tmServiceDuplicateGuardKey(cleanKind, cleanTarget, cleanRef, cleanPrice, mainFp, baselineFp, context)
    end
    return {
        source = source or "main_writer",
        status = "candidate",
        guard_key = guardKey,
        kind = cleanKind,
        target = cleanTarget,
        ref_or_label = cleanRef,
        price = cleanPrice,
        main_fp = mainFp,
        baseline_fp = baselineFp,
        context = context,
        reason = tmServiceCleanText(reason, "", 96),
    }
end

function tmServiceMainDuplicateGuard(triggerId, kind, target, refOrLabel, price, reason, source)
    local row = tmBuildServiceDuplicateGuardRow(triggerId, kind, target, refOrLabel, price, reason, source)
    if row.guard_key == "none" then
        row.status = "skipped"
        row.reason = row.reason ~= "" and row.reason or "missing_main_fp"
        tmStoreServiceDuplicateGuardDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
        return false, row
    end
    if tmServiceDuplicateGuardKeySeen(triggerId, row.guard_key) then
        row.status = "duplicate"
        tmStoreServiceDuplicateGuardDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
        tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, row.kind, row.target, row.ref_or_label, row.price, "duplicate", row.reason ~= "" and row.reason or "duplicate_guard", row.guard_key, row.source)
        return true, row
    end
    return false, row
end

function tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuard(triggerId, row, reason)
    if type(row) ~= "table" or row.guard_key == nil or row.guard_key == "" or row.guard_key == "none" then return false end
    local remembered = tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuardKey(triggerId, row.guard_key)
    row.status = remembered and "remembered" or "seen"
    if reason ~= nil and tostring(reason) ~= "" then row.reason = tmServiceCleanText(reason, "", 96) end
    tmStoreServiceDuplicateGuardDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    return remembered
end

function tmStoreServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, row)
    return tmServiceAppendRawDiagnostic(
        triggerId,
        TM_SERVICE_PAYMENT_GUARD_STORE_KEY,
        TM_SERVICE_PAYMENT_GUARD_LATEST_KEY,
        TM_SERVICE_PAYMENT_GUARD_MAX_ROWS,
        tmServicePaymentGuardLine(row)
    )
end

function tmStoreServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, row)
    return tmServiceAppendRawDiagnostic(
        triggerId,
        TM_SERVICE_APPLIED_LEDGER_STORE_KEY,
        TM_SERVICE_APPLIED_LEDGER_LATEST_KEY,
        TM_SERVICE_APPLIED_LEDGER_MAX_ROWS,
        tmServiceAppliedLedgerLine(row)
    )
end

function tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, kind, target, refOrLabel, price, status, reason, appliedKey, source)
    local baselineFp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)
    local context = tmServiceTxContext(triggerId)
    local row = {
        source = source or "main_writer",
        status = tmServiceGuardStatus(status),
        kind = tmServiceCleanKind(kind),
        target = tmServiceCleanText(target, "none", 64),
        ref_or_label = tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel, "none", 96),
        price = tmServiceCleanPrice(price, "none"),
        main_fp = tmServiceWriterMainFingerprint(triggerId),
        baseline_fp = baselineFp,
        context = context,
        applied_key = appliedKey or "none",
        reason = tmServiceCleanText(reason, "", 96),
    }
    tmStoreServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, row)
    return row
end

function tmRecordServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, kind, target, refOrLabel, price, reason, source)
    local baselineFp = tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)
    local context = tmServiceTxContext(triggerId)
    local mainFp = tmServiceWriterMainFingerprint(triggerId)
    local cleanKind = tmServiceCleanKind(kind)
    local cleanTarget = tmServiceCleanText(target, "none", 64)
    local cleanRef = tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel, "none", 96)
    local cleanPrice = tmServiceCleanPrice(price, "none")
    local appliedKey = tmServiceAppliedLedgerKey(cleanKind, cleanTarget, cleanRef, cleanPrice, mainFp, baselineFp, context)
    tmStoreServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, {
        source = source or "main_writer",
        applied_key = appliedKey,
        kind = cleanKind,
        target = cleanTarget,
        ref_or_label = cleanRef,
        price = cleanPrice,
        main_fp = mainFp,
        baseline_fp = baselineFp,
        context = context,
        reason = tmServiceCleanText(reason, "", 96),
    })
    tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, cleanKind, cleanTarget, cleanRef, cleanPrice, "applied", reason, appliedKey, source)
    return appliedKey
end

function tmServicePositivePrice(value, fallback)
    local price = math.floor(tonumber(value) or 0)
    if price <= 0 and fallback ~= nil then price = math.floor(tonumber(fallback) or 0) end
    if price <= 0 then return 0 end
    return clamp(price, 1, TM_GOLD_MAX_SINGLE or 1000000)
end

function tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, kind, target, refOrLabel, price, reason, source)
    local src = source or "main_writer"
    local cleanKind = tmServiceCleanKind(kind)
    local cleanTarget = tmServiceCleanText(target, "none", 64)
    local cleanRef = tmServiceCleanText(refOrLabel, "none", 96)
    local cleanReason = tmServiceCleanText(reason, "", 96)
    local cost = tmServicePositivePrice(price, nil)

    if cleanKind == "revive" then
        if cost <= 0 then cost = 50 end
        if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[cleanTarget] then
            tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "revive", cleanTarget, "none", cost, "invalid_target", "bad_owner", nil, src)
            return false, "invalid_target", "none", nil
        end
        local duplicate, guardRow = tmServiceMainDuplicateGuard(triggerId, "revive", cleanTarget, "none", cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "revive", src)
        if duplicate then
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "부활 중복 처리 생략: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, cleanTarget))
            return false, "duplicate", "none", guardRow
        end
        if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. cleanTarget .. "_status", "active") ~= "ko" then
            tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "revive", cleanTarget, "none", cost, "invalid_target", "target_not_ko", nil, src)
            return false, "invalid_target", "none", nil
        end
        if tmSpendGold(triggerId, cost, "revive:" .. cleanTarget) == true then
            local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. cleanTarget .. "_hp_max", 30)
            healHeroine(triggerId, cleanTarget, math.floor(hpMax / 2))
            setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "revive:" .. cleanTarget .. ":" .. tostring(cost))
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "부활: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, cleanTarget) .. " · " .. tostring(cost) .. "골드 소비")
            local appliedKey = tmRecordServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, "revive", cleanTarget, "none", cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "revive", src)
            tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuard(triggerId, guardRow, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "revive")
            return true, "applied", appliedKey, guardRow
        end
        tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "revive", cleanTarget, "none", cost, "insufficient_gold", "spend_failed", nil, src)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "부활 실패(골드 부족): " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, cleanTarget) .. " · 필요 " .. tostring(cost) .. "골드")
        return false, "insufficient_gold", "none", guardRow
    end

    if cleanKind == "rest" then
        if cost <= 0 then cost = 20 end
        local duplicate, guardRow = tmServiceMainDuplicateGuard(triggerId, "rest", "party", "inn", cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "inn_rest", src)
        if duplicate then
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "여관 휴식 중복 처리 생략")
            return false, "duplicate", "none", guardRow
        end
        if tmSpendGold(triggerId, cost, "inn_rest") == true then
            for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
                if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active") ~= "ko" then
                    healHeroine(triggerId, id, getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 30))
                end
            end
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "여관 휴식: 파티 체력 회복 · " .. tostring(cost) .. "골드 소비")
            local appliedKey = tmRecordServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, "rest", "party", "inn", cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "inn_rest", src)
            tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuard(triggerId, guardRow, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "inn_rest")
            return true, "applied", appliedKey, guardRow
        end
        tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "rest", "party", "inn", cost, "insufficient_gold", "spend_failed", nil, src)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "여관 휴식 실패(골드 부족)")
        return false, "insufficient_gold", "none", guardRow
    end

    if cleanKind == "buy" then
        local label = tmLootSanitizeText(cleanRef, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
        if label == "" or label == "none" or cost <= 0 then
            tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "buy", "none", label ~= "" and label or "none", cost, "blocked", "bad_buy", nil, src)
            return false, "blocked", "none", nil
        end
        local duplicate, guardRow = tmServiceMainDuplicateGuard(triggerId, "buy", "none", label, cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_buy", src)
        if duplicate then
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 구매 중복 처리 생략: " .. label)
            return false, "duplicate", "none", guardRow
        end
        if tmSpendGold(triggerId, cost, "shop:" .. label) == true then
            local itemRef = tmStoreRuntimePartyItem(triggerId, label, nil, tmInferRuntimeItemKindFromLabel(label))
            setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "shop_buy:" .. label)
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 구매: " .. label .. " · " .. tostring(cost) .. "골드 소비")
            local appliedKey = tmRecordServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, "buy", "none", itemRef or label, cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_buy", src)
            tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuard(triggerId, guardRow, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_buy")
            return true, "applied", itemRef or appliedKey, guardRow
        end
        tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "buy", "none", label, cost, "insufficient_gold", "spend_failed", nil, src)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 구매 실패(골드 부족): " .. label)
        return false, "insufficient_gold", "none", guardRow
    end

    if cleanKind == "sell" then
        local ref = cleanRef:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if not ref:match("^it%d+$") then
            tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, cost, "blocked", "bad_ref", nil, src)
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "shop_sell_bad_ref")
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 판매 실패(잘못된 아이템 참조): " .. ref)
            return false, "blocked", "none", nil
        end
        if cost <= 0 then
            tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, cost, "blocked", "bad_price", nil, src)
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "shop_sell_bad_price")
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 판매 실패(가격 오류): " .. tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref))
            return false, "blocked", "none", nil
        end
        local duplicate, guardRow = tmServiceMainDuplicateGuard(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_sell", src)
        if duplicate then
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 판매 중복 처리 생략: " .. tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref))
            return false, "duplicate", "none", guardRow
        end
        if not csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref) then
            tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, cost, "missing_item", "not_in_party_bag", nil, src)
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "shop_sell_missing_item")
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 판매 실패(공용 가방에 없음): " .. tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref))
            return false, "missing_item", "none", nil
        end
        local equippedOwner = tmEquippedItemOwner(triggerId, ref)
        if equippedOwner then
            tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "sell", equippedOwner, ref, cost, "blocked", "equipped_item", nil, src)
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "shop_sell_equipped_item")
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 판매 실패(장착 중): " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, equippedOwner) .. " · " .. tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref))
            return false, "blocked", "none", nil
        end
        local label = tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref)
        setVar(triggerId, "party_items", removeCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref))
        tmAwardGold(triggerId, cost, "shop_sell:" .. label)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "shop_sell:" .. ref .. ":" .. tostring(cost))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 판매: " .. label .. " · " .. tostring(cost) .. "골드 획득")
        local appliedKey = tmRecordServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, cost, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_sell", src)
        tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuard(triggerId, guardRow, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_sell")
        return true, "applied", appliedKey, guardRow
    end

    tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, cleanKind, cleanTarget, cleanRef, cost, "blocked", "unsupported_kind", nil, src)
    return false, "blocked", "none", nil
end

function tmApplyServiceBuyQuantityTransaction(triggerId, refOrLabel, totalPrice, qty, reason, source)
    local src = source or "main_writer"
    local label = tmLootSanitizeText(refOrLabel, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    local cleanQty = tonumber(tmServiceCleanQty(qty or "none", "none")) or 0
    local total = tmServicePositivePrice(totalPrice, nil)
    local cleanReason = tmServiceCleanText(reason, "", 96)
    if label == "" or label == "none" or cleanQty <= 0 or total <= 0 then
        tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "buy", "none", label ~= "" and label or "none", total, "blocked", "bad_buy_quantity", nil, src)
        return false, "blocked", "none", nil
    end
    local guardRef = tmServiceQuantityMaterialRef(label, cleanQty)
    local duplicate, guardRow = tmServiceMainDuplicateGuard(triggerId, "buy", "none", guardRef, total, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_buyq", src)
    if duplicate then
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 묶음 구매 중복 처리 생략: " .. label .. " x" .. tostring(cleanQty))
        return false, "duplicate", "none", guardRow
    end
    if tmSpendGold(triggerId, total, "shopq:" .. label .. ":" .. tostring(cleanQty)) ~= true then
        tmRecordServicePaymentGuard(triggerId, "buy", "none", guardRef, total, "insufficient_gold", "spend_failed", nil, src)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 묶음 구매 실패(골드 부족): " .. label .. " x" .. tostring(cleanQty))
        return false, "insufficient_gold", "none", guardRow
    end
    local refs = {}
    local itemKind = tmInferRuntimeItemKindFromLabel(label)
    for _ = 1, cleanQty do
        table.insert(refs, tmStoreRuntimePartyItem(triggerId, label, nil, itemKind))
    end
    local resultRef = table.concat(refs, ",")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "shop_buyq:" .. label .. ":" .. tostring(cleanQty))
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "상점 묶음 구매: " .. label .. " x" .. tostring(cleanQty) .. " · " .. tostring(total) .. "골드 소비")
    local appliedKey = tmRecordServiceAppliedLedger(triggerId, "buy", "none", guardRef, total, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_buyq", src)
    tmRememberServiceDuplicateGuard(triggerId, guardRow, cleanReason ~= "" and cleanReason or "shop_buyq")
    return true, "applied", resultRef ~= "" and resultRef or appliedKey, guardRow
end

TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_KEYS_VAR = "tm_reward_aux_grant_keys"
TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_KEY_MAX = 40
TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_DIAG_STORE_KEY = "tm_reward_aux_grant_diag"
TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_DIAG_LATEST_KEY = "tm_reward_aux_grant_diag_latest"
TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_DIAG_MAX_ROWS = 30

TM_SERVICE_AUX_DIAG_STORE_KEY = "tm_service_aux_diag"
TM_SERVICE_AUX_DIAG_LATEST_KEY = "tm_service_aux_diag_latest"
TM_SERVICE_AUX_DIAG_MAX_ROWS = 30

TM_WORLD_ACTOR_AUX_DIAG_STORE_KEY = "tm_world_actor_aux_diag"
TM_WORLD_ACTOR_AUX_DIAG_LATEST_KEY = "tm_world_actor_aux_diag_latest"
TM_WORLD_ACTOR_AUX_DIAG_MAX_ROWS = 30
TM_ACTOR_STATE_AUX_APPLY_KEYS_VAR = "tm_actor_state_aux_apply_keys"
TM_ACTOR_STATE_AUX_APPLY_KEY_MAX = 40

function tmRewardAuxGrantDiagLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.proof_key or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.qty or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.result_ref or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, row)
    local line = tmRewardAuxGrantDiagLine(row)
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
end

function tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, source, status, proof, resultRef, reason)
    tmStoreRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = source,
        status = status,
        proof_key = proof and proof.proof_key or "none",
        kind = proof and proof.kind or "none",
        name = proof and proof.name or "none",
        qty = proof and proof.qty or "none",
        result_ref = resultRef or "none",
        reason = reason or "",
    })
end

function tmRewardAuxGrantKeySeen(triggerId, proofKey)
    local key = tostring(proofKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    return csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_KEYS_VAR, ""), key)
end

function tmRememberRewardAuxGrantKey(triggerId, proofKey)
    local key = tostring(proofKey or "")
    if key == "" or key == "none" then return false end
    local items = parseList(getVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_KEYS_VAR, ""), ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == key then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, key)
    while #items > TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_REWARD_AUX_GRANT_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmRewardAuxGrantAllowedKind(kind)
    local k = tmRewardDuplicateCanonicalKind(kind)
    return k == "item" or k == "consumable" or k == "key" or k == "skillbook" or k == "gold"
end

function tmRewardAuxGrantCleanVisibleName(name)
    return tmLootSanitizeText(name or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
end

function tmRewardAuxGrantPositiveAmount(qty)
    local amount = math.floor(tonumber(qty) or 0)
    if amount <= 0 then return 0 end
    return clamp(amount, 1, TM_GOLD_MAX_SINGLE or 1000000)
end

function tmRewardAuxGrantSkillbookKv(aux, proof)
    local gradeOrRarity = aux and aux.fields and tmLootSanitizeText(aux.fields[6] or "", 24) or ""
    local grade = gradeOrRarity:upper()
    local rarity = gradeOrRarity:lower()
    if not TM_EFFECT_GRADES[grade] then grade = "C" end
    if not TM_LOOT_RARITIES[rarity] then rarity = "common" end
    return {
        name = proof.name,
        rarity = rarity,
        grade = grade,
        stat = "int",
        role = "support",
        source = "aux_reward",
    }
end

function tmRewardRefreshSideEffectVarKeys(triggerId)
    local keys = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_REWARD_REFRESH_SIDE_EFFECT_VAR_KEYS or {}) do
        table.insert(keys, key)
    end
    return keys
end

function tmSnapshotRewardRefreshSideEffects(triggerId)
    return tmSnapshotResolvedVars(triggerId, tmRewardRefreshSideEffectVarKeys(triggerId))
end

function tmRestoreRewardRefreshSideEffects(triggerId, snap)
    tmRestoreResolvedVars(triggerId, snap)
end

function tmApplyRewardAuxFillMissingGrant(triggerId, source, main, aux, proof, itemMeta)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then
        tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", proof, "none", "source_not_panel")
        return false
    end
    if not proof or proof.status ~= "candidate" or proof.evidence_source ~= "aux" then
        tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "not_aux_candidate")
        return false
    end
    if tostring(main and main.status or "missing") ~= "none" then
        tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", proof, "none", "main_authoritative")
        return false
    end
    if tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing") ~= "present" then
        tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "aux_not_present")
        return false
    end
    if tmRewardAuxGrantKeySeen(triggerId, proof.proof_key) then
        tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", proof, "none", "duplicate_key")
        return false
    end
    local kind = tmRewardDuplicateCanonicalKind(proof.kind)
    if not tmRewardAuxGrantAllowedKind(kind) then
        tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", proof, "none", "kind_not_allowed")
        return false
    end

    local sideEffectSnapshot = nil
    if src == "manual_refresh" then
        sideEffectSnapshot = tmSnapshotRewardRefreshSideEffects(triggerId)
    end
    local resultRef = nil
    if kind == "item" or kind == "consumable" or kind == "key" then
        local name = tmRewardAuxGrantCleanVisibleName(proof.name)
        if not tmRewardHasComparableName(name) then
            tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "bad_item_name")
            return false
        end
        local rarity = aux and aux.fields and aux.fields[6] or ""
        local auxKind = aux and aux.fields and aux.fields[2] or "item"
        local evidence = aux and aux.fields and aux.fields[8] or ""
        local profile = tmResolveRuntimeItemProfile(triggerId, name, rarity, auxKind, evidence, itemMeta)
        local ref, storedName, _, _, storeMode = tmStoreRuntimePartyItemProfile(triggerId, name, rarity, profile.kind, profile, {dedupe = true})
        if ref then
            resultRef = ref
            setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "aux_reward_item:" .. ref)
            tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
            if storeMode == "merged" then
                tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 중복 처리: " .. storedName .. " (" .. ref .. ")")
            else
                tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 획득: " .. storedName .. " (" .. ref .. ")")
            end
        end
    elseif kind == "skillbook" then
        local name = tmRewardAuxGrantCleanVisibleName(proof.name)
        if not tmRewardHasComparableName(name) then
            tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "bad_skillbook_name")
            return false
        end
        resultRef = tmStoreRewardSkillbook(triggerId, tmRewardAuxGrantSkillbookKv(aux, proof))
        if resultRef then tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward") end
    elseif kind == "gold" then
        local amount = tmRewardAuxGrantPositiveAmount(proof.qty)
        if amount <= 0 then
            tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "bad_gold_amount")
            return false
        end
        if tmAwardGold(triggerId, amount, "aux_reward:" .. tostring(proof.name or "gold"), nil) then
            resultRef = "gold:" .. tostring(amount)
            setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "aux_reward_gold:" .. tostring(amount))
            tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
        end
    end

    if resultRef == nil or resultRef == "" then
        if src == "manual_refresh" then
            tmRestoreRewardRefreshSideEffects(triggerId, sideEffectSnapshot)
        end
        tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, "none", "writer_failed")
        return false
    end
    tmRememberRewardAuxGrantKey(triggerId, proof.proof_key)
    tmRewardAuxGrantDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "applied", proof, resultRef, "ok")
    return true
end

function tmApplyRewardAuxFillMissingRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmRewardReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local itemMetas = tmAuxItemMetaParsedRows(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local applied = false
    for _, aux in ipairs(tmRewardAuxParsedRows(triggerId, rows or {}, src)) do
        local status, reason, auxKind, auxName = tmRewardCompareStatus(main, aux)
        local proof = tmBuildRewardDuplicateProofDiagnostic(triggerId, src, main, aux, auxKind, auxName, status, reason)
        local itemMeta = tmFindAuxItemMetaForReward(proof, aux, itemMetas)
        if tmApplyRewardAuxFillMissingGrant(triggerId, src, main, aux, proof, itemMeta) then
            applied = true
        end
    end
    return applied
end
