function tmServiceAuxAdapterPrice(kind, price)
    local cleanKind = tmServiceCleanKind(kind)
    local cleanPrice = tmServiceCleanPrice(price, "none")
    if cleanKind == "revive" and cleanPrice == "none" then return 50 end
    if cleanKind == "rest" and cleanPrice == "none" then return 20 end
    return tmServicePositivePrice(cleanPrice, nil)
end

function tmServiceAuxAdapterAllowedKind(kind)
    local cleanKind = tmServiceCleanKind(kind)
    return cleanKind == "revive" or cleanKind == "rest" or cleanKind == "buy" or cleanKind == "sell"
end

function tmServiceRefreshSideEffectVarKeys(triggerId)
    local keys = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_SERVICE_REFRESH_SIDE_EFFECT_VAR_KEYS or {}) do
        table.insert(keys, key)
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS or {}) do
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_hp")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_status")
    end
    return keys
end

function tmSnapshotServiceRefreshSideEffects(triggerId)
    return tmSnapshotResolvedVars(triggerId, tmServiceRefreshSideEffectVarKeys(triggerId))
end

function tmRestoreServiceRefreshSideEffects(triggerId, snap)
    tmRestoreResolvedVars(triggerId, snap)
end

function tmApplyServiceAuxFillMissingTransaction(triggerId, source, main, aux, proof)
    local src = tostring(source or "")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then
        tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, nil, "none", "source_not_panel")
        return false
    end
    if tostring(main and main.status or "missing") ~= "none" then
        tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "main_present", proof, nil, "none", "main_authoritative")
        return false
    end
    if not proof or proof.status ~= "candidate" or proof.evidence_source ~= "aux" then
        tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, nil, "none", "not_aux_candidate")
        return false
    end
    if tostring(aux and aux.status or "missing") ~= "confirmed" then
        tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, nil, "none", "aux_not_confirmed")
        return false
    end
    if not tmServiceAuxAdapterAllowedKind(proof.kind) then
        tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, nil, "none", "kind_not_allowed")
        return false
    end
    local proofQty = tmServiceCleanQty(proof.qty or "none", "none")
    if proofQty ~= "none" and proof.kind ~= "buy" then
        tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, nil, "none", "quantity_kind_not_allowed")
        return false
    end
    local price = tmServiceAuxAdapterPrice(proof.kind, proof.price)
    if price <= 0 then
        tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", proof, nil, "none", "bad_price")
        return false
    end
    local target = proof.target
    local refOrLabel = proof.ref_or_label
    if proof.kind == "rest" then
        target = "party"
        refOrLabel = "inn"
    end
    local sideEffectSnapshot = nil
    if src == "manual_refresh" then
        sideEffectSnapshot = tmSnapshotServiceRefreshSideEffects(triggerId)
    end
    local ok, status, resultRef, guardRow
    if proof.kind == "buy" and proofQty ~= "none" then
        ok, status, resultRef, guardRow = tmApplyServiceBuyQuantityTransaction(
            triggerId,
            refOrLabel,
            price,
            proofQty,
            "aux_service_q",
            "aux_adapter"
        )
    else
        ok, status, resultRef, guardRow = tmApplyServiceTransaction(
            triggerId,
            proof.kind,
            target,
            refOrLabel,
            price,
            "aux_service",
            "aux_adapter"
        )
    end
    if src == "manual_refresh" and not ok then
        tmRestoreServiceRefreshSideEffects(triggerId, sideEffectSnapshot)
        guardRow = nil
        resultRef = "none"
    end
    tmServiceAuxAdapterDiagnostic(triggerId, src, status, proof, guardRow, resultRef, ok and "ok" or status)
    return ok
end

function tmApplyServiceAuxFillMissingRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local main = tmServiceReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    local aux = tmServiceFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, src)
    local status, reason, auxMat = tmServiceCompareStatus(main, aux)
    local proof = tmBuildServiceTxProofDiagnostic(triggerId, src, main, aux, auxMat, status, reason)
    return tmApplyServiceAuxFillMissingTransaction(triggerId, src, main, aux, proof)
end

function tmSkillUseAuxCleanField(value, fallback)
    local clean = tmPanelCueCleanField(value or "", 96)
    if clean == "" or clean == "-" then return fallback or "none" end
    return clean
end

function tmSkillUseAuxParsedRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local parsedRows = {}
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_SKILL_USE" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
            table.insert(parsedRows, parsed)
        end
    end
    return parsedRows
end

function tmSkillUseAuxRememberLatest(triggerId, source, status, ownerId, skillRef, target, reason)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_skill_use_aux_latest", table.concat({
        tostring(source or "aux"),
        tostring(status or "unknown"),
        tostring(ownerId or "none"),
        tostring(skillRef or "none"),
        tostring(target or "none"),
        tostring(reason or "")
    }, "|"))
end

function tmApplySkillUseAuxFillMissingRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    local applied = false
    for _, aux in ipairs(tmSkillUseAuxParsedRows(triggerId, rows or {}, src)) do
        local status = tostring(aux.status or "unknown")
        local fields = aux.fields or {}
        if status == "confirmed" and aux.reason == "ok" then
            local ownerId = tmSkillUseAuxCleanField(fields[3] or aux.owner, "none")
            local skillRef = tmSkillUseAuxCleanField(fields[4], "current")
            local target = tmSkillUseAuxCleanField(fields[5], "self")
            local beforeError = getVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_skill_use_last_result", "pending|" .. src)
            tmApplySkillUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef, target, "aux_skill_use")
            local afterError = getVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
            local afterResult = getVar(triggerId, "tm_skill_use_last_result", "")
            local changed = afterResult:find("applied|", 1, true) == 1
            if changed then
                applied = true
                tmSkillUseAuxRememberLatest(triggerId, src, "applied", ownerId, skillRef, target, "ok")
            else
                tmSkillUseAuxRememberLatest(triggerId, src, "blocked", ownerId, skillRef, target, afterError ~= "" and afterError or beforeError)
            end
        else
            tmSkillUseAuxRememberLatest(triggerId, src, status, fields[3] or "none", fields[4] or "none", fields[5] or "none", aux.reason or "no_mutation")
        end
    end
    return applied
end

function tmAuxNormalizeEnum(raw)
    local token = tostring(raw or ""):lower()
    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    token = token:gsub("[%s%-]+", "_")
    return TM_AUX_ENUM_ALIASES[token] or token
end

function tmAuxNormalizeActorOp(raw)
    local token = tostring(raw or ""):lower()
    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    token = token:gsub("[%s%-]+", "_")
    if token == "" or token == "-" or token == "none" or token == "no" or token == "absent" then return "none" end
    if token == "unknown" or token == "unsure" or token == "uncertain" or token == "unclear" then return "unknown" end
    if token == "apply" or token == "add" or token == "present" or token == "set" then return "apply" end
    if token == "clear" or token == "remove" or token == "removed" or token == "cleanse" then return "clear" end
    if token == "tick" or token == "advance" or token == "pass" then return "tick" end
    return token
end

function tmAuxNormalizeRewardStatus(raw)
    local token = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(raw)
    if token == "confirmed" then return "present" end
    return token
end

function tmAuxNormalizeWorldState(raw)
    local token = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(raw)
    if token == "cleared" then return "resolved" end
    return token
end

function tmAuxNormalizeConditionId(raw)
    local token = tostring(raw or ""):lower()
    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    token = token:gsub("[%s%-]+", "_")
    if token == "" or token == "-" or token == "none" or token == "no" or token == "absent" then return "none" end
    if token == "unknown" or token == "unsure" or token == "uncertain" or token == "unclear" then return "unknown" end
    return token:gsub("[^%w_]", "")
end

function tmAuxActorConditionAllowed(conditionId)
    local token = tmAuxNormalizeConditionId(conditionId)
    if token == "none" or token == "unknown" or token == "all" or token == "removable" then return true, token end
    return tmConditionDef(token) ~= nil, token
end

function tmAuxDurationAllowed(raw)
    local token = tostring(raw or ""):lower()
    token = token:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if token == "" or token == "-" or token == "none" or token == "unknown" then return true end
    return token:match("^%d%d?$") ~= nil
end

function tmAuxSplitFields(payload)
    local fields = {}
    for part in (tostring(payload or "") .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        table.insert(fields, tmPanelCueCleanField(part, 180))
    end
    return fields
end

function tmCollectAuxMarkerRows(text)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    local rows = {}
    local function add(name, payload)
        local marker = tostring(name or "")
        if marker:match("^AUX_[%u_]+$") then
            table.insert(rows, {name = marker, payload = tostring(payload or "")})
        end
    end
    for name, payload in raw:gmatch("▥(AUX_[%u_]+):(.-)▥") do add(name, payload) end
    for name, payload in raw:gmatch("<<(AUX_[%u_]+):([^>]*)>>") do add(name, payload) end
    for name, payload in raw:gmatch("%[%[(AUX_[%u_]+):(.-)%]%]") do add(name, payload) end
    for name, payload in raw:gmatch("%{%{(AUX_[%u_]+):(.-)%}%}") do add(name, payload) end
    return rows
end

function tmStripAuxMarkers(text)
    local clean = tostring(text or "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?▥AUX_[%u_]+:.-▥", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?<<AUX_[%u_]+:[^>]*>>", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?%[%[AUX_[%u_]+:.-%]%]", "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?%{%{AUX_[%u_]+:.-%}%}", "")
    return clean
end

function tmAuxThreatConflict(triggerId, status, fields)
    local mainState = getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_state", "missing")
    if mainState == "" then mainState = "missing" end
    local mainId = getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_main_marker_id", "")
    local auxId = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[3] or "", 48)
    if status == "none" and mainState == "set" then return "main_set_aux_none" end
    if status == "present" and mainState == "none" then return "main_none_aux_present" end
    if status == "present" and mainState == "set" and mainId ~= "" and auxId ~= "" and auxId ~= "enemy:current" and auxId ~= "current" and auxId ~= mainId then
        return "main_set_aux_different"
    end
    return ""
end

function tmAuxIntentConflict(triggerId, status, fields)
    local ownerId = tostring(fields[2] or "")
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return "bad_owner" end
    local mainPresent = tmCsvSet(getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_present_ids", ""))
    if status == "none" and mainPresent[ownerId] then return "main_present_aux_none" end
    if status == "present" and not mainPresent[ownerId] then return "main_missing_aux_present" end
    return ""
end

function tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source)
    local spec = TM_AUX_OBSERVE_SPECS[row.name]
    if not spec then
        return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "unknown_marker", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = ""}
    end
    local fields = tmAuxSplitFields(row.payload)
    if #fields < spec.fields then
        return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "field_count", conflict = "", fields = fields, owner = ""}
    end
    local version = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[1])
    if version ~= spec.version then
        return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "bad_version:" .. tostring(fields[1] or ""), conflict = "", fields = fields, owner = ""}
    end
    local ownerId = ""
    local status
    if spec.staticStatus then
        status = spec.staticStatus
    elseif spec.statusNormalizer == "actor_op" then
        status = tmAuxNormalizeActorOp(fields[spec.statusField])
    elseif spec.statusNormalizer == "reward_status" then
        status = tmAuxNormalizeRewardStatus(fields[spec.statusField])
    elseif spec.statusNormalizer == "world_state" then
        status = tmAuxNormalizeWorldState(fields[spec.statusField])
    else
        status = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[spec.statusField])
    end
    if not spec.allowedStatus[status] then
        return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "bad_status:" .. tostring(fields[spec.statusField] or ""), conflict = "", fields = fields, owner = ownerId}
    end
    if spec.statusField then fields[spec.statusField] = status end
    if spec.ownerField then
        local rawOwner = tostring(fields[spec.ownerField] or "")
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[rawOwner] then
            ownerId = rawOwner
        else
            local ownerToken = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(rawOwner)
            if spec.ownerNoneStatuses and spec.ownerNoneStatuses[status] and (ownerToken == "none" or ownerToken == "unknown") then
                ownerId = ownerToken
                fields[spec.ownerField] = ownerToken
            else
                return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "bad_owner:" .. rawOwner, conflict = "", fields = fields, owner = ""}
            end
        end
    end
    if spec.enumFields then
        for _, enum in ipairs(spec.enumFields) do
            local token = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[enum.index])
            if not enum.allowed[token] then
                return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "bad_" .. tostring(enum.label or "enum") .. ":" .. tostring(fields[enum.index] or ""), conflict = "", fields = fields, owner = ownerId}
            end
        end
    end
    if spec.conditionField then
        local allowed, cleanCondition = tmAuxActorConditionAllowed(fields[spec.conditionField])
        if not allowed then
            return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "bad_condition:" .. tostring(fields[spec.conditionField] or ""), conflict = "", fields = fields, owner = ownerId}
        end
        fields[spec.conditionField] = cleanCondition
    end
    if spec.durationField and not tmAuxDurationAllowed(fields[spec.durationField]) then
        return {source = source, name = row.name, status = "malformed", applied = "false", reason = "bad_duration:" .. tostring(fields[spec.durationField] or ""), conflict = "", fields = fields, owner = ownerId}
    end
    local conflict = ""
    if row.name == "AUX_THREAT" then
        conflict = tmAuxThreatConflict(triggerId, status, fields)
    elseif row.name == "AUX_INTENT" then
        conflict = tmAuxIntentConflict(triggerId, status, fields)
    end
    return {source = source, name = row.name, status = status, applied = "observe", reason = "ok", conflict = conflict, fields = fields, owner = ownerId}
end

function tmValidateAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source)
    local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source)
    return {
        source = parsed.source,
        name = parsed.name,
        status = parsed.status,
        applied = parsed.applied,
        reason = parsed.reason,
        conflict = parsed.conflict,
    }
end

function tmActorStateFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_ACTOR_STATE" then
            return tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
        end
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_ACTOR_STATE", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = ""}
end

function tmActorStateAuxConditionKey(triggerId, main, parsed)
    local fields = parsed and parsed.fields or {}
    local status = tostring(parsed and parsed.status or "")
    local materialParts
    if status == "tick" then
        materialParts = {
            "none",
            "all",
            tostring(main and main.fp or ""),
            tostring(tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)),
        }
        table.insert(materialParts, 1, "tick")
    else
        materialParts = {
            tostring(fields[2] or ""),
            tostring(fields[4] or ""),
            tostring(main and main.fp or ""),
            tostring(tmPanelRefreshBaselineFingerprint(triggerId)),
        }
    end
    if status == "clear" then
        table.insert(materialParts, 1, "clear")
    end
    return "as" .. tmPanelStableFingerprint(table.concat(materialParts, "\n"))
end

function tmActorStateAuxConditionKeySeen(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    return csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, TM_ACTOR_STATE_AUX_APPLY_KEYS_VAR, ""), token)
end

function tmRememberActorStateAuxConditionKey(triggerId, key)
    local token = tostring(key or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" then return false end
    local items = parseList(getVar(triggerId, TM_ACTOR_STATE_AUX_APPLY_KEYS_VAR, ""), ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == token then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, token)
    while #items > TM_ACTOR_STATE_AUX_APPLY_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_ACTOR_STATE_AUX_APPLY_KEYS_VAR, #items > 0 and table.concat(items, ",") or "none")
    return true
end

function tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, source, status, parsed, reason, key)
    local fields = parsed and parsed.fields or {}
    local op = tmAuxNormalizeActorOp(fields[3] or (parsed and parsed.status) or "")
    local diagName = "AUX_ACTOR_STATE_APPLY"
    if op == "clear" then
        diagName = "AUX_ACTOR_STATE_CLEAR"
    elseif op == "tick" then
        diagName = "AUX_ACTOR_STATE_TICK"
    end
    tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
        source = source or "aux",
        name = diagName,
        status = status or "blocked",
        subject = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[2] or "", 48),
        ref_or_condition = tmAuxNormalizeConditionId(fields[4] or ""),
        state_or_duration = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[5] or "", 24),
        visible_name = key or "",
        evidence = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[6] or "", 120),
        reason = reason or "",
    })
end

function tmApplyActorStateAuxConditionRuntime(triggerId, source, parsed)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    local aux = parsed or {status = "missing", reason = "missing", fields = {}, owner = ""}
    if aux.reason == "missing" then return false end
    if aux.reason ~= "ok" then
        tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", aux, aux.reason or "malformed", "none")
        return false
    end
    if aux.status ~= "apply" and aux.status ~= "clear" and aux.status ~= "tick" then return false end
    if src ~= "panel" then
        tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", aux, "source_not_panel", "none")
        return false
    end

    local fields = aux.fields or {}
    local ownerId = aux.owner or fields[2] or ""
    local conditionId = tmAuxNormalizeConditionId(fields[4] or "")
    if aux.status ~= "tick" then
        if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", aux, "bad_owner", "none")
            return false
        end
        if conditionId == "none" or conditionId == "unknown" or conditionId == "all" or conditionId == "removable" or not tmConditionDef(conditionId) then
            tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "blocked", aux, "condition_not_exact", "none")
            return false
        end
    end

    local main = tmConditionReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    if main.status == "missing" then
        tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", aux, "main_snapshot_missing", "none")
        return false
    end
    if main.status ~= "none" then
        tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", aux, "main_authoritative", "none")
        return false
    end

    local key = tmActorStateAuxConditionKey(triggerId, main, aux)
    if tmActorStateAuxConditionKeySeen(triggerId, key) then
        tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, "skipped", aux, "duplicate_key", key)
        return false
    end
    tmRememberActorStateAuxConditionKey(triggerId, key)
    local applied = false
    if aux.status == "tick" then
        applied = tmTickConditions(triggerId, "aux_actor_state")
    elseif aux.status == "clear" then
        applied = tmClearCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, "aux_actor_state")
    else
        applied = tmApplyCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, "aux_actor_state")
    end
    tmActorStateAuxConditionDiagnostic(triggerId, src, applied and "applied" or "blocked", aux, applied and "ok" or "writer_no_state", key)
    return applied
end

function tmApplyActorStateAuxConditionRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local parsed = tmActorStateFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, source or "aux")
    return tmApplyActorStateAuxConditionRuntime(triggerId, source or "aux", parsed)
end

function tmEpisodeFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows, source)
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_EPISODE" then
            return tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
        end
    end
    return {source = source or "aux", name = "AUX_EPISODE", status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = "", fields = {}, owner = ""}
end

function tmApplyEpisodeAuxWrapupRuntime(triggerId, source, parsed)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    if src ~= "panel" and src ~= "manual_refresh" then return false end
    if not tmSessionPanelEpisodeMarkersEnabled(triggerId) then return false end
    local aux = parsed or {status = "missing", reason = "missing", fields = {}}
    if aux.reason ~= "ok" then return false end
    local fields = aux.fields or {}
    local kind = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
    if kind ~= "wrapup" then return false end
    if aux.status ~= "suggested" and aux.status ~= "confirmed" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "false") == "true" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") == "true" then return false end
    local currentEpisode = tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId)
    if currentEpisode == "" then return false end
    local auxEpisode = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[4] or "")
    if auxEpisode ~= "none" and auxEpisode ~= "unknown" and auxEpisode ~= "current" then
        local normalized = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[4] or "", 64))
        if normalized ~= "" and normalized ~= currentEpisode then return false end
    end
    return tmSetScenarioWrapupSuggested(triggerId, "aux_episode_" .. src)
end

function tmApplyEpisodeAuxWrapupRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local parsed = tmEpisodeFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, source or "aux")
    return tmApplyEpisodeAuxWrapupRuntime(triggerId, source or "aux", parsed)
end

function tmEpisodeAuxLifecycleEpisodeId(triggerId, rawEpisode)
    local current = tmCurrentEpisodeForWrapup(triggerId)
    if current == "" then return "" end
    local episode = tmPanelCueCleanField(rawEpisode or "", 80)
    local lowered = episode:lower()
    if episode == "" or lowered == "none" or lowered == "current" or lowered == "episode_id_or_none" then
        return current
    end
    local normalized = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(episode)
    if normalized ~= current then return "" end
    return current
end

function tmEpisodeAuxFlagDetail(rawDetail)
    local detail = tmPanelCueCleanField(rawDetail or "", 120)
    local op, flagId = detail:match("^([%w_%-]+):([%w_%-]+)$")
    op = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(op or "")
    flagId = tmPanelCueCleanField(flagId or "", 80)
    if op ~= "add" and op ~= "remove" then return "", "" end
    if flagId == "" or flagId == "none" or not flagId:match("^[%w_%-]+$") then return "", "" end
    return op, flagId
end

function tmEpisodeAuxNodeDetail(rawDetail)
    local detail = tmPanelCueCleanField(rawDetail or "", 120)
    local nodeId = detail:match("^node:([%w_%-]+)$") or detail
    nodeId = tmPanelCueCleanField(nodeId or "", 80)
    if nodeId == "" or nodeId == "none" or nodeId == "unknown" then return "" end
    if not nodeId:match("^[%w_%-]+$") then return "" end
    return nodeId
end

function tmApplyEpisodeFlagMarker(triggerId, op, flagId, source)
    local action = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(op or "")
    local cleanFlag = tmPanelCueCleanField(flagId or "", 80)
    if cleanFlag == "" or cleanFlag == "none" or not cleanFlag:match("^[%w_%-]+$") then return false end

    if action == "add" then
        setVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", "none"), cleanFlag))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "flag_add:" .. cleanFlag)
        return true
    end

    if action == "remove" then
        setVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", removeCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", "none"), cleanFlag))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "flag_remove:" .. cleanFlag)
        return true
    end

    return false
end

function tmApplyEpisodeAuxLifecycleRuntime(triggerId, source, parsed)
    local src = tostring(source or "aux")
    local aux = parsed or {status = "missing", reason = "missing", fields = {}}
    if aux.reason == "missing" then return false end
    if aux.reason ~= "ok" then return false end
    if src ~= "panel" then return false end
    if not tmSessionPanelEpisodeMarkersEnabled(triggerId) then return false end

    local fields = aux.fields or {}
    local kind = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or "")
    if kind ~= "episode_clear" and kind ~= "episode_fail" and kind ~= "flag" and kind ~= "start" and kind ~= "node" then return false end
    if aux.status ~= "confirmed" then return false end

    local main = tmEpisodeReadMainSnapshot(triggerId)
    if main.status == "missing" or main.status ~= "none" then return false end

    local episodeId = tmEpisodeAuxLifecycleEpisodeId(triggerId, fields[4] or "")
    if episodeId == "" then return false end
    local progress = getVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "none")
    if progress == "cleared" or progress == "failed" then return false end

    local flagOp, flagId = "", ""
    local nodeId = ""
    if kind == "flag" then
        flagOp, flagId = tmEpisodeAuxFlagDetail(fields[5] or "")
        if flagOp == "" then return false end
    elseif kind == "node" then
        nodeId = tmEpisodeAuxNodeDetail(fields[5] or "")
        if nodeId == "" then return false end
    elseif kind == "start" and progress == "active" then
        return false
    end

    local key = tmEpisodeAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, main, aux, episodeId)
    if tmEpisodeAuxLifecycleKeySeen(triggerId, key) then return false end

    local applied = false
    if kind == "episode_clear" then
        applied = tmApplyEpisodeClearMarker(triggerId, episodeId, {
            source = "aux_episode_panel",
            skipItem = main.item_marker == "true",
            skipSkillbook = main.skillbook_marker == "true",
        })
    elseif kind == "episode_fail" then
        applied = tmApplyEpisodeFailMarker(triggerId, episodeId, "aux_episode_panel")
    elseif kind == "flag" then
        applied = tmApplyEpisodeFlagMarker(triggerId, flagOp, flagId, "aux_episode_panel")
    elseif kind == "start" then
        applied = tmApplyEpisodeStartMarker(triggerId, episodeId, "aux_episode_panel")
    else
        applied = tmApplyEpisodeNodeMarker(triggerId, episodeId, nodeId, "aux_episode_panel")
    end
    if applied then tmRememberEpisodeAuxLifecycleKey(triggerId, key) end
    return applied
end

function tmApplyEpisodeAuxLifecycleRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local parsed = tmEpisodeFirstAuxParsed(triggerId, rows or {}, source or "aux")
    return tmApplyEpisodeAuxLifecycleRuntime(triggerId, source or "aux", parsed)
end

function tmApplyAuxIntentFillMissingRows(triggerId, rows, source)
    local result = {applied = {}, cleared = {}, skipped = {}, handled = {}}
    if tostring(source or "") ~= "panel" then return result end
    local mainPresent = tmCsvSet(getVar(triggerId, "tm_intent_last_present_ids", ""))
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_INTENT" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source)
            local ownerId = parsed.owner or ""
            if ownerId ~= "" and parsed.reason == "ok" then
                result.handled[ownerId] = true
                if mainPresent[ownerId] then
                    result.skipped[ownerId] = true
                elseif parsed.status == "present" then
                    local action = parsed.fields[4] or ""
                    local clean, isClear, valid = tmNormalizePlayerIntentText(action)
                    if valid and not isClear and clean ~= "" then
                        local ok, didClear = tmApplyPlayerIntent(triggerId, ownerId, clean, "aux_intent_fill_missing")
                        if ok then
                            result.applied[ownerId] = true
                            if didClear then result.cleared[ownerId] = true end
                        end
                    end
                elseif parsed.status == "none" then
                    local ok, didClear = tmApplyPlayerIntent(triggerId, ownerId, "none", "aux_intent_clear_stale")
                    if ok then
                        if didClear then
                            result.cleared[ownerId] = true
                        else
                            result.skipped[ownerId] = true
                        end
                    end
                elseif parsed.status == "unknown" then
                    result.skipped[ownerId] = true
                end
            elseif ownerId ~= "" and mainPresent[ownerId] then
                result.handled[ownerId] = true
                result.skipped[ownerId] = true
            end
        end
    end
    return result
end

function tmAuxDiagLine(row)
    return table.concat({
        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.name or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.applied or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.conflict or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreAuxDiagnostics(triggerId, rows)
    if type(rows) ~= "table" or #rows == 0 then return end
    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_AUX_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for line in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if line ~= "" then table.insert(kept, line) end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
        table.insert(kept, tmAuxDiagLine(row))
    end
    while #kept > TM_AUX_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    local latest = tmAuxDiagLine(rows[#rows])
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_AUX_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_AUX_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, latest)
end

function tmServiceAuxDiagLine(row)

        tmPackEscape(row.source or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.status or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.kind or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.target or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.ref_or_label or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.price or ""),
        tmPackEscape(row.reason or ""),
    }, "|")
end

function tmStoreServiceAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, row)

    local kept = {}
    local current = tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_AUX_DIAG_STORE_KEY) or "")
    for item in current:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
        if item ~= "" then table.insert(kept, item) end
    end
    table.insert(kept, line)
    while #kept > TM_SERVICE_AUX_DIAG_MAX_ROWS do table.remove(kept, 1) end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_AUX_DIAG_STORE_KEY, table.concat(kept, "\n"))
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_SERVICE_AUX_DIAG_LATEST_KEY, line)
end

function tmStoreServiceAuxDiagnostics(triggerId, rows, source)
    local found = false
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_SERVICE" or row.name == "AUX_SERVICE_Q" then
            found = true
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
            local mat = tmServiceAuxMaterial(parsed)
            tmStoreServiceAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
                source = source or "aux",
                status = parsed.status or "malformed",
                kind = mat.kind or "",
                target = mat.target or "",
                ref_or_label = mat.qty and mat.qty ~= "none" and mat.qty ~= "1" and tmServiceQuantityMaterialRef(mat.ref_or_label, mat.qty) or (mat.ref_or_label or ""),
                price = mat.price or "",
                reason = parsed.reason or "",
            })
        end
    end
    if not found then
        tmStoreServiceAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            source = source or "aux",
            status = "missing",
            kind = "",
            target = "",
            ref_or_label = "",
            price = "",
            reason = "missing",
        })
    end
end

function tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostics(triggerId, rows, source)
    local foundWorld = false
    local foundActor = false
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        if row.name == "AUX_WORLD" or row.name == "AUX_ACTOR_STATE" then
            local parsed = tmParseAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux")
            local fields = parsed.fields or {}
            if row.name == "AUX_WORLD" then
                foundWorld = true
                tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
                    source = source or "aux",
                    name = "AUX_WORLD",
                    status = parsed.status or "malformed",
                    subject = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[2] or ""),
                    ref_or_condition = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[3] or "", 96),
                    state_or_duration = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(fields[4] or ""),
                    visible_name = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[5] or "", 96),
                    evidence = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[6] or "", 120),
                    reason = parsed.reason or "",
                })
            else
                foundActor = true
                tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
                    source = source or "aux",
                    name = "AUX_ACTOR_STATE",
                    status = parsed.status or "malformed",
                    subject = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[2] or "", 48),
                    ref_or_condition = tmAuxNormalizeConditionId(fields[4] or ""),
                    state_or_duration = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[5] or "", 24),
                    visible_name = "",
                    evidence = tmPanelCueCleanField(fields[6] or "", 120),
                    reason = parsed.reason or "",
                })
            end
        end
    end
    if not foundWorld then
        tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            source = source or "aux",
            name = "AUX_WORLD",
            status = "missing",
            subject = "",
            ref_or_condition = "",
            state_or_duration = "",
            visible_name = "",
            evidence = "",
            reason = "missing",
        })
    end
    if not foundActor then
        tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostic(triggerId, {
            source = source or "aux",
            name = "AUX_ACTOR_STATE",
            status = "missing",
            subject = "",
            ref_or_condition = "",
            state_or_duration = "",
            visible_name = "",
            evidence = "",
            reason = "missing",
        })
    end
end

function tmObserveAuxMarkers(triggerId, output, source)
    local text = tostring(output or "")
    local rows = tmCollectAuxMarkerRows(text)
    local diagnostics = {}
    if #rows == 0 then
        for name in pairs(TM_AUX_OBSERVE_SPECS) do
            table.insert(diagnostics, {source = source or "aux", name = name, status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = ""})
        end
    else
        local seen = {}
        for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
            seen[row.name] = true
            table.insert(diagnostics, tmValidateAuxObserveRow(triggerId, row, source or "aux"))
        end
        for name in pairs(TM_AUX_OBSERVE_SPECS) do
            if not seen[name] then
                table.insert(diagnostics, {source = source or "aux", name = name, status = "missing", applied = "false", reason = "missing", conflict = ""})
            end
        end
    end
    tmStoreAuxDiagnostics(triggerId, diagnostics)
    tmStoreServiceAuxDiagnostics(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmStoreWorldActorAuxDiagnostics(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmCompareRewardWithAuxRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmCompareServiceWithAuxRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmCompareNpcWithAuxWorldRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmProveNpcIdentityWithAuxWorldRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmApplyNpcAuxFillMissingRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmApplyNpcAuxNameRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmApplyNpcAuxMetaRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmApplyNpcAuxPaymentRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    tmApplyNpcAuxLifecycleRows(triggerId, rows, source or "aux")
    return tmStripAuxMarkers(text), rows
end

function tmExtractPanelMarker(text, name)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    local value = raw:match("▥" .. name .. ":(.-)▥")
    if value == nil then value = raw:match("<<" .. name .. ":(.-)>>") end
    if value == nil then value = raw:match("%[%[" .. name .. ":(.-)%]%]") end
    if value == nil then value = raw:match("%{%{" .. name .. ":(.-)%}%}") end
    if value == nil then value = raw:match(name .. "%s*:%s*(.-)\n[A-Z_]+%s*:") end
    if value == nil then value = raw:match(name .. "%s*:%s*(.+)$") end
    if value == nil and name == "BRIEF" then
        value = raw:match("현재%s*상황%s*\n(.-)\n%s*추천%s*리드")
            or raw:match("Current%s+Situation%s*\n(.-)\n%s*Recommended%s+Lead")
    end
    if value == nil and name == "GUIDE_LEAD" then
        value = raw:match("추천%s*리드%s*\n(.-)$")
            or raw:match("Recommended%s+Lead%s*\n(.-)$")
        if value ~= nil then
            value = value:gsub("\n%s*새로고침%s*$", "")
            value = value:gsub("\n%s*추천%s*리드%s*적용%s*$", "")
            value = value:gsub("^%s*collapse%s*\n", "")
            value = value:gsub("^%s*expand%s*\n", "")
        end
    end
    return value or ""
end

function tmExtractPanelMarkers(text, name)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    local values = {}
    local function add(value)
        local clean = tmTrimText(value)
        if clean ~= "" then
            table.insert(values, clean)
        end
    end
    for value in raw:gmatch("▥" .. name .. ":(.-)▥") do add(value) end
    for value in raw:gmatch("<<" .. name .. ":(.-)>>") do add(value) end
    for value in raw:gmatch("%[%[" .. name .. ":(.-)%]%]") do add(value) end
    for value in raw:gmatch("%{%{" .. name .. ":(.-)%}%}") do add(value) end
    if #values == 0 then
        local single = tmExtractPanelMarker(raw, name)
        if single ~= "" then add(single) end
    end
    return table.concat(values, "\n")
end

function tmParseSessionPanelLLMText(triggerIdOrText, maybeText)
    local triggerId = maybeText ~= nil and triggerIdOrText or nil
    local text = maybeText ~= nil and maybeText or triggerIdOrText
    local summary = tmSanitizePanelBrief(tmExtractPanelMarker(text, "BRIEF"))
    local rawLead = tmExtractPanelMarker(text, "GUIDE_LEAD")
    local rollCue = tmExtractPanelMarkers(text, "ROLL_PANEL")
    local combatCue = tmExtractPanelMarkers(text, "COMBAT_PANEL")
    local defenseCue = tmExtractPanelMarkers(text, "DEFENSE_PANEL")
    if triggerId ~= nil then
        local ok, reason, lead = tmValidateGuideLead(triggerId, rawLead)
        if not ok then return summary, "", reason, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue end
        return summary, lead, "", rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue
    end
    local lead = tmSanitizeGuideLead(rawLead)
    return summary, lead, lead == "" and "empty_after_sanitize" or "", rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue
end

function tmGuideLeadCompareText(text)
    local raw = tmStripControlMarkers(tostring(text or ""))
    raw = raw:gsub("<.->", " ")
    raw = raw:gsub("{{.-}}", " ")
    raw = raw:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", " ")
    raw = raw:gsub("[,%.%!%?;:%(%)%[%]%{%}\"'`~]", " ")
    for _, punct in ipairs({"，", "。", "！", "？", "…", "·", "“", "”", "‘", "’", "《", "》", "〈", "〉", "「", "」", "『", "』", "、"}) do
        raw = raw:gsub(punct, " ")
    end
    raw = raw:gsub("%s+", " ")
    raw = raw:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return raw:lower()
end

function tmGuideLeadTokenSet(text)
    local set = {}
    local count = 0
    for token in tmGuideLeadCompareText(text):gmatch("%S+") do
        if #token >= 4 and not set[token] then
            set[token] = true
            count = count + 1
        end
    end
    return set, count
end

function tmGuideLeadOverlapRatio(a, b)
    local setA, countA = tmGuideLeadTokenSet(a)
    local setB, countB = tmGuideLeadTokenSet(b)
    if countA == 0 or countB == 0 then return 0 end
    local hit = 0
    for token, _ in pairs(setA) do
        if setB[token] then hit = hit + 1 end
    end
    local union = countA
    for token, _ in pairs(setB) do
        if not setA[token] then union = union + 1 end
    end
    return hit / math.max(1, union)
end

TM_GUIDE_LEAD_SIMILARITY_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD = 0.90
TM_GUIDE_LEAD_PREVIOUS_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.90
TM_GUIDE_LEAD_RECENT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.95
TM_GUIDE_LEAD_RETRY_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.95
TM_GUIDE_LEAD_HISTORY_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.99

function tmGuideLeadSimilar(a, b, threshold)
    local left = tmGuideLeadCompareText(a)
    local right = tmGuideLeadCompareText(b)
    if left == "" or right == "" then return false end
    if left == right then return true end
    return tmGuideLeadOverlapRatio(left, right) >= (threshold or TM_GUIDE_LEAD_SIMILARITY_DEFAULT_THRESHOLD)
end

function tmGuideLeadLooksRepeated(triggerId, lead)
    local previousLead = tmSanitizeGuideLead(getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", ""))
    if previousLead ~= "" and tmGuideLeadSimilar(lead, previousLead, TM_GUIDE_LEAD_PREVIOUS_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD) then
        return true, "previous_lead"
    end
    local recent = tmTailText(getVar(triggerId, "session_log_recent", ""), 1600)
    if recent ~= "" and tmGuideLeadSimilar(lead, recent, TM_GUIDE_LEAD_RECENT_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD) then
        return true, "recent_log"
    end
    return false, ""
end

function tmGuideLeadCandidateHistory(triggerId)
    return tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_candidate_history", ""))
end

function tmRememberGuideLeadCandidate(triggerId, lead, reason)
    local clean = tmSanitizeGuideLead(lead)
    if clean == "" then return end
    clean = clean:gsub("%s+", " ")
    local entry = "- " .. tmTailText(clean, 220) .. " [" .. tostring(reason or "similar") .. "]"
    local lines = {entry}
    local history = tmGuideLeadCandidateHistory(triggerId)
    for line in history:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        if line ~= entry then
            table.insert(lines, line)
        end
        if #lines >= 5 then break end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_candidate_history", table.concat(lines, "\n"))
end

function tmGuideLeadLooksRepeatedWithHistory(triggerId, lead)
    local repeated, reason = tmGuideLeadLooksRepeated(triggerId, lead)
    if repeated then return true, reason end
    local history = tmGuideLeadCandidateHistory(triggerId)
    for line in history:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local candidate = line:gsub("^%-%s*", ""):gsub("%s*%[[^%]]+%]%s*$", "")
        if candidate ~= "" and tmGuideLeadSimilar(lead, candidate, TM_GUIDE_LEAD_HISTORY_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD) then
            return true, "candidate_history"
        end
    end
    return false, ""
end

function tmGuideLeadWarningText(triggerId, reason)
    local r = tostring(reason or "")
    if r == "previous_lead" or r == "recent_log" or r == "candidate_history" or r == "same_attempt" or r == "too_similar" then
        return T(triggerId, "이전 리드와 충분히 달라지지 않았을 수 있습니다. 그런 경우 새로고침을 눌러주세요", "The lead may not be different enough from the previous one. In that case, press refresh.", "前のリードと十分に違わない可能性があります。その場合は更新を押してください。")
    end
    if r ~= "" and r ~= "false" then
        return tmGuideLeadValidationError(r)
    end
    return ""
end

function tmBootstrapGuideLeadFallbackText(triggerId)
    local scene = tmSanitizeGuideLead(getVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", ""))
    if scene == "" then
        scene = tmSanitizeGuideLead(getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_opening_text", ""))
    end
    scene = scene:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    local firstLine = tmTrimText(scene:match("([^\n]+)") or scene)
    if firstLine ~= "" then
        firstLine = tmTailText(firstLine, 180)
    end
    local ko = "테이블 위의 침묵이 짧게 내려앉고, 첫 단서가 다음 움직임을 끌어냅니다."
    local en = "A brief hush settles over the table, and the first clue pulls the next move into focus."
    local ja = "卓上に短い沈黙が落ち、最初の手掛かりが次の動きを引き寄せます。"
    if firstLine ~= "" then
        ko = firstLine .. "\n" .. ko
        en = firstLine .. "\n" .. en
        ja = firstLine .. "\n" .. ja
    end
    return T(triggerId, ko, en, ja)
end

    tmApplyEpisodeAuxLifecycleRows(triggerId, auxRows, src)
end

function tmKeepGuideLeadAfterRefreshFailure(triggerId, summary, reason, source, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue, auxRows, auxSource)
    tmStorePanelSelections(triggerId, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    if auxRows ~= nil then
        tmApplySessionPanelAuxFactRows(triggerId, auxRows, auxSource)
    end
    local fp = tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId)
    local cleanSummary = tostring(summary or "")
    local isBootstrap = tostring(source or ""):find("bootstrap", 1, true) ~= nil
    if cleanSummary ~= "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", cleanSummary)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary_src", fp)
    end
    local okPrev, _, previousLead = tmValidateGuideLead(triggerId, getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", ""))
    if not okPrev or previousLead == "" then
        previousLead = isBootstrap and tmBootstrapGuideLeadFallbackText(triggerId) or tmGuideLeadFallbackText(triggerId)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", previousLead)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_src", fp)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_last_source", tostring(source or "panel_invalid_kept"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", tostring(reason or "invalid_refresh"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", isBootstrap and "" or tmGuideLeadRefreshRejectedWarningText(triggerId))
    if cleanSummary ~= "" then
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장면 요약: " .. cleanSummary)
    end
    print("[TRPGMaster] guide lead refresh rejected and previous lead kept: " .. tostring(reason or ""))
    return true, ""
end

function tmGuideLeadExactlySame(a, b)
    return tmGuideLeadCompareText(a) == tmGuideLeadCompareText(b)
end

function tmAcceptGuideLeadCandidate(triggerId, lead, source, options)
    local opts = options or {}
    local ok, invalidReason, clean = tmValidateGuideLead(triggerId, lead)
    if not ok then
        if opts.warnOnInvalid then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", tmGuideLeadValidationError(invalidReason))
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", invalidReason)
        end
        return false, true, invalidReason
    end

    local repeated = opts.repeated
    local reason = opts.reason or opts.repeatedReason or ""
    if repeated == nil then
        repeated, reason = tmGuideLeadLooksRepeatedWithHistory(triggerId, clean)
    end
    if repeated and reason == "" then reason = "too_similar" end
    if opts.rejectRepeated and repeated then
        local previousLead = tmSanitizeGuideLead(getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", ""))
        if previousLead ~= "" and not tmGuideLeadExactlySame(previousLead, clean) then
            repeated = false
            reason = ""
        end
    end
    if opts.rejectRepeated and repeated then
        tmRememberGuideLeadCandidate(triggerId, clean, reason)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", tmGuideLeadWarningText(triggerId, reason))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", reason)
        return false, true, reason
    end

    local fp = tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", clean)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_src", fp)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_last_source", tostring(source or "unknown"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", repeated and reason or "")
    if repeated then
        tmRememberGuideLeadCandidate(triggerId, clean, reason)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", tmGuideLeadWarningText(triggerId, reason))
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", "")
    end
    return true, repeated, reason
end

function tmSelectPanelLLM(triggerId)
    return tmSelectHelperLLM(triggerId)
end

-- FB-5: generate the lead text via the same LLM picker convention as
-- tmGeneratePartySheetsWithLLM / tmGenerateOpeningSceneText.
function tmGenerateGuideLead(triggerId)
    return tmGenerateSessionPanel(triggerId)
end

function tmCallSessionPanelLLM(triggerId, retryMode, options)
    local opts = options or {}
    local manualSnapshot = opts.manual == true
    local languageName = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local systemText = "Refresh a TRPG session panel in one pass. Follow the enabled output contracts in the user prompt. Use " .. languageName .. " for BRIEF and GUIDE_LEAD. Authoritative current-turn result and compact Lua state are mechanical truth when present; latest visible Main response is scene evidence."
    if retryMode == "fresh_angle" then
        systemText = "Refresh a TRPG session panel with a fresh scene angle in one pass. Follow the enabled output contracts in the user prompt. Use " .. languageName .. " for BRIEF and GUIDE_LEAD. Focus on authoritative current-turn result, newest visible change, and compact Lua state."
    elseif retryMode == "card_result_required" then
        systemText = "Rewrite a TRPG session panel after Lua has rendered roll/combat/defense cards. Follow the enabled output contracts in the user prompt. Use " .. languageName .. " for BRIEF and GUIDE_LEAD. Carry the resolved card outcomes and current Lua state forward as completed fiction."
    end
    if manualSnapshot then
        systemText = systemText .. " For manual refresh, return exactly four <<PANEL_INTENT:owner|text-or-none>> markers before selecting cards. PANEL_INTENT is the refreshed current action snapshot. ROLL_PANEL, COMBAT_PANEL, and DEFENSE_PANEL use that same snapshot; cards belong to owners whose PANEL_INTENT is a current action. INTENT_AUX belongs to automatic panel refresh."
    else
        systemText = systemText .. " Also return exactly four <<INTENT_AUX:owner|text-or-none>> markers for sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, and yuseola. INTENT_AUX reports current action evidence from the latest visible response only; use none for owners whose current action is absent. Keep INTENT_AUX to table action text."
    end
    systemText = systemText .. " Always return exactly one <<ENEMY_AUDIT:status|id_or_reason|display_or_none>> marker. ENEMY_AUDIT status is present, none, or unknown. Main ENEMY markers stay authoritative; Lua uses ENEMY_AUDIT when Main ENEMY marker presence is missing."
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        systemText = systemText .. " Korean particle rule: for generated names/titles, do not attach bare particles that may be wrong; use safe particles like '이(가)', '은(는)', '을(를)' or rephrase."
    end
    local messages = {
        {role = "system", content = systemText},
        {role = "user", content = tmBuildSessionPanelPrompt(triggerId, retryMode, manualSnapshot)}
    }
    local fn = tmSelectPanelLLM(triggerId)
    if not fn then
        return false, "", "", "RisuAI LLM API is unavailable."
    end
    TM_PANEL_LLM_IN_PROGRESS = true
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId, messages)
    TM_PANEL_LLM_IN_PROGRESS = false
    if not ok then
        return false, "", "", tostring(result)
    end
    local text, err = tmReadLLMText(result)
    if err then
        return false, "", "", err
    end
    local panelText = text or ""
    local auxRows = nil
    panelText, auxRows = tmObserveAuxMarkers(triggerId, panelText, manualSnapshot and "manual_refresh" or "panel")
    panelText = tmApplyEnemyAuditMarkers(triggerId, panelText, manualSnapshot and "manual_refresh" or "panel", auxRows)
    if manualSnapshot then
        tmApplyPanelIntentSnapshot(triggerId, panelText, "manual_refresh")
    end
    local summary, lead, leadReason, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue = tmParseSessionPanelLLMText(triggerId, panelText)
    if summary == "" then
        return false, "", "", "BRIEF marker was empty or missing."
    end
    if lead == "" then
        return false, summary, "", tmGuideLeadValidationError(leadReason), leadReason, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue, auxRows
    end
    if manualSnapshot then
        rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue = tmFilterPanelCuesByPanelIntent(triggerId, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    else
        local auxIntentFill = tmApplyAuxIntentFillMissingRows(triggerId, auxRows, "panel")
        panelText = tmApplyAuxIntentMarkers(triggerId, panelText, "panel", auxIntentFill)
    end
    local groundingGate = tmPanelGroundingGateActive(triggerId)
    local panelSnapshotHasAction = manualSnapshot and tmCsvOrNone(getVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_intent_action_owners", "")) ~= "none"
    if not panelSnapshotHasAction then
        rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue = tmGroundPanelCardCues(triggerId, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    end
    if groundingGate and not panelSnapshotHasAction then tmClearStoredIntentsForPanelGrounding(triggerId) end
    return true, summary, lead, "", "", rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue, auxRows
end

function tmPanelCueHasResolvedRows(rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    for _, row in ipairs(tmPanelCueRows(rollCue)) do
        if #tmPanelCueSplit(row, 7) > 0 then return true end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(tmPanelCueRows(combatCue)) do
        if #tmPanelCueSplit(row, 10) > 0 then return true end
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(tmPanelCueRows(defenseCue)) do
        if #tmPanelCueSplit(row, 12) > 0 then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmGuideLeadAsksSameRollAfterCards(lead)
    local text = tostring(lead or "")
    if text == "" then return false end
    local compact = text:gsub("%s+", "")
    local lowered = compact:lower()
    if compact:find("굴려주세요", 1, true) or compact:find("굴려줘", 1, true)
        or compact:find("굴려볼", 1, true) or compact:find("굴릴", 1, true)
        or compact:find("주사위를굴", 1, true) or compact:find("다이스를굴", 1, true)
        or compact:find("판정해보", 1, true) or compact:find("판정하자", 1, true)
        or compact:find("체크해보", 1, true) then
        return true
    end
    if lowered:find("roll", 1, true) and lowered:find("please", 1, true) then return true end
    if lowered:find("makeacheck", 1, true) or lowered:find("rollthe", 1, true) then return true end
    return false
end

function tmGuideLeadNeedsCardResultRetry(lead, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    if not tmPanelCueHasResolvedRows(rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue) then return false end
    return tmGuideLeadAsksSameRollAfterCards(lead)
end

function tmGenerateSessionPanel(triggerId, options)
    local opts = options or {}
    if opts.manual ~= true and (opts.auto == true or opts.bootstrap == true) then
        tmRememberPanelRefreshBaseline(triggerId)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_retry_used", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", "")

    local auxSource = opts.manual and "manual_refresh" or "panel"
    local ok, summary, lead, err, errReason, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue, auxRows = tmCallSessionPanelLLM(triggerId, "", opts)
    if not ok then
        if summary ~= "" and errReason ~= nil and tostring(errReason) ~= "" then
            local source = opts.bootstrap and "panel_bootstrap_invalid_kept"
                or (opts.manual and "manual_invalid_kept" or "panel_invalid_kept")
            return tmKeepGuideLeadAfterRefreshFailure(triggerId, summary, errReason, source, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue, auxRows, auxSource)
        end
        return false, err
    end

    local repeated, repeatedReason = false, ""
    local acceptSource = opts.bootstrap and "panel_bootstrap" or "panel"
    local keepExistingRepeatedLead = false
    if not opts.bootstrap then
        repeated, repeatedReason = tmGuideLeadLooksRepeatedWithHistory(triggerId, lead)
        acceptSource = repeated and "panel_similar" or "panel"
    end
    if repeated then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_retry_used", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", repeatedReason)
        tmRememberGuideLeadCandidate(triggerId, lead, repeatedReason)
        local retryOk, retrySummary, retryLead, retryErr, retryErrReason, retryRollCue, retryCombatCue, retryDefenseCue, retryAuxRows = tmCallSessionPanelLLM(triggerId, "fresh_angle", opts)
        local retryRepeated = true
        local retryReason = "retry_failed"
        if retryOk and retryLead ~= "" then
            retryRepeated, retryReason = tmGuideLeadLooksRepeatedWithHistory(triggerId, retryLead)
            if not retryRepeated and tmGuideLeadSimilar(retryLead, lead, TM_GUIDE_LEAD_RETRY_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD) then
                retryRepeated = true
                retryReason = "same_attempt"
            end
        end
        if retryOk and retrySummary ~= "" and retryLead ~= "" and not retryRepeated then
            summary = retrySummary
            lead = retryLead
            rollCue = retryRollCue
            combatCue = retryCombatCue
            defenseCue = retryDefenseCue
            auxRows = retryAuxRows
            repeated = false
            repeatedReason = ""
            acceptSource = "panel_retry"
        else
            if retrySummary ~= "" then
                summary = retrySummary
                rollCue = retryRollCue
                combatCue = retryCombatCue
                defenseCue = retryDefenseCue
            end
            if retryOk and retryLead ~= "" then
                repeatedReason = retryReason
                tmRememberGuideLeadCandidate(triggerId, retryLead, retryReason)
                acceptSource = opts.manual and "manual_retry_blocked" or "panel_retry_blocked"
            else
                if retryErrReason ~= nil and tostring(retryErrReason) ~= "" then
                    repeatedReason = retryErrReason
                end
                acceptSource = opts.manual and "manual_initial_blocked" or "panel_initial_blocked"
            end
            keepExistingRepeatedLead = true
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", T(triggerId, "이전 리드와 충분히 달라지지 않았을 수 있습니다. 그런 경우 새로고침을 눌러주세요", "The lead may not be different enough from the previous one. In that case, press refresh.", "前のリードと十分に違わない可能性があります。その場合は更新を押してください。"))
            if not retryOk then
                print("[TRPGMaster] guide lead retry failed: " .. tostring(retryErr))
            end
        end
    end

    local fp = tmSessionPanelFingerprint(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", summary)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary_src", fp)
    tmStorePanelSelections(triggerId, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue)
    if not keepExistingRepeatedLead and tmGuideLeadNeedsCardResultRetry(lead, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue) then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_retry_used", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", "card_result_required")
        local retryOk, retrySummary, retryLead, retryErr, retryErrReason, retryRollCue2, retryCombatCue2, retryDefenseCue2, retryAuxRows = tmCallSessionPanelLLM(triggerId, "card_result_required", opts)
        if retryOk and retrySummary ~= "" and retryLead ~= "" and not tmGuideLeadAsksSameRollAfterCards(retryLead) then
            summary = retrySummary
            lead = retryLead
            auxRows = retryAuxRows
            acceptSource = opts.manual and "manual_card_result_retry" or "panel_card_result_retry"
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", summary)
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary_src", fp)
        else
            local reason = retryErrReason ~= nil and tostring(retryErrReason) ~= "" and retryErrReason or "card_result_required"
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", tmGuideLeadValidationError(reason))
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", reason)
            if not retryOk then
                print("[TRPGMaster] card-result guide lead retry failed: " .. tostring(retryErr))
            end
        end
    end
    if keepExistingRepeatedLead then
        local previousLead = tmSanitizeGuideLead(getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", ""))
        local reason = repeatedReason ~= "" and repeatedReason or "too_similar"
        if previousLead == "" then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", "")
        end
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_src", fp)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_last_source", acceptSource)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", reason)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", tmGuideLeadWarningText(triggerId, reason))
        tmApplySessionPanelAuxFactRows(triggerId, auxRows, auxSource)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장면 요약: " .. summary)
        return true, ""
    end
    local accepted, _, acceptReason = tmAcceptGuideLeadCandidate(triggerId, lead, acceptSource, {
        repeated = repeated,
        reason = repeatedReason,
        warnOnInvalid = true,
        rejectRepeated = opts.manual and not opts.bootstrap,
    })
    if not accepted then
        local source = opts.bootstrap and "panel_bootstrap_accept_blocked"
            or (opts.manual and "manual_accept_blocked" or "panel_accept_blocked")
        return tmKeepGuideLeadAfterRefreshFailure(triggerId, summary, acceptReason, source, rollCue, combatCue, defenseCue, auxRows, auxSource)
    end
    tmApplySessionPanelAuxFactRows(triggerId, auxRows, auxSource)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장면 요약: " .. summary)
    return true, ""
end

function tmRuntimeScenarioId(source)
    if tostring(source or "") == "random" then return TM_RUNTIME_RANDOM_EPISODE_ID end
    return TM_RUNTIME_FREE_EPISODE_ID
end

function tmRuntimeEpisodeContentFor(triggerId, episodeId)
    local runtimeId = getVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_id", "")
    if runtimeId ~= "" and episodeId == runtimeId then
        return getVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_content", "")
    end
    return ""
end

        "Do not use real player names in SUMMARY/OPENING/SCENES. Keep player-specific spotlight out of the scenario sheet.",

        "one concise in-scenario objective sentence",
        "SUMMARY_KO:",
        "Korean display summary for UI/picker use only; keep concise",
        "SUMMARY_JA:",
        "Japanese display summary for UI/picker use only; keep concise",
        "OPENING:",
        "first visible situation the GM can narrate",
        "OPENING_KO:",
        "Korean display opening for UI/sheet use only; keep concise",
        "OPENING_JA:",
        "Japanese display opening for UI/sheet use only; keep concise",
        "SCENES:",
        "1. First Location Or Request",
        "- WIS DC 12: first visible clue, hidden pressure, or suspicious detail.",
        "- Failure creates worse position, prop trouble, or incomplete context.",
        "",
        "2. Complication Or Threat",
        "- DEX or INT DC 13: handle movement, timing, puzzle logic, route reading, or a concrete obstacle.",
        "- A scene-fitting hostile force, NPC rival, monster, or trap can become concrete here.",
        "",
        "3. Resolution Beat",
        "- CHA, INT, or WIS DC 14: resolve the core objective, negotiate the payoff, identify the truth, or secure the reward.",
        "- Success resolves the request and points to REWARDS/NEXT_HINT.",
        "ROLL_HINTS:",
        "- WIS DC 12: first clue or threat read.",
        "- DEX DC 13: movement, timing, stealth, or obstacle handling.",
        "- INT DC 13: puzzle, route, mechanism, or source interpretation.",
