function tmExtractRuntimeEpisodeSheet(text)
    local raw = tmStripControlMarkers(tostring(text or ""))
    raw = raw:gsub("```[%w_%-]*\n", "")
    raw = raw:gsub("```", "")
    local startAt = raw:find("=== TM_EPISODE ===", 1, true)
    if startAt then raw = raw:sub(startAt) end
    return tmTrimText(raw)
end

function tmRuntimeScenarioSheetValid(content, episodeId)
    local text = tostring(content or "")
    if text == "" or not text:find("=== TM_EPISODE ===", 1, true) then return false end
    local sheet = parseSheet(text)
    if tmTrimText(sheet.ID or "") ~= episodeId then return false end
    if tmTrimText(sheet.TITLE or "") == "" then return false end
    return tmEpisodePickerEligible(sheet, text)
end

function tmStoreRuntimeScenario(triggerId, source, seed, content)
    local episodeId = tmRuntimeScenarioId(source)
    local runtimeTitle = tmTrimText(parseSheet(content).TITLE or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_id", episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_content", content)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_source", tostring(source or "free"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_seed", tostring(seed or ""))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_runtime_episode_created_at", tostring(tmNow()))
    -- Runtime episodes reuse stable IDs, so an old title cache can outlive the
    -- newly generated sheet unless it is replaced together with the content.
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title_src", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title", "")
    if runtimeTitle ~= "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title_src", episodeId)
        setVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title", runtimeTitle)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", "")
    tmSelectEpisodeById(triggerId, episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "runtime_scenario:selected:" .. episodeId)
    tmPaceResetState(triggerId, "runtime_scenario")
    return episodeId
end

function tmGenerateRuntimeScenario(triggerId, source, seed)
    source = tostring(source or "free")
    seed = tmTrimText(seed)
    if source ~= "random" and seed == "" then
        return false, "자유 시나리오 내용을 한두 줄로 입력해 주세요."
    end
    local episodeId = tmRuntimeScenarioId(source)
    local messages = {
        {role = "system", content = "Generate one valid TRPGMaster TM_EPISODE sheet only."},
        {role = "user", content = tmBuildRuntimeScenarioPrompt(triggerId, source, seed, episodeId)}
    }
    local fn = tmSelectPanelLLM(triggerId)
    if not fn then
        return false, "RisuAI LLM API를 사용할 수 없습니다."
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(fn, triggerId, messages)
    if not ok then return false, tostring(result) end
    local text, err = tmReadLLMText(result)
    if err then return false, err end
    local content = tmExtractRuntimeEpisodeSheet(text or "")
    if not tmRuntimeScenarioSheetValid(content, episodeId) then
        return false, "LLM 응답에서 유효한 TM_EPISODE 시트를 읽지 못했습니다."
    end
    tmStoreRuntimeScenario(triggerId, source, seed, content)
    return true, episodeId
end

function tmGenerateFreeScenarioFromSeed(triggerId, input)
    if type(input) ~= "string" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", "free scenario input has not been submitted")
        return false
    end
    local seed = tmTrimText(input)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_user_input", tostring(input or ""))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_seed", seed)
    if seed == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", T(triggerId, "자유 시나리오 내용을 입력해야 합니다.", "Free scenario input is required.", "自由シナリオの内容を入力してください。"))
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "자유 시나리오 내용을 입력해야 합니다.", "Free scenario input is required.", "自由シナリオの内容を入力してください。"))
        return false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", "")
    local ok, err = tmGenerateRuntimeScenario(triggerId, "free", seed)
    if ok then
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "자유 시나리오를 생성하고 선택했습니다.", "Free scenario generated and selected.", "自由シナリオを生成して選択しました。"))
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", T(triggerId, "자유 시나리오 생성 실패: ", "Free scenario generation failed: ", "自由シナリオ生成失敗: ") .. tostring(err))
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "자유 시나리오 생성 실패: ", "Free scenario generation failed: ", "自由シナリオ生成失敗: ") .. tostring(err))
    end
    return ok
end

function tmHandleCustomScenarioInput(triggerId, input)
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_pending", "false") == "true" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", "")
    end
    return false
end

function tmGuideLeadHasBlockedText(text)
    return countKeywords(text, {
        "▥", "<<", ">>", "{{", "}}", "<div", "</div", "<img"
    }) > 0
end

function tmGuideLeadHasProcedureInstruction(text)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    if raw:find("판정 결과를", 1, true) or raw:find("결과를 설명", 1, true)
        or raw:find("결과를 묘사", 1, true) or raw:find("결과를 확인", 1, true)
        or raw:find("난이도", 1, true) or raw:find("DC", 1, true) then
        return true
    end
    local patterns = {
        "확인해 보자", "확인해보자", "살펴보자", "누가 먼저", "어떻게 할래",
        "어떻게 하겠", "what do you do", "who goes first",
        "describe the result", "explain the result", "check the result"
    }
    local lower = raw:lower()
    for _, pattern in ipairs(patterns) do
        if lower:find(pattern:lower(), 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmGuideLeadHasMetaInstruction(text)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    local metaPatterns = {
        "주사위 성공", "성공 여부", "실패 시", "실패하면", "결과에 따라",
        "묘사해 주세요", "묘사해주세요", "설명해 주세요", "처리해 주세요", "반영해 주세요",
        "describe the result", "explain the result", "depending on the roll"
    }
    local function hasMeta(segment)
        local lower = tostring(segment or ""):lower()
        for _, pattern in ipairs(metaPatterns) do
            if lower:find(pattern:lower(), 1, true) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    if hasMeta(raw) then return true end
    for segment in raw:gmatch("%b()") do
        if hasMeta(segment) then return true end
    end
    for segment in raw:gmatch("%b[]") do
        if hasMeta(segment) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmGuideLeadHasExtraProcedureInstruction(text)
    local lower = tostring(text or ""):lower()
    local patterns = {
        "확인해보자", "확인해 보자", "살펴보자", "살펴 보자",
        "어떻게 할래", "무엇을 할래", "누가 먼저"
    }
    for _, pattern in ipairs(patterns) do
        if lower:find(pattern:lower(), 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmGuideLeadLabelProblem(triggerId, text)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local realName = CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or ""
        local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, id)
        if pcName ~= "" and pcName ~= "none" and pcName ~= "pending" and realName ~= "" then
            local exactLabel = pcName .. " (" .. realName .. ")"
            local compactLabel = pcName .. "(" .. realName .. ")"
            local hasExact = raw:find(exactLabel, 1, true) ~= nil
            if raw:find(compactLabel, 1, true) and not hasExact then return "bad_pc_player_label_spacing" end
            if raw:find(pcName, 1, true) and not hasExact then return "bare_pc_name" end
            if raw:find(realName, 1, true) and not hasExact then return "bare_player_name" end
        end
        for _, alias in ipairs(tmPlayerNameAliases(id)) do
            if alias ~= "" and raw:find(alias, 1, true) then
                local visiblePcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, id)
                local exactAliasLabel = visiblePcName ~= "" and realName ~= "" and (visiblePcName .. " (" .. realName .. ")") or ""
                if exactAliasLabel == "" or not raw:find(exactAliasLabel, 1, true) then
                    return "bare_player_alias"
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmGuideLeadHasBarePlayerNames(triggerId, text)
    return tmGuideLeadLabelProblem(triggerId, text) ~= ""
end

function tmHideGuideLeadVisibleMechanics(text)
    local out = tostring(text or "")
    for _, stat in ipairs({"STR", "DEX", "CON", "INT", "WIS", "CHA"}) do
        out = out:gsub("%S+%s*%(" .. stat .. "%)%s*판정으로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub("%S+%s*%(" .. stat .. "%)%s*판정로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub("%S+%s*%(" .. stat .. "%)%s*체크로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub("%S+%s*%(" .. stat .. "%)%s*체크으로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub(stat .. "%s*판정으로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub(stat .. "%s*판정로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub(stat .. "%s*체크로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub(stat .. "%s*체크으로", "주사위로")
    end
    for _, ko in ipairs({"힘", "근력", "민첩", "체력", "건강", "지능", "지혜", "매력"}) do
        out = out:gsub(ko .. "%s*판정으로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub(ko .. "%s*판정로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub(ko .. "%s*체크로", "주사위로")
        out = out:gsub(ko .. "%s*체크으로", "주사위로")
    end
    out = out:gsub("[Dd][Cc]%s*[%d]+", "")
    out = out:gsub("난이도는?%s*[%d]+[^%.\n!！?？。]*[%.\n!！?？。]?", "")
    out = out:gsub("목표값은?%s*[%d]+[^%.\n!！?？。]*[%.\n!！?？。]?", "")
    out = out:gsub("목표치는?%s*[%d]+[^%.\n!！?？。]*[%.\n!！?？。]?", "")
    out = out:gsub("기준은?%s*[%d]+[^%.\n!！?？。]*[%.\n!！?？。]?", "")
    return out
end

function tmSanitizeGuideLead(raw)
    local text = tmStripControlMarkers(tmStripInternalGuideBlocks(tostring(raw or "")))
    text = text:gsub("▥.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("{{.-}}", "")
    text = text:gsub("<.->", "")
    text = text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    text = text:gsub("[ \t]+\n", "\n")
    text = text:gsub("\n\n\n+", "\n\n")
    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if text == "" or tmGuideLeadHasBlockedText(text) then return "" end
    return text
end

function tmLuaPatternEscape(text)
    return tostring(text or ""):gsub("([%(%)%.%%%+%-%*%?%[%]%^%$])", "%%%1")
end

function tmGuideLeadNormalizeLabels(triggerId, text)
    local out = tostring(text or "")
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local realName = CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or ""
        local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, id)
        if pcName ~= "" and pcName ~= "none" and pcName ~= "pending" and realName ~= "" then
            local exactLabel = pcName .. " (" .. realName .. ")"
            local compactLabel = pcName .. "(" .. realName .. ")"
            local token = "__TM_GUIDE_LABEL_" .. id .. "__"
            out = out:gsub(tmLuaPatternEscape(exactLabel), token)
            out = out:gsub(tmLuaPatternEscape(compactLabel), token)
            out = out:gsub(tmLuaPatternEscape(pcName), token)
            out = out:gsub(tmLuaPatternEscape(realName), token)
            for _, alias in ipairs(tmPlayerNameAliases(id)) do
                if alias ~= "" then out = out:gsub(tmLuaPatternEscape(alias), token) end
            end
            out = out:gsub(token, exactLabel)
        end
    end
    return out
end

function tmGuideLeadStripMetaGroups(text)
    local out = tostring(text or "")
    local function stripIfMeta(segment)
        if tmGuideLeadHasMetaInstruction(segment)
            or tmGuideLeadHasExtraProcedureInstruction(segment)
            or tmGuideLeadHasProcedureInstruction(segment) then
            return ""
        end
        return segment
    end
    out = out:gsub("%b()", stripIfMeta)
    out = out:gsub("%b[]", stripIfMeta)
    return out
end

function tmGuideLeadTrimProcedureTail(line)
    local text = tostring(line or "")
    return text:gsub("[%s,，]+$", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
end

function tmGuideLeadLineUsable(line)
    local text = tostring(line or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if text == "" then return false end
    if text == "collapse" or text == "expand" then return false end
    if text == "새로고침" or text == "추천 리드 적용"
        or text == "Refresh" or text == "Apply Lead"
        or text == "更新" or text == "リードを適用" then return false end
    return true
end

function tmRepairGuideLeadText(triggerId, raw)
    local text = tmStripControlMarkers(tmStripInternalGuideBlocks(tostring(raw or "")))
    text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("{{.-}}", "")
    text = text:gsub("<.->", "")
    text = text:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    text = tmGuideLeadNormalizeLabels(triggerId, text)

    local lines = {}
    for line in text:gmatch("[^\n]+") do
        local trimmed = tmGuideLeadTrimProcedureTail(line)
        if tmGuideLeadLineUsable(trimmed) then
            table.insert(lines, trimmed)
        end
    end
    local repaired = table.concat(lines, "\n")
    repaired = repaired:gsub("\n\n\n+", "\n\n")
    repaired = repaired:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return repaired
end

function tmValidateGuideLead(triggerId, raw)
    local original = tostring(raw or "")
    if original:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then return false, "missing_guide_lead", "" end
    local repaired = tmRepairGuideLeadText(triggerId, original)
    if repaired:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then return false, "empty_after_repair", "" end
    if tmGuideLeadHasBlockedText(repaired) then return false, "blocked_text", "" end
    local clean = tmSanitizeGuideLead(repaired)
    if clean == "" then return false, "empty_after_sanitize", "" end
    return true, "", clean
end

function tmGuideLeadValidationError(reason)
    local r = tostring(reason or "")
    if r == "missing_guide_lead" then return "GUIDE_LEAD marker was empty or missing." end
    if r == "meta_instruction" then return "GUIDE_LEAD contained internal/meta instructions." end
    if r == "blocked_text" then return "GUIDE_LEAD contained blocked markup or control text." end
    if r == "procedure_instruction" then return "GUIDE_LEAD contained procedure or roll instructions." end
    if r == "empty_after_repair" then return "GUIDE_LEAD became empty after repair." end
    if r == "empty_after_sanitize" then return "GUIDE_LEAD became empty after cleanup." end
    if r == "bad_pc_player_label_spacing" then return "GUIDE_LEAD used PC(player) instead of PC (player)." end
    if r == "bare_pc_name" then return "GUIDE_LEAD used a bare PC name instead of PC (player)." end
    if r == "bare_player_name" or r == "bare_player_alias" then return "GUIDE_LEAD used a bare player name instead of PC (player)." end
    if r == "too_similar" or r == "previous_lead" or r == "recent_log" or r == "candidate_history" or r == "same_attempt" then
        return "GUIDE_LEAD refresh did not produce a distinct lead."
    end
    return "GUIDE_LEAD response was invalid."
end

function tmProceedHintMarker()
    return '\n<div class="yp-ph"></div>'
end

function tmPanelRefreshStateVarKeys(triggerId)
    local keys = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(TM_GUIDE_REFRESH_STATE_VAR_KEYS or {}) do
        table.insert(keys, key)
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS or {}) do
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_intent")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_hp")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_mp")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_mp_max")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_status")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_equipment")
        table.insert(keys, "p_" .. id .. "_skills")
    end
    local enemyIds = {}
    local function addEnemyId(enemyId)
        local id = tostring(enemyId or "")
        if id ~= "" and not enemyIds[id] then enemyIds[id] = true end
    end
    addEnemyId(getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", ""))
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT or 0 do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] == "enemy" then addEnemyId(fields[2]) end
    end
    for enemyId in pairs(enemyIds) do
        for _, suffix in ipairs({
            "name", "hp", "hp_max", "dc", "atk", "defeated",
            "special", "traits", "weakness", "resistance"
        }) do
            table.insert(keys, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_" .. suffix)
        end
    end
    return keys
end

function tmSnapshotRawStores(triggerId, keys)
    local snap = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys or {}) do
        local value = tmRawGetVar(triggerId, key)
        snap[key] = {exists = value ~= nil, value = value or ""}
    end
    return snap
end

function tmRestoreRawStores(triggerId, snap)
    for key, entry in pairs(snap or {}) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.exists then
            tmRawSetVar(triggerId, key, entry.value or "")
        else
            tmRawSetVar(triggerId, key, "")
        end
    end
end

function tmSnapshotResolvedVars(triggerId, keys)
    local snap = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys or {}) do
        snap[key] = {exists = true, value = getVar(triggerId, key, "")}
    end
    return snap
end

function tmRestoreResolvedVars(triggerId, snap)
    local previous = TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS
    TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = true
    for key, entry in pairs(snap or {}) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.exists then
            setVar(triggerId, key, entry.value or "")
        else
            setVar(triggerId, key, "")
        end
    end
    TM_SAVE_RESTORE_IN_PROGRESS = previous
end

function tmSerializeRawStoreSnapshot(snap, keys)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys or TM_GUIDE_REFRESH_STATE_STORE_KEYS or {}) do
        local entry = snap and snap[key]
        local exists = type(entry) == "table" and entry.exists == true
        local value = exists and (entry.value or "") or ""
        table.insert(parts, tmPackEscape(key) .. "=" .. (exists and "1" or "0") .. "~" .. tmPackEscape(value))
    end
    return table.concat(parts, "|")
end

function tmDeserializeRawStoreSnapshot(raw)
    local text = tostring(raw or "")
    if text == "" then return nil end
    local snap = {}
    for token in (text .. "|"):gmatch("(.-)|") do
        if token ~= "" then
            local encodedKey, rest = token:match("^([^=]*)=(.*)$")
            if encodedKey ~= nil then
                local flag, encodedValue = tostring(rest or ""):match("^([^~]*)~(.*)$")
                local key = tmPackUnescape(encodedKey)
                if key ~= "" then
                    snap[key] = {exists = flag == "1", value = tmPackUnescape(encodedValue or "")}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return snap
end

function tmRememberPanelRefreshBaseline(triggerId)
    local snap = tmSnapshotRawStores(triggerId, TM_GUIDE_REFRESH_STATE_STORE_KEYS)
    local encoded = tmSerializeRawStoreSnapshot(snap, TM_GUIDE_REFRESH_STATE_STORE_KEYS)
    if encoded == "" then return false end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_REFRESH_BASELINE_KEY, encoded)
    local varKeys = tmPanelRefreshStateVarKeys(triggerId)
    local varSnap = tmSnapshotResolvedVars(triggerId, varKeys)
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_REFRESH_VAR_BASELINE_KEY, tmSerializeRawStoreSnapshot(varSnap, varKeys))
    return true
end

function tmRestorePanelRefreshBaseline(triggerId)
    local snap = tmDeserializeRawStoreSnapshot(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_REFRESH_BASELINE_KEY))
    if type(snap) ~= "table" then return false end
    tmRestoreRawStores(triggerId, snap)
    local varSnap = tmDeserializeRawStoreSnapshot(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PANEL_REFRESH_VAR_BASELINE_KEY))
    if type(varSnap) == "table" then
        tmRestoreResolvedVars(triggerId, varSnap)
    end
    return true
end

function tmGenerateSessionPanelPreview(triggerId, options)
    local opts = options or {}
    local previous = TM_PANEL_REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS
    TM_PANEL_REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS = true
    local ok, result, err = pcall(function()
        local restored = tmRestorePanelRefreshBaseline(triggerId)
        if not restored then
            print("[TRPGMaster] guide refresh baseline missing; regenerating from current state")
        end
        if opts.rerollDice == true then
            tmPrepareTurnDicePool(triggerId)
        end
        return tmGenerateSessionPanel(triggerId, opts)
    end)
    TM_PANEL_REFRESH_IN_PROGRESS = previous
    if not ok then
        error(result)
    end
    return result, err
end

_G["tmToggleGuideLeadCollapsed"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local collapsed = getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_collapsed", "false") == "true"
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_collapsed", collapsed and "false" or "true")
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmRefreshGuideLead"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "세션 중에만 추천 리드를 갱신할 수 있습니다.", "Suggested leads can only be refreshed during a session.", "おすすめリードはセッション中のみ更新できます。"))
        return
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_refresh_loading", "true")
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {fullReload = true, await = true})
    local callOk, panelOk, panelErr = pcall(tmGenerateSessionPanelPreview, triggerId, {manual = true, rerollDice = true})
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_refresh_loading", "false")
    if not callOk then
        error(panelOk)
    end
    if not panelOk then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "현재 상황/추천 리드 갱신 실패: ", "Current situation/suggested lead refresh failed: ", "現在状況/おすすめリードの更新に失敗: ") .. tostring(panelErr))
        return
    end
end)

_G["tmApplyGuideLead"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local summary = getVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", "")
    local okLead, leadReason, lead = tmValidateGuideLead(triggerId, getVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", ""))
    if summary == "" or not okLead or lead == "" then
        if leadReason ~= "" then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", tmGuideLeadValidationError(leadReason))
        end
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "현재 상황 또는 추천 리드가 아직 LLM 응답으로 준비되지 않았습니다.", "The current situation or suggested lead is not ready from the LLM response yet.", "現在状況またはおすすめリードがまだLLM応答で準備されていません。"))
        return
    end
    if type(addChat) ~= "function" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "RisuAI addChat API를 사용할 수 없어 가이드를 입력할 수 없습니다.", "The RisuAI addChat API is unavailable, so the guide cannot be sent.", "RisuAI addChat APIを使用できないため、ガイドを入力できません。"))
        return
    end
    local ok, err = pcall(addChat, triggerId, "user", summary .. "\n\n" .. lead .. tmProceedHintMarker())
    if not ok then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "가이드 적용 실패: ", "Guide application failed: ", "ガイド適用失敗: ") .. tostring(err))
        return
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "guide_lead:applied")
end)

function tmScenarioSheetBodyHtml(triggerId)
    local scenario = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    if scenario == "" then scenario = getVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", "")) end
    local episodeId = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(scenario)
    if episodeId == "" then
        return '<div class="tm-side-note"><b>시나리오 없음</b><br>시나리오를 선택해 주세요.</div>'
    end
    local content = ""
    if type(tmFetchEpisodeContent) == "function" then content = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId) end
    local sheet = parseSheet(content)
    local fallback = tmFallbackEpisodeEntry()
    local title = tmTrimText(sheet.TITLE or tmScenarioTitle(triggerId, episodeId))
    if title == "" or title == episodeId then title = fallback.title end
    local loreSummary = tmEpisodeDisplaySummaryFromContent(triggerId, content)
    if loreSummary == "" then loreSummary = fallback.summary end
    local opening = tmEpisodeDisplayOpeningFromContent(triggerId, content)
    if opening == "" then opening = T(triggerId, "선택된 에피소드의 첫 장면을 짧게 제시한다.", "Present the selected episode's opening scene briefly.", "選択したエピソードの最初の場面を短く提示する。") end
    local scenes = tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "SCENES", T(triggerId, "장면 구성 한국어 요약이 아직 준비되지 않았습니다.", "Scene outline is not ready yet.", "場面構成の要約はまだ準備されていません。"))
    if scenes == "" then scenes = T(triggerId, "플레이어 선언을 듣고, 현재 장면에 맞는 단서와 장애물을 제시한다.", "Listen to player declarations, then present clues and obstacles fitting the current scene.", "プレイヤー宣言を聞き、現在の場面に合う手掛かりと障害を提示する。") end
    local rollHints = tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "ROLL_HINTS", T(triggerId, "플레이어 선언에 맞춰 필요한 판정을 고른다.", "Choose checks that match player declarations.", "プレイヤー宣言に合う判定を選ぶ。"))
    if rollHints == "" then rollHints = T(triggerId, "플레이어 선언에 맞춰 필요한 판정을 고른다.", "Choose checks that match player declarations.", "プレイヤー宣言に合う判定を選ぶ。") end
    local enemies = tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "THREATS", T(triggerId, "필요할 때 현재 장면과 레벨에 맞는 위협을 LLM이 만들고 공식형 enemy ID로 저장한다.", "When needed, the LLM creates a scene- and level-appropriate threat and stores it as a formula enemy ID.", "必要な時、LLMが現在の場面とレベルに合う脅威を作り、公式型enemy IDとして保存する。"))
    if enemies == "" then enemies = T(triggerId, "필요할 때 현재 장면과 레벨에 맞는 위협을 LLM이 만들고 공식형 enemy ID로 저장한다.", "When needed, the LLM creates a scene- and level-appropriate threat and stores it as a formula enemy ID.", "必要な時、LLMが現在の場面とレベルに合う脅威を作り、公式型enemy IDとして保存する。") end
    local rewards = tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "REWARDS", T(triggerId, "클리어 결과에 맞춰 XP, 아이템, 스킬북, 플래그를 부여한다.", "Award XP, items, skillbooks, and flags according to the clear result.", "クリア結果に応じてXP、アイテム、スキルブック、フラグを付与する。"))
    if rewards == "" then rewards = T(triggerId, "클리어 결과에 맞춰 XP, 아이템, 스킬북, 플래그를 부여한다.", "Award XP, items, skillbooks, and flags according to the clear result.", "クリア結果に応じてXP、アイテム、スキルブック、フラグを付与する。") end
    local nextHint = tmEpisodeDisplaySection(triggerId, content, "NEXT_HINT", T(triggerId, "마무리 후 동아리실 테이블 반응으로 돌아온다.", "After the wrap-up, return to the clubroom table reactions.", "締めくくり後、部室テーブルの反応に戻る。"))
    if nextHint == "" then nextHint = tmTrimText(sheet.CLEAR_FLAG or "") end
    if nextHint == "" then nextHint = T(triggerId, "마무리 후 동아리실 테이블 반응으로 돌아온다.", "After the wrap-up, return to the clubroom table reactions.", "締めくくり後、部室テーブルの反応に戻る。") end
    local guideDefault = tmEpisodeGuideFromContent(triggerId, content)
    local summary = tmSessionBriefValue(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", loreSummary)
    local guide = tmSessionBriefValue(triggerId, "tm_decision_guide", guideDefault)
    local pages = {
        tmScenarioSlide(T(triggerId, "개요", "Overview", "概要"), {
            tmScenarioMaterial(T(triggerId, "제목", "Title", "タイトル"), title),
            tmScenarioMaterial("Episode ID", episodeId),
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "current_state"), tmBriefLineBreaks(summary)),
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "gm_guide"), '<span class="tm-scenario-guide-text">' .. tmRenderGuideText(guide) .. '</span>'),
        }),
        tmScenarioSlide(T(triggerId, "의뢰와 목표", "Request And Goal", "依頼と目標"), {
            tmScenarioMaterial(T(triggerId, "권장 레벨", "Recommended Level", "推奨レベル"), tmTrimText(sheet.RECOMMENDED_LEVEL or fallback.level)),
            tmScenarioMaterial(T(triggerId, "길이", "Length", "長さ"), tmTrimText(sheet.LENGTH or fallback.length)),
            tmScenarioMaterial(T(triggerId, "톤", "Tone", "トーン"), tmTrimText(sheet.TONE or fallback.tone)),
        }),
        tmScenarioSlide(T(triggerId, "장소와 단서", "Places And Clues", "場所と手掛かり"), {
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(T(triggerId, "도입", "Opening", "導入"), tmBriefLineBreaks(opening)),
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(T(triggerId, "장면", "Scenes", "場面"), tmBriefLineBreaks(scenes)),
            tmScenarioMaterial(T(triggerId, "장르 태그", "Genre Tags", "ジャンルタグ"), tmTrimText(sheet.GENRE_TAGS or "")),
            tmScenarioMaterial(T(triggerId, "장소 태그", "Setting Tags", "舞台タグ"), tmTrimText(sheet.SETTING_TAGS or "")),
        }),
        tmScenarioSlide(T(triggerId, "처리와 보상", "Resolution And Rewards", "処理と報酬"), {
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(T(triggerId, "판정 힌트", "Check Hints", "判定ヒント"), tmBriefLineBreaks(rollHints)),
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(T(triggerId, "위협", "Threats", "脅威"), tmBriefLineBreaks(enemies)),
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(T(triggerId, "보상", "Rewards", "報酬"), tmBriefLineBreaks(rewards)),
            tmScenarioMaterialHtml(T(triggerId, "다음 단서", "Next Hint", "次の手掛かり"), tmBriefLineBreaks(nextHint)),
        }),
    }
    return tmPhoneSlider("scenario", pages)
end

function tmScenarioPickerEpisodeCardHtml(triggerId, entry, slot)
    local summary = entry.summary
    if summary == "" then summary = "에피소드 요약이 비어 있습니다." end
    local meta = tmEpisodePickerMeta(entry)
    if meta == "" then meta = entry.id end
    return '<div class="tm-scenario-option"><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(entry.title or entry.id)
        .. '</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(summary)
        .. '</span><em>' .. tmEscapeHtml(meta)
        .. '</em><div>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "select"), "tmSelectEpisodeChoice" .. tostring(slot)) .. '</div></div>'
end

function tmScenarioPickerPagerLabelHtml(triggerId, targetPage, text)
    local inputId = "tm-scenario-picker-" .. tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId) .. "-" .. tostring(targetPage)
    return '<label class="tm-scenario-pager-label" for="' .. tmEscapeHtml(inputId) .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(text) .. '</label>'
end

function tmScenarioPickerCssBodyHtml(triggerId, episodes, page, pages)
    tmStoreEpisodeChoiceSlots(triggerId, episodes, 1, true)
    local group = "tm-scenario-picker-" .. tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId)
    local radios, pagers, pageBodies = {}, {}, {}
    for p = 1, pages do
        local inputId = group .. "-" .. tostring(p)
        table.insert(radios, '<input type="radio" class="tm-scenario-picker-radio tm-scenario-picker-radio-' .. tostring(p) .. '" name="' .. tmEscapeHtml(group) .. '" id="' .. tmEscapeHtml(inputId) .. '"' .. (p == page and " checked" or "") .. '>')
        local prev = (p == 1) and pages or (p - 1)
        local next = (p == pages) and 1 or (p + 1)
        table.insert(pagers, '<div class="tm-scenario-pager tm-scenario-pager-page tm-scenario-pager-page-' .. tostring(p) .. '"><span>'
            .. tmScenarioPickerPagerLabelHtml(triggerId, prev, tmUiText(triggerId, "prev"))
            .. '</span><b>' .. tostring(p) .. ' / ' .. tostring(pages)
            .. '</b><span>' .. tmScenarioPickerPagerLabelHtml(triggerId, next, tmUiText(triggerId, "next")) .. '</span></div>')
        local cards = {}
        local startIndex = (p - 1) * TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE
        for i = 1, TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE do
            local slot = startIndex + i
            local entry = episodes[slot]
            if not entry then break end
            table.insert(cards, tmScenarioPickerEpisodeCardHtml(triggerId, entry, slot))
        end
        table.insert(pageBodies, '<div class="tm-scenario-picker-page tm-scenario-picker-page-' .. tostring(p) .. '"><div class="tm-scenario-picker">' .. table.concat(cards, "") .. '</div></div>')
    end
    return '<div class="tm-scenario-picker-css tm-scenario-picker-pages-' .. tostring(pages) .. '">'
        .. table.concat(radios, "")
        .. table.concat(pagers, "")
        .. '<div class="tm-scenario-picker tm-scenario-picker-runtime">' .. tmScenarioPickerRuntimeCardsHtml(triggerId) .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-scenario-picker-pages">' .. table.concat(pageBodies, "") .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmScenarioPickerLegacyBodyHtml(triggerId, episodes, page, pages)
    local startIndex = (page - 1) * TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE
    tmStoreEpisodeChoiceSlots(triggerId, episodes, page, false)
    local cards = {}
    for i = 1, TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE do
        local entry = episodes[startIndex + i]
        if not entry then break end
        table.insert(cards, tmScenarioPickerEpisodeCardHtml(triggerId, entry, i))
    end
    local pager = '<div class="tm-scenario-pager"><span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "prev"), "tmScenarioPickerPrev")
        .. '</span><b>' .. tostring(page) .. ' / ' .. tostring(pages)
        .. '</b><span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "next"), "tmScenarioPickerNext") .. '</span></div>'
    return pager
        .. '<div class="tm-scenario-picker">'
        .. tmScenarioPickerRuntimeCardsHtml(triggerId)
        .. table.concat(cards, "")
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmScenarioPickerBodyHtml(triggerId)
    local episodes = tmFetchEpisodeList(triggerId)
    local page, pages = tmEpisodePickerPage(triggerId, episodes)
    if pages <= TM_EPISODE_PICKER_CSS_PAGE_CAP then
        return tmScenarioPickerCssBodyHtml(triggerId, episodes, page, pages)
    end
    return tmScenarioPickerLegacyBodyHtml(triggerId, episodes, page, pages)
end

function tmRelationStateText(triggerId, ownerId)
    local affection = clamp(getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_affection", 100), 0, 500)
    local tier = getAffinityLevel(triggerId, ownerId, "ko")
    if affection <= 75 then return tier .. " · 아직 거리를 재는 중" end
    if affection <= 175 then return tier .. " · 동아리 안에서 조금씩 익숙해지는 중" end
    if affection <= 300 then return tier .. " · GM의 진행에 점점 편하게 반응함" end
    if affection <= 400 then return tier .. " · 세션의 중요한 순간에 강하게 몰입함" end
    return tier .. " · 특별히 신뢰하는 관계"
end

function tmPlayerProgressBarRowHtml(key, label, curValue, maxValue)
    if maxValue > 0 then curValue = clamp(curValue, 0, maxValue) end
    local pct = tmVitalPercent(curValue, maxValue)
    return '<div class="tm-player-vital-row tm-player-vital-' .. key .. '">'
        .. '<span class="tm-player-vital-label">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-player-vital-track" aria-hidden="true"><i style="width:' .. tostring(pct) .. '%"></i></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-player-vital-value">' .. tostring(curValue) .. '/' .. tostring(maxValue) .. '</span>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmPlayerVitalBarRowHtml(triggerId, ownerId, key, label)
    local maxValue = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. key .. "_max", 0)
    local curValue = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. key, 0)
    return tmPlayerProgressBarRowHtml(key, label, curValue, maxValue)
end

function tmPlayerExpBarRowHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    local exp = tmExpProgress(triggerId, ownerId)
    return tmPlayerProgressBarRowHtml("exp", "EXP", exp.cur, exp.next)
end

function tmPlayerVitalsBarsHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    return '<div class="tm-player-vital-bars">'
        .. tmPlayerVitalBarRowHtml(triggerId, ownerId, "hp", "HP")
        .. tmPlayerVitalBarRowHtml(triggerId, ownerId, "mp", "MP")
        .. tmPlayerExpBarRowHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmRenderPlayerInfoCard(triggerId, ownerId)
    local info = TM_PLAYER_INFO_KO[ownerId] or {}
    local affection = clamp(getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_affection", 100), 0, 500)
    local percent = tmAffinityPercent(triggerId, ownerId)
    local tier = getAffinityLevel(triggerId, ownerId, "ko")
    local introText = tmCleanLogText((info.overview or "") .. " " .. (info.experience or "") .. " " .. (info.tone or ""))
    local portrait = '<div class="tm-player-portrait">' .. tmUiAssetHtml(ownerId .. '_neutral_default.webp', "tm-player-portrait-asset", CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId) .. '</div>'
    return '<div class="tm-player-card tm-player-cinema-card">'
        .. '<div class="tm-player-profile">' .. portrait .. '<div class="tm-player-intro"><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(info.role or "") .. '</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(info.subtitle or "") .. '</span><p class="tm-player-desc">' .. tmEscapeHtml(introText) .. '</p></div></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-player-dynamic">'
        .. '<div class="tm-player-line"><b>관계 상태</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmRelationStateText(triggerId, ownerId)) .. '</span></div>'
        .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-affection-block"><div class="tm-affection-head"><b>관계</b><span>' .. tostring(affection) .. '/500 · ' .. tmEscapeHtml(tier) .. '</span></div><div class="tm-affection-bar"><i style="width:' .. tostring(percent) .. '%"></i></div></div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmWardrobeAddAsset(entries, seen, raw)
    local asset = tmTrimText(raw):lower():gsub("%.webp$", "")
    if asset == "" then return end
    asset = asset:gsub("[^a-z0-9_]", "")
    local ownerId, outfit = asset:match("^([a-z]+)_neutral_(.+)$")
    if not ownerId or not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return end
    if not outfit or outfit == "" or seen[asset] then return end
    seen[asset] = true
    table.insert(entries, {asset = asset, owner = ownerId, outfit = outfit})
end

function tmWardrobeCatalog(triggerId)
    local cacheKey = tostring(triggerId or "") .. "\31" .. tostring(TM_BUILTIN_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS or "")
    local cached = TM_WARDROBE_CATALOG_CACHE[cacheKey]
    if cached then return cached end
    local entries, seen = {}, {}
    for outfit in TM_BUILTIN_RISU_IMAGE_OUTFITS:gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local cleanOutfit = tmTrimText(outfit)
        if cleanOutfit ~= "" then
            for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
                tmWardrobeAddAsset(entries, seen, ownerId .. "_neutral_" .. cleanOutfit)
            end
        end
    end
    if type(getLoreBooks) == "function" then
        local ok, books = pcall(getLoreBooks, triggerId, "TM_WARDROBE_CATALOG")
        if ok and type(books) == "table" then
            for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
                local content = type(entry) == "table" and tostring(entry.content or "") or ""
                for line in content:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do
                    local one = line:match("^%s*ASSET%s*:%s*([%w_%-%.]+)")
                    if one then tmWardrobeAddAsset(entries, seen, one) end
                    local many = line:match("^%s*ASSETS%s*:%s*(.+)$")
                    if many then
                        for token in many:gmatch("[^,%s]+") do
                            tmWardrobeAddAsset(entries, seen, token)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    TM_WARDROBE_CATALOG_CACHE = {[cacheKey] = entries}
    return entries
end

function tmWardrobeDisplayName(outfit)
    local text = tostring(outfit or ""):gsub("_", " ")
    return text
end

function tmWardrobeBodyHtml(triggerId)
    local entries = tmWardrobeCatalog(triggerId)
    local cards = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
        local ownerId = entry.owner
        local ownerName = CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId
        local assetName = entry.asset .. ".webp"
        local label = ownerName .. " · " .. entry.outfit
        table.insert(cards,
            '<div class="tm-wardrobe-card">'
            .. '<div class="tm-wardrobe-thumb">' .. tmUiAssetHtml(assetName, "tm-wardrobe-asset", label) .. '</div>'
            .. '<div class="tm-wardrobe-meta"><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(ownerName) .. '</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmWardrobeDisplayName(entry.outfit)) .. '</span></div>'
            .. '</div>')
    end
    return (#cards > 0)
        and ('<div class="tm-wardrobe-grid">' .. table.concat(cards, "") .. '</div>')
        or ('<div class="tm-sheet-note">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "등록된 의상이 없습니다.", "No registered outfits.", "登録された衣装がありません。")) .. '</div>')
end

function tmSessionLogBodyHtml(triggerId)
    local summary = getVar(triggerId, "session_log_summary", "")
    if summary == "" then summary = "아직 압축된 세션 요약이 없습니다." end
    local lines = tmSessionLogLines(triggerId)
    local logHtml = ""
    if #lines == 0 then
        logHtml = '<div class="tm-log-empty">아직 기록된 플레이 로그가 없습니다.</div>'
    else
        local rows = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(lines) do table.insert(rows, '<li>' .. tmEscapeHtml(line) .. '</li>') end
        logHtml = '<ol class="tm-log-list">' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</ol>'
    end
    local combatHtml = tmCurrentThreatInlineHtml(triggerId)
    if combatHtml == "" then
        combatHtml = tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "현재 기록된 위협 없음", "No current recorded threat", "現在記録された脅威はありません"))
    end
    local runtimeHtml = tmRuntimeObjectHtml(triggerId)
    return '<div class="tm-log-grid">'
        .. '<section><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "현재 세션 요약", "Current Session Summary", "現在のセッション要約")) .. '</h4><p>' .. tmBriefLineBreaks(summary) .. '</p></section>'
        .. '<section><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "최근 이벤트", "Recent Events", "最近のイベント")) .. '</h4>' .. logHtml .. '</section>'
        .. '<section><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "보상/성장", "Rewards/Growth", "報酬/成長")) .. '</h4><p>' .. tmPartyRewardSummaryHtml(triggerId) .. '</p></section>'
        .. '<section><h4>' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "전투 상태", "Combat State", "戦闘状態")) .. '</h4><p>' .. combatHtml .. '</p>' .. runtimeHtml .. '</section>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmRenderHomePanel(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "ui_home_open", "true") ~= "true" then return "" end
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    local scenario = getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", "")
    local sessionStarted = getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true"
    if mode == "normal" then
        return ""
    end
    local sessionText = sessionStarted and tmUiText(triggerId, "session_in_progress") or tmUiText(triggerId, "session_preparing")
    local panelTitle = sessionStarted and tmUiText(triggerId, "session_progress") or tmUiText(triggerId, "first_session_prep")
    local scenarioTitle = (tmTrimText(scenario) == "" or scenario == "fantasy_first_session") and "시나리오 없음" or tmScenarioTitle(triggerId, scenario)
    local scenarioTip = tmScenarioTooltipText(triggerId, scenario)
    local scenarioHelp = ""
    if scenarioTip ~= "" then
        scenarioHelp = ' <span class="tm-guide-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "current_scenario")) .. '">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip">' .. tmBriefLineBreaks(scenarioTip) .. '</span></span>'
    end
    local actionsClass = "tm-home-actions "
        .. (sessionStarted and "tm-home-actions-session" or "tm-home-actions-prep")
    local actions = ""
    if sessionStarted then
        actions = tmDrawerActionSpanHtml(triggerId, "character-sheet", tmUiText(triggerId, "character_sheet"))
            .. tmDrawerActionSpanHtml(triggerId, "scenario-sheet", tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_sheet"))
            .. tmDrawerActionSpanHtml(triggerId, "session-log", tmUiText(triggerId, "session_log"))
            .. '<span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_end"), "tmAskEndScenario") .. '</span>'
    else
        actions = tmDrawerActionSpanHtml(triggerId, "character-sheet", tmUiText(triggerId, "character_sheet"))
            .. tmDrawerActionSpanHtml(triggerId, "scenario-picker", tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_picker"))
            .. '<span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "first_session_start"), "tmStartFirstSessionFromPrep") .. '</span>'
            .. '<span>' .. tmButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "session_load"), "tmOpenSessionSeedLoadPopup") .. '</span>'
    end
    local prepGrid = ""
    if not sessionStarted then
        prepGrid = '<div class="tm-home-grid">'
            .. '<div><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "current_scenario")) .. scenarioHelp .. '</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(scenarioTitle) .. '</span></div>'
            .. '<div><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "session_state")) .. '</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(sessionText) .. '</span></div>'
            .. '<div><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "character_sheet")) .. '</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmSheetStatusLabel(triggerId)) .. '</span></div>'
            .. '</div>'
    end
    return '<div class="tm-home-panel trs-compat" data-mode="' .. tmEscapeHtml(mode) .. '" data-state="' .. tmEscapeHtml(mode) .. '">'
        .. '<div class="tm-home-head"><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(panelTitle) .. '</span><small>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "clubroom")) .. '</small></div>'
        .. tmRenderSessionBrief(triggerId)
        .. prepGrid
        .. '<div class="' .. actionsClass .. '">'
        .. actions
        .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmSettingsPanelHtml(triggerId)
    local lang = getVar(triggerId, "lang", "ko")
    local helperSource = tmHelperLLMSource(triggerId)
    local asset = getVar(triggerId, "asset_display", "")
    if asset == "" then asset = "show" end
    local gimmickNsfw = getVar(triggerId, "gimmick_nsfw_enabled", "true")
    local diceXpMultiplier = tmDiceXpMultiplier(triggerId)
    local function settingsBtn(label, fn, active)
        return '<span class="yp-settings-btn' .. (active and ' yp-settings-active' or '') .. '">' .. tmButton(label, fn) .. '</span>'
    end
    local function settingsRow(label, buttons)
        return '<div class="yp-settings-row"><span class="yp-settings-label">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '</span><span class="yp-settings-toggle">' .. buttons .. '</span></div>'
    end
    return settingsRow(T(triggerId, "언어", "Language", "言語"),
            settingsBtn("한국어", "setLang_ko", lang == "ko")
            .. settingsBtn("English", "setLang_en", lang == "en")
            .. settingsBtn("日本語", "setLang_ja", lang == "ja"))
        .. settingsRow(T(triggerId, "세션 모델", "Session Model", "セッションモデル"),
            settingsBtn(T(triggerId, "보조모델(Aux)", "Aux Model", "補助モデル(Aux)"), "setAuxLLMOn", helperSource == "aux")
            .. settingsBtn(T(triggerId, "주모델(Main)", "Main Model", "主モデル(Main)"), "setAuxLLMOff", helperSource == "main"))
        .. settingsRow(T(triggerId, "에셋 표시", "Asset Display", "アセット表示"),
            settingsBtn("ON", "setAssetShow", asset == "show")
            .. settingsBtn(T(triggerId, "접기", "Fold", "折りたたみ"), "setAssetFold", asset == "fold")
            .. settingsBtn("OFF", "setAssetHide", asset == "hide"))
        .. settingsRow(T(triggerId, "주사위 XP 배율", "Dice XP Multiplier", "ダイスXP倍率"),
            settingsBtn("1x", "setDiceXpMultiplier1", diceXpMultiplier == 1)
            .. settingsBtn("2x", "setDiceXpMultiplier2", diceXpMultiplier == 2)
            .. settingsBtn("3x", "setDiceXpMultiplier3", diceXpMultiplier == 3))
        .. settingsRow("Gimmick NSFW",
            settingsBtn("ON", "setGimmickNsfwOn", gimmickNsfw == "true")
            .. settingsBtn("OFF", "setGimmickNsfwOff", gimmickNsfw ~= "true"))

TM_PENDING_DRAWER_KEEP = {}
TM_RENDERING_DRAWER_ID = ""
TM_DRAWER_IDS = {
    "settings",
    "manual",
    "scenario-picker",
    "scenario-sheet",
    "session-log",
    "player-info",
    "wardrobe",
    "character-sheet",
    "party-bag",
}
TM_DRAWER_ID_SET = {}
for _, tmDrawerIdForSet in ipairs(TM_DRAWER_IDS) do
    TM_DRAWER_ID_SET[tmDrawerIdForSet] = true
end

function tmDrawerSafeDomKeyPart(value)
    local key = tostring(value or ""):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "-")
    if key == "" then return "main" end
    return key
end

function tmPrepareDrawerDomKey(triggerId)
    local base = tmDrawerSafeDomKeyPart(triggerId)
    local key = base .. "-" .. tostring(tmNow()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_dom_key", key)
    return key
end

function tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId)
    local key = tmDrawerSafeDomKeyPart(getVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_dom_key", ""))
    if key ~= "main" then return key end
    return tmDrawerSafeDomKeyPart(triggerId)
end

function tmDrawerRadioName(triggerId)
    return "tm-drawer-" .. tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId) .. "-main"
end

function tmDrawerInputId(triggerId, drawerId)
    return "tm-drawer-" .. tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId) .. "-" .. tostring(drawerId or "")
end

function tmDrawerLegacyPanelToDrawer(panel)
    local key = tostring(panel or "")
    local map = {
        settings = "settings",
        manual = "manual",
        scenario = "scenario-sheet",
        scenario_sheet = "scenario-sheet",
        scenario_picker = "scenario-picker",
        session_log = "session-log",
        log = "session-log",
        player_info = "player-info",
        players = "player-info",
        wardrobe = "wardrobe",
        character_sheet = "character-sheet",
        party_bag = "party-bag",
    }
    return map[key] or ""
end

function tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    local id = tostring(drawerId or "")
    local mapped = tmDrawerLegacyPanelToDrawer(id)
    if mapped ~= "" then return mapped end
    if TM_DRAWER_ID_SET[id] then return id end
    return ""
end

function tmDrawerFnKey(drawerId)
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    if id == "" then return "" end
    return id:gsub("%-", "_")
end

function tmDrawerOpenFnName(drawerId)
    local key = tmDrawerFnKey(drawerId)
    if key == "" then return "" end
    return "tmOpenDrawer_" .. key
end

function tmSetActiveDrawer(triggerId, drawerId, options)
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_active_drawer", id)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", id == "character-sheet" and "true" or "false")
    if id == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_open_anim", "")
    elseif type(options) == "table" and options.animate == true then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_open_anim", id)
    end
    return id ~= ""
end

function tmDrawerPendingKeepId(triggerId)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if key ~= "" then
        local pending = tmDrawerNormalizeId(TM_PENDING_DRAWER_KEEP[key])
        if pending ~= "" then return pending end
    end
    return tmDrawerNormalizeId(getVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", ""))
end

function tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen(triggerId, drawerId)
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    if id == "" then return false end
    tmSetActiveDrawer(triggerId, id)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", id)
    return true
end

function tmQueuePersistentDrawerKeep(triggerId, drawerId)
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if id == "" or key == "" then return false end
    TM_PENDING_DRAWER_KEEP[key] = id
    return true
end

function tmClearQueuedPersistentDrawerKeep(triggerId, drawerId)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if key == "" then return false end
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    if tmDrawerNormalizeId(TM_PENDING_DRAWER_KEEP[key]) ~= id then return false end
    TM_PENDING_DRAWER_KEEP[key] = nil
    return true
end

function tmApplyPendingPersistentDrawerKeep(triggerId)
    local key = tostring(triggerId or "")
    if key == "" then return false end
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(TM_PENDING_DRAWER_KEEP[key])
    TM_PENDING_DRAWER_KEEP[key] = nil
    if id == "" then return false end
    return tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen(triggerId, id)
end

function tmTakePersistentDrawerKeep(triggerId)
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(getVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", ""))
    if id ~= "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", "")
    end
    return id
end

function tmDrawerButtonFnForRender(fnName)
    return tostring(fnName or "")
end

function tmRenderDrawerBodyWithContext(triggerId, drawerId, renderFn)
    local previous = TM_RENDERING_DRAWER_ID
    TM_RENDERING_DRAWER_ID = tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    local ok, result = pcall(renderFn)
    TM_RENDERING_DRAWER_ID = previous
    if not ok then error(result) end
    return tostring(result or "")
end

function tmClosePersistentDrawerState(triggerId)
    if tmDrawerPendingKeepId(triggerId) ~= "" then return end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_active_drawer", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_open_anim", "")
    if tmDrawerLegacyPanelToDrawer(getVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")) ~= "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false") == "true" then
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false")
    end
end

function tmScenarioDrawerId(triggerId)
    return (getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true") and "scenario-sheet" or "scenario-picker"
end

function tmDrawerTitle(triggerId, drawerId)
    if drawerId == "settings" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "settings") end
    if drawerId == "manual" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "manual") end
    if drawerId == "scenario-picker" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_picker") end
    if drawerId == "scenario-sheet" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_sheet") end
    if drawerId == "session-log" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "session_log") end
    if drawerId == "player-info" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "player_info") end
    if drawerId == "wardrobe" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "wardrobe") end
    if drawerId == "character-sheet" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "character_sheet") end
    if drawerId == "party-bag" then return tmUiText(triggerId, "party_bag") end
    return tmUiText(triggerId, "info")
end

function tmDrawerBodyHtml(triggerId, drawerId)
    return tmRenderDrawerBodyWithContext(triggerId, drawerId, function()
        if drawerId == "settings" then return tmSettingsPanelHtml(triggerId) end
        if drawerId == "manual" then
            return tmManualBodyHtml(triggerId)
        end
        if drawerId == "scenario-picker" then return tmScenarioPickerBodyHtml(triggerId) end
        if drawerId == "scenario-sheet" then return tmScenarioSheetBodyHtml(triggerId) end
        if drawerId == "session-log" then return tmSessionLogBodyHtml(triggerId) end
        if drawerId == "player-info" then return tmPlayerInfoBodyHtml(triggerId) end
        if drawerId == "wardrobe" then return tmWardrobeBodyHtml(triggerId) end
        if drawerId == "character-sheet" then return tmCharacterSheetBodyHtml(triggerId) end
        if drawerId == "party-bag" then return tmPartyBagHtml(triggerId) end
        return ""
    end)
end

function tmDrawerActiveId(triggerId)
    local keepId = tmTakePersistentDrawerKeep(triggerId)
    if keepId ~= "" then
        tmSetActiveDrawer(triggerId, keepId)
        return keepId
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false") == "true" then
        tmSetActiveDrawer(triggerId, "character-sheet")
        return "character-sheet"
    end
    local legacy = tmDrawerLegacyPanelToDrawer(getVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", ""))
    if legacy ~= "" then
        tmSetActiveDrawer(triggerId, legacy)
        return legacy
    end
    local active = tmDrawerNormalizeId(getVar(triggerId, "tm_active_drawer", ""))
    local opening = tmDrawerNormalizeId(getVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_open_anim", ""))
    if active ~= "" and active == opening then return active end
    return ""
end

function tmTakeDrawerOpenAnimation(triggerId, drawerId)
    local id = tmDrawerNormalizeId(drawerId)
    local pending = tmDrawerNormalizeId(getVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_open_anim", ""))
    if pending == "" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_open_anim", "")
    return id ~= "" and pending == id
end

function tmDrawerRailOpenerHtml(triggerId, drawerId, icon, title, extraClass)
    local escapedTitle = tmEscapeHtml(title or tmDrawerTitle(triggerId, drawerId))
    local inputId = tmEscapeHtml(tmDrawerInputId(triggerId, drawerId))
    return '<span class="tm-side-btn' .. (extraClass or "") .. ' tm-drawer-open" title="' .. escapedTitle .. '"><label class="tm-side-btn-label" for="' .. inputId .. '" aria-label="' .. escapedTitle .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(icon or "") .. '</label></span>'
end

function tmDrawerActionHtml(triggerId, drawerId, label)
    local inputId = tmEscapeHtml(tmDrawerInputId(triggerId, drawerId))
    return '<label class="tm-drawer-action-label" for="' .. inputId .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label or tmDrawerTitle(triggerId, drawerId)) .. '</label>'
end

function tmDrawerActionSpanHtml(triggerId, drawerId, label)
    return '<span>' .. tmDrawerActionHtml(triggerId, drawerId, label) .. '</span>'
end

function tmRenderPersistentDrawers(triggerId)
    local activeId = tmDrawerActiveId(triggerId)
    local animateActive = tmTakeDrawerOpenAnimation(triggerId, activeId)
    local radioName = tmEscapeHtml(tmDrawerRadioName(triggerId))
    local noneInputId = tmEscapeHtml(tmDrawerInputId(triggerId, "none"))
    local html = '<div class="tm-drawer-root tm-persistent-drawer-root trs-compat" data-drawer-root="main">'
    html = html .. '<input type="radio" class="tm-drawer-state tm-drawer-none-radio" name="' .. radioName .. '" id="' .. noneInputId .. '"' .. (activeId == "" and " checked" or "") .. '>'
    for _, drawerId in ipairs(TM_DRAWER_IDS) do
        local inputId = tmEscapeHtml(tmDrawerInputId(triggerId, drawerId))
        html = html .. '<input type="radio" class="tm-drawer-state tm-drawer-panel-radio tm-drawer-' .. drawerId .. '-radio" name="' .. radioName .. '" id="' .. inputId .. '"' .. (activeId == drawerId and " checked" or "") .. '>'
    end
    html = html .. '<label class="tm-drawer-backdrop" for="' .. noneInputId .. '" aria-label="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "close")) .. '"></label>'
    for _, drawerId in ipairs(TM_DRAWER_IDS) do
        local title = tmEscapeHtml(tmDrawerTitle(triggerId, drawerId))
        local isActive = activeId == drawerId
        local extraClass = (drawerId == "character-sheet") and " tm-sheet-modal" or ""
        if isActive and animateActive then extraClass = extraClass .. " tm-drawer-animate-open" end
        html = html
            .. '<aside class="tm-modal tm-drawer tm-' .. drawerId .. '-drawer' .. extraClass .. ' trs-compat" data-panel="' .. tmEscapeHtml(drawerId) .. '" role="dialog" aria-label="' .. title .. '">'
            .. '<div class="tm-modal-head tm-drawer-head"><span>' .. title .. '</span><span class="tm-drawer-close-action"><label class="tm-drawer-close" for="' .. noneInputId .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "close")) .. '</label></span></div>'
            .. '<div class="tm-drawer-body" data-active="' .. (isActive and "true" or "false") .. '">' .. tmDrawerBodyHtml(triggerId, drawerId) .. '</div>'
            .. '</aside>'
    end
    return html .. '</div>'
end

function tmOpenPersistentDrawer(triggerId, drawerId)
    pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId, {skipControlPanelBuild = true, skipUnchangedSeed = true})
    if not tmSetActiveDrawer(triggerId, drawerId, {animate = true}) then return "" end
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {reloadLastChar = true})
    return ""
end

function tmClosePersistentDrawer(triggerId)
    pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId, {skipControlPanelBuild = true, skipUnchangedSeed = true})
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_active_drawer", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_open_anim", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false")
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {reloadLastChar = true})
    return ""
end

for _, tmDrawerHandlerId in ipairs(TM_DRAWER_IDS) do
    local drawerId = tmDrawerHandlerId
    local fnName = tmDrawerOpenFnName(drawerId)
    _G[fnName] = async(function(triggerId)
        return tmOpenPersistentDrawer(triggerId, drawerId)
    end)
end

_G["tmCloseDrawer"] = async(function(triggerId)
    return tmClosePersistentDrawer(triggerId)
end)

function tmRenderSidePanelSlide(triggerId)
    local panel = getVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    if getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false") == "true" then
        panel = "character_sheet"
    end
    if panel == "" then return "" end
    if panel == "class_creator" then return "" end
    if tmDrawerLegacyPanelToDrawer(panel) ~= "" then return "" end
    local title = tmUiText(triggerId, "info")
    local body = ""
    local closeFn = "closeSidePanel"
    local extraClass = ""
    if panel == "manual" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "manual")
        body = tmManualBodyHtml(triggerId)
    elseif panel == "scenario" or panel == "scenario_sheet" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_sheet")
        body = tmScenarioSheetBodyHtml(triggerId)
    elseif panel == "scenario_picker" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_picker")
        body = tmScenarioPickerBodyHtml(triggerId)
    elseif panel == "log" or panel == "session_log" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "session_log")
        body = tmSessionLogBodyHtml(triggerId)
    elseif panel == "party_bag" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "party_bag")
        body = tmPartyBagHtml(triggerId)
    elseif panel == "players" or panel == "player_info" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "player_info")
        body = tmPlayerInfoBodyHtml(triggerId)
    elseif panel == "wardrobe" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "wardrobe")
        body = tmWardrobeBodyHtml(triggerId)
    elseif panel == "character_sheet" then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "character_sheet")
        body = tmCharacterSheetBodyHtml(triggerId)
        closeFn = "closeCharSheet"
        extraClass = " tm-sheet-modal"
    end
    return '<div class="tm-side-slide-backdrop trs-compat" data-panel="' .. tmEscapeHtml(panel) .. '">'
        .. '<span class="tm-side-slide-close-area">' .. tmSideSlideSafeButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "close"), closeFn) .. '</span>'
        .. '<aside class="tm-modal tm-side-slide' .. extraClass .. ' trs-compat" data-panel="' .. tmEscapeHtml(panel) .. '" role="dialog" aria-label="' .. tmEscapeHtml(title) .. '">'
        .. '<div class="tm-modal-head tm-side-slide-head"><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(title) .. '</span><span>' .. tmSideSlideSafeButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "close"), closeFn) .. '</span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-side-slide-body">' .. body .. '</div>'
        .. '</aside>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmRenderCharacterSheetRegion(triggerId)
    return tmRenderPersistentDrawers(triggerId) .. tmRenderSidePanelSlide(triggerId) .. tmRenderCharacterSheetPanel(triggerId)
end

function tmRenderInAppPopup(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "false") ~= "true" then return "" end
    local kind = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_kind", "normal")
    local title = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_title", tmUiText(triggerId, "notice_title"))
    local body = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_body", "")
    if body == "" then return "" end
    local yesFn = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_fn", "")
    local noFn = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_fn", "")
    local yesLabel = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_label", tmUiText(triggerId, "yes"))
    local noLabel = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_label", tmUiText(triggerId, "no"))
    local closeFn = (noFn ~= "") and noFn or "closeInAppPopup"
    local actions = '<div class="tm-modal-actions">' .. tmPopupSafeButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "ok"), "closeInAppPopup") .. '</div>'
    if yesFn ~= "" then
        actions = '<div class="tm-modal-actions tm-modal-actions-confirm">'
            .. '<span>' .. tmButton(yesLabel ~= "" and yesLabel or tmUiText(triggerId, "yes"), yesFn) .. '</span>'
            .. '<span>' .. tmPopupSafeButton(noLabel ~= "" and noLabel or tmUiText(triggerId, "no"), closeFn) .. '</span>'
            .. '</div>'
    end
    local bodyClass = "tm-modal-body"
    if kind == "save-code" then bodyClass = bodyClass .. " tm-modal-body-save-code" end
    if kind == "party-bag-target" then bodyClass = bodyClass .. " tm-modal-body-party-bag-target" end
    local bodyHtml = tmEscapeHtml(body)
    if kind == "save-code" then
        local exportText = tostring(tmStateGet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_EXPORT_DISPLAY_TEXT_KEY, "") or "")
        if exportText ~= "" and body:find(exportText, 1, true) then
            local intro = body
            local pos = body:find(exportText, 1, true)
            if pos then intro = tmTrimText(body:sub(1, pos - 1)) end
            bodyHtml = '<div class="tm-save-code-copy-note">' .. tmEscapeHtml(intro) .. '</div>'
                .. '<pre class="tm-save-code-box"><code x-hl-lang="txt">' .. tmEscapeHtml(exportText) .. '</code></pre>'
                .. '<div class="tm-save-code-copy-note">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId,
                    "위 저장 코드를 처음부터 끝까지 복사해서 세션 불러오기에 붙여넣으세요.",
                    "Copy the full save code above and paste it into Load Session.",
                    "上の保存コードを最初から最後までコピーして、セッション読込に貼り付けてください。")) .. '</div>'
        end
    elseif kind == "party-bag-target" then
        bodyHtml = body
        actions = ""
    end
    return '<div class="tm-modal-backdrop trs-compat">'
        .. '<div class="tm-modal tm-modal-' .. tmEscapeHtml(kind) .. '">'
        .. '<div class="tm-modal-head"><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(title) .. '</span><span>' .. tmPopupSafeButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "close"), closeFn) .. '</span></div>'
        .. '<div class="' .. bodyClass .. '">' .. bodyHtml .. '</div>'
        .. actions
        .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmRenderCountdown(seconds)
    seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(tonumber(seconds) or 0))
    local parts = {'<span class="tm-countdown" aria-label="' .. tostring(seconds) .. '">'}
    for offset = 0, seconds do
        local value = seconds - offset
        local style = 'animation-delay:' .. tostring(offset) .. 's;'
        if offset > 0 then style = style .. 'opacity:0;' end
        table.insert(parts, '<i aria-hidden="true" style="' .. style .. '">' .. tostring(value) .. '</i>')
    end
    table.insert(parts, '</span>')
    return table.concat(parts)
end

function tmRenderLoadingOverlay(triggerId)
    local locked = getVar(triggerId, "action_locked", "false") == "true"
    local sheetPending = getVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false") == "true"
    local firstSessionHold = getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false") == "true"
    local saveCodePending = getVar(triggerId, "tm_save_code_pending", "false") == "true"
    local sessionLoadPending = getVar(triggerId, "tm_session_load_pending", "false") == "true"
    local customClassGenerating = getVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_generating", "false") == "true"
    if not locked and not sheetPending and not firstSessionHold and not saveCodePending and not sessionLoadPending and not customClassGenerating then return "" end
    local title = tmUiText(triggerId, "please_wait")
    local body = tmUiText(triggerId, "tidying_screen")
    if saveCodePending then
        title = T(triggerId, "세션 저장 코드 생성 중", "Generating Session Save Code", "セッション保存コード生成中")
        body = T(triggerId, "현재 세션 상태를 저장 코드로 정리하고 있습니다.\n잠시만 기다려주세요.", "Preparing the current session state as a save code.\nPlease wait.", "現在のセッション状態を保存コードにまとめています。\nしばらくお待ちください。")
    end
    if sessionLoadPending then
        title = T(triggerId, "세션 저장 코드 불러오는 중", "Loading Session Save Code", "セッション保存コード読込中")
        body = T(triggerId, "저장 코드에서 세션 상태를 복원하고 있습니다.\n잠시만 기다려주세요.", "Restoring the session state from the save code.\nPlease wait.", "保存コードからセッション状態を復元しています。\nしばらくお待ちください。")
    end
    if firstSessionHold then
        title = T(triggerId, "세션 준비중", "Preparing Session", "セッション準備中")
        body = T(triggerId, "세션을 준비중입니다.\n잠시만 기다려주세요.", "Preparing the session.\nPlease wait.", "セッションを準備中です。\nしばらくお待ちください。")
    end
    if sheetPending then
        title = tmUiText(triggerId, "sheet_creating")
        body = tmUiText(triggerId, "creating_character_sheets")
    end
    if customClassGenerating then
        title = T(triggerId, "직업 TRAIT 생성 중", "Generating Class TRAIT", "クラス TRAIT 生成中")
        body = T(triggerId, "입력한 직업 컨셉을 로어북 템플릿에 맞춰 정리하고 있습니다.\n잠시만 기다려주세요.", "Converting the submitted class concept into the lorebook template.\nPlease wait.", "入力されたクラスコンセプトをロアブックテンプレートに合わせて整理しています。\nしばらくお待ちください。")
    end
    return '<div class="tm-loading-backdrop trs-compat" aria-live="polite">'
        .. '<div class="tm-loading-modal">'
        .. '<span class="tm-spinner"></span>'
        .. '<b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(title) .. '</b>'
        .. '<span class="tm-loading-body">' .. tmEscapeHtml(body) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-loading-count">' .. tmLoadingUnlockHtml(triggerId, 0) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-loading-tip">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmLoadingTipText(triggerId)) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-loading-unlock tm-timeout-now">' .. tmFnButton(tmUiText(triggerId, "unlock"), "tmForceUnlock") .. '</span>'
        .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmGenerateControlPanel(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "false") ~= "true" then
        local changed = tmSetControlPanelHtml(triggerId, "")
        return "", changed
    end
    tmPrepareDrawerDomKey(triggerId)
    tmEnsurePartySheets(triggerId)
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal")
    local sessionStarted = getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true"
    local scenarioRailTitle = sessionStarted and tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_sheet") or tmUiText(triggerId, "scenario_picker")
    -- FB-2: icon-only rail buttons; wrapper span title= survives DOMPurify and
    -- gives a hover tooltip on desktop.
    local modeButton = (mode == "normal")
        and '<span class="tm-side-btn tm-side-mode" title="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "return_session")) .. '">' .. tmButton("🎲", "tmReturnToSessionFlow") .. '</span>'
        or '<span class="tm-side-btn tm-side-mode" title="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "daily")) .. '">' .. tmButton("☕", "startNormalScene") .. '</span>'
    local dailyInfoButton = tmDrawerRailOpenerHtml(triggerId, "player-info", "👥", tmUiText(triggerId, "player_info"), "")
    local dailyWardrobeButton = tmDrawerRailOpenerHtml(triggerId, "wardrobe", "👗", tmUiText(triggerId, "wardrobe"), "")
    local saveSeedButton = '<span class="tm-side-btn" title="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "session_save")) .. '">' .. tmButton("💾", "tmAskSessionSaveSeed") .. '</span>'
    local characterInfoButton = tmDrawerRailOpenerHtml(triggerId, "character-sheet", "🎭", tmUiText(triggerId, "character_sheet"), "")
    local customClassButton = '<span class="tm-side-btn" title="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmUiText(triggerId, "add_class")) .. '">' .. tmButton("🧩", "tmStartCustomClassInput") .. '</span>'
    local trpgInfoButtons = tmDrawerRailOpenerHtml(triggerId, "manual", "❔", tmUiText(triggerId, "manual"), "")
        .. tmDrawerRailOpenerHtml(triggerId, tmScenarioDrawerId(triggerId), "🗺️", scenarioRailTitle, "")
        .. tmDrawerRailOpenerHtml(triggerId, "session-log", "⏱️", tmUiText(triggerId, "session_log"), "")
        .. saveSeedButton
        .. customClassButton
        .. characterInfoButton
    local settingsRailButton = tmSettingsDrawerOpenerHtml(triggerId)
    local sideUi = '<div class="tm-side-ui trs-compat" data-mode="' .. tmEscapeHtml(mode) .. '">'
        .. '<div class="tm-side-rail">'
        .. modeButton
        .. settingsRailButton
        .. (mode == "normal" and (dailyInfoButton .. dailyWardrobeButton .. saveSeedButton) or trpgInfoButtons)
        .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
    local overlayUi = '<div class="tm-overlay-root trs-compat">'
        .. TM_POPUP_REGION_START
        .. tmRenderInAppPopup(triggerId)
        .. TM_POPUP_REGION_END
        .. TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_START
        .. tmRenderCharacterSheetRegion(triggerId)
        .. TM_CHARSHEET_REGION_END
        .. tmRenderScenarioPicker(triggerId)
        .. tmRenderScenarioSheetModal(triggerId)
        .. tmRenderPlayerInfoModal(triggerId)
        .. tmRenderWardrobeModal(triggerId)
        .. tmRenderSessionLogModal(triggerId)
        .. tmRenderLoadingOverlay(triggerId)
        .. '</div>'
    local panelEngineHtml = ""
    if mode ~= "normal" then
        panelEngineHtml = tmPanelEngineCardHtml(triggerId)
    end
    local html = '<div class="tm-control-root trs-compat" data-mode="' .. tmEscapeHtml(mode) .. '">'
        .. panelEngineHtml
        .. tmRenderHomePanel(triggerId)
        .. overlayUi
        .. sideUi
        .. '</div>'
    local changed = tmSetControlPanelHtml(triggerId, html)
    return html, changed
end

function tmStripControlPanelMarkersOnly(msg)
    local clean = tostring(msg or "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\r\n", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?" .. TM_CONTROL_MARKER, "")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n?" .. TM_CONTROL_MARKER_LEGACY, "")
    clean = clean:gsub("[ \t]+\n", "\n")
    clean = clean:gsub("\n+$", "")
    return clean
end

function tmFirstMessageRendersControlPanelDirectly(triggerId, chatHistory, lastCharIndex, rawMsg)
    if type(chatHistory) ~= "table" then return false end
    if tonumber(lastCharIndex) ~= 1 or #chatHistory ~= 1 then return false end
    local raw = tostring(rawMsg or "")
    if not raw:find("{{getvar::tm_control_panel_html}}", 1, true)
        and not raw:find("◆TM_START◆", 1, true) then
        return false
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then return true end
    return getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false") == "true"
end

function tmEnsureControlPanelMarker(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "false") ~= "true" then return false end
    local html = tmGetControlPanelHtml(triggerId)
    if html == "" then return false end
    if getFullChat == nil or setChat == nil then return false end
    local chatHistory = getFullChat(triggerId)
    if not chatHistory then return false end
    local lastCharIndex = nil
    for i = #chatHistory, 1, -1 do
        if chatHistory[i].role == "char" then
            lastCharIndex = i
            break
        end
    end
    if not lastCharIndex then return false end
    local rawMsg = chatHistory[lastCharIndex].data or ""
    if tmFirstMessageRendersControlPanelDirectly(triggerId, chatHistory, lastCharIndex, rawMsg) then
        local cleanFirstMsg = tmStripControlPanelMarkersOnly(rawMsg)
        if cleanFirstMsg ~= rawMsg then
            setChat(triggerId, lastCharIndex - 1, cleanFirstMsg)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local keepFirstSessionReady = getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false") == "true"
        and rawMsg:find(TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER, 1, true) ~= nil
    local clean = tmStripControlMarkers(rawMsg)
    if keepFirstSessionReady and not clean:find(TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER, 1, true) then
        clean = clean .. "\n" .. TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER
    end
    local nextMsg = clean .. "\n" .. TM_CONTROL_MARKER
    if nextMsg ~= (chatHistory[lastCharIndex].data or "") then
        setChat(triggerId, lastCharIndex - 1, nextMsg)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

function tmAfterStateChange(triggerId, options)
    options = options or {}
    if TM_GUARDED_DEPTH and TM_GUARDED_DEPTH > 0 then
        TM_STATE_CHANGE_PENDING = true
        if options.fastPopup then tmQueueFastPopupRefresh(triggerId, options.fastPopup) end
        if options.fastSheet then tmQueueFastSheetRefresh(triggerId, options.fastSheet) end
        return
    end
    TM_STATE_CHANGE_PENDING = false
    local refreshOptions = {}
    if options.fastPopup then refreshOptions.fastPopup = options.fastPopup end
    if options.fastSheet then refreshOptions.fastSheet = options.fastSheet end
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, refreshOptions)
end

local tmRollPartySheetsState = tmRollPartySheets
local tmConfirmPartySheetsState = tmConfirmPartySheets
