    setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", "")
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId, {fastSheet = "close"})
end)

_G["tmStartCustomClassInput"] = async(function(triggerId)
    pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId)
    if _actionLocked then
        print("[TRPG] class creator input: _actionLocked, skipping")
        return
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_seed", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_input_error", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_generating", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_player_info_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_wardrobe_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_session_log_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_sheet_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_select_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false")
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "class_creator:popup_open")
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {fullReload = true, await = true})

    if type(alertInput) ~= "function" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "RisuAI 입력 팝업 API를 사용할 수 없습니다.", "RisuAI input popup API is unavailable.", "RisuAI入力ポップアップAPIを使用できません。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end

    local input = alertInput(triggerId,
        T(triggerId,
            "새 직업 컨셉을 한두 줄로 입력하세요.\n\n예: 동방에서 온 사무라이 검사",
            "Enter the new class concept in one or two lines.\n\nExample: a samurai swordsman from the East",
            "新しいクラスコンセプトを一、二行で入力してください。\n\n例: 東方から来た侍剣士")
    ):await()
    local seed = ""
    if type(input) == "string" then seed = tmTrimText(input) end

    if seed == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_seed", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_input_error", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "class_creator:popup_cancelled")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end

    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_seed", seed)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_input_error", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_generating", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "class_creator:generating")
    _actionLocked = true
    tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, true)
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId)

    local callOk, generatedOk, message = pcall(tmGenerateCustomClassTraitFromSeed, triggerId, seed)
    if not callOk then
        message = tostring(generatedOk)
        generatedOk = false
    end

    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_generating", "false")
    _actionLocked = false
    tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, false)

    if generatedOk then
        tmShowCustomClassResultPopup(triggerId, message)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "class_creator:generated:" .. getVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_last_id", ""))
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_input_error", tostring(message or ""))
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "class_creator:failed")
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "직업 생성 실패: ", "Class generation failed: ", "クラス生成失敗: ") .. tostring(message or ""))
    end
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId)
end)

_G["openCustomClassPanel"] = _G["tmStartCustomClassInput"]

_G["tmCancelCustomClassInput"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_seed", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_input_error", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_generating", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "class_creator:cancelled")
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

-- FB-9: manual page flip. async (not guarded) like setLang_* — a non-destructive
-- page var change must not flash the loading overlay on every click.
local function tmManualFlip(delta)
    return async(function(triggerId)
        pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId)
        local total = #TM_MANUAL_PAGES
        local page = clamp(getNumVar(triggerId, "tm_manual_page", 1), 1, total)
        page = ((page - 1 + delta) % total) + 1
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_manual_page", tostring(page))
        tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen(triggerId, "manual")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
    end)
end
_G["tmManualPrev"] = tmManualFlip(-1)
_G["tmManualNext"] = tmManualFlip(1)

local function tmManualJump(page)
    return async(function(triggerId)
        pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId)
        local total = #TM_MANUAL_PAGES
        local target = clamp(tonumber(page) or 1, 1, total)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_manual_page", tostring(target))
        tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen(triggerId, "manual")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
    end)
end

for i = 1, #TM_MANUAL_PAGES do
    _G["tmManualPage" .. tostring(i)] = tmManualJump(i)
end

_G["tmShowSessionSaveSeed"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    local saveCode = tmCreateVisibleSaveCode(triggerId)
    if saveCode == "" then
        tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_EXPORT_DISPLAY_TEXT_KEY, "")
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "아직 출력할 세션 저장 코드가 없습니다.",
            "There is no session save code to show yet.",
            "表示できるセッション保存コードがまだありません。"))
    else
        local exportText = "__tm_save_export_code = " .. saveCode
        tmStateSet(triggerId, TM_SAVE_EXPORT_DISPLAY_TEXT_KEY, exportText)
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "아래 전체 값을 복사해서 세션 불러오기에 붙여넣으세요. 새 게임에서도 이 코드 자체로 복원됩니다.",
            "Copy the full value below and paste it into Load Session. This code contains the saved state for a new game.",
            "以下の値をすべてコピーしてセッション読込に貼り付けてください。このコード自体に保存状態が含まれています。") .. "\n\n" .. exportText)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_kind", "save-code")
    end
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end, {saveCodeLoading = true})

_G["tmOpenSessionSeedLoadPopup"] = async(function(triggerId)
    if type(alertInput) ~= "function" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "RisuAI 입력 팝업 API를 사용할 수 없습니다.",
            "RisuAI input popup API is unavailable.",
            "RisuAI入力ポップアップAPIを使用できません。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    local input = alertInput(triggerId,
        T(triggerId,
            "__tm_save_export_code 값을 붙여넣으세요.\n로드한 후에 진행 버튼을 누르세요.\n\n예: __tm_save_export_code = tm1_...",
            "Paste the __tm_save_export_code value.\nAfter loading, press the Proceed button.\n\nExample: __tm_save_export_code = tm1_...",
            "__tm_save_export_code の値を貼り付けてください。\n読み込んだ後、進行ボタンを押してください。\n\n例: __tm_save_export_code = tm1_...")
    ):await()
    local seed = ""
    if type(input) == "string" then seed = tmNormalizeSaveSeedInput(input) end
    if seed == "" then
        return
    end

    local parsed, ok = pcall(tmParseAndApplySaveSeed, triggerId, seed, {skipControlPanelBuild = true})
    if not parsed then
        print("[TRPG ERROR] session load failed: " .. tostring(ok))
        ok = false
    end
    if ok then
        tmNormalizeLoadedSessionDisplay(triggerId)
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "세션 저장 코드를 불러왔습니다.",
            "Session save code loaded.",
            "セッション保存コードを読み込みました。"))
    else
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "해당 저장 데이터를 불러올 수 없습니다. 새 게임 복구에는 __tm_save_export_code = tm1_... 전체 값을 붙여넣어야 합니다.",
            "Could not load saved data. For a new game, paste the full __tm_save_export_code = tm1_... value.",
            "保存データを読み込めません。新規ゲームで復元するには __tm_save_export_code = tm1_... の値全体を貼り付けてください。"))
    end
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmConfirmCreateCharacters"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)

    tmRollPartySheetsState(triggerId)

    setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false")

        setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "false")

    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmStartFirstSessionFromPrep"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_home_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    if not tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId) then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_select_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", tmGetActiveOwner(triggerId))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "start_blocked:missing_character_sheets")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    local ok, err = tmEnsureScenarioSelectedForStart(triggerId)
    if not ok then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_select_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_sheet_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "scenario_picker")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "start_blocked:missing_scenario")
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "시나리오가 아직 선택되지않았습니다.\n시나리오를 골라주세요.", "No scenario has been selected yet.\nPlease choose a scenario.", "シナリオがまだ選択されていません。\nシナリオを選んでください。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    tmStartSessionCore(triggerId)
end, {firstSessionLoading = true})

_G["tmStartNewSessionFlow"] = _G["tmStartFirstSessionFromPrep"]
_G["startNewSession"] = _G["tmStartNewSessionFlow"]

function tmSelectEpisodeById(triggerId, episodeId)
    episodeId = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(episodeId)
    local content = ""
    if type(tmFetchEpisodeContent) == "function" then content = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId) end
    local title = tmScenarioTitle(triggerId, episodeId)
    local summary = tmEpisodeDisplaySummaryFromContent(triggerId, content)
    if summary == "" then summary = tmFallbackEpisodeEntry().summary end
    local guide = tmEpisodeGuideFromContent(triggerId, content)
    setVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "session_prep")
    setVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode", episodeId)
    tmResetTerminalEnemyAutoclear(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "selected")
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "selected")
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_node", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", "none")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "selected:" .. episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_explicit_selection", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_none_after_end", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", summary)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_decision_guide", guide)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary_src", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_decision_guide_src", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_src", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_opening_text", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_saved_recent_chat_tail", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_hint", "")
    tmClearScenarioWrapupState(triggerId)
    tmPaceResetState(triggerId, "episode_selected")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_select_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_sheet_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "'", "'", "「") .. title .. T(triggerId, "'을 선택했습니다.", "' selected.", "」を選択しました。"))
end

_G["tmStartFreeScenarioInput"] = async(function(triggerId)
    pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId)
    if _actionLocked then
        print("[TRPG] tmStartFreeScenarioInput: _actionLocked, skipping")
        return
    end

    setVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "session_prep")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_select_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_sheet_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_seed", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", "")
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "runtime_scenario:free_popup_open")
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {fullReload = true, await = true})

    if type(alertInput) ~= "function" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "RisuAI 입력 팝업 API를 사용할 수 없습니다.", "RisuAI input popup API is unavailable.", "RisuAI入力ポップアップAPIを使用できません。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end

    local input = alertInput(triggerId,
        T(triggerId,
            "자유 시나리오 내용을 한두 줄로 입력하세요.\n\n예: 1레벨 초보자용. 숲속 축제에서 사라진 마차를 추적하는 짧은 판타지 모험.",
            "Enter the free scenario in one or two lines.\n\nExample: A short level-1 beginner fantasy adventure tracking a vanished wagon at a forest festival.",
            "自由シナリオの内容を一、二行で入力してください。\n\n例: 初心者向けレベル1。森の祭りで消えた馬車を追う短いファンタジー冒険。")
    ):await()
    local seed = ""
    if type(input) == "string" then
        seed = tmTrimText(input)
    end

    if seed == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_seed", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "runtime_scenario:free_popup_cancelled")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end

    _actionLocked = true
    tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, true)
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId)
    local ok, err = pcall(tmGenerateFreeScenarioFromSeed, triggerId, seed)
    if not ok then
        print("[TRPG ERROR] free scenario generation: " .. tostring(err))
        pcall(tmError, triggerId, T(triggerId, "자유 시나리오 생성 실패: ", "Free scenario generation failed: ", "自由シナリオ生成失敗: ") .. tostring(err))
    end
    _actionLocked = false
    tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, false)
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmCancelFreeScenarioInput"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_seed", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_scenario_input_error", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "runtime_scenario:free_cancelled")
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmGenerateRandomScenario"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "game_initialized", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "session_prep")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "runtime_scenario:random_generating")
    local ok, err = tmGenerateRuntimeScenario(triggerId, "random", "")
    if ok then
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "랜덤 시나리오를 생성하고 선택했습니다.", "Random scenario generated and selected.", "ランダムシナリオを生成して選択しました。"))
    else
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "랜덤 시나리오 생성 실패: ", "Random scenario generation failed: ", "ランダムシナリオ生成失敗: ") .. tostring(err))
    end
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end, {preRefresh = true})

for episodeSlot = 1, TM_EPISODE_PICKER_SLOTS do
    local slot = episodeSlot
    _G["tmSelectEpisodeChoice" .. tostring(slot)] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        local episodeId = getVar(triggerId, "tm_episode_choice_" .. tostring(slot), "")
        if episodeId == "" then
            local episodes = tmFetchEpisodeList(triggerId)
            local page = tmEpisodePickerPage(triggerId, episodes)
            local index = ((page or 1) - 1) * TM_EPISODE_PICKER_PAGE_SIZE + slot
            if episodes[index] then episodeId = episodes[index].id or "" end
        end
        if episodeId == "" then
            tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "선택할 에피소드를 찾지 못했습니다.", "Could not find an episode to select.", "選択するエピソードが見つかりませんでした。"))
            tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
            return
        end
        tmSelectEpisodeById(triggerId, episodeId)
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
    end)
end

    tmSelectEpisodeById(triggerId, TM_DEFAULT_EPISODE_ID)
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

function tmOpenClassSelectForOwner(triggerId, ownerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
    if not tmCanEditSheets(triggerId) then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "시나리오 진행 중에는 시트를 바꿀 수 없습니다.", "Sheets cannot be changed while a scenario is in progress.", "シナリオ進行中はシートを変更できません。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    if not tmHasCharacterSheets(triggerId) then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "true")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then ownerId = tmGetActiveOwner(triggerId) end
    setVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_mode", "class_select")
    setVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_owner", ownerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", ownerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "class_reroll_confirm", "false")
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end

_G["tmConfirmRerollActiveSheet"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
    if not tmCanEditSheets(triggerId) then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "시나리오 진행 중에는 시트를 바꿀 수 없습니다.", "Sheets cannot be changed while a scenario is in progress.", "シナリオ進行中はシートを変更できません。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    if not tmHasCharacterSheets(triggerId) then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "true")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    local ownerId = tmSheetEditOwner(triggerId)
    local sheetSnapshot = tmSnapshotSheet(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:reroll_one_requested:" .. ownerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false")
    tmRollSheetStatsForced(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId)
    local ok, err = tmGenerateOneSheetWithLLM(triggerId, ownerId)
    if ok then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:reroll_one:" .. ownerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_notice", (CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId) .. " 시트를 다시 작성했습니다.")
    else
        tmRestoreSheet(triggerId, ownerId, sheetSnapshot)
        setVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_mode", "reroll_one")
        setVar(triggerId, "sheet_edit_owner", ownerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "party_sheet_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "class_selection_done", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:reroll_one_failed:" .. ownerId)
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "시트 재작성 실패: ", "Sheet rewrite failed: ", "シート再作成失敗: ") .. tostring(err))
    end
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

    end
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

TM_CLASS_SELECTION_SLOT_CAP = 24

function tmClassSelectionSlotKey(index)
    return string.format("tm_class_select_slot_%02d", tonumber(index) or 0)
end

function tmClassSelectionSlotFn(index)
    return string.format("tmSetClassSlot_%02d", tonumber(index) or 0)
end

function tmSetClassSelectionSlots(triggerId, classIds)
    for index = 1, TM_CLASS_SELECTION_SLOT_CAP do
        local classId = classIds and classIds[index] or ""
        setVar(triggerId, tmClassSelectionSlotKey(index), tmNormalizeClassId(classId))
    end
end

function tmApplyClassSelection(triggerId, selectedClassId)
    selectedClassId = tmNormalizeClassId(selectedClassId)
    setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
    if selectedClassId == "" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "직업 변경 실패: ", "Class change failed: ", "クラス変更失敗: ") .. "empty slot")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    if not tmCanEditSheets(triggerId) then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "시나리오 진행 중에는 시트를 바꿀 수 없습니다.", "Sheets cannot be changed while a scenario is in progress.", "シナリオ進行中はシートを変更できません。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    if not tmHasCharacterSheets(triggerId) then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_confirm", "true")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    local ownerId = tmSheetEditOwner(triggerId)
    if tmApplyClassOnlyChange(triggerId, ownerId, selectedClassId) then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", ownerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "active_owner_id", ownerId)
        tmNotice(triggerId, (CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId) .. T(triggerId, " 직업을 ", " class changed to ", " のクラスを") .. tmClassNameForLang(triggerId, selectedClassId) .. T(triggerId, "(으)로 바꿨습니다.", ".", "に変更しました。"))
    else
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId, "직업 변경 실패: ", "Class change failed: ", "クラス変更失敗: ") .. tostring(selectedClassId))
    end
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end

for index = 1, TM_CLASS_SELECTION_SLOT_CAP do
    local slotIndex = index
    _G[tmClassSelectionSlotFn(slotIndex)] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        local selectedClassId = getVar(triggerId, tmClassSelectionSlotKey(slotIndex), "")
        tmApplyClassSelection(triggerId, selectedClassId)
    end)
end

_G["tmRollActiveSheet"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    tmEnsurePartySheets(triggerId)
    local ownerId = tmGetActiveOwner(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_sheet_rolled", "false") ~= "true" then
        tmRollSheetStats(triggerId, ownerId)
    end
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_class", "rogue")
    local stat = tmPrimaryStatFor(triggerId, classId)
    local result = resolveAction(triggerId, ownerId, stat, 13)
    local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, ownerId, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, T(triggerId, "캐릭터 시트 기본 판정", "Character sheet base check", "キャラクターシート基本判定"), result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
    tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "panel_roll:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. stat)
    local successThreshold = clamp((result.dc or 13) - (result.mod or 0) - (result.penalty or 0), 1, 20)
    tmNotice(triggerId, string.format(T(triggerId, "%s의 %s 판정: d20 %d, 성공 기준 %d", "%s %s check: d20 %d, success threshold %d", "%sの%s判定: d20 %d、成功基準 %d"), CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId, tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, stat), result.raw, successThreshold))
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

for _, ownerIdForGrowth in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
    _G["tmLevelUp_" .. ownerIdForGrowth] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        if tmLevelUpOwner(triggerId, ownerIdForGrowth) then
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", ownerIdForGrowth)
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_player_info_open", "false")
            tmNotice(triggerId, tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerIdForGrowth) .. T(triggerId, " 레벨업을 반영했습니다.", " level-up applied.", " のレベルアップを反映しました。"))
        end
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId, {fastSheet = "levelup"})
    end)
    _G["tmSpendAp_" .. ownerIdForGrowth] = tmLocalSheetButtonGuard(function(triggerId)
        local stat = tmRecommendedGrowthStat(triggerId, ownerIdForGrowth)
        if tmSpendApOnStat(triggerId, ownerIdForGrowth, stat, "추천 성장") then
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", ownerIdForGrowth)
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_player_info_open", "false")
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "refresh"
    end)
    for _, statKeyForGrowth in ipairs(TM_PLAYER_STAT_KEYS) do
        local ownerId = ownerIdForGrowth
        local statKey = statKeyForGrowth
        _G["tmSpendAp_" .. ownerId .. "_" .. statKey] = tmLocalSheetButtonGuard(function(triggerId)
            if tmSpendApOnStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey, "직접 성장") then
                setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", ownerId)
                setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
                setVar(triggerId, "ui_player_info_open", "false")
                return "local_success"
            end
            return "refresh"
        end)
    end
end

function tmStartSessionCore(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true" then
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "이미 첫 시나리오가 시작되었습니다.", "The first scenario has already started.", "最初のシナリオはすでに開始しています。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    if not tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId) then
        setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_started", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "character_setup")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "아직 캐릭터 시트가 확정되지 않았습니다.", "Character sheets have not been confirmed yet.", "キャラクターシートはまだ確定していません。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    local selectedEpisodeId = tmResolveSelectedEpisodeForStart(triggerId)
    if selectedEpisodeId == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_select_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_scenario_sheet_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "scenario_picker")
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "start_blocked:missing_scenario")
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "시나리오가 아직 선택되지않았습니다.\n시나리오를 골라주세요.", "No scenario has been selected yet.\nPlease choose a scenario.", "シナリオがまだ選択されていません。\nシナリオを選んでください。"))
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", selectedEpisodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", selectedEpisodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode", selectedEpisodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_explicit_selection", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_none_after_end", "false")
    local episodeContent = ""
    if type(tmFetchEpisodeContent) == "function" then episodeContent = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, selectedEpisodeId) end
    local episodeTitle = tmScenarioTitle(triggerId, selectedEpisodeId)
    local episodeSummary = tmEpisodeDisplaySummaryFromContent(triggerId, episodeContent)
    if episodeSummary == "" then episodeSummary = tmFallbackEpisodeEntry().summary end
    local episodeGuide = tmEpisodeGuideFromContent(triggerId, episodeContent)
    local episodeOpening = tmEpisodeDisplayOpeningFromContent(triggerId, episodeContent)
    if episodeOpening == "" then episodeOpening = episodeSummary end
    local episodeRollHint = tmFirstEpisodeLine(tmEpisodeSection(episodeContent, "ROLL_HINTS"))
    if episodeRollHint == "" then episodeRollHint = TM_FIRST_SCENE_ROLL_HINT end
    local opening = tmGenerateOpeningSceneText(triggerId)
    opening = '<img="pt_first_session_cosplay_changing">\n\n' .. tostring(opening or "")
    tmApplyFirstSessionCosplayState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "playing")
    setVar(triggerId, "session_started", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary", episodeOpening)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_decision_guide", episodeGuide)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_hint", episodeRollHint)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_scene_summary_src", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_decision_guide_src", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_src", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_candidate_history", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_warning", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_duplicate_reason", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_last_source", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_retry_used", "false")
    tmClearScenarioWrapupState(triggerId)
    tmPaceResetState(triggerId, "first_session_start")
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_intent", "")
    end
    opening = tmApplyIntentMarkers(triggerId, opening, "first_session_opening")
    opening = tmStripInternalGuideBlocks(opening)
    opening = opening:gsub("¢È.-¢È", "")
    opening = opening:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
    opening = opening:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_opening_text", tmTailText(tmSanitizeChatSnippet(opening), 2600))
    local openingForChat = tmAppendIllustrationWaitMarker(triggerId, opening)
    if not tmAddNarrativeChat(triggerId, openingForChat) then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "game_phase", "session_prep")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_lead_src", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_opening_text", "")
        tmPaceResetState(triggerId, "first_session_start_failed")
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
        return
    end
    tmAdvanceSessionCount(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", selectedEpisodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "active")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode", selectedEpisodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "intro")
    tmResetTerminalEnemyAutoclear(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_node", "opening_request")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "episode:start:" .. selectedEpisodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "start:" .. selectedEpisodeId)
    tmSetSessionLogSummary(triggerId, "첫 판타지 세션이 시작됐다. 네 플레이어는 코스프레 상태로 '" .. episodeTitle .. "'의 첫 판정을 기다리고 있다.")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "세션 시작: " .. episodeTitle)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장면: " .. episodeOpening)
    tmPrepareTurnDicePool(triggerId)
    local leadOk, leadErr = tmGenerateSessionPanel(triggerId, {bootstrap = true})
    if not leadOk then
        print("[TRPGMaster] first-session guide lead generation failed: " .. tostring(leadErr))
    end
    tmClearIllustrationWaitMarkerFromLastChar(triggerId, {force = true})
    tmAppendToLastCharChat(triggerId, TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER)
    setVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_post_action_locked_display", "true")
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end

TM_SHEET_TAB_SWITCH_LOCK = false

function tmSwitchCharacterSheetTab(triggerId, ownerId)
    if TM_SHEET_TAB_SWITCH_LOCK then
        print("[TRPG] charSheetTab: tab switch already refreshing, skipping")
        return
    end
    TM_SHEET_TAB_SWITCH_LOCK = true
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId, {skipControlPanelBuild = true, skipUnchangedSeed = true})
        if _actionLocked then
            print("[TRPG] charSheetTab: _actionLocked, skipping")
            return
        end
        if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return end
        if getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false") == "true"
            and getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", "") == ownerId
            and getVar(triggerId, "active_owner_id", "") == ownerId then
            return
        end
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", ownerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "active_owner_id", ownerId)
        tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen(triggerId, "character-sheet")
        tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {reloadLastChar = true, fastSheet = "tab"})
    end)
    TM_SHEET_TAB_SWITCH_LOCK = false
    if not ok then error(err) end
end

for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
    local ownerId = id
    _G["tmSelect_" .. ownerId] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "active_owner_id", ownerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", "sheet:active:" .. ownerId)
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
    end)
    _G["charSheetTab_" .. ownerId] = async(function(triggerId)
        local ok, err = pcall(tmSwitchCharacterSheetTab, triggerId, ownerId)
        if not ok then
            print("[TRPG ERROR] " .. tostring(err))
            pcall(tmError, triggerId, "처리 중 오류: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
end

function forEachHeroine(triggerId, fn)
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do fn(triggerId, id) end
end

function getHeroine(triggerId, id)
    return {
        id        = id,
        name_ko   = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_name_ko", CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or id),
        affection = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_affection", 100),
        trust     = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_trust", 50),
        status    = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active"),
    }
end

function saveHeroine(triggerId, h)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. h.id .. "_affection", h.affection)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. h.id .. "_trust", h.trust)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. h.id .. "_status", h.status)
end

function modifyAffection(triggerId, id, delta)
    local cur = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_affection", 100)
    local new = clamp(cur + delta, 0, 500)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_affection", new)
    return new
end

function modifyTrust(triggerId, id, delta)
    local cur = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_trust", 50)
    local new = clamp(cur + delta, 0, 100)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_trust", new)
    return new
end

function getAffinityLevel(triggerId, id, lang)
    lang = lang or getVar(triggerId, "lang", "ko")
    local val = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_affection", 100)
    if val <= 25  then return lang == "ko" and "냉랭함" or "Cold"
    elseif val <= 75 then return lang == "ko" and "어색함" or "Awkward"
    elseif val <= 125 then return lang == "ko" and "알아가는 중" or "Getting Acquainted"
    elseif val <= 175 then return lang == "ko" and "아는 사이" or "Acquaintance"
    elseif val <= 225 then return lang == "ko" and "편한 대화" or "Comfortable"
    elseif val <= 275 then return lang == "ko" and "친근함" or "Familiar"
    elseif val <= 325 then return lang == "ko" and "호감" or "Friendly"
    elseif val <= 375 then return lang == "ko" and "가까운 사이" or "Close"
    elseif val <= 450 then return lang == "ko" and "깊은 신뢰" or "Deep Bond"
    else return lang == "ko" and "특별한 인연" or "Special Bond" end
end

function getSystemTier(affValue)
    if affValue <= 25 then return "Cold"
    elseif affValue <= 75 then return "Awkward"
    elseif affValue <= 125 then return "Getting Acquainted"
    elseif affValue <= 175 then return "Acquaintance"
    elseif affValue <= 225 then return "Comfortable"
    elseif affValue <= 275 then return "Casual"
    elseif affValue <= 325 then return "Warm"
    elseif affValue <= 375 then return "Trusting"
    elseif affValue <= 450 then return "Devoted"
    else return "Special Bond" end
end

function getAffinityTier(triggerId, id)
    local val = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_affection", 100)
    if val <= 50 then return 1
    elseif val <= 100 then return 2
    elseif val <= 150 then return 3
    elseif val <= 200 then return 4
    elseif val <= 250 then return 5
    elseif val <= 300 then return 6
    elseif val <= 350 then return 7
    elseif val <= 400 then return 8
    elseif val <= 450 then return 9
    else return 10 end
end

function tmAffinityPercent(triggerId, id)
    local val = clamp(getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_affection", 100), 0, 500)
    return math.floor((val / 500) * 100)
end

-- 004 §14.1 D002 weighted emotion keywords
EMOTION_WEIGHTS_POSITIVE = {
    ["기뻐"]=2, ["웃"]=1, ["행복"]=3, ["설레"]=3, ["고마"]=2, ["좋아"]=2,
    ["사랑"]=3, ["안아"]=2, ["다정"]=2, ["따뜻"]=2, ["미소"]=1, ["반가"]=2,
    ["감사"]=2, ["포근"]=2, ["신뢰"]=2,
}
EMOTION_WEIGHTS_NEGATIVE = {
    ["화나"]=2, ["짜증"]=2, ["싫"]=2, ["무서"]=1, ["실망"]=3, ["배신"]=3,
    ["역겨"]=3, ["귀찮"]=1, ["차가"]=2, ["냉소"]=2, ["비꼼"]=2, ["한숨"]=1,
    ["외면"]=1, ["눈살"]=1, ["질색"]=2,
}
CHAR_EMOTION_BIAS = {
    sinsoyul  = {pos=1.0, neg=1.0},
    junghanna  = {pos=1.0, neg=1.0},  -- 허당 bonus applied separately
    kimminhee = {pos=1.0, neg=0.5},  -- tsundere
    yuseola   = {pos=1.3, neg=1.0},  -- whisper
}

-- parseAddressee: 004 §2.2 spec. Returns nil | charId | "all"
function parseAddressee(input)
    if not input or input == "" then return nil end
    local lower = input:lower()
    if input:find("모두") or input:find("다들") or input:find("여러분") then return "all" end
    local key_map = {
        sinsoyul  = {"신소율","소율아","소율이가","소율을","소율에게","소율이","소율은","소율의","소율과","소율","sinsoyul","shin soyul"},
        junghanna = {"정한나","한나야","한나가","한나를","한나에게","한나는","한나의","한나와","한나","junghanna","jung hanna"},
        kimminhee = {"김민희","민희야","민희가","민희를","민희에게","민희는","민희의","민희와","민희","kimminhee","kim minhee"},
        yuseola   = {"유설아","설아야","설아가","설아를","설아에게","설아는","설아의","설아와","설아","yuseola","yu seola"},
    }
    local matches = {}
    for id, keys in pairs(key_map) do
        for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
            if input:find(k, 1, true) or lower:find(k:lower(), 1, true) then
                matches[id] = true
                break
            end
        end
    end
    local ids = {}
    for id,_ in pairs(matches) do table.insert(ids, id) end
    if #ids == 0 then return nil end
    if #ids >= 2 then return "all" end
    return ids[1]
end

function computeActiveHeroines(triggerId, addressee)
    if addressee == nil or addressee == "" or addressee == "all" then
        return table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ",")
    end
    return addressee
end

function heuristicEmotionDelta(triggerId, charId, llmResponse)
    if not llmResponse or llmResponse == "" then return 0 end
    local pos, neg = 0, 0
    for kw, w in pairs(EMOTION_WEIGHTS_POSITIVE) do
        if llmResponse:find(kw, 1, true) then pos = pos + w end
    end
    for kw, w in pairs(EMOTION_WEIGHTS_NEGATIVE) do
        if llmResponse:find(kw, 1, true) then neg = neg + w end
    end
    local bias = CHAR_EMOTION_BIAS[charId] or {pos=1.0, neg=1.0}
    local delta = math.floor((pos * bias.pos) - (neg * bias.neg))
    if charId == "junghanna" and llmResponse:find("허당", 1, true) then delta = delta + 1 end
    return clamp(delta, -10, 10)
end

function heuristicTRPGAffectionDelta(triggerId, charId, output)
    local text = tostring(output or "") .. " " .. getVar(triggerId, "last_roll_meta", "")
    if text == "" then return 0 end
    local realName = CHAR_NAMES_KO[charId] or charId
    local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, charId)
    if not text:find(realName, 1, true) and (pcName == "" or not text:find(pcName, 1, true)) then
        return 0
    end
    local pos = countKeywords(text, {"스포트라이트", "활약", "구해", "구출", "공정", "재밌", "웃", "칭찬", "성공", "대성공", "도와", "멋지"})
    local neg = countKeywords(text, {"무시", "소외", "불공정", "억지", "불만", "짜증", "대실패", "당황"})
    if pos == 0 and neg == 0 then return 0 end
    return clamp(pos - neg, -2, 2)
end

-- LLM emits ▥AFF:charId:+N▥ / ▥AFF:charId:-N▥. Strip + apply.
function stripAndApplyAffinityMarkers(triggerId, output)
    local applied = false
    output = output:gsub("▥AFF:([%w_]+):([+-]?%d+)▥", function(id, n)
        local delta = tonumber(n) or 0
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] then
            modifyAffection(triggerId, id, delta)
            applied = true
        end
        return ""
    end)
    output = output:gsub("<<AFF:([%w_]+):([+-]?%d+)>>", function(id, n)
        local delta = tonumber(n) or 0
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] then
            modifyAffection(triggerId, id, delta)
            applied = true
        end
        return ""
    end)
    return output, applied
end

TIER_DAMAGE_MULT = {
    crit_success = 1.5,
    success      = 1.0,
    partial      = 0.5,
    fail         = 0.0,
    crit_fail    = 0.0,

-- === D045 effect contract: grade -> dice mapping ===
-- Effect grade (C/B/A/S) maps to a {count, sides} dice spec. Used by the
-- structured effect parser so an LLM only declares a grade, never raw dice.
TM_EFFECT_GRADE_DICE = {
    C = {1, 4},
    B = {1, 6},
    A = {1, 8},
    S = {1, 12},
}

-- tmEffectGradeDice: grade -> count, sides, expr. Unknown/nil -> C (1d4).
function tmEffectGradeDice(grade)
    local spec = TM_EFFECT_GRADE_DICE[tostring(grade or "")] or TM_EFFECT_GRADE_DICE.C
    local count, sides = spec[1], spec[2]
    return count, sides, count .. "d" .. sides
end

-- tmRollDice: sum count rolls of math.random(sides). count/sides clamped >= 1.
function tmRollDice(count, sides)
    count = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(count) or 1))
    sides = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(sides) or 1))
    local total = 0
    for _ = 1, count do total = total + math.random(sides) end
    return total
end

-- Whitelists for the structured effect contract (D045).
TM_EFFECT_CATEGORIES = {
    damage = true, condition = true, damage_condition = true,
    damage_reduction = true, condition_resist = true, condition_immunity = true,
    heal = true, mp_restore = true, mp_reduce = true,
    buff_stat = true, debuff_stat = true, utility = true,
}
TM_EFFECT_GRADES = { C = true, B = true, A = true, S = true }
TM_EFFECT_TRIGGERS = {
    passive = true, on_hit = true, on_success = true, on_crit = true,
    on_fail = true, on_damage_taken = true, on_use = true, on_tick = true,
    on_enter = true, on_trigger = true, scene = true,
}
TM_EFFECT_TARGETS = { self = true, ally = true, enemy = true, scene = true, gimmick = true }

-- tmEffectDefaultTrigger: per-source-kind default trigger when none given.
function tmEffectDefaultTrigger(sourceKind)
    if sourceKind == "item" then return "on_hit" end
    if sourceKind == "skill" then return "on_use" end
    if sourceKind == "gimmick" then return "on_trigger" end
    return "passive"
end

-- tmEffectDefaultTarget: default target by effect category. damage-ish -> enemy,
-- heal/mp/buff -> self, everything else -> self.
function tmEffectDefaultTarget(effect)
    if effect == "damage" or effect == "damage_condition"
        or effect == "condition" or effect == "debuff_stat" then
        return "enemy"
    end
    return "self"
end

-- tmParseRuntimeEffect: parse a raw effect payload into a structured table.
-- Structured iff payload (split on '|') has >=1 'key=value' segment. The
-- category key is 'effect='. Unknown values fall back to safe defaults; a
-- condition is only kept when tmConditionDef validates it. Dice are derived
-- from grade. For prose-only payloads, nothing is invented: effect=utility,
-- grade=C (1d4), trigger=default-by-kind, text=whole raw payload.
-- NOTE: 'text' is returned verbatim (NOT sanitized) — the caller sanitizes it.
function tmParseRuntimeEffect(payload, sourceKind)
    local raw = tostring(payload or "")
    local segs = {}
    local hasKv = false
    for seg in (raw .. "|"):gmatch("([^|]*)|") do
        table.insert(segs, seg)
        if seg:match("^%s*[%w_]+%s*=") then hasKv = true end
    end

    local defTrigger = tmEffectDefaultTrigger(sourceKind)

    if not hasKv then
        local _, _, dice = tmEffectGradeDice("C")
        local count, sides = TM_EFFECT_GRADE_DICE.C[1], TM_EFFECT_GRADE_DICE.C[2]
        return {
            structured = false,
            grade = "C",
            dice = dice,
            count = count,
            sides = sides,
            trigger = defTrigger,
            effect = "utility",
            condition = nil,
            stat = nil,
            target = "self",
            text = raw,
        }
    end

    local kv = {}
    for _, seg in ipairs(segs) do
        local k, v = seg:match("^%s*([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.*)$")
        if k then
            v = tostring(v):gsub("%s+$", "")
            kv[k:lower()] = v
        end
    end

    local effect = (kv.effect or ""):lower()
    if not TM_EFFECT_CATEGORIES[effect] then effect = "utility" end
    if effect == "condition_resist" or effect == "condition_immunity"
        or effect == "buff_stat" or effect == "debuff_stat" then
        defTrigger = "passive"
    end

    local grade = (kv.grade or ""):upper()
    if not TM_EFFECT_GRADES[grade] then grade = "C" end

    local trigger = (kv.trigger or ""):lower()
    if not TM_EFFECT_TRIGGERS[trigger] then trigger = defTrigger end

    local stat = (kv.stat or ""):lower()
    if not TM_LOOT_STATS[stat] then stat = nil end

    local condition = (kv.condition or ""):lower()
    if condition == "" or not tmConditionDef(condition) then condition = nil end

    local target = (kv.target or ""):lower()
    if not TM_EFFECT_TARGETS[target] then target = tmEffectDefaultTarget(effect) end

    local count, sides, dice = tmEffectGradeDice(grade)

    return {
        structured = true,
        grade = grade,
        dice = dice,
        count = count,
        sides = sides,
        trigger = trigger,
        effect = effect,
        condition = condition,
        stat = stat,
        target = target,
        text = kv.text or "",
    }
end

INTENT_KEYWORDS = {
    dice_request = {"주사위", "굴려", "굴리", "굴린", "굴림", "판정", "체크", "다이스", "roll", "check", "dice", "d20", "d6", "d4", "d8", "d10", "d12"},
    combat       = {"공격", "때려", "베어", "벤다", "쏴", "쏘아", "쏜다", "죽여", "죽이", "찔러", "후려", "attack", "kill"},
    social       = {"설득", "협상", "흥정", "거래", "심문", "추궁", "유도", "회유", "유혹", "말걸", "말 걸", "질문", "대화", "위협", "겁줘", "도발", "진정", "거짓말", "속여", "속이", "둘러대", "정보", "신뢰", "persuade", "negotiate", "bargain", "interrogate", "deceive", "intimidate", "seduce", "talk"},
    investigate  = {"살펴", "조사", "감지", "관찰", "탐지", "뒤져", "확인", "열어", "열기", "문열", "만져", "건드", "다가", "접근", "피해", "피하", "숨", "숨어", "해제", "잠금", "듣", "들어", "냄새", "찾", "수색", "inspect", "search", "open", "touch", "avoid", "hide"},
}

-- 칭찬/명사/부정문이 굴림을 오발하지 않게 분류 전에 걷어내는 목록.
-- ("베개 좀 줘"가 전투 판정으로 적 HP를 깎는 사고 방지 — cross-review BS-5)
TM_INTENT_FALSE_POSITIVES = {"설득력", "위협적", "체크무늬", "체크아웃", "베개", "쏘아붙", "공격적"}
TM_INTENT_NEGATIONS = {
    "주사위%s*굴리지%s*마", "굴리지%s*마", "굴리지%s*말", "굴릴%s*필요%s*없",
    "판정하지%s*마", "판정%s*없이", "공격하지%s*마",
}

STAT_KEYWORDS = {
    str = {"STR", "str", "strength", "근력", "힘"},
    dex = {"DEX", "dex", "dexterity", "민첩"},
    con = {"CON", "con", "constitution", "체력", "건강"},
    int = {"INT", "int", "intelligence", "지능"},
    wis = {"WIS", "wis", "wisdom", "지혜"},
    cha = {"CHA", "cha", "charisma", "매력"},
}

function normalizeStatKey(statKey)
    local key = (statKey or "dex"):lower()
    if STAT_KEYWORDS[key] then return key end
    return "dex"
end

function tmValidRollStatKey(statKey)
    local raw = tostring(statKey or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local key = raw:lower()
    if STAT_KEYWORDS[key] then return key end
    for stat, words in pairs(STAT_KEYWORDS) do
        for _, word in ipairs(words) do
            local w = tostring(word or "")
            if w ~= "" and (raw == w or key == w:lower()) then return stat end
        end
    end
    local asciiTokens = " " .. key:gsub("[^%w_]+", " ") .. " "
    for stat, words in pairs(STAT_KEYWORDS) do
        for _, word in ipairs(words) do
            local w = tostring(word or "")
            local lower = w:lower()
            if w ~= "" and lower:match("^[a-z]+$") then
                if asciiTokens:find(" " .. lower .. " ", 1, true) then return stat end
            elseif w ~= "" and raw:find(w, 1, true) then
                return stat
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- rollD20: HG L544-548 inspired, returns (raw, total) tuple for nat-1/20 detection in 5-tier
function rollD20(bonus)
    local raw = math.random(20)
    local total = raw + (bonus or 0)
    return raw, total
end

function getAbilityMod(statValue)
    return math.floor(((statValue or 10) - 10) / 2)
end

function tmDynamicLeveledBonus(id)
    local level = tonumber(tostring(id or ""):match("_l(%d+)_")) or 1
    return clamp(math.floor((level + 1) / 2), 1, 5)
end

TM_EFFECT_GRADE_FLAT = { C = 1, B = 2, A = 3, S = 4 }

function tmEffectGradeFlatValue(grade)
    return TM_EFFECT_GRADE_FLAT[tostring(grade or ""):upper()] or 1
end

function tmEquipmentBonusForStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    local total = 0
    local equipment = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", "")
    for itemId in tostring(equipment):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local resolvedId = tmResolveEquipmentBaseId(triggerId, itemId)
        local stat = resolvedId:match("^eq_l%d+_([a-z]+)_")
        if stat == statKey then
            total = total + tmDynamicLeveledBonus(resolvedId)
        end
    end
    return clamp(total, 0, 5)
end

function tmStructuredPassiveStatBonusForStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    if type(tmCollectRuntimeEffects) ~= "function" then return 0 end
    local total = 0
    for _, eff in ipairs(tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, ownerId, "item+skill")) do
        local trigger = tostring(eff.trigger or "")
        if (trigger == "passive" or trigger == "scene")
            and tostring(eff.stat or "") == statKey then
            local amount = tmEffectGradeFlatValue(eff.grade)
            if eff.effect == "buff_stat" then
                total = total + amount
            elseif eff.effect == "debuff_stat" then
                total = total - amount
            end
        end
    end
    return clamp(total, -5, 5)
end

function tmExternalStatBonusForStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    return clamp(tmEquipmentBonusForStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
        + tmStructuredPassiveStatBonusForStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey), -5, 8)
end

function tmEffectivePlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey, default)
    local base = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey, default or 10)
    local statBonus = tmExternalStatBonusForStat(triggerId, ownerId, statKey)
    return base + statBonus, base, statBonus
end

-- === Loot markers (ITEM_NAME / ITEM_EFFECT / SKILL_NAME / SKILL_EFFECT / EQUIP) ===
-- LLM proposes display names; Lua sanitizes, assigns compact itNNN/skNNN refs and
-- stores records in ^/; -separated registries. No auto-equip: EQUIP marker only.

TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX = 40
TM_LOOT_EFFECT_MAX = 200

TM_LOOT_STATS    = { str = true, dex = true, con = true, int = true, wis = true, cha = true }
TM_LOOT_TYPES    = { equipment = true, consumable = true, key = true }
TM_LOOT_SLOTS    = { weapon = true, armor = true, accessory = true, focus = true, tool = true }
TM_LOOT_ROLES    = { strike = true, guard = true, trick = true, burst = true, heal = true, support = true, control = true, evade = true }
TM_LOOT_RARITIES = { common = true, uncommon = true, rare = true }

-- tmTruncateUtf8: cut at maxChars UTF-8 characters counting lead bytes
-- (b < 0x80 or b >= 0xC0), byte loop like hasBatchim — no utf8 lib dependency.
function tmTruncateUtf8(s, maxChars)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    local chars = 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        local b = s:byte(i)
        if b < 0x80 or b >= 0xC0 then
            chars = chars + 1
            if chars > maxChars then return s:sub(1, i - 1) end
        end
    end
    return s
end

-- tmLootSanitizeText: strip record/field/marker separators and newlines so
-- registry split/join stays deterministic, then cap length.
function tmLootSanitizeText(text, maxChars)
    local s = tostring(text or "")
    s = s:gsub("[%^;|]", " ")
    s = s:gsub("[\r\n]", " ")
    s = s:gsub("%s+", " "):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    return tmTruncateUtf8(s, maxChars or TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
end

function tmLootFail(triggerId, reason)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", reason)
    print("[TRPG LOOT] parse fail: " .. reason)
end

function tmLootRarityOrDefault(triggerId, rawRarity)
    local rarity = tmLootSanitizeText(rawRarity or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    if TM_LOOT_RARITIES[rarity] then return rarity end
    rarity = getVar(triggerId, "loot_budget_rarity", "common")
    if TM_LOOT_RARITIES[rarity] then return rarity end
    return "common"
end

function tmLootLevelBand(triggerId)
    local total = 0
    local count = 0
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        total = total + getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1)
        count = count + 1
    end
    local avg = count > 0 and math.floor((total / count) + 0.5) or 1
    return clamp(avg, 1, 5)
end

function tmLootContextValue(triggerId, varName, allowed, fallback)
    local raw = tmLootSanitizeText(getVar(triggerId, varName, ""), 24):lower()
    if allowed and allowed[raw] then return raw end
    return fallback
end

function tmLootDefaultItemBase(triggerId)
    local level = tmLootLevelBand(triggerId)
    local stat = tmLootContextValue(triggerId, "loot_context_stat", TM_LOOT_STATS, "dex")
    local role = tmLootContextValue(triggerId, "loot_context_role", TM_LOOT_ROLES, "trick")
    local slot = tmLootContextValue(triggerId, "loot_context_slot", TM_LOOT_SLOTS, "accessory")
    local owner = tmLootSanitizeText(getVar(triggerId, "loot_context_owner", "party"), 24)
    if owner == "" or (owner ~= "party" and not CHAR_NAMES_KO[owner]) then owner = "party" end
    return "eq_l" .. tostring(level) .. "_" .. stat .. "_" .. role, slot, tostring(level), stat, role, owner
end

function tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(raw)
    local token = tmAuxNormalizeEnum(raw or "")
    if token == "" or token == "none" or token == "unknown" or token == "-" then return "" end
    return token
end

function tmRewardRarityFromMeta(triggerId, rewardValue, meta)
    local raw = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 4))
    if raw == "" then raw = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(rewardValue or "") end
    if TM_LOOT_RARITIES[raw] then return raw end
    local grade = tostring(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 5) ~= "" and tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 5) or rewardValue or ""):upper()
    if grade == "S" or grade == "A" then return "rare" end
    if grade == "B" then return "uncommon" end
    if grade == "C" then return "common" end
    return tmLootRarityOrDefault(triggerId, raw)
end

function tmRewardGradeFromMeta(rarity, rewardValue, meta)
    local grade = tostring(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 5) ~= "" and tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 5) or rewardValue or ""):upper()
    if TM_EFFECT_GRADES and TM_EFFECT_GRADES[grade] then return grade end
    if rarity == "rare" then return "A" end
    if rarity == "uncommon" then return "B" end
    return "C"
end

function tmRewardLevelForRarity(triggerId, rarity)
    local level = tmLootLevelBand(triggerId)
    if rarity == "rare" then return tostring(clamp(math.max(level + 1, 3), 1, 5)) end
    if rarity == "uncommon" then return tostring(clamp(math.max(level, 2), 1, 5)) end
    return tostring(level)
end

function tmResolveRuntimeItemSlot(kind, text, meta)
    if kind == "consumable" then return "item" end
    if kind == "key" then return "key" end
    local slot = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 6))
    if slot ~= "" and (TM_LOOT_SLOTS[slot] or slot == "item" or slot == "key") then return slot end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"shield", "armor", "armour", "helmet", "helm", "방패", "갑옷", "투구", "鎧", "盾", "兜"}) then return "armor" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"ring", "amulet", "cloak", "necklace", "relic", "반지", "목걸이", "망토", "유물", "指輪", "首飾り"}) then return "accessory" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"staff", "wand", "tome", "book", "symbol", "지팡이", "완드", "마도서", "성표", "杖"}) then return "focus" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"tool", "kit", "도구", "공구"}) then return "tool" end
    return "weapon"
end

function tmResolveRuntimeItemStat(kind, text, meta)
    local stat = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 7))
    if stat ~= "" and TM_LOOT_STATS[stat] then return stat end
    if kind ~= "equipment" then return kind == "consumable" and "wis" or "none" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"shield", "armor", "armour", "helmet", "방패", "갑옷", "투구", "鎧", "盾"}) then return "con" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"dagger", "bow", "boots", "cloak", "단검", "활", "장화", "망토", "弓", "短剣"}) then return "dex" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"staff", "wand", "tome", "book", "rune", "지팡이", "완드", "마도서", "룬", "杖"}) then return "int" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"holy", "heal", "prayer", "성표", "성물", "치유", "기도"}) then return "wis" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"ring", "amulet", "charm", "music", "voice", "반지", "목걸이", "부적", "음악", "목소리"}) then return "cha" end
    return "str"
end

function tmResolveRuntimeItemRole(kind, text, meta)
    local role = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 8))
    if role ~= "" and TM_LOOT_ROLES[role] then return role end
    if kind == "key" then return "support" end
    if kind == "consumable" then
        if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"heal", "potion", "medicine", "회복", "치유", "포션", "물약", "약"}) then return "heal" end
        return "support"
    end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"shield", "armor", "armour", "방패", "갑옷"}) then return "guard" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"fire", "bomb", "explosive", "화염", "폭탄"}) then return "burst" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"bind", "sleep", "fear", "ice", "속박", "수면", "공포", "얼음"}) then return "control" end
    if tmTextHasAnyToken(text, {"boots", "cloak", "shadow", "장화", "망토", "그림자"}) then return "evade" end
    return "strike"
end

function tmResolveRuntimeItemProfile(triggerId, rawName, rawRarity, rawKind, evidence, meta)
    local name = tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    local kind = tmResolveAuxRewardItemKind(rawKind, name, evidence, meta)
    local rarity = tmRewardRarityFromMeta(triggerId, rawRarity, meta)
    local grade = tmRewardGradeFromMeta(rarity, rawRarity, meta)
    local text = tostring(name or "") .. " " .. tostring(evidence or "") .. " " .. tostring(tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 12))
    local slot = tmResolveRuntimeItemSlot(kind, text, meta)
    local stat = tmResolveRuntimeItemStat(kind, text, meta)
    local role = tmResolveRuntimeItemRole(kind, text, meta)
    local level = kind == "equipment" and tmRewardLevelForRarity(triggerId, rarity) or "0"
    local baseId = "runtime_consumable"
    if kind == "equipment" then
        baseId = "eq_l" .. tostring(level) .. "_" .. stat .. "_" .. role
    elseif kind == "key" then
        baseId = "runtime_key_item"
    end
    return {
        name = name,
        kind = kind,
        rarity = rarity,
        grade = grade,
        slot = slot,
        level = level,
        stat = stat,
        role = role,
        baseId = baseId,
        owner = "party",
        evidence = tmLootSanitizeText(evidence or tmAuxItemMetaField(meta, 12), TM_LOOT_EFFECT_MAX),
        meta = meta,
    }
end

function tmLootDefaultSkillBase(triggerId, owner)
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_class", "rogue")
    local stat = tmLootContextValue(triggerId, "skill_context_stat", TM_LOOT_STATS, tmPrimaryStatFor(triggerId, classId))
    local role = tmLootContextValue(triggerId, "skill_context_role", TM_LOOT_ROLES, "support")
    local level = tmLootLevelBand(triggerId)
    local mpCost = "mp" .. tostring(clamp(math.ceil(level / 2), 1, 5))
    return "sk_l" .. tostring(level) .. "_" .. stat .. "_" .. role, tostring(level), stat, role, mpCost
end

function tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, varName, record)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, varName, "none")
    if registry == "none" or registry == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, varName, record)
    else
        setVar(triggerId, varName, registry .. ";" .. record)
    end
end

function tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, varName, ref)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, varName, "none")
    if registry == "none" or registry == "" then return nil end
    for record in registry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        if record:sub(1, #ref + 1) == ref .. "^" then return record end
    end
    return nil
end

function tmRegistryFields(record)
    local fields = {}
    for field in tostring(record or ""):gmatch("[^%^]+") do
        table.insert(fields, field)
    end
    return fields
end

function tmItemRegistryField(triggerId, itemRef, fieldIndex)
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemRef)
    if not record then return nil end
    return tmRegistryFields(record)[fieldIndex]
end

-- tmResolveEquipmentBaseId: itNNN equipment slots resolve to the registry baseId
-- (field 4) for bonus math; direct eq_l IDs pass through unchanged (no regression).
function tmResolveEquipmentBaseId(triggerId, itemId)
    if not tostring(itemId):match("^it%d+$") then return itemId end
    return tmItemRegistryField(triggerId, itemId, 4) or itemId
end

function tmRuntimeItemRefActive(triggerId, ref)
    local itemRef = tmCleanItemRef(ref)
    if itemRef == "" then return false end
    if csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), itemRef) then return true end
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", ""), itemRef) then return true end
        for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(getVar(triggerId, tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId), "none"), ",")) do
            local id = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
            if id == itemRef then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmFindDuplicateRuntimePartyItem(triggerId, name)
    local wanted = tmCanonicalRewardNameToken(name)
    if wanted == "" or wanted == "none" or wanted == "unknown" then return nil end
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_item_registry", "none")
    if registry == "" or registry == "none" then return nil end
    for record in registry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
        local ref = fields[1] or ""
        if tmCleanItemRef(ref) ~= "" and tmRuntimeItemRefActive(triggerId, ref) then
            if tmCanonicalRewardNameToken(fields[2] or "") == wanted then
                return ref, fields
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function tmRarityRank(rarity)
    local r = tostring(rarity or "")
    if r == "rare" then return 3 end
    if r == "uncommon" then return 2 end
    if r == "common" then return 1 end
    return 0
end

function tmUpgradeRuntimePartyItemRecord(triggerId, ref, profile)
    local itemRef = tmCleanItemRef(ref)
    if itemRef == "" or not profile then return false end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemRef)
    if not record then return false end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    for i = 1, 11 do
        if not fields[i] or fields[i] == "" then fields[i] = "-" end
    end
    fields[2] = fields[2] ~= "-" and fields[2] or profile.name
    if tmRarityRank(profile.rarity) > tmRarityRank(fields[3]) then fields[3] = profile.rarity end
    local currentKind = tmNormalizeRuntimeItemKind(fields[5])
    if profile.kind == "equipment" or (currentKind ~= "equipment" and (profile.kind == "key" or profile.kind == "consumable")) then
        fields[5] = profile.kind
        fields[4] = profile.baseId
        fields[6] = profile.slot
        fields[7] = profile.level
        fields[8] = profile.stat
        fields[9] = profile.role
    elseif fields[4] == "-" or fields[4] == "" or fields[4] == "no_effect" then
        fields[4] = profile.baseId
    end
    if fields[10] == "-" or fields[10] == "" then fields[10] = profile.owner or "party" end
    tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemRef, table.concat(fields, "^"))
    return true
end

function tmRuntimeItemProfileEffectPayload(profile)
    if not profile or not profile.meta then return "" end
    local effect = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(profile.meta, 9))
    if effect == "" or effect == "none" or effect == "unknown" then return "" end
    local trigger = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(profile.meta, 10))
    if trigger == "" then
        if effect == "condition_resist" or effect == "condition_immunity" or effect == "buff_stat" or effect == "debuff_stat" then
            trigger = "passive"
        elseif profile.kind == "consumable" then
            trigger = "on_use"
        else
            trigger = "on_hit"
        end
    end
    local target = tmAuxMetaCleanEnum(tmAuxItemMetaField(profile.meta, 11))
    if target == "" then
        if effect == "damage" or effect == "damage_condition" or effect == "condition" or effect == "debuff_stat" then
            target = "enemy"
        else
            target = "self"
        end
    end
    local text = tmLootSanitizeText(tmAuxItemMetaField(profile.meta, 12), TM_LOOT_EFFECT_MAX)
    if text == "" then
        text = tmLootSanitizeText(profile.name .. " " .. effect, TM_LOOT_EFFECT_MAX)
    end
    local parts = {
        "grade=" .. tostring(profile.grade or "C"),
        "trigger=" .. trigger,
        "effect=" .. effect,
        "target=" .. target,
        "text=" .. text,
    }
    if profile.stat and profile.stat ~= "" and profile.stat ~= "none" then
        table.insert(parts, "stat=" .. profile.stat)
    end
    return table.concat(parts, "|")
end

function tmAttachRuntimeItemProfileEffect(triggerId, ref, profile)
    if tmCleanItemRef(ref) == "" then return false end
    local payload = tmRuntimeItemProfileEffectPayload(profile)
    if payload == "" then return false end
    if tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", ref) then return false end
    return tmAttachItemEffect(triggerId, ref, payload)
end

function tmStoreRuntimePartyItemProfile(triggerId, rawName, rawRarity, rawKind, profile, opts)
    local name = tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    if name == "" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "item_name_empty")
        return nil
    end
    local resolved = profile or tmResolveRuntimeItemProfile(triggerId, name, rawRarity, rawKind or "equipment", name, nil)
    resolved.name = name
    local rarity = resolved.rarity or tmLootRarityOrDefault(triggerId, rawRarity)
    local kind = tmNormalizeRuntimeItemKind(resolved.kind or rawKind or "equipment")
    if opts and opts.dedupe then
        local duplicateRef = tmFindDuplicateRuntimePartyItem(triggerId, name)
        if duplicateRef then
            tmUpgradeRuntimePartyItemRecord(triggerId, duplicateRef, resolved)
            tmAttachRuntimeItemProfileEffect(triggerId, duplicateRef, resolved)
            setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
            return duplicateRef, name, rarity, kind, "merged"
        end
    end
    local n = getNumVar(triggerId, "inventory_next_id", 1)
    local ref = string.format("it%03d", n)
    setVar(triggerId, "inventory_next_id", n + 1)
    local baseId = resolved.baseId or "runtime_consumable"
    local slot = resolved.slot or "item"
    local level = resolved.level or "0"
    local stat = resolved.stat or "none"
    local role = resolved.role or "support"
    local owner = resolved.owner or "party"
    local record = table.concat({ref, name, rarity, baseId, kind, slot, level, stat, role, owner, "-"}, "^")
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "party_item_registry", record)
    setVar(triggerId, "party_items", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref))
    tmAttachRuntimeItemProfileEffect(triggerId, ref, resolved)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    return ref, name, rarity, kind
end

function tmStoreRuntimePartyItem(triggerId, rawName, rawRarity, rawKind)
    return tmStoreRuntimePartyItemProfile(triggerId, rawName, rawRarity, rawKind, nil, nil)
end

function tmStoreFormulaEquipmentAsPartyItem(triggerId, ownerId, equipmentId)
    local id = tostring(equipmentId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local level, stat, role = tmFormulaParts(id)
    if not level then return nil end
    local name = tmLootSanitizeText(tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, id), TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    if name == "" then name = tmFormulaLabel(triggerId, id, "equipment") or id end
    local n = getNumVar(triggerId, "inventory_next_id", 1)
    local ref = string.format("it%03d", n)
    setVar(triggerId, "inventory_next_id", n + 1)
    local record = table.concat({ref, name, "common", id, "equipment", "equipment", tostring(level), stat, role, ownerId, "-"}, "^")
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "party_item_registry", record)
    setVar(triggerId, "party_items", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref))
    return ref, name
end

-- tmStoreLootItem: legacy ITEM_NAME marker -> party item registry record. No
-- owner cue in the marker, so new loot enters the shared party bag first.
function tmStoreLootItem(triggerId, rawName, rawRarity)
    return tmStoreRuntimePartyItem(triggerId, rawName, rawRarity, "equipment")
end

function tmApplyRewardItemMarker(triggerId, rawPayload, source)
    local payload = tostring(rawPayload or "")
    local name, rarity = payload, ""
    local sep = payload:find("|", 1, true)
    if sep then
        name = payload:sub(1, sep - 1)
        rarity = payload:sub(sep + 1)
    end
    local itemId = tmLootSanitizeText(name, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    if itemId == "" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "reward_item_empty")
        return nil
    end

    if itemId:match("^it%d+$") or itemId:match("^eq_l%d+_") then
        setVar(triggerId, "party_items", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), itemId))
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "reward_item:" .. itemId)
        tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 보상: " .. tmEquipLabel(triggerId, itemId))
        return itemId, itemId
    end

    local ref, storedName = tmStoreLootItem(triggerId, itemId, rarity)
    if ref then
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "reward_item:" .. ref)
        tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 보상: " .. storedName .. " (" .. ref .. ")")
        return ref, storedName
    end
    return nil
end

-- tmStoreLootSkill: SKILL_NAME marker -> skill registry. Valid owner gets a
-- formula baseId from the class primary stat; invalid owner is kept as a
-- party-held record only (no p_*_skills attach, no mechanical effect).
function tmStoreLootSkill(triggerId, rawOwner, rawName, rawRarity)
    local name = tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    if name == "" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_name_empty")
        return nil
    end
    local owner = tmLootSanitizeText(rawOwner or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    local rarity = tmLootRarityOrDefault(triggerId, rawRarity)
    local n = getNumVar(triggerId, "skill_next_id", 1)
    local ref = string.format("sk%03d", n)
    setVar(triggerId, "skill_next_id", n + 1)
    local record
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[owner] then
        local baseId, level, stat, role, mpCost = tmLootDefaultSkillBase(triggerId, owner)
        record = table.concat({ref, owner, name, rarity, baseId, level, stat, role, mpCost, "-"}, "^")
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_skills", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_skills", ""), ref))
        local loadoutVar = "p_" .. owner .. "_skill_loadout"
        local loadout = getVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, "")
        if not csvListContains(loadout, ref) and csvItemCount(loadout) < TM_SKILL_LOADOUT_CAP then
            setVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, addCsvItem(loadout, ref))
        end
    else
        record = table.concat({ref, "party", name, rarity, "no_effect", "0", "none", "none", "mp0", "-"}, "^")
    end
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", record)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    return ref, name
end

-- tmStoreRewardSkillbook: REWARD:skillbook reward -> an 'owned' skillbook record.
-- The reward NAMES its skill at acquisition (no identify step). kv is the parsed
-- key=value table from the marker payload. Field layout (10 fields):
--   ref^name^rarity^grade^stat^role^source^state^effRef^learnedBy
-- state starts "owned"; effRef/learnedBy start "-" (effRef set later by the
-- SKILLBOOK_EFFECT handler, learnedBy by a later SKILLBOOK_LEARN ticket).
function tmFindDuplicateRewardSkillbook(triggerId, name, grade, stat, role, source)
    local wantedName = tmCanonicalRewardNameToken(name)
    if wantedName == "" then return nil end
    local cleanSource = tmLootSanitizeText(source or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")
    if registry == "" or registry == "none" then return nil end
    for record in registry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
        local state = fields[8] or ""
        if state == "owned" or state == "learned" then
            local sameName = tmCanonicalRewardNameToken(fields[2] or "") == wantedName
            local sameGrade = tostring(fields[4] or "") == tostring(grade or "")
            local sameStat = tostring(fields[5] or "") == tostring(stat or "")
            local sameRole = tostring(fields[6] or "") == tostring(role or "")
            local existingSource = tmLootSanitizeText(fields[7] or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
            local sameSource = cleanSource == "" or cleanSource == "-" or existingSource == "" or existingSource == "-" or existingSource == cleanSource
            if sameName and sameGrade and sameStat and sameRole and sameSource then return fields[1] end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function tmStoreRewardSkillbook(triggerId, kv)
    kv = kv or {}
    local name = tmLootSanitizeText(kv.name, TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    if name == "" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_name_empty")
        return nil
    end
    local rarity = tmLootRarityOrDefault(triggerId, kv.rarity)
    local stat = tmLootSanitizeText(kv.stat or "", 24):lower()
    if not TM_LOOT_STATS[stat] then stat = "int" end
    local role = tmLootSanitizeText(kv.role or "", 24):lower()
    if not TM_LOOT_ROLES[role] then role = "support" end
    local grade = tmLootSanitizeText(kv.grade or "", 8):upper()
    if not TM_EFFECT_GRADES[grade] then grade = "C" end
    local source = tmLootSanitizeText(kv.source or "", TM_LOOT_NAME_MAX)
    if source == "" then source = "-" end
    local duplicateRef = tmFindDuplicateRewardSkillbook(triggerId, name, grade, stat, role, source)
    if duplicateRef then
        setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "스킬북 중복 처리 생략: " .. name .. " (" .. duplicateRef .. ")")
        return duplicateRef
    end
    local n = getNumVar(triggerId, "skillbook_next_id", 1)
    local ref = string.format("sb%03d", n)
    setVar(triggerId, "skillbook_next_id", n + 1)
    local record = table.concat({ref, name, rarity, grade, stat, role, source, "owned", "-", "-"}, "^")
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", record)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "스킬북 획득: " .. name .. " (" .. ref .. ")")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "skillbook:" .. ref)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    return ref
end

function tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, varName, ref, newRecord)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, varName, "none")
    local rebuilt = {}
    for record in registry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        if record:sub(1, #ref + 1) == ref .. "^" then
            table.insert(rebuilt, newRecord)
        else
            table.insert(rebuilt, record)
        end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, varName, table.concat(rebuilt, ";"))
end

-- tmEffectMachineTuple: pack parsed effect into the field-7 ':'-tuple
-- (effect:condition:stat:target). ':' survives tmLootSanitizeText; nil -> "".
-- Built AFTER sanitize and NOT passed through sanitize, so ':' is safe.
function tmEffectMachineTuple(parsed)
    return table.concat({
        parsed.effect or "utility",
        parsed.condition or "",
        parsed.stat or "",
        parsed.target or "",
    }, ":")
end

-- tmEffectNoteRecord: build the stored note record. Fields 1-4 are EXACTLY the
-- legacy format (effRef^parentRef^llm^<sanitizedText>). Structured effects add
-- machine fields 5-7 (^<grade>^<trigger>^<effect>:<condition>:<stat>:<target>).
-- Prose-only effects keep a 4-field record identical to today.
function tmEffectNoteRecord(effRef, parentRef, sanitizedText, parsed)
    local base = effRef .. "^" .. parentRef .. "^llm^" .. sanitizedText
    if parsed and parsed.structured then
        return base .. "^" .. parsed.grade .. "^" .. parsed.trigger
            .. "^" .. tmEffectMachineTuple(parsed)
    end
    return base
end

-- tmAttachItemEffect: ITEM_EFFECT pairing — effNNN reuses the parent it number,
-- registry effRef (field 11) is set and a no_effect baseId becomes fx_special_text.
-- The RAW payload is parsed (D045 structured contract) BEFORE sanitizing so the
-- '|'-delimited machine payload survives; only the readable .text is sanitized.
function tmAttachItemEffect(triggerId, itemRef, rawText)
    local parsed = tmParseRuntimeEffect(rawText, "item")
    local effText = tmLootSanitizeText(parsed.text, TM_LOOT_EFFECT_MAX)
    if effText == "" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "effect_empty")
        return false
    end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemRef)
    if not record then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "orphan_item_effect")
        return false
    end
    local effRef = "eff" .. itemRef:sub(3)
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    if fields[4] == "no_effect" then fields[4] = "fx_special_text" end
    fields[11] = effRef
    tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemRef, table.concat(fields, "^"))
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", tmEffectNoteRecord(effRef, itemRef, effText, parsed))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    return true
end

-- tmAttachSkillEffect: SKILL_EFFECT pairing — sk_effNNN reuses the parent sk number.
function tmAttachSkillEffect(triggerId, skillRef, rawText)
    local parsed = tmParseRuntimeEffect(rawText, "skill")
    local effText = tmLootSanitizeText(parsed.text, TM_LOOT_EFFECT_MAX)
    if effText == "" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "effect_empty")
        return false
    end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", skillRef)
    if not record then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "orphan_skill_effect")
        return false
    end
    local effRef = "sk_eff" .. skillRef:sub(3)
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    fields[10] = effRef
    tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", skillRef, table.concat(fields, "^"))
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", tmEffectNoteRecord(effRef, skillRef, effText, parsed))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    return true
end

-- tmResolveOwnerId: resolve a free-text owner token to a CHAR_IDS member.
-- Accepts the canonical id directly, or matches the token against the fixed
