-- Korean name (CHAR_NAMES_KO), the runtime real-name var (p_<id>_name_ko), or
-- the PC name (p_<id>_pc_name). Returns the id or nil (caller raises bad_owner).
function tmResolveOwnerId(triggerId, token)
    local t = tostring(token or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if t == "" then return nil end
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[t] then return t end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if t == (CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or "")
            or t == getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_name_ko", "")
            or t == getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_pc_name", "") then
            return id
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- tmSkillbookCopyEffectToSkill: re-attach a skillbook's stored D045 effect to a
-- newly learned skill. Method (b): copy the sb_eff note record verbatim under a
-- new sk_eff<NNN> key (preserves the exact structured fields 5-7 + sanitized
-- text 4 — no lossy raw round-trip), set the skill record's field 10 to the new
-- effRef. bookEffRef is the book's field 9 (e.g. sb_eff001); returns the new
-- effRef or nil when the source note is missing.
function tmSkillbookCopyEffectToSkill(triggerId, bookEffRef, skRef)
    local source = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", bookEffRef)
    if not source then return nil end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(source)
    local newEffRef = "sk_eff" .. skRef:sub(3)
    fields[1] = newEffRef
    fields[2] = skRef
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", table.concat(fields, "^"))
    local skRecord = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", skRef)
    if skRecord then
        local skFields = tmRegistryFields(skRecord)
        skFields[10] = newEffRef
        tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", skRef, table.concat(skFields, "^"))
    end
    return newEffRef
end

-- tmApplySkillbookLearn: SKILLBOOK_LEARN — an 'owned' skillbook is consumed to
-- create a learned skill on a target owner. Mirrors tmStoreLootSkill's record
-- shape (formula baseId/level/mpCost from the owner's class band) but overrides
-- stat/role from the BOOK (fields 5/6). Adds the skill to p_<owner>_skills only —
-- never to the loadout (learning != equipping). Marks the book learned (field 8)
-- and stamps the owner (field 10). Carries the book's D045 effect to the skill.
function tmApplySkillbookLearn(triggerId, sbRef, ownerToken)
    if not tostring(sbRef or ""):match("^sb%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_learn_bad_ref")
        return ""
    end
    local rec = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", sbRef)
    if not rec then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_learn_unknown")
        return ""
    end
    local f = tmRegistryFields(rec)
    if f[8] ~= "owned" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_already_learned")
        return ""
    end
    local owner = tmResolveOwnerId(triggerId, ownerToken)
    if not owner then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_learn_bad_owner")
        return ""
    end
    local n = getNumVar(triggerId, "skill_next_id", 1)
    local skRef = string.format("sk%03d", n)
    setVar(triggerId, "skill_next_id", n + 1)
    -- Derive level/mpCost from the owner's class band exactly like tmStoreLootSkill,
    -- but build baseId from the BOOK's stat/role so the learned skill keeps the
    -- book's identity (tmLootDefaultSkillBase's own stat/role are discarded).
    local _, level, _, _, mpCost = tmLootDefaultSkillBase(triggerId, owner)
    local stat = f[5]
    local role = f[6]
    local baseId = "sk_l" .. tostring(level) .. "_" .. stat .. "_" .. role
    local name = f[2]
    local rarity = f[3]
    local record = table.concat({skRef, owner, name, rarity, baseId, level, stat, role, mpCost, "-"}, "^")
    tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", record)
    if f[9] ~= "-" then
        tmSkillbookCopyEffectToSkill(triggerId, f[9], skRef)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_skills", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_skills", ""), skRef))
    f[8] = "learned"
    f[10] = owner
    tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", sbRef, table.concat(f, "^"))
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "스킬북 습득: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, owner) .. " · " .. name .. " (" .. skRef .. ")")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "skillbook_learn:" .. sbRef .. ":" .. skRef)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    return ""
end

function tmApplySkillbookSellMarker(triggerId, sbRef, price, source)
    local ref = tostring(sbRef or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if not ref:match("^sb%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_sell_bad_ref")
        return false, "bad_ref"
    end
    local cost = tmServicePositivePrice(price, nil)
    if cost <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_sell_bad_price")
        return false, "bad_price"
    end
    local rec = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", ref)
    if not rec then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_sell_unknown")
        return false, "unknown"
    end
    local f = tmRegistryFields(rec)
    if f[8] ~= "owned" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_sell_not_owned")
        return false, "not_owned"
    end
    local name = tmTrimVisibleText(f[2] or ref)
    if name == "" then name = ref end
    f[8] = "sold"
    if not f[10] or f[10] == "" then f[10] = "-" end
    tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", ref, table.concat(f, "^"))
    tmAwardGold(triggerId, cost, "skillbook_sell:" .. name)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "skillbook_sell:" .. ref .. ":" .. tostring(cost))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "스킬북 판매: " .. name .. " (" .. ref .. ") · " .. tostring(cost) .. "골드 획득")
    return true, "applied"
end

-- tmSkillbookTooltipText: rich tooltip for a skillbook ref. When the book has a
-- stored D045 effect (field 9), reuse the structured tooltip (grade/dice/category
-- /target/condition) prefixed with name·grade; otherwise a plain name/grade/stat/
-- role/source line. No "감정"/"identify" wording — the book names its skill at
-- acquisition, there is no identify step.
function tmSkillbookTooltipText(triggerId, sbRef)
    local rec = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", sbRef)
    if not rec then return tmEscapeHtml(tostring(sbRef or "")) end
    local f = tmRegistryFields(rec)
    local name = f[2] or sbRef
    local grade = f[4] or "C"
    local rows = {}
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "kind", tmTooltipKindLabel(triggerId, "skillbook"))
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "grade", grade)
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "stat", tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, f[5] or ""))
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "role", tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, f[6] or ""))
    if f[7] and f[7] ~= "-" and f[7] ~= "" then tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "source", f[7]) end
    if f[9] and f[9] ~= "-" then
        local rich = tmEffectTooltipHtml(tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", f[9]), triggerId)
        if rich then return tmMechanicTooltipHtml(triggerId, name, rows, "", rich) end
    end
    return tmMechanicTooltipHtml(triggerId, name, rows, "", nil)
end

-- tmApplyEquipMarker: EQUIP is the only equip path (no auto-equip, no repair —
-- a wrong auto-equip is worse than a dropped marker).
function tmApplyEquipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "equip_bad_owner")
        return ""
    end
    if not tostring(itemRef):match("^it%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "equip_bad_ref")
        return ""
    end
    if not csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), itemRef) then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "equip_unknown_item")
        return ""
    end
    if tmRuntimeItemKind(triggerId, itemRef) ~= "equipment" then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "equip_not_equipment")
        return ""
    end
    local equipVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment"
    local equipped = getVar(triggerId, equipVar, "")
    if not csvListContains(equipped, itemRef) and tmOwnerEquipmentItemSlots(triggerId, ownerId) >= TM_EQUIPMENT_ITEM_SLOT_CAP then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "equip_item_full")
        return ""
    end
    setVar(triggerId, equipVar, addCsvItem(equipped, itemRef))
    setVar(triggerId, "party_items", removeCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), itemRef))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "equip:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. itemRef)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장착: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, itemRef))
    return ""
end

function tmApplyUnequipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "unequip_bad_owner")
        return ""
    end
    if not tostring(itemRef):match("^it%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "unequip_bad_ref")
        return ""
    end
    local equipVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment"
    local equipped = getVar(triggerId, equipVar, "")
    if not csvListContains(equipped, itemRef) then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "unequip_missing_item")
        return ""
    end
    setVar(triggerId, equipVar, removeCsvItem(equipped, itemRef))
    setVar(triggerId, "party_items", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), itemRef))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "unequip:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. itemRef)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장착 해제: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, itemRef))
    return ""
end

function tmEquippedItemOwner(triggerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tostring(itemRef or "")
    if ref == "" then return nil end
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", ""), ref) then
            return ownerId
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function tmApplyShopSellMarker(triggerId, itemRef, price)
    tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "sell", "none", itemRef, price, "shop_sell", "main_writer")
    return ""
end

function tmSkillRegistryField(triggerId, skillRef, fieldIndex)
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", skillRef)
    if not record then return nil end
    return tmRegistryFields(record)[fieldIndex]
end

function tmSkillBaseId(triggerId, skillRef)
    local id = tostring(skillRef or "")
    if id:match("^sk%d+$") then return tmSkillRegistryField(triggerId, id, 5) or id end
    return id
end

function tmSkillMpCost(triggerId, skillRef)
    local ref = tostring(skillRef or "")
    local token = nil
    if ref:match("^sk%d+$") then
        token = tmSkillRegistryField(triggerId, ref, 9)
    end
    local n = tonumber(tostring(token or ""):match("mp(%d+)"))
    if n then return n end
    if ref:match("^sk%d+$") then return 1 end
    if ref:match("^sk_l%d+_") then return 1 end
    return 0
end

function tmSkillRole(triggerId, skillRef)
    local baseId = tmSkillBaseId(triggerId, skillRef)
    return tostring(baseId or ""):match("^sk_l%d+_[a-z]+_([a-z_]+)$") or "support"
end

function tmSkillStat(triggerId, skillRef)
    local baseId = tmSkillBaseId(triggerId, skillRef)
    return tostring(baseId or ""):match("^sk_l%d+_([a-z]+)_") or "wis"
end

function tmOwnerSkillLoadout(triggerId, ownerId)
    local loadout = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_loadout", "")
    if loadout ~= "" and loadout ~= "none" then return loadout end
    return getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", "")
end

function tmNormalizeSkillUseToken(text)
    local value = tostring(text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    value = value:gsub("%b()", "")
    value = value:gsub("[%s%p]+", "")
    return value:lower()
end

function tmSkillRefMatchesVisibleToken(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef, token)
    local want = tmNormalizeSkillUseToken(token)
    if want == "" then return false end
    local candidates = {
        skillRef,
        tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, skillRef),
        tmOwnerSkillLabel(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef),
        tmOwnerLoadoutDescription(triggerId, ownerId, "skill", skillRef),
    }
    for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
        local got = tmNormalizeSkillUseToken(candidate)
        if got ~= "" and (got == want or got:find(want, 1, true) or want:find(got, 1, true)) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmFirstSkillRefInList(list)
    for _, ref in ipairs(parseList(list, ",")) do
        if ref ~= "" and ref ~= "none" then return ref end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmResolveSkillUseRef(triggerId, ownerId, skillToken)
    local token = tostring(skillToken or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    local owned = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", "")
    local loadout = tmOwnerSkillLoadout(triggerId, ownerId)
    if csvListContains(loadout, token) then return token end
    if csvListContains(owned, token) then return token end

    local lowered = token:lower()
    if token == "" or token == "none" or lowered == "current" or lowered == "active"
        or lowered == "loaded" or lowered == "skill" then
        local active = tmFirstSkillRefInList(loadout)
        if active ~= "" then return active end
        return tmFirstSkillRefInList(owned)
    end

    for _, ref in ipairs(parseList(loadout, ",")) do
        if tmSkillRefMatchesVisibleToken(triggerId, ownerId, ref, token) then return ref end
    end
    for _, ref in ipairs(parseList(owned, ",")) do
        if tmSkillRefMatchesVisibleToken(triggerId, ownerId, ref, token) then return ref end
    end
    return token
end

function tmApplySkillEquipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_equip_bad_owner"); return "" end
    local owned = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", "")
    if not csvListContains(owned, skillRef) then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_equip_not_owned"); return "" end
    local loadoutVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_loadout"
    local loadout = getVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, "")
    if not csvListContains(loadout, skillRef) and csvItemCount(loadout) >= TM_SKILL_LOADOUT_CAP then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_loadout_full")
        return ""
    end
    setVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, addCsvItem(loadout, skillRef))
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "SKILL_EQUIP: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, skillRef))
    return ""
end

function tmApplySkillUnequipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_unequip_bad_owner"); return "" end
    local loadoutVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_loadout"
    setVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, removeCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, ""), skillRef))
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "SKILL_UNEQUIP: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, skillRef))
    return ""
end

function tmApplySkillForgetMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_forget_bad_owner"); return false end
    local ref = tostring(skillRef or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if ref == "" or ref == "none" then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_forget_bad_ref"); return false end
    local ownedVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills"
    local loadoutVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_loadout"
    local owned = getVar(triggerId, ownedVar, "")
    local loadout = getVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, "")
    if not csvListContains(owned, ref) and not csvListContains(loadout, ref) then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_forget_not_owned"); return false end
    local label = tmOwnerSkillLabel(triggerId, ownerId, ref)
    setVar(triggerId, ownedVar, removeCsvItem(owned, ref))
    setVar(triggerId, loadoutVar, removeCsvItem(loadout, ref))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "skill_forget:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. ref)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "스킬 잊기: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. label)
    return true
end

TM_SKILL_USE_APPLIED_KEYS_VAR = "tm_skill_use_applied_keys"
TM_SKILL_USE_APPLIED_KEY_MAX = 12

function tmResetSkillUseAppliedKeys(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, TM_SKILL_USE_APPLIED_KEYS_VAR, "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_skill_use_last_result", "")
end

function tmSkillUseMaterialKey(ownerId, skillRef, kind, targetId)
    return table.concat({
        tostring(ownerId or ""),
        tostring(skillRef or ""),
        tostring(kind or ""),
        tostring(targetId or "")
    }, ":")
end

function tmSkillUseAppliedKeySeen(triggerId, key)
    local clean = tostring(key or "")
    if clean == "" then return false end
    return csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, TM_SKILL_USE_APPLIED_KEYS_VAR, ""), clean)
end

function tmRememberSkillUseAppliedKey(triggerId, key)
    local clean = tostring(key or "")
    if clean == "" then return false end
    local items = parseList(getVar(triggerId, TM_SKILL_USE_APPLIED_KEYS_VAR, ""), ",")
    for _, item in ipairs(items) do
        if item == clean then return false end
    end
    table.insert(items, clean)
    while #items > TM_SKILL_USE_APPLIED_KEY_MAX do table.remove(items, 1) end
    setVar(triggerId, TM_SKILL_USE_APPLIED_KEYS_VAR, table.concat(items, ","))
    return true
end

function tmSkillMetadataHasRecoveryCue(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    local text = table.concat({
        tostring(skillRef or ""),
        tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, skillRef),
        tmOwnerSkillLabel(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef),
        tmOwnerLoadoutDescription(triggerId, ownerId, "skill", skillRef),
        tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", skillRef),
    }, " ")
    local lower = text:lower()
    for _, cue in ipairs({
        "회복", "치유", "부활", "소생", "응급", "보살핌", "돌봄", "힐",
        "heal", "healing", "recover", "recovery", "restore", "revive", "mend", "cure", "first aid",
        "回復", "治癒", "蘇生", "癒"
    }) do
        local needle = tostring(cue or "")
        if needle ~= "" and (text:find(needle, 1, true) or lower:find(needle:lower(), 1, true)) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmSkillUseHealsAlly(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef, role, kind)
    if kind ~= "ally" then return false end
    if role == "heal" or role == "support" then return true end
    if role == "protect" then
        return tmSkillMetadataHasRecoveryCue(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    end
    return false
end

function tmSkillUseTarget(triggerId, ownerId, target)
    local raw = tostring(target or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if raw == "" or raw == "self" then return "ally", ownerId end
    local kind, id = raw:match("^([%w_]+):(.*)$")
    if kind == "ally" and CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] then return "ally", id end
    if kind == "enemy" then
        if id == "" or id == "current" then id = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "") end
        if id ~= "" then return "enemy", id end
    end
    if kind == "npc" or kind == "gimmick" then return kind, id end
    if raw == "scene" then return "scene", raw end
    return "ally", ownerId
end

function tmApplySkillUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef, target, source)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_use_bad_owner"); return "" end
    skillRef = tmResolveSkillUseRef(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    local owned = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", "")
    if not csvListContains(owned, skillRef) then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_use_not_owned"); return "" end
    local loadout = tmOwnerSkillLoadout(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not csvListContains(loadout, skillRef) then tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_use_not_loaded"); return "" end
    local mpCost = tmSkillMpCost(triggerId, skillRef)
    if mpCost > 0 and tmOwnerHasCondition(triggerId, ownerId, "silence") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_silenced")
        return ""
    end
    if getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp", 0) < mpCost then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_mp_short")
        return ""
    end

    local kind, targetId = tmSkillUseTarget(triggerId, ownerId, target)
    local appliedKey = tmSkillUseMaterialKey(ownerId, skillRef, kind, targetId)
    if tmSkillUseAppliedKeySeen(triggerId, appliedKey) then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_skill_use_last_result", "blocked|" .. tostring(source or "main_writer") .. "|" .. appliedKey .. "|duplicate")
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skill_use_duplicate")
        return ""
    end
    if mpCost > 0 then adjustHeroineMp(triggerId, ownerId, -mpCost) end
    tmRememberSkillUseAppliedKey(triggerId, appliedKey)

    local role = tmSkillRole(triggerId, skillRef)
    local amount = tmSkillAmountDetails(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef).amount
    local effectText = "effect"
    if tmSkillUseHealsAlly(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef, role, kind) and CHAR_NAMES_KO[targetId] then
        healHeroine(triggerId, targetId, amount)
        effectText = "heal +" .. tostring(amount) .. " to " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, targetId)
    elseif kind == "enemy" and targetId ~= "" then
        loadEnemy(triggerId, targetId)
        tmApplyEnemyDamage(triggerId, targetId, amount, "skill:" .. tostring(skillRef))
        effectText = "damage " .. tostring(amount) .. " to " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId)
    end
    -- D045/P047 T002: fire the USED skill's own structured effect on the on_use event.
    -- Target kind/id come from tmSkillUseTarget (kind/targetId already computed above).
    local usedEffect = tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", skillRef)
    if usedEffect then
        usedEffect.sourceRef = skillRef
        usedEffect.parentRef = usedEffect.parentRef or skillRef
        if tmResolveEffectTrigger(usedEffect, "on_use") then
            local cat, amt = tmApplyRuntimeEffect(usedEffect, {
                triggerId = triggerId,
                actorId = ownerId,
                targetId = targetId,
                targetKind = kind,
                event = "on_use",
            })
            effectText = effectText .. " / fx " .. tostring(cat) .. (((tonumber(amt) or 0) > 0) and (" " .. tostring(amt)) or "")
        end
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "skill_use:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. skillRef)
    if kind == "enemy" and targetId ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true" then
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy_defeated:" .. targetId)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_skill_use_last_result", "applied|" .. tostring(source or "main_writer") .. "|" .. appliedKey .. "|" .. effectText)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "SKILL_USE: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " / " .. tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, skillRef) .. " / MP -" .. tostring(mpCost) .. " / " .. effectText)
    return ""
end

-- === Runtime object slots (enemy / npc / gimmick) ===
-- Fixed slots avoid creating one variable per temporary scene object. Records:
-- kind^id^name^state^stats^note

TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT = 10
TM_OBJECT_FIELD_MAX = 96

function tmObjectSlotVar(slot)
    return string.format("tm_obj_%02d", tonumber(slot) or 1)
end

function tmClearRuntimeObjects(triggerId)
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        setVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), "")
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_next_slot", "1")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_last", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy_slot", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_npc", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_npc_slot", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_gimmick", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_gimmick_slot", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_runtime_object_error", "")
end

function tmClearRuntimeEnemies(triggerId)
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local varName = tmObjectSlotVar(slot)
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, varName, ""))
        if fields[1] == "enemy" then
            setVar(triggerId, varName, "")
        end
    end
    local last = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_last", ""))
    if last[2] == "enemy" then setVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_last", "") end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy_slot", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy:none")
end

function tmResetTerminalEnemyAutoclear(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_autoclear_terminal_episode", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_autoclear_terminal_reason", "")
end

function tmRuntimeEnemyStateExists(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "") ~= "" then return true end
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] == "enemy" and fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] ~= "-" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmMaybeAutoclearEnemyForTerminalEpisode(triggerId, source)
    local progress = getVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "none")
    if progress ~= "cleared" and progress ~= "failed" then return false end
    local episodeId = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    if episodeId == "" or episodeId == "none" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_autoclear_terminal_episode", "") == episodeId then
        return false
    end
    local hadEnemyState = tmRuntimeEnemyStateExists(triggerId)
    if hadEnemyState then
        tmClearRuntimeEnemies(triggerId)
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_autoclear_terminal_episode", episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_autoclear_terminal_reason",
        progress .. ":" .. tostring(source or "") .. ":" .. (hadEnemyState and "cleared" or "empty"))
    return hadEnemyState
end

function tmMarkTerminalEnemyAutoclearProcessed(triggerId, source)
    local progress = getVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "none")
    if progress ~= "cleared" and progress ~= "failed" then return end
    local episodeId = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    if episodeId == "" or episodeId == "none" then return end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_autoclear_terminal_episode", episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_enemy_autoclear_terminal_reason",
        progress .. ":" .. tostring(source or "") .. ":enemy_set")
end

function tmObjectSlotId(slot)
    return string.format("%02d", tonumber(slot) or 1)
end

function tmObjectFields(record)
    local fields = {}
    for field in tostring(record or ""):gmatch("[^%^]+") do
        table.insert(fields, field)
    end
    for i = #fields + 1, 6 do fields[i] = "" end
    return fields
end

function tmFindActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] == "enemy" and fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] ~= "-" then
            local enemyId = fields[2]
            local state = fields[4] ~= "" and fields[4] or "active"
            if state == "active" and not tmEnemyIsDefeated(triggerId, enemyId) then
                return enemyId, tmObjectSlotId(slot)
            end
        end
    end
    return "", ""
end

function tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
    local enemyId, slotId = tmFindActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
    if enemyId == "" then return "" end
    loadEnemy(triggerId, enemyId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", enemyId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy_slot", slotId)
    return enemyId
end

function tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(value)
    return tostring(value or ""):lower():match("^en_l%d") ~= nil
end

function tmRuntimeObjectFallbackName(triggerId, kind, objectId)
    local id = tostring(objectId or "")
    if kind == "enemy" and tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(id) then
        return T(triggerId, "미지의 적", "Unknown Enemy", "未知の敵")
    end
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        if kind == "enemy" then return "위협 " .. id end
        if kind == "gimmick" then return "기믹 " .. id end
        if kind == "npc" then return "NPC " .. id end
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        if kind == "enemy" then return "脅威 " .. id end
        if kind == "gimmick" then return "ギミック " .. id end
        if kind == "npc" then return "NPC " .. id end
    end
    return id
end

function tmObjectSanitize(value, maxChars)
    local s = tmLootSanitizeText(value, maxChars or TM_OBJECT_FIELD_MAX)
    if s == "" then return "-" end
    return s
end

function tmRuntimeObjectRecord(kind, objectId, name, state, stats, note)
    return table.concat({
        tmObjectSanitize(kind, 16),
        tmObjectSanitize(objectId, 48),
        tmObjectSanitize(name ~= "" and name or objectId, 48),
        tmObjectSanitize(state ~= "" and state or "active", 24),
        tmObjectSanitize(stats, 120),
        tmObjectSanitize(note, 120),
    }, "^")
end

function tmNextObjectSlot(triggerId)
    local slot = getNumVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_next_slot", 1)
    slot = clamp(slot, 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT)
    local nextSlot = slot + 1
    if nextSlot > TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT then nextSlot = 1 end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_next_slot", nextSlot)
    return slot
end

function tmStoreRuntimeObject(triggerId, kind, objectId, name, state, stats, note)
    local slot = tmNextObjectSlot(triggerId)
    local slotId = tmObjectSlotId(slot)
    local cleanKind = tmObjectSanitize(kind, 16)
    local cleanId = tmObjectSanitize(objectId, 48)
    setVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), tmRuntimeObjectRecord(cleanKind, cleanId, name or cleanId, state or "active", stats or "-", note or "-"))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_last", slotId .. "^" .. cleanKind .. "^" .. cleanId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_" .. cleanKind, cleanId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_" .. cleanKind .. "_slot", slotId)
    return slotId
end

function tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, kind)
    local slotId = getVar(triggerId, "current_" .. kind .. "_slot", "")
    if slotId ~= "" then return tonumber(slotId) end
    local last = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_last", ""))
    if last[2] == kind then return tonumber(last[1]) end
    return nil
end

function tmClearCurrentRuntimeObjectRef(triggerId, kind, slot, objectId)
    local cleanKind = tostring(kind or "")
    if cleanKind == "" then return false end
    local slotNum = tonumber(slot)
    local slotId = slotNum and tmObjectSlotId(slotNum) or ""
    local expectedId = tostring(objectId or "")
    local currentSlotId = getVar(triggerId, "current_" .. cleanKind .. "_slot", "")
    local currentId = getVar(triggerId, "current_" .. cleanKind, "")
    local changed = false
    if currentSlotId ~= "" or currentId ~= "" then
        if slotId ~= "" and currentSlotId ~= "" and tonumber(currentSlotId) ~= slotNum then return false end
        if expectedId ~= "" and expectedId ~= "none" and currentId ~= "" and currentId ~= expectedId then return false end
        setVar(triggerId, "current_" .. cleanKind, "")
        setVar(triggerId, "current_" .. cleanKind .. "_slot", "")
        changed = true
    end
    local last = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_last", ""))
    if last[2] == cleanKind then
        local slotMatches = slotId == "" or last[1] == slotId
        local idMatches = expectedId == "" or expectedId == "none" or last[3] == expectedId
        if slotMatches and idMatches then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_obj_last", "")
            changed = true
        end
    end
    return changed
end

function tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, kind, slot, fieldIndex, value)
    local slotNum = tonumber(slot)
    if not slotNum or slotNum < 1 or slotNum > TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT or math.floor(slotNum) ~= slotNum then return false end
    local varName = tmObjectSlotVar(slotNum)
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, varName, ""))
    if fields[1] ~= kind then return false end
    -- Field 6 = readable note (120). Field 7 = D045 machine tuple, which can reach
    -- ~57 chars worst-case (e.g. S:on_damage_taken:condition_immunity:weakened:con:gimmick)
    -- so it needs the wide cap or the ':'-tuple would truncate. Other fields: 48.
    local cap = 48
    if fieldIndex == 6 then cap = 120 elseif fieldIndex == 7 then cap = TM_OBJECT_FIELD_MAX end
    fields[fieldIndex] = tmObjectSanitize(value, cap)
    setVar(triggerId, varName, table.concat(fields, "^"))
    return true
end

function tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, kind, fieldIndex, value)
    local slot = tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, kind)
    if not slot then return false end
    return tmUpdateRuntimeObjectSlotField(triggerId, kind, slot, fieldIndex, value)
end

function tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, kind, objectId)
    local id = tostring(objectId or "")
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] == kind and fields[2] == id and fields[3] ~= "" and fields[3] ~= "-" then
            if tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, fields[3]) then return fields[3] end
            return tmRuntimeObjectFallbackName(triggerId, kind, id)
        end
    end
    return tmRuntimeObjectFallbackName(triggerId, kind, id)
end

function tmParseRuntimeStats(stats)
    local out = {}
    for pair in tostring(stats or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local k, v = pair:match("^%s*([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if k and v then out[k] = v end
    end
    return out
end

-- tmGimmickRecordEffectFields: parse the ':'-packed machine tuple from a gimmick
-- record's field 7 directly (no var re-read), enriched with readable text from
-- field 6, into a `fields` table for tmEffectTooltipHtml. nil when no tuple.
function tmGimmickRecordEffectFields(record)
    local tuple = record and record[7]
    if not tuple or tuple == "" or tuple == "-" then return nil end
    local grade, trigger, effect, condition, stat, target =
        tuple:match("^([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*)$")
    if not grade then return nil end
    if not TM_EFFECT_GRADES[grade] then grade = "C" end
    local _, _, dice = tmEffectGradeDice(grade)
    local effId = (effect ~= nil and effect ~= "") and effect or "utility"
    local note = record[6]
    return {
        grade = grade,
        dice = dice,
        trigger = (trigger ~= nil and trigger ~= "") and trigger or nil,
        effect = effId,
        condition = (condition ~= nil and condition ~= "") and condition or nil,
        stat = (stat ~= nil and stat ~= "") and stat or nil,
        target = (target ~= nil and target ~= "") and target or nil,
        text = (note ~= nil and note ~= "" and note ~= "-") and note or nil,
        statChanges = (effId == "buff_stat" or effId == "debuff_stat"),
    }
end

-- tmRuntimeObjectTooltip: returns ALREADY-ESCAPED tooltip HTML. Gimmicks with a
-- stored structured effect (field 7) get the rich tmEffectTooltipHtml; all other
-- objects (and effect-less gimmicks) get the legacy key=value text escaped once.
function tmRuntimeObjectTooltip(triggerId, fields, slot)
    if fields[1] == "gimmick" then
        local rich = tmEffectTooltipHtml(tmGimmickRecordEffectFields(fields), triggerId)
        if rich then return rich end
    end
    local stats = tmParseRuntimeStats(fields[5] or "")
    local bits = {
        "slot=" .. tmObjectSlotId(slot),
        "kind=" .. tostring(fields[1] or ""),
        "id=" .. tostring(fields[2] or ""),
        "state=" .. tostring(fields[4] or ""),
    }
    for _, key in ipairs({"hp", "hp_max", "dc", "atk", "band", "tier", "type", "role", "stance"}) do
        if stats[key] and stats[key] ~= "" then table.insert(bits, key .. "=" .. stats[key]) end
    end
    if fields[6] and fields[6] ~= "" and fields[6] ~= "-" then table.insert(bits, "note=" .. fields[6]) end
    return tmEscapeHtml(table.concat(bits, " / "))
end

function tmRuntimeObjectSummary(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] ~= "" and fields[1] ~= "-" and fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] ~= "-" then
            table.insert(rows, string.format("- slot=%s kind=%s id=%s name=%s state=%s stats=%s note=%s",
                tmObjectSlotId(slot),
                fields[1],
                fields[2],
                fields[3],
                fields[4],
                fields[5],
                fields[6]))
        end
    end
    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

function tmRuntimeObjectHtml(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
        if fields[1] ~= "" and fields[1] ~= "-" and fields[2] ~= "" and fields[2] ~= "-" then
            local stats = tmParseRuntimeStats(fields[5] or "")
            local state = fields[4] or "active"
            local short = state
            if stats.hp and stats.hp_max then short = short .. " / HP " .. stats.hp .. "/" .. stats.hp_max end
            if stats.dc then short = short .. " / DC " .. stats.dc end
            table.insert(rows, '<li><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, fields[1], fields[2])) .. '</b><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(fields[1] .. " · " .. short) .. '</span><span class="tm-guide-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="runtime object detail">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip">' .. tmRuntimeObjectTooltip(triggerId, fields, slot) .. '</span></span></li>')
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then return "" end
    return '<ul class="tm-runtime-object-list">' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</ul>'
end

TM_GIMMICK_TIERS = { minor = true, standard = true, severe = true, apex = true }
TM_GIMMICK_TYPES = {
    trap = true, puzzle = true, hazard = true, social = true, chase = true,
    magical = true, environmental = true, nsfw_trap = true
}
TM_NPC_ROLES = {
    questgiver = true, bystander = true, rival = true, ally = true, captive = true,
    merchant = true, guard = true, adventurer = true, cultist = true, scholar = true
}
TM_NPC_STANCES = { friendly = true, neutral = true, wary = true, hostile = true, unknown = true }

function tmGimmickDcFor(band, tier)
    local tierBonus = { minor = -1, standard = 0, severe = 2, apex = 4 }
    return clamp(9 + 2 * (tonumber(band) or 1) + (tierBonus[tier] or 0), 8, 24)
end

function tmParseGimmickFormulaId(gimmickId)
    local id = tostring(gimmickId or "")
    if #id == 0 or #id > 40 then return nil end
    local n, tier, gtype = id:match("^gm_l(%d%d?)_([a-z]+)_([a-z_]+)$")
    if not n then return nil end
    local band = clamp(tonumber(n) or 1, 1, 5)
    if not TM_GIMMICK_TIERS[tier] then tier = "standard" end
    if not TM_GIMMICK_TYPES[gtype] then gtype = "hazard" end
    return { band = band, tier = tier, type = gtype, dc = tmGimmickDcFor(band, tier) }
end

function tmParseNpcFormulaId(npcId)
    local id = tostring(npcId or "")
    if #id == 0 or #id > 48 then return nil end
    local n, role, stance = id:match("^npc_l(%d%d?)_([a-z_]+)_([a-z_]+)$")
    if not n then return nil end
    local band = clamp(tonumber(n) or 1, 1, 5)
    if not TM_NPC_ROLES[role] then role = "bystander" end
    if not TM_NPC_STANCES[stance] then stance = "unknown" end
    return { band = band, role = role, stance = stance }
end

function tmNpcStatsFor(formula)
    local band = formula and formula.band or 1
    local hp = 8 + band * 4
    local dc = tmEnemyDcFor(band)
    local atk = math.max(1, band + 2)
    return hp, dc, atk
end

function tmStoreRuntimeGimmick(triggerId, gimmickId)
    local formula = tmParseGimmickFormulaId(gimmickId)
    if not formula then return nil end
    local stats = table.concat({
        "band=" .. tostring(formula.band),
        "tier=" .. formula.tier,
        "type=" .. formula.type,
        "dc=" .. tostring(formula.dc),
    }, ",")
    local slot = tmStoreRuntimeObject(triggerId, "gimmick", gimmickId, gimmickId, "active", stats, "-")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "gimmick:" .. gimmickId)
    return slot
end

function tmStoreRuntimeNpc(triggerId, npcId)
    local formula = tmParseNpcFormulaId(npcId)
    if not formula then return nil end
    local hp, dc, atk = tmNpcStatsFor(formula)
    local stats = table.concat({
        "band=" .. tostring(formula.band),
        "role=" .. formula.role,
        "stance=" .. formula.stance,
        "hp=" .. tostring(hp),
        "dc=" .. tostring(dc),
        "atk=" .. tostring(atk),
    }, ",")
    local slot = tmStoreRuntimeObject(triggerId, "npc", npcId, npcId, formula.stance, stats, "-")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "npc:" .. npcId)
    return slot
end

function tmRarityLabel(triggerId, rarity)
    local r = tostring(rarity or "common")
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        if r == "rare" then return "희귀" end
        if r == "uncommon" then return "고급" end
        return "일반"
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        if r == "rare" then return "レア" end
        if r == "uncommon" then return "アンコモン" end
        return "コモン"
    end
    return r
end

-- tmItemDisplayName: itNNN -> "name(rarity)" from registry; legacy eq_l IDs and
-- unknown refs stay as raw id.
function tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, itemId)
    if not tostring(itemId):match("^it%d+$") then return itemId end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemId)
    if not record then return itemId end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    if not fields[2] then return itemId end
    local name = tmTrimVisibleText(fields[2])
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" and not tmTextHasHangul(name) then
        name = "아이템 " .. tostring(itemId)
    end
    return name .. "(" .. tmRarityLabel(triggerId, fields[3] or "common") .. ")"
end

-- tmSkillDisplayName: skNNN -> "name(rarity)" from party_skill_registry
-- (fields 3=name, 4=rarity); non-skNNN and unknown refs stay as raw id.
function tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, skillId)
    if not tostring(skillId):match("^sk%d+$") then return skillId end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", skillId)
    if not record then return skillId end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    if not fields[3] then return skillId end
    local name = tmTrimVisibleText(fields[3])
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" and not tmTextHasHangul(name) then
        name = "스킬 " .. tostring(skillId)
    end
    return name .. "(" .. tmRarityLabel(triggerId, fields[4] or "common") .. ")"
end

function tmFormulaParts(id)
    local level, stat, role = tostring(id):match("^%a+_l(%d+)_([a-z]+)_([a-z_]+)$")
    if not level or not TM_STAT_LABELS[stat] then return nil end
    return level, stat, role
end

function tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, role)
    role = tostring(role or "")
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        return TM_ROLE_LABELS_KO[role] or ""
    end
    local labels = {
        strike = "strike", guard = "guard", trick = "trick", burst = "burst",
        heal = "healing", support = "support", control = "control", evade = "evasion",
        focus = "focus", sword = "sword", smite = "smite",
    }
    return labels[role] or role:gsub("_", " ")
end

function tmFormulaSuffix(triggerId, kind)
    if kind == "skill" then return T(triggerId, "스킬", "skill", "スキル") end
    return T(triggerId, "장비", "equipment", "装備")
end

-- tmFormulaLabel: formula id (eq_lN_stat_role / sk_lN_stat_role) -> visible
-- label. Returns nil when the stat token is not known so the caller keeps raw id.
function tmFormulaLabel(triggerId, id, kind)
    local level, stat, role = tmFormulaParts(id)
    if not level then return nil end
    local roleLabel = tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, role)
    local suffix = tmFormulaSuffix(triggerId, kind)
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        local statLabel = TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[stat] or stat
        if roleLabel ~= "" then
            return "Lv" .. level .. " " .. statLabel .. " " .. roleLabel .. " " .. suffix
        end
        return "Lv" .. level .. " " .. statLabel .. " " .. suffix
    end
    local statLabel = TM_STAT_LABELS[stat] or stat
    if roleLabel ~= "" then
        return "Lv" .. level .. " " .. statLabel .. " " .. roleLabel .. " " .. suffix
    end
    return "Lv" .. level .. " " .. statLabel .. " " .. suffix
end

function tmFormulaDescription(triggerId, id, kind)
    local level, stat, role = tmFormulaParts(id)
    if not level then return "" end
    local suffix = tmFormulaSuffix(triggerId, kind)
    local roleLabel = tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, role)
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        local statLabel = TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[stat] or stat
        local usage = TM_STAT_USAGE_KO[stat] or "판정"
        local roleText = roleLabel ~= "" and (roleLabel .. " 역할의 ") or ""
        return "Lv" .. level .. " " .. statLabel .. " 기반 " .. roleText .. suffix .. "입니다. " .. usage .. "에 어울립니다."
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        local statLabel = TM_STAT_LABELS[stat] or stat
        local roleText = roleLabel ~= "" and (roleLabel .. " ") or ""
        return "Lv" .. level .. " " .. statLabel .. " 기반の" .. roleText .. suffix .. "です。"
    end
    local statLabel = TM_STAT_LABELS[stat] or stat
    local roleText = roleLabel ~= "" and (roleLabel .. " ") or ""
    return "Level " .. level .. " " .. statLabel .. "-based " .. roleText .. suffix .. "."
end

-- tmEquipLabel: human display label for any equipment-ish id. itNNN goes through
-- the registry, eq_l formula ids become Korean labels, anything else stays raw.
function tmEquipLabel(triggerId, itemId)
    local id = tostring(itemId or "")
    if id:match("^it%d+$") then return tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, id) end
    if id:match("^eq_l%d+_") then return tmFormulaLabel(triggerId, id, "equipment") or id end
    return id
end

-- tmSkillLabel: skill counterpart of tmEquipLabel.
function tmSkillLabel(triggerId, skillId)
    local id = tostring(skillId or "")
    if id:match("^sk%d+$") then return tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, id) end
    if id:match("^sk_l%d+_") then return tmFormulaLabel(triggerId, id, "skill") or id end
    return id
end

function tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, itemId)
    local id = tostring(itemId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if id == "" or id == "none" then return "미정" end
    if id:match("^it%d+$") then return tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, id) end
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(ownerId or "") .. "_class", "rogue")
    local classDefaultName = tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, classId, "equipment", id, "equipment_name")
    local equipped = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(ownerId or "") .. "_equipment", "")
    local displayName = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(ownerId or "") .. "_equipment_name", "")
    if id:match("^eq_l%d+_") and csvListContains(equipped, id) and tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, displayName, "equipment") then
        return displayName
    end
    if classDefaultName ~= "" then return classDefaultName end
    return tmEquipLabel(triggerId, id)
end

function tmOwnerSkillLabel(triggerId, ownerId, skillId)
    local id = tostring(skillId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if id == "" or id == "none" then return "미정" end
    if id:match("^sk%d+$") then return tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, id) end
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(ownerId or "") .. "_class", "rogue")
    local classDefaultName = tmLoadoutFallbackTextForRefFor(triggerId, classId, "skill", id, "skill_name")
    local skills = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(ownerId or "") .. "_skills", "")
    local displayName = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(ownerId or "") .. "_skill_name", "")
    if id:match("^sk_l%d+_") and csvListContains(skills, id) and tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, displayName, "skill") then
        return displayName
    end
    if classDefaultName ~= "" then return classDefaultName end
    return tmSkillLabel(triggerId, id)
end

function tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, varName, ref)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, varName, "none")
    if registry == "none" or registry == "" then return "" end
    for record in registry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
        if fields[1] == ref or fields[2] == ref then
            return fields[4] or ""
        end
    end
    return ""
end

-- tmRuntimeEffectsForRef: read the structured machine fields (5-7) of an effect
-- note record. Returns {grade, trigger, effect, condition, stat, target, dice}
-- or nil when the record is prose-only (<5 fields). Mirrors the matching of
-- tmRegistryNoteForRef (field1 or field2).
function tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, varName, ref)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, varName, "none")
    if registry == "none" or registry == "" then return nil end
    for record in registry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
        if fields[1] == ref or fields[2] == ref then
            if #fields < 5 then return nil end
            local grade = fields[5] or "C"
            local trigger = fields[6] or ""
            local tuple = fields[7] or ""
            local effect, condition, stat, target =
                tuple:match("^([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*)$")
            local _, _, dice = tmEffectGradeDice(grade)
            return {
                grade = grade,
                trigger = trigger,
                effect = (effect ~= nil and effect ~= "") and effect or "utility",
                condition = (condition ~= nil and condition ~= "") and condition or nil,
                stat = (stat ~= nil and stat ~= "") and stat or nil,
                target = (target ~= nil and target ~= "") and target or nil,
                dice = dice,
            }
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- tmGimmickRuntimeEffectFields: re-parse the ':'-packed machine tuple stored in
-- field 7 of the gimmick runtime object (written by the GIMMICK_EFFECT handler).
-- Returns {grade, trigger, effect, condition, stat, target, dice} or nil when no
-- gimmick is current or no machine tuple was stored. Slot defaults to the current
-- gimmick slot; an explicit slot may be passed.
function tmGimmickRuntimeEffectFields(triggerId, slot)
    slot = slot or tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "gimmick")
    if not slot then return nil end
    local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
    if fields[1] ~= "gimmick" then return nil end
    local tuple = fields[7]
    if not tuple or tuple == "" or tuple == "-" then return nil end
    local grade, trigger, effect, condition, stat, target =
        tuple:match("^([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*):([^:]*)$")
    if not grade then return nil end
    if not TM_EFFECT_GRADES[grade] then grade = "C" end
    local _, _, dice = tmEffectGradeDice(grade)
    return {
        grade = grade,
        trigger = (trigger ~= nil and trigger ~= "") and trigger or nil,
        effect = (effect ~= nil and effect ~= "") and effect or "utility",
        condition = (condition ~= nil and condition ~= "") and condition or nil,
        stat = (stat ~= nil and stat ~= "") and stat or nil,
        target = (target ~= nil and target ~= "") and target or nil,
        dice = dice,
    }
end

    condition_resist = "condition resist",
    condition_immunity = "condition immunity",
    heal = "healing",
    mp_restore = "MP restore",
    mp_reduce = "MP reduce",
    buff_stat = "stat buff",
    debuff_stat = "stat debuff",
    utility = "utility",
}
TM_EFFECT_CATEGORY_LABELS_JA = {
    damage = "ダメージ",
    condition = "状態付与",
    damage_condition = "ダメージ+状態",
    damage_reduction = "ダメージ軽減",
    condition_resist = "状態耐性",
    condition_immunity = "状態無効",
    heal = "回復",
    mp_restore = "MP回復",
    mp_reduce = "MP減少",
    buff_stat = "能力強化",
    debuff_stat = "能力弱化",
    utility = "ユーティリティ",
}
function tmEffectCategoryLabel(cat, triggerId)
    local id = tostring(cat or "")
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "en" then return TM_EFFECT_CATEGORY_LABELS_EN[id] or id end
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then return TM_EFFECT_CATEGORY_LABELS_JA[id] or TM_EFFECT_CATEGORY_LABELS_EN[id] or id end
    return TM_EFFECT_CATEGORY_LABELS_KO[id] or id
end

-- tmTargetLabel: localized label for an effect target (TM_EFFECT_TARGETS).
TM_EFFECT_TARGET_LABELS_KO = {
    self = "자신",
    ally = "아군",
    enemy = "적",
    scene = "장면",
    gimmick = "기믹",
}
TM_EFFECT_TARGET_LABELS_EN = {
    self = "self",
    ally = "ally",
    enemy = "enemy",
    scene = "scene",
    gimmick = "gimmick",
}
TM_EFFECT_TARGET_LABELS_JA = {
    self = "自分",
    ally = "味方",
    enemy = "敵",
    scene = "シーン",
    gimmick = "ギミック",
}
function tmTargetLabel(t, triggerId)
    local id = tostring(t or "")
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "en" then return TM_EFFECT_TARGET_LABELS_EN[id] or id end
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then return TM_EFFECT_TARGET_LABELS_JA[id] or TM_EFFECT_TARGET_LABELS_EN[id] or id end
    return TM_EFFECT_TARGET_LABELS_KO[id] or id
end

function tmTooltipRowHtml(key, value)
    local v = tostring(value or "")
    if v == "" or v == "none" or v == "-" then return "" end
    return '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">'
        .. tmEscapeHtml(key) .. '</span><span class="tm-tip-v">'
        .. tmEscapeHtml(v) .. '</span></span>'
end

-- tmMechanicTooltipHtml: returns ALREADY-ESCAPED deterministic tooltip HTML.
-- `extraHtml` must already be escaped; callers use it for structured effect rows.
function tmMechanicTooltipHtml(triggerId, title, rows, prose, extraHtml)
    local out = {}
    local cleanTitle = tmTrimVisibleText(title)
    if cleanTitle ~= "" then
        table.insert(out, '<span class="tm-tip-grade">' .. tmEscapeHtml(cleanTitle) .. '</span>')
    end
    for _, row in ipairs(rows or {}) do
        local key = row[1] or row.key or ""
        local value = row[2] or row.value or ""
        local html = tmTooltipRowHtml(key, value)
        if html ~= "" then table.insert(out, html) end
    end
    if extraHtml and extraHtml ~= "" then table.insert(out, extraHtml) end
    local cleanProse = tmSanitizeLoadoutDescription(prose)
    if cleanProse ~= "" then
        table.insert(out, tmTooltipRowHtml(tmTooltipLabel(triggerId, "explanation"), cleanProse))
    end
    if #out == 0 then
        return tmTooltipProseHtml("", T(triggerId, "설명이 아직 없습니다.", "No description yet.", "説明はまだありません。"))
    end
    return table.concat(out, "")
end

function tmTooltipStatChangeText(triggerId, changed, statId)
    if not changed then
        return T(triggerId, "유효 능력치 변동 없음", "no effective stat change", "有効能力の変動なし")
    end
    local statName = statId ~= "" and tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, statId) or ""
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        return statName ~= "" and ("유효 능력치 변동 있음 (" .. statName .. ")") or "유효 능력치 변동 있음"
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        return statName ~= "" and ("有効能力の変動あり (" .. statName .. ")") or "有効能力の変動あり"
    end
    return statName ~= "" and ("effective stat change (" .. statName .. ")") or "effective stat change"
end

-- tmEffectTooltipHtml: build an ALREADY-ESCAPED rich tooltip from a `fields`
-- table {grade, dice, trigger, effect, condition, stat, target, text,
-- statChanges}. Each dynamic value is individually tmEscapeHtml-ed. Returns nil
-- when fields is nil so callers can fall back to the legacy text tooltip.
function tmEffectTooltipHtml(fields, triggerId)
    if not fields then return nil end
    local rows = {}
    local grade = tostring(fields.grade or "C")
    local dice = tostring(fields.dice or "")
    local gradeLine = tmEscapeHtml(grade)
    if dice ~= "" then gradeLine = gradeLine .. " · " .. tmEscapeHtml(dice) end
    table.insert(rows, '<span class="tm-tip-grade">' .. gradeLine .. '</span>')

    local function addRow(k, v)
        local html = tmTooltipRowHtml(k, v)
        if html ~= "" then table.insert(rows, html) end
    end

    local trigger = tostring(fields.trigger or "")
    if trigger ~= "" then addRow(tmTooltipLabel(triggerId, "trigger"), tmEffectTriggerLabel(triggerId, trigger)) end

    local effect = tostring(fields.effect or "")
    if effect ~= "" then addRow(tmTooltipLabel(triggerId, "kind"), tmEffectCategoryLabel(effect, triggerId)) end

    local condId = tostring(fields.condition or "")
    if condId ~= "" then
        addRow(tmTooltipLabel(triggerId, "condition"), tmTooltipConditionLabel(triggerId, condId))
    end

    local target = tostring(fields.target or "")
    if target ~= "" then addRow(tmTooltipLabel(triggerId, "target"), tmTargetLabel(target, triggerId)) end

    -- D043 line: does this effect change an ability score?
    local statChanges = fields.statChanges
    if statChanges == nil then
        statChanges = (effect == "buff_stat" or effect == "debuff_stat")
    end
    if statChanges then
        local statId = tostring(fields.stat or "")
        table.insert(rows, '<span class="tm-tip-eff-yes">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmTooltipStatChangeText(triggerId, true, statId)) .. '</span>')
    else
        table.insert(rows, '<span class="tm-tip-eff-no">' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmTooltipStatChangeText(triggerId, false, "")) .. '</span>')
    end

    local text = tostring(fields.text or "")
    if text ~= "" then addRow(tmTooltipLabel(triggerId, "explanation"), text) end

    return table.concat(rows, "")
end

-- tmItemEffectFields: structured `fields` table for an item ref, or nil when the
-- item has no stored structured effect (prose-only / none).
function tmItemEffectFields(triggerId, ref)
    local eff = tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", ref)
    if not eff then return nil end
    eff.text = tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", ref)
    eff.statChanges = (eff.effect == "buff_stat" or eff.effect == "debuff_stat")
    return eff
end

-- tmSkillEffectFields: structured `fields` table for a skill ref, or nil.
function tmSkillEffectFields(triggerId, ref)
    local eff = tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", ref)
    if not eff then return nil end
    eff.text = tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", ref)
    eff.statChanges = (eff.effect == "buff_stat" or eff.effect == "debuff_stat")
    return eff
end

function tmTooltipProseHtml(text, fallback)
    local clean = tmSanitizeLoadoutDescription(text)
    if clean == "" then clean = fallback or "설명이 아직 없습니다." end
    return '<span class="tm-tip-prose">' .. tmEscapeHtml(clean) .. '</span>'
end

function tmOwnerLoadoutDescription(triggerId, ownerId, kind, ref)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[tostring(ownerId or "")] then return "" end
    local id = tostring(ref or "")
    local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(ownerId or "") .. "_class", "rogue")
    if kind == "skill" then
        local desc = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skill_desc", "")
        if tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, desc, "skill") then return desc end
        local classDefaultDesc = tmLoadoutFallbackTextForRefFor(triggerId, classId, "skill", id, "skill_desc")
        if classDefaultDesc ~= "" then return classDefaultDesc end
        if id:match("^sk_l%d+_") then return tmFormulaDescription(triggerId, id, "skill") end
        return ""
    end
    local desc = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment_desc", "")
    if tmUseStoredLoadoutVisibleText(triggerId, desc, "equipment") then return desc end
    local classDefaultDesc = tmClassDefaultLoadoutTextForRefFor(triggerId, classId, "equipment", id, "equipment_desc")
    if classDefaultDesc ~= "" then return classDefaultDesc end
    if id:match("^eq_l%d+_") then return tmFormulaDescription(triggerId, id, "equipment") end
    return ""
end

function tmStoredEffectDescription(triggerId, varName, ref)
    local note = tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, varName, ref)
    if tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, note) then return note end
    return ""
end

function tmRuntimeItemGeneratedDescription(triggerId, itemId)
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemId)
    if not record then return "" end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    local kind = tmNormalizeRuntimeItemKind(fields[5] or "item")
    local stat = fields[8] or ""
    local role = fields[9] or ""
    if kind == "equipment" then
        local statLabel = stat ~= "" and stat ~= "none" and tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, stat) or ""
        local roleLabel = role ~= "" and role ~= "none" and tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, role) or ""
        if tmLang(triggerId) == "en" then
            return "Equipment. Equip it to use its " .. (statLabel ~= "" and statLabel or "stat") .. (roleLabel ~= "" and (" " .. roleLabel) or "") .. " profile."
        elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
            return "装備品です。装備すると" .. (statLabel ~= "" and statLabel or "能力") .. (roleLabel ~= "" and ("・" .. roleLabel) or "") .. "の特性を使います。"
        end
        return "장비입니다. 장착하면 " .. (statLabel ~= "" and statLabel or "능력치") .. (roleLabel ~= "" and (" " .. roleLabel) or "") .. " 특성을 사용합니다."
    elseif kind == "key" then
        return T(triggerId, "시나리오 진행용 열쇠/단서 아이템입니다.", "Key item for scenario progress.", "シナリオ進行用のキーアイテムです。")
    end
    return T(triggerId, "소모품입니다. 등록된 사용 효과가 있으면 사용 시 적용됩니다.", "Consumable item. A registered use effect applies when used.", "消耗品です。登録された使用効果があれば使用時に適用されます。")
end

function tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, labelKey, value)
    local v = tostring(value or "")
    if v == "" or v == "none" or v == "-" then return end
    table.insert(rows, {tmTooltipLabel(triggerId, labelKey), v})
end

function tmSkillAmountDetails(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    local stat = tmSkillStat(triggerId, skillRef)
    local levelBonus = tmDynamicLeveledBonus(tmSkillBaseId(triggerId, skillRef))
    local effectiveStat, baseStat, statBonus = tmEffectivePlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, stat, 10)
    local statMod = math.max(0, getAbilityMod(effectiveStat))
    local amount = 2 + levelBonus + statMod
    return {
        amount = amount,
        stat = stat,
        baseStat = baseStat,
        statBonus = statBonus,
        effectiveStat = effectiveStat,
        statMod = statMod,
        levelBonus = levelBonus,
    }
end

function tmSkillEffectiveStatTooltipText(triggerId, details)
    if not details then return "" end
    local statName = tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, details.stat)
    local base = tonumber(details.baseStat) or 10
    local bonus = tonumber(details.statBonus) or 0
    local effective = tonumber(details.effectiveStat) or base
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        return statName .. " " .. tostring(effective)
            .. " = 기본 " .. tostring(base)
            .. " + 보너스 " .. tmSigned(bonus)
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        return statName .. " " .. tostring(effective)
            .. " = 基本 " .. tostring(base)
            .. " + 補正 " .. tmSigned(bonus)
    end
    return statName .. " " .. tostring(effective)
        .. " = base " .. tostring(base)
        .. " + bonus " .. tmSigned(bonus)
end

function tmSkillAmountTooltipText(triggerId, details)
    if not details then return "" end
    local levelBonus = tonumber(details.levelBonus) or 0
    local statMod = tonumber(details.statMod) or 0
    local amount = tonumber(details.amount) or 0
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        return "2 + Lv 보너스 " .. tostring(levelBonus)
            .. " + 능력 보정 " .. tmSigned(statMod)
            .. " = " .. tostring(amount)
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        return "2 + Lv補正 " .. tostring(levelBonus)
            .. " + 能力補正 " .. tmSigned(statMod)
            .. " = " .. tostring(amount)
    end
    return "2 + level bonus " .. tostring(levelBonus)
        .. " + stat mod " .. tmSigned(statMod)
        .. " = " .. tostring(amount)
end

function tmRuntimeItemMechanicRows(triggerId, itemId, ownerId)
    local rows = {}
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", itemId)
    local fields = record and tmRegistryFields(record) or {}
    local kind = fields[5] or "item"
    if kind == "" or kind == "-" or kind == "none" then kind = "item" end
    local baseId = fields[4] or ""
    local rarity = fields[3] or ""
    local slot = fields[6] or ""
    local formulaLevel, formulaStat, formulaRole = tmFormulaParts(baseId)
    local level = fields[7] or formulaLevel or ""
    local stat = fields[8] or formulaStat or ""
    local role = fields[9] or formulaRole or ""
    if (level == "" or level == "-" or level == "none") and formulaLevel then level = formulaLevel end
    if (stat == "" or stat == "-" or stat == "none") and formulaStat then stat = formulaStat end
    if (role == "" or role == "-" or role == "none") and formulaRole then role = formulaRole end

    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "kind", tmTooltipKindLabel(triggerId, kind))
    if rarity ~= "" and rarity ~= "-" and rarity ~= "none" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "rarity", tmRarityLabel(triggerId, rarity))
    end
    if slot ~= "" and slot ~= "-" and slot ~= "none" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "slot", tmTooltipSlotLabel(triggerId, slot))
    end
    if level ~= "" and level ~= "-" and level ~= "0" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "level", "Lv" .. tostring(level))
    end
    if stat ~= "" and stat ~= "-" and stat ~= "none" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "stat", tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, stat))
    end
    if role ~= "" and role ~= "-" and role ~= "none" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "role", tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, role))
    end
    if formulaLevel and formulaStat then
        local bonus = tmDynamicLeveledBonus(baseId)
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "bonus", tmSigned(bonus) .. " " .. tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, formulaStat) .. " " .. T(triggerId, "(장착 시 최종 능력치)", "(effective stat when equipped)", "(装備時の有効能力)"))
    end
    local effect = tmItemEffectFields(triggerId, itemId)
    if effect and effect.grade then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "grade", tostring(effect.grade) .. (effect.dice and (" · " .. tostring(effect.dice)) or ""))
    end
    return rows
end

function tmRuntimeSkillMechanicRows(triggerId, skillId, ownerId)
    local rows = {}
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", skillId)
    local fields = record and tmRegistryFields(record) or {}
    local baseId = tmSkillBaseId(triggerId, skillId)
    local formulaLevel, formulaStat, formulaRole = tmFormulaParts(baseId)
    local level = fields[6] or formulaLevel or ""
    local stat = fields[7] or formulaStat or ""
    local role = fields[8] or formulaRole or ""
    if (level == "" or level == "-" or level == "none") and formulaLevel then level = formulaLevel end
    if (stat == "" or stat == "-" or stat == "none") and formulaStat then stat = formulaStat end
    if (role == "" or role == "-" or role == "none") and formulaRole then role = formulaRole end

    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "kind", tmTooltipKindLabel(triggerId, "skill"))
    local effect = tmSkillEffectFields(triggerId, skillId)
    if effect and effect.grade then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "grade", tostring(effect.grade) .. (effect.dice and (" · " .. tostring(effect.dice)) or ""))
    end
    if level ~= "" and level ~= "-" and level ~= "0" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "level", "Lv" .. tostring(level))
    end
    if stat ~= "" and stat ~= "-" and stat ~= "none" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "stat", tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, stat))
    end
    if role ~= "" and role ~= "-" and role ~= "none" then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "role", tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, role))
    end
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "mp", tostring(tmSkillMpCost(triggerId, skillId)))
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[tostring(ownerId or "")] and formulaStat then
        local details = tmSkillAmountDetails(triggerId, ownerId, skillId)
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "level_bonus", tmSigned(details.levelBonus))
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "effective_stat", tmSkillEffectiveStatTooltipText(triggerId, details))
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "skill_amount", tmSkillAmountTooltipText(triggerId, details))
    end
    return rows
end

function tmFormulaMechanicTooltip(triggerId, id, kind, ownerId)
    local level, stat, role = tmFormulaParts(id)
    if not level then return nil end
    local rows = {}
    local isSkill = kind == "skill"
    local title = isSkill and tmOwnerSkillLabel(triggerId, ownerId, id) or tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, id)

    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "kind", tmTooltipKindLabel(triggerId, isSkill and "skill" or "equipment"))
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "level", "Lv" .. tostring(level))
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "stat", tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, stat))
    tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "role", tmFormulaRoleLabel(triggerId, role))
    if isSkill then
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "mp", tostring(tmSkillMpCost(triggerId, id)))
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[tostring(ownerId or "")] then
            local details = tmSkillAmountDetails(triggerId, ownerId, id)
            tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "level_bonus", tmSigned(details.levelBonus))
            tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "effective_stat", tmSkillEffectiveStatTooltipText(triggerId, details))
            tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "skill_amount", tmSkillAmountTooltipText(triggerId, details))
        end
    else
        tmTooltipAddRow(rows, triggerId, "bonus", tmSigned(tmDynamicLeveledBonus(id)) .. " " .. tmTooltipStatLabel(triggerId, stat) .. " " .. T(triggerId, "(장착 시 최종 능력치)", "(effective stat when equipped)", "(装備時の有効能力)"))
    end

    local proseKind = isSkill and "skill" or "item"
    return tmMechanicTooltipHtml(triggerId, title, rows,
        tmOwnerLoadoutDescription(triggerId, ownerId, proseKind, id))
end

function tmRuntimeItemMechanicTooltip(triggerId, itemId, ownerId)
    local title = tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, itemId)
    if title == itemId then title = tmTooltipKindLabel(triggerId, "item") end
    local rich = tmEffectTooltipHtml(tmItemEffectFields(triggerId, itemId), triggerId)
    local prose = ""
    if not rich then
        prose = tmStoredEffectDescription(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", itemId)
        if prose == "" then prose = tmRuntimeItemGeneratedDescription(triggerId, itemId) end
    end
    return tmMechanicTooltipHtml(triggerId, title, tmRuntimeItemMechanicRows(triggerId, itemId, ownerId), prose, rich)
end

function tmRuntimeSkillMechanicTooltip(triggerId, skillId, ownerId)
    local title = tmSkillDisplayName(triggerId, skillId)
    if title == skillId then title = tmTooltipKindLabel(triggerId, "skill") end
    local rich = tmEffectTooltipHtml(tmSkillEffectFields(triggerId, skillId), triggerId)
    local prose = ""
    if not rich then
        prose = tmStoredEffectDescription(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", skillId)
        if prose == "" then prose = tmOwnerLoadoutDescription(triggerId, ownerId, "skill", skillId) end
    end
    return tmMechanicTooltipHtml(triggerId, title, tmRuntimeSkillMechanicRows(triggerId, skillId, ownerId), prose, rich)
end

-- tmGimmickEffectFields: structured `fields` table for a gimmick slot, or nil.
-- Reads the gimmick record (machine tuple field 7 + readable note field 6) and
-- delegates to tmGimmickRecordEffectFields. slotId defaults to current gimmick.
function tmGimmickEffectFields(triggerId, slotId)
    local slot = tonumber(slotId) or tmCurrentObjectSlot(triggerId, "gimmick")
    if not slot then return nil end
    local record = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, tmObjectSlotVar(slot), ""))
    if record[1] ~= "gimmick" then return nil end
    return tmGimmickRecordEffectFields(record)
end

-- =========================================================================
-- D045/P047 T002: runtime effect RESOLUTION layer
-- =========================================================================
-- EVENT-EMISSION MAP — which call site emits which trigger event this cycle:
--   tmApplyCombatMarker (combat path):
--       on_hit          when the attack landed (tier success/partial/crit_success AND damageDealt>0)
--       on_crit         when tier == crit_success
--       on_fail         when tier == fail OR crit_fail
--       on_damage_taken when the enemy counter-attacked (combat.counterDmg > 0)
--   tmApplySkillUseMarker (skill path):
--       on_use          always, for the USED skill's own structured effect
--   resolveCombat (defender damage_reduction):
--       on_damage_taken collected on the defender before counter-damage is applied
--   NOT emitted by combat/skill this cycle (display/log-only — never fire here):
--       passive, scene  -> never match a combat/skill event (see tmResolveEffectTrigger)
--       on_enter, on_trigger, on_tick -> gimmick/tick events, emitted elsewhere
-- =========================================================================

-- tmResolveEffectTrigger: true iff the effect's declared trigger matches `event`.
-- passive/scene are display/log-only and NEVER match a combat/skill event.
-- on_enter/on_trigger/on_tick are gimmick/tick events (not emitted by combat/skill).
function tmResolveEffectTrigger(effect, event)
    if not effect or not event or event == "" then return false end
    local trig = tostring(effect.trigger or "")
    if trig == "passive" or trig == "scene" or trig == "" then return false end
    return trig == event
end

-- tmApplyRuntimeEffect: apply one structured effect against a target.
-- context = {triggerId, actorId, targetId, targetKind, tier, event, counterDmg}.
-- Returns (category, amount, detail). Passive stat/protection effects are
-- consumed by tmEffectivePlayerStat/tmApplyCondition instead of this event path.
function tmApplyRuntimeEffect(effect, context)
    context = context or {}
    local triggerId = context.triggerId
    local targetId = context.targetId
    local targetKind = context.targetKind
    local category = tostring(effect.effect or "utility")
    local count = effect.count
    local sides = effect.sides
    if not count or not sides then
        count, sides = tmEffectGradeDice(effect.grade)
    end
    local srcRef = effect.parentRef or effect.sourceRef or "rt"

    -- shared damage helper: roll grade dice, reduce enemy HP (reuse skill-use
    -- enemy-damage/defeat pattern), defeat handling. Returns rolled amount.
    local function applyDamage()
        local amount = tmRollDice(count, sides)
        if targetKind == "enemy" and targetId and targetId ~= "" then
            tmApplyEnemyDamage(triggerId, targetId, amount, "effect:" .. tostring(srcRef))
        end
        return amount
    end

    -- shared condition helper: party target -> apply; enemy target -> log-only.
    local function applyConditionBranch()
        local condId = effect.condition
        if not condId or not tmConditionDef(condId) then
            return "condition_skip", 0, "no valid condition"
        end
        if targetKind == "enemy" then
            -- enemies CANNOT receive conditions (D044) — log-only, write NO state.
            return "condition_logonly", 0, "condition " .. tostring(condId) .. " (enemy: log-only)"
        end
        if targetKind == "ally" or targetKind == "self" then
            tmApplyCondition(triggerId, targetId, condId, "effect:" .. tostring(srcRef))
            return "condition", 0, "condition " .. tostring(condId) .. " -> " .. tostring(targetId)
        end
        -- scene/npc/gimmick targets: log-only
        return "condition_logonly", 0, "condition " .. tostring(condId) .. " (" .. tostring(targetKind) .. ": log-only)"
    end

    if category == "damage" then
        local amount = applyDamage()
        return "damage", amount, "damage " .. tostring(amount) .. " -> " .. tostring(targetId)
    elseif category == "heal" then
        local amount = tmRollDice(count, sides)
        if (targetKind == "ally" or targetKind == "self") and CHAR_NAMES_KO[targetId] then
            healHeroine(triggerId, targetId, amount)
            return "heal", amount, "heal +" .. tostring(amount) .. " -> " .. tostring(targetId)
        end
        return "heal", amount, "heal +" .. tostring(amount) .. " (no party target)"
    elseif category == "mp_restore" then
        local amount = tmRollDice(count, sides)
        if (targetKind == "ally" or targetKind == "self") and CHAR_NAMES_KO[targetId] then
            adjustHeroineMp(triggerId, targetId, amount)
            return "mp_restore", amount, "mp +" .. tostring(amount) .. " -> " .. tostring(targetId)
        end
        return "mp_restore", amount, "mp +" .. tostring(amount) .. " (no party target)"
    elseif category == "mp_reduce" then
        local amount = tmRollDice(count, sides)
        if (targetKind == "ally" or targetKind == "self") and CHAR_NAMES_KO[targetId] then
            adjustHeroineMp(triggerId, targetId, -amount)
            return "mp_reduce", amount, "mp -" .. tostring(amount) .. " -> " .. tostring(targetId)
        end
        return "mp_reduce", amount, "mp -" .. tostring(amount) .. " (no party target)"
    elseif category == "condition" then
        local cat, amt, detail = applyConditionBranch()
        return cat, amt, detail
    elseif category == "damage_condition" then
        local dmg = applyDamage()
        local cat, _, condDetail = applyConditionBranch()
        return "damage_condition", dmg, "damage " .. tostring(dmg) .. " + " .. tostring(condDetail)
    elseif category == "damage_reduction" then
        -- rolled value; the actual subtraction happens in resolveCombat (caller).
        local amount = tmRollDice(count, sides)
        return "damage_reduction", amount, "reduce " .. tostring(amount)
    elseif category == "condition_resist" or category == "condition_immunity"
        or category == "buff_stat" or category == "debuff_stat" then
        -- Event path reports the passive value; state math is handled elsewhere.
        return category .. "_passive", tmEffectGradeFlatValue(effect.grade), category .. " (passive path)"
    else
        -- utility (and any unmapped category) — narrative/log only.
        return "utility", 0, tostring(effect.text or "utility")
    end
end

-- tmCollectRuntimeEffects: collect an actor's structured runtime effects from
-- equipped items and/or loaded skills. sourceFilter: "item" | "skill" | "item+skill".
-- Each returned effect is enriched with derived count/sides (via tmEffectGradeDice)
-- and the source ref (effect.sourceRef / effect.parentRef) for logs/tooltips.
function tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, ownerId, sourceFilter)
    sourceFilter = sourceFilter or "item+skill"
    local wantItem = sourceFilter:find("item", 1, true) ~= nil
    local wantSkill = sourceFilter:find("skill", 1, true) ~= nil
    local out = {}

    local function enrich(eff, ref)
        if not eff then return end
        if not eff.count or not eff.sides then
            local count, sides = tmEffectGradeDice(eff.grade)
            eff.count = count
            eff.sides = sides
        end
        eff.sourceRef = ref
        eff.parentRef = eff.parentRef or ref
        table.insert(out, eff)
    end

    if wantItem then
        for _, ref in ipairs(parseList(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", ""), ",")) do
            if ref ~= "" and ref ~= "none" then
                enrich(tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", ref), ref)
            end
        end
    end
    if wantSkill then
        for _, ref in ipairs(parseList(tmOwnerSkillLoadout(triggerId, ownerId), ",")) do
            if ref ~= "" and ref ~= "none" then
                enrich(tmRuntimeEffectsForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", ref), ref)
