            end
        end
    end
    return out
end

-- tmEffectResultHtml: compact HTML lines for fired effects. `fired` is a list of
-- {eff=effectTable, res={category, amount, detail}}. Reuses tmEscapeHtml + a
-- tm- class consistent with tmCombatResultHtml.
function tmEffectResultHtml(fired)
    if not fired or #fired == 0 then return "" end
    local rows = {}
    for _, item in ipairs(fired) do
        local res = item.res or {}
        local category = tostring(res[1] or "")
        local amount = tonumber(res[2]) or 0
        local detail = tostring(res[3] or "")
        local eff = item.eff or {}
        local label
        if detail ~= "" then
            label = detail
        else
            label = category
            if amount > 0 then label = label .. " " .. tostring(amount) end
        end
        if eff.condition and eff.condition ~= "" and not label:find(tostring(eff.condition), 1, true) then
            label = label .. " [" .. tostring(eff.condition) .. "]"
        end
        table.insert(rows, "<span>" .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. "</span>")
    end
    return '<div class="tm-effect-result"><b>Effects</b>' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</div>'
end

-- tmCombatEventsForResult: derive the emitted trigger events from a combat result.
-- See EVENT-EMISSION MAP above.
function tmCombatEventsForResult(combat)
    local events = {}
    local tier = combat.judgment and combat.judgment.tier or ""
    local landed = (tier == "success" or tier == "partial" or tier == "crit_success")
        and (combat.damageDealt or 0) > 0
    if landed then table.insert(events, "on_hit") end
    if tier == "crit_success" then table.insert(events, "on_crit") end
    if tier == "fail" or tier == "crit_fail" then table.insert(events, "on_fail") end
    if (combat.counterDmg or 0) > 0 then table.insert(events, "on_damage_taken") end
    return events
end

-- tmResolveEffectTarget: map the effect's declared `target` field to a concrete
-- (kind, id) using the firing context (actorId = the party actor, enemyId = the
-- combat/skill enemy). self/ally -> the actor; enemy -> the enemy id; scene/npc/
-- gimmick -> passthrough (handlers treat these as log-only). Defaults to enemy
-- for damage-ish categories, self otherwise.
function tmResolveEffectTarget(eff, context)
    local target = tostring(eff.target or "")
    if target == "" then target = tmEffectDefaultTarget(eff.effect) end
    if target == "self" or target == "ally" then
        return "ally", context.actorId
    elseif target == "enemy" then
        return "enemy", context.enemyId
    end
    return target, target  -- scene/npc/gimmick: kind == id placeholder (log-only)
end

-- tmFireRuntimeEffects: for each collected effect, fire it AT MOST ONCE across the
-- list of emitted events (de-dup by effect identity). Returns the `fired` list.
-- context = {actorId, enemyId, tier, counterDmg}.
function tmFireRuntimeEffects(triggerId, effects, events, context)
    local fired = {}
    for _, eff in ipairs(effects) do
        -- damage_reduction is consumed by resolveCombat, not re-applied here.
        if eff.effect ~= "damage_reduction" then
            local matchedEvent = nil
            for _, event in ipairs(events) do
                if tmResolveEffectTrigger(eff, event) then matchedEvent = event; break end
            end
            if matchedEvent then
                local targetKind, targetId = tmResolveEffectTarget(eff, context)
                local ctx = {
                    triggerId = triggerId,
                    actorId = context.actorId,
                    targetId = targetId,
                    targetKind = targetKind,
                    tier = context.tier,
                    event = matchedEvent,
                    counterDmg = context.counterDmg,
                }
                table.insert(fired, {eff = eff, res = {tmApplyRuntimeEffect(eff, ctx)}})
            end
        end
    end
    return fired
end

-- tmItemTooltipText: returns ALREADY-ESCAPED player-facing tooltip HTML.
-- D056/P062: mechanics first, prose only as the final explanation row.
function tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, itemId, ownerId)
    local id = tostring(itemId or "")
    if id:match("^it%d+$") then
        return tmRuntimeItemMechanicTooltip(triggerId, id, ownerId)
    end
    if id:match("^eq_l%d+_") then
        return tmFormulaMechanicTooltip(triggerId, id, "item", ownerId)
            or tmTooltipProseHtml("", T(triggerId, "이 장비의 상세 효과는 아직 정리되지 않았습니다.", "Equipment details are not ready yet.", "この装備の詳細効果はまだ整理されていません。"))
    end
    return tmTooltipProseHtml("", T(triggerId, "이 장비의 상세 효과는 아직 정리되지 않았습니다.", "Equipment details are not ready yet.", "この装備の詳細効果はまだ整理されていません。"))
end

-- tmSkillTooltipText: returns ALREADY-ESCAPED player-facing tooltip HTML.
function tmSkillTooltipText(triggerId, skillId, ownerId)
    local id = tostring(skillId or "")
    if id:match("^sk%d+$") then
        return tmRuntimeSkillMechanicTooltip(triggerId, id, ownerId)
    end
    if id:match("^sk_l%d+_") then
        return tmFormulaMechanicTooltip(triggerId, id, "skill", ownerId)
            or tmTooltipProseHtml("", T(triggerId, "이 스킬의 상세 설명은 아직 정리되지 않았습니다.", "Skill details are not ready yet.", "このスキルの詳細説明はまだ整理されていません。"))
    end
    return tmTooltipProseHtml("", T(triggerId, "이 스킬의 상세 설명은 아직 정리되지 않았습니다.", "Skill details are not ready yet.", "このスキルの詳細説明はまだ整理されていません。"))
end

function tmSheetBagPendingSkillEntriesHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return "" end
    local out = {}
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")
    if registry ~= "" and registry ~= "none" then
        for record in tostring(registry):gmatch("[^;]+") do
            local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
            local ref = f[1] or ""
            if ref ~= "" and f[8] == "owned" then
                local key = tmSheetBagActionKey("skillbook", "learn", ownerId, ref)
                local name = tmTrimVisibleText(f[2] or "")
                if name == "" then name = T(triggerId, "스킬북", "Skillbook", "スキルブック") end
                table.insert(out, tmLoadoutEntryHtml(name, tmSkillbookTooltipText(triggerId, ref), "", "tm-sheet-local-pending-entry tm-sheet-local-show-" .. key))
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "")
end

function tmOwnerLoadoutHtml(triggerId, ownerId, csv, kind)
    local out = {}
    if csv ~= nil and csv ~= "" and csv ~= "none" then
        for id in tostring(csv):gmatch("[^,]+") do
            local trimmed = id:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if trimmed ~= "" and trimmed ~= "none" then
                local label = kind == "skill" and tmOwnerSkillLabel(triggerId, ownerId, trimmed) or tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, trimmed)
                local tip = kind == "skill" and tmSkillTooltipText(triggerId, trimmed, ownerId) or tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, trimmed, ownerId)
                local action = ""
                if kind == "skill" and type(tmSheetBagSlotActionButton) == "function" then
                    action = tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "skill", "forget", ownerId, trimmed)
                end
                table.insert(out, tmLoadoutEntryHtml(label, tip, action))
            end
        end
    end
    if kind == "skill" then
        local pending = tmSheetBagPendingSkillEntriesHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
        if pending ~= "" then table.insert(out, pending) end
    end
    if #out == 0 then return '<span class="tm-loadout-empty">none</span>' end
    return '<span class="tm-loadout-list">' .. table.concat(out, "") .. '</span>'
end

TM_TOOLTIP_SLOT_LABELS = {
    weapon = {ko = "무기", en = "weapon", ja = "武器"},
    armor = {ko = "방어구", en = "armor", ja = "防具"},
    accessory = {ko = "장신구", en = "accessory", ja = "装飾品"},
    focus = {ko = "매개체", en = "focus", ja = "焦点具"},
    tool = {ko = "도구", en = "tool", ja = "道具"},
    item = {ko = "아이템", en = "item", ja = "アイテム"},
    key = {ko = "열쇠/단서", en = "key item", ja = "キーアイテム"},
}

function tmTooltipSlotLabel(triggerId, slot)
    local labels = TM_TOOLTIP_SLOT_LABELS[tostring(slot or "")]
    if not labels then return tostring(slot or "") end
    local lang = tmLang(triggerId)
    if lang == "en" then return labels.en or labels.ko end
    if lang == "ja" then return labels.ja or labels.en or labels.ko end
    return labels.ko or labels.en or tostring(slot or "")
end

-- tmLoadoutChipHtml: `tip` is ALREADY-ESCAPED tooltip HTML (from
-- tmItemTooltipText / tmStackItemTooltipText) — do NOT escape again here.
function tmLoadoutChipHtml(label, tip)
    return '<span class="tm-loadout-chip">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '</span><span class="tm-guide-help tm-loadout-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="loadout detail">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip">' .. tostring(tip or "") .. '</span></span>'
end

function tmLoadoutChipHtmlWithSuffix(label, tip, suffixHtml)
    return '<span class="tm-loadout-chip"><span class="tm-loadout-chip-label">' .. tmEscapeHtml(label) .. '</span>' .. tostring(suffixHtml or "") .. '</span><span class="tm-guide-help tm-loadout-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="loadout detail">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip">' .. tostring(tip or "") .. '</span></span>'
end

TM_PARTY_BAG_BUTTON_ACTIONS = TM_PARTY_BAG_BUTTON_ACTIONS or {}
TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS = TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS or {}
TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_NEXT = TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_NEXT or 1
TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_MAX = 64
TM_PARTY_BAG_PENDING_VAR = "tm_party_bag_pending"
TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_MAP_VAR = "tm_party_bag_slot_actions"
TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS = TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS or {}
TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_NEXT = TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_NEXT or 1
TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_OVERFLOW = TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_OVERFLOW or false
TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX = 1024
TM_SHEET_BAG_RENDER_TRIGGER_ID = TM_SHEET_BAG_RENDER_TRIGGER_ID or nil
TM_SHEET_BAG_PENDING_VAR = "tm_sheet_bag_pending"
TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAP_VAR = "tm_sheet_bag_slot_actions"
TM_SHEET_BAG_SALE_MODE_VAR = "tm_sheet_bag_sale_mode"

function tmPartyBagButtonSafePart(value)
    local part = tostring(value or ""):gsub("[^%w_]", "_")
    if part == "" then return "none" end
    return part
end

function tmPartyBagButtonFn(action, ref, ownerId)
    return table.concat({
        "tmBag" .. tmPartyBagButtonSafePart(action),
        tmPartyBagButtonSafePart(ref),
        tmPartyBagButtonSafePart(ownerId),
    }, "_")
end

function tmRegisterPartyBagButton(fnName, handler)
    local name = tostring(fnName or "")
    if name == "" or type(handler) ~= "function" then return "" end
    TM_PARTY_BAG_BUTTON_ACTIONS[name] = handler
    _G[name] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        local fn = TM_PARTY_BAG_BUTTON_ACTIONS[name]
        if type(fn) == "function" then fn(triggerId) end
        tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
    end)
    return name
end

function tmPartyBagActionButton(label, fnName, handler)
    local fn = tmRegisterPartyBagButton(fnName, handler)
    if fn == "" then return "" end
    return '<span class="tm-party-bag-action">' .. tmButton(label, fn) .. '</span>'
end

function tmPartyBagResetActionSlots()
    TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS = {}
    TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_NEXT = 1
end

function tmPartyBagPersistSlotActions(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for slot = 1, TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_MAX do
        local payload = TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot]
        if payload and payload ~= "" then
            table.insert(rows, tostring(slot) .. "=" .. payload)
        end
    end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_MAP_VAR, table.concat(rows, ";"))
end

function tmPartyBagEncodeAction(kind, action, ref)
    return table.concat({tostring(kind or ""), tostring(action or ""), tostring(ref or "")}, "|")
end

function tmPartyBagDecodeAction(payload)
    local text = tostring(payload or "")
    local kind, action, ref = text:match("^([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.*)$")
    return kind or "", action or "", ref or ""
end

function tmPartyBagStoredSlotPayload(triggerId, slot)
    local target = tostring(tonumber(slot) or 0)
    for record in tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_MAP_VAR) or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local k, v = record:match("^(%d+)=(.*)$")
        if k == target then return v or "" end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmPartyBagSlotFn(slot)
    return "tmPartyBagSlot_" .. tostring(slot)
end

function tmPartyBagRegisterSlotAction(kind, action, ref)
    local slot = tonumber(TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_NEXT) or 1
    if slot > TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_MAX then return "" end
    TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot] = tmPartyBagEncodeAction(kind, action, ref)
    TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_NEXT = slot + 1
    return tmPartyBagSlotFn(slot)
end

function tmPartyBagSlotActionButton(label, kind, action, ref)
    local fn = tmPartyBagRegisterSlotAction(kind, action, ref)
    if fn == "" then return "" end
    return '<span class="tm-party-bag-action">' .. tmButton(label, fn) .. '</span>'
end

function tmPartyBagSetPending(triggerId, kind, action, ref)
    setVar(triggerId, TM_PARTY_BAG_PENDING_VAR, tmPartyBagEncodeAction(kind, action, ref))
end

function tmPartyBagClearPending(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, TM_PARTY_BAG_PENDING_VAR, "")
end

function tmPartyBagPending(triggerId)
    return tmPartyBagDecodeAction(getVar(triggerId, TM_PARTY_BAG_PENDING_VAR, ""))
end

function tmPartyBagActionsAvailable(triggerId)
    return type(tmIsCharacterSetupComplete) == "function" and tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId) == true
end

function tmGetPartyGold(triggerId)
    if not tmPartyBagActionsAvailable(triggerId) then return 0 end
    return getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)
end

function tmPartyBagActionUnavailableHtml(triggerId)
    if tmPartyBagActionsAvailable(triggerId) then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-side-note">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId,
        "시트 준비가 끝난 뒤 공용 가방 조작을 사용할 수 있습니다.",
        "Party-bag actions become available after character sheets are ready.",
        "キャラクターシートの準備後に共有バッグ操作を使用できます。")) .. '</div>'
end

function tmPartyBagTargetLabel(triggerId, ownerId)
    if type(tmGuidePcLabel) == "function" then return tmGuidePcLabel(triggerId, ownerId) end
    return tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId)
end

function tmPartyBagSelectorHtml(triggerId)
    -- Target selection is rendered through the global in-app popup layer.
    return ""
end

function tmPartyBagTargetPopupBody(triggerId, targetLabel)
    local buttons = {}
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        table.insert(buttons, '<span class="tm-party-bag-target">' .. tmButton(tmPartyBagTargetLabel(triggerId, ownerId), "tmPartyBagTarget_" .. ownerId) .. '</span>')
    end
    return '<div class="tm-party-bag-selector">'
        .. '<div class="tm-party-bag-selector-item">' .. tmEscapeHtml(targetLabel) .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-party-bag-targets">' .. table.concat(buttons, "") .. '</div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-party-bag-selector-cancel">' .. tmButton(T(triggerId, "취소", "Cancel", "キャンセル"), "tmPartyBagCancelTarget") .. '</div>'
        .. '</div>'
end

function tmPartyBagOpenTargetPopup(triggerId, kind, action, ref)
    if not tmPartyBagActionsAvailable(triggerId) then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "시트 준비가 끝난 뒤 공용 가방 조작을 사용할 수 있습니다.",
            "Party-bag actions become available after character sheets are ready.",
            "キャラクターシートの準備後に共有バッグ操作を使用できます。"))
        return false
    end
    local title = ""
    local targetLabel = ""
    if kind == "skillbook" and action == "learn" then
        title = T(triggerId, "누구에게 줄지 선택하세요", "Choose who receives it", "誰に渡すか選んでください")
        targetLabel = tmSkillbookLabel(triggerId, ref)
    elseif kind == "item" and (action == "equip" or action == "assign") then
        title = T(triggerId, "누가 장비할 지 선택하세요", "Choose who equips it", "誰が装備するか選んでください")
        targetLabel = tmEquipLabel(triggerId, ref)
    else
        return false
    end
    tmPartyBagSetPending(triggerId, kind, action, ref)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "party_bag")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "true")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_kind", "party-bag-target")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_title", title)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_body", tmPartyBagTargetPopupBody(triggerId, targetLabel))
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_fn", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_fn", "tmPartyBagCancelTarget")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_yes_label", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_label", "")
    return true
end

function tmPartyBagRaritySellBase(rarity)
    local r = tostring(rarity or "common"):lower()
    if r == "rare" then return 60 end
    if r == "uncommon" then return 25 end
    return 10
end

function tmPartyBagGradeSellBonus(grade)
    local g = tostring(grade or "C"):upper()
    if g == "S" then return 70 end
    if g == "A" then return 35 end
    if g == "B" then return 15 end
    return 0
end

function tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
    if kind == "item" then
        local rec = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", ref)
        if not rec then return 0 end
        local f = tmRegistryFields(rec)
        local level = tonumber(f[7] or "1") or 1
        return tmServicePositivePrice(tmPartyBagRaritySellBase(f[3]) + math.max(0, level - 1) * 5, 10)
    elseif kind == "stack_item" then
        local def = TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[tmStackItemId(ref)]
        if not def then return 0 end
        return tmServicePositivePrice(def.sell_price or 10, 10)
    elseif kind == "skillbook" then
        local rec = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", ref)
        if not rec then return 0 end
        local f = tmRegistryFields(rec)
        return tmServicePositivePrice(tmPartyBagRaritySellBase(f[3]) + tmPartyBagGradeSellBonus(f[4]), 10)
    end
    return 0
end

function tmPartyBagSellConfirmBody(triggerId, label, price)
    local cost = tostring(price or 0)
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        return tmJosaEunNeun(triggerId, label) .. " " .. cost .. "골드입니다.\n판매하시겠습니까?"
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        return tostring(label or "") .. "は" .. cost .. "ゴールドです。\n売却しますか？"
    end
    return tostring(label or "") .. " is worth " .. cost .. " gold.\nSell it?"
end

function tmPartyBagOpenSellConfirm(triggerId, kind, ref)
    local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
    if price <= 0 then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매할 수 있는 가격을 확인하지 못했습니다.",
            "Could not determine a sell price.",
            "売却価格を確認できませんでした。"))
        return false
    end
    local label = kind == "skillbook" and tmSkillbookLabel(triggerId, ref) or tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref)
    tmPartyBagSetPending(triggerId, kind, "sell", ref)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "party_bag")
    tmOpenConfirmPopup(
        triggerId,
        T(triggerId, "판매 확인", "Confirm Sale", "売却確認"),
        tmPartyBagSellConfirmBody(triggerId, label, price),
        tmUiText(triggerId, "yes"),
        "tmPartyBagConfirmSell",
        tmUiText(triggerId, "no"),
        "tmPartyBagCancelTarget"
    )
    return true
end

function tmPartyBagHandleSlotAction(triggerId, slot)
    local payload = TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[tonumber(slot) or 0]
    if not payload or payload == "" then
        payload = tmPartyBagStoredSlotPayload(triggerId, slot)
    end
    local kind, action, ref = tmPartyBagDecodeAction(payload)
    if ref == "" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "공용 가방을 다시 열고 버튼을 눌러 주세요.",
            "Open the party bag again and press the button.",
            "共有バッグを開き直してボタンを押してください。"))
        return
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "party_bag")
    if kind == "item" and (action == "equip" or action == "assign") then
        tmPartyBagOpenTargetPopup(triggerId, kind, action, ref)
        return
    end
    if kind == "skillbook" and action == "learn" then
        tmPartyBagOpenTargetPopup(triggerId, kind, action, ref)
        return
    end
    if kind == "item" and action == "sell" then
        tmPartyBagOpenSellConfirm(triggerId, kind, ref)
        return
    end
    if kind == "skillbook" and action == "sell" then
        tmPartyBagOpenSellConfirm(triggerId, kind, ref)
        return
    end
    tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
        "처리할 수 없는 공용 가방 작업입니다.",
        "This party-bag action cannot be handled.",
        "この共有バッグ操作は処理できません。"))
end

function tmPartyBagApplyPendingToOwner(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return end
    local kind, action, ref = tmPartyBagPending(triggerId)
    if ref == "" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "선택 중인 공용 가방 작업이 없습니다.",
            "No party-bag action is currently selected.",
            "選択中の共有バッグ操作がありません。"))
        return
    end
    if kind == "item" and action == "assign" then
        tmApplyItemAssignMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref, "1")
    elseif kind == "item" and action == "equip" then
        tmApplyEquipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref)
    elseif kind == "skillbook" and action == "learn" then
        tmApplySkillbookLearn(triggerId, ref, ownerId)
    else
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "처리할 수 없는 공용 가방 대상 선택입니다.",
            "This party-bag target selection cannot be handled.",
            "この共有バッグの対象選択は処理できません。"))
        return
    end
    tmPartyBagClearPending(triggerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "party_bag")
end

for tmPartyBagSlotIndex = 1, TM_PARTY_BAG_SLOT_MAX do
    local slot = tmPartyBagSlotIndex
    _G[tmPartyBagSlotFn(slot)] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        tmPartyBagHandleSlotAction(triggerId, slot)
    end)
end

for _, tmPartyBagOwnerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
    local owner = tmPartyBagOwnerId
    _G["tmPartyBagTarget_" .. owner] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        tmPartyBagApplyPendingToOwner(triggerId, owner)
    end)
end

_G["tmPartyBagCancelTarget"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    tmPartyBagClearPending(triggerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "party_bag")
end)

_G["tmPartyBagConfirmSell"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local kind, action, ref = tmPartyBagPending(triggerId)
    if action ~= "sell" or ref == "" then
        tmPartyBagClearPending(triggerId)
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "선택 중인 판매 작업이 없습니다.",
            "No sale action is currently selected.",
            "選択中の売却操作がありません。"))
        return
    end
    local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
    local ok = false
    if kind == "item" then
        ok = select(1, tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, tostring(price), "shop_sell", "ui_button")) == true
    elseif kind == "skillbook" then
        ok = select(1, tmApplySkillbookSellMarker(triggerId, ref, tostring(price), "ui_button")) == true
    end
    tmPartyBagClearPending(triggerId)
    if ok then
        tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "party_bag")
    else
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매를 처리하지 못했습니다.",
            "Could not complete the sale.",
            "売却を処理できませんでした。"))
    end
end)

function tmSheetBagLoadStoredSlotActions(triggerId)
    for record in tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAP_VAR) or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local k, v = record:match("^(%d+)=(.*)$")
        local slot = tonumber(k)
        if slot and slot >= 1 and slot <= TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX and v and v ~= "" then
            TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot] = v
        end
    end
end

function tmSheetBagResetActionSlots(triggerId)
    TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS = {}
    TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_NEXT = 1
    TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_OVERFLOW = false
    if triggerId ~= nil then
        TM_SHEET_BAG_RENDER_TRIGGER_ID = triggerId
        tmSheetBagLoadStoredSlotActions(triggerId)
    end
end

function tmSheetBagEncodeAction(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    return table.concat({tostring(kind or ""), tostring(action or ""), tostring(ownerId or ""), tostring(ref or "")}, "|")
end

function tmSheetBagDecodeAction(payload)
    local kind, action, ownerId, ref = tostring(payload or ""):match("^([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.*)$")
    return kind or "", action or "", ownerId or "", ref or ""
end

function tmSheetBagPersistSlotActions(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for slot = 1, TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX do
        local payload = TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot]
        if payload and payload ~= "" then
            table.insert(rows, tostring(slot) .. "=" .. payload)
        end
    end
    tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAP_VAR, table.concat(rows, ";"))
end

function tmSheetBagStoredSlotPayload(triggerId, slot)
    local target = tostring(tonumber(slot) or 0)
    for record in tostring(tmRawGetVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAP_VAR) or ""):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local k, v = record:match("^(%d+)=(.*)$")
        if k == target then return v or "" end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmSheetBagSlotFn(slot)
    return "tmSheetBagSlot_" .. tostring(slot)
end

function tmSheetBagActFn(slot)
    return string.format("tmSheetBagAct_%04d", tonumber(slot) or 0)
end

function tmSheetBagActionKey(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    local raw = table.concat({
        tostring(kind or ""),
        tostring(action or ""),
        tostring(ownerId or ""),
        tostring(ref or ""),
    }, "_")
    local safe = raw:gsub("[^%w_%-]", "_")
    if safe == "" then safe = "action" end
    return safe
end

function tmSheetBagActionStateId(key)
    return "tm-sheet-local-" .. tostring(key or "action")
end

function tmSheetBagActionOpenId(key)
    return "tm-sheet-confirm-" .. tostring(key or "action")
end

function tmSheetBagActionStyleHtml(key)
    local safeKey = tmEscapeHtml(tostring(key or "action"))
    local stateId = tmEscapeHtml(tmSheetBagActionStateId(key))
    return '<style>.tm-character-sheet-shell .tm-sheet-local-show-' .. safeKey .. ',.tm-character-sheet-shell .tm-sheet-local-show-row-' .. safeKey .. '{display:none!important}.tm-character-sheet-shell:has(#' .. stateId .. ':checked) .tm-sheet-local-show-' .. safeKey .. '{display:inline-flex!important}.tm-character-sheet-shell:has(#' .. stateId .. ':checked) .tm-sheet-local-show-row-' .. safeKey .. '{display:grid!important}.tm-character-sheet-shell:has(#' .. stateId .. ':checked) .tm-sheet-local-hide-' .. safeKey .. ',.tm-character-sheet-shell:has(#' .. stateId .. ':checked) .tm-sheet-local-hide-row-' .. safeKey .. '{display:none!important}</style>'
end

function tmSheetBagStateInputHtml(key, className)
    local cls = "tm-sheet-local-state tm-sheet-local-hide-state"
    if tostring(className or "") ~= "" then cls = cls .. " " .. tostring(className or "") end
    return tmSheetBagActionStyleHtml(key) .. '<input type="checkbox" class="' .. tmEscapeHtml(cls) .. '" id="' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmSheetBagActionStateId(key)) .. '">'
end

function tmSheetBagRegisterSlotAction(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    local slot = tonumber(TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_NEXT) or 1
    if slot > TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX then
        TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_OVERFLOW = true
        return ""
    end
    TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot] = tmSheetBagEncodeAction(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_NEXT = slot + 1
    return tmSheetBagSlotFn(slot), tmSheetBagActionKey(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
end

function tmSheetBagActionHash(value)
    local text = tostring(value or "")
    local hash = 5381
    for i = 1, #text do
        hash = (hash * 33 + text:byte(i)) % 1000000007
    end
    return tostring(hash)
end

function tmSheetBagStableActionSlot(triggerId, payload)
    local raw = tostring(payload or "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if triggerId ~= nil then tmSheetBagLoadStoredSlotActions(triggerId) end
    local base = (tonumber(tmSheetBagActionHash(raw)) or 0) % TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX
    for offset = 0, TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX - 1 do
        local slot = ((base + offset) % TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX) + 1
        local existing = TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot]
        if not existing or existing == "" or existing == raw then
            TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot] = raw
            return slot
        end
    end
    TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_OVERFLOW = true
    return nil
end

function tmSheetBagRegisterStableAction(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    local key = tmSheetBagActionKey(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    local payload = tmSheetBagEncodeAction(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    local slot = tmSheetBagStableActionSlot(TM_SHEET_BAG_RENDER_TRIGGER_ID, payload)
    if not slot then return "", key end
    return tmSheetBagActFn(slot), key
end

function tmSheetBagConfirmSlotActionButton(label, kind, action, ownerId, ref, title, body)
    local key = tmSheetBagActionKey(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    local confirmFn = tmSheetBagRegisterStableAction(kind, action .. "_confirm", ownerId, ref)
    if confirmFn == "" then return "" end
    local confirmSlot = tonumber(tostring(confirmFn):match("(%d+)$"))
    if not confirmSlot then return "" end
    local openId = tmSheetBagActionOpenId(key)
    local stateId = tmSheetBagActionStateId(key)
    return '<span class="tm-party-bag-action tm-sheet-bag-action tm-sheet-confirm-action">'
        .. tmSheetBagActionStyleHtml(key)
        .. '<input type="checkbox" class="tm-sheet-confirm-state" id="' .. tmEscapeHtml(openId) .. '">'
        .. '<input type="checkbox" class="tm-sheet-local-state tm-sheet-local-hide-state" id="' .. tmEscapeHtml(stateId) .. '">'
        .. tmSheetBagToggleLabelButtonHtml(label, openId, "tm-sheet-confirm-open")
        .. '<span class="tm-sheet-inline-confirm tm-sheet-confirm-box-' .. tmEscapeHtml(key) .. '">'
        .. '<b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(title or "") .. '</b>'
        .. '<span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(body or "") .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-sheet-inline-confirm-actions">'
        .. tmSheetBagRisuBtnLabelHtml("확인", "sbslot-" .. tostring(confirmSlot), stateId, "tm-sheet-confirm-yes")
        .. tmSheetBagToggleLabelButtonHtml("취소", openId, "tm-sheet-confirm-cancel")
        .. '</span></span></span>'
end

function tmSheetBagSlotActionButton(label, kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    if kind == "skillbook" and action == "learn" then
        return tmSheetBagConfirmSlotActionButton(label, kind, action, ownerId, ref,
            "스킬 등록",
            "스킬을 등록하시겠습니까? (스킬을 등록하면 스킬북이 사라집니다.)")
    end
    if kind == "skill" and action == "forget" then
        return tmSheetBagConfirmSlotActionButton(label, kind, action, ownerId, ref,
            "스킬 잊기",
            "스킬을 잊으시겠습니까?")
    end
    local fn, key = tmSheetBagRegisterStableAction(kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    if fn == "" then return "" end
    -- D212/P309: emit the 3 non-confirm action families (owner release/unequip,
    -- common give, sale sell) via risu-btn/onButtonClick (data = "sbslot-<slot>")
    -- instead of risu-trigger. A click then mutates state + re-renders only THIS
    -- message (ReloadChatPointer[idx]) with no global ReloadGUIPointer remount.
    -- The stable slot number is embedded in the stable-action fn name
    -- (tmSheetBagAct_%04d); the persisted slot->payload map (tm var) lets the
    -- fresh click engine resolve it. Hidden checkbox + <label for> are preserved
    -- for the 0ms :checked visual preview.
    local slot = tonumber(tostring(fn):match("(%d+)$"))
    if not slot then return "" end
    return '<span class="tm-party-bag-action tm-sheet-bag-action">' .. tmSheetBagStateInputHtml(key) .. tmSheetBagRisuBtnLabelHtml(label, "sbslot-" .. tostring(slot), tmSheetBagActionStateId(key), "tm-sheet-local-trigger") .. '</span>'
end

function tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml(label, kind, action, ref)
    local out = {}
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local actionHtml = tmSheetBagSlotActionButton(label, kind, action, ownerId, ref)
        if actionHtml ~= "" then
            table.insert(out, '<span class="tm-sheet-bag-owner-actions tm-sheet-bag-owner-' .. tostring(ownerId) .. '">' .. actionHtml .. '</span>')
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "")
end

function tmSheetBagOwnerSaleToggleHtml(triggerId, saleLabel)
    return ""
end

function tmSheetBagSetPending(triggerId, kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    setVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_PENDING_VAR, tmSheetBagEncodeAction(kind, action, ownerId, ref))
end

function tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_PENDING_VAR, "")
end

function tmSheetBagPending(triggerId)
    return tmSheetBagDecodeAction(getVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_PENDING_VAR, ""))
end

function tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", ownerId)
    end
    if type(tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen) == "function" then
        tmKeepPersistentDrawerOpen(triggerId, "character-sheet")
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
end

function tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
end

function tmSheetBagQueueDirectRefresh(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_open", "false") == "true" then return end
    if getVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "") ~= "" then return end
    if type(tmQueueFastSheetRefresh) == "function" then
        tmQueueFastSheetRefresh(triggerId, "sheet_bag")
    end
end

function tmSheetBagQueuePopupRefresh(triggerId)
    if type(tmQueueFastPopupRefresh) == "function" then
        tmQueueFastPopupRefresh(triggerId, "sheet_bag_popup")
    end
end

function tmSheetBagQueueConfirmSuccessRefresh(triggerId)
    tmSheetBagQueuePopupRefresh(triggerId)
    tmSheetBagQueueDirectRefresh(triggerId)
end

function tmSheetBagWarnEquipmentFull(triggerId)
    tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
        "장비가 꽉찼습니다.\n장비/아이템을 먼저 해제해 주세요.",
        "Equipment slots are full.\nRelease equipment or items first.",
        "装備枠がいっぱいです。\n先に装備/アイテムを外してください。"))
end

function tmSheetBagWarnSkillFull(triggerId)
    tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
        "스킬창이 꽉찼습니다.\n스킬을 먼저 잊어 주세요.",
        "Skill slots are full.\nForget a skill first.",
        "スキル欄がいっぱいです。\n先にスキルを忘れてください。"))
end

function tmSheetBagApplyCommonItem(triggerId, ownerId, ref)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    if tmOwnerEquipmentItemSlots(triggerId, ownerId) >= TM_EQUIPMENT_ITEM_SLOT_CAP then
        tmSheetBagWarnEquipmentFull(triggerId)
        return false
    end
    if tmItemRefAssignable(triggerId, ref) then
        tmApplyItemAssignMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref, "1")
    else
        tmApplyEquipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref)
    end
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerRegistryEquipment(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then return false end
    local equipVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment"
    local before = getVar(triggerId, equipVar, "")
    if not csvListContains(before, ref) then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "sheet_unequip_missing_item")
        return false
    end
    tmApplyUnequipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref)
    if getVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "") ~= "" then return false end
    local after = getVar(triggerId, equipVar, "")
    if csvListContains(after, ref) then return false end
    if not csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref) then return false end
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerFormulaEquipment(triggerId, ownerId, equipmentId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    local id = tostring(equipmentId or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if not id:match("^eq_l%d+_") or not tmFormulaParts(id) then return false end
    local equipVar = "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment"
    local equipped = getVar(triggerId, equipVar, "")
    if not csvListContains(equipped, id) then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "formula_unequip_missing_item")
        return false
    end
    local ref, name = tmStoreFormulaEquipmentAsPartyItem(triggerId, ownerId, id)
    if not ref then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "formula_unequip_store_failed")
        return false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, equipVar, removeCsvItem(equipped, id))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "formula_unequip:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. ref)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장착 해제: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. tostring(name or ref))
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerRegistryItem(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" then return false end
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local beforeItems = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    if tmStackListGet(beforeItems, ref) <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "sheet_item_release_missing_item")
        return false
    end
    tmApplyItemReleaseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref, "1")
    if getVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "") ~= "" then return false end
    local afterItems = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    if tmStackListGet(afterItems, ref) >= tmStackListGet(beforeItems, ref) then return false end
    if not csvListContains(getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none"), ref) then return false end
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagApplyCommonStackItem(triggerId, ownerId, itemId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    local id = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    if id == "" or not TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then return false end
    local partyItems = getVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", "none")
    if tmStackListGet(partyItems, id) <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "sheet_stack_give_missing_item")
        return false
    end
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local ownerItems = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    if tmStackListGet(ownerItems, id) <= 0 and tmOwnerEquipmentItemSlots(triggerId, ownerId) >= TM_EQUIPMENT_ITEM_SLOT_CAP then
        tmSheetBagWarnEquipmentFull(triggerId)
        return false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", tmStackListRemoveOne(partyItems, id))
    setVar(triggerId, itemVar, tmStackListAdd(ownerItems, id, 1))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "stack_item_assign:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. id)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 분배: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id))
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerStackItem(triggerId, ownerId, itemId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    local id = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    if id == "" or not TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then return false end
    local itemVar = tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId)
    local ownerItems = getVar(triggerId, itemVar, "none")
    if tmStackListGet(ownerItems, id) <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "sheet_stack_release_missing_item")
        return false
    end
    setVar(triggerId, itemVar, tmStackListRemoveOne(ownerItems, id))
    setVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", tmStackListAdd(getVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", "none"), id, 1))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "stack_item_release:" .. ownerId .. ":" .. id)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 반환: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id))
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagOpenLearnConfirm(triggerId, ownerId, sbRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    if csvItemCount(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", "")) >= TM_SKILL_LOADOUT_CAP then
        tmSheetBagWarnSkillFull(triggerId)
        return false
    end
    tmSheetBagSetPending(triggerId, "skillbook", "learn", ownerId, sbRef)
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmOpenConfirmPopup(
        triggerId,
        T(triggerId, "스킬 등록", "Register Skill", "スキル登録"),
        T(triggerId, "스킬을 등록하시겠습니까? (스킬을 등록하면 스킬북이 사라집니다.)", "Register this skill? (Registering consumes the skillbook.)", "このスキルを登録しますか？（登録するとスキルブックは消費されます。）"),
        tmUiText(triggerId, "yes"),
        "tmSheetBagConfirmLearn",
        tmUiText(triggerId, "no"),
        "tmSheetBagCancel"
    )
    tmSheetBagQueuePopupRefresh(triggerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagOpenForgetConfirm(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return false end
    tmSheetBagSetPending(triggerId, "skill", "forget", ownerId, skillRef)
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmOpenConfirmPopup(
        triggerId,
        T(triggerId, "스킬 잊기", "Forget Skill", "スキルを忘れる"),
        T(triggerId, "스킬을 잊으시겠습니까?", "Forget this skill?", "このスキルを忘れますか？"),
        tmUiText(triggerId, "yes"),
        "tmSheetBagConfirmForget",
        tmUiText(triggerId, "no"),
        "tmSheetBagCancel"
    )
    tmSheetBagQueuePopupRefresh(triggerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagOpenSellConfirm(triggerId, kind, ownerId, ref)
    local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
    if price <= 0 then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매할 수 있는 가격을 확인하지 못했습니다.",
            "Could not determine a sell price.",
            "売却価格を確認できませんでした。"))
        return false
    end
    local label = kind == "skillbook" and tmSkillbookLabel(triggerId, ref)
        or (kind == "stack_item" and tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, ref) or tmItemDisplayName(triggerId, ref))
    tmSheetBagSetPending(triggerId, kind, "sell", ownerId, ref)
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmOpenConfirmPopup(
        triggerId,
        T(triggerId, "판매 확인", "Confirm Sale", "売却確認"),
        tmPartyBagSellConfirmBody(triggerId, label, price),
        tmUiText(triggerId, "yes"),
        "tmSheetBagConfirmSell",
        tmUiText(triggerId, "no"),
        "tmSheetBagCancel"
    )
    tmSheetBagQueuePopupRefresh(triggerId)
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagApplyStackItemSell(triggerId, itemId, price)
    local id = tmStackItemId(itemId)
    if id == "" or not TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then return false end
    local partyItems = getVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", "none")
    if tmStackListGet(partyItems, id) <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "sheet_stack_sell_missing_item")
        return false
    end
    local cost = tmServicePositivePrice(price, tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, "stack_item", id))
    if cost <= 0 then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", tmStackListRemoveOne(partyItems, id))
    tmAwardGold(triggerId, cost, "stack_item_sell:" .. id)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "stack_item_sell:" .. id .. ":" .. tostring(cost))
    setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 판매: " .. tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id) .. " · " .. tostring(cost) .. "골드 획득")
    return true
end

function tmSheetBagApplyDirectSell(triggerId, kind, ref)
    local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
    if price <= 0 then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매할 수 있는 가격을 확인하지 못했습니다.",
            "Could not determine a sell price.",
            "売却価格を確認できませんでした。"))
        return false
    end
    if kind == "item" then
        return select(1, tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, tostring(price), "shop_sell", "ui_sheet_button")) == true
    elseif kind == "stack_item" then
        return tmSheetBagApplyStackItemSell(triggerId, ref, price) == true
    elseif kind == "skillbook" then
        return select(1, tmApplySkillbookSellMarker(triggerId, ref, tostring(price), "ui_sheet_button")) == true
    end
    return false
end

function tmSheetBagHandleAction(triggerId, kind, action, ownerId, ref)
    kind = tostring(kind or "")
    action = tostring(action or "")
    ownerId = tostring(ownerId or "")
    ref = tostring(ref or "")
    if ref == "" then
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "캐릭터 시트를 다시 열고 버튼을 눌러 주세요.",
            "Open the character sheet again and press the button.",
            "キャラクターシートを開き直してボタンを押してください。"))
        return "local_noop"
    end
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    if kind == "item" and action == "give" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagApplyCommonItem(triggerId, ownerId, ref) then
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "stack_item" and action == "give" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagApplyCommonStackItem(triggerId, ownerId, ref) then
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "item" and action == "sell" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagApplyDirectSell(triggerId, "item", ref) then return "local_success" end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "stack_item" and action == "sell" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagApplyDirectSell(triggerId, "stack_item", ref) then return "local_success" end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "skillbook" and action == "learn" then
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "skillbook" and action == "learn_confirm" then
        if csvItemCount(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", "")) >= TM_SKILL_LOADOUT_CAP then
            tmSheetBagWarnSkillFull(triggerId)
            return "local_noop"
        end
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        tmApplySkillbookLearn(triggerId, ref, ownerId)
        tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
        return "local_success"
    end
    if kind == "skillbook" and action == "sell" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagApplyDirectSell(triggerId, "skillbook", ref) then return "local_success" end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "owner_item" and action == "unequip" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerRegistryEquipment(triggerId, ownerId, ref) then
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "owner_formula_equipment" and action == "unequip" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerFormulaEquipment(triggerId, ownerId, ref) then
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "owner_item" and action == "release" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerRegistryItem(triggerId, ownerId, ref) then
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "owner_stack_item" and action == "release" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmSheetBagReleaseOwnerStackItem(triggerId, ownerId, ref) then
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "skill" and action == "forget" then
        return "local_noop"
    end
    if kind == "skill" and action == "forget_confirm" then
        tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
        if tmApplySkillForgetMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref) then
            tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
            return "local_success"
        end
        return "local_noop"
    end
    tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
        "처리할 수 없는 시트 가방 작업입니다.",
        "This sheet-bag action cannot be handled.",
        "このシートバッグ操作は処理できません。"))
    return "local_noop"
end

function tmSheetBagHandleSlotAction(triggerId, slot)
    local payload = TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[tonumber(slot) or 0]
    if not payload or payload == "" then
        payload = tmSheetBagStoredSlotPayload(triggerId, slot)
    end
    local kind, action, ownerId, ref = tmSheetBagDecodeAction(payload)
    return tmSheetBagHandleAction(triggerId, kind, action, ownerId, ref)
end

for tmSheetBagSlotIndex = 1, TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_MAX do
    local slot = tmSheetBagSlotIndex
    _G[tmSheetBagSlotFn(slot)] = tmSheetBagFastLocalButton(function(triggerId)
        return tmSheetBagHandleSlotAction(triggerId, slot)
    end)
    _G[tmSheetBagActFn(slot)] = tmSheetBagFastLocalButton(function(triggerId)
        return tmSheetBagHandleSlotAction(triggerId, slot)
    end)
end

-- === D212/P309: sheet-bag onButtonClick dispatcher (Design A+) ===
-- Declared at file top-level so it lands in the per-mode 'onButtonClick' click
-- engine's _G: that engine runs the whole file via doString then
-- global.get('onButtonClick') (scriptings.ts). A render-lazy _G[name]= would only
-- exist in the editDisplay/output engine and be a silent no-op here (I078).
-- The dispatcher routes risu-btn "sbslot-<slot>" straight to the RAW mutation
-- handler tmSheetBagHandleSlotAction, deliberately BYPASSING the
-- tmSheetBagFastLocalButton wrapper (whose tm_popup_open=="true" branch reaches
-- tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay -> reload). On success it rebuilds
-- tm_control_panel_html via the VAR-WRITE path only (no reload), so the automatic
-- single-message remount shows the destination row from real state (kills
-- snap-back). Never calls reloadDisplay/reloadChat/ReloadGUIPointer on success.
_tmSheetBagClickLock = _tmSheetBagClickLock or false
_tmFnClickLock = _tmFnClickLock or false

function tmSheetBagRebuildControlPanelVar(triggerId)
    -- Re-render tm_control_panel_html via VAR-WRITE ONLY (never reload). Prefer the
    -- fast in-place sheet-region splice; fall back to a full safe regenerate. Both
    -- terminate at tmSetControlPanelHtml -> tmRawSetVar -> setChatVar (no varChanged,
    -- no ReloadGUIPointer, no reloadDisplay/reloadChat).
    local ok, refreshed = pcall(tmRefreshCharacterSheetRegion, triggerId, "sheet_bag")
    if ok == true and refreshed == true then return true end
    local ok2 = pcall(tmBuildControlPanelSafe, triggerId)
    return ok2 == true
end

function tmHandleSafeFnButton(triggerId, fnName)
    local name = tostring(fnName or "")
    if name == "closeCharSheet" then
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", "")
        return true
    end
    if name == "closeSidePanel" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_side_panel", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_drawer_keep_active", "")
        return true
    end
    if name == "closeInAppPopup" then
        local cancelFn = getVar(triggerId, "tm_popup_no_fn", "")
        if cancelFn == "tmCancelSheetEdit" then
            tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        end
        tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
        return true
    end
    if name == "tmCancelSheetEdit" then
        tmClearSheetEditState(triggerId)
        tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
        return true
    end
    if name == "tmForceUnlock" then
        _actionLocked = false
        tmSetActionLocked(triggerId, false)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_guide_refresh_loading", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_save_code_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_session_load_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_generating", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false")
        pcall(tmClearIllustrationWaitMarkerFromLastChar, triggerId, {force = true})
        pcall(tmClearSheetEditState, triggerId)
        tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId, "대기가 오래 걸려 잠금을 해제했습니다. 필요한 작업은 다시 실행할 수 있습니다.", "The wait took too long, so the lock was released. You can try the action again.", "待機が長くなったためロックを解除しました。必要な操作はもう一度実行できます。"))
        return true
    end
    local apOwner, apStat = name:match("^tmSpendAp_([%w_]+)_([%a]+)$")
    if apOwner and CHAR_NAMES_KO[apOwner] then
        local statKey = normalizeStatKey(apStat)
        if tmSpendApOnStat(triggerId, apOwner, statKey, "직접 성장") then
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", apOwner)
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_player_info_open", "false")
        end
        return true
    end
    local levelOwner = name:match("^tmLevelUp_([%w_]+)$")
    if levelOwner and CHAR_NAMES_KO[levelOwner] then
        if tmLevelUpOwner(triggerId, levelOwner) then
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", levelOwner)
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
            setVar(triggerId, "ui_player_info_open", "false")
            tmNotice(triggerId, tmActorLabel(triggerId, levelOwner) .. T(triggerId, " 레벨업을 반영했습니다.", " level-up applied.", " のレベルアップを反映しました。"))
        end
        return true
    end
    local classOwner = name:match("^tmOpenClassSelect_([%w_]+)$")
    if classOwner and CHAR_NAMES_KO[classOwner] then
        tmOpenClassSelectForOwner(triggerId, classOwner)
        return true
    end
    local classSlot = name:match("^tmSetClassSlot_(%d%d)$")
    if classSlot then
        local selectedClassId = getVar(triggerId, tmClassSelectionSlotKey(tonumber(classSlot) or 0), "")
        tmApplyClassSelection(triggerId, selectedClassId)
        return true
    end
    if tmFastFnButtonAllowedForRender(name) then
        local fn = _G[name]
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            local result = fn(triggerId)
            tmAwaitHostResult(result)
            return "delegated"
        end
    end
    return false
end

onButtonClick = async(function(id, data)
    local raw = tostring(data or "")
    local fnName = raw:match("^fn%-([%w_]+)$")
    if fnName and not tmFastFnButtonAllowedForRender(fnName) then fnName = nil end
    if fnName then
        if _tmFnClickLock == true then return end
        _tmFnClickLock = true
        local ok, handled = pcall(tmHandleSafeFnButton, id, fnName)
        if ok == true and handled == true then
            pcall(tmSheetBagRebuildControlPanelVar, id)
        elseif ok ~= true then
            print("[TRPG ERROR] safe fn button failed: " .. tostring(handled))
            pcall(tmError, id, "처리 중 오류: " .. tostring(handled))
            pcall(tmSheetBagRebuildControlPanelVar, id)
        end
        _tmFnClickLock = false
        return
    end
    local slotStr = raw:match("^sbslot%-(%d+)$")
    if not slotStr then return end            -- empty / unknown / not-ours -> safe no-op (AC-4)
    local slot = tonumber(slotStr)
    if not slot then return end
    if _tmSheetBagClickLock == true then return end   -- re-entrancy / duplicate-click guard
    _tmSheetBagClickLock = true
    -- Everything between the lock set and clear is pcall-protected so a throw can
    -- never leave the click engine's lock stuck true (which would dead-lock every
    -- future sheet-bag click until the engine is recreated).
    -- A fresh click engine has an empty in-engine slot table; restore it from the
    -- persisted chat var so the payload resolves.
    if type(tmSheetBagLoadStoredSlotActions) == "function" then
        pcall(tmSheetBagLoadStoredSlotActions, id)
    end
    -- Resolve the slot payload up front. A stale/consumed slot yields empty here;
    -- return silently WITHOUT entering tmSheetBagHandleAction (which would tmError
    -- -> open an error popup and close the drawer). Silent no-op keeps drawer+state
    -- unchanged and calls no reload (AC-4).
    local pok, payload = pcall(function()
        local p = TM_SHEET_BAG_SLOT_ACTIONS[slot]
        if not p or p == "" then p = tmSheetBagStoredSlotPayload(id, slot) end
        return p
    end)
    if pok ~= true or not payload or payload == "" then
        _tmSheetBagClickLock = false
        return
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(tmSheetBagHandleSlotAction, id, slot)
    if ok == true and result == "local_success" then
        pcall(tmSheetBagRebuildControlPanelVar, id)   -- var-write rebuild; NO reload
    end
    _tmSheetBagClickLock = false
    -- Intentionally no reloadDisplay/reloadChat/tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay here:
    -- Chat.svelte bumps ReloadChatPointer[idx] on its own for a single-message
    -- re-render, and the rebuilt tm_control_panel_html above makes that re-render
    -- reflect real state (destination row) independent of the :checked toggle.
end)

_G["tmToggleSheetBagSaleMode"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SALE_MODE_VAR, "off") == "on" and "off" or "on"
    setVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SALE_MODE_VAR, mode)
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, getVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_active_tab", tmGetActiveOwner(triggerId)))
end)

for _, tmSheetBagSaleOwnerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
    local ownerId = tmSheetBagSaleOwnerId
    _G["tmToggleSheetBagSaleMode_" .. ownerId] = guarded(function(triggerId)
        local mode = getVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SALE_MODE_VAR, "off") == "on" and "off" or "on"
        setVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SALE_MODE_VAR, mode)
        tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    end)
end

_G["tmSheetBagCancel"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local _, _, ownerId = tmSheetBagPending(triggerId)
    tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmSheetBagQueuePopupRefresh(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmSheetBagConfirmLearn"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local kind, action, ownerId, ref = tmSheetBagPending(triggerId)
    if kind ~= "skillbook" or action ~= "learn" or ref == "" then
        tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "선택 중인 스킬 등록 작업이 없습니다.",
            "No skill registration is currently selected.",
            "選択中のスキル登録操作がありません。"))
        return
    end
    if csvItemCount(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_skills", "")) >= TM_SKILL_LOADOUT_CAP then
        tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
        tmSheetBagWarnSkillFull(triggerId)
        tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
        return
    end
    tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
    tmApplySkillbookLearn(triggerId, ref, ownerId)
    tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmSheetBagQueueConfirmSuccessRefresh(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmSheetBagConfirmForget"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local kind, action, ownerId, ref = tmSheetBagPending(triggerId)
    if kind ~= "skill" or action ~= "forget" or ref == "" then
        tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "선택 중인 스킬 잊기 작업이 없습니다.",
            "No skill forget action is currently selected.",
            "選択中のスキル削除操作がありません。"))
        return
    end
    tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
    tmApplySkillForgetMarker(triggerId, ownerId, ref)
    tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
    tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    tmSheetBagQueueConfirmSuccessRefresh(triggerId)
end)

_G["tmSheetBagConfirmSell"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    local kind, action, ownerId, ref = tmSheetBagPending(triggerId)
    local ok = false
    tmSheetBagBeginDirectMutation(triggerId)
    if action == "sell" and ref ~= "" and kind == "item" then
        local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
        ok = select(1, tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, tostring(price), "shop_sell", "ui_sheet_button")) == true
    elseif action == "sell" and ref ~= "" and kind == "stack_item" then
        local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
        ok = tmSheetBagApplyStackItemSell(triggerId, ref, price) == true
    elseif action == "sell" and ref ~= "" and kind == "skillbook" then
        local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
        ok = select(1, tmApplySkillbookSellMarker(triggerId, ref, tostring(price), "ui_sheet_button")) == true
    end
    tmSheetBagClearPending(triggerId)
    if ok then
        tmClearPopupState(triggerId)
    else
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매를 처리하지 못했습니다.",
            "Could not complete the sale.",
            "売却を処理できませんでした。"))
    end
    tmSheetBagKeepOpen(triggerId, ownerId)
    if ok then
        tmSheetBagQueueConfirmSuccessRefresh(triggerId)
    end
end)

function tmPartyBagOwnerShortLabel(triggerId, ownerId)
    local owner = tostring(ownerId or "")
    local name = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. owner .. "_name_ko", "")
    if name == "" then name = CHAR_NAMES_KO[owner] or owner end
    return name
end

function tmPartyBagOwnerActionButtons(triggerId, action, ref, koLabel, enLabel, jaLabel, handlerFactory)
    local buttons = {}
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local owner = ownerId
        local itemRef = tostring(ref or "")
        local label = T(triggerId, koLabel, enLabel, jaLabel) .. " " .. tmPartyBagOwnerShortLabel(triggerId, owner)
        table.insert(buttons, tmPartyBagActionButton(label, tmPartyBagButtonFn(action, itemRef, owner), handlerFactory(owner, itemRef)))
    end
    if #buttons == 0 then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-party-bag-actions">' .. table.concat(buttons, "") .. '</div>'
end

function tmPartyBagSellPriceFromInput(rawInput)
    local text = tmTrimText(rawInput)
    if text == "" then return 0 end
    local digits = text:match("^(%d+)$")
    if not digits then return 0 end
    return tmServicePositivePrice(digits, nil)
end

function tmApplyPartyBagItemSellInput(triggerId, itemRef, rawInput)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" or not ref:match("^it%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "shop_sell_bad_ref")
        return false
    end
    local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFromInput(rawInput)
    if price <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "shop_sell_bad_price")
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매 가격은 양의 정수로 입력하세요.",
            "Enter a positive integer sell price.",
            "売却価格は正の整数で入力してください。"))
        return false
    end
    local ok = tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "sell", "none", ref, tostring(price), "shop_sell", "ui_button")
    return ok == true
end

function tmStartPartyBagItemSellInput(triggerId, itemRef)
    local ref = tmCleanItemRef(itemRef)
    if ref == "" or not ref:match("^it%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "shop_sell_bad_ref")
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매할 수 있는 공용 가방 아이템을 찾을 수 없습니다.",
            "Could not find a sellable shared party-bag item.",
            "売却できる共有バッグのアイテムが見つかりません。"))
        return false
    end
    return tmPartyBagOpenSellConfirm(triggerId, "item", ref)
end

function tmApplyPartyBagSkillbookSellInput(triggerId, sbRef, rawInput)
    local ref = tostring(sbRef or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if not ref:match("^sb%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_sell_bad_ref")
        return false
    end
    local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFromInput(rawInput)
    if price <= 0 then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_sell_bad_price")
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매 가격은 양의 정수로 입력하세요.",
            "Enter a positive integer sell price.",
            "売却価格は正の整数で入力してください。"))
        return false
    end
    local ok = tmApplySkillbookSellMarker(triggerId, ref, tostring(price), "ui_button")
    return ok == true
end

function tmStartPartyBagSkillbookSellInput(triggerId, sbRef)
    local ref = tostring(sbRef or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if not ref:match("^sb%d+$") then
        tmLootFail(triggerId, "skillbook_sell_bad_ref")
        tmError(triggerId, T(triggerId,
            "판매할 수 있는 스킬북을 찾을 수 없습니다.",
            "Could not find a sellable skillbook.",
            "売却できるスキルブックが見つかりません。"))
        return false
    end
    return tmPartyBagOpenSellConfirm(triggerId, "skillbook", ref)
end

function tmLoadoutEntryHtml(label, tip, actionHtml, className)
    local cls = "tm-loadout-entry"
    if tostring(className or "") ~= "" then cls = cls .. " " .. tostring(className) end
    return '<span class="' .. tmEscapeHtml(cls) .. '">' .. tostring(actionHtml or "") .. tmLoadoutChipHtml(label, tip) .. '</span>'
end

function tmSheetBagPendingOwnerEntriesHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then return "" end
    local out = {}
    local items = getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none")
    if items ~= "" and items ~= "none" then
        for _, itemId in ipairs(parseList(items, ",")) do
            local id = itemId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and id:match("^it%d+$") then
                local key = tmSheetBagActionKey("item", "give", ownerId, id)
                local label = tmItemRefAssignable(triggerId, id) and tmSheetBagItemLabel(triggerId, id) or tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, id)
                table.insert(out, tmLoadoutEntryHtml(label, tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId), "", "tm-sheet-local-pending-entry tm-sheet-local-show-" .. key))
            end
        end
    end
    local stackItems = getVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", "none")
    if stackItems ~= "" and stackItems ~= "none" then
        for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(stackItems, ",")) do
            local id, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
            if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and count > 0 and TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then
                local key = tmSheetBagActionKey("stack_item", "give", ownerId, id)
                table.insert(out, tmLoadoutEntryHtml(tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id), tmStackItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId), "", "tm-sheet-local-pending-entry tm-sheet-local-show-" .. key))
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out, "")
end

function tmOwnerEquipmentItemsHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    local out = {}
    local equipment = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", "")
    for itemId in tostring(equipment):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local id = itemId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" then
            local action = ""
            local hideClass = ""
            if id:match("^it%d+$") then
                local ref = id
                local owner = ownerId
                action = tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "owner_item", "unequip", owner, ref)
                hideClass = tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey("owner_item", "unequip", owner, ref), false)
            elseif id:match("^eq_l%d+_") and tmFormulaParts(id) then
                local ref = id
                local owner = ownerId
                action = tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "owner_formula_equipment", "unequip", owner, ref)
                hideClass = tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey("owner_formula_equipment", "unequip", owner, ref), false)
            end
            table.insert(out, tmLoadoutEntryHtml(tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, id), tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId), action, hideClass))
        end
    end
    local items = getVar(triggerId, tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId), "none")
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(items, ",")) do
        local id, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
        if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and count > 0 then
            local label = tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id)
            if count > 1 then label = label .. " x" .. tostring(count) end
            local action = ""
            local hideClass = ""
            if id:match("^it%d+$") then
                local ref = id
                local owner = ownerId
                action = tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "owner_item", "release", owner, ref)
                hideClass = tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey("owner_item", "release", owner, ref), false)
            elseif TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then
                local ref = id
                local owner = ownerId
                action = tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "owner_stack_item", "release", owner, ref)
                hideClass = tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey("owner_stack_item", "release", owner, ref), false)
            end
            table.insert(out, tmLoadoutEntryHtml(label, tmStackItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId), action, hideClass))
        end
    end
    local pending = tmSheetBagPendingOwnerEntriesHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    if #out == 0 and pending == "" then return '<span class="tm-loadout-empty">none</span>' end
    if pending ~= "" then table.insert(out, pending) end
    return '<span class="tm-loadout-list">' .. table.concat(out, "") .. '</span>'
end

function tmSheetBagSaleMode(triggerId)
    return getVar(triggerId, TM_SHEET_BAG_SALE_MODE_VAR, "off") == "on"
end

function tmSheetBagSaleInputId(triggerId, ownerId)
    return "tm-sheet-bag-sale-" .. tmDrawerDomKey(triggerId) .. "-" .. tmDrawerSafeDomKeyPart(ownerId)
end

function tmSheetBagActionModesHtml(normalAction, saleAction)
    return '<span class="tm-sheet-bag-normal-action">' .. tostring(normalAction or "") .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-sheet-bag-sale-action">' .. tostring(saleAction or "") .. '</span>'
end

function tmSheetBagHideClass(key, row)
    if tostring(key or "") == "" then return "" end
    return (row and "tm-sheet-local-hide-row-" or "tm-sheet-local-hide-") .. tostring(key)
end

function tmSheetBagCommonRowHideClasses(kind, ref, ownerId, ownerLinked)
    local owners = {}
    if ownerLinked then
        for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do table.insert(owners, id) end
    elseif CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
        table.insert(owners, ownerId)
    end
    local classes = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(owners) do
        table.insert(classes, tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey(kind, "give", id, ref), true))
        table.insert(classes, tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey(kind, "sell", id, ref), true))
    end
    return table.concat(classes, " ")
end

function tmSheetBagSkillbookRowHideClasses(ref, ownerId, ownerLinked)
    local owners = {}
    if ownerLinked then
        for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do table.insert(owners, id) end
    elseif CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
        table.insert(owners, ownerId)
    end
    local classes = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(owners) do
        table.insert(classes, tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey("skillbook", "learn", id, ref), true))
        table.insert(classes, tmSheetBagHideClass(tmSheetBagActionKey("skillbook", "sell", id, ref), true))
    end
    return table.concat(classes, " ")
end

function tmSheetBagSalePriceSuffixHtml(triggerId, kind, ref)
    local price = tmPartyBagSellPriceFor(triggerId, kind, ref)
    if price <= 0 then return "" end
    return '<span class="tm-sheet-sale-price"> (' .. tmEscapeHtml(tostring(price)) .. 'G)</span>'
end

function tmSheetBagItemLabel(triggerId, itemId)
    local id = tostring(itemId or "")
    if TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[tmStackItemId(id)] then return tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id) end
    if not id:match("^it%d+$") then return tmEquipLabel(triggerId, id) end
    local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_item_registry", id)
    if not record then return id end
    local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
    local name = tmTrimVisibleText(fields[2] or "")
    if name == "" then name = T(triggerId, "아이템", "item", "アイテム") end
    return name .. "(" .. tmRarityLabel(triggerId, fields[3] or "common") .. ")"
end

function tmSheetBagSkillbookLabel(triggerId, sbRef)
    local rec = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", sbRef)
    if not rec then return T(triggerId, "스킬북", "Skillbook", "スキルブック") end
    local f = tmRegistryFields(rec)
    local name = tmTrimVisibleText(f[2] or "")
    if name == "" then name = T(triggerId, "스킬북", "Skillbook", "スキルブック") end
    local suffix = f[8] or "owned"
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        suffix = suffix == "learned" and "습득" or (suffix == "sold" and "판매됨" or "소지")
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        suffix = suffix == "learned" and "習得" or (suffix == "sold" and "売却済み" or "所持")
    end
    return name .. "(" .. suffix .. ")"
end

function tmSheetBagRowHtml(actionHtml, label, tip, className, suffixHtml)
    return '<div class="tm-sheet-bag-row ' .. tostring(className or "") .. '"><span class="tm-sheet-bag-act">' .. tostring(actionHtml or "")
        .. '</span><span class="tm-sheet-bag-item">' .. tmLoadoutChipHtmlWithSuffix(label, tip, suffixHtml) .. '</span></div>'
end

function tmSheetBagPendingCommonRowsHtml(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local equipment = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", "")
        for itemId in tostring(equipment):gmatch("[^,]+") do
            local id = itemId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" then
                local kind = nil
                if id:match("^it%d+$") then
                    kind = "owner_item"
                elseif id:match("^eq_l%d+_") and tmFormulaParts(id) then
                    kind = "owner_formula_equipment"
                end
                if kind then
                    local key = tmSheetBagActionKey(kind, "unequip", ownerId, id)
                    table.insert(rows, tmSheetBagRowHtml("", tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, id), tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId), "tm-sheet-local-pending-row tm-sheet-local-show-row-" .. key, ""))
                end
            end
        end
        local items = getVar(triggerId, tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId), "none")
        for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(items, ",")) do
            local id, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
            if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and count > 0 then
                local key
                local label
                local tip
                if id:match("^it%d+$") then
                    key = tmSheetBagActionKey("owner_item", "release", ownerId, id)
                    label = tmSheetBagItemLabel(triggerId, id)
                    tip = tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId)
                elseif TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then
                    key = tmSheetBagActionKey("owner_stack_item", "release", ownerId, id)
                    label = tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id)
                    tip = tmStackItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId)
                end
                if key then
                    table.insert(rows, tmSheetBagRowHtml("", label, tip, "tm-sheet-local-pending-row tm-sheet-local-show-row-" .. key, ""))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(rows, "")
end

function tmSheetBagItemsSectionHtml(triggerId, ownerId, saleMode, opts)
    local ownerLinked = type(opts) == "table" and opts.ownerLinked == true
    local cssSaleMode = saleMode == "css"
    local rows = {}
    local items = getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none")
    if items ~= "" and items ~= "none" then
        for _, itemId in ipairs(parseList(items, ",")) do
            local id = itemId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and id:match("^it%d+$") then
                local action
                if cssSaleMode and ownerLinked then
                    action = tmSheetBagActionModesHtml(
                        tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("+", "item", "give", id),
                        tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("-", "item", "sell", id))
                elseif cssSaleMode then
                    action = tmSheetBagActionModesHtml(
                        tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("+", "item", "give", ownerId, id),
                        tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "item", "sell", ownerId, id))
                elseif ownerLinked then
                    action = saleMode
                        and tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("-", "item", "sell", id)
                        or tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("+", "item", "give", id)
                else
                    action = saleMode
                        and tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "item", "sell", ownerId, id)
                        or tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("+", "item", "give", ownerId, id)
                end
                local rowClass = "tm-sheet-bag-item-row " .. tmSheetBagCommonRowHideClasses("item", id, ownerId, ownerLinked)
                table.insert(rows, tmSheetBagRowHtml(action, tmSheetBagItemLabel(triggerId, id), tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId), rowClass, tmSheetBagSalePriceSuffixHtml(triggerId, "item", id)))
            end
        end
    end
    local stackItems = getVar(triggerId, "party_stack_items", "none")
    if stackItems ~= "" and stackItems ~= "none" then
        for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(stackItems, ",")) do
            local id, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
            if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" and count > 0 and TM_STACK_ITEM_DEFS[id] then
                local label = tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, id)
                if count > 1 then label = label .. " x" .. tostring(count) end
                local action
                if cssSaleMode and ownerLinked then
                    action = tmSheetBagActionModesHtml(
                        tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("+", "stack_item", "give", id),
                        tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("-", "stack_item", "sell", id))
                elseif cssSaleMode then
                    action = tmSheetBagActionModesHtml(
                        tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("+", "stack_item", "give", ownerId, id),
                        tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "stack_item", "sell", ownerId, id))
                elseif ownerLinked then
                    action = saleMode
                        and tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("-", "stack_item", "sell", id)
                        or tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("+", "stack_item", "give", id)
                else
                    action = saleMode
                        and tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "stack_item", "sell", ownerId, id)
                        or tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("+", "stack_item", "give", ownerId, id)
                end
                local rowClass = "tm-sheet-bag-stack-item-row " .. tmSheetBagCommonRowHideClasses("stack_item", id, ownerId, ownerLinked)
                table.insert(rows, tmSheetBagRowHtml(action, label, tmStackItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, ownerId), rowClass, tmSheetBagSalePriceSuffixHtml(triggerId, "stack_item", id)))
            end
        end
    end
    local pending = tmSheetBagPendingCommonRowsHtml(triggerId)
    if #rows == 0 then
        table.insert(rows, '<div class="tm-sheet-bag-empty">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "아이템 없음", "No items", "アイテムなし")) .. '</div>')
    end
    if pending ~= "" then table.insert(rows, pending) end
    return '<div class="tm-sheet-bag-section"><div class="tm-sheet-bag-section-title">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "아이템/장비", "Items/Equipment", "アイテム/装備")) .. '</div><div class="tm-sheet-bag-list">' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</div></div>'
end

function tmSheetBagSkillbooksSectionHtml(triggerId, ownerId, saleMode, opts)
    local ownerLinked = type(opts) == "table" and opts.ownerLinked == true
    local cssSaleMode = saleMode == "css"
    local rows = {}
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")
    if registry ~= "" and registry ~= "none" then
        for record in tostring(registry):gmatch("[^;]+") do
            local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
            local ref = f[1] or ""
            if ref ~= "" and f[8] == "owned" then
                local action
                if cssSaleMode and ownerLinked then
                    action = tmSheetBagActionModesHtml(
                        tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("+", "skillbook", "learn", ref),
                        tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("-", "skillbook", "sell", ref))
                elseif cssSaleMode then
