                    action = tmSheetBagActionModesHtml(
                        tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("+", "skillbook", "learn", ownerId, ref),
                        tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "skillbook", "sell", ownerId, ref))
                elseif ownerLinked then
                    action = saleMode
                        and tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("-", "skillbook", "sell", ref)
                        or tmSheetBagOwnerActionGroupsHtml("+", "skillbook", "learn", ref)
                else
                    action = saleMode
                        and tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("-", "skillbook", "sell", ownerId, ref)
                        or tmSheetBagSlotActionButton("+", "skillbook", "learn", ownerId, ref)
                end
                local rowClass = "tm-sheet-bag-skillbook-row " .. tmSheetBagSkillbookRowHideClasses(ref, ownerId, ownerLinked)
                table.insert(rows, tmSheetBagRowHtml(action, tmSheetBagSkillbookLabel(triggerId, ref), tmSkillbookTooltipText(triggerId, ref), rowClass, tmSheetBagSalePriceSuffixHtml(triggerId, "skillbook", ref)))
            end
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then
        table.insert(rows, '<div class="tm-sheet-bag-empty">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "스킬북 없음", "No skillbooks", "スキルブックなし")) .. '</div>')
    end
    return '<div class="tm-sheet-bag-section"><div class="tm-sheet-bag-section-title">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "스킬북", "Skillbooks", "スキルブック")) .. '</div><div class="tm-sheet-bag-list">' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</div></div>'
end

function tmCharacterSheetPartyBagHtml(triggerId, ownerId, opts)
    if not tmPartyBagActionsAvailable(triggerId) then return "" end
    local ownerLinked = type(opts) == "table" and opts.ownerLinked == true
    local saleMode = "css"
    local saleInputId = tmEscapeHtml(tmSheetBagSaleInputId(triggerId, ownerId))
    local gold = tostring(tmGetPartyGold(triggerId))
    local saleToggle = '<label class="tm-sheet-bag-sale-label tm-sheet-bag-sale-label-off" for="' .. saleInputId .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "판매 OFF", "Sale OFF", "販売 OFF")) .. '</label>'
        .. '<label class="tm-sheet-bag-sale-label tm-sheet-bag-sale-label-on" for="' .. saleInputId .. '">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "판매 ON", "Sale ON", "販売 ON")) .. '</label>'
    return '<div class="tm-s5-card tm-sheet-bag-card"><input type="checkbox" class="tm-sheet-bag-sale-state" id="' .. saleInputId .. '"><div class="tm-sheet-bag-head"><span class="tm-s5-card-k">'
        .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "공용 가방", "Party Bag", "共有バッグ"))
        .. '</span><span class="tm-sheet-bag-gold">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "소지금", "Gold", "所持金")) .. ': ' .. gold .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "골드", " gold", " Gold")) .. '</span><span class="tm-sheet-bag-sale-toggle">' .. saleToggle .. '</span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-sheet-bag-grid">'
        .. tmSheetBagItemsSectionHtml(triggerId, ownerId, saleMode, {ownerLinked = ownerLinked})
        .. tmSheetBagSkillbooksSectionHtml(triggerId, ownerId, saleMode, {ownerLinked = ownerLinked})
        .. '</div></div>'
end

function tmPartyItemsDisplay(triggerId)
    local items = getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none")
    if items == "" or items == "none" then return "none" end
    local out = {}
    for itemId in tostring(items):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        table.insert(out, tmEquipLabel(triggerId, itemId))
    end
    if #out == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(out, ", ")
end

function tmPartyBagItemsSectionHtml(triggerId)
    local items = getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none")
    local rows = {}
    if items ~= "" and items ~= "none" then
        for itemId in tostring(items):gmatch("[^,]+") do
            local id = itemId:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if id ~= "" and id ~= "none" then
                local label = tmEquipLabel(triggerId, id)
                local tip = tmItemTooltipText(triggerId, id, nil)
                local actions = ""
                if tmPartyBagActionsAvailable(triggerId) and id:match("^it%d+$") then
                    local route = tmItemRefAssignable(triggerId, id) and "assign" or "equip"
                    actions = '<span class="tm-party-bag-row-actions">'
                        .. tmPartyBagSlotActionButton(T(triggerId, "장비", "Equip", "装備"), "item", route, id)
                        .. tmPartyBagSlotActionButton(T(triggerId, "판매", "Sell", "売却"), "item", "sell", id)
                        .. '</span>'
                end
                table.insert(rows, '<div class="tm-party-bag-row"><span class="tm-party-bag-ref">' .. tmEscapeHtml(id) .. '</span><span class="tm-party-bag-item">' .. tmLoadoutChipHtml(label, tip) .. '</span>' .. actions .. '</div>')
            end
        end
    end
    if #rows == 0 then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-party-bag-section"><div class="tm-party-bag-heading">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "아이템", "Items", "アイテム")) .. '</div><div class="tm-party-bag-list">' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</div></div>'
end

function tmPartyBagSkillbooksSectionHtml(triggerId)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")

    if registry ~= "" and registry ~= "none" then

    if #rows == 0 then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-party-bag-section"><div class="tm-party-bag-heading">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "스킬북", "Skillbooks", "スキルブック")) .. '</div><div class="tm-party-bag-list">' .. table.concat(rows, "") .. '</div></div>'
end

function tmPartyBagHtml(triggerId)
    tmPartyBagResetActionSlots()
    local itemSection = tmPartyBagItemsSectionHtml(triggerId)
    local skillbookSection = tmPartyBagSkillbooksSectionHtml(triggerId)
    tmPartyBagPersistSlotActions(triggerId)
    local goldHtml = ""
    if tmPartyBagActionsAvailable(triggerId) then
        goldHtml = '<div class="tm-party-bag-gold">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "소지금", "Gold", "所持金")) .. ': ' .. tostring(tmGetPartyGold(triggerId)) .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "골드", " gold", " Gold")) .. '</div>'
    end
    local selectorHtml = tmPartyBagSelectorHtml(triggerId)
    local unavailableHtml = tmPartyBagActionUnavailableHtml(triggerId)
    if itemSection == "" and skillbookSection == "" then
        return '<div class="tm-party-bag">' .. goldHtml .. selectorHtml .. unavailableHtml .. '<div class="tm-party-bag-empty">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "공용 가방에 보관 중인 전리품이 없습니다.", "No loot is currently stored in the party bag.", "共有バッグに保管中の戦利品はありません。")) .. '</div></div>'
    end
    local note = T(triggerId,
        "공용 전리품과 파티 소지금",
        "Shared loot and party gold",
        "共有戦利品とパーティ所持金")
    return '<div class="tm-party-bag">' .. goldHtml .. selectorHtml .. unavailableHtml .. '<div class="tm-side-note">' .. tmEscapeHtml(note) .. '</div>' .. itemSection .. skillbookSection .. '</div>'
end

-- tmPartyItemsWithRefs: prompt-facing list "it001(낡은 은단검)" so the LLM knows
-- which it-ref to use in ▥EQUIP:owner|item_ref▥.
function tmPartyItemsWithRefs(triggerId)
    local items = getVar(triggerId, "party_items", "none")
    if items == "" or items == "none" then return "none" end
    local out = {}
    for itemId in tostring(items):gmatch("[^,]+") do
        local name = tmItemRegistryField(triggerId, itemId, 2)
        if itemId:match("^it%d+$") and name then
            table.insert(out, itemId .. "(" .. name .. ")")
        else
            table.insert(out, itemId)
        end
    end
    if #out == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(out, ",")
end

function tmSkillbookLabel(triggerId, sbRef)
    local rec = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", sbRef)
    if not rec then return tostring(sbRef or "") end
    local f = tmRegistryFields(rec)
    local state = f[8] or "owned"
    local learnedBy = f[10] or "-"
    local name = tmTrimVisibleText(f[2] or sbRef)
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" and not tmTextHasHangul(name) then
        name = "스킬북 " .. tostring(sbRef)
    end
    local suffix = state
    if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
        if state == "learned" then
            suffix = "습득"
        elseif state == "appraised" then
            suffix = "감정됨"
        else
            suffix = "소지"
        end
    elseif tmLang(triggerId) == "ja" then
        if state == "learned" then
            suffix = "習得"
        elseif state == "appraised" then
            suffix = "鑑定済み"
        else
            suffix = "所持"
        end
    end
    if state == "learned" and learnedBy ~= "" and learnedBy ~= "-" then
        if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
            suffix = suffix .. ": " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, learnedBy)
        else
            suffix = suffix .. " by " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, learnedBy)
        end
    end
    return name .. " (" .. sbRef .. ", " .. suffix .. ")"
end

function tmPartySkillbooksDisplay(triggerId)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")
    if registry == "" or registry == "none" then return "none" end
    local out = {}
    for record in tostring(registry):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
        if f[1] and f[1] ~= "" and f[8] == "owned" then
            table.insert(out, tmSkillbookLabel(triggerId, f[1]))
        end
    end
    if #out == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(out, ", ")
end

function tmPartySkillbooksWithRefs(triggerId)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")
    if registry == "" or registry == "none" then return "none" end
    local out = {}
    for record in tostring(registry):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
        if f[1] and f[1] ~= "" and f[8] == "owned" then
            table.insert(out, string.format("%s(name=%s,state=%s,grade=%s,stat=%s,role=%s,learned_by=%s)",
                f[1] or "", f[2] or "", f[8] or "", f[4] or "", f[5] or "", f[6] or "", f[10] or "-"))
        end
    end
    if #out == 0 then return "none" end
    return table.concat(out, ",")
end

function tmPartySkillbooksHtml(triggerId)
    local registry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")
    if registry == "" or registry == "none" then return '<span class="tm-loadout-empty">none</span>' end
    local out = {}
    for record in tostring(registry):gmatch("[^;]+") do
        local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
        if f[1] and f[1] ~= "" and f[8] == "owned" then
            table.insert(out, tmLoadoutChipHtml(tmSkillbookLabel(triggerId, f[1]), tmSkillbookTooltipText(triggerId, f[1])))
        end
    end
    if #out == 0 then return '<span class="tm-loadout-empty">none</span>' end
    return '<span class="tm-loadout-list">' .. table.concat(out, "") .. '</span>'
end

function tmPartyRewardSummaryHtml(triggerId)
    return "XP " .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0))
        .. " / items " .. tmEscapeHtml(tmPartyItemsDisplay(triggerId))
        .. " / skillbooks " .. tmPartySkillbooksHtml(triggerId)
end

function tmRuntimeRegistrySummary(triggerId)
    local rows = {}
    local itemRegistry = getVar(triggerId, "party_item_registry", "none")
    if itemRegistry ~= "" and itemRegistry ~= "none" then
        for record in itemRegistry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
            local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
            if f[1] and f[1] ~= "" then
                local note = tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, "item_effect_notes", f[1])
                table.insert(rows, string.format("- item %s name=%s rarity=%s base=%s kind=%s slot=%s stat=%s role=%s owner=%s effect=%s",
                    f[1] or "", f[2] or "", f[3] or "", f[4] or "", f[5] or "", f[6] or "", f[8] or "", f[9] or "", f[10] or "", note ~= "" and note or "-"))
            end
        end
    end
    local skillRegistry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skill_registry", "none")
    if skillRegistry ~= "" and skillRegistry ~= "none" then
        for record in skillRegistry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
            local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
            if f[1] and f[1] ~= "" then
                local note = tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", f[1])
                table.insert(rows, string.format("- skill %s owner=%s name=%s rarity=%s base=%s stat=%s role=%s mp=%s effect=%s",
                    f[1] or "", f[2] or "", f[3] or "", f[4] or "", f[5] or "", f[7] or "", f[8] or "", tostring(tmSkillMpCost(triggerId, f[1])), note ~= "" and note or "-"))
            end
        end
    end
    local skillbookRegistry = getVar(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", "none")
    if skillbookRegistry ~= "" and skillbookRegistry ~= "none" then
        for record in skillbookRegistry:gmatch("[^;]+") do
            local f = tmRegistryFields(record)
            if f[1] and f[1] ~= "" then
                local note = f[9] and f[9] ~= "-" and tmRegistryNoteForRef(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes", f[9]) or ""
                table.insert(rows, string.format("- skillbook %s name=%s rarity=%s grade=%s stat=%s role=%s source=%s state=%s learned_by=%s effect=%s",
                    f[1] or "", f[2] or "", f[3] or "", f[4] or "", f[5] or "", f[6] or "", f[7] or "", f[8] or "", f[10] or "-", note ~= "" and note or "-"))
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(rows, "\n")
end

function getDiceResultTier(raw, total, dc)
    if raw == 1 then return "crit_fail" end
    if raw == 20 or total >= dc + 10 then return "crit_success" end
    if total >= dc then return "success" end
    if total >= dc - 3 then return "partial" end
    return "fail"
end

function resolveAction(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc)
    dc = dc or 13
    local status = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. actorId .. "_status", "active")
    if status == "ko" then
        return {actor = actorId, tier = "crit_fail", raw = 0, total = 0, dc = dc,
                stat = statKey, mod = 0, penalty = 0, reason = "ko"}
    end
    local effectiveStat, statVal, equipmentBonus = tmEffectivePlayerStat(triggerId, actorId, statKey, 10)
    local mod = getAbilityMod(effectiveStat)
    local penalty = 0
    local conditionPenalty, conditionDetail = tmConditionPenalty(triggerId, actorId, statKey)
    penalty = penalty + conditionPenalty
    local bonus = mod + penalty
    local raw, total = rollD20(bonus)
    local tier = getDiceResultTier(raw, total, dc)
    return {actor = actorId, tier = tier, raw = raw, total = total, dc = dc,
            stat = statKey, mod = mod, penalty = penalty, equipmentBonus = equipmentBonus,
            statValue = statVal, effectiveStat = effectiveStat,
            conditionPenalty = conditionPenalty, conditionDetail = conditionDetail}
end

function resolveActionWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    dc = dc or 13
    local status = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. actorId .. "_status", "active")
    if status == "ko" then
        return {actor = actorId, tier = "crit_fail", raw = 0, total = 0, dc = dc,
                stat = statKey, mod = 0, penalty = 0, reason = "ko"}
    end
    local effectiveStat, statVal, equipmentBonus = tmEffectivePlayerStat(triggerId, actorId, statKey, 10)
    local mod = getAbilityMod(effectiveStat)
    local conditionPenalty, conditionDetail = tmConditionPenalty(triggerId, actorId, statKey)
    local situational = (tonumber(bonusAdjust) or 0) - (tonumber(penaltyAdjust) or 0)
    local penalty = conditionPenalty + situational
    raw = clamp(math.floor(tonumber(raw) or 1), 1, 20)
    local total = raw + mod + penalty
    local tier = getDiceResultTier(raw, total, dc)
    return {actor = actorId, tier = tier, raw = raw, total = total, dc = dc,
            stat = statKey, mod = mod, penalty = penalty, equipmentBonus = equipmentBonus,
            statValue = statVal, effectiveStat = effectiveStat,
            conditionPenalty = conditionPenalty, conditionDetail = conditionDetail}
end

function damageHeroine(triggerId, id, dmg)
    if not dmg or dmg <= 0 then return getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 30) end
    local cur = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 30)
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 30)
    local new = clamp(cur - dmg, 0, hpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", new)
    if new == 0 then setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "ko") end
    return new
end

function healHeroine(triggerId, id, amt)
    if not amt or amt <= 0 then return getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 30) end
    local cur = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 30)
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 30)
    local new = clamp(cur + amt, 0, hpMax)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", new)
    if new > 0 and getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active") == "ko" then
        setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active")
    end
    return new
end

function adjustHeroineHp(triggerId, id, delta)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] then return false end
    local amount = tonumber(delta) or 0
    if amount < 0 then
        damageHeroine(triggerId, id, math.abs(amount))
    elseif amount > 0 then
        healHeroine(triggerId, id, amount)
    end
    return true
end

function adjustHeroineMp(triggerId, id, delta)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] then return false end
    tmEnsureSheet(triggerId, id)
    local amount = tonumber(delta) or 0
    local cur = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_mp", 0)
    local mpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_mp_max", 0)
    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_mp", clamp(cur + amount, 0, mpMax))
    return true
end

-- resolveCombat: SINGLE-ROLL fresh (HG executeCombat 20-turn loop REJECTED per 003 §4.1)
function tmXpVarKey(prefix, id)
    return prefix .. "_" .. tostring(id or "unknown"):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "_")
end

function tmAwardXp(triggerId, amount, reason, onceKey)
    local xpGain = math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0)
    if xpGain <= 0 then return false end
    if onceKey and onceKey ~= "" then
        local varName = tmXpVarKey("xp_awarded", onceKey)
        if getVar(triggerId, varName, "false") == "true" then return false end
        setVar(triggerId, varName, "true")
    end
    local xp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0) + xpGain
    setVar(triggerId, "party_xp", xp)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "xp:" .. tostring(reason or "runtime") .. ":" .. tostring(xpGain))
    tmRefreshLevelReady(triggerId)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "XP +" .. tostring(xpGain) .. " / " .. tostring(reason or "runtime") .. " / total " .. tostring(xp))
    tmAutoLevelUpReadyParty(triggerId)
    return true
end

TM_GOLD_MAX_SINGLE = 1000000

function tmAwardGold(triggerId, amount, reason, onceKey)
    local gain = math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0)
    if gain <= 0 then return false end
    gain = clamp(gain, 0, TM_GOLD_MAX_SINGLE)
    if onceKey and onceKey ~= "" then
        local varName = tmXpVarKey("xp_awarded", onceKey)
        if getVar(triggerId, varName, "false") == "true" then return false end
        setVar(triggerId, varName, "true")
    end
    local gold = (type(tmGetPartyGold) == "function" and tmGetPartyGold(triggerId) or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)) + gain
    setVar(triggerId, "party_gold", gold)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "GOLD +" .. tostring(gain) .. " / " .. tostring(reason or "runtime") .. " / total " .. tostring(gold))
    return true
end

-- tmSpendGold: the ONLY function permitted to decrease party_gold.
function tmSpendGold(triggerId, amount, reason)
    local cost = math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0)
    if cost <= 0 then return false end
    cost = clamp(cost, 0, TM_GOLD_MAX_SINGLE)
    local gold = type(tmGetPartyGold) == "function" and tmGetPartyGold(triggerId) or getNumVar(triggerId, "party_gold", 100)
    if cost > gold then return false end
    local remaining = clamp(gold - cost, 0, gold)
    setVar(triggerId, "party_gold", remaining)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "GOLD -" .. tostring(cost) .. " / " .. tostring(reason or "runtime") .. " / total " .. tostring(remaining))
    return true
end

function tmRollXpForTier(tier)
    return 1
end

function tmDiceXpMultiplier(triggerId)
    local value = getNumVar(triggerId, "dice_xp_multiplier", 1)
    if value == 2 or value == 3 then return value end
    return 1
end

function tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, tier)
    local gain = tmRollXpForTier(tier) * tmDiceXpMultiplier(triggerId)
    if gain <= 0 then return false end
    local episode = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
    if episode == "" then episode = getVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", "session") end
    local capVar = tmXpVarKey("roll_xp_total", episode)
    local current = getNumVar(triggerId, capVar, 0)
    setVar(triggerId, capVar, current + gain)
    return tmAwardXp(triggerId, gain, "roll_check", nil)
end

function tmEpisodeRewardXp(triggerId, episodeId)
    local content = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId)
    local rewards = tmEpisodeSection(content, "REWARDS")
    local xp = tonumber(rewards:match("[Xx][Pp]%s*[:=]%s*(%d+)")) or tonumber(rewards:match("(%d+)%s*[Xx][Pp]")) or 0
    return xp
end

function tmEpisodeRewardGold(triggerId, episodeId)
    local content = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId)
    local rewards = tmEpisodeSection(content, "REWARDS")
    local gold = tonumber(rewards:match("[Gg][Oo][Ll][Dd]%s*[:=]%s*(%d+)")) or 0
    return gold
end

function tmEpisodeRewardField(triggerId, episodeId, fieldNames)
    local content = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId)
    local rewards = tmEpisodeSection(content, "REWARDS")
    if rewards == "" then return "" end
    local wanted = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(fieldNames or {}) do
        local key = tmTrimText(name):lower()
        if key ~= "" then wanted[key] = true end
    end
    for line in (rewards .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local key, value = tmTrimText(line):match("^([%w_]+)%s*[:=]%s*(.+)$")
        if key and wanted[key:lower()] then
            return tmTrimText(value)
        end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmEpisodeRewardValueIsNone(value)
    local v = tmTrimText(value):lower()
    return v == "" or v == "none" or v == "no" or v == "n/a" or v == "-"
end

function tmAwardEpisodeClearLoot(triggerId, episodeId, options)
    local opts = options or {}
    local anyAwarded = false

    if not opts.skipItem then
        local itemName = tmEpisodeRewardField(triggerId, episodeId, {"ITEM", "ITEM_HINT"})
        if not tmEpisodeRewardValueIsNone(itemName) then
            local guardVar = tmXpVarKey("xp_awarded", "episode_clear_item:" .. tostring(episodeId or "unknown"))
            if getVar(triggerId, guardVar, "false") ~= "true" then
                local ref, storedName = tmStoreLootItem(triggerId, itemName, nil)
                if ref then
                    setVar(triggerId, guardVar, "true")
                    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "episode_clear_item:" .. ref)
                    tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
                    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "에피소드 보상 아이템: " .. storedName .. " (" .. ref .. ")")
                    anyAwarded = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not opts.skipSkillbook then
        local skillbookName = tmEpisodeRewardField(triggerId, episodeId, {"SKILLBOOK", "SKILLBOOK_HINT"})
        if not tmEpisodeRewardValueIsNone(skillbookName) then
            local guardVar = tmXpVarKey("xp_awarded", "episode_clear_skillbook:" .. tostring(episodeId or "unknown"))
            if getVar(triggerId, guardVar, "false") ~= "true" then
                local ref = tmStoreRewardSkillbook(triggerId, {
                    name = skillbookName,
                    rarity = "common",
                    grade = "C",
                    stat = "int",
                    role = "support",
                    source = tostring(episodeId or "episode"),
                })
                if ref then
                    setVar(triggerId, guardVar, "true")
                    tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
                    anyAwarded = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return anyAwarded
end

function tmEnemyXpValue(enemyId)
    local formula = tmParseEnemyFormulaId(enemyId)
    if not formula then return 10 end
    local mult = { fragile = 5, standard = 8, heavy = 12, apex = 18 }
    return (mult[formula.tier] or 8) * formula.band
end

function tmEnemyGoldValue(enemyId)
    local formula = tmParseEnemyFormulaId(enemyId)
    if not formula then return 6 end
    local base = { fragile = 4, standard = 6, heavy = 9, apex = 14 }
    return (base[formula.tier] or 6) * formula.band
end

function tmAwardEnemyDefeatXp(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_xp_awarded", "false") == "true" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_xp_awarded", "true")
    return tmAwardXp(triggerId, tmEnemyXpValue(enemyId), "enemy:" .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId), "enemy:" .. enemyId)
end

function tmAwardEnemyDefeatGold(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_gold_awarded", "false") == "true" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_gold_awarded", "true")
    return tmAwardGold(triggerId, tmEnemyGoldValue(enemyId), "enemy:" .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId), "enemy_gold:" .. enemyId)
end

function tmEnemyStatsCsv(triggerId, enemyId, hp)
    hp = clamp(tonumber(hp) or getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", 0), 0, 9999)
    return table.concat({
        "hp=" .. tostring(hp),
        "hp_max=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp_max", 20)),
        "dc=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_dc", 13)),
        "atk=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_atk", 4)),
        "defeated=" .. getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false"),
    }, ",")
end

function tmEnemyIsDefeated(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true" then return true end
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp_max", 0)
    if hpMax <= 0 then return false end
    return getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", hpMax) <= 0
end

function tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not tmEnemyIsDefeated(triggerId, enemyId) then return false end
    if getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "") == enemyId then
        setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
        setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy_slot", "")
        if type(tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy) == "function" then
            tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
        end
    end
    return true
end

function tmUpdateEnemyRuntimeState(triggerId, enemyId, hp)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return end
    local state = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true" and "defeated" or "active"
    local stats = tmEnemyStatsCsv(triggerId, enemyId, hp)
    for slot = 1, TM_OBJECT_SLOT_COUNT do
        local varName = tmObjectSlotVar(slot)
        local fields = tmObjectFields(getVar(triggerId, varName, ""))
        if fields[1] == "enemy" and fields[2] == enemyId then
            fields[4] = tmObjectSanitize(state, 24)
            fields[5] = tmObjectSanitize(stats, 120)
            setVar(triggerId, varName, table.concat(fields, "^"))
            if state == "defeated" then
                tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, enemyId)
            else
                setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", enemyId)
                setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy_slot", tmObjectSlotId(slot))
            end
            return
        end
    end
    pcall(tmStoreRuntimeEnemyObject, triggerId, enemyId)
    if state == "defeated" then tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, enemyId) end
end

function tmFinalizeEnemyDefeat(triggerId, enemyId, source)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return false end
    loadEnemy(triggerId, enemyId)
    local alreadyDefeated = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true"
    setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", 0)
    setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "true")
    tmUpdateEnemyRuntimeState(triggerId, enemyId, 0)
    tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, enemyId)
    tmAwardEnemyDefeatXp(triggerId, enemyId)
    tmAwardEnemyDefeatGold(triggerId, enemyId)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy_defeated:" .. enemyId)
    tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
    if not alreadyDefeated then
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "위협 처치: " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId) .. " / " .. tostring(source or "runtime"))
    end
    return true
end

function tmApplyEnemyDamage(triggerId, enemyId, amount, source)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return 0, false end
    loadEnemy(triggerId, enemyId)
    local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", 0)
    local nextHp = clamp(hp - (tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 9999)
    setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", nextHp)
    if nextHp <= 0 then
        tmFinalizeEnemyDefeat(triggerId, enemyId, source)
        return 0, true
    end
    tmUpdateEnemyRuntimeState(triggerId, enemyId, nextHp)
    return nextHp, false
end

function resolveCombat(triggerId, actorId, targetId, weapon)
    weapon = weapon or {damage = 4, stat = "str"}
    local dc = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_dc", 13)
    local result = resolveAction(triggerId, actorId, weapon.stat, dc)
    local effectiveStat = tmEffectivePlayerStat(triggerId, actorId, weapon.stat, 10)
    local statMod = getAbilityMod(effectiveStat)
    local baseDmg = (weapon.damage or 4) + statMod
    local mult = TIER_DAMAGE_MULT[result.tier] or 0
    local dmg = math.floor(baseDmg * mult)
    if dmg < 0 then dmg = 0 end
    local newEnemyHp, enemyDefeated = tmApplyEnemyDamage(triggerId, targetId, dmg, "combat:" .. tostring(actorId))
    local counterDmg = 0
    if result.tier == "fail" or result.tier == "crit_fail" then
        local enemyAtk = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_atk", 4)
        counterDmg = enemyAtk + (result.tier == "crit_fail" and 2 or 0)
        -- D045/P047 T002: defender's damage_reduction effects (trigger on_damage_taken)
        -- roll grade dice and reduce the incoming counter-damage before it lands.
        local reduction = 0
        for _, eff in ipairs(tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, actorId, "item+skill")) do
            if eff.effect == "damage_reduction" and tmResolveEffectTrigger(eff, "on_damage_taken") then
                reduction = reduction + tmRollDice(eff.count, eff.sides)
            end
        end
        if reduction > 0 then
            counterDmg = math.max(0, counterDmg - reduction)
        end
        damageHeroine(triggerId, actorId, counterDmg)
    end
    return {judgment = result, damageDealt = dmg, counterDmg = counterDmg,
            enemyHp = newEnemyHp, enemyDefeated = enemyDefeated}
end

function resolveCombatWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, targetId, weapon, raw, dcOverride, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    weapon = weapon or {damage = 4, stat = "str"}
    local dc = tonumber(dcOverride) or getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_dc", 13)
    local result = resolveActionWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, weapon.stat, dc, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    local effectiveStat = tmEffectivePlayerStat(triggerId, actorId, weapon.stat, 10)
    local statMod = getAbilityMod(effectiveStat)
    local baseDmg = (weapon.damage or 4) + statMod
    local mult = TIER_DAMAGE_MULT[result.tier] or 0
    local dmg = math.floor(baseDmg * mult)
    if dmg < 0 then dmg = 0 end
    local newEnemyHp, enemyDefeated = tmApplyEnemyDamage(triggerId, targetId, dmg, "combat:" .. tostring(actorId))
    local counterDmg = 0
    if result.tier == "fail" or result.tier == "crit_fail" then
        local enemyAtk = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_atk", 4)
        counterDmg = enemyAtk + (result.tier == "crit_fail" and 2 or 0)
        local reduction = 0
        for _, eff in ipairs(tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, actorId, "item+skill")) do
            if eff.effect == "damage_reduction" and tmResolveEffectTrigger(eff, "on_damage_taken") then
                reduction = reduction + tmRollDice(eff.count, eff.sides)
            end
        end
        if reduction > 0 then
            counterDmg = math.max(0, counterDmg - reduction)
        end
        damageHeroine(triggerId, actorId, counterDmg)
    end
    return {judgment = result, damageDealt = dmg, counterDmg = counterDmg,
            enemyHp = newEnemyHp, enemyDefeated = enemyDefeated}
end

function tmCombatTargetId(triggerId, rawTarget)
    local target = tostring(rawTarget or "")
    local kind, id = target:match("^([%w_]+):(.*)$")
    if kind == "enemy" then
        local wantsCurrent = id == "" or id == "current"
        if wantsCurrent then
            id = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
            if id == "" and type(tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy) == "function" then
                id = tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
            end
        end
        if id ~= "" and not id:match("^[%w_%-]+$") then return "" end
        if tmEnemyIsDefeated(triggerId, id) then
            tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, id)
            if wantsCurrent and type(tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy) == "function" then
                return tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
            end
            return ""
        end
        return id
    end
    if target:match("^en_l") then
        if tmEnemyIsDefeated(triggerId, target) then
            tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, target)
            return ""
        end
        return target
    end
    local current = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    if tmEnemyIsDefeated(triggerId, current) then
        tmRetireCurrentEnemyIfDefeated(triggerId, current)
        current = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
    end
    if current == "" and type(tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy) == "function" then
        current = tmPromoteActiveRuntimeEnemy(triggerId)
    end
    return current
end

function tmCombatModeDamage(mode)
    local tableDamage = { quick = 3, strike = 4, attack = 4, spell = 4, heavy = 6, guard = 2 }
    return tableDamage[tostring(mode or ""):lower()] or 4
end

TM_DEFENSE_MODE_RULES = {
    block = {default_stat = "con", stats = {con = true, str = true}, tier_rule = "standard"},
    guard = {default_stat = "con", stats = {con = true, str = true, wis = true}, tier_rule = "standard"},
    dodge = {default_stat = "dex", stats = {dex = true}, tier_rule = "evasive"},
    evade = {default_stat = "dex", stats = {dex = true}, tier_rule = "evasive"},
    resist = {default_stat = "con", stats = {con = true, wis = true, int = true}, tier_rule = "standard"},
    deescalate = {default_stat = "cha", stats = {cha = true, wis = true}, tier_rule = "social"},
    social = {default_stat = "cha", stats = {cha = true, wis = true}, tier_rule = "social"},
    protect = {default_stat = "con", stats = {con = true, str = true, wis = true}, tier_rule = "protect"},
    escape = {default_stat = "dex", stats = {dex = true, str = true}, tier_rule = "evasive"},
    counter = {default_stat = "dex", stats = {dex = true, str = true}, tier_rule = "counter"},
}

TM_DEFENSE_TIER_RULES = {
    standard = {crit_success = 0.0, success = 0.0, partial = 0.5, fail = 1.0, crit_fail = 1.25},
    evasive = {crit_success = 0.0, success = 0.0, partial = 0.5, fail = 1.0, crit_fail = 1.25},
    social = {crit_success = 0.0, success = 0.0, partial = 0.5, fail = 1.0, crit_fail = 1.0},
    protect = {crit_success = 0.0, success = 0.25, partial = 0.5, fail = 1.0, crit_fail = 1.25},
    counter = {crit_success = 0.0, success = 0.0, partial = 0.5, fail = 1.0, crit_fail = 1.25},
}

TM_DEFENSE_DAMAGE_KIND = {
    physical = true, magic = true, condition = true, social = true, other = true,
}

function tmDefenseDamageKind(raw)
    local kind = tmPanelCueCleanField(raw, 24):lower()
    if TM_DEFENSE_DAMAGE_KIND[kind] then return kind end
    return "physical"
end

function tmValidateDefenseModeStat(mode, statKey)
    local modeKey = tmPanelCueCleanField(mode, 24):lower()
    if modeKey == "" then modeKey = "block" end
    if modeKey == "defend" then modeKey = "block" end
    if modeKey == "talk" then modeKey = "social" end
    local rule = TM_DEFENSE_MODE_RULES[modeKey] or TM_DEFENSE_MODE_RULES.block
    local stat = tmValidRollStatKey(statKey) or rule.default_stat or "con"
    if not rule.stats[stat] then stat = rule.default_stat or "con" end
    return {mode = modeKey, stat = stat, tier_rule = rule.tier_rule or "standard", rule = rule}
end

function tmDeterministicDiceRoll(key, count, sides)
    local c = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(count) or 1))
    local s = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(sides) or 1))
    local total = 0
    local base = tostring(key or "det")
    for i = 1, c do
        local seed = tonumber(tmPanelStableFingerprint(base .. "#" .. tostring(i) .. "#" .. tostring(s))) or i
        total = total + (seed % s) + 1
    end
    return total
end

function tmDefenseDamageReduction(triggerId, defenderId, rollKey)
    local reduction = 0
    local key = tostring(rollKey or "") ~= "" and tostring(rollKey) or ("defense:" .. tostring(defenderId))
    for idx, eff in ipairs(tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, defenderId, "item+skill")) do
        if eff.effect == "damage_reduction" and tmResolveEffectTrigger(eff, "on_damage_taken") then
            reduction = reduction + tmDeterministicDiceRoll(key .. ":dr:" .. tostring(idx), eff.count, eff.sides)
        end
    end
    return reduction
end

function tmDeriveIncomingDamage(triggerId, enemyId, incomingOverride, defenseMode, damageKind)
    local explicit = math.floor(tonumber(incomingOverride) or 0)
    if explicit > 0 then return clamp(explicit, 0, 99) end
    local atk = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. tostring(enemyId or "") .. "_atk", 4)
    return clamp(math.floor(tonumber(atk) or 4), 0, 99)
end

function resolveDefenseWithRaw(triggerId, defenderId, enemyId, defenseMode, statKey, raw, dcOverride, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust, incomingDamage, damageKind, rollKey)
    local modeInfo = tmValidateDefenseModeStat(defenseMode, statKey)
    local dc = tonumber(dcOverride) or getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. tostring(enemyId or "") .. "_dc", 13)
    dc = clamp(dc, 5, 25)
    local result = resolveActionWithRaw(triggerId, defenderId, modeInfo.stat, dc, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    local incoming = tmDeriveIncomingDamage(triggerId, enemyId, incomingDamage, modeInfo.mode, damageKind)
    local tierRule = TM_DEFENSE_TIER_RULES[modeInfo.tier_rule] or TM_DEFENSE_TIER_RULES.standard
    local mult = tonumber(tierRule[result.tier]) or 1.0
    local afterTier = clamp(math.floor(incoming * mult + 0.5), 0, 999)
    local tierMitigated = clamp(incoming - afterTier, 0, incoming)
    local reduction = afterTier > 0 and tmDefenseDamageReduction(triggerId, defenderId, rollKey) or 0
    local finalDamage = clamp(afterTier - reduction, 0, 999)
    if finalDamage > 0 then
        damageHeroine(triggerId, defenderId, finalDamage)
    end
    return {
        judgment = result,
        defender = defenderId,
        enemyId = enemyId,
        mode = modeInfo.mode,
        stat = modeInfo.stat,
        damageKind = tmDefenseDamageKind(damageKind),
        incomingDamage = incoming,
        tierMitigated = tierMitigated,
        effectReduction = reduction,
        finalDamage = finalDamage,
        hpAfter = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. defenderId .. "_hp", 0),
    }
end

function resolveDefense(triggerId, defenderId, enemyId, defenseMode, statKey, dcOverride, incomingDamage, damageKind)
    local modeInfo = tmValidateDefenseModeStat(defenseMode, statKey)
    local dc = tonumber(dcOverride) or getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. tostring(enemyId or "") .. "_dc", 13)
    local result = resolveAction(triggerId, defenderId, modeInfo.stat, clamp(dc, 5, 25))
    return resolveDefenseWithRaw(triggerId, defenderId, enemyId, modeInfo.mode, modeInfo.stat, result.raw, result.dc, 0, 0, incomingDamage, damageKind, "defense:auto:" .. tostring(defenderId) .. ":" .. tostring(enemyId) .. ":" .. tostring(result.raw))
end

function tmApplyCombatAsRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, stat, dc, reason, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    local meta = ""
    if raw ~= nil then
        meta = tmApplyRollMarkerWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, stat, dc, reason, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    else
        meta = tmApplyRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, stat, dc, reason)
    end
    local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    if meta ~= "" then
        tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "비피해 대치 판정: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId) .. " · " .. tmRollReasonText(reason))
    end
    return card ~= "" and ("\n" .. card .. "\n") or ""
end

function tmCombatResultHtml(triggerId, actorId, enemyId, combat)
    if not combat or not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return "" end
    local actorLabel = tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId)
    local enemyName = tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId)
    local dmg = tonumber(combat.damageDealt) or 0
    local counter = tonumber(combat.counterDmg) or 0
    local enemyHp = tonumber(combat.enemyHp) or 0
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp_max", 0)
    if hpMax <= 0 then hpMax = enemyHp end
    local hpPct = 0
    if hpMax > 0 then
        hpPct = clamp(math.floor((enemyHp / hpMax) * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100)
    end
    local outcome = "hit"
    local sentence
    if combat.enemyDefeated then
        outcome = "defeated"
        if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
            sentence = actorLabel .. "의 공격으로 " .. tmJosaIga(triggerId, enemyName) .. " 쓰러졌습니다."
        else
            sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s의 공격으로 %s가 쓰러졌습니다.", "%s's attack defeated %s.", "%sの攻撃で%sが倒れました。"), actorLabel, enemyName)
        end
    elseif dmg <= 0 and counter > 0 then
        outcome = "counter"
        sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s의 공격은 %s에게 피해를 주지 못했고 반격을 받았습니다.", "%s's attack failed to damage %s and drew a counterattack.", "%sの攻撃は%sにダメージを与えられず、反撃を受けました。"), actorLabel, enemyName)
    elseif dmg <= 0 then
        outcome = "none"
        sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s의 공격은 %s에게 피해를 주지 못했습니다.", "%s's attack did not damage %s.", "%sの攻撃は%sにダメージを与えられませんでした。"), actorLabel, enemyName)
    elseif counter > 0 then
        outcome = "trade"
        if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
            sentence = tmJosaIga(triggerId, actorLabel) .. " " .. enemyName .. "에게 피해를 주었지만 반격을 받았습니다."
        else
            sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s가 %s에게 피해를 주었지만 반격을 받았습니다.", "%s damaged %s but took a counterattack.", "%sは%sにダメージを与えましたが、反撃を受けました。"), actorLabel, enemyName)
        end
    else
        if tmLang(triggerId) == "ko" then
            sentence = tmJosaIga(triggerId, actorLabel) .. " " .. enemyName .. "에게 피해를 주었습니다."
        else
            sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s가 %s에게 피해를 주었습니다.", "%s damaged %s.", "%sは%sにダメージを与えました。"), actorLabel, enemyName)
        end
    end
    local damageLabel = dmg > 0
        and string.format(T(triggerId, "피해 %d", "Damage %d", "ダメージ %d"), dmg)
        or T(triggerId, "피해 없음", "No damage", "ダメージなし")
    local counterLabel = counter > 0
        and string.format(T(triggerId, "반격 %d", "Counter %d", "反撃 %d"), counter)
        or T(triggerId, "반격 없음", "No counter", "反撃なし")
    local hpValue = tostring(enemyHp) .. "/" .. tostring(hpMax)
    local defeatedChip = combat.enemyDefeated
        and ('<span class="tm-combat-chip tm-combat-chip-ko">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "격파", "Defeated", "撃破")) .. '</span>')
        or ""
    return '<div class="tm-combat-result" data-outcome="' .. tmEscapeHtml(outcome) .. '">'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-label">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "전투", "Combat", "戦闘")) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-copy"><span class="tm-combat-sentence">' .. tmEscapeHtml(sentence) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-chips"><span class="tm-combat-chip tm-combat-chip-damage">' .. tmEscapeHtml(damageLabel) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-chip tm-combat-chip-counter">' .. tmEscapeHtml(counterLabel) .. '</span>' .. defeatedChip .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-hp"><span class="tm-combat-hp-label"><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "적 HP", "Enemy HP", "敵HP")) .. '</span><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(hpValue) .. '</b></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-hp-bar" aria-hidden="true"><span class="tm-combat-hp-fill" style="width:' .. tostring(hpPct) .. '%"></span></span></span></div>'
end

function tmDefenseResultHtml(triggerId, defenderId, enemyId, defense)
    if not defense or not defenderId or defenderId == "" or not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return "" end
    local defenderLabel = tmActorLabel(triggerId, defenderId)
    local enemyName = tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId)
    local incoming = tonumber(defense.incomingDamage) or 0
    local final = tonumber(defense.finalDamage) or 0
    local mitigated = clamp(incoming - final, 0, incoming)
    local hp = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. defenderId .. "_hp", 0)
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. defenderId .. "_hp_max", 0)
    local hpPct = 0
    if hpMax > 0 then hpPct = clamp(math.floor((hp / hpMax) * 100 + 0.5), 0, 100) end
    local tier = defense.judgment and defense.judgment.tier or "fail"
    local sentence
    if final <= 0 then
        sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s가 %s의 위협을 막아 피해를 받지 않았습니다.", "%s defended against %s and took no damage.", "%sは%sの脅威を防ぎ、ダメージを受けませんでした。"), defenderLabel, enemyName)
    elseif mitigated > 0 then
        sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s가 %s의 위협을 일부 막았지만 피해를 받았습니다.", "%s reduced %s's threat but still took damage.", "%sは%sの脅威を一部防ぎましたが、ダメージを受けました。"), defenderLabel, enemyName)
    else
        sentence = string.format(T(triggerId, "%s가 %s의 위협을 막지 못해 피해를 받았습니다.", "%s failed to stop %s's threat and took damage.", "%sは%sの脅威を止められず、ダメージを受けました。"), defenderLabel, enemyName)
    end
    local damageLabel = final > 0
        and string.format(T(triggerId, "피해 %d", "Damage %d", "ダメージ %d"), final)
        or T(triggerId, "피해 없음", "No damage", "ダメージなし")
    local mitigateLabel = mitigated > 0
        and string.format(T(triggerId, "감소 %d", "Mitigated %d", "軽減 %d"), mitigated)
        or T(triggerId, "감소 없음", "No mitigation", "軽減なし")
    local hpValue = hpMax > 0 and (tostring(hp) .. "/" .. tostring(hpMax)) or tostring(hp)
    return '<div class="tm-combat-result tm-defense-result tm-defense-' .. tmEscapeHtml(tmCssToken(tier)) .. '">'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-badge">' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "방어 결과", "Defense Result", "防御結果")) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-copy"><span class="tm-combat-sentence">' .. tmEscapeHtml(sentence) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-chips"><span class="tm-combat-chip tm-combat-chip-damage">' .. tmEscapeHtml(damageLabel) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-chip tm-combat-chip-counter">' .. tmEscapeHtml(mitigateLabel) .. '</span></span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-hp"><span class="tm-combat-hp-label"><span>' .. tmEscapeHtml(T(triggerId, "방어자 HP", "Defender HP", "防御者HP")) .. '</span><b>' .. tmEscapeHtml(hpValue) .. '</b></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-combat-hp-bar" aria-hidden="true"><span class="tm-combat-hp-fill" style="width:' .. tostring(hpPct) .. '%"></span></span></span></div>'
end

function tmApplyDefenseMarker(triggerId, defenderId, target, statKey, mode, reason, dcOverride, incomingDamage, damageKind)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[defenderId] then return "" end
    local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, defenderId)
    if blocked ~= "" then
        tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, defenderId, blocked, "defense_marker")
        return ""
    end
    local targetId = tmCombatTargetId(triggerId, target)
    if targetId == "" then return "" end
    loadEnemy(triggerId, targetId)
    local defense = resolveDefense(triggerId, defenderId, targetId, mode, statKey, dcOverride, incomingDamage, damageKind)
    local result = defense.judgment
    local fired = tmFireRuntimeEffects(triggerId,
        tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, defenderId, "item+skill"),
        tmCombatEventsForResult({judgment = result, damageDealt = 0, counterDmg = defense.finalDamage}),
        { actorId = defenderId, enemyId = targetId, tier = result.tier, counterDmg = defense.finalDamage })
    local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, defenderId, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, reason, result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
    tmAppendRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
    tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, result.tier)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "defense:" .. defenderId .. ":" .. targetId)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "DEFENSE: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, defenderId) .. " <- " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId) .. " / incoming " .. tostring(defense.incomingDamage or 0) .. " / dmg " .. tostring(defense.finalDamage or 0) .. " / hp " .. tostring(defense.hpAfter or 0))
    if #fired > 0 then
        local parts = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(fired) do
            table.insert(parts, tostring(item.res[1] or "") .. (((tonumber(item.res[2]) or 0) > 0) and (" " .. tostring(item.res[2])) or ""))
        end
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "DEFENSE_EFFECTS: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, defenderId) .. " / " .. table.concat(parts, ", "))
    end
    local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    return (card ~= "" and ("\n" .. card .. "\n") or "") .. tmDefenseResultHtml(triggerId, defenderId, targetId, defense) .. tmEffectResultHtml(fired)
end

function tmApplyDefenseMarkerWithRaw(triggerId, defenderId, target, statKey, mode, reason, raw, dcOverride, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust, incomingDamage, damageKind, rollKey)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[defenderId] then return "" end
    local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, defenderId)
    if blocked ~= "" then
        tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, defenderId, blocked, "defense_marker_raw")
        return ""
    end
    local targetId = tmCombatTargetId(triggerId, target)
    if targetId == "" then return "" end
    loadEnemy(triggerId, targetId)
    local defense = resolveDefenseWithRaw(triggerId, defenderId, targetId, mode, statKey, raw, dcOverride, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust, incomingDamage, damageKind, rollKey)
    local result = defense.judgment
    local fired = tmFireRuntimeEffects(triggerId,
        tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, defenderId, "item+skill"),
        tmCombatEventsForResult({judgment = result, damageDealt = 0, counterDmg = defense.finalDamage}),
        { actorId = defenderId, enemyId = targetId, tier = result.tier, counterDmg = defense.finalDamage })
    local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, defenderId, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, reason, result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
    tmAppendRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
    tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, result.tier)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "defense:" .. defenderId .. ":" .. targetId)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "DEFENSE: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, defenderId) .. " <- " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId) .. " / incoming " .. tostring(defense.incomingDamage or 0) .. " / dmg " .. tostring(defense.finalDamage or 0) .. " / hp " .. tostring(defense.hpAfter or 0))
    if #fired > 0 then
        local parts = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(fired) do
            table.insert(parts, tostring(item.res[1] or "") .. (((tonumber(item.res[2]) or 0) > 0) and (" " .. tostring(item.res[2])) or ""))
        end
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "DEFENSE_EFFECTS: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, defenderId) .. " / " .. table.concat(parts, ", "))
    end
    local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    return (card ~= "" and ("\n" .. card .. "\n") or "") .. tmDefenseResultHtml(triggerId, defenderId, targetId, defense) .. tmEffectResultHtml(fired)
end

function tmApplyCombatMarker(triggerId, actorId, target, statKey, mode, reason)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[actorId] then return "" end
    local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, actorId)
    if blocked ~= "" then
        tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, actorId, blocked, "combat_marker")
        return ""
    end
    local stat = tmValidRollStatKey(statKey) or "str"
    local targetId = tmCombatTargetId(triggerId, target)
    if targetId == "" then return "" end
    loadEnemy(triggerId, targetId)
    if not tmCombatPanelShouldDamage(mode, stat, reason) then
        local dc = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_dc", 13)
        return tmApplyCombatAsRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, stat, clamp(dc, 5, 25), reason)
    end
    local combat = resolveCombat(triggerId, actorId, targetId, { stat = stat, damage = tmCombatModeDamage(mode) })
    local result = combat.judgment
    -- D045/P047 T002: fire the actor's structured item+skill effects for the events
    -- this combat emits (on_hit/on_crit/on_fail/on_damage_taken — see EVENT-EMISSION MAP).
    local fired = tmFireRuntimeEffects(triggerId,
        tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, actorId, "item+skill"),
        tmCombatEventsForResult(combat),
        { actorId = actorId, enemyId = targetId, tier = result.tier, counterDmg = combat.counterDmg })
    local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, actorId, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, reason, result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
    tmAppendRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
    tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, result.tier)
    if getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true" then
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy_defeated:" .. targetId)
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "combat:" .. actorId .. ":" .. targetId)
    end
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "COMBAT: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId) .. " -> " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId) .. " / dmg " .. tostring(combat.damageDealt or 0) .. " / hp " .. tostring(combat.enemyHp or 0))
    if #fired > 0 then
        local parts = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(fired) do
            table.insert(parts, tostring(item.res[1] or "") .. (((tonumber(item.res[2]) or 0) > 0) and (" " .. tostring(item.res[2])) or ""))
        end
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "COMBAT_EFFECTS: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId) .. " / " .. table.concat(parts, ", "))
    end
    combat.enemyHp = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_hp", combat.enemyHp or 0)
    combat.enemyDefeated = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true"
    local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    return (card ~= "" and ("\n" .. card .. "\n") or "") .. tmCombatResultHtml(triggerId, actorId, targetId, combat) .. tmEffectResultHtml(fired)
end

function tmApplyCombatMarkerWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, target, statKey, mode, reason, raw, dcOverride, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[actorId] then return "" end
    local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, actorId)
    if blocked ~= "" then
        tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, actorId, blocked, "combat_marker_raw")
        return ""
    end
    local stat = tmValidRollStatKey(statKey) or "str"
    local targetId = tmCombatTargetId(triggerId, target)
    if targetId == "" then return "" end
    loadEnemy(triggerId, targetId)
    if not tmCombatPanelShouldDamage(mode, stat, reason) then
        local dc = tonumber(dcOverride) or getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_dc", 13)
        return tmApplyCombatAsRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, stat, clamp(dc, 5, 25), reason, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    end
    local combat = resolveCombatWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, targetId, { stat = stat, damage = tmCombatModeDamage(mode) }, raw, dcOverride, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    local result = combat.judgment
    local fired = tmFireRuntimeEffects(triggerId,
        tmCollectRuntimeEffects(triggerId, actorId, "item+skill"),
        tmCombatEventsForResult(combat),
        { actorId = actorId, enemyId = targetId, tier = result.tier, counterDmg = combat.counterDmg })
    local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, actorId, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, reason, result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
    tmAppendRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
    tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, result.tier)
    if getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true" then
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy_defeated:" .. targetId)
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "combat:" .. actorId .. ":" .. targetId)
    end
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "COMBAT: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId) .. " -> " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, targetId) .. " / dmg " .. tostring(combat.damageDealt or 0) .. " / hp " .. tostring(combat.enemyHp or 0))
    if #fired > 0 then
        local parts = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(fired) do
            table.insert(parts, tostring(item.res[1] or "") .. (((tonumber(item.res[2]) or 0) > 0) and (" " .. tostring(item.res[2])) or ""))
        end
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "COMBAT_EFFECTS: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId) .. " / " .. table.concat(parts, ", "))
    end
    combat.enemyHp = getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_hp", combat.enemyHp or 0)
    combat.enemyDefeated = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. targetId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true"
    local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    return (card ~= "" and ("\n" .. card .. "\n") or "") .. tmCombatResultHtml(triggerId, actorId, targetId, combat) .. tmEffectResultHtml(fired)
end

function classifyIntentHeuristic(input)
    if not input or input == "" then return "narrative" end
    local cleaned = input
    for _, fp in ipairs(TM_INTENT_FALSE_POSITIVES) do
        cleaned = cleaned:gsub(fp, " ")
    end
    for _, neg in ipairs(TM_INTENT_NEGATIONS) do
        cleaned = cleaned:gsub(neg, " ")
    end
    local lower = cleaned:lower()
    for _, cat in ipairs({"dice_request", "combat", "social", "investigate"}) do
        for _, kw in ipairs(INTENT_KEYWORDS[cat]) do
            if cleaned:find(kw, 1, true) or lower:find(kw:lower(), 1, true) then
                return cat
            end
        end
    end
    return "narrative"
end

function parseRollRequest(input)
    if not input or input == "" then
        return {count = 1, sides = 20, statKey = nil, bonus = 0}
    end
    local count, sides = input:match("(%d+)[dD](%d+)")
    count = tonumber(count) or 1
    sides = tonumber(sides) or 20
    local bonus = tonumber(input:match("[dD]%d+%s*([+-]%d+)")) or 0
    local statKey = nil
    for key, words in pairs(STAT_KEYWORDS) do
        for _, w in ipairs(words) do
            if input:find(w, 1, true) then statKey = key; break end
        end
        if statKey then break end
    end
    return {count = count, sides = sides, statKey = statKey, bonus = bonus}
end

function tmStatKeyFromText(text, fallback)
    local source = tostring(text or "")
    local lower = source:lower()
    for key, words in pairs(STAT_KEYWORDS) do
        if lower == key then return key end
        for _, word in ipairs(words) do
            local w = tostring(word or "")
            if w ~= "" and (source:find(w, 1, true) or lower:find(w:lower(), 1, true)) then
                return key
            end
        end
    end
    return fallback
end

function tmParseRollHintLine(line)
    local text = tostring(line or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    text = text:gsub("^[-*]%s*", "")
    text = text:gsub("^([A-Za-z가-힣]+)%s+[oO][rR]%s+[A-Za-z가-힣]+%s+DC", "%1 DC")
    text = text:gsub("^([A-Za-z가-힣]+)%s+또는%s+[A-Za-z가-힣]+%s+DC", "%1 DC")
    if text == "" then return nil end
    local statToken, dcText, reason = text:match("^([A-Za-z가-힣]+)%s+DC%s*(%d+)%s*[:：%-]%s*(.+)$")
    if not statToken then
        statToken, dcText, reason = text:match("^([A-Za-z가-힣]+)%s*(%d+)%s*[:：%-]%s*(.+)$")
    end
    if not statToken then return nil end
    local stat = tmStatKeyFromText(statToken, nil)
    local dc = tonumber(dcText)
    if not stat or not dc then return nil end
    return {
        stat = stat,
        dc = clamp(dc, 5, 25),
        reason = tostring(reason or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""),
        raw = text,
    }
end

function tmEpisodeRollHints(triggerId)
    local _, content = tmCurrentEpisodeContent(triggerId)
    local section = tmEpisodeSection(content, "ROLL_HINTS")
    local hints = {}
    for line in (section .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
        local hint = tmParseRollHintLine(line)
        if hint then table.insert(hints, hint) end
    end
    return hints
end

function tmRollHintScore(hint, context)
    local score = 0
    local text = tostring(context or "")
    local lower = text:lower()
    for word in tostring(hint.reason or ""):gmatch("[%w가-힣]+") do
        if #word > 1 and (text:find(word, 1, true) or lower:find(word:lower(), 1, true)) then
            score = score + 2
        end
    end
    for _, word in ipairs(STAT_KEYWORDS[hint.stat] or {}) do
        if text:find(word, 1, true) or lower:find(tostring(word):lower(), 1, true) then
            score = score + 1
        end
    end
    return score
end

function tmSelectRollHintForContext(triggerId, text)
    local hints = tmEpisodeRollHints(triggerId)
    if #hints == 0 then return nil end
    local context = tostring(text or "") .. " " .. getVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "")
    local best, bestScore = hints[1], -1
    for _, hint in ipairs(hints) do
        local score = tmRollHintScore(hint, context)
        if score > bestScore then
            best, bestScore = hint, score
        end
    end
    if bestScore <= 0 then return nil end
    return best
end

function tmTextHasAny(input, keywords)
    local text = tostring(input or "")
    local lower = text:lower()
    for _, kw in ipairs(keywords or {}) do
        local key = tostring(kw or "")
        if key ~= "" and (text:find(key, 1, true) or lower:find(key:lower(), 1, true)) then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function tmIsInitiativeText(input)
    return tmTextHasAny(input, {"주도권", "선공", "행동 순서", "행동순서", "턴 순서", "턴순서", "initiative"})
end

function tmIsGroupRollText(input)
    return tmTextHasAny(input, {"다들", "각자", "전원", "모두", "네 명", "네명", "4명", "파티", "일행", "전체", "all"})
end

function tmRollTargetsForInput(triggerId, input, addressee)
    if addressee and addressee ~= "" and addressee ~= "all" and CHAR_NAMES_KO[addressee] then
        local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, addressee)
        if blocked ~= "" then
            tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, addressee, blocked, "input_addressee")
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_target_source", "addressee_blocked:" .. addressee .. ":" .. blocked)
            return {}
        end
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_target_source", "addressee:" .. addressee)
        return {addressee}
    end
    if addressee == "all" or tmIsGroupRollText(input) then
        local targets = {}
        local blockedCount = 0
        for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
            local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, id)
            if blocked == "" then
                table.insert(targets, id)
            else
                blockedCount = blockedCount + 1
                tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, id, blocked, "input_group")
            end
        end
        if #targets > 0 and blockedCount > 0 then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_target_source", "group_filtered")
        elseif #targets > 0 then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_target_source", "group")
        else
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_target_source", "group_blocked_all")
        end
        return targets
    end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, id)
        if blocked == "" then
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_target_source", "default:first_eligible")
            print("[TRPGMaster] explicit roll target missing; using first eligible character default")
            return {id}
        end
        tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, id, blocked, "input_default_scan")
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_target_source", "default_blocked_all")
    return {}
end

function tmInitiativeCompare(triggerId, a, b)
    for _, stat in ipairs(TM_INITIATIVE_ORDER) do
        local av = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. a .. "_" .. stat, 10)
        local bv = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. b .. "_" .. stat, 10)
        if av ~= bv then return av > bv end
    end
    return tostring(a) < tostring(b)
end

function tmBuildInitiativeOrder(triggerId)
    local order = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do table.insert(order, id) end
    table.sort(order, function(a, b) return tmInitiativeCompare(triggerId, a, b) end)
    local labels = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(order) do table.insert(labels, tmActorLabel(triggerId, id)) end
    return table.concat(labels, " > ")
end

function emitRollMeta(triggerId, actor, tier, roll, total, dc, hint, stat, reason, mod, equipmentBonus, penalty)
    local statKey = normalizeStatKey(stat or "dex")
    local statValue = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. tostring(actor or "") .. "_" .. statKey, 10)
    local statBonus = tonumber(equipmentBonus) or 0
    local effectiveStat = statValue + statBonus
    local margin = (tonumber(total) or 0) - (tonumber(dc) or 0)
    local actionText = tmRollActionText(triggerId, actor, reason)
    return string.format(
        '▥ROLL actor="%s" actor_label="%s" stat="%s" stat_name="%s" stat_value="%d" stat_bonus="%s" effective_stat="%d" tier="%s" tier_label="%s" roll="%d" mod="%s" equip="%s" penalty="%s" total="%d" dc="%d" margin="%s" advice="%s" reason="%s"▥',
        tostring(actor or "user"),
        tmEscapeHtml(tmActorLabel(triggerId, actor)),
        statKey,
        tmEscapeHtml(TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[statKey] or TM_STAT_LABELS[statKey] or statKey),
        statValue,
        tmSigned(statBonus),
        effectiveStat,
        tostring(tier or "fail"),
        tmEscapeHtml(tmTierLabel(tier)),
        tonumber(roll) or 0,
        tmSigned(mod or 0),
        tmSigned(statBonus),
        tmSigned(penalty or 0),
        tonumber(total) or 0,
        tonumber(dc) or 0,
        tmSigned(margin),
        "",
        tmEscapeHtml(actionText)
    )
end

function tmRollMetaAttr(meta, name)
    return tostring(meta or ""):match(tostring(name or "") .. '="([^"]*)"') or ""
end

function tmCssToken(value)
    return tostring(value or ""):gsub("[^%w_%-]", "")
end

function tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
    local raw = tostring(meta or "")
    if raw == "" then return "" end
    local actor = tmCssToken(tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "actor"))
    if actor == "" then return "" end
    local tier = tmCssToken(tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "tier"))
    if tier == "" then tier = "unknown" end
    local actorLabel = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "actor_label")
    local actorLabelHtml = actorLabel:gsub(" %(([^%)]+)%)", ' <span class="tm-roll-actor-muted">(%1)</span>')
    local statName = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "stat_name")
    local statValue = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "stat_value")
    local statBonus = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "stat_bonus")
    if statBonus == "" then statBonus = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "equip") end
    local effectiveStat = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "effective_stat")
    if effectiveStat == "" then effectiveStat = statValue end
    local tierLabel = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "tier_label")
    local roll = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "roll")
    local mod = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "mod")
    local penalty = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "penalty")
    local dc = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "dc")
    local reason = tmRollMetaAttr(raw, "reason")
    if reason == "" then reason = "판정" end
    local rollNum = tonumber(roll) or 0
    local rollFace = clamp(rollNum, 1, 20)
    local rollAsset = string.format("tm_dice_d20_%02d.png", rollFace)
    local dcNum = tonumber(dc) or 0
    local modNum = tonumber(mod) or 0
    local penaltyNum = tonumber(penalty) or 0
    local successThreshold = clamp(dcNum - modNum - penaltyNum, 1, 20)
    local partialThreshold = clamp(dcNum - 3 - modNum - penaltyNum, 1, 20)
    local thresholdCompareOp = rollNum >= successThreshold and "&ge;" or "&lt;"
    local compareOp = thresholdCompareOp
    local displayThreshold = successThreshold
    local function thresholdFormula(extra)
        local formula = tostring(dcNum)
        local function subtract(value)
            local n = tonumber(value) or 0
            if n >= 0 then
                formula = formula .. " - " .. tostring(n)
            else
                formula = formula .. " + " .. tostring(math.abs(n))
            end
        end
        subtract(modNum)
        subtract(penaltyNum)
        if extra and extra ~= 0 then formula = formula .. " - " .. tostring(extra) end
        return formula
    end
    local successFormula = thresholdFormula(0) .. " = " .. tostring(successThreshold) .. " 이상"
    local partialFormula = thresholdFormula(3) .. " = " .. tostring(partialThreshold) .. " 이상"
    local comparison = tostring(rollNum) .. " " .. thresholdCompareOp .. " " .. tostring(successThreshold)
    local naturalNoteHtml = ""
    if rollNum == 1 then
        compareOp = "="
        displayThreshold = 1
        naturalNoteHtml = '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">자연 1</span><span class="tm-tip-v">대실패 우선</span></span>'
    elseif rollNum == 20 then
        compareOp = "="
        displayThreshold = 20
        naturalNoteHtml = '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">자연 20</span><span class="tm-tip-v">대성공 우선</span></span>'
    end
    if statBonus == "" then statBonus = "+0" end
    return '<div class="tm-roll-result tm-roll-v3 tm-roll-owner-' .. actor .. '" data-tier="' .. tier .. '">'
        .. '<div class="tm-roll-head">' .. tmUiAssetHtml(actor .. '_roll_portrait.webp', "tm-roll-portrait", actor .. "_roll_portrait") .. '<span class="tm-roll-actor">' .. actorLabelHtml .. '</span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-roll-main"><div class="tm-roll-left">'
        .. tmUiAssetHtml(rollAsset, "tm-roll-d20 tm-roll-d20-asset", "주사위 " .. tostring(rollFace))
        .. '<span class="tm-roll-threshold"><span class="tm-roll-op">' .. compareOp .. '</span><span class="tm-roll-dc">' .. tostring(displayThreshold) .. '</span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-guide-help tm-roll-help" tabindex="0" aria-label="계산 기준">?<span class="tm-guide-tooltip tm-roll-tooltip">'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">관련 능력</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. statName .. ' ' .. statValue .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">능력치 보너스</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. statBonus .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">유효 능력</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. effectiveStat .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">d20</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. tostring(rollNum) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">d20 보정</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. tmSigned(modNum) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">상태 보정</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. tmSigned(penaltyNum) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">원래 난이도</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. tostring(dcNum) .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">성공 기준식</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. successFormula .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row"><span class="tm-tip-k">부분 성공 기준식</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. partialFormula .. '</span></span>'
        .. '<span class="tm-tip-row tm-roll-tip-total"><span class="tm-tip-k">비교</span><span class="tm-tip-v">' .. comparison .. '</span></span>'
        .. naturalNoteHtml
        .. '</span></span></span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-roll-right"><div class="tm-roll-action"><span class="tm-roll-action-label">행동</span><span>' .. reason .. '</span></div>'
        .. '<div class="tm-roll-spacer"></div><div class="tm-roll-result-row"><span class="tm-roll-check">' .. statName .. ' 판정</span><span class="tm-roll-tier">' .. tierLabel .. '</span></div></div></div></div>'
end

function tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, why)
    local detail = table.concat({
        "why=" .. tostring(why or "invalid"),
        "actor=" .. tostring(actorId or ""),
        "stat=" .. tostring(statKey or ""),
        "dc=" .. tostring(dc or ""),
        "reason=" .. tmRollReasonText(reason),
    }, "|")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_roll_marker_error", detail)
    print("[TRPGMaster] rejected ROLL marker: " .. detail)
    return ""
end

function tmRollStripQuotes(value)
    local text = tmTrimText(value)
    local first = text:sub(1, 1)
    local last = text:sub(-1)
    if (first == '"' and last == '"') or (first == "'" and last == "'") then
        return text:sub(2, -2)
    end
    return text
end

function tmRollCompactAlias(value)
    return tmRollStripQuotes(value):lower():gsub("[%s\"'`“”‘’]+", "")
end

function tmRollActorAliases(triggerId, ownerId)
    local aliases = {ownerId, CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ""}
    local runtimeRealName = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_name_ko", "")
    if runtimeRealName ~= "" then table.insert(aliases, runtimeRealName) end
    local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, ownerId)
    if pcName ~= "" then
        table.insert(aliases, pcName)
        table.insert(aliases, pcName .. "(" .. (CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId) .. ")")
        table.insert(aliases, pcName .. " (" .. (CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId) .. ")")
    end
    table.insert(aliases, tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId))
    table.insert(aliases, tmGuidePcLabel(triggerId, ownerId))
    for _, alias in ipairs(tmPlayerNameAliases(ownerId)) do table.insert(aliases, alias) end
    return aliases
end

function tmResolveRollActorId(triggerId, actorId)
    local raw = tmRollStripQuotes(actorId)
    if CHAR_NAMES_KO[raw] then return raw end
    local compact = tmRollCompactAlias(raw)
    if compact == "" then return raw end
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        for _, alias in ipairs(tmRollActorAliases(triggerId, id)) do
            local aliasCompact = tmRollCompactAlias(alias)
            if aliasCompact ~= "" and (compact == aliasCompact or (#aliasCompact >= 4 and compact:find(aliasCompact, 1, true))) then
                return id
            end
        end
    end
    return raw
end

function tmRollDcNumber(dc)
    return tostring(dc or ""):match("(%d+)")
end

function tmRollPayloadAttr(payload, keys, restAllowed)
    local p = tostring(payload or "")
    for _, key in ipairs(keys or {}) do
        local quoted = p:match(key .. '%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"') or p:match(key .. "%s*=%s*'([^']*)'")
        if quoted and quoted ~= "" then return tmTrimText(quoted) end
        local plain = restAllowed and p:match(key .. "%s*=%s*(.+)$") or p:match(key .. "%s*=%s*([^%s|:]+)")
        if plain and plain ~= "" then return tmTrimText(plain) end
    end
    return ""
end

function tmParseLooseRollPayload(triggerId, payload)
    local p = tmTrimText(payload)
    if p == "" then return nil, nil, nil, nil end
    local actor, stat, dc, reason = p:match("^([^|]+)|([^|]+)|([^|]+)|(.-)$")
    if not actor then
        actor, stat, dc, reason = p:match("^([^:]+):([^:]+):([^:]+):(.-)$")
    end
    if not actor then
        actor = tmRollPayloadAttr(p, {"actor", "owner", "char", "character", "actor_label"}, false)
        stat = tmRollPayloadAttr(p, {"stat", "ability", "check"}, false)
        dc = tmRollPayloadAttr(p, {"dc", "target", "difficulty"}, false)
        reason = tmRollPayloadAttr(p, {"reason", "action", "text", "desc", "description"}, true)
    end
    if not actor or actor == "" then
        actor, stat, dc, reason = p:match("^([^%s|:]+)%s+([^%s|:]+)%s+([Dd]?[Cc]?%s*%d+)%s*(.-)$")
    end
    if (not stat or stat == "" or not tmRollDcNumber(dc)) then
        local first, rest = p:match("^([^%s|:]+)%s+(.+)$")
        if first and rest then
            local restStat = tmValidRollStatKey(rest)
            local dcSearch = rest:gsub("[Dd]%s*20", "")
            local restDc = rest:match("[Dd][Cc]%s*(%d+)") or rest:match("난이도%s*(%d+)") or rest:match("기준%s*(%d+)") or dcSearch:match("(%d+)")
            if restStat and restDc then
                actor, stat, dc, reason = first, restStat, restDc, rest
            end
        end
    end
    dc = tmRollDcNumber(dc)
    if not actor or actor == "" or not stat or stat == "" or not dc then return nil, nil, nil, nil end
    if not reason or reason == "" then reason = p end
    return actor, stat, dc, reason
end

function tmApplyRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason)
    if tmIsInitiativeText(reason) then return "" end
    actorId = tmResolveRollActorId(triggerId, actorId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[actorId] then
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "invalid_actor")
    end
    local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, actorId)
    if blocked ~= "" then
        tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, actorId, blocked, "roll_marker")
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "actor_ineligible_" .. blocked)
    end
    local stat = tmValidRollStatKey(statKey)
    if not stat then
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "invalid_stat")
    end
    local targetDc = tonumber(tmRollDcNumber(dc))
    if not targetDc then
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "invalid_dc")
    end
    targetDc = clamp(targetDc, 5, 25)
    local result = resolveAction(triggerId, actorId, stat, targetDc)
    local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, actorId, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, reason, result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "roll:" .. actorId .. ":" .. stat .. ":" .. tmRollReasonText(reason))
    tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, result.tier)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "판정: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId) .. " · " .. (TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[result.stat] or result.stat) .. " · " .. tmTierLabel(result.tier))
    return meta
end

function tmApplyRollMarkerWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
    if tmIsInitiativeText(reason) then return "" end
    actorId = tmResolveRollActorId(triggerId, actorId)
    if not CHAR_NAMES_KO[actorId] then
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "invalid_actor")
    end
    local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, actorId)
    if blocked ~= "" then
        tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, actorId, blocked, "roll_marker_raw")
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "actor_ineligible_" .. blocked)
    end
    local stat = tmValidRollStatKey(statKey)
    if not stat then
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "invalid_stat")
    end
    local targetDc = tonumber(tmRollDcNumber(dc))
    if not targetDc then
        return tmRejectRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason, "invalid_dc")
    end
    targetDc = clamp(targetDc, 5, 25)
    local result = resolveActionWithRaw(triggerId, actorId, stat, targetDc, raw, bonusAdjust, penaltyAdjust)
