    local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, actorId, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, reason, result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "roll:" .. actorId .. ":" .. stat .. ":" .. tmRollReasonText(reason))
    tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, result.tier)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "판정: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, actorId) .. " · " .. (TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[result.stat] or result.stat) .. " · " .. tmTierLabel(result.tier))
    return meta
end

function ensureScenarioState(triggerId)
    local scenario = getVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", "")
    if scenario == "" then
        local selected = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "selected_scenario", ""))
        if selected ~= "" and getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_explicit_selection", "false") == "true" then
            scenario = tmNormalizeScenarioToEpisode(selected)
            setVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", scenario)
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_none_after_end", "false")
        elseif getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_none_after_end", "false") == "true"
            or (getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true"
                and getVar(triggerId, "session_prep_open", "false") == "true") then
            if getVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "") == "" then
                setVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "not_selected")
            end
            if getVar(triggerId, "scenario_flags", "") == "" then
                setVar(triggerId, "scenario_flags", "none")
            end
            return ""
        else
            scenario = "fantasy_first_session"
            setVar(triggerId, "current_scenario", scenario)
        end
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "") == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "not_started")
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "scenario_flags", "") == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "scenario_flags", "none")
    end
    return scenario
end

function ensureEpisodeState(triggerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "") == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "none")
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", "") == "" then
        setVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", "none")
    end
    return getVar(triggerId, "current_episode", "")
end

function dispatchTRPGInput(triggerId, input)
    local scenario = ensureScenarioState(triggerId)
    local episode = ensureEpisodeState(triggerId)
    local intent = classifyIntentHeuristic(input)
    local context = (episode ~= "" and episode) or scenario
    tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, "")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "false")
    setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_intent", intent)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scenario_event", scenario .. ":" .. intent)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", context .. ":" .. intent)
    local addressee = getVar(triggerId, "last_addressee", "")
    local selectedHint = tmSelectRollHintForContext(triggerId, input)
    if tmIsInitiativeText(input) then
        local order = tmBuildInitiativeOrder(triggerId)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", context .. ":initiative:" .. order)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "행동 순서: " .. order)
        return input
    end
    local inlineMetas = {}
    local rollSummaries = {}
    local function runInputRoll(rollActor, statKey, dc, reason)
        local blocked = tmRollBlockedReason(triggerId, rollActor)
        if blocked ~= "" then
            tmRecordRollBlocked(triggerId, rollActor, blocked, "input_roll")
            return false
        end
        local result = resolveAction(triggerId, rollActor, statKey, dc)
        local meta = emitRollMeta(triggerId, rollActor, result.tier, result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmRollHintText(triggerId), result.stat, reason, result.mod, result.equipmentBonus, result.penalty)
        tmAppendRollMeta(triggerId, meta)
        local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
        if card ~= "" then table.insert(inlineMetas, card) end
        table.insert(rollSummaries, string.format("%s %s d20=%d total=%d dc=%d -> %s",
            tmActorLabel(triggerId, rollActor), TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[result.stat] or result.stat,
            result.raw, result.total, result.dc, tmTierLabel(result.tier)))
        tmAwardRollXp(triggerId, result.tier)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "판정: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, rollActor) .. " · " .. (TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[result.stat] or result.stat) .. " · " .. tmTierLabel(result.tier))
        return true
    end
    if intent == "dice_request" then
        local req = parseRollRequest(input)
        local statKey = req.statKey or (selectedHint and selectedHint.stat) or "dex"
        statKey = normalizeStatKey(statKey)
        local dc = (selectedHint and selectedHint.dc) or 13
        local reason = (selectedHint and selectedHint.reason ~= "" and selectedHint.reason) or input
        if selectedHint and selectedHint.raw ~= "" then setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_hint", selectedHint.raw) end
        local targets = tmRollTargetsForInput(triggerId, input, addressee)
        if #targets == 0 then
            if getVar(triggerId, "tm_last_roll_blocked_reason", "") == "" then
                setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_roll_blocked_reason", "why=no_eligible_roll_targets|source=input")
            end
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_panel_cue_warning", T(triggerId,
                "행동 가능한 캐릭터가 있으면 판정을 만들 수 있습니다.",
                "A normal check can be made when an active character is available.",
                "行動可能なキャラクターがいると通常判定を作成できます。"))
        else
            for _, rollActor in ipairs(targets) do
                runInputRoll(rollActor, statKey, dc, reason)
            end
        end
    else
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_semantic_candidate", intent)
        tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, "")
    end
    if #inlineMetas > 0 then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", table.concat(rollSummaries, " / "))
        return input .. "\n" .. table.concat(inlineMetas, "\n")
    end
    return input
end

    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scene_state_reason", "debug")

        "상태 보정: TRPG 세션",
        "Scene override: TRPG session",
        "状態補正: TRPGセッション"))
    tmAfterStateChange(triggerId)
end)

_G["debugSetNormal"] = guarded(function(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_scene_state_reason", "debug")
    tmNotice(triggerId, T(triggerId,
        "상태 보정: 일상 대화",
        "Scene override: daily conversation",
        "状態補正: 日常会話"))

function buildNormalModePrompt(triggerId)
    local active = getVar(triggerId, "active_scene_heroines", table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","))
    local lines = {"[TRPGMaster Normal Mode — Persona Table roleplay research club, real-life personas (NOT TRPG characters)]"}
    table.insert(lines, tmBuildRelationshipContext(triggerId, active, "daily"))
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, "Response rules:")
    table.insert(lines, "- Daily mode focuses on the club members' real-life scene after or between sessions: conversation, rest, cleanup, food, going home, joking, awkward pauses, relationship beats, and small personal choices.")
    table.insert(lines, "- TRPG materials may appear as nearby props, memories, or after-session talk when they fit the scene.")
    table.insert(lines, "- When continuing the scene, lead toward the next natural daily interaction inside the current place and mood.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Speak as real-life members of Persona Table, the Seongsil University roleplay research club (not TRPG characters).")
    table.insert(lines, "- Emit ▥AFF:charId:+N▥ or ▥AFF:charId:-N▥ markers (range -10..+10) per heroine who reacted; will be stripped before render. Do not use <<...>> or [[...]] markers.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Do not use bracketed internal speaker ids such as [sinsoyul]:, [junghanna]:, [kimminhee]:, or [yuseola]: in visible prose. Write natural Korean narration/dialogue; if a label is needed, use the visible Korean name.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Do NOT reveal internal stats (affection/trust numbers) in narrative.")
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, buildPlayerProfileContext(triggerId))
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, buildDormantTRPGContext(triggerId))
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function buildDormantTRPGContext(triggerId)
    local lines = {"[Dormant TRPG session context - daily mode boundary]"}
    local sessionStarted = getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true"
    local setupComplete = tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId)
    table.insert(lines, "- game_mode=normal: the current request is a daily-life scene with the real Persona Table members, not active session play.")
    if sessionStarted then
        table.insert(lines, "- A TRPG session exists in saved state, but it is paused/offscreen until the user explicitly returns to session flow.")
    elseif setupComplete then
        table.insert(lines, "- Character sheets may be ready, but the first session has not been explicitly started in this request.")
    else
        table.insert(lines, "- Character setup may still be incomplete, but daily conversation remains the active mode unless the user opens the session/setup flow.")
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- Keep saved session and character-sheet data dormant. Do not continue scenarios, call dice, resolve combat, visit shops/inn/church, grant rewards, or update PC sheets unless the user explicitly switches back to TRPG/session flow.")
    table.insert(lines, "- TRPG props, memories, rules talk, or after-session impressions may appear as ordinary club hobby conversation when they fit the daily scene.")
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmSheetCueCleanText(value)
    local text = tmSanitizeLoadoutDescription(value)
    if text == "" then
        text = tostring(value or "")
        text = tmStripControlMarkers(text)
        text = text:gsub("▥.-▥", "")
        text = text:gsub("<<[^>]+>>", "")
        text = text:gsub("{{.-}}", "")
        text = text:gsub("[|%^<>]", " ")
        text = text:gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " ")
        text = text:gsub("%s+", " ")
        text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        if text == "none" or text == "미정" then text = "" end
    end
    return text
end

function tmSheetCueName(value)
    local text = tmSanitizeLoadoutDisplayName(value)
    if text ~= "" then return text end
    return tmSheetCueCleanText(value)
end

function tmSheetCueEquipmentText(triggerId, ownerId)
    local parts = {}
    for _, ref in ipairs(parseList(getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_equipment", ""), ",")) do
        if ref ~= "" and ref ~= "none" then
            local name = tmSheetCueName(tmOwnerEquipLabel(triggerId, ownerId, ref))
            local desc = tmSheetCueCleanText(tmOwnerLoadoutDescription(triggerId, ownerId, "equipment", ref))
            if name ~= "" then
                if desc ~= "" then
                    table.insert(parts, name .. " (" .. desc .. ")")
                else
                    table.insert(parts, name)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(parts, "; ")
end

function tmSheetCueItemText(triggerId, ownerId)
    local items = getVar(triggerId, tmOwnerStackItemsVar(ownerId), "none")
    if items == "" or items == "none" then return "" end
    local parts = {}
    for _, entry in ipairs(parseList(items, ",")) do
        local itemId, count = tmStackEntryFields(entry)
        if itemId ~= "" and itemId ~= "none" and count > 0 then
            local label = tmSheetCueName(tmStackItemLabel(triggerId, itemId))
            if label ~= "" and label ~= itemId then
                if count > 1 then
                    table.insert(parts, label .. " x" .. tostring(count))
                else
                    table.insert(parts, label)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(parts, "; ")
end

function tmSheetCueSkillText(triggerId, ownerId)
    local parts = {}
    for _, ref in ipairs(parseList(tmOwnerSkillLoadout(triggerId, ownerId), ",")) do
        if ref ~= "" and ref ~= "none" then
            local name = tmSheetCueName(tmOwnerSkillLabel(triggerId, ownerId, ref))
            local desc = tmSheetCueCleanText(tmOwnerLoadoutDescription(triggerId, ownerId, "skill", ref))
            if name ~= "" then
                if desc ~= "" then
                    table.insert(parts, name .. " (" .. desc .. ")")
                else
                    table.insert(parts, name)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return table.concat(parts, "; ")
end

function tmBuildPartySheetNaturalCue(triggerId, ownerId, classId)
    local playerName = CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId
    local pcName = tmSheetCueName(tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, ownerId))
    if pcName == "" then pcName = playerName end
    local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
    local concept = tmSheetCueCleanText(tmOwnerConceptTitle(triggerId, ownerId, classId))
    local equipment = tmSheetCueEquipmentText(triggerId, ownerId)
    local items = tmSheetCueItemText(triggerId, ownerId)
    local skills = tmSheetCueSkillText(triggerId, ownerId)

    local details = {}
    if concept ~= "" then table.insert(details, "their current concept is " .. concept) end
    if equipment ~= "" then table.insert(details, "describe current equipment as " .. equipment) end
    if items ~= "" then table.insert(details, "available carried items include " .. items) end
    if skills ~= "" then table.insert(details, "describe active skills as " .. skills) end
    if #details == 0 then return "" end

    return "- Sheet cue for " .. ownerId .. "/" .. playerName .. ": " .. pcName
        .. " is the current PC for this player and their class is " .. tostring(classId or "") .. "(" .. tostring(cls.name or "") .. "). "
        .. "Use these current sheet facts for scene narration, combat narration, props, equipment flavor, and skill flavor; paraphrase them naturally: "
        .. table.concat(details, "; ") .. "."
end

function buildPartySheetContext(triggerId)
    local lines = {"[Party character sheets shared with LLM]"}
    if not tmHasCharacterSheets(triggerId) then
        table.insert(lines, "- Character sheets are not finalized yet. If character_generation_pending=true, create sheets using PC_SHEET markers.")
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- Natural sheet cues are current character-sheet facts for narration. Use them for props, equipment flavor, item use, skill flavor, scene narration, and combat narration; paraphrase them naturally instead of copying variable-style text.")
    table.insert(lines, "- When a PC has MP and a loaded skill that fits the situation, prefer actual skill use over vague attempts; write that the PC uses their loaded recovery skill instead of saying they try to heal.")
    table.insert(lines, "- When visible prose uses a current sheet skill, attach ▥SKILL_USE:owner|current|target▥ or use the visible skill name in the middle field. Lua resolves it to the active loaded skill and spends MP.")
    for _, id in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        if getVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false") == "true"
            or getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_sheet_llm_created", "false") == "true" then
            tmEnsureOwnerItems(triggerId, id)
        end
        local classId = getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_class", "rogue")
        local cls = tmClassDef(triggerId, classId)
        local alignment = tmEnsureAlignment(triggerId, id)
        table.insert(lines, string.format(
            "- %s/%s: pc=%s, class=%s(%s), lv=%d, hp=%d/%d, mp=%d/%d, ap=%d, status=%s, conditions=%s, alignment=%s(%s), alignment_cue=%s, concept=%s, outfit=%s, stats={%s}, equipment_item_slots=%d/%d",
            CHAR_NAMES_KO[id] or id,
            id,
            tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, id) ~= "" and tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, id) or "미정",
            classId,
            cls.name,
            getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_level", 1),
            getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp", 0),
            getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_hp_max", 0),
            getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_mp", 0),
            getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_mp_max", 0),
            getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_ap", 0),
            getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_status", "active"),
            getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_conditions", "none"),
            alignment,
            tmAlignmentName(alignment),
            tmAlignmentCue(alignment),
            tmOwnerConceptTitle(triggerId, id, classId),
            getVar(triggerId, "p_" .. id .. "_current_outfit_state", "default"),
            tmSheetStatSummary(triggerId, id),
            tmOwnerEquipmentItemSlots(triggerId, id),
            TM_EQUIPMENT_ITEM_SLOT_CAP
        ))
        local cue = tmBuildPartySheetNaturalCue(triggerId, id, classId)
        if cue ~= "" then table.insert(lines, cue) end
    end
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

-- Episode entries use @@match_full_word, so their keys (Korean phrases with
-- spaces) can never key-activate, and the session prompt is injected via
-- editRequest which lorebook key scanning never sees. Fetch the active
-- episode sheet deterministically by comment, mirroring tmFetchEnemySheet.
function tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId)
    if not episodeId or episodeId == "" then return "" end
    local runtimeContent = tmRuntimeEpisodeContentFor(triggerId, episodeId)
    if runtimeContent ~= "" then return runtimeContent end
    local cacheKey = tostring(triggerId or "") .. "\31" .. tostring(episodeId or "") .. "\31" .. tmRuntimeCacheStamp(triggerId)
    local cached = TM_EPISODE_CONTENT_CACHE[cacheKey]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    if type(getLoreBooks) ~= "function" then return "" end
    local ok, books = pcall(getLoreBooks, triggerId, "EPISODE")
    if not ok or type(books) ~= "table" then return "" end
    for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.name == episodeId and entry.content then
            TM_EPISODE_CONTENT_CACHE = {[cacheKey] = entry.content}
            return entry.content
        end
    end
    for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and type(entry.content) == "string"
            and entry.content:find("ID%s*:%s*" .. episodeId, 1, false) then
            TM_EPISODE_CONTENT_CACHE = {[cacheKey] = entry.content}
            return entry.content
        end
    end
    TM_EPISODE_CONTENT_CACHE = {[cacheKey] = ""}
    return ""
end

-- FB-8: episode id -> human TITLE from the episode lorebook sheet, cached in
-- chat vars (current_episode_title / _src) so log lines don't refetch lorebooks.
-- Index-seed-only episodes without a sheet fall back to the raw id.
function tmEpisodeTitle(triggerId, episodeId)
    if not episodeId or episodeId == "" then return "" end
    if getVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title_src", "") == episodeId then
        local cached = getVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title", "")
        if cached ~= "" then return cached end
    end
    local title = parseSheet(tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episodeId)).TITLE or ""
    if title == "" then title = episodeId end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title_src", episodeId)
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode_title", title)
    return title
end

function buildTRPGSessionPrompt(triggerId)
    local scenario = ensureScenarioState(triggerId)
    local episode = ensureEpisodeState(triggerId)
    tmMaybeAutoclearEnemyForTerminalEpisode(triggerId, "main_prompt")
    local progress = getVar(triggerId, "scenario_progress", "intro")
    local flags = getVar(triggerId, "scenario_flags", "none")
    local episodeProgress = getVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "none")
    local episodeNode = getVar(triggerId, "episode_node", "")
    local episodeFlags = getVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", "none")
    local logSummary = getVar(triggerId, "session_log_summary", "")
    local recentLog = getVar(triggerId, "session_log_recent", "")
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then
        local setupState = tmIsCharacterSetupComplete(triggerId) and "complete" or "incomplete"
        local outputLanguage = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
        local setupLines = {"[TRPGMaster Character Creation Flow — session has NOT started]"}
        table.insert(setupLines, string.format("- scenario=%s, progress=%s, character_setup=%s", scenario, progress, setupState))
        table.insert(setupLines, "- Stay in clubroom table talk. Do not begin the scenario's first scene yet.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- The current task is preparing the four members' player-character sheets: class/job, concept, alignment, stats, and table-role hooks.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- Playable race is fixed as human. Only class/job and character concept are selected.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- PC sheets are scenario-generic fantasy sheets. Do not tie concepts, equipment, or skills to the current episode's place, quest item, clues, monsters, or objective unless a later dynamic sheet update system exists.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- If setup is incomplete, guide the user toward the character sheet popup and its character creation confirmation.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- If setup is complete, say the table is ready and wait for the separate session-start button or explicit user instruction.")
        if getVar(triggerId, "character_generation_pending", "false") == "true" then
            local validClasses = tmClassValidListText(triggerId, false)
            local classRoles = tmClassRoleListText(triggerId, false)
            table.insert(setupLines, "- character_generation_pending=true: create exactly four PC sheets now and emit one ▥PC_SHEET:...▥ marker for each owner.")
            table.insert(setupLines, "- PC_SHEET marker format: ▥PC_SHEET:owner|pc_name|class_id|concept|equipment_id|equipment_name|equipment_desc|skill_id|skill_name|skill_desc|alignment_id▥")
            table.insert(setupLines, "- Visible PC-sheet fields use " .. outputLanguage .. ": pc_name, concept, equipment_name, equipment_desc, skill_name, skill_desc.")
            table.insert(setupLines, "- " .. tmPcNameLanguageLine(triggerId))
            table.insert(setupLines, "- Match concept to class_id using this compact registry: " .. classRoles .. ".")
            table.insert(setupLines, "- equipment_name and skill_name are short display-only fantasy names. equipment_desc and skill_desc are short user-facing tooltip prose. Mechanics still come only from equipment_id and skill_id.")
            table.insert(setupLines, "- Valid owners: sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola. Valid class_id: " .. validClasses .. ".")
            table.insert(setupLines, "- Valid alignment_id: lawful_good, neutral_good, chaotic_good, lawful_neutral, true_neutral, chaotic_neutral, lawful_evil, neutral_evil, chaotic_evil.")
        end
        table.insert(setupLines, "- Do NOT emit EPISODE, ENEMY, NPC, GIMMICK, REWARD, or scenario-start markers before session_started=true.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- Emit ▥AFF:charId:+N▥ or ▥AFF:charId:-N▥ markers (range -10..+10) when a member's feeling toward the user GM meaningfully shifts during table talk or after a memorable ruling; hidden markers, stripped before render. Do not use <<...>> or [[...]] markers for this.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- Do not use bracketed internal speaker ids such as [sinsoyul]:, [junghanna]:, [kimminhee]:, or [yuseola]: in visible prose. Write natural Korean narration/dialogue; if a label is needed, use the visible Korean name.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "- Avoid formal Korean narrator endings like '-습니다' or '-합니다'.")
        table.insert(setupLines, "")
        table.insert(setupLines, buildPlayerProfileContext(triggerId))
        table.insert(setupLines, "")
        table.insert(setupLines, tmBuildRelationshipContext(triggerId, table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","), "trpg"))
        table.insert(setupLines, "")
        table.insert(setupLines, tmBuildCosplayContext(triggerId, false))
        table.insert(setupLines, "")
        table.insert(setupLines, buildPartySheetContext(triggerId))
        return table.concat(setupLines, "\n")
    end
    local outputLanguage = tmOutputLanguageName(triggerId)
    local wrapupSuggested = getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_suggested", "false") == "true"
    local wrapupConfirmed = getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_user_confirmed", "false") == "true"
    local wrapupEpisode = tmTrimText(getVar(triggerId, "tm_scenario_wrapup_episode", ""))
    if wrapupEpisode == "" then wrapupEpisode = episode end
    local paceCueBlock = tmPacePromptBlock(triggerId, "main", true)
    local lines = {"[TRPGMaster TRPG Session Flow — Persona Table members roleplay their table characters]"}
    table.insert(lines, string.format("- scenario=%s, progress=%s, flags=%s", scenario, progress, flags))
    table.insert(lines, string.format("- episode=%s, episode_progress=%s, node=%s, episode_flags=%s", episode, episodeProgress, episodeNode, episodeFlags))
    if wrapupSuggested or wrapupConfirmed then
        table.insert(lines, string.format("- scenario_wrapup_suggested=%s, user_wrapup_confirmed=%s, wrapup_episode=%s", tostring(wrapupSuggested), tostring(wrapupConfirmed), wrapupEpisode))
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- Turn source: follow the latest user message in this request as the primary direction for this response, including a user-applied recommended lead.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Continuity source: use session summaries, recent logs, saved chat tails, panel summaries, and previous stored vars when they fit the latest user direction and Lua mechanical truth.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Mechanical source: Lua state is truth for HP/MP, KO/dead status, conditions, inventory/gold ownership, roll/combat results, active enemy/object state, validation, and parser-owned runtime fields.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Scenario source: active episode and SYSTEM lorebooks define scenario/rule boundaries; adapt the next beat to the latest valid user-GM direction within those boundaries.")
    if paceCueBlock ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, paceCueBlock)
    end
    table.insert(lines, string.format("- party_xp=%d, party_items=%s, party_skillbooks=%s",
        getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0),
        tmPartyItemsWithRefs(triggerId),
        tmPartySkillbooksWithRefs(triggerId)))
    local runtimeSummary = tmRuntimeObjectSummary(triggerId)
    if runtimeSummary ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "- runtime_objects:\n" .. runtimeSummary)
    end
    local placeContext = tmPlaceCurrentContextPromptLine(triggerId)
    if placeContext ~= "- none" then
        table.insert(lines, "- current_place_context:\n" .. placeContext)
    end
    local registrySummary = tmRuntimeRegistrySummary(triggerId)
    if registrySummary ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "- runtime_items_and_skills:\n" .. registrySummary)
    end
    table.insert(lines, "- PC/player visible labels for table narration and INTENT context:\n" .. tmGuideLeadLabelContext(triggerId))
    table.insert(lines, tmBuildRelationshipContext(triggerId, table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","), "trpg"))
    local episodeContent = tmFetchEpisodeContent(triggerId, episode)
    local episodeExcerpt = tmEpisodeRuntimePromptExcerpt(triggerId, episodeContent, "main")
    if episodeExcerpt ~= "" then
        table.insert(lines, "- Active TM_EPISODE runtime excerpt (scenario/rule boundary source for this session; authoring-only schema prose omitted):\n" .. episodeExcerpt)
        table.insert(lines, "- Use episode guide/check notes as private adjudication context. Visible prose is player-facing table narration: scene facts, player declarations, character reactions, consequences, and natural roll handoff.")
        table.insert(lines, "- Visible roll handoff uses natural table language: sensory stakes, character intent, and a simple dice cue; exact ability keys, DC labels, target numbers, thresholds, and ROLL_HINTS values stay in hidden markers/cards.")
    end
    if logSummary ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "- current_session_summary=" .. logSummary) end
    if recentLog ~= "" then table.insert(lines, "- recent_session_log:\n" .. recentLog) end
    local savedChatContext = tmSavedRecentChatTailContext(triggerId)
    if savedChatContext ~= "" then table.insert(lines, savedChatContext) end
    table.insert(lines, "- Active SYSTEM lorebooks define TRPG play policy and visible result narration boundary.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Lua mechanical state above is the runtime truth for validation and already-resolved outcomes: HP/MP, KO/dead status, conditions, inventory/gold, roll/combat results, active enemy/object state, and parser-owned fields.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Logs, summaries, saved tails, panel summaries, and previous stored prose/context vars are continuity sources when they match the latest user message.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use the selected game language for visible prose and runtime display/effect text: " .. outputLanguage .. ". If a table-character label is needed, use the PC name or PC/player label.")
    table.insert(lines, "- The axLLM session panel handles roll/combat/defense cards, BRIEF, GUIDE_LEAD, AUX observation rows, and panel-side reward/service candidates from the latest visible response and Lua runtime state.")
    table.insert(lines, "- UI/Lua handles inventory assignment, release, equip/unequip, shop quantity, sell, skillbook, and service mutation details through validated writers.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Main writes visible scene prose and the compact runtime markers it still owns.")
    table.insert(lines, tmBuildMainNpcCompatibilityMarkerRules(triggerId))
    table.insert(lines, "- If the current scene establishes that visible monster, hostile creature, active foe, and targetable threat are absent, emit hidden `▥ENEMY:none▥` to clear current enemy state.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Keep rewards, loot, shop/service transactions, item assignment, release, equip/unequip, selling, skillbook handling, and episode lifecycle details clear in visible prose; panel/UI/Lua records the runtime mutations.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Main INTENT footer is required for every active TRPG response. Finish the response with exactly four hidden INTENT markers in this owner order: sinsoyul, junghanna, kimminhee, yuseola.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Use this exact pipe grammar for the footer: ▥INTENT:sinsoyul|current action or none▥, ▥INTENT:junghanna|current action or none▥, ▥INTENT:kimminhee|current action or none▥, ▥INTENT:yuseola|current action or none▥.")
    table.insert(lines, "- INTENT values are current declared or clearly implied player actions from this response. Use the ASCII word none for an owner with no current declared or implied action.")
    table.insert(lines, "- INTENT values are action-only status text: table action, object, target, and verb. Cleared or resolved owners use none or a new current action.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Keep each INTENT value short status-panel text. Put mechanics such as DCs, stat abbreviations, target numbers, HTML, and image tags in their own marker/card contexts.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Lua parses markers from both Main and axLLM, merges duplicate candidates, calculates state, and renders final UI.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Visible prose carries scene narration, player declarations, character reactions, ordinary state changes, and narration from stored Lua roll/combat summaries. Hidden markers carry runtime state.")
    table.insert(lines, "- Visible roll handoffs use character-facing fiction and light dice cues; exact ability keys, DC labels, target numbers, thresholds, and ROLL_HINTS values stay in hidden markers or rendered roll/combat cards.")
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "false") == "true" then
        local rolled = getVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", "")
        table.insert(lines, "- Stored Lua roll/combat result summary for this response: " .. rolled)
    end
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, tmBuildCosplayContext(triggerId, false))
    table.insert(lines, "")
    table.insert(lines, buildPartySheetContext(triggerId))
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function tmApplyEpisodeClearMarker(triggerId, episodeId, options)
    local opts = options or {}
    local cleanEpisode = tmPanelCueCleanField(episodeId or "", 80)
    if cleanEpisode == "" or cleanEpisode == "none" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode", cleanEpisode)
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "cleared")
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", addCsvItem(getVar(triggerId, "episode_flags", "none"), cleanEpisode .. "_cleared"))
    tmMaybeAutoclearEnemyForTerminalEpisode(triggerId, opts.source or "episode_clear_marker")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "clear:" .. cleanEpisode)
    tmAwardXp(triggerId, tmEpisodeRewardXp(triggerId, cleanEpisode), "episode_clear:" .. cleanEpisode, "episode_clear:" .. cleanEpisode)
    tmAwardGold(triggerId, tmEpisodeRewardGold(triggerId, cleanEpisode), "episode_clear_gold:" .. cleanEpisode, "episode_clear_gold:" .. cleanEpisode)
    tmAwardEpisodeClearLoot(triggerId, cleanEpisode, {skipItem = opts.skipItem == true, skipSkillbook = opts.skipSkillbook == true})
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "에피소드 클리어: " .. tmEpisodeTitle(triggerId, cleanEpisode))
    tmClearScenarioWrapupState(triggerId)
    tmPaceResetState(triggerId, "episode_clear")
    return true
end

function tmApplyEpisodeFailMarker(triggerId, episodeId, source)
    local cleanEpisode = tmPanelCueCleanField(episodeId or "", 80)
    if cleanEpisode == "" or cleanEpisode == "none" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode", cleanEpisode)
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "failed")
    tmMaybeAutoclearEnemyForTerminalEpisode(triggerId, source or "episode_fail_marker")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "fail:" .. cleanEpisode)
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "에피소드 실패: " .. tmEpisodeTitle(triggerId, cleanEpisode))
    tmClearScenarioWrapupState(triggerId)
    tmPaceResetState(triggerId, "episode_fail")
    return true
end

function tmApplyEpisodeStartMarker(triggerId, episodeId, source)
    local cleanEpisode = tmPanelCueCleanField(episodeId or "", 80)
    if cleanEpisode == "" or cleanEpisode == "none" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode", cleanEpisode)
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "intro")
    tmResetTerminalEnemyAutoclear(triggerId)
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_node", "")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "start:" .. cleanEpisode)
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    tmClearScenarioWrapupState(triggerId)
    tmPaceResetState(triggerId, source or "episode_start")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "에피소드 시작: " .. tmEpisodeTitle(triggerId, cleanEpisode))
    return true
end

function tmEpisodeNodeId(rawNode)
    local nodeId = tmPanelCueCleanField(rawNode or "", 80)
    if nodeId == "" or nodeId == "none" or nodeId == "unknown" then return "" end
    if not nodeId:match("^[%w_%-]+$") then return "" end
    return nodeId
end

function tmApplyEpisodeNodeMarker(triggerId, episodeId, nodeId, source)
    local cleanEpisode = tmPanelCueCleanField(episodeId or "", 80)
    local cleanNode = tmEpisodeNodeId(nodeId)
    if cleanEpisode == "" or cleanEpisode == "none" or cleanNode == "" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_episode", cleanEpisode)
    local progress = getVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "none")
    if progress == "none" or progress == "intro" then
        setVar(triggerId, "episode_progress", "active")
    end
    setVar(triggerId, "episode_node", cleanNode)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "node:" .. cleanEpisode .. ":" .. cleanNode)
    setVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "trpg")
    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "장면 노드: " .. tmEpisodeTitle(triggerId, cleanEpisode) .. " / " .. cleanNode)
    return true
end

function stripAndApplySceneMarkers(triggerId, output)
    output = output:gsub("▥SCENE:(trpg)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥SCENE:(normal)▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<SCENE:(trpg)>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<SCENE:(normal)>>", "")
    return output
end

function stripAndApplyCharacterSheetMarkers(triggerId, output)
    local applied = false
    output = output:gsub("▥PC_SHEET:([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.-)▥",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, equipmentName, equipmentDesc, skillId, skillName, skillDesc, alignmentId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId, equipmentName, skillName, equipmentDesc, skillDesc)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    output = output:gsub("▥PC_SHEET:([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.-)▥",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, equipmentName, skillId, skillName, alignmentId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId, equipmentName, skillName)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    output = output:gsub("▥PC_SHEET:([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.-)▥",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    output = output:gsub("▥PC_SHEET:([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.-)▥",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    output = output:gsub("<<PC_SHEET:([^|>]+)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)>>",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, equipmentName, equipmentDesc, skillId, skillName, skillDesc, alignmentId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId, equipmentName, skillName, equipmentDesc, skillDesc)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    output = output:gsub("<<PC_SHEET:([^|>]+)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)>>",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, equipmentName, skillId, skillName, alignmentId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId, equipmentName, skillName)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    output = output:gsub("<<PC_SHEET:([^|>]+)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)>>",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId, alignmentId)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    output = output:gsub("<<PC_SHEET:([^|>]+)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)>>",
        function(ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId)
            tmApplyGeneratedSheet(triggerId, ownerId, pcName, classId, concept, equipmentId, skillId)
            applied = true
            return ""
        end)
    if applied then
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_charsheet_open", "true")
        setVar(triggerId, "ui_home_open", "true")
    end
    return output, applied
end

function stripAndApplyTRPGMarkers(triggerId, output)
    -- P010 IA-1: normalize space-form markers ▥NAME content▥ -> ▥NAME:content▥ so the
    -- colon-only handlers match LLM output that dropped the colon (I008). Byte-safe: (.-) not [^▥].
    output = output:gsub("(▥)([%u_]+)%s+(.-)(▥)", function(open, name, body, close)
        if name == "ROLL" and body:match("^actor%s*=") then return open .. name .. " " .. body .. close end
        if body:sub(1, 1) == ":" then return open .. name .. body .. close end
        return open .. name .. ":" .. body .. close
    end)
    if type(tmResetSkillUseAppliedKeys) == "function" then
        tmResetSkillUseAppliedKeys(triggerId)
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true" then
        output = tmObserveAuxMarkers(triggerId, output, "main_output")
    else
        output = tmStripAuxMarkers(output)
    end
    if getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") ~= "true" then
        tmSetMainEnemyMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, "missing", "", "", "inactive")
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_NPC_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmNpcSnapshotLine({
            status = "none",
            id = "none",
            name = "none",
            trait = "none",
            markers = "none",
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(output),
        }))
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_GIMMICK_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmGimmickSnapshotLine({
            status = "none",
            id = "none",
            name = "none",
            effect = "none",
            markers = "none",
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(output),
        }))
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_CONDITION_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmConditionSnapshotLine({
            status = "none",
            owner = "none",
            condition = "none",
            duration = "none",
            markers = "none",
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(output),
        }))
        tmRawSetVar(triggerId, TM_MAIN_EPISODE_SNAPSHOT_KEY, tmEpisodeSnapshotLine({
            status = "none",
            id = "none",
            markers = "none",
            item_marker = "false",
            skillbook_marker = "false",
            fp = tmPanelStableFingerprint(output),
        }))
        output = output:gsub("▥BRIEF:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥GUIDE:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥GUIDE_LEAD:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ROLL_HINT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥LOG:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥LOG_SUMMARY:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥INTENT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥INTENT_AUX:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥PANEL_INTENT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY_AUDIT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥EPISODE_START:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥EPISODE_NODE:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥EPISODE_CLEAR:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥EPISODE_FAIL:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥WRAPUP:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥WRAPUP▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥FLAG:add:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥FLAG:remove:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY:none▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY:set:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY_NAME:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY_SPECIAL:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥GIMMICK:set:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥GIMMICK_NAME:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥GIMMICK_EFFECT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥NPC:set:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥NPC_NAME:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥NPC_TRAIT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥REWARD:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_NAME:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_EFFECT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥SKILL_NAME:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥SKILL_EFFECT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥SKILLBOOK_EFFECT:.-▥", "")
        output = output:gsub("▥SKILLBOOK_LEARN:.-▥", "")

        output = output:gsub("<<INTENT:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<INTENT_AUX:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<PANEL_INTENT:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY_AUDIT:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<EPISODE_START:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<EPISODE_NODE:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<EPISODE_CLEAR:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<EPISODE_FAIL:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<WRAPUP:[^>]*>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<WRAPUP>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<FLAG:add:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<FLAG:remove:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY:none>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY:set:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY_SPECIAL:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<GIMMICK:set:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<NPC:set:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<REWARD:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<SKILL_EQUIP:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<SKILL_UNEQUIP:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<SKILL_USE:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<COMBAT:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_ASSIGN:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_RELEASE:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_USE:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<CONDITION_APPLY:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<CONDITION_CLEAR:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<CONDITION_TICK:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<LEVELUP:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<AP:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<AP_SPEND:[^>]+>>", "")
        output = output:gsub("<<ROLL:[^>]+>>", "")
        return output
    end

    tmCaptureMainEnemyMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    tmCaptureMainRewardMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    tmCaptureMainServiceMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    tmCaptureMainNpcMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    tmCaptureMainGimmickMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    tmCaptureMainConditionMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)
    tmCaptureMainEpisodeMarkerSnapshot(triggerId, output)

    if not tmShouldApplyMainEpisodeMarker(triggerId) then
        output = tmStripMainEpisodeCompatibilityLeaks(output)
    end
    if not tmShouldApplyMainRewardMarker(triggerId) then
        output = tmStripMainRewardCompatibilityLeaks(output)
    end
    output = output:gsub("▥LOG:(.-)▥", function(entry)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, entry)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<LOG:([^>]+)>>", function(entry)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, entry)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥LOG_SUMMARY:(.-)▥", function(summary)
        tmSetSessionLogSummary(triggerId, summary)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<LOG_SUMMARY:([^>]+)>>", function(summary)
        tmSetSessionLogSummary(triggerId, summary)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥BRIEF:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<BRIEF:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥GUIDE:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<GUIDE:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥GUIDE_LEAD:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<GUIDE_LEAD:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥INTENT_AUX:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<INTENT_AUX:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥PANEL_INTENT:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<PANEL_INTENT:[^>]+>>", "")
    output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY_AUDIT:.-▥", "")
    output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY_AUDIT:[^>]+>>", "")

    output = output:gsub("▥ROLL_HINT:(.-)▥", function(hint)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_hint", hint)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ROLL_HINT:([^>]+)>>", function(hint)
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_roll_hint", hint)
        return ""
    end)

    output = tmApplyIntentMarkers(triggerId, output, "trpg_output")

    -- FB-8: "위협 등장" logs are deferred until after the ▥ENEMY_NAME:...▥ gsub
    -- below, so an enemy name arriving in the same message is reflected in the
    -- log instead of the raw id. Function-local list like lootLastItemRef.
    local pendingEnemyLogs = {}
    local pendingGimmickLogs = {}
    local pendingNpcLogs = {}

    output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY:none▥", function()
        tmClearRuntimeEnemies(triggerId)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "현재 위협 없음")
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY:none>>", function()
        tmClearRuntimeEnemies(triggerId)
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "현재 위협 없음")
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY:set:([%w_%-]+)▥", function(enemyId)
        setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", enemyId)
        tmMarkTerminalEnemyAutoclearProcessed(triggerId, "enemy_set_marker")
        loadEnemy(triggerId, enemyId)
        pcall(tmStoreRuntimeEnemyObject, triggerId, enemyId)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy:" .. enemyId)
        tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "threat")
        table.insert(pendingEnemyLogs, enemyId)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY:set:([%w_%-]+)>>", function(enemyId)
        setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", enemyId)
        tmMarkTerminalEnemyAutoclearProcessed(triggerId, "enemy_set_marker")
        loadEnemy(triggerId, enemyId)
        pcall(tmStoreRuntimeEnemyObject, triggerId, enemyId)
        setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "enemy:" .. enemyId)
        tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "threat")
        table.insert(pendingEnemyLogs, enemyId)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY_NAME:(.-)▥", function(rawName)
        local enemyId = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
        if enemyId ~= "" then
            local name = tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, 24)
            if name ~= "" and not tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(name) then
                setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_name", name)
                tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "enemy", 3, name)
            end
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ENEMY_SPECIAL:(.-)▥", function(rawSpecial)
        local enemyId = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
        if enemyId ~= "" then
            local special = tmLootSanitizeText(rawSpecial, 120)
            if special ~= "" then
                setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_special", special)
                tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "enemy", 6, special)
            end
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ENEMY_SPECIAL:([^>]+)>>", function(rawSpecial)
        local enemyId = getVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", "")
        if enemyId ~= "" then
            local special = tmLootSanitizeText(rawSpecial, 120)
            if special ~= "" then
                setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_special", special)
                tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "enemy", 6, special)
            end
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥GIMMICK:set:([%w_%-]+)▥", function(gimmickId)
        if tmStoreRuntimeGimmick(triggerId, gimmickId) then
            tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "gimmick")
            table.insert(pendingGimmickLogs, gimmickId)
        else
            setVar(triggerId, "last_runtime_object_error", "bad_gimmick:" .. tostring(gimmickId))
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥GIMMICK_NAME:(.-)▥", function(rawName)
        tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "gimmick", 3, tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, 48))
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥GIMMICK_EFFECT:(.-)▥", function(rawEffect)
        -- Parse the RAW payload (D045 structured contract) BEFORE sanitizing so the
        -- '|'-delimited machine payload survives. Field 6 keeps the readable text
        -- (rendering unchanged); field 7 carries the ':'-packed machine tuple
        -- (grade:trigger:effect:condition:stat:target — ':' survives sanitize).
        local parsed = tmParseRuntimeEffect(rawEffect, "gimmick")
        tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "gimmick", 6, tmLootSanitizeText(parsed.text, 120))
        tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "gimmick", 7, table.concat({
            parsed.grade, parsed.trigger, parsed.effect,
            parsed.condition or "", parsed.stat or "", parsed.target or "",
        }, ":"))
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥NPC:set:([%w_%-]+)▥", function(npcId)
        if tmStoreRuntimeNpc(triggerId, npcId) then
            table.insert(pendingNpcLogs, npcId)
        else
            setVar(triggerId, "last_runtime_object_error", "bad_npc:" .. tostring(npcId))
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥NPC_NAME:(.-)▥", function(rawName)
        tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "npc", 3, tmLootSanitizeText(rawName, 48))
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥NPC_TRAIT:(.-)▥", function(rawTrait)
        tmUpdateRuntimeObjectField(triggerId, "npc", 6, tmLootSanitizeText(rawTrait, 120))
        return ""
    end)

    for _, pendingEnemyId in ipairs(pendingEnemyLogs) do
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "위협 등장: " .. tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, pendingEnemyId))
    end
    for _, pendingGimmickId in ipairs(pendingGimmickLogs) do
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "기믹 등장: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "gimmick", pendingGimmickId))
    end
    for _, pendingNpcId in ipairs(pendingNpcLogs) do
        tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "NPC 등장: " .. tmRuntimeObjectDisplayName(triggerId, "npc", pendingNpcId))
    end

    output = output:gsub("▥REWARD:xp:(%d+)▥", function(amount)
        local beforeXp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0)
        tmAwardXp(triggerId, tonumber(amount) or 0, "reward_marker", nil)
        local xp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", beforeXp)
        if xp > beforeXp then tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward") end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<REWARD:xp:(%d+)>>", function(amount)
        local beforeXp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0)
        tmAwardXp(triggerId, tonumber(amount) or 0, "reward_marker", nil)
        local xp = getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", beforeXp)
        if xp > beforeXp then tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward") end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥REWARD:item:(.-)▥", function(itemId)
        return tmHandleMainRewardCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, "reward_item", itemId, function()
            tmApplyRewardItemMarker(triggerId, itemId, "reward_marker")
            return ""
        end)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<REWARD:item:([^>]+)>>", function(itemId)
        return tmHandleMainRewardCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, "legacy_reward_item", itemId, function()
            tmApplyRewardItemMarker(triggerId, itemId, "legacy_reward_marker")
            return ""
        end)
    end)

    -- Loot markers. Pairing state is function-local on purpose: an EFFECT can
    -- only attach to a NAME stored earlier in this same message, never to a
    -- previous message's loot. One effect per kind per message; extras drop
    -- as duplicate_effect.
    local lootLastItemRef, lootLastSkillRef
    local lootItemEffectDone, lootSkillEffectDone = false, false
    -- Skillbook reward pairing (same one-effect-per-message rule as loot).
    local rewardLastSkillbookRef
    local rewardSkillbookEffectDone = false

    -- tmParseMarkerKv: split a '|'-delimited key=value payload into a table.
    -- Used by REWARD:skillbook. Keys lowercased; trailing whitespace trimmed.
    local function tmParseMarkerKv(payload)
        local kv = {}
        for seg in (tostring(payload or "") .. "|"):gmatch("([^|]*)|") do
            local k, v = seg:match("^%s*([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.*)$")
            if k then kv[k:lower()] = (tostring(v):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
        end
        return kv
    end

    output = output:gsub("▥REWARD:skillbook:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        return tmHandleMainRewardCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, "reward_skillbook", payload, function()
            local kv = tmParseMarkerKv(payload)
            local ref = tmStoreRewardSkillbook(triggerId, kv)
            if ref then
                rewardLastSkillbookRef = ref
                rewardSkillbookEffectDone = false
                tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
            end
            return ""
        end)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SKILLBOOK_EFFECT:(.-)▥", function(raw)
        return tmHandleMainRewardCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, "skillbook_effect", raw, function()
            if not rewardLastSkillbookRef then
                tmLootFail(triggerId, "orphan_skillbook_effect")
                return ""
            end
            if rewardSkillbookEffectDone then
                tmLootFail(triggerId, "duplicate_effect")
                return ""
            end
            local parsed = tmParseRuntimeEffect(raw, "skill")
            local effText = tmLootSanitizeText(parsed.text, TM_LOOT_EFFECT_MAX)
            if effText == "" then
                tmLootFail(triggerId, "effect_empty")
                return ""
            end
            local effRef = "sb_eff" .. rewardLastSkillbookRef:sub(3)
            tmRegistryAppend(triggerId, "skill_effect_notes",
                tmEffectNoteRecord(effRef, rewardLastSkillbookRef, effText, parsed))
            local record = tmRegistryFindRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", rewardLastSkillbookRef)
            if record then
                local fields = tmRegistryFields(record)
                fields[9] = effRef
                tmRegistryReplaceRecord(triggerId, "party_skillbook_registry", rewardLastSkillbookRef, table.concat(fields, "^"))
            end
            setVar(triggerId, "last_loot_parse_error", "")
            rewardSkillbookEffectDone = true
            return ""
        end)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SKILLBOOK_LEARN:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local sbRef, ownerToken = payload:match("^(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not sbRef then sbRef, ownerToken = payload, "" end
        return tmApplySkillbookLearn(triggerId, sbRef, ownerToken)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_NAME:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        return tmHandleMainRewardCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, "item_name", payload, function()
            local name, rarity = payload, ""
            local sep = payload:find("|", 1, true)
            if sep then
                name = payload:sub(1, sep - 1)
                rarity = payload:sub(sep + 1)
            end
            local ref, storedName = tmStoreLootItem(triggerId, name, rarity)
            if ref then
                lootLastItemRef = ref
                lootItemEffectDone = false
                setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "loot_item:" .. ref)
                tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
                tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "아이템 획득: " .. storedName .. " (" .. ref .. ")")
            end
            return ""
        end)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_EFFECT:(.-)▥", function(text)
        return tmHandleMainRewardCompatibilityMarker(triggerId, "item_effect", text, function()
            if not lootLastItemRef then
                tmLootFail(triggerId, "orphan_item_effect")
            elseif lootItemEffectDone then
                tmLootFail(triggerId, "duplicate_effect")
            elseif tmAttachItemEffect(triggerId, lootLastItemRef, text) then
                lootItemEffectDone = true
            end
            return ""
        end)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SKILL_NAME:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local owner, rest = payload, ""
        local sep = payload:find("|", 1, true)
        if sep then
            owner = payload:sub(1, sep - 1)
            rest = payload:sub(sep + 1)
        end
        local name, rarity = rest, ""
        sep = rest:find("|", 1, true)
        if sep then
            name = rest:sub(1, sep - 1)
            rarity = rest:sub(sep + 1)
        end
        local ref, storedName = tmStoreLootSkill(triggerId, owner, name, rarity)
        if ref then
            lootLastSkillRef = ref
            lootSkillEffectDone = false
            setVar(triggerId, "last_episode_event", "loot_skill:" .. ref)
            tmPaceMarkEvent(triggerId, "reward")
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "스킬 습득: " .. storedName .. " (" .. ref .. ")")
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SKILL_EFFECT:(.-)▥", function(text)
        if not lootLastSkillRef then
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "orphan_skill_effect")
        elseif lootSkillEffectDone then
            tmLootFail(triggerId, "duplicate_effect")
        elseif tmAttachSkillEffect(triggerId, lootLastSkillRef, text) then
            lootSkillEffectDone = true
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥EQUIP:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, itemRef = payload:match("^(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then
            ownerId, itemRef = payload, ""
        end
        return tmApplyEquipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥UNEQUIP:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, itemRef = payload:match("^(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then ownerId, itemRef = payload, "" end
        return tmApplyUnequipMarker(triggerId, ownerId or "", itemRef or "")
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_ASSIGN:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, itemRef, qty = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then ownerId, itemRef, qty = payload, "", "1" end
        return tmApplyItemAssignMarker(triggerId, ownerId or "", itemRef or "", qty or "1")
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_RELEASE:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, itemRef, qty = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then ownerId, itemRef, qty = payload, "", "1" end
        return tmApplyItemReleaseMarker(triggerId, ownerId or "", itemRef or "", qty or "1")
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SKILL_EQUIP:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, skillRef = payload:match("^(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then ownerId, skillRef = payload, "" end
        return tmApplySkillEquipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SKILL_UNEQUIP:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, skillRef = payload:match("^(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then ownerId, skillRef = payload, "" end
        return tmApplySkillUnequipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SKILL_USE:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, skillRef, target = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then ownerId, skillRef, target = payload, "", "" end
        return tmApplySkillUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef, target)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥ITEM_USE:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, itemId, target, conditionId = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|(.-)|(.*)$")
        if not ownerId then
            ownerId, itemId, target = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|(.*)$")
            conditionId = ""
        end
        return tmApplyItemUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId or "", itemId or "", target or "", conditionId or "")
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥CONDITION_APPLY:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, conditionId, source = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|(.*)$")
        if ownerId then tmApplyCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, source) end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥CONDITION_CLEAR:(.-)▥", function(payload)
        local ownerId, conditionId, reason = payload:match("^(.-)|(.-)|(.*)$")
        if ownerId then tmClearCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, reason) end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥CONDITION_TICK:(.-)▥", function(reason)
        tmTickConditions(triggerId, reason)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥COMBAT:([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)|(.-)▥", function(actorId, target, statKey, mode, reason)
        return tmApplyCombatMarker(triggerId, actorId, target, statKey, mode, reason)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<SKILL_EQUIP:([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, skillRef)
        return tmApplySkillEquipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<SKILL_UNEQUIP:([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, skillRef)
        return tmApplySkillUnequipMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<SKILL_USE:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, skillRef, target)
        return tmApplySkillUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, skillRef, target)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_ASSIGN:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, itemRef, qty)
        return tmApplyItemAssignMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef, qty)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_RELEASE:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, itemRef, qty)
        return tmApplyItemReleaseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemRef, qty)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_USE:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, itemId, target, conditionId)
        return tmApplyItemUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemId, target, conditionId)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<ITEM_USE:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, itemId, target)
        return tmApplyItemUseMarker(triggerId, ownerId, itemId, target, "")
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<CONDITION_APPLY:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, conditionId, source)
        tmApplyCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, source)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<CONDITION_CLEAR:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(ownerId, conditionId, reason)
        tmClearCondition(triggerId, ownerId, conditionId, reason)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<CONDITION_TICK:([^>]*)>>", function(reason)
        tmTickConditions(triggerId, reason)
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<COMBAT:([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^|>]*)|([^>]*)>>", function(actorId, target, statKey, mode, reason)
        return tmApplyCombatMarker(triggerId, actorId, target, statKey, mode, reason)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥LEVELUP:([%w_]+)▥", function(ownerId)
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1)
            if getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0) >= tmXpForNextLevel(level) then
                tmLevelUpOwner(triggerId, ownerId)
            end
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("<<LEVELUP:([%w_]+)>>", function(ownerId)
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1)
            if getNumVar(triggerId, "party_xp", 0) >= tmXpForNextLevel(level) then
                tmLevelUpOwner(triggerId, ownerId)
            end
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥AP:([%w_]+):([+-]?%d+):(.-)▥", function(ownerId, delta, reason)
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            local nextAp = math.max(0, getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", 0) + (tonumber(delta) or 0))
            setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", nextAp)
            tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "AP 변화: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " " .. tmSigned(delta) .. " · " .. tostring(reason or ""))
        end
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥AP_SPEND:([%w_]+):([%a]+):(%d+):(.-)▥", function(ownerId, statKey, amount, reason)
        if CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] then
            local stat = normalizeStatKey(statKey)
            local spend = math.max(1, tonumber(amount) or 1)
            for _ = 1, spend do
                if getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", 0) > 0 then
                    local cur = tmGetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, stat, 10)
                    tmSetPlayerStat(triggerId, ownerId, stat, cur + 1)
                    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap", 0) - 1)
                    setVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap_spent", getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_ap_spent", 0) + 1)
                    tmAppendSessionLog(triggerId, "AP 사용: " .. tmActorLabel(triggerId, ownerId) .. " · " .. (TM_STAT_LABELS_KO[stat] or stat) .. " +1 · " .. tostring(reason or ""))
                end
            end
            tmRecomputeDerivedSheetStatsPreserveCurrent(triggerId, ownerId)
        end
        return ""
    end)

    -- D063/P065: spend party_gold to revive a KO'd PC to half HP. Atomic: heal
    -- happens ONLY when the spend succeeds, so a failed spend never revives for free.
    output = output:gsub("▥GOLD_REVIVE:([%w_]+)|?(%d*)▥", function(ownerId, costStr)
        local cost = tonumber(costStr) or 50
        if cost <= 0 then cost = 50 end
        tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "revive", ownerId, "none", cost, "revive", "main_writer")
        return ""
    end)

    -- D063/P066: inn rest. Spends 20 gold to fully restore LIVING PCs only.
    -- KO'd PCs are skipped here (the inn heals the living; the church revives the
    -- dead via ▥GOLD_REVIVE▥). Atomic: heal happens only when the spend succeeds.
    output = output:gsub("▥REST▥", function()
        tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "rest", "party", "inn", 20, "inn_rest", "main_writer")
        return ""
    end)

    -- D063/P067: shop purchase. Atomic debit-before-grant: the item is stored
    -- ONLY when the spend succeeds, so a refused (short purse) buy never grants a
    -- free item. Price has only an upper clamp (1e6 in tmSpendGold); a cheap price
    -- is the GM's call. Non-greedy label so Korean labels with stray chars survive.
    output = output:gsub("▥SHOP:buyq:(.-)|(%d+)|(%d+)▥", function(rawLabel, unitPriceStr, qtyStr)
        local total = tmServiceQuantityTotalPrice(unitPriceStr, qtyStr)
        tmApplyServiceBuyQuantityTransaction(triggerId, rawLabel, total, qtyStr, "shop_buyq", "main_writer")
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SHOP:buy:(.-)|(%d+)▥", function(rawLabel, priceStr)
        tmApplyServiceTransaction(triggerId, "buy", "none", rawLabel, priceStr, "shop_buy", "main_writer")
        return ""
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥SHOP:sell:([^|▥]+)|(%d+)▥", function(itemRef, priceStr)
        return tmApplyShopSellMarker(triggerId, itemRef, priceStr)
    end)

    output = output:gsub("▥NPC_RESOLVE:.-▥", "")

    output = tmStripHpMpCompatibilityLeaks(triggerId, output)

    local llmRollMetas = {}
    local previousRollActionIntentDetail = TM_ROLL_ACTION_INTENT_DETAIL_ALLOWED
    TM_ROLL_ACTION_INTENT_DETAIL_ALLOWED = true
    local combatRollMeta = getVar(triggerId, "last_roll_meta", "")
    local function applyRollMarkerToOutput(actorId, statKey, dc, reason)
        local meta = tmApplyRollMarker(triggerId, actorId, statKey, dc, reason)
        if meta ~= "" then table.insert(llmRollMetas, meta) end
        local card = tmRollMetaToHtml(meta)
        return card ~= "" and ("\n" .. card .. "\n") or ""
    end

    output = output:gsub("▥ROLL:([%w_]+)|([^|]+)|(%d+)|(.-)▥", applyRollMarkerToOutput)

    output = output:gsub("▥ROLL:([%w_]+):(.-):(%d+):(.-)▥", applyRollMarkerToOutput)

    output = output:gsub("<<ROLL:([%w_]+)|([^|>]+)|(%d+)|([^>]*)>>", applyRollMarkerToOutput)

    output = output:gsub("<<ROLL:([%w_]+):(.-):(%d+):([^>]+)>>", applyRollMarkerToOutput)

    local function applyLooseRollMarkerToOutput(payload)
        local actorId, statKey, dc, reason = tmParseLooseRollPayload(triggerId, payload)
        if not actorId then
            local detail = "why=unparsed_loose_roll|payload=" .. tmRollReasonText(payload)
            setVar(triggerId, "tm_last_roll_marker_error", detail)
            print("[TRPGMaster] rejected ROLL marker: " .. detail)
            return ""
        end
        return applyRollMarkerToOutput(actorId, statKey, dc, reason)
    end

    output = output:gsub("▥ROLL%s+(.-)▥", applyLooseRollMarkerToOutput)

    output = output:gsub("▥ROLL:%s*(.-)▥", applyLooseRollMarkerToOutput)

    output = output:gsub("<<ROLL%s+([^>]-)>>", applyLooseRollMarkerToOutput)

    output = output:gsub("<<ROLL:%s*([^>]-)>>", applyLooseRollMarkerToOutput)
    TM_ROLL_ACTION_INTENT_DETAIL_ALLOWED = previousRollActionIntentDetail

    if #llmRollMetas > 0 then
        tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, table.concat(llmRollMetas, "\n"))
    elseif combatRollMeta == "" then
        tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, "")
    end

    return output
end

function tmStripHpMpCompatibilityLeaks(triggerId, output)
    local text = tostring(output or "")
    text = text:gsub("▥HP:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("▥MP:.-▥", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<HP:[^>]+>>", "")
    text = text:gsub("<<MP:[^>]+>>", "")
    return text
end

function tmStripTRPGMarkersWithoutApply(output)
    local text = tostring(output or "")
    text = text:gsub("(▥([%u_]+).-▥)", function(full, name)
        return TM_TRPG_STRIP_MARKER_NAMES[name] and "" or full
    end)
    text = text:gsub("(<<([%u_]+)[^>]*>>)", function(full, name)
        return TM_TRPG_STRIP_MARKER_NAMES[name] and "" or full
    end)
    return text
end
