-- === SECTION 12: listenEdit Dispatcher ===

listenEdit("editInput", async(function(triggerId, data)
    pcall(tmLoadLatestStateFromHistory, triggerId)
    local input = tmStripSaveSeedTags(data or "")
    if getVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_pending", "false") == "true" then
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_generating", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_custom_class_input_error", "")
    end
    if tmHandleCustomScenarioInput(triggerId, input) then
        return ""
    end
    local addressee = parseAddressee(input)
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal")
    setVar(triggerId, "last_user_input", input)
    setVar(triggerId, "last_addressee", addressee or "")
    setVar(triggerId, "active_scene_heroines", computeActiveHeroines(triggerId, addressee))
    pcall(tmRefreshNaiGuideText, triggerId)
    if mode == "trpg" then
        tmRecordScenarioWrapupDeclaration(triggerId, input)
        input = dispatchTRPGInput(triggerId, input)
    else
        tmSetRollMeta(triggerId, "")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_pending", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "tm_input_roll_summary", "")
    end
    return input
end))

listenEdit("editRequest", function(triggerId, data)
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal")
    if TM_PANEL_LLM_IN_PROGRESS == true then
        return data
    end
    pcall(tmRefreshNaiGuideText, triggerId)
    tmCaptureRequestSaveSeed(triggerId, data)
    -- RisuAI editRequest data shape: OpenAIChat[] array of {role, content}
    -- (scriptings.ts:1299 <T extends string|OpenAIChat[]>)
    -- Inject system prompt at position 1 with table.insert
    if type(data) == "table" and data[1] and data[1].role then
        for _, message in ipairs(data) do
            if type(message) == "table" and type(message.content) == "string" then
                message.content = tmSanitizeRenderedUiForRequest(message.content)
            end
        end
        if mode == "trpg" then
            tmPrepareTurnDicePool(triggerId)
        end
        local prompt = (mode == "trpg") and buildTRPGSessionPrompt(triggerId) or buildNormalModePrompt(triggerId)
        table.insert(data, 1, {role = "system", content = prompt})
    elseif type(data) == "string" then
        data = tmSanitizeRenderedUiForRequest(data)
    end
    return data
end)

listenEdit("editOutput", function(triggerId, data)
    TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_IN_PROGRESS = true
    pcall(tmRestoreRequestSaveSeedForOutput, triggerId)
    local output = tmStripSaveSeedTags(data or "")
    output = tmStripInternalGuideBlocks(output)
    output = tmStripControlMarkers(output)
    output = output:gsub("{{button::", "\\{button: ")
    output = output:gsub("tm%-control%-panel", "llm-generated-text")
    output = output:gsub("tm%-party%-grid", "llm-generated-text")
    output = stripAndApplySceneMarkers(triggerId, output)
    output = stripAndApplyCharacterSheetMarkers(triggerId, output)
    local mode = getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal")
    if mode == "trpg" then
        output = stripAndApplyTRPGMarkers(triggerId, output)
    else
        output = tmStripTRPGMarkersWithoutApply(output)
    end
    if mode == "trpg" then
        local stripped, applied = stripAndApplyAffinityMarkers(triggerId, output)
        output = stripped
        output = tmReplaceInternalSpeakerLabels(triggerId, output)
        if not applied then
            local active = getVar(triggerId, "active_scene_heroines", table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","))
            for id in active:gmatch("[^,]+") do
                local delta = heuristicTRPGAffectionDelta(triggerId, id, output)
                if delta ~= 0 then modifyAffection(triggerId, id, delta) end
            end
        end
        output = tmAppendIllustrationWaitMarker(triggerId, output)
        TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_IN_PROGRESS = false
        return tmAppendSaveSeedTag(triggerId, output)
    end
    if mode ~= "normal" then
        output = tmReplaceInternalSpeakerLabels(triggerId, output)
        output = tmAppendIllustrationWaitMarker(triggerId, output)
        TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_IN_PROGRESS = false
        return tmAppendSaveSeedTag(triggerId, output)
    end

    -- (1) LLM-emitted markers (authoritative)
    local stripped, applied = stripAndApplyAffinityMarkers(triggerId, output)
    output = stripped
    output = tmReplaceInternalSpeakerLabels(triggerId, output)

    -- (2) Heuristic fallback if LLM didn't emit markers
    local active = getVar(triggerId, "active_scene_heroines", table.concat(CHAR_IDS, ","))
    if not applied then
        for id in active:gmatch("[^,]+") do
            local delta = heuristicEmotionDelta(triggerId, id, output)
            if delta ~= 0 then modifyAffection(triggerId, id, delta) end
        end
    end

    output = tmAppendIllustrationWaitMarker(triggerId, output)
    TM_SAVE_OUTPUT_IN_PROGRESS = false
    return tmAppendSaveSeedTag(triggerId, output)
end)

-- FB-10: standing-image caption — TRPG 모드: "PC이름 (플레이어이름)", 일상 모드: 플레이어이름
function tmCharacterImageCaption(triggerId, ownerId)
    local playerName = CHAR_NAMES_KO[ownerId] or ownerId
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal") == "trpg" then
        local pcName = tmVisiblePcName(triggerId, ownerId)
        if pcName ~= "" and pcName ~= "미정" then
            return pcName .. " (" .. playerName .. ")"
        end
    end
    return playerName
end

function tmCharacterImageLevelBadgeHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal") ~= "trpg" then return "" end
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false") ~= "true" then return "" end
    local level = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_level", 1)
    return '<span class="tm-standing-level">Lv ' .. tostring(level) .. '</span>'
end

function tmNormalizeRisuOutfitToken(outfit)
    local token = tostring(outfit or "")
    if token == "maid_cosplay" then return "maid" end
    return token
end

TM_RISU_IMAGE_EMOTION_ALIASES = {
    nervous = "anxious",
    confident = "proud",
    annoyed = "frustrated",
}

function tmNormalizeRisuEmotionToken(emotion)
    local token = tostring(emotion or "")
    return TM_RISU_IMAGE_EMOTION_ALIASES[token] or token
end

function tmSplitCharacterImageAssetName(triggerId, assetName)
    local raw = tostring(assetName or "")
    local ownerId = raw:match("^([a-z]+)_")
    if not ownerId or TM_COMPRESSED_OWNER_SET[ownerId] ~= true then return nil, nil, nil end
    local rest = raw:sub(#ownerId + 2)
    local outfits = tmRisuImageGuideOutfits(triggerId)
    table.insert(outfits, "maid_cosplay")
    table.sort(outfits, function(a, b) return #a > #b end)
    for _, outfit in ipairs(outfits) do
        local normalizedOutfit = tmNormalizeRisuOutfitToken(outfit)
        for _, candidate in ipairs({outfit, normalizedOutfit}) do
            local suffix = "_" .. candidate
            if rest:sub(-#suffix) == suffix then
                local poseOrEmotion = rest:sub(1, #rest - #suffix)
                if poseOrEmotion ~= "" then
                    return ownerId, poseOrEmotion, normalizedOutfit
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil, nil, nil
end

function tmNormalizeCharacterImageAssetName(triggerId, assetName)
    local raw = tostring(assetName or "")
    local ownerId, poseOrEmotion, outfit = tmSplitCharacterImageAssetName(triggerId, raw)
    if ownerId and poseOrEmotion and outfit then
        poseOrEmotion = tmNormalizeRisuEmotionToken(poseOrEmotion)
        return ownerId .. "_" .. poseOrEmotion .. "_" .. outfit
    end
    return raw
end

function tmResolveCharacterImageAssetName(triggerId, assetName)
    return tmNormalizeCharacterImageAssetName(triggerId, assetName)
end

function tmStandingCharacterVitalsHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal") ~= "trpg" then return "" end
    if getVar(triggerId, "character_setup_complete", "false") ~= "true" then return "" end
    local hpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_hp_max", 0)
    local mpMax = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. ownerId .. "_mp_max", 0)
    if hpMax <= 0 and mpMax <= 0 then return "" end
    return '<div class="tm-standing-vitals">' .. tmPlayerVitalsBarsHtml(triggerId, ownerId) .. '</div>'
end

function tmHideRenderedTrpgPanelOpenTags(text, className)
    local function hideTag(tag)
        if tag:match('style%s*=') then
            return tag:gsub('style%s*=%s*"', 'style="display:none !important; ', 1)
        end
        return tag:gsub(">$", ' style="display:none !important;">')
    end
    local out = tostring(text or "")
    out = out:gsub('(<div[^>]-class%s*=%s*"[^"]*' .. className .. '[^"]*"[^>]*>)', hideTag)
    out = out:gsub("(<div[^>]-class%s*=%s*'[^']*" .. className .. "[^']*'[^>]*>)", hideTag)
    return out
end

function tmHideRenderedTrpgPanelsForDaily(triggerId, text)
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal") ~= "normal" then return text end
    local out = tostring(text or "")
    out = tmHideRenderedTrpgPanelOpenTags(out, "tm%-roll%-result")
    out = tmHideRenderedTrpgPanelOpenTags(out, "tm%-combat%-result")
    out = tmHideRenderedTrpgPanelOpenTags(out, "tm%-panel%-engine%-card")
    return out
end

function tmDisplayTextNeedsImageWrapOrPanelHide(triggerId, text)
    local raw = tostring(text or "")
    if raw == "" then return false end
    if raw:find(TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER, 1, true) then return true end
    if raw:find('<img="', 1, true) then return true end
    if getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal") == "normal" then
        if raw:find("tm-roll-result", 1, true) then return true end
        if raw:find("tm-combat-result", 1, true) then return true end
        if raw:find("tm-panel-engine-card", 1, true) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

function tmWrapCharacterImages(triggerId, text)
    local out = tostring(text or "")
    if not tmDisplayTextNeedsImageWrapOrPanelHide(triggerId, out) then
        return out
    end
    if out:find(TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER, 1, true) then
        out = out:gsub("\n?" .. TM_FIRST_SESSION_READY_MARKER, "")
    end
    local function wrapIllustrationImage(assetName)
        return '<div class="tm-illustration-image trs-compat"><img src="{{raw::' .. assetName .. '.webp}}" alt="' .. assetName .. '"></div>'
    end
    out = out:gsub('<img="(pt_[%w_]+)">', wrapIllustrationImage)
    out = out:gsub('<img="(bg_[%w_]+)">', wrapIllustrationImage)
    for _, ownerId in ipairs(CHAR_IDS) do
        out = out:gsub('<img="(' .. ownerId .. '[%w_]*)">', function(assetName)
            local caption = tmEscapeHtml(tmCharacterImageCaption(triggerId, ownerId)) .. tmCharacterImageLevelBadgeHtml(triggerId, ownerId)
            local srcAssetName = tmResolveCharacterImageAssetName(triggerId, assetName)
            return '<div class="yp-character-image trs-compat"><img src="{{raw::' .. srcAssetName .. '.webp}}" alt="' .. assetName .. '"><span class="tm-standing-caption">' .. caption .. '</span>' .. tmStandingCharacterVitalsHtml(triggerId, ownerId) .. '</div>'
        end)
    end
    out = tmHideRenderedTrpgPanelsForDaily(triggerId, out)
    return out
end

listenEdit("editDisplay", function(triggerId, data)
    local ok, result = pcall(tmWrapCharacterImages, triggerId, data)
    if ok and result then return result end
    return data
end)

function tmShouldAutoRefreshSessionPanel(triggerId)
    return getVar(triggerId, "session_started", "false") == "true"
        and getVar(triggerId, "game_mode", "normal") == "trpg"
        and getVar(triggerId, "tm_first_session_loading_hold", "false") ~= "true"
        and getVar(triggerId, "action_locked", "false") ~= "true"
end

onOutput = async(function(triggerId)
    pcall(tmRefreshNaiGuideText, triggerId)
    if tmShouldAutoRefreshSessionPanel(triggerId) then
        local ok, result, err = pcall(tmGenerateSessionPanel, triggerId, {auto = true})
        if not ok then
            print("[TRPGMaster] auto session panel refresh failed: " .. tostring(result))
        elseif result ~= true and err ~= nil and tostring(err) ~= "" then
            print("[TRPGMaster] auto session panel refresh failed: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end
    pcall(tmClearIllustrationWaitMarkerFromLastChar, triggerId)
    tmRefreshControlPanelDisplay(triggerId, {reload = false})
end)

-- === SECTION 11: Lorebook Activation + Dungeon + NSFW ===

-- Enemy source of truth is the compact runtime enemy id plus optional display
-- name. The LLM supplies scene flavor; Lua derives combat stats from formula IDs.

-- tmFetchEnemySheet: legacy/custom-module compatibility only. Core TRPGMaster no
-- longer ships a large ENEMY lorebook catalog.
-- Older module ENEMY entries can still be parsed when present.
-- Previous behavior pulled all comment=="ENEMY" lorebook entries via the host
-- getLoreBooks API and return the parsed sheet whose ID (or entry name) matches
-- enemyId. Returns nil on any failure (host API missing/unavailable, no match,
-- empty result) so the caller can fall back to defaults — combat never breaks.
function tmFetchEnemySheet(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return nil end
    if type(getLoreBooks) ~= "function" then return nil end
    -- getLoreBooks can json.decode(nil) when no character is selected -> pcall.
    local ok, books = pcall(getLoreBooks, triggerId, "ENEMY")
    if not ok or type(books) ~= "table" then return nil end
    -- primary match: parsed ID field
    for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.content then
            local sheet = parseSheet(entry.content)
            if sheet.ID == enemyId then return sheet end
        end
    end
    -- fallback match: lorebook entry name field
    for _, entry in ipairs(books) do
        if type(entry) == "table" and entry.name == enemyId and entry.content then
            return parseSheet(entry.content)
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- === en_l enemy formula ===
-- en_l{band}_{tier}_{ctype}: formula enemies generated by the LLM and validated
-- by Lua. band is the party level band 1-5 (NOT eq_l-style level); ctype is
-- flavor only and never moves stats.

TM_ENEMY_CTYPES = { beast = true, construct = true, undead = true, lesser_folk = true,
    spirit = true, humanoid = true, plant = true, dragonkin = true, ooze = true, fiend = true }

-- ATK flat integers = atkToInt() of the band dice 1d4+1/1d6+2/1d8+3/2d6+3/2d8+4
TM_ENEMY_ATK_BY_BAND = { [1] = 3, [2] = 5, [3] = 7, [4] = 10, [5] = 13 }

-- HP LUT derived from the 102 static sheets (interpolated cells: fragile[1],
-- standard[5], apex[1], apex[2]).
TM_ENEMY_HP_LUT = {
    fragile  = { [1] = 9,  [2] = 20, [3] = 34, [4] = 48, [5] = 66 },
    standard = { [1] = 12, [2] = 22, [3] = 36, [4] = 50, [5] = 70 },
    heavy    = { [1] = 14, [2] = 28, [3] = 42, [4] = 56, [5] = 74 },
    apex     = { [1] = 16, [2] = 30, [3] = 46, [4] = 60, [5] = 78 },
}

-- DC: 9 + 2*band + (band>=2 and 2 or 0) -> 11/15/17/19/21
function tmEnemyDcFor(band)
    return 9 + 2 * band + (band >= 2 and 2 or 0)
end

-- tmParseEnemyFormulaId: nil on anything that is not en_l grammar (caller keeps
-- legacy defaults). Token errors inside valid grammar are repaired, never rejected.
function tmParseEnemyFormulaId(enemyId)
    local id = tostring(enemyId or "")
    if #id == 0 or #id > 32 then return nil end
    local n, tier, ctype = id:match("^en_l(%d%d?)_([a-z]+)_([a-z_]+)$")
    if not n then return nil end
    n = tonumber(n)
    if n >= 6 then n = math.ceil(n / 2) end -- level(6-10) misuse -> band
    local band = clamp(n, 1, 5)
    if not TM_ENEMY_HP_LUT[tier] then tier = "standard" end
    if not TM_ENEMY_CTYPES[ctype] then ctype = "beast" end
    return { band = band, tier = tier, ctype = ctype }
end

-- tmEnemyDisplayName: ▥ENEMY_NAME:...▥ stores a Korean display name; missing or
-- broken name falls back to the raw id so display never breaks.
function tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return enemyId end
    local name = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_name", enemyId)
    if tmUseStoredVisibleText(triggerId, name) and not tmLooksLikeInternalEnemyId(name) then return name end
    return tmRuntimeObjectFallbackName(triggerId, "enemy", enemyId)
end

function loadEnemy(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return false end
    setVar(triggerId, "current_enemy", enemyId)
    -- Only seed on first encounter; preserves HP/DC/ATK of an already-spawned
    -- enemy across turns (resolveCombat mutates enemy_<id>_hp in place).
    if getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", -1) < 0 then
        local sheet = tmFetchEnemySheet(triggerId, enemyId)
        -- Legacy/custom enemy sheets may still provide a display NAME so logs
        -- do not show the raw id. A later ENEMY_NAME marker may overwrite it.
        if sheet and sheet.NAME and sheet.NAME ~= "" then
            setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_name", sheet.NAME)
        end
        local hp = sheet and tonumber(sheet.HP) or 20
        local dc = sheet and tonumber(sheet.DC) or 13
        local atk = sheet and atkToInt(sheet.ATK) or 4
        if not sheet then
            -- Formula path: current core enemies should arrive as en_l ids.
            -- Unknown legacy ids keep the safe defaults.
            local formula = tmParseEnemyFormulaId(enemyId)
            if formula then
                hp = TM_ENEMY_HP_LUT[formula.tier][formula.band]
                dc = tmEnemyDcFor(formula.band)
                atk = TM_ENEMY_ATK_BY_BAND[formula.band]
            end
        end
        -- per-field guards: a present-but-garbage HP/DC also falls back
        if not hp or hp <= 0 then hp = 20 end
        if not dc or dc <= 0 then dc = 13 end
        if not atk or atk <= 0 then atk = 4 end
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", hp)
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp_max", hp)
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_dc", dc)
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_atk", atk)
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_xp_awarded", "false")
        setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_gold_awarded", "false")
        if getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_special", "") == "" then
            setVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_special", sheet and (sheet.SPECIAL or sheet.TRAIT or "") or "")
        end
    end
    return true
end

function tmStoreRuntimeEnemyObject(triggerId, enemyId)
    if not enemyId or enemyId == "" then return nil end
    local stats = table.concat({
        "hp=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp", 20)),
        "hp_max=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_hp_max", 20)),
        "dc=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_dc", 13)),
        "atk=" .. tostring(getNumVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_atk", 4)),
        "defeated=" .. getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false"),
    }, ",")
    local state = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_defeated", "false") == "true" and "defeated" or "active"
    local note = getVar(triggerId, "enemy_" .. enemyId .. "_special", "")
    return tmStoreRuntimeObject(triggerId, "enemy", enemyId, tmEnemyDisplayName(triggerId, enemyId), state, stats, note ~= "" and note or "-")
end
-- getEffectiveNsfw: min(global cap, per-char phase) per 004 §14 dual-track
function getEffectiveNsfw(triggerId, charId)
    local globalCap = getNumVar(triggerId, "game_nsfw_level", 0)
    local charPhase = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. charId .. "_nsfw_phase", 0)
    return math.min(globalCap, charPhase)
end

function canUnlockNsfwPhase(triggerId, charId, targetPhase)
    local aff = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. charId .. "_affection", 100)
    local trust = getNumVar(triggerId, "p_" .. charId .. "_trust", 50)
    local threshold_aff = {[0] = 0, [1] = 160, [2] = 240, [3] = 320}
    local threshold_trust = {[0] = 0, [1] = 30, [2] = 60, [3] = 80}
    return aff >= (threshold_aff[targetPhase] or 999)
       and trust >= (threshold_trust[targetPhase] or 999)
end
